jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

The Marketing team at Tide works across multiple markets to drive member acquisition and growth. The team collaborates closely with Product, Engineering, SEO, Design, Legal and other business functions to deliver and optimise digital experiences across Tide's marketing websites.

ABOUT

THE ROLE:

We are looking for a Senior Content Manager with expertise in Contentful CMS (or similar platforms like Drupal/WordPress) to manage website content operations across multiple geographies.

This is a hands-on role spanning CMS management, end-to-end website publishing, and continuous process improvement. You will work closely with Marketing, SEO, Legal, Product, Design and Engineering teams to deliver web experiences, drive CMS enhancements, support website migrations and localisation, and manage marketing technology integrations.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

We’re hiring a Senior Website Content Manager to own how Tide’s website content is built, published and improved across markets. You’ll combine hands-on Contentful expertise with strong project management and stakeholder skills, running day-to-day publishing while making the CMS and workflows better over time.

Responsibilities
• Own Tide’s Contentful CMS and the end-to-end publishing process across markets: intake, scoping, prioritisation, build, QA and go-live.
• Build and maintain pages using existing content models, components and templates, translating Figma designs and business requirements into live pages.
• Manage content structures, assets, references, environments and localisation workflows.
• Run the request pipeline in Jira, balancing campaigns, product launches, SEO work, regulatory updates and BAU, and communicating timelines and dependencies clearly.
• Act as the main CMS contact for Marketing, SEO, Product, Engineering, Design and Legal, and work with Product and Engineering on new capabilities, bugs and enhancements.
• Manage localisation across the UK, India, Germany and France with internal teams and external partners, and support migrations, restructures and new market launches.
• Implement on-page SEO (metadata, headings, internal links, redirects) and support martech integrations such as forms, geo-targeting, personalisation and A/B testing, troubleshooting with Engineering and Analytics.
• Maintain quality and governance through regular audits, publishing checklists, QA standards and brand and accessibility compliance.
• Improve the CMS: identify gaps in content models, components and workflows, build self-service capability, and shape the enhancement roadmap.
• Create and maintain documentation, SOPs and training so stakeholders can work independently.
• Mentor junior team members and manage agency or freelance support.

Requirements
• 5+ years managing web content or CMS platforms in a fast-paced, multi-market environment.
• Hands-on enterprise CMS experience, ideally Contentful (content modelling, components, references, environments, localisation). WordPress or Drupal experience is also relevant.
• Proven end-to-end publishing ownership, with strong prioritisation across competing deadlines.
• Experience working with Marketing, SEO, Legal, Product, Design and Engineering, and turning business needs into clear technical tasks.
• Working knowledge of page structure, responsive layouts and basic HTML/CSS, plus SEO, accessibility and QA best practice.
• Understanding of martech tools (forms, tracking, geo-targeting, personalisation, A/B testing).
• Experience with Jira and Confluence.
• Excellent communication, attention to detail and ability to adapt to changing priorities.

Nice to have
• Website migrations or multi-market launches
• GA4, Hotjar or similar analytics tools
• SSR, CDN and deployment concepts
• Copywriting or editing experience
• Experience in a regulated industry such as fintech

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
• Competitive salary
• Self Family Health Insurance
• Term Life Insurance
• OPD Benefits
• Mental wellbeing through Plumm
• Learning Development Budget
• 15 days of Privilege leaves
• 12 days of Casual leaves
• 12 days of Sick leaves
• 3 paid days off for volunteering or L D activities

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Send Core

jobs.title: Senior Procurement Lead - People & Workplace
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Procurement Lead to join our Third Party Management and Procurement Team in London (UK). 

This role will focus on leading the People & Workplace category comprising or subcategories such as Recruitment, Benefits, Travel, Meals & Entertainment, Facilities. It's a unique opportunity to build on your entrepreneurial and commercial expertise, help deliver Wise’s mission of money without borders, and grow within a global, fast-paced listed company environment while ensuring our key deals deliver the best value for money for Wise.

Wise is a fast growing business so we expect that the right candidate will be able to clearly demonstrate exceptional behaviours and commercial prowess which have resulted in material commercial outcomes in prior organisations. 

Your mission: 

At Wise, our mission is to make money borderless — and Procurement plays a key role in making that happen. We enable smarter, data-driven sourcing decisions that ensure Wise partners with the right suppliers, minimises risk, and drives maximum value from every third-party investment. Our goal? To make buying at Wise as seamless and frictionless as sending money across borders.

Procurement sits within our Third Party Management (TPM) function, alongside Third Party Risk Management, IntraGroup Services, and TPM Tooling. We’re a new and rapidly growing team that supports the business across all third party purchases.

This is your chance to help shape what Procurement looks like at Wise — providing an exceptional standard of customer service, building scalable processes, driving innovation, and helping us create a best-in-class global procurement function from the ground up! 

Your mission is to enable, protect, and empower the business and people of Wise by ensuring Wise’s purchases support our commercial objectives, flow through frictionless processes and deliver the best value for money.

About

the Role:
• Develop and execute long-term procurement strategies that align with Wise's business objectives. This includes conducting market analysis to stay ahead of industry trends and predict shifts in supply and demand.
• Manage a team of 2x Procurement professionals helping them to navigate complexity through effective coaching and development strategies.
• Strategically partner with the business acting as their main point of contact whilst building robust relationships with stakeholders within the organization. Facilitate regular cross-departmental meetings to ensure alignment between procurement strategies and business objectives.
• Lead efforts to achieve cost reductions and optimization of spend across categories. Utilize analytical and financial skills to assess total cost of ownership and budget impact of procurement decisions.
• Evaluate and support selection of suppliers, utilizing robust criteria for quality, price, and reliability.
• Identify opportunities for consolidating suppliers, renegotiating contracts, or initiating new proposals.
• Assisting in the creation of risk mitigation strategies to address supply chain disruptions. Stay informed about political and economic environments impacting supply chains and support the development of contingency plans.
• Stay up to date on initiatives aimed at sustainable and ethical sourcing to enhance Wise's reputation and ensure compliance with relevant standards and regulations.
• Advocate for and implement innovative procurement technologies and process automation to enhance procurement processes, increase efficiency, and reduce manual tasks.
• Mentor and develop procurement team members, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth.
• Ensure all procurement activities comply with internal policies, legal requirements, and industry regulations while promoting integrity and transparency across all operations.
• Stay abreast of industry best practices and leverage them to improve Wise's procurement processes and strategy. Encourage creative problem-solving and new procurement solutions to maximize organizational effectiveness.

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Choose your path to impact. As a Lead You’ll take ownership from day one. Of course, you will have feedback from smart, curious people across Wise but you’ll experience unique levels of ownership and empowerment within your role.
• Be extremely hands on. No far away leaders in Wise, and in this role you’d be expected to take on the work yourself.
• Be part of our mission to make money without borders the new normal.

jobs.title: Engineering Operations Manager: Large-Scale Programmes, SOX & Controls
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Technical Programme Manager to lead large-scale engineering programmes and help engineering tribes improve planning, prioritisation and delivery.

You’ll turn broad priorities into clear plans, work through technical dependencies and help teams resolve risks and competing priorities. You’ll also lead technology control improvements, working with engineering and specialists in Risk, Compliance and Audit on requirements including SOX and IT General Controls.

This role suits someone who takes initiative, brings structure to ambiguous problems and follows delivery through to completion. You’ll be comfortable working closely with engineers, challenging incomplete plans and making sure decisions lead to action.

How we work

You’ll join a small Engineering Operations team, working across engineering and business functions. We bring clarity to complex work through practical planning, clear ownership and consistent follow-through.

You’ll partner with tribe leadership on planning and operational improvements, and coordinate delivery with engineering teams and control owners. Engineering teams retain responsibility for technical decisions, while control owners remain accountable for control execution and evidence.

What you’ll achieve:
• Lead complex technical programmes. Turn broad priorities into clear outcomes, scope, workstreams and milestones. Drive delivery across engineering teams, from initial planning and technical dependencies through rollout and ongoing operations.
• Partner with engineering leaders. Support tribe-level planning, prioritisation and operational reviews, helping teams make realistic commitments and follow through on them.
• Resolve risks and dependencies. Identify blockers early, clarify ownership and bring the right people together to resolve competing priorities and make decisions that keep delivery moving.
• Make progress and decisions clear. Give stakeholders a dependable view of delivery, risks and trade-offs. Challenge unsupported progress updates and escalate issues with clear impact and practical options.
• Deliver technology control improvements. Work with engineering, Risk, Compliance and Audit to translate control requirements, including SOX and IT General Controls, into practical delivery plans. Coordinate remediation, testing readiness and validated closure.
• Improve how engineering operates. Use data and automation to reduce manual reporting and coordination. Build practical frameworks, guidance and training that help teams adopt better ways of working.
• Make changes sustainable. Establish clear ownership, processes and handovers so programme outcomes and control improvements become part of everyday operations.

What you’ll bring:
• A strong track record of independently leading complex technical programmes across multiple engineering teams and business functions, with clear delivery outcomes.
• Enough technical understanding to work through system dependencies, implementation constraints and rollout decisions with engineers.
• Experience working closely with engineering leaders on planning, priorities, dependencies and operational improvements.
• Experience delivering technical programmes involving security, technology risk, regulatory requirements or control improvements. You can work with specialists to turn requirements into engineering plans and follow them through to completion. Direct SOX or ITGC experience is valuable.
• An understanding of control ownership, evidence requirements and the distinction between implementing a change and having it validated for closure.
• The ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear plans, take ownership and drive progress without relying on formal authority.
• Strong stakeholder management and the confidence to challenge unclear ownership, incomplete plans and unsupported progress claims.
• Clear communication, including the ability to facilitate difficult discussions and give leaders concise updates on progress, risks and decisions.
• An analytical approach, using data to identify problems, assess progress and improve ways of working.

You don’t need to meet every requirement. If you bring strong technical programme delivery experience and relevant experience with risk or controls, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead - AML
jobs.description:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you’ll be helping us create an entirely new network for the world’s money — for everyone, everywhere.

Instant, low cost, and convenient are three guiding principles for Wise products. Those same benefits can also attract people looking to misuse financial services for money laundering and other financial crimes. The IMF estimates that up to 5% of world GDP is laundered each year — and Wise is investing in building systems that help detect and stop this activity, while keeping things smooth for legitimate customers.

We’re looking for an Engineering Lead to join our AML Squad and shape how Wise detects money laundering and terrorist financing risk across our products and regions. You’ll lead an existing, cross-functional team responsible for risk detection and alert creation, combining engineering excellence with product thinking and people leadership.

About the Role

The AML Risk team, within the AML Squad at Wise, builds systems and controls that detect money laundering and terrorist financing risks. We use data and our knowledge of criminal behaviour to create effective detection controls and useful alerts. Criminal activity changes quickly — we improve our controls as new risks appear, aiming to detect more real risk, reduce false alerts, and avoid unnecessary friction for legitimate customers.

As the Engineering Lead, you will:
• Lead a team that owns AML risk detection and alert creation
• Set technical direction and drive the team’s roadmap and delivery
• Build reliable and scalable systems that support and evolve Wise’s AML controls
• Partner closely with product managers, data scientists, analysts, and AML subject matter experts to turn risk knowledge into effective controls
• Improve how quickly and accurately Wise detects risk, while balancing effectiveness, false positives, and customer experience

This is a role for someone who can combine hands-on technical leadership, people leadership, and strong ownership of a problem space.

Technical Responsibilities
• Own the team’s technical roadmap, ensuring AML detection systems are reliable, effective, scalable, and maintainable.
• Lead the development of new detection capabilities to identify emerging patterns of criminal activity.
• Act as a technical expert for AML risk detection and alert creation, guiding the squad’s engineering approach and standards.
• Design systems and tooling that make it easier to create, test, iterate, and measure the impact of AML controls.
• Provide hands-on technical leadership through architectural guidance, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
• Maintain high standards for code quality, consistency, observability, and operational reliability.
• Balance immediate operational needs with long-term architectural investments so the platform evolves without compromising stability.

Leadership Responsibilities
• Lead, coach, and mentor engineers across experience levels, building a culture of technical ownership, continuous improvement, and resilience.
• Partner with product managers, data scientists, analysts, and AML experts to shape priorities and convert problem understanding into deliverable outcomes.
• Help the team navigate complex priorities and trade-offs (e.g., detection effectiveness vs. false alerts vs. delivery speed vs. long-term quality).
• Collaborate with other Engineering Leads and Staff Engineers on wider technical direction and cross-squad initiatives.
• Represent the team across Wise, aligning stakeholders and leading projects from initial idea through to release and iteration.
• Create clarity when priorities are ambiguous, enabling the team to make decisions and stay focused.

jobs.title: Staff ML Scientist / Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a strong technical contributor with a background in machine learning and systems engineering. Bonus point if they owned the roadmap of services/tools used by more than one internal team.

This is a highly autonomous person that identifies low-hanging fruit worth tackling to move us ever closer to the vision they create for the problem-space they own. They must be able to communicate with stakeholders and users, steer short-term deliveries without compromising milestones in the roadmap, set guidelines and standards.

They collaborate with Data Science Leads to align work that would otherwise be siloed. They review experiments and design documents to improve projects from the get-go. 

This role is a unique opportunity to scale and advance the impact of Data Science in Servicing tribe – namely Fincrime, KYC and Customer Support squads. What you build will have a direct impact on Wise’s mission and millions of our customers.

About

the Role:

Our team exists to enable hundreds of specialized risk ML models – their lifecycle, governance and interface with compliance – while removing as much of the maintenance toil from Data Scientist and product teams.

We split the work in two tracks: Labels and Models
• Labels: central platform for risk labels
• Models: libraries and services to experiment, eval, promote and track models

Historically Wise is a company of very autonomous and distributed teams, which means different implementations exist to prevent and mitigate risk vectors.

We’ve invested a lot into centralizing risk assessments and their inputs (features) and have strong adoption from FinCrime, Verification, Mitigation and Global Products teams.

We’re now expanding this investment to the next critical component in scaling Wise: more and better ML /AI while keeping auditors and regulators happy.

Here’s how you’ll be contributing:
• Software engineering: e.g. testing + CI/CD, monitoring/alerting + disaster recovery
• MLOps: Terraform and AWS infra, ML governance for hundreds of models
• Data Engineering: distributed processing at terabyte scale
• Science: drive experiments to prove value of new methodologies / algorithms applied to cross-team domains

You will drive high-priority projects from proof-of-concept to MVP, to service / tooling, estimate and measure impact.

jobs.title: FinCrime Quality Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a FinCrime Quality Senior Specialist to join our growing team. 

The primary function of the QC Senior Specialist is to empower and support the QC team, ensuring that quality processes and operational efficiency are consistently maintained and improved. This entails identifying areas of improvement related to quality processes, documentation, and operational workflows to enhance both customer experience and business outcomes. The role is critical in conducting Check-the-Checker (CTC) reviews and organising calibration sessions to uphold and elevate the quality standards of the team. The QC Senior Specialist is responsible for overseeing the resolution of disputes, ensuring all resolutions are aligned with established quality standards and organisational procedures. Additionally, this role provides mentorship and guidance to team members, particularly new hires during their onboarding process, by helping them understand their roles and performing accreditation for their competencies. By fostering a robust quality culture and working closely with internal and external stakeholders, the QC Senior Specialist ensures that the QC team remains competent, compliant, and focused on continuous improvement. The position also involves collaborating with variou functions such as Training, Knowledge Management (KM), Continuous Improvement (CI), and reporting directly to the Quality Team Lead to drive the implementation of the quality management strategy and framework across the organisation.

Activities performed on the job
• Performs CTC (Check-the-checker)
• Conduct regular quality checks on QC Specialists, vendors and products, to assure work quality in a timely manner.
• Provides constructive feedback to QC Specialists for performance improvement and to ensure QC teams remain consistent.
• Identifies repeated errors and compliance risks and escalates to compliance oversight from CTC and regular quality reviews.
• Manages and responds to QC review disputes and makes necessary corrections if needed
• Reviews and closes disputes in a timely manner and responds to Operations accordingly.
• Demonstrates attention to detail to objectively review cases and provide feedback that is constructive and considers the operational agent’s perspective.
• Arrange and lead calibration sessions for QC Specialists
• Owns calibration sessions and is responsible to ensure team alignment on how to use the Quality Control Framework for consistent reviews and results.
• Is responsible to organise and run bi-weekly calibration sessions, assess how well the team is calibrated, work with peers to ensure all teams (including internal / vendor) are calibrated.
• Is responsible for maintaining comprehensive documentation on calibration discussions including but not limited to: cases calibrated, final decisions and actions items proposed.
• Works closely with QC Specialists by collaborating on difficult cases and contributing constructively to discussions to improve alignment and performance across the team.
• In situations where consensus is challenging to achieve and team members are indecisive or calibration is misaligned, QC Senior Specialist is responsible for making well-informed decisions and upholding the grading guidelines.
• Training & mentoring
• Assists in onboarding new joiners and mentoring specialists.
• Creates structured training plans that help new employees understand the QC processes and their specific roles. This includes developing schedules that cover necessary training sessions, workshops, and introductory meetings.
• Prepares and leads training sessions that might include job-specific skills, software tutorials. These sessions aim to equip the new joiners with the skills and knowledge necessary to perform their duties efficiently.
• Organises training sessions to equip new joiners with domain specific knowledge.
• Ensures that newcomers receive all necessary materials, such as manuals, guidelines, and access to online resources, to assist them in their learning and integration process.
• Acts as a mentor to new employees, offering support and guidance. This might involve answering questions about grading guidelines and QC procedures, providing feedback, and assisting with problem-solving during the initial phases of their journey.
• Introduces new joiners to key team members and stakeholders within the organization. Facilitates networking opportunities can help new joiners build important relationships and integrate more quickly into the team.
• Evaluates the knowledge, skills, and capabilities of new team members to determine their readiness to undertake their roles and responsibilities (accreditation).
• Facilitates knowledge transfer sessions to share expertise, industry insights, and lessons learned with team members, contributing to their professional development and growth within the organization.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Contact Automation - AI
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Contact Automation team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of customer support at Wise. You'll be a key technical leader in an autonomous team, driving the vision and end-to-end solutions for the Wise Assistant. This is a high-impact role where you'll tackle complex engineering challenges to automate real customer issues, significantly improving their experience and our operational efficiency.

How We Work
• Agile & Collaborative: We operate in an agile fashion, fostering close collaboration between engineers, product managers, content designers, analysts, and data scientists.
• Cross-Functional Teams: You'll work alongside talented individuals to design, build, and iterate on solutions that deliver tangible customer value.

• Integrate & Orchestrate: Lead and manage the technical integration with third-party AI Agent vendors, ensuring seamless and robust connectivity.
• Scale & Optimize: Continuously improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of our automation platform to handle growing volumes and complexity.
• Collaborate for Impact: Work closely with content designers to implement and refine automated conversational flows, ensuring a high-quality user experience.
• Mentor: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers, fostering a culture of engineering excellence and continuous learning.

jobs.title: Lead, Markets Control & Analytics
jobs.description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission
As Markets Control Analytics Lead, you will drive P L transparency, pricing and hedging analytics, front-to-back operational KPIs, and robust control frameworks across traditional and digital asset classes. You'll get to turn complex trading data into actionable insights, strengthen P L transparency and build automated, scalable processes that improve trading performance and support better business decisions.

What you’ll do
• P L Performance: Own the daily P L process across all asset classes, including production, validation, reconciliation, variance analysis, attribution and trader sign-off.
• Trading Analytics TCA: Analyse pricing, hedging, inventory and FX performance, including execution quality, spreads and trading costs, to identify opportunities for P L improvement.
• Operational KPIs Dashboards: Define and monitor front-to-back KPIs across Trading, Operations, Custody and Settlement, building dashboards that drive transparency, efficiency and scalability.
• Controls Automation: Establish robust P L and KPI controls, automate reporting and collaborate with Trading, Treasury, Risk, Data and Engineering to ensure data integrity and operational excellence.
• GL Reconciliation: Own the monthly Trading P L-to-General Ledger reconciliation across products, partnering with Accounting to ensure accurate valuation, realised P L and financial reporting.

Who you are
• Education: Degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting or a related field; CFA, CPA or ACCA is a plus.
• Experience:

7+ years in front-office (e.g., Quant Trading) or middle-office (e.g., Product Control, Trading Operations) roles within banking, trading or fintech.
• Markets Knowledge: Strong understanding of trading P L, hedging and inventory risk across asset classes, including P L bases such as cash, FIFO, average cost and mark-to-market. Experience with crypto, stablecoins, precious metals or FX is a plus.
• Technical

Skills:

Proficient in Excel, SQL, Python or similar tools, with experience in analytics, dashboards and automation.
• Mindset: Hands-on, analytical and entrepreneurial, with the ownership and drive to build and scale a high-impact function.

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Frontend (Banking)
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level - from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you’ll do

As a Frontend Engineer on the Banking Experience team, you’ll build and scale the web and mobile features our banking customers rely on every day. We’re a customer-obsessed, full-stack team: you’ll own features from user experience through data models and metrics, working closely with Product, Design and various platform teams. You’ll use data to decide what to build, advocate for customers, and help us launch into new markets. We’re looking for engineers who care as much about the product as the code, and who want to drive direct business impact with a high quality bar.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities:
• Work with engineers across the company to build new features and products.
• Work side-by-side with user facing teams (Sales, Support) to best understand the needs of our customers.
• Design and implement experiments to improve our customer’s experiences.
• Own problems end-to-end, thinking through everything from user experience, data models, scalability, operability and ongoing metrics.
• Tune and polish features to a high-degree of excellence
• Data driven outcomes

Requirements:
• 4+ years of professional experience architecting, developing, and testing client-side code end to end
• Experience developing software for the Web platform, including cross-browser compatibility
• Experience with modern tools like ES6+, React, GraphQL, Webpack, Vite, React Native (not a hard requirement)
• Uphold our high engineering standards
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Compensation:

The expected salary range for this role is $152,000 - $190,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: AI Development Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Key Responsibilities

 

- Ship features on either side of the stack — gateway routing, MCP servers, agent workflows, knowledge base, or a user-facing AI feature.

- Build the evals that prove a prompt or retrieval change actually helped, before it reaches users.

- Prototype in days, then add the tests and logging that let it run unattended in production.

- Pull adoption, cost, and quality data, and report what you find — including when it contradicts the story.

- Talk to the people using what you build, internal or external; their complaints are the roadmap.

 

Requirements

 

Must have

- Built something real with LLM APIs: prompting, streaming, tool calling, failure handling.

- Git, tests, and debugging to root cause instead of guessing.

- SQL and enough data sense to spot an outlier skewing an average.

 

Nice to have

- Agent frameworks or MCP; daily use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor).

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

About the Role

*Pls kindly note this role has no base salary, it's commission based

We are looking for a internationally minded Regional Business Development Specialist to drive the expansion of Bybit’s payments ecosystem across MENA and emerging global corridors. This role will focus on merchant acquisition, local payment partnerships, PSP integrations, and strategic growth initiatives for Bybit Pay, Card, and Fiat channels.

The ideal candidate has deep experience in payments, fintech, or crypto, strong local market understanding, and a proven track record of driving regional growth.

 

Key

Responsibilities:
• Support market expansion for Bybit Pay across global, building and owning the full growth pipeline
• Acquire and manage merchants, PSPs, payment gateways, fintech partners, Web3 projects, community leaders, and other growth channels.
• Drive the end-to-end BD cycle: market mapping, lead generation, pitching, negotiation, and partnership execution.
• Collaborate with internal teams (Product, Card, Fiat Channels, Compliance, Payments Ops, Marketing) to activate and scale payment use cases.
• Develop regional GTM strategies and identify high-potential payment corridors for crypto-to-fiat and fiat-to-crypto flows.
• Support cross-border payment products, including settlement channels, payout solutions, and merchant integrations.
• Provide market intelligence, partner feedback, and competitive analysis to optimize product direction.
• Represent Bybit in industry events, conferences, and ecosystem partnerships.

Requirements:
• 1+ years of experience in payments / fintech / PSP / acquiring / merchant growth / crypto BD.
• Long-term overseas work or study experience (must-have).
• Strong understanding of local payment rails, fiat/crypto conversion flows, card programs, and merchant needs.
• Demonstrated success in driving regional growth or launching payment products in multiple markets.
• Ability to work independently and thrive in fast-paced, high-ownership environments.
• Native local language proficiency + strong English communication skills.
• Network across fintech, Web3, PSPs, acquirers, or merchant ecosystems is highly preferred.

 

Preferred Qualifications
• Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements for payments and cross-border movement.
• Background working in global remote teams.
• Prior experience with crypto exchanges, payment gateways, or card programs.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

jobs.title: [Intern] Big Data Development Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Key

Responsibilities:
• Assess the Status Quo — Develop an end-to-end understanding of the campaign lifecycle and available data assets; identify all decision points currently reliant on manual judgment (opportunity identification, audience selection, budget estimation, campaign mechanics design, post-campaign review) and determine where intelligent automation yields the highest return.
• What Campaign to Run — Mine campaign opportunities from user behavior, product and market signals, and historical campaign performance; build an AI Agent that outputs candidate campaign themes with clear supporting evidence, not just a ranked list.
• Who to Target — Build or reuse user segmentation and response/propensity models; apply uplift modeling to direct budget toward truly incremental audiences who would be influenced, rather than users who would convert anyway.
• How Much Budget — Build a cost-benefit model: projected participation, incremental trading volume / revenue, ROI simulation, budget allocation recommendations, and sensitivity and risk analysis (including abuse and reward-farming risks under incentive designs).
• Feasibility Analysis Plan Design — Translate model outputs into a reviewable proposal: objectives, mechanics, target audience, budget, expected KPIs, and risk control boundaries; align with PM, Growth, and business stakeholders.
• MVP Delivery — Implement the end-to-end pipeline (data → model → recommendation → campaign configuration → A/B or holdout evaluation); run it on at least one real campaign or rigorous backtest; quantify improvement relative to the current manual decision-making baseline.

Requirements:
• Undergraduate or graduate student in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or a related field.
• Solid proficiency in SQL and Python. Experience with real-time / streaming tech stacks (Flink, Kafka) is a plus.
• Data science foundations relevant to this project: A/B experiment design, causal inference and uplift modeling, propensity/response models, and basic predictive modeling. Must be able to distinguish correlation from incremental effect.
• Hands-on experience with LLM application development: prompt engineering, RAG, Agent / tool-calling frameworks; able to use LLMs for reasoning and orchestration on top of quantitative models.
• Business acumen: genuine interest in fintech / crypto and growth marketing; able to translate a business question ("Should we run a trading competition next month?") into a data problem, and translate the conclusion back into an actionable decision for business stakeholders.
• Strong communication skills — this role sits at the intersection of data, PM, and growth/marketing.
• Bonus: experience in growth / CRM / campaign analytics, recommendation systems, or marketing mix modeling background.
• Minimum 3-month internship commitment, 5 days per week on-site.
• Fluent in Mandarin is required.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

jobs.title: Social Lead
jobs.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

Bybit is looking for a Head of Social Media who is equal parts creative visionary and operational leader. This is not a "post and pray" role — you will own the global social strategy for one of the world's top crypto exchanges, lead a distributed team across regions, and be the connective tissue between brand, product, community, and culture.

You will inherit a team that is growing fast, working with external agencies, and navigating the complexity of a global rebrand (Brand 6.0). You'll need to bring structure without killing creativity, and bring creativity without losing accountability.

What You'll Own

Strategy Narrative
• Define and execute Bybit's global social media strategy across X (Twitter), Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and emerging platforms
• Translate complex crypto and fintech concepts into compelling, platform-native content that resonates with traders, retail users, and the broader Web3 community
• Build and maintain Bybit's social voice — bold, credible, and culturally relevant — in alignment with Brand 6.0 guidelines
• Develop channel/product-specific strategies that balance global consistency with regional relevance

Team Leadership Operations
• Lead, mentor, and grow a global social media team (currently ~4–6 members) plus manage relationships with production and influencer agencies and other departments
• Establish clear workflows, content brief processes, and approval protocols to eliminate last-minute requests and ensure quality at scale
• Build and own the content calendar, ensuring alignment with campaigns, product launches, market moments, and executive communications
• Implement SOPs for content creation, agency briefing, influencer collaboration, and crisis response

Campaign Content Execution
• Partner with the Creative team on campaign assets, ensuring briefs are detailed, timely, and actionable
• Oversee influencer strategy — from shortlisting and legal clearance to performance tracking
• Manage the production agency relationship for high-quality video content the internal team cannot produce at speed

Data, OKRs Reporting
• Own social media OKRs: follower growth, organic engagement, share of voice, sentiment, and new user acquisition via social
• Use Sprinklr and native platform analytics to run weekly performance reviews and quarterly post-mortems
• Present social performance to leadership in biweekly reviews; flag risks and opportunities proactively
• Leverage AI tools for trend harvesting, content optimization, and competitive analysis

Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with BU marketing teams (WBU, GBU, PBU) to support product-specific social moments without duplicating effort
• Align with the Strategy Office on global go-to-market strategy and upper-funnel performance
• Coordinate with Legal and Compliance on influencer clearances, regulatory messaging, and market-specific restrictions

What We're Looking For

Must-Have
• 4–8 years of social media experience, with at least 3 years in a leadership role managing a team
• Marketing background — you think in campaigns, narratives, and audience journeys, not just posts
• Proven track record of growing social accounts at scale for a global brand (1M+ followers preferred)
• Strong project management skills — you can run multiple workstreams, manage agencies, and hit deadlines without chaos
• Experience with Sprinklr or equivalent enterprise social media management platforms
• AI-native mindset — you actively use AI tools in your workflow for content, research, and analysis
• Exceptional written and spoken English; additional languages (Arabic, Mandarin, Spanish, Portuguese) are a strong plus

Nice-to-Have
• Experience managing influencer programs end-to-end, including legal and compliance workflows
• Background working with executive communications — writing for or managing the social presence of C-suite spokespeople
• Experience with rebranding or brand evolution at a global company
• Familiarity with OAP/project management systems and cross-functional campaign coordination
• Deep knowledge of crypto, Web3, or fintech — you can write about DeFi, trading products, and market events without needing a translator (optional)

What Makes This Role Unique
• You'll be shaping the social voice of a top-3 global crypto exchange during a pivotal rebranding moment
• Direct access to and collaboration with the executive leadership
• A team that is genuinely invested in getting better — we're building SOPs, improving briefs, and upgrading our tooling (new OAP system launching mid-August)
• Real budget, real agencies, real campaigns — this is not a one-person show
• A culture that values ownership, speed, and creative courage

What We Don't Want
• Someone who needs to be told what to post
• Someone who can't write a content brief or manage an agency
• Someone who treats social as a support function rather than a growth engine
• Someone who can't handle ambiguity or a fast-moving environment

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.

jobs.description:
About the role

Data Engineering sits at the heart of Chime: nearly every product, analytics and AI initiative runs through the data our teams build. As a Director of Engineering, you'll lead Data Foundations and Insights, managing engineering managers and staff engineers who build the foundations the rest of Chime depends on. You'll partner closely with product, analytics, ML and business leaders to make sure our data reflects the true end state of the business for analysts and AI tools alike. And you'll play a core role in Chime's AI transformation, making sure the foundations are built right from day one.

In this role, you can expect to
• Lead and grow an organization of engineering managers and staff engineers, setting a high bar for quality, reliability and ownership.
• Build strong partnerships with product, analytics, ML, risk and business leaders, and keep them confident in what your org delivers.
• Set the multi-year technical vision and roadmap for Chime's data foundations, and tie each investment to business and member outcomes.
• Make sure our data reflects the true end state of the business, so analysts and AI tools can trust it and act on it.
• Shape the data architecture that underpins Chime's AI transformation, making the right foundational calls early.
• Balance competing priorities across many partner teams, making clear trade-offs and explaining them well.
• Hire, coach and develop leaders, and build a team culture of trust, candor and inclusion.

To thrive in this role, you have
• Experience leading engineering organizations through managers, including managing managers and staff-level engineers.
• A track record of building trusted partnerships with cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders, and keeping them aligned through competing priorities.

jobs.description:
About the role

Chime is building a world-class Member Services organization, and the quality of that experience starts long before a member ever reaches an agent. It starts with how well that agent was trained. We're creating this role to raise the bar on two things at once: how consistently training gets delivered across our partner network, and how accountable our BPO partners are for delivering it well. As our Sr. Training Lead, you'll own training governance for Operations and Member Experience, spend real time in the classroom at our vendor sites training new hire agents yourself, and hold our partners' training teams to a higher standard than they've been held to before.

This is a new role on our Learning, Training, and Content Operations team. It's remote, with approximately 30% domestic and international travel to our BPO partner sites.

In this role, you can expect to
• Own training execution across our lines of business, ensuring BPO trainers are facilitating our programs and content as expected, that agents are receiving the support they need during new hire training, that agents are completing training on time, and provide feedback to the Learning team about opportunities.
• Guide a group of BPO master trainer contractors to drive training excellence with BPO training teams.
• Travel to our partner sites roughly 30-40% of the time and train in the room, facilitating new hire classes, delivering Train-the-Trainer ahead of site launches and major releases, and co-facilitating alongside BPO trainers so you see delivery quality firsthand instead of reading about it.
• Own trainer effectiveness at our BPOs end to end, including trainer certification and recertification, training lead calibration, a real observation and coaching cadence, and the decision about who is cleared to teach a Chime class.
• Hold our BPO partners accountable for training delivery the way a vendor manager would: build the scorecard, run the governance cadence with partner training leadership, bring the data to business reviews, and drive corrective action plans when a site misses.
• Measure what matters, using graduation rates (overall and on-time), nesting performance, speed to proficiency, trainer certification rates, and early-tenure quality and performance to find where delivery is breaking down and fix it.
• Partner closely with Learning, Content, Quality, Workforce Management, Partner Operations, and LOB Operations so that launches land on time and agents are ready on day one.
• Diagnose the gaps in how we train today and partner to rebuild the standard, bringing a point of view on what good looks like rather than waiting for it to be defined for you.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 7+ years in training, learning, or talent development within a contact center, BPO, or other high-volume service environment, including hands-on facilitation of new hire classes for frontline agents. You are still comfortable in front of a room.
• Proven experience managing outsourced or BPO partners and holding them accountable for outcomes, including building performance metrics, governance frameworks, scorecards, and corrective action mechanisms. You've had the hard conversation with a vendor and kept the relationship.
• Experience building training governance from the ground up: certification and train-the-trainer programs, facilitation standards, observation and coaching models, and the documentation that makes them hold up over time and under audit.
• Strong coaching skills with other trainers, and the judgment to tell the difference between a content problem, a facilitation problem, and an operations problem.
• Comfort with data, with the ability to evaluate program effectiveness, identify trends across sites and vendors, and translate what you find into business requirements and decisions.
• The ability to influence without authority across internal stakeholders and external partners at every level, from a trainer on the floor to a partner's site leadership.
• Willingness to travel domestically and internationally approximately 30-40% of the time. Experience in financial services, fintech, or another regulated environment is a plus.

• Partner internally with Country MLROs, local compliance teams, operations teams and other stakeholders on high-risk matters, information sharing and investigation strategy.
• Partner with law enforcement agencies and external stakeholders on suspicious activity reporting, information requests, and intelligence sharing.

• Demonstrated ability to perform data-driven investigations using SQL, blockchain analytics tools and other research techniques to extract investigative insights, identify suspicious behaviour and develop defensible conclusions.

jobs.title: Experiential Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About the role

We’re looking for an Experiential Marketing Manager to produce the real-world experiences where traders, creators, partners, and builders meet MetaMask. You’ll lead production, help shape event strategy, and sharpen the creative execution.

What You’ll Do

You’ll join the Experiential Global Events team within MetaMask’s Creative Studio and report to the Director of Experiential Marketing. We concept, design, and produce the ways people meet MetaMask in real life across global conferences, community events, VIP experiences, co-branded activations, and more. Our calendar runs across the world with priorities across APAC, the US, Europe and LATAM. 

You’ll lead production, taking each event from brief to on-site to recap. You’ll work cross-functionally with internal and external teams, rallying people from planning through production and on the ground. Your focus will be experiences for our most active users and co-branded work with brands and creators, alongside community events for the builders who create on MetaMask.

Our formats are expanding to include live trading competitions, viewing events, product launches, and private experiences for VIP traders and creator partners.

How You’ll Do It
• Produce events and experiences end to end: venues, run of show, fabrication, AV, F B, and staffing, working alongside our production agency partners.
• Own timelines, workback plans, and budgets for multiple events running in parallel across regions.
• Source, negotiate with, and manage agencies, venues, and vendors in APAC, the US, Europe and LATAM.
• Run registration and guest management, from guest lists and approvals to VIP access and arrival.
• Build programming for events and panels, including formats, session flow, and speaker coordination.
• Keep the operational side tight: source-of-truth docs, trackers, internal team staffing, and on-the-ground comms during conference weeks. Build playbooks that make each event easier to run than the last, using AI tools to move faster.
• Partner with cross-functional teams across product, marketing, business development and more to turn briefs into event plans with clear audiences, objectives, and success metrics tied to product and business goals.
• Help develop and refine concepts with the creative team. Bring a point of view on formats, venues, and cultural trends, and work with designers and copywriters on decks and creative deliverables.
• Work with content capture teams so every event produces strong stories and shareable content.
• Track post-event results, including attendance, registration data, and social reach and sentiment, and write recaps that show what worked and what to change.
• Over time, help source and manage co-hosts and sponsors for our owned franchises.

We’re looking for someone with
• 5+ years in event production, experiential marketing, or brand activations, ideally in fintech, crypto, consumer tech, esports, or entertainment.
• Experience producing large-format or competitive live events, such as tournaments, launches, or live viewing events.
• A track record of delivering multi-city or international events on time and on budget.
• Experience managing agencies and vendors and negotiating contracts under tight deadlines.
• Experience producing premium or invite-only experiences for high-value guests.
• Strong initiative. You spot what needs to happen and do it before anyone asks, and you stay steady when the plan changes.
• Strategic and creative judgment. You connect an event to a product or business goal, and you bring ideas that sharpen a concept.
• A systems mindset. You turn one-off events into repeatable processes.
• Clear, confident communication with stakeholders at every level, including senior leadership. Partners, vendors, and colleagues want to work with you again.
• Based in the US or EU, and willing to travel internationally up to 20% of the year, typically 1 to 2 weeks per quarter across several markets.
• Curiosity about money, markets, and how people trade, save, and spend. Finance experience isn’t required, but interest is.

It’s a bonus to have
• Experience in crypto, whether producing events for digital asset audiences or at global conferences such as Token2049, Korea Blockchain Week, EthCC, or Devcon.
• Experience sourcing or managing event co-hosts and sponsors.
• Relationships with brands, creators, or communities that could become MetaMask partners.
• An existing network of production vendors, agencies, and venues across multiple regions.
• Familiarity with tools like Notion, Slack, and Luma.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.

US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)

$101,000 $141,000 USD

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

MetaMask is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself, which can be found on our page.

MetaMask may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, or conducting initial candidate assessments. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and improve efficiency — they do not replace human judgment. A human recruiter or hiring manager reviews every candidate, and all final hiring decisions are made by people, not AI.

jobs.title: Associate, Resource Management
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

At Current, we're looking for an Associate, Staffing Talent Operations to support day-to-day resource management, staffing coordination, and talent operations across our multidisciplinary agency.

Reporting to the Director, Staffing Talent Operations, this person will work closely with Production, Operations, and department leads to manage resource allocations, monitor team capacity, and ensure staffing plans are accurate and up to date.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront, understands resource management within an agency environment, and is comfortable managing multiple staffing priorities. We're looking for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and able to keep teams aligned on who's working on what.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
• Manage day-to-day resource allocations, staffing schedules, and project assignments in Adobe Workfront across active and upcoming projects.
• Participate in weekly departmental resourcing calls, documenting staffing decisions, allocation changes, and action items.
• Make real-time updates in Workfront during resourcing meetings and follow up to ensure all staffing changes are accurately reflected.
• Monitor team capacity, availability, and utilization across departments, including Creative, Strategy, Design, Production, and Technology.
• Partner with Production and department leads to understand project timelines, staffing needs, and upcoming resource requirements.
• Identify scheduling conflicts, resource gaps, and over- or under-allocation, escalating concerns and helping coordinate solutions.
• Track upcoming and TBD resource requests, following up with teams to ensure open staffing needs are addressed.
• Support short- and long-term resource forecasting, utilization reporting, and staffing documentation.
• Assist with freelance resource coordination, recruiting activities, candidate tracking, and maintaining talent pipelines.
• Help maintain accurate staffing data, improve resource management processes, and support Workfront best practices.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED
• 2-4 years of experience in resource management, staffing operations, or a similar role, preferably within a digital or creative agency.
• Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront is required, particularly resource planning, allocations, scheduling, and capacity management.
• Experience managing staffing and resource allocations across multiple projects, departments, or disciplines.
• Understanding of resource forecasting, utilization, project timelines, and staffing requirements.
• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
• Ability to capture staffing decisions accurately and make system updates in real time.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working directly with producers, project managers, and department leads.
• Proactive problem-solving skills and the ability to identify staffing conflicts and follow through on next steps.
• Proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel for tracking, reporting, and maintaining staffing data.
• Experience supporting freelance staffing, recruiting coordination, or talent pipeline management is a plus.
• Familiarity with digital production workflows, project budgets, and scope management is a plus.

WHY CURRENT

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You'll have the opportunity to work across multiple departments, help shape how we manage staffing and talent, and play an important role in supporting our teams as the agency continues to grow.

The target hourly compensation range for this contract role is $30-$45 per hour. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location. This position is initially offered as maternity leave coverage, with the potential for conversion to a permanent role based on performance and business needs.

jobs.title: Customer Support Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States
jobs.description:
Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. Since we launched Mercury in 2019, our customer base has grown to over 450,000 startups and small businesses from all around the world. With growth comes the need to ensure our customer experience is top of mind even in the most challenging scenarios.

We’re working to build something like magic for a really wide range of startup businesses. A key piece of the magic we’ve built thus far has been smart, product-driven support, and we’re looking to bring on an operational-focused, thoughtful Support Manager to help us continuously improve our Customer Support experience as we scale quickly.

You’ll join as a manager on our Customer Support team, partnering closely with our existing Customer Support Leadership team to execute the operational function of the team and support the wider strategic vision. You’ll manage your own cohort of specialists who are dedicated to managing customer interactions and operational tasks across key customer workstreams. You’ll work closely with our Voice of the Customer, Customer Trust, Operations, WFM and CX Eng teams to improve our product and general customer-facing processes to provide clear, thoughtful, and accurate support systems to help customers.

You’ll need to understand how our products and internal teams work in detail. Banking* has a lot of moving pieces, so this is harder than it might seem. Finding efficient, elegant solutions for problems stemming from the oft-convoluted U.S. financial system isn’t always easy, but if you’re good at your job, our users will never know it.

Your Role:
• Lead Develop: Hire, mentor, and manage a customer support team that excels in product knowledge, user support, and the US banking* system
• Performance Management Development: Own team performance management by setting clear goals, tracking key metrics, and driving continuous improvement across your team. Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth within your team, providing regular feedback and coaching
• Process Improvements, AI Automation: Refine and evolve our support processes, building workflows that drive efficiency and effectiveness across the organization including AI tools and automation to make Support faster and more effective. Take ideas from pilot to production while keeping every workflow within our compliance, privacy, and regulatory standards

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States
jobs.description:
Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. Since we launched Mercury in 2019, our customer base has grown to over 300,000 startups and small businesses from all around the world. This turns out to be a pretty wild endeavor, so we’re looking to bring someone smart onto our Customer Support team to help us out.

As a member of our Customer Support team, you’ll make sure our users are charmed by warmth and competence when they have questions or needs that aren’t being met by our product. You’ll radiate intelligence while exercising your best human qualities, like compassion and empathy, even in the face of frustration. 

You’ll need to understand how our product works in detail. Banking* has a lot of moving pieces, so this is harder than it might seem. Finding efficient, elegant solutions for problems stemming from the oft-convoluted U.S. financial system isn’t always easy, but if you’re good at your job, our users will never know it.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

What You’ll Do:
• Answer user questions over chat, email, and phone
• Handle user account requests, including application processing, card disputes, missing payments, card shipments, and a whole lot more
• Teach customers how to use our product (hopefully most of it is self-explanatory), and translate user confusion into product suggestions
• Identify the systemic flaws that lead to user problems
• Work with our engineering team to find and squash bugs
• Communicate our users' needs to our partner banks and work with them to improve their products and processes
• Write help articles and FAQs
• Learn our internal tools and figure out how to improve them
• Put in place processes to make your job more efficient
• Help with other compliance and customer tasks
• Create and sustain warm relationships with our users
• Help build out the customer support and ops infrastructure at Mercury

What You Bring:
• Have 2+ years of experience in a Customer Experience / Customer Support role
• Consistently exercise empathy
• Always seek to answer the question behind the question
• Understand how to translate complex terminology into clear, human user communication
• Enjoy thinking about how to automate as much of your job as possible
• Keep a clean, ordered inbox
• Stay calm and collected while working on ten things at once
• Feel confident talking with startup folks in person, over chat, or on the phone
• Use creativity while working within difficult constraints
• Show kindness in the face of unpleasantness (our customers generally are really great, but they can get passionate when it comes to their businesses)

Would be nice if you:
• Have experience working in retail branch banking

You're not just navigating; you're shaping the landscape, constructing robust architectures that withstand the tests of time and scale. As we gear up for the next stages of Mercury's growth, you will:
