jobs.title: Senior Product Design Manager - Business Banking & Investments
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.description:
Art Blakey led the Jazz Messengers from behind the drums. He brought musicians including Wayne Shorter and Lee Morgan into the band, encouraged them to write new music, and helped them develop into bandleaders themselves. His contribution was both the music he made and the talent he brought forward. Blue Note Records

We’re looking for a Product Design Manager with that combination of creative leadership and personal craft. Someone with strong design judgement, deep visual craft, and the ambition to change what businesses expect from financial software.

You’ll lead design for Mercury’s Business Banking* and Investments teams, spanning payments, accounts, and treasury. These teams help businesses move money, organize their accounts, and put idle cash to work. As the team grows, you’ll be accountable for the quality of its work, the development of its designers, and the impact of the experiences it ships.

Our ambition goes beyond making familiar banking workflows look better. We want to question how they work, identify what customers should no longer have to think about, and create something meaningfully better. That takes a leader who can recognize a promising idea, push it further, and bring a team together to make it real.

Visual design matters deeply in this role. So do interaction design, simplicity, and the judgment to make them work together. You should have a clear point of view about what excellent looks like and the hands-on ability to demonstrate it. You’ll hold a high standard through specific feedback, compelling direction, and a willingness to work alongside the team. People should feel inspired to do the best work of their careers, and supported in getting there.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

In this role, you’ll:
• Raise the quality bar of the team's work. Own the visual and interaction quality of the experiences your team ships, from the structure of a complex workflow to typography, composition, spacing, and motion. Make the standard concrete through thoughtful critique and clear direction. Review the implemented experience, not just the design file.
• Challenge the status quo. Partner with Product and Engineering to shape an ambitious direction for payments, accounts, and treasury. Question inherited assumptions, including our own. Help the team distinguish genuine constraints from familiar habits, explore alternatives, and turn the strongest ideas into simpler, more useful products.
• Take ownership from problem to outcome. Identify opportunities without waiting for a brief. Create clarity when the path is ambiguous, bring the right people together, make decisions, and work through obstacles. Your responsibility continues after handoff and launch: understand what changed for customers and the business, and act when the results fall short.
• Get hands-on where your craft makes a difference. Sketch a stronger direction, prototype an interaction, or work through a difficult flow with a designer. Be able to show what better looks like, not only describe it. Use your skills selectively to advance the work and develop the designer’s judgment without taking over their ownership.
• Turn ambition into excellent work that ships on time. Make deliberate decisions about scope, sequencing, and where to spend the team’s attention. Surface tradeoffs early and resolve them with your partners. Know which details are essential to the experience and where a simpler approach will help the team move faster without compromising what matters.
• Build a healthy team with high expectations. Develop designers’ taste, confidence, and ability to deliver. Give direct, useful feedback, set clear performance expectations, and address gaps with care and conviction. Explain why the work matters and bring people together around a shared vision. Celebrate the designers behind the work and make their contributions visible across Mercury Design.

You should:
• Have strong visual and interaction design craft. Your portfolio demonstrates thoughtful typography, composition, hierarchy, and interaction design in shipped products.
• Know how to simplify complex product experiences. You can work through complicated workflows, information architecture, and product constraints to make experiences clear and intuitive.
• Have managed designers and raised the quality of their work. You can show how your coaching, feedback, and clear expectations helped designers grow and improved what reached customers. You know how to inspire ambition while holding people accountable.
• Have set a product vision and helped a team deliver it. You can connect an ambitious direction to practical decisions about scope and sequencing, with shipped work and clear customer or business impact.
• Stay close to the design work. You’re comfortable sketching, prototyping, and working through detailed design problems alongside designers, with the judgment to know when your direct contribution will help.
• Build strong partnerships with Product and Engineering. You’ve shaped priorities together, worked through competing constraints, and used clear storytelling to build alignment around design decisions.
• Think and work like an owner. You act on what’s best for customers and the business, not just what’s in the brief. You spot problems and opportunities before they’re assigned, make decisions with incomplete information, and adapt without drama when priorities shift. You stay close to implementation and outcomes, and you care more about making Mercury better than about whose idea it was.
• Build conviction without relying on authority. You can tell a clear story about where the product should go and why. You start disagreements with curiosity, make your reasoning specific, and change your mind when a better idea emerges. You help people pursue a demanding standard because they understand and believe in it.

What success looks like

A year from now, the team’s shipped work demonstrates a visibly higher standard of visual craft, interaction quality, and simplicity. It has moved beyond incremental improvements to deliver new approaches with clear customer and business impact. Designers are ambitious, motivated, and growing in their judgment. They own their work, deliver reliably, and receive recognition across Mercury Design for what they contribute.

Please share examples of both your own design craft and work produced under your leadership. We’d like to understand the standards you set, the assumptions you challenged, the decisions you owned, and what ultimately shipped.

jobs.title: Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

At Moniepoint, as an Analytics Manager, you will use data to make better decisions, faster for the business. You will own metrics, measurement, experimentation and the analysis/data roadmap for a business area. You’ll use data to quantify business KPIs and conduct analyses to uncover unknowns, helping the business unit achieve its goals for acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, and revenue. As a leader of the business unit, the role sits at the intersection of product management, data engineering, and growth.

What you’ll do
• Strategic Leadership: Build a disciplined, exceptional analytical team. Develop and execute a comprehensive data and analytics roadmap and strategy
• Team Building Management: Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of analytics professionals
• Data Insights Analytics - including forecast building, business analysis and model development and productionisation. Drive the generation of actionable insights from data to support various business functions, including product, operations, marketing and engineering. What is our actual CAC per channel? Which customer segments are more/less engaged? What are our customers’ share of wallet - how can we use this? What is the typical behaviour of a Moniepoint consumer? What products cause the biggest incremental engagement?
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with growth, product, and engineering managers to ensure we collect the right data for meaningful business insights. Bring data leadership and rigour to our approach to product development. Build a strategic understanding of the business and structure complex projects to bring them to life.

Business: Growth
• Create and maintain the yearly forecast and budget for your products.
• Define the product's growth plan and lead execution across the entire funnel from acquisition through to monetisation and retention
• Own and optimise specific business metrics or commercial goals, covering the entire funnel from new user acquisition through conversion, activation, retention, and expansion
• Perform detailed product analysis covering the product management funnel with all its aspects, implementing changes into the buying funnel to improve conversion
• Design and execute A/B testing programs to optimise sales and conversion rates/adoption at each funnel stage
• Lead testing and optimisation efforts for the conversion funnel across offline and online channels, prioritising tests that drive the biggest business impact
• Improve the product's design and deploy experiments to improve lifetime value (LTV) and decrease churn 

Technical: Data Analytics
• Use deep, flexible, and comprehensive analytics covering the entire funnel from marketing acquisition to product usage
• Analyse user behaviour to improve the sales funnel and increase conversions, using advanced analytics to assess campaign performance and refine strategies
• Define and track growth metrics including customer acquisition cost (CAC), activation rate, retention rate, payback time, and revenue per customer
• Conduct cohort analysis and journey mapping to identify bottlenecks and optimisation opportunities

What you need to succeed
• +5 years in Analytics and Analytics Management.
• 2+ years in a management role managing teams and driving strategic initiatives
• Proven track record in a consumer-FMCG environment, preferably in a CPG or fintech environment
• Deep experience scaling product businesses, with demonstrated ownership of significant revenue targets

Technical Skills
• Strong analytical skills with ability to drive metrics and benchmarks, plus experience with growth experiments, A/B testing, and funnel optimisation
• Deep SQL knowledge.
• Proficiency in product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Grafana, Tableau, Looker, etc)
• Deep understanding of data analytics, user behaviour analysis and segmentation

Leadership Soft Skills
• Strong communication skills to interact with teams, stakeholders, and users through verbal presentations, written reports, and visual media
• Proven ability to build, mentor, and scale high-performing product teams
• Expertise in data analytics tools and digital marketing platforms with the ability to manage and mentor teams of marketers, analysts, and designers
• Strategic thinker with strong commercial awareness and business acumen

Key Performance Indicators
• User acquisition and activation rates
• Customer retention and churn rates
• Expansion revenue (upsell/cross-sell)
• Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) / Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) ratio
• Product adoption metrics

What sets you apart
• Advanced degree in Business or STEM
• Experience in Growth Analytics, Product analytics, Credit risk analytics
• Background in both mass-marketing and product-led growth models
• Experience managing P L or budget responsibility

What you’ll get
• Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
• Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
• Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process
• Online SQL take-home task (30 mins): Take-home test.
• Business Case 1 (1 hour - 1 hour 30 mins): Live case. No take-home required.
• Business Case 2 (1 hour - 1 hour 30 mins): Live case. No take-home required.
• Exec Interview (30 mins - 1 hour): Culture Fit. No take-home required.

jobs.title: Senior Manager Complaints Operations & Service Delivery
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager – Complaints Operations Service Delivery to lead the day-to-day complaints operation of N26 across all our markets, with focus on Germany. 

Reporting directly to the Head of Customer Service Complaints Management and Prevention, you will own how the operation performs: regulatory deadlines met in every market, capacity planned rather than improvised, productivity defined and tracked, quality assured and continuity guaranteed. 

The complaints market managers report to you; you steer the quality-assurance and workforce-management specialists who support complaints; you work hand in hand with our Compliance Prevention function, which designs the controls you operate; and you act as designated deputy to the Head of department for complaints operations. This is a hands-on senior operations role in a supervised, high-scrutiny environment — the right job for someone who has turned an operation around on SLAs before and can prove it with numbers.

What You Will Do
• Service Delivery SLA Ownership: Own regulatory timeliness and backlog across DE/AT, FR, ES, IT and Greater Europe; set queue strategy and prioritisation rules; run the daily and weekly operating rhythm; intervene before thresholds are breached, not after.
• Capacity Workforce Planning: Own the complaints forecast, staffing model and scheduling, including BPO volume steering; translate volume trends and regulatory changes (e.g. new deadline regimes) into capacity decisions; keep the capacity model current and evidenced.
• Productivity Operational Excellence: Define productivity standards per market and team, track them monthly, and drive the adoption of optimisation measures — routing, templates, tooling, automation — together with Operational Readiness and our Product Tech partners.
• Quality Assurance: Run the QA system for complaints output — sampling, calibration across markets, feedback loops, rework reduction — so that quality is measured, not assumed.
• Business Continuity: Own the contingency plan for the complaints operation: triggers, surge playbooks, cross-market and BPO backup, regular tests.
• Team Leadership: Lead, develop and hold accountable the complaints market managers; build operational-management capability in the team; manage performance with facts.
• Evidence Governance: Produce the operating evidence (reports, sign-offs, exceptions and their handling) that Compliance Prevention, Internal Audit and external reviewers test; represent complaints operations in management and audit forums and deputise for the Head of department on complaints operations.

What You Will Bring
• Minimal

requirements:
• 7+ years in customer or complaints operations in regulated financial services (bank, payment or e-money institution, insurer), including 3+ years leading managers of managers or a multi-site / multi-market operation.
• A demonstrable track record of lifting SLA attainment and productivity in an operation of comparable size (50+ FTE in-house and/or BPO).
• Full professional proficiency in English.
• Background

Experience:

Service delivery, workforce management or operational-excellence leadership; experience steering BPO partners on forecast, quality and cost; exposure to audits or regulatory remediation as an operational owner.
• Functional Technical Knowledge: Forecasting and capacity planning, scheduling, queue and skills-based routing, QA calibration and productivity metrics; practical knowledge of complaint-handling timelines (PSD2 15 / 35 business days, national regimes) and delay-notification duties; case-management and BI tooling (Salesforce, Metabase or equivalent).
• Leadership: Direct, fact-based and calm under scrutiny; able to develop managers who are strong on content into strong operators; comfortable presenting to senior management and auditors.
• Languages: Fluent English required; German or Spanish is a strong plus.

What's in it for you:
• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe's most innovative banks 🚀.
• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
• Vacation days vary depending on your location of work. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.
• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are?

N26 has reimagined banking for today's digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it's how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

Founded in 2013, N26 now has 7 million customers in 24 markets. We employ more than 1700 employees across 3 office locations in Berlin, Madrid and Barcelona.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position!

N26 is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

We are seeking a Principal Engineer with a deep expertise in autonomous AI agent architecture and deployment, to spearhead the design, development, and optimization of intelligent agent systems on our global crypto exchange platform. This is a senior role requiring a hands-on AI science background combined with strategic oversight, technical direction, and cross-functional collaboration.

 

You will work at the cutting edge of AI and crypto, designing AI agents that can autonomously reason, act, and evolve in complex, real-time environments such as trading, security, compliance, and customer interaction.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Lead the design, development, and lifecycle management of autonomous AI agents tailored to crypto exchange operations (e.g., customer assistant, trading bots, risk detection agents, fraud prevention agents, etc.).

• Drive experimentation, simulations, and continuous learning pipelines for agent performance optimization.
• Stay ahead of the curve on developments in AGI, LLM-integrated agents, and cognitive architectures; apply relevant innovations to production systems.
• Mentor and lead a team of AI scientists and engineers; help define the AI roadmap and research strategy.
• Ensure system scalability, security, and regulatory compliance of AI-powered solutions in the crypto exchange domain.

About the Opportunity

The Americas Compliance team is hiring a Senior Compliance Manager to own compliance for OKXICE TSV and for the joint venture's new broker-dealer. OKXICE TSV is the tokenized securities venue run by the OKX and Intercontinental Exchange joint venture under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, and it lets eligible US users trade tokenized US-listed stocks on-chain. The joint venture is also registering a broker-dealer with FINRA. You'll be the main person accountable for meeting the exemption's ongoing conditions and for taking the broker-dealer through FINRA membership and into operation. You'll work closely with Legal, Finance, Product, Web3 Risk Control and our AML, Sanctions and Surveillance teams, as well as outside counsel and the broker-dealer's clearing firm. These are new businesses, so you'll help build the programs as well as run them.

What You'll Be Doing
• Own the compliance program for the venue's SEC exemption, including tracking each condition, testing controls and keeping records ready for regulatory examination.
• Manage the venue's public notice: review revisions, control versions, and make sure the notice matches how the product actually works. This includes corrections and material-change filings within the required deadlines.
• Run the issuer notice process from start to finish, including tracking delivery, handling objections and confirming each stock's listing date.
• Track and monitor TSV limits on an ongoing basis, including per-stock and volume limits against consolidated market data, periodic tier rechecks, trading halts and eligible stablecoins. Escalate breaches, significant operational events and required SEC notifications.
• Oversee participant onboarding and ongoing wallet maintenance and monitoring, including KYC/KYB, daily sanctions and on-chain wallet rescreening, keeping wallet-to-participant records current, and issuing and revoking the soulbound token (SBT) credential that grants access.
• Lead the broker-dealer through the FINRA new membership application, including Form BD, the business plan and supporting exhibits, responses to FINRA staff requests, and the membership interview.
• Coordinate the evidence FINRA needs before approval, such as the officer and director structure, authorized signatories on the broker-dealer's bank accounts, bank statements, the independent auditor engagement, the clearing agreement, and flow-of-funds and demo materials.
• Build the broker-dealer's compliance program, including written supervisory procedures, the supervisory control system, an AML program under FINRA Rule 3310 with customer identification procedures, and books and records under SEC Rules 17a-3 and 17a-4.
• Once the broker-dealer is approved, run its ongoing compliance, including the annual certification under FINRA Rule 3130, supervisory control testing under Rule 3120, regulatory filings, and FINRA examinations and inquiries. Work with the Financial and Operations Principal on net capital and FOCUS reporting.

 

What We Look For In You
• 8+ years of compliance experience at a FINRA-registered broker-dealer, exchange, alternative trading system (ATS) or digital asset firm, with direct experience of SEC- and FINRA-regulated activity.
• FINRA Series 24 (General Securities Principal) registration, or the ability to qualify within an agreed period after joining.
• Hands-on experience with a FINRA new membership or continuing membership application, including preparing the application and handling FINRA staff questions through to approval.
• Working knowledge of the federal securities laws and FINRA rules that apply to broker-dealers and trading venues, such as Regulation ATS, Regulation NMS, the net capital and customer protection rules, and market manipulation rules, plus the ability to apply them to new market structures.
• Experience building or running compliance programs under regulatory conditions, exemptive relief or no-action positions.
• Familiarity with how blockchain-based trading works, including self-custodied wallets, smart contracts, liquidity pools and on-chain screening.
• Strong drafting skills, with experience turning complex technical or legal detail into clear public disclosures and procedures.
• Sound judgment and the ability to work with Product, Engineering and Legal teams across time zones.

 

Nice to Haves
• Experience with tokenized securities, transfer agents or digital asset broker-dealers.
• Exposure to OFAC sanctions programs and blocked property handling for on-chain assets.
• Experience reporting to a board or joint venture governance body.
• Series 14 (Compliance Official) registration.
• Experience working with a clearing firm under a fully disclosed clearing arrangement.
• A JD or a similar legal background.

Enterprise Efficiency builds internal products and platforms that power how our company operates globally.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and improve our Payroll, Global Compensation, and Leave and Absence systems. You should bring deep, hands-on expertise in at least one of these domains, along with a working understanding of the core processes, system capabilities, and interdependencies across the other two.

You will partner closely with People, Payroll, Total Rewards, Finance, and Engineering to translate complex policies and operational requirements into reliable, intuitive, and scalable products. This is a hands-on product role, with ownership from problem discovery and process design through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.

Professional working proficiency in both English and Mandarin is required for product documentation, meetings, and cross-functional collaboration.

 

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Turn HR domain expertise into effective products. Understand the policies, operational processes, and user needs across Payroll, Global Compensation, and Leave and Absence. Work with domain specialists to translate these into clear product capabilities that simplify work for employees, managers, and operational teams.
• Own the product roadmap for your scope. Partner with People, Payroll, Total Rewards, and Finance stakeholders to prioritize system foundations and efficiency opportunities.
• Redesign end-to-end workflows. Improve processes such as payroll input validation and reconciliation, compensation reviews and changes, and leave requests and balance management. Define clear business rules, effective dates, approvals, exceptions, and ownership, with support from the relevant domain experts.
• Connect HR systems and strengthen data integrity. Partner with engineering to integrate HRIS, payroll providers, compensation tools, and leave systems, improve data consistency, and deliver connected user experiences with appropriate permissions and audit trails.
• Improve efficiency through automation and AI. Work with internal stakeholders to identify and implement practical solutions that reduce repetitive work and improve accuracy and decision quality.

What We Look For In You

5+ years of experience in product management or closely related enterprise product roles, with substantial experience delivering HR or People systems.

Nice to Haves

Reporting to a senior member of the Legal Department and working closely with external advisors including lobbying, policy, and legal partners, you will help advance OKX’s U.S. policy and regulatory priorities across federal and, where relevant, state-level issues affecting crypto and digital assets. You will translate regulatory developments into practical insights, coordinate external engagement, and work cross-functionally to ensure policy considerations are reflected in business decisions.

jobs.title: シニアデータアナリスト（金融事業領域）
jobs.description:
PayPayについて

 

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50か国の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_

我々は自分たちの想像を超える未来を創るためにあえて明確なビジョンは必要ないと考えています。常にDay1であるスタンスを忘れずに、誰もが想像できないようなビジョン（未来）を実現していくのがPayPayです。
この壮大なビジョンに前向きに取り組み、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、自ら課題発見し、周囲と協力して新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

 

業務について

▼PayPay 金融事業開発本部の紹介

PayPayを決済アプリから「金融スーパーアプリ」へと進化させるため、新たな金融事業の企画・実行を担う組織です。
「Web3」「グローバル（国際アライアンス）」「AI/データ活用」の3つの領域を軸に、国内外のトッププレイヤーとのパートナーシップや最先端技術を活用したプロダクト開発を強力に推進しています。
 7,000万人以上のユーザー基盤を背景に、スマホセントリックで先進的な金融体験を世界スケールで創出することを目指しています。

▼関連コンテンツ
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 01
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 02
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 03
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 05
• 圧倒的なスピードで、「USER FIRST」を実現する。
• その仕事はユーザーファーストか？業界の常識を超えた「金融」サービスへの追求
• 機械学習モデル×ユーザーファーストで、想定の5倍の成果を生んだ「PayPay資金調達」
• データの“限界”と向き合い、未知の問題に解を出すPayPayのデータサイエンティスト

▼募集の背景

スマホファーストな金融サービスのUI/UXを拡充していくためには、ユーザーが抱える課題に対する解決策（そのほとんどは、まだ世の中に存在していません）を、データとテクノロジーの力で実現していく必要があります。
しかし、ユーザーの深い課題は目に見えないことが多く、ヒアリング等の表面的なアプローチだけでは見えてきません。膨大なデータからインサイトを発見・構造化し、ゆくゆくは機械学習（ML）などの高度な技術も駆使しながら解決策へと昇華していく高度なアプローチが不可欠です。
本気のユーザー・ファーストな金融サービスを実現するため、既存の枠組みを超えて「データ起点の新規プロジェクト」や「機械学習案件の創出」までを自ら牽引し、金融サービスをより良くしていきたいという強い情熱と実行力を持つハイレベルなプロフェッショナルを募集します。

▼業務内容 

PayPayの金融事業開発部門に所属し、データ分析を通じて事業開発・サービス開発を強力に推進していただきます。急速に成長するPayPayの中で、圧倒的なスピード感とスケールで事業を支え、牽引できることが最大の魅力です。
アナリストとしての役割は、課題発見やモニタリングといった分析の「提供」にとどまりません。自ら戦略を立て、施策実行や仮説検証までをリードしていただきます。さらに将来的には、本人の志向に合わせて機械学習（ML）を活用した新規案件の企画立案や、MLプロジェクトのPMなど、アナリストの枠を超えて事業成長にフルコミットし、ご自身のスキルとキャリアの幅を大きく広げていただける最適の環境です。

【具体的な業務内容】

1. 事業分野における意思決定支援とデータ戦略のリード
• 経営指標（KPI）の高度な分析および事業の数値シミュレーション
• 新規事業の事業計画策定への貢献およびKPI設計・推進
• モニタリングのためのダッシュボード構築と自動化
• アプリ導線の分析および最適化の提案

2. データに基づいた企画/改善による事業貢献（AI/ML活用を含む）
• グロース戦略の企画、実施、および効果検証
• ユーザーセグメンテーションの設計・改善（将来的な予測モデル等の導入視野）
• （ゆくゆくは）機械学習モデルを活用した新規施策の立案、およびMLプロジェクトのマネジメント

【分析環境】
Snowflake / Databricks / Sigma / Python（3系）

▼本ポジションの魅力
• 日本最大級のユーザー規模がもたらす「圧倒的なデータ量のスケール」を活用し、機械学習などの高度な分析に挑戦できる
• データからユーザーの深層心理や行動原理を紐解き、本気のユーザー・ファーストな事業・サービス開発の立ち上げからグロースまで主導できる
• ユーザーの声を元に、アジャイルかつハイスピードで毎日のPDCAを回せる
• シニアアナリストからスタートし、機械学習プロジェクトのPMや新規AI案件のプロデューサーへとキャリアを拡張できる

必要な経験/スキル
• SQLによる高度な集計、分析業務の経験（5年以上）
• BIツールを用いた可視化・ダッシュボード構築経験（5年以上）
• PythonやRを使った分析業務の経験（3年以上／機械学習の基礎的な理解を含む）
• データベースの構造に関する深い知見
• 新興技術・最新テクノロジーへの強い興味関心とキャッチアップ力

【加えて下記のいずれか1つ以上を強みとしてPRできる経験】
• 課題解決力：複雑な問題を特定して根本原因を掘り下げる論理的思考力と、改善に向けて周囲を巻き込みリードする実行力
• コミュニケーション力：複数のステークホルダー（経営陣、開発、ビジネス側）の意図を汲み取り、共通の目標達成に向けてプロジェクトを統合・推進する強力なファシリテーション能力
• プロジェクトマネジメント力：戦略立案にとどまらず、ビジネス全体のチームを率い、スケジュールや予算、リソースを適切にコントロールしながら完遂に導く力

 

あると望ましい経験/スキル
• ソフトウェア開発の経験
• 機械学習（予測モデル、レコメンド等）に関する知見、実装経験
• プロジェクトマネジメントの経験

PayPayが求める人物像

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Corporate Engineering team is building and scaling the next generation of enterprise AI infrastructure at Robinhood. Our mission is to make AI capabilities reliable, secure, and accessible across the company, enabling teams to build, deploy, and operate intelligent solutions at scale. From enterprise LLM integrations to agentic workflows and hybrid cloud infrastructure, we're creating the foundation that supports how Robinhood leverages AI internally.

As an AI Operations Engineer, Enterprise Tech, you'll help support, maintain, and improve the AI platforms and infrastructure used by teams across Robinhood. You'll work hands-on with LLM integrations, automation, monitoring, and production systems, partnering with engineers and internal users to troubleshoot issues and build solutions that make our AI capabilities more reliable and easier to use. This is an opportunity to grow your expertise in AI infrastructure while contributing to a rapidly evolving area of Corporate Engineering.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY, and Bellevue, WA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do
• Build internal tooling, automation, and self-service solutions that streamline AI operations, reduce manual intervention, and improve the developer experience.

• Troubleshoot technical issues involving LLM integrations, APIs, model behavior, and system performance, working directly with developers and internal teams to identify and resolve problems.
• Support enterprise LLM integrations, including Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, helping monitor API usage, token consumption, performance, and reliability.

jobs.title: Business Controls Testing Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The Role

The First Line of Defense (1LOD) Business Controls Testing (BCT) team executes independent, evidence-based control testing to evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of SoFi’s internal controls across in-scope business processes.

As a Business Controls Testing Senior Analyst, you will independently plan and execute complex control reviews, partner with business and control owners, and communicate clear, well-supported results. You will apply sound risk judgment to identify control gaps, evaluate potential impacts, and drive timely resolution activities. This role requires a strong command of control testing methodology, the ability to navigate ambiguity, and an effective, solutions-oriented approach to stakeholder management.

What You’ll Do
• Execute design effectiveness and operating effectiveness testing, including transactional testing, in accordance with the 1LOD BCT Playbook, procedures, and applicable policies.
• Lead control-owner engagement throughout the testing lifecycle, including walkthroughs, test-script development, evidence requests, status updates, and results discussions.
• Assess processes, risks, controls, data, and documentation to identify weaknesses, gaps, or vulnerabilities; determine whether controls are appropriately designed and operating effectively.
• Produce complete, accurate, and timely workpapers, testing reports, findings, and supporting documentation in required trackers and systems of record, including AuditBoard.
• Clearly articulate testing results, risk implications, and recommended actions to control owners, business partners, management, and other stakeholders.
• Drive accountability for timely evidence submission, issue remediation, and follow-up activities; perform validation or re-performance testing, as needed.
• Partner with issue management and control owners to support the development of actionable remediation plans, milestones, owners, and timelines for identified control failures.
• Exercise judgment in resolving diverse and complex testing issues; proactively identify roadblocks, communicate risks and downstream implications, and propose practical, principle-based solutions.
• Maintain productive relationships across product, process, and control-owner teams, as well as 1LOD Risk Business Controls and Enterprise Risk Management partners.
• Conduct peer quality-assurance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and contribute to consistent application of BCT methodology and documentation standards.
• Support onboarding, training, cross-training, and knowledge sharing for team members.
• Contribute to cross-functional initiatives and continuous-improvement efforts that strengthen testing processes, reporting, and the overall control environment.

What You’ll Need
• 5+ years of relevant experience in risk management, internal controls, control testing, audit, quality assurance, compliance, or a related field; experience in financial services, banking, fintech, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated experience executing control design and operating effectiveness testing, including writing or using test scripts, performing transactional testing, assessing evidence, and documenting results.
• Strong understanding of operational risk management, internal controls, control design, issue remediation, and control-testing methodologies.
• Ability to independently manage a portfolio of testing activities, prioritize competing deadlines, and provide proactive status updates and timely escalations.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to use data to assess risk, reach evidence-based conclusions, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex control and risk concepts for varied audiences and facilitate productive stakeholder discussions.
• Proven ability to build trust, influence without direct authority, and drive shared accountability in a cross-functional, matrixed environment.
• High attention to detail, sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and a continuous-improvement mindset.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, particularly Excel/Google Sheets; experience with GRC platforms such as ServiceNow/AuditBoard is preferred.
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in a first-line risk and controls, operational risk, internal audit, or second-line risk function.
• Experience supporting risk and control self-assessments (RCSAs), issue management, remediation validation, or regulatory/exam readiness.
• Experience testing and deep understanding of technical/ITGC/InfoSec related controls.
• Professional certification or progress toward certification, such as CIA, CISA, CRCM, CRCM, CPA, or equivalent.

jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The Role

The Independent Compliance Testing (ICT) Program serves as a key second line of defense at SoFi, helping ensure regulatory requirements are met across applicable lines of business.

As an ICT Compliance Specialist, you will perform independent compliance testing, monitoring, audit, and remediation validation activities across the enterprise. You will assess business-line adherence to applicable consumer and commercial lending, credit card, payments, and servicing laws and regulations.

This role will focus on customer restitution and remediation validation, ongoing monitoring of compliance metrics and controls, audit readiness, issue management, and corrective-action testing. The successful candidate must have hands-on experience conducting audits or compliance reviews, evaluating controls, documenting testing procedures, identifying findings, and validating remediation.

The ICT Compliance Specialist will report to the Regulatory Compliance Testing Team Lead and may support testing across additional financial-services subject areas as needed.

 

What You’ll Do
• Execute independent compliance testing, audit, validation, and monitoring activities in accordance with ICT methodology, standard operating procedures, and team leadership guidance.
• Develop and execute audit and compliance testing procedures to assess the design and operating effectiveness of controls.
• Perform risk-based validation of customer remediation and restitution activities, assessing accuracy, completeness, fairness, and timeliness.
• Evaluate remediation milestones and validation tollgates, including scoping, population identification, calculation methodology, payment execution, and sustainability.
• Conduct ongoing and quarterly monitoring of key compliance metrics, operational controls, and regulatory requirements.
• Analyze trends, exceptions, control gaps, and emerging risks to identify potential systemic issues.
• Validate the accuracy and integrity of data provided by first-line business teams for metrics related to SCRA, FCRA, Regulation B, and other applicable regulations.
• Partner with Data Analytics and technical teams to review queries, logic, inclusion and exclusion criteria, lookback periods, and impacted-population methodologies.
• Recalculate restitution and remediation amounts to confirm that financial relief is accurate and aligned with approved criteria.
• Identify, classify, document, and track audit and compliance findings through remediation and issue closure.
• Perform follow-up testing, sustainability reviews, and validation procedures to confirm that corrective actions have been fully implemented and remain effective.
• Investigate potential errors through structured inquiry, sampling, data analysis, and root-cause analysis.
• Determine whether identified issues are isolated or systemic and assess their potential compliance and customer impact.
• Coordinate validation intake, audit planning, testing milestones, planning meetings, status updates, and stakeholder communications.
• Prepare clear audit workpapers, validation memoranda, monitoring reports, sampling strategies, dashboards, and executive-level reporting.
• Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready documentation supporting testing conclusions and independent review.
• Coordinate with business teams, Compliance, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders during regulatory examinations and internal audits.
• Provide requested documentation, data, testing results, and issue-status updates within established deadlines.
• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with Compliance Officers, Issue Owners, Member Remediation, business leaders, Internal Audit, and cross-functional partners.
• Identify opportunities to improve monitoring and audit efficiency through data analytics, automation, and technology-enabled compliance solutions.
• Complete all testing, monitoring, documentation, and reporting activities in accordance with established timelines and the program’s annual validation plan.

What You’ll Need
• Bachelor’s degree.
• At least 6+ years of professional experience in internal audit, compliance audit, regulatory compliance testing, compliance monitoring, or regulatory risk, preferably within financial services or a regulated banking institution.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience conducting internal audits, compliance audits, regulatory reviews, or control assessments.
• Experience developing audit scopes, testing procedures, sampling approaches, workpapers, findings, and audit or validation reports.
• Experience evaluating control design and operating effectiveness.
• Experience tracking corrective actions and performing follow-up testing to confirm remediation and sustainability.
• Strong working knowledge of consumer lending, credit cards, payments, servicing, and applicable laws and regulations.
• Familiarity with Regulation Z, Regulation B, the Fair Credit Reporting Act, the Truth in Lending Act, the Equal Credit Opportunity Act, the CARD Act, the Fair Credit Billing Act, the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act, the Military Lending Act, E-SIGN, and applicable state laws.
• Experience evaluating data populations, sampling methodologies, calculations, controls, and remediation outcomes.
• Strong documentation skills, including preparation of audit workpapers, validation memoranda, monitoring reports, and audit-support materials.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, critical-thinking, and root-cause-analysis skills.
• Ability to identify trends and risk themes from data and translate findings into clear business conclusions.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
• Ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and operate independently under established methodology and leadership guidance.
• Experience supporting internal audits, regulatory examinations, or external audits.

Nice to Have
• CRCM, CIA, CISA, CPA, CAMS, or other relevant compliance, audit, risk, or financial-services certification.
• Experience with SQL, data analytics, dashboarding, or automated monitoring tools.
• Experience with customer remediation, restitution, or enterprise issue-management programs.
• Experience working with consumer and commercial financial products.
• Experience preparing executive reporting related to audit, compliance monitoring, findings, remediation, and risk trends.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Cards
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

Cards is one of the largest revenue lines at Tide. The domain owns everything that happens on the card: issuing and processing across the UK, EU and India, each with its own processors, card schemes and regulators.

This includes prepaid, debit, multi-currency and team cards, alongside products such as Apple Pay and Google Pay tokenisation, 3DS, card controls and settlement.

The teams are cross-functional, working closely with product, design, commercial and operations. Engineering comprises three teams, with engineers based in Bulgaria, Lithuania and India.

ABOUT

THE ROLE:

As Head of Engineering, Cards, you will lead the engineering organisation across the UK, EU and India, shaping the next phase of the Cards platform.

With the core platform transformation largely complete, your focus will be on:
• Product and member

experience:

Partnering with Product and Design to improve card experiences, including tokenisation, payment journeys, team controls and reducing false declines.
• AI-led engineering: Embedding AI coding agents across the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, delivery speed and quality.
• Platform and commercial ownership: Completing the transition from our legacy processor, strengthening partner relationships and driving improvements in cost efficiency and unit economics.

You will set the technical direction, develop engineering leadership and ensure the platform remains reliable, scalable and commercially sustainable.

As Head of Engineering, Cards, you will:
• Lead and develop engineering managers and senior engineers across distributed teams.
• Define the technical strategy and architecture for the Cards domain.
• Drive reliability, scalability and cost efficiency across card issuing and processing.
• Embed AI-assisted and agentic development practices across engineering teams.
• Partner with Product, Design and Commercial teams to prioritise and deliver the roadmap.
• Own technical relationships with card processors and schemes, including integrations and certifications.
• Strengthen engineering capabilities, particularly at Staff and senior IC levels.
• Collaborate with other engineering leaders across Payments on shared infrastructure.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking for an experienced engineering leader with a strong technical foundation and a track record of leading large, distributed engineering organisations.

Experience and background
• Experience leading engineering managers and large engineering teams.
• Strong experience in cards, payments or banking, with a deep understanding of card issuing, processing and card scheme operations. Experience on either the issuer or processor side is a strong plus.
• Experience building and operating distributed engineering teams across multiple locations.
• Proven ability to improve engineering delivery, productivity and quality.
• Experience partnering with Product, Commercial and Finance leaders on business outcomes and unit economics.
• Experience managing third-party technology providers and strategic partnerships.

Technical expertise
• Strong understanding of microservices, event-driven architecture and cloud-native systems.
• Experience with relational databases, distributed systems and large-scale transaction processing.
• Ability to challenge architectural decisions and engage in technical and production-level discussions.
• Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and their application across the software development lifecycle.

Leadership
• Ability to set technical direction and drive execution through engineering leaders.
• Strong commercial acumen and data-driven decision-making.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• A strong focus on developing engineering talent and building high-performing teams.

OUR TECH STACK: 

Java and Spring Boot microservices running on AWS, with PostgreSQL as our primary datastore. We use SNS/SQS for asynchronous and event-driven messaging. Observability is Coralogix. CI/CD runs through GitHub with automated testing and security scanning. Mobile is Flutter, web is Angular.

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
• Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
• Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
• Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
• Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
• Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts.
• Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
• Life Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
• Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
• Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
• Volunteering Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
• Learning Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
• WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
• Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
• Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
• Snacks Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

 

Disclaimer

 

It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
• All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
• Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
• Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Lead Commercial Analyst
jobs.description:
Wise Platform takes all of the world-class payments products Wise has built over the last 15 years and enables hundreds of millions of consumers and businesses to access them in the places where they already move and manage their money - with banks and online platforms.

Today, we’re already powering payments for some of the world’s top neobanks like Monzo, N26, and Nubank, alongside a growing list of leading global banks such as UniCredit, Morgan Stanley and Standard Chartered. In the online platforms space, we’re powering payments for partners across a whole range of industry verticals and use cases. Whether that’s leading marketplaces like Google, Agoda, or Upwork, workforce management tools like Deel, or investment platforms like Interactive Brokers - we’re bringing the power, simplicity, and transparency of Wise to even more people and businesses.

And, we’re just getting started! Wise Platform is one of the newest and fastest growing products at Wise. We’re a global and highly cross-functional team, spearheading Wise next phase of growth!

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Lead Regional Analyst (Northam) to join our deal-flow analytics team in Wise Platform. You will partner with our Commercial and Delivery teams based in North America, empowering them with data and insights to drive growth. Your analysis and sales intelligence will enable us to optimise sales and delivery processes, reduce time to revenue and drive team performance. You will not just answer business questions—you will proactively identify the questions we should be asking. If you’re a commercially minded analyst, with a knack for bringing data life and passion for helping businesses grow, we’d love to hear from you! 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
• You will deliver high-impact, scalable data solutions such as building and maintaining robust reporting models and data products that directly support the sales and delivery team's efficiency and effectiveness.
• You will lead the design and implementation of North America's key performance indicators (KPIs). Acting as a strategic advisor to regional leadership, you will anchor our measurement around revenue generation, ensuring absolute clarity on team performance while prescribing actionable, data-backed interventions to drive commercial objectives.
• You will collaborate with Finance and Sales Ops to drive monthly and bi-weekly performance updates, providing executive commentary, insights, and strategic recommendations. Furthermore, you will aggregate behavioral trends from partner transactions to equip sales teams with data-driven hooks, while leading quarterly performance-to-goals reviews to align leadership on IC target setting and improve forecast accuracy.
• As a principal individual contributor, you will design and maintain standardized global assets to eliminate redundant effort and fragmentation across all regions for areas such as forecasting, sales insights, etc.
• You will be leveraging advanced analytics, crafting dashboards and visualisations that bring commercial performance data to life, tell a clear story, and offer diagnostic power, some examples include:
• Strategic Deal Acceleration (The "Spoke"): You will lead tactical deal acceleration for North America by building custom prospect decks (QBDs), complex business cases for specific opportunities, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) for existing accounts. You will prioritize critical (P1) late-stage, high-value deals to drastically reduce turnaround time (TAT) and increase overall win rates.
• GTM Planning & Market Sizing: Partnering tightly with Sales Enablement and Product Analysts, you will build addressable market sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM) and tailored entry strategies for target verticals. You will estimate the wallet size of high-priority target accounts to systematically build Target Account Lists (TAL) and localize GTM strategies across the region.
• Account Optimization & Wallet Share Expansion: Moving entirely beyond passive reporting, you will proactively run deep-dive wallet share analysis of existing partner portfolios to uncover untapped expansion revenue. You will identify over performing and underperforming metrics—such as volumes, user behavior, and currencies—and flag these to Account Managers to guide proactive forecast revisions and highlight clear growth opportunities.
• You will collaborate with analysts in the team to enhance our forecasting capabilities. This allows us to performance manage the business, teams and partners - alongside supporting operational teams to capacity plan effectively.
• You will shape how we leverage data to sell Wise Platform, identifying key insights and crafting compelling data-driven narratives that empower commercial teams to convert prospects into partners.

jobs.description:
About the team

Banks need flexibility in how they fund international payments, settle with Wise and convert currencies. Our Cash Management team builds the products that give them that control and make Wise work for more partners and their customers.

The problems are concrete. How can a bank lock in an exchange rate today and provide the funds later? How can it send payments first and settle with Wise afterward? We build the capabilities behind those choices, helping partners manage their cash around the needs of their business.

We’re a small, growing team developing new products in a domain with plenty to learn and shape. You’ll have a meaningful say in how we solve customer problems, design our systems and maintain engineering quality as we grow. The work combines product development with the challenge of building dependable services that move money across systems.

You’ll work closely with product managers, partner banks and engineers across Wise whose systems handle accounts, incoming payments and liquidity. Together, you’ll understand partner needs, agree how those systems fit together and turn complex requirements into practical products.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Engineer who enjoys understanding a customer’s problem, designing a solution and taking responsibility for how it performs in production.

This is a hands-on role with substantial ownership. You’ll have the autonomy to move work forward, alongside colleagues who contribute through shared design, reviews and pairing.

You will:
• Own solutions from problem to production. Work with product managers and engineers to understand partner needs, shape the approach, and design, build, test and operate backend services.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Manager (Risk & Controls) CONTRACT (14 month Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
Senior Finance Manager - Risk and Controls (Maternity Cover)

14-Month Fixed-Term Contract

London, hybrid 

 

At Wise, our mission is Money Without Borders: instant, convenient, transparent and eventually free. As we grow and scale, we're looking for an experienced Senior Finance Manager to join our Finance team in London or Tallinn on a fixed-term contract of approximately 14 months, covering a maternity leave. You will take ownership of a live workload and keep it running smoothly. Your focus will be the SOX controls across general and operational accounting, financial reporting, consolidation and group close, and accounting systems.

You will work closely with Finance, Product, Operations and Technology teams. You will help maintain a strong control environment that supports Wise's growth and doesn't add unnecessary bureaucracy.

 

Your Mission:
• Expert Advisor: Act as the Finance Risk and Controls expert advisor on SOX controls across general and operational accounting, financial reporting, consolidation and group close. Advise and support control owners so that controls are well designed, operate effectively and meet US SOX requirements.
• Keep the close running on time: Be the point of contact for Finance control owners on questions about their controls through each month-end so that the close is completed on time.
• Be the point of contact for control testing: Work with Internal Audit, External Audit and our Internal Controls Testing teams on walkthroughs, evidence and testing in your area. Coordinate with control owners, evaluate exceptions and identify root causes.
• Drive remediation: Track open deficiencies and close them out with control owners. Distinguish isolated failures from systemic issues, and validate that fixes work.
• Accounting system controls: Have a good understanding of the SOX-relevant system controls in Microsoft Business Central and our other internal accounting systems, covering system access, segregation of duties, interfaces, change management and automated controls.
• Maintain process and control documentation: Keep process maps and risk-control matrices accurate and current in line with SOX standards.
• Partner across the business: Work with Finance, Product, Technology and Audit colleagues to solve complex problems. Share knowledge and coach colleagues, and escalate risks early.
• Own the accountability framework for “record to report”: Take full ownership of the accountability framework for the record to report process, to support Financial Statement attestation. Set clear ownership, escalation routes and governance for controls across Group Finance, and make sure every key control has a named owner who is held to account.

 

What you'll get from

the role:
• Real impact: You will keep Wise's SOX control environment strong, and support the remediation of Material Weaknesses.
• Visibility: You will work with senior leaders across Finance.
• Autonomy and ownership: You will have a high level of responsibility and the freedom to decide how best to deliver.
• Breadth of learning: You will gain in-depth knowledge of Wise's business by working with teams across Finance and the wider company.
• Room to grow: You will build your expertise and influence in a fast-growing, global FinTech.

jobs.title: KYC Operations Team Lead - Deactivations

As the Team Lead for KYC Operations on our newly established Deactivations Team, you will be at the forefront of strengthening Wise's commitment to regulatory compliance and protecting our financial ecosystem. Your mission is to build and guide a team of senior analysts who will become the authority in enhanced due diligence (EDD) and masters of risk assessment. You will lead your team who investigate complex KYC cases, empowering them with the duty to guarantee that every decision is compliant and accurate. As this is a newly formed team at Wise, you won't just be following established guidelines - you'll be a primary architect in their creation. You will lead the effort to shape the team's processes, enhance its tools, and develop its operational strategy. Your leadership, insights, and the feedback from your team will be crucial in building this function from the ground up.

This is a unique opportunity for a sharp, inspiring leader who excels in high-pressure situations and has a passion for developing expert investigators. If you are eager to build a team of subject matter experts in the comprehensive KYC/FinCrime arena and seek a position where your leadership will significantly influence our clients, enhance our reputation, and mentor the next wave of talent —then this opportunity is perfect for you.

Job Responsibilities
• Team Leadership

Lead by example and drive a customer focused mindset across your team. Promote a culture of ownership and accountability. Build high-performing teams that value knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
• People management

Coach and develop a strong team of KYC Analysts. Come up with initiatives to help your team to grow their skills, behaviours, and competencies. Design and manage development plans on identified opportunities. Conducts career map check-ins and makes recommendations for promotions, salary raises, and other decisions.
• Operational management

Identify and propose opportunities for process improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase operational efficiency. Provide guidance and support on complex, high-risk cases and escalations, which may include acting as a direct point of contact for customers via email, phone, or video call during sensitive inquiries, interviews, or escalations.
• Performance management

Measure team KPIs and ensure performance targets and quality standards are met while maintaining focus on customer experience. Conduct regular one on one coaching sessions, usually on a weekly or biweekly basis. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best practices and enhance overall team spirit.
• Expertise Sharing

Be a subject matter expert in your area with the ability to train and coach your team on operational topics. Maintain a good understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, and applying a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Able to perform deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership.
• Planning and execution

Ensure key performance indicators are being met and provide insights to other stakeholders. Take full accountability in delivering your own initiatives and making sure your team is making progress on their goals.
• Stakeholder management and communication

Collaborate closely with your stakeholders ensuring clear communication and coordination of actions. You communicate mindfully and professionally while choosing the right formats and platforms to convey your message to a wider audience in a timely manner. Your initiatives and reports are well documented and it has a clear scope that includes potential impact in different areas.
• Quality assurance and control

Implement and maintain a robust quality assurance framework for your team. Conduct regular checks and reviews of your team’s casework to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to the highest standards of our policies and regulatory obligations. Provide targeted coaching and constructive feedback based on quality findings to drive continuous improvement. Analyse quality metrics to identify trends, address root causes of errors, and develop initiatives that enhance the team's overall performance and mitigate risk.

Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. Your mission

Keep Bitpanda's Braze running right. You will own the configuration of our Braze workspaces, from the data model behind attributes, events and segments to our templates and content blocks. You understand how APIs and data integrations work, and you can work directly with engineers to scope solutions and fix data issues. Your work lets the CRM team ship campaigns without worrying about the infrastructure underneath.

 

What you'll do
• Configure and maintain our Braze workspaces: attributes, segments, templates, content blocks and Liquid logic.
• Set up multi-market sends with Localisation so every language version is right.
• Run QA before every send and own deliverability hygiene.
• Fix broken attributes, templates and sends first-line; escalate pipeline issues to our MarTech Engineer.
• Document the setup so the team is never dependent on one person.

 

Who you are
• You have two to four years administering Braze (or similar CRM platform) for a multi-market programme.
• You own configuration, attributes, templates and QA hands-on; you are not looking for a strategy role.
• You are comfortable with Liquid, HTML and CSS for email templates, basic SQL for segment checks and reading integration API documentation.
• You document what you build and you check before you send.

 

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
