jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Marketplaces
jobs.description:
About us:

Branch is on a mission to empower workers with financial freedom. We do this by helping companies accelerate payments and providing working Americans with accessible, free financial services. We’re committed to building and delivering more inclusive, transparent, and frictionless financial products.

Our goal of empowerment extends to our own employees, too. Have a great idea? Share it today and it might just get implemented tomorrow. As a member of our team, your voice and creativity matter—and they can directly impact our products, company, and culture. 

We not only focus on attracting great talent from across the country, but also on building teams that help that talent thrive. That means valuing a diversity of opinions and working styles, while creating a shared belief in innovation, initiative, and winning together.

Come join our team as we develop new ways to improve the lives of working Americans.

About

the role:

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Enterprise Account Executive to join our Marketplaces sales team. Branch is a leader in the marketplace payments space, with some of the largest labor and delivery marketplaces in the world — including Uber and Instacart — among our largest customers. In this role, you will be responsible for driving new business acquisition and revenue growth by selling our innovative FinTech solutions to enterprise-level clients. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of managing complex sales cycles, building strong relationships with C-level executives, and a deep understanding of the financial services industry.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• Own and manage a named book of enterprise and upper‐mid‐market labor and seller marketplace clients to build strategic relationships at C-suite, VP, and director levels.
• Lead full sales cycles, from inbound and outbound prospecting through contract negotiation and closing.
• Partner closely with our embedded payments platform partner's sales organization to jointly identify, pursue, and manage shared accounts — driving co-sell and cross-sell opportunities and enabling their sellers to effectively position Branch within their deals.
• Develop and execute comprehensive account plans to win new business and expand with existing clients.
• Work cross‐functionally across Product, Finance, and Engineering to design and deliver custom solutions as part of a technical selling process.
• Drive and refine the marketplace strategy: help define and scale repeatable engagement models, sales motions, and positioning for Branch’s platform offerings.
• Use metrics and financial analysis to quantify value propositions and ROI for prospective clients.
• Collaborate with internal teams to shape product roadmap based on client feedback, competitive landscape, and market demand.
• Hit or exceed revenue targets, sales quotas, and other KPIs relevant to platform and enterprise deals.

Qualifications (required):
• 5–8 years of experience in enterprise sales, preferably selling platforms, embedded finance, payments, or infrastructure solutions.
• Have closed sizable ($500k+ ARR), complex deals (multi-stakeholder, multi-quarter cycles, including technical and non‐technical buyers).
• Are comfortable engaging senior executives (CTOs, CFOs, COOs) as well as technical leaders (engineers, security / compliance).
• Have strong product acumen and are capable of understanding and communicating both technical and financial value.
• Are highly analytical — you know how to build business cases, model ROI, and use data to drive decisions.
• Are self-motivated, resourceful, and can thrive in a fast‐moving environment that requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
• Are excellent communicators, both written and verbal.

Qualifications (preferred):
• Previous experience in fintech, embedded finance, or payments infrastructure.
• Experience selling into or working with HR technology and vertical SaaS platforms.
• Familiarity with risk, regulatory, and compliance considerations in financial services.

Compensation:

The On-Target Earnings (OTE) range for this role is $260-$300k (base compensation + commission). The compensation range displayed reflects an average range for the position across all the U.S. The compensation offered to an applicant could be higher or lower based on each applicant's specific skill set, depth of experience, relevant education or training, etc. 

Location:

This position is classified as REMOTE within the United States of America.

We are unable to hire candidates located outside of the domestic U.S.

Benefits:
• Market-leading medical, dental, and vision insurance
• Stock options
• Free Premium-Tier Origin Financial Wellness subscription
• Monthly home-office stipend
• 401k (TransAmerica)
• 12-weeks paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents
• Flexible time off + sick and safe time
• 11 paid company holidays
• Branch@Branch Same Day Pay Option

Identity Verification

As part of our application process, you'll receive a separate email from Greenhouse shortly containing a unique identity verification link. This step, powered by Persona, helps us confirm applicant identities and keep our hiring process secure for everyone. 

Upon identity verification, all biometric data is deleted. If you need support completing this application, please reach out to Careers@branchapp.com

Working at Branch

A remote-first company with employees located throughout the U.S., Branch emphasizes transparency, accountability, and trust to create a collaborative environment where our product, engineering, marketing, customer support, customer success, and sales teams can all thrive together. Learn more about what we do in this video!

Our collaborative spirit has helped us become an award-winning FinTech company, with Branch’s innovation and workplace recognized across industries. Branch has been honored by Inc., the Webby Awards, Benzinga FinTech Awards, FinTech Breakthrough Awards, Top Workplaces USA, Great Places to Work, and EY Entrepreneur of the Year, Heartland, among others. 

Learn more about our culture, approach, technology, and people here: https://www.branchapp.com/about

 

Branch is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Must be currently authorized to work in the USA without sponsorship or transfer.

No third-parties, please.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving force behind revenue at Brex, and Enterprise Sales continues to scale Brex upmarket. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring customers, and expanding value across our portfolio. Brex wins by changing how companies control spend (corporate cards, spend management, and expense in one platform, with AI agents that act upstream of the expense report) against both legacy tools and modern competitors. We celebrate individual accomplishments and team wins, with a high-performance culture rooted in collaboration, transparency, and execution.

What You’ll Do

As Director of Sales for our Enterprise segment, you will lead a team of approximately five Account Executives driving new customer acquisition as Brex moves further upmarket. You will own team performance and help customers build the business case for an enterprise-wide platform spanning corporate cards, spend management, and expense management.

You will operate at every level: in the deals, not above them. That means joining customer conversations, coaching multi-threading and executive engagement, and running a proactive operating cadence for account planning, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, and forecasting. Observing a forecast from the sidelines is not the job; being present on customer calls and shaping deal strategy with your AEs is non-negotiable. Success means exceeding team targets, developing strong enterprise sellers, and introducing repeatable ways of working that raise performance across Enterprise and Brex.

Where You’ll Work

This role can be based in any of our hubs: San Francisco, New York, Seattle, or Salt Lake City. Our hybrid environment combines the energy and connection of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three days per week in the office - Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also offer up to four weeks per year of fully remote work. 

Responsibilities
• Lead, coach, and develop approximately five Account Executives; hire and onboard additional talent while setting clear expectations for performance and accountability.
• Own team bookings and new customer acquisition; guide account prioritization and pipeline creation across direct, partner, and Capital One commercial bank opportunities.
• Establish a proactive operating cadence for account planning, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, and forecasting, with clear milestones, risks, owners, and next steps.
• Join customer calls and actively shape deal strategy, helping AEs build executive relationships, establish value before signature, and align Finance, Accounting, IT, HR, and Travel and Expense stakeholders.
• Orchestrate complex opportunities across Product, Marketing, Finance, Pricing, and implementation teams; translate customer needs into business cases, resolve blockers, and align commitments with delivery readiness.
• Partner with implementation and customer-facing teams on mutual action plans that extend from signature through go-live, helping closed deals convert into realized revenue.
• Build and test industry-specific messaging and sales playbooks from customer insights and successful deals; share effective practices across Enterprise and the broader business.
• Build trust through transparency, candid feedback, and direct conflict resolution; take ownership of improvements and partner with Enterprise Sales leadership and cross-functional GTM partners (Product, Marketing, Finance, Implementation, and Enablement) to strengthen how the segment operates.

Requirements
• 5+ years of first-line Enterprise sales leadership experience, including direct management, hiring, and development of Account Executives or transferable leadership experience.
• Proven record of meeting or exceeding team targets in complex, competitive B2B sales, with evidence of improving seller performance and sales execution.
• Experience leading enterprise-wide platform sales with long cycles and multiple buying functions; ability to establish a compelling business case and secure commitment before deployment.
• Hands-on deal leadership: joins customer conversations, coaches multithreading and executive engagement, and helps teams resolve difficult decisions that stall opportunities.
• Strong operating and project management discipline, with an established approach to account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and coordinating internal and customer stakeholders.
• Ability to influence cross-functional priorities, articulate the commercial value of customer needs, and coordinate execution across Product, Marketing, Finance, and customer-facing teams.
• Experience selling with partners and navigating the dependencies of a complex platform; financial services, spend management, or Office of the CFO experience is a plus.
• Clear communicator and low-ego, high-ownership leader who builds trust, acts with sound judgment in ambiguity, and introduces improvements that other teams can adopt.

Compensation

The target OTE range for this position is $316,400 - $395,500. Final base salary determination accounts for individual expertise, geographical location, relevant background, market dynamics, and internal equity alignment. Beyond base pay, comprehensive offer packages may encompass equity grants alongside additional total rewards components.

Brex LLC operates as a fully owned subsidiary under Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.description:
About Us

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Key Responsibilities
• Cloud Security Architecture and Hardening
Design, implement, and continuously strengthen security architectures across public cloud environments, including AWS, Tencent Cloud, Huawei Cloud, and Alibaba Cloud. Areas of focus include container isolation, Identity and Access Management (IAM), VPC network segmentation, and security policies.
• Security Operations and Incident Response
Build and continuously improve cloud security monitoring and operations capabilities, including Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM). Detect, investigate, and respond to security incidents, conduct root cause analysis and post-incident reviews, and drive remediation through to closure.
• Infrastructure Security and Vulnerability Management
Assess and harden cloud compute instances, containers, cloud services, and supporting infrastructure. Develop and enhance host and cloud vulnerability scanning capabilities, and track remediation to completion.
• Identity and Access Management
Design and maintain cloud IAM and Cloud Access Management (CAM) permission frameworks. Establish lifecycle management policies for credentials, including access keys and secret keys (AK/SK), API keys, and access tokens. Enforce least-privilege access and conduct periodic access reviews.
• Compliance and Risk Management
Conduct regular security baseline assessments and risk assessments across cloud environments. Produce security compliance reports against industry standards such as CIS Benchmarks, and support internal and external security audits, compliance reviews, and remediation activities.
• Security Standards and Technical Enablement
Develop and maintain cloud security policies, technical standards, and best-practice documentation. Provide security guidance, technical support, and training to engineering and operations teams to strengthen the organization’s overall cloud security capabilities.

Qualifications
• A solid foundation in Linux systems administration, with a strong understanding of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, and TLS, as well as common network security principles.
• Familiarity with major public cloud platforms, including AWS, Tencent Cloud, and Alibaba Cloud, with hands-on experience in cloud resource management, security configuration, or operations.
• An understanding of cloud-native technologies and their security models, with familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, serverless architectures, and associated security practices.
• Familiarity with public cloud IAM/CAM frameworks, with practical experience in permission model design, account governance, key management, or least-privilege implementation.
• An understanding of common cloud security threats and attack paths, including lateral movement, privilege escalation, server-side request forgery (SSRF), and abuse of the Instance Metadata Service (IMDS).
• Experience in vulnerability scanning, risk assessment, or security tool integration. Hands-on experience deploying, integrating, and operating Tenable, Orca, or comparable solutions is preferred.
• Experience managing north–south and east–west traffic, reducing exposed network boundaries, or designing and implementing zero-trust network architectures is preferred.
• Strong security risk awareness, analytical and problem-solving skills, and effective communication and collaboration abilities, with a demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional security initiatives and remediation efforts to completion.

 

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:

- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.

jobs.description:
As Mercury prepares to become a bank, our Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) program is in active development to meet bank-level regulatory expectations. As an early member of a growing TPRM team, you’ll help run the program day-to-day and contribute how it matures, bringing your own judgment and point of view to a function that is usually more rigidly defined, with room to be creative and make your mark.

As a Third Party Risk Manager, you will play a key part in helping protect Mercury, our customers, and the broader financial ecosystem from the risks associated with third parties. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Third Party Risk Management, you will conduct third party risk assessments, help build out related risk reporting, and carry out second line oversight activities to help reduce the impact of third-party risks.

This position focuses on enterprise-wide TPRM, rather than in-depth expertise in a specific domain like security or privacy. You will work closely with subject-matter experts across Compliance, Information Security, Privacy, and Procurement to make sure their requirements are reflected in the program, bringing a view across the full third-party lifecycle and the regulatory expectations that come with banking.*

Key

Responsibilities:
• Assess and risk rate: Complete third-party risk assessments, risk rate third parties, and open and track issues through resolution.
• Second-line oversight: Review and challenge first-line due diligence and ongoing monitoring, including reporting, approvals and oversight of those activities. First-line owners remain accountable for managing the third-party relationship, including SLAs, business reviews, exit strategies and onboarding.
• Reporting and data: Support maintenance of third party risk reporting and metrics for management and governance forums, and help keep the underlying data accurate.
• Tooling and automation: Help implement tooling and automation to make processes more efficient
• Program uplift: Support and contribute to uplift efforts across the TPRM program, including updates to policies, due diligence, risk assessment processes, and risk management across the third party lifecycle

Required

Qualifications:
• 4+ years of third party risk management experience, including 2+ years in a regulated financial services environment (bank, or fintech working with bank partners)
• Working knowledge of regulatory guidance on third party risk, including the Interagency Guidance on Third Party Relationships (and related FFIEC, OCC and FDIC expectations), and TPRM industry practices across the third party lifecycle (planning, due diligence, contracting, monitoring, termination)
• Hands-on experience completing third party risk assessments across multiple risk domains, not only security
• Experience reviewing and challenging first-line risk work with evidence-based pushback
• Experience supporting audits or exams of a TPRM program (gathering evidence, responding to requests, following up on findings)
• Experience building or maintaining TPRM reporting and metrics, with attention to data accuracy
• Solid program and project management skills, with experience supporting a program that spans multiple cross-functional components and driving process improvements through to implementation

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

The Senior Business Analyst plays a key role in shaping the growth and success of Moniepoint’s payment products. You'll design, test, and implement strategies that improve user acquisition, boost retention, and elevate product engagement. This role blends deep quantitative analysis with collaborative, strategic thinking. You'll partner with teams across the business to ensure our payment solutions meet real market demands and grow efficiently as we scale. Ultimately, you'll make sure our products not only attract users but also scale sustainably to create financial happiness for everyone.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Key Responsibilities
• Partner closely with product managers, business development, and data engineering teams to help our growth team uncover problems and make product metrics highly visible.
• Translate complex product and business questions into simple, actionable insights.
• Build, maintain, and scale self-service dashboards and custom visualisation tools.
• Own end-to-end analytics for our growth products—from gathering data requirements and estimating opportunity sizes to designing experiments and conducting post-launch impact reviews.
• Cultivate trusted relationships across teams, acting as a collaborative link between technology, business, and product.
• Apply advanced mathematical and statistical modelling techniques (including A/B tests, multivariate testing, clustering, and supervised learning) to solve practical business problems that drive high-impact results.

Qualifications
• 3 to 4 years of professional experience (excluding academic projects and internships) in a quantitative analysis role within high-scale tech companies, tier-1 consulting firms, or investment banks with strong programming demands.
• Excellent SQL skills (which we will test during our interview process).
• Practical experience designing, running, and analysing experiments on digital products (such as A/B and multivariate tests).
• Hands-on experience with popular visualisation tools like Tableau or Looker.
• Experience applying statistical modelling and advanced analytics to deliver practical, product-shaping insights.
• Strong skills in statistical programming (Python) and familiarity with tools like Pandas, SciPy, and Jupyter notebooks.
• Clear, professional spoken and written English.

Additional skills
• Product management
• Analytics
• Marketing
• Data Science
• Design
• Customer Success

What we can offer you
• Culture - We put our people first and prioritise every team member's well-being. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
• Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
• Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

• A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
• A panel interview with a member of the hiring team.
• A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

About the Role

N26 is seeking an analytical, regulatory-minded Complaints Compliance Prevention Manager to lead compliance governance, audit remediation, and the preventive control framework within our Complaints Management Prevention department. Reporting directly to the head of the department, you will own the end-to-end planning and execution of our regulatory remediation roadmap, separating administrative control and preventive functions from operational case handling. In this role, you will establish a robust, BaFin-compliant preventive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) framework and oversee CMP's Written Orders (SfO) to ensure full operational integrity, data quality, and compliance across all active N26 markets.The role combines a compliance mindset with deep understanding of operations specificity.

Dein Fokus liegt auf der rechtlichen Architektur und Absicherung wegweisender Finanzprodukte. Du gestaltest die Zukunft des digitalen Banking, indem du komplexe regulatorische Anforderungen in rechtssichere Konzepte übersetzt – von der Skalierung unserer Bank-, Trading- und Krypto-Angebote bis hin zur Erschließung neuer europäischer Märkte. Dabei balancierst du Agilität mit höchster Compliance und stellst sicher, dass unsere Produktvisionen stets im Einklang mit dem Aufsichtsrecht stehen.

Deine Aufgaben:
• Du wirst innerhalb des N26 Legal Departments in unserem Banking Law Litigation Team arbeiten und bei der Einführung sowie Skalierung von zukunftsweisenden Bank- und Finanzprodukten mitwirken (z. B. Trading Crypto).
• Du berätst das Management und den Vorstand ganzheitlich in allen rechtlichen Fragen im Zusammenhang mit bestehenden und neuen Banking, Trading und Finanzprodukten.
• Du bewertest komplexe regulatorische Anforderungen und entwickelst rechtssichere Konzepte für neue Produkte in einem dynamischen Umfeld.
• Du arbeitest eng mit dem Product und dem Compliance Team zusammen und stellst sicher, dass Innovation und regulatorische Compliance Hand in Hand gehen.
• Du fungierst als Ansprechpartner bei regulatorischen Prüfungen und steuerst souverän die Kommunikation mit Aufsichtsbehörden.
• Du koordinierst eigenverantwortlich die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Rechtsberatern und stellst eine erstklassige Beratungsqualität sicher.
• Du führst eigenständig Gerichts- sowie Streitbeilegungsverfahren und verantwortest das Management bedeutender Verfahren über alle Instanzen hinweg.
 

What you need to be successful

Hintergrund:
• Du bist deutscher Volljurist und hast das erste und zweite juristische Staatsexamen mit überdurchschnittlichen Ergebnissen abgeschlossen.
• Du kannst mindestens 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung und einen wesentlichen Teil davon im Bank- und Finanzrecht in einer renommierten Kanzlei oder/und in einem internationalen Unternehmen (gerne auch Fintech) vorweisen.
• Umfassende Kenntnisse im Bank- und Finanzrecht und in angrenzenden Rechtsgebieten sind erforderlich. Erfahrungen in anderen Rechtsgebieten sind willkommen.
• Idealerweise hast du bereits einen Fachanwaltslehrgang im Bank- und Kapitalmarktrecht erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder führst bereits den entsprechenden Fachanwaltstitel.
• Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift, jede weitere Sprache (insbesondere Französisch, Spanisch oder Italienisch) ist ein Plus.

Fähigkeiten:
• Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an technischen und betriebswirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen sowie digitalen Geschäftsmodellen.
• Du arbeitest eigenständig, triffst Entscheidungen und bist bereit diese auch intern und extern zu vertreten.
• Du bist bereit, dir pragmatisch auch neue Themen und Rechtsgebiete zu erschließen und dynamische regulatorische Entwicklungen eng zu begleiten.
• Du besitzt ein hohes Level an Integrität, Einsatzbereitschaft und Eigeninitiative und scheust dich nicht vor Personalverantwortung.

Das erwartet dich bei uns:
• Treibe deine Karriere voran und werde Teil eines der bekanntesten FinTech-Disruptoren Europas 🚀.
• Mitarbeiter-Benefits: Ein attraktives Budget für deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung, ein Home-Office-Budget, Rabatte auf Fitness- und Wellness-Mitgliedschaften, Sprach-Apps sowie Vergünstigungen für den öffentlichen Nahverkehr.
• Exklusive N26 Vorteile: Als N26 Mitarbeiter:in erhältst du kostenlosen Zugang zu einem N26 Premium-Konto sowie kostenlose Abonnements für Freunde und Familie.
• Treuebonus: Ein zusätzlicher Tag Urlaub für jedes Jahr Betriebszugehörigkeit.
• Freiraum Technologie: Ein hohes Maß an Autonomie und Zugang zu modernsten Technologien – während du in einem freundlichen, internationalen Team mit unterschiedlichsten Erfahrungen und Hintergründen arbeitest.
• Relocation-Paket: Unterstützung beim Umzug und Visum-Prozess für alle, die es benötigen.

Wer wir sind

N26 hat Banking für die heutige digitale Welt neu gedacht. Technologie und Design prägen alles, was wir tun – so bauen wir die globale Bankenplattform, die Menschen weltweit gerne nutzen.

Wir haben physische Filialen, Papierkram und versteckte Gebühren abgeschafft und durch ein elegantes digitales Erlebnis ersetzt. Menschen die Freiheit zu geben, so zu leben und zu banken, wie sie wollen – das ist es, was uns jeden Morgen antreibt und inspiriert.

Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin, weitere Standorte befinden sich in mehreren europäischen Städten wie Madrid und Barcelona. Unser Team zählt über 1.700 Mitarbeiter:innen aus mehr als 80 Nationen.

Chancengleichheit für alle

jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Brand Creative Team is evolving and elevating how the Robinhood brand shows up and reaches people – capturing attention, earning trust, and driving our next phase of growth.

Design has always given Robinhood an edge, and it matters more than ever as we continue to grow.

As Creative Director, Design, you will lead the Robinhood brand identity and the design system behind it, setting the direction for everything from campaigns to product launches and events. You'll push the brand forward, hold the work to a world-class bar, and make sure it scales as Robinhood reaches more people.

This role is based in our New York, NY or Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do
• Set the design vision. Define where the Robinhood visual identity goes next and what world-class looks like across brand, campaigns, motion, product and IRL. Turn a clear point of view into design that puts Robinhood at the forefront of the best design brands in the world.
• Own the brand design system. Lead how we define, document and evolve the identity so it stays ownable, flexible and cohesive everywhere it shows up. Build guidelines and workflows that work for the people using them and hold up at scale.
• Modernize how we make. Put AI at the center of how we design. Lead the charge on evaluating, piloting and standardizing the tools and AI-forward workflows that transform concepting, production and localization.
• Raise the bar on the work. Hold a high standard for craft and ideas, from concept through execution. Give clear feedback, don't let good enough ship, and keep agency partners and timelines moving.
• Move brand and product forward together. Partner with Product Design to build best-in-class experiences where brand and product feel like one. Make every moment so compelling people want to come back.
• Partner with the business. Work with marketing, growth and other teams to keep the brand tied to business goals. Turn goals and data into design decisions, and bring senior leaders along.

What you bring
• 10+ years in design, art direction and brand storytelling, with 4+ years in senior design roles at a consumer brand, fintech or agency.
• A world-class portfolio of brand-level work and system-level thinking across brand, marketing and product.
• Demonstrated experience at the forefront of technology, specifically use of AI to level up design output and quality.
• Experience leading designers and multidisciplinary teams, including freelancers and agencies.

Skills and mindset
• Visionary and business-minded. You have a clear creative vision and the conviction to set direction. You understand how design drives the business and turn goals and data into work that delivers impact.
• Craft and collaboration. You have a strong eye and a high bar, you know what great looks like, and you can say why. You collaborate and take feedback to reach better solutions.
• Systems thinker. You think in systems, not one-off assets.
• AI-native. You're at the forefront of technology and use AI to improve design output and quality.
• Influence and leadership. You bring people along on the journey. You win over senior executives, teams, and the people around you.
• Experience in financial services or another regulated category is a plus.

What we offer
• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
• Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
• Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
• Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
• Employer-paid life disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more
• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces

jobs.title: Direct Mail Marketing Manager, Credit Card (Contract)
jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The role:

SoFi is seeking an energetic, organized, and resourceful Direct Mail Marketing Manager for a one-year contract to manage the end-to-end direct mail creative process for the SoFi Credit Card product, from strategy and planning through creative development, stakeholder review, approval, production, and tracking. This role will also analyze campaign performance and provide recommendations to optimize future direct mail strategies and creative.

At SoFi, you’ll become part of a new kind of finance company whose ambition is to help our members achieve financial independence and reach their goals. We aim to be at the center of our members’ financial lives and help every member get their money right. We created student loan refinancing, addressing the biggest financial challenge of a new generation through a modern approach to lending and personal finance. Next, we expanded our products and services across loans, investing, and cash management. SoFi has achieved significant growth, with ambitious plans ahead, but to continue this growth, we need great talent. And that starts with you.

What you’ll do: 

This role owns four core areas of responsibility:
1. Creative Strategy Planning
• Lead end-to-end creative strategy and execution for Credit Card direct mail campaigns, partnering with Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to align initiatives with business goals, priorities, and growth objectives.
• Lead quarterly creative planning with the creative agency, using audience insights, customer behavior, performance data, and test-and-learn principles to develop strategic recommendations for the Product Marketing Manager.
• Lead upfront data and audience planning with DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science and agency team defining targeting, segmentation, personalization, measurement requirements, and data inputs that inform the creative strategy, testing plan, and campaign brief.
• Own the creative roadmap and partner with the creative agency to develop compelling messaging, visual storytelling, offers, personalization, branding, and calls to action.
2. Campaign Production Management
• Serve as the day-to-day campaign lead and primary liaison among Product Marketing Manager, the creative and data strategy agency, DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science, other internal stakeholders, and print vendors.
• Serve as the lead DM representative in Credit Card business unit meetings, Marketing Data Science handoff meetings, and other recurring meetings. Prepare slides as needed, capture key decisions and action items, and distribute notes to appropriate stakeholders.
• Translate approved strategies into actionable campaign plans, creative briefs, testing plans, and production requirements.
• Manage monthly direct mail tests and creative variations, ensuring audience definitions, segmentation, data requirements, personalization, and creative variants are aligned and executable.
• Own campaign timelines and the shared production calendar, including data due dates, creative milestones, review rounds, release dates, print dates, and drop dates.
• Manage assets, versioning, production samples, dependencies, risks, and bottlenecks to ensure campaigns launch accurately and on time.
• Maintain the monthly campaign matrix, including audience targeting, creative variations, testing plans, data requirements, and other campaign details.
• Partner with Marketing Data Science to update campaign matrices and verify that targeting and personalization information is accurate before each drop.
• Lead weekly status meetings with Product Marketing Managers, including agenda development, stakeholder alignment, and action-item follow-up.
3. Compliance, Quality Operations
• Lead the Compliance and Legal review process for direct mail materials, partnering with Product Marketing and the creative agency to ensure executions meet regulatory, disclosure, brand, and business requirements.
• Manage creative review and quality control across messaging, data, personalization, offers, URLs, disclosures, and final production files.
• Serve as the central point of accountability for ensuring every campaign is accurate, compliant, data-aligned, approved, and production-ready.
• Manage campaign production and postage costs, partnering with the DM billing team to keep campaigns within budget.
4. Performance, Insights Competitive Intelligence
• Partner with Marketing Data Science, analytics, and the creative agency to evaluate campaign and creative test results against product and business goals.
• Translate audience, performance, and campaign data into actionable insights that inform creative recommendations, messaging, offers, personalization, segmentation, and future test strategies.
• Lead weekly Product Marketing Manager performance updates and monthly reporting, presenting results and optimization recommendations to Product Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Apply campaign learnings to improve future direct mail initiatives and inform the creative roadmap.
• Build and maintain a competitive direct mail library, monitoring competitor activity, creative trends, offers, formats, personalization, and audience strategies.
• Share monthly competitive and performance insights with the broader Marketing organization to inform future campaign and product marketing strategy.

What you’ll need:
• Bachelor's degree with 4+ years of project management experience, preferably supporting direct mail or other marketing campaigns within financial services or another highly regulated industry.
• Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to execute complex, multi-channel campaigns and operational initiatives.
• Experience managing high-volume direct mail, CRM, lifecycle, or integrated marketing creative execution, ideally within financial services, credit cards, banking, or another highly regulated industry.
• Strong project and production management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, creative versions, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.
• Highly proficient in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, Docs, Slides, Gmail, and Calendar, Tableau, Snowflake; comfortable building and maintaining detailed trackers and production workflows.
• Strong understanding of creative development, production, version control, review/approval processes, and vendor management.
• Experience working directly with Legal, Compliance, Creative, Marketing, Analytics, Data, and external production vendors.
• Strong attention to detail and a high level of ownership, particularly when managing personalized credit card communications where small errors can have significant downstream impact.
• Comfortable working in a test-and-learn environment, using campaign performance data to inform future creative decisions.
• Excellent communication and organizational skills with the ability to keep senior stakeholders informed while driving day-to-day execution.
• Financial services or credit card marketing experience strongly preferred, particularly familiarity with regulated marketing, compliance reviews, disclosures, and credit-related communications.

Compensation and Benefits

jobs.title: Head of Credit Decision Modelling and Strategy
jobs.description:
Starling is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way. Read more about our story here.

We’re a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We’re a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. We employ more than 3,500 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

To support our ongoing growth, we’re looking to recruit a Head of Credit Risk Modelling and Strategy within the 2nd line Credit Risk Team. The role will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the financial stability of the Bank by leading the development and continuous improvement of regulatory and operational credit risk models and credit decisioning strategies. The role requires a deep understanding of credit risk principles, regulatory requirements, and credit model and strategy development. As part of the second line of defence, you will work closely with, and provide insight to, stakeholders across the business, while delivering robust credit risk models and strategies that align with the Bank’s overall risk appetite and strategy.

Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities
• Lead the development, monitoring and maintenance of the Bank’s credit risk decisioning models, including acquisition scorecards and affordability models.
• Develop and monitor automated decisioning strategies for the Bank’s lending products.
• Define standards for credit risk model development which align to the Bank’s Model Risk Framework, and ensure these are implemented within the team.
• Ensure all credit risk models and strategies comply with relevant UK regulatory standards, including PRA and FCA requirements.
• Collaborate with key internal stakeholders, including the first line Asset Management and Finance teams, to ensure models and strategies support business objectives.
• Ensure all models and standards are documented to a high standard, and present outputs to senior stakeholders and committees.
• Lead and develop a high performing team of risk modelling analysts, and support individual continuous professional development.
• Keep track of industry trends and regulatory requirements to continually enhance the Bank’s management of credit risk.
• 10+ years’ experience in Credit Risk within a Banking environment.
• Strong experience of credit risk modelling, gained through model development or validation related roles.
• Strong understanding of retail and SME lending products.
• Experience of developing and maintaining credit risk strategies, ideally in an unsecured retail lending environment.
• Experience of a range of lending products (mortgages, unsecured retail lending, SME lending) preferred.
• Proven experience in influencing, negotiation and relationship management.
• Strong communication skills, with experience of preparing and presenting documents in relation to models.
• Coding experience in Python, R, SAS or similar.
• Good knowledge of model risk governance.
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships

jobs.description:
Starling is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way. Read more about our story here.

We are looking for a talented and passionate Senior Credit Decision Modelling Analyst to join our 2nd line Credit Risk team. Our team plays a critical role in developing and maintaining credit risk models and strategies across Starling, including the models used to assess our new lending applications. If you have experience in credit risk model development, and are eager to be part of the team that plays a vital role in credit risk management, we want to hear from you! 

As a Senior Credit Decision Modelling Analyst, you will be responsible for:
• Developing and implementing credit risk models and strategies.
• Working closely with stakeholders to ensure that model developments meet business requirements.
• Producing detailed model documentation, including methodology, assumptions, and limitations.
• Monitoring model performance and conducting regular reviews to ensure accuracy and stability.
• Collaborating with model validation teams to address any findings and ensure models are robust.
• Presenting model developments to Senior leadership, and representing the Credit Risk Modelling team with internal and external stakeholders.
• Minimum 3 - 5 years’ experience in developing credit risk models.
• Proficient in the use of analytical tools such as Python/R/SQL/SAS and spreadsheets.
• Graduate level education preferable, ideally in a numerical degree (or an equivalent work experience).
• Good understanding of unsecured lending products, ideally covering both retail and SME.
• Good knowledge of regulatory and risk management guidelines relating to credit risk.
• Ability to articulate model development methodologies and findings in a succinct and clear way that is suitable for the target audience.
• Organised, flexible and adaptable, with the ability to switch between tasks seamlessly.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst - Credit Products
jobs.location: India, Bengaluru; India, Delhi NCR; India, Hyderabad
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT

THE ROLE:

As a Senior Analyst - Credit Products you’ll work closely with Tide’s credit product teams to shape credit product and risk decision making. This role will suit an individual that can operate with a high degree of independence and has hands-on experience of proactively taking initiative to uncover insights from data. 

As a key member of our team, your role will go beyond merely generating reports; you will be expected to extract meaningful insights from data, enabling informed decision-making that drives our lending strategy. If you have a keen ability to decipher complex credit focused data sets and transform them into actionable insights that guide our decision making, we encourage you to apply for this position and help shape the future of SME lending.

Some of the things you’ll be doing:
• Data Analysis Insight Generation: Utilise advanced analytics to derive meaningful insights from complex data sets. Focus on analysing lending product performance, identifying trends, and providing actionable recommendations.
• Credit Risk Management: Monitor and optimise key performance indicators (KPIs) related to credit risk. Develop strategies to mitigate risk while supporting business growth.
• Collaboration with Credit Product Teams: Work closely with product managers and developers to inform and guide the development of new credit products. Use data-driven insights to influence product strategy and design.
• Reporting Communication: Prepare comprehensive reports and presentations for senior management and stakeholders. Clearly communicate findings and recommendations.
• Continuous Learning Improvement: Stay abreast of industry trends and advancements in data analytics tools and methodologies. Continuously seek ways to improve our data analysis processes and credit product offerings.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
• 4+ years of experience working as a credit focused analyst or data scientist at a fintech or bank.
• You have expert SQL proficiency and can navigate complex data warehouse relationships
• You are a self starter who takes initiative and can operate with a high degree of independence.
• You have the ability to deal with ambiguity and competing objectives in a fast paced environment.

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: 

Make work, work for you! We are embracing new ways of working and support flexible working arrangements. With our new Hybrid working model Working Out of Office (WOO) policy our colleagues can work remotely from home or anywhere in their home country. Additionally, you can work from a different country for 90 days of the year. Plus, you’ll get:
• Competitive salary
• Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing
• Employee Assistance Programme
• 12 casual 15 Privilege leaves
• We invest in your development with professional L D budget per year
• Spacious office in Hitechcity with all day snacks
• 24 hours paid volunteering time off per year
• Hybrid working
• Sabbatical leave 

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

 

Disclaimer

 

It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.

ABOUT THE TEAM:

Tide is one app with many products for small businesses: business accounts, payments, credit, insurance, invoicing, accounting and more. Over 2 million members across the UK, India, Germany and France use it to run their businesses.

Our Product Design team designs every part of that experience. Designers work inside cross-functional teams alongside Product Managers, Engineers, UX Writers and Researchers, and we encourage designers to move between teams so they keep learning and growing.

We’re at an exciting point. Under our new design structure, we’re raising the bar on craft, making the whole app feel like one connected experience, and building a stronger design community. We’re also building a senior individual contributor track in design for the first time. This role is one of the first, so you’ll help define what design looks like at Tide.

THE ROLE:

As a Senior Staff Product Designer, you’ll work on our most complex and high-visibility problems. You’ll report directly to the Head of Design and work across teams rather than sitting in one, moving to wherever the biggest design challenge is.

Projects include continuing to evolve our AI solutions, helping shape the next phase of our app architecture and taking lead on new 0 to 1 initiatives. You will also help actively raise the quality bar across the entire design organization.

We’re open to designers operating at Senior-Staff or Principal level. Titles vary across companies, so what matters most is the strength of your craft, the quality of your thinking, and the impact you’ve had.

• Lead multiple projects end to end. Go from early discovery and concepts to prototyping, testing and handover to engineering, working hands-on in Figma.
• Shape the experience strategy. Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to turn messy, ambiguous problems into a clear design vision, priorities and roadmap.
• Connect the app. Work with design leads across Tide to create shared patterns and foundations, as Tide app continues to evolve across 55+ products.
• Raise the craft bar. Set the example for quality, mentor other designers, and introduce better ways of working.
• Pioneer AI. Shape how AI shows up in our product, and how we use AI in our own design process, from ideas to code.
• Measure and iterate. Ship, learn from real member behaviour, and improve. You’d rather launch, learn and refine than wait for perfection.

• 12+ years in product design, with experience operating at Staff level or above (or equivalent scope) in a SaaS, fintech or scale-up environment

• Systems thinking: you design across features and touchpoints, not just single screens

• Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.

• Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - API Experience & Security
jobs.description:
Your customers are the developers, security teams, and operational teams at our partners. Companies like Morgan Stanley, N26 and Ramp rely on Wise Platform APIs to run critical payments journeys in production. It’s your job to ensure they can connect securely, operate reliably, and troubleshoot issues quickly — without needing manual support.

As the Senior Product Manager for API Tooling, you will own the roadmap and execution for the API access, security and webhook infrastructure and tooling of Wise Platform API integrations. You’ll focus on reducing partner-impacting incidents (especially auth- and webhook-related), improving observability and self-serve troubleshooting, and modernising the auth and security foundations so the platform can scale safely over the next few years. You will partner and work closely with the Security, Account Access and Wise Platform teams to build API solutions suitable for our enterprise partnerships.

Your mission: Make Wise Platform integrations secure-by-default and reliable in production, with self-serve operational API visibility that reduces failures and support load.

What you’ll be working on
• Own the Wise Platform partner API access, webhook service and WP API security offering, making it easy for developers to securely connect and troubleshoot our APIs.
• Design in partnership with the Security team, credential management, authentication strategies, and secure connection protocols that balance security with developer experience.
• Build and improve webhook reliability, observability, and usability.
• Deliver API and webhook logs and diagnostics tooling that helps partners and internal teams investigate and recover from issues faster.
• Ensure the auth and security infrastructure of Wise Platform is robust and scalable for the long term service demands.

In this role, you will;

Own the roadmap
• Define and execute a roadmap centred on secure access, reliability, and operational excellence in production.

Drive execution
• Work closely with engineering to ship improvements that measurably reduce incidents, support load, and time-to-resolution.
• Make pragmatic trade-offs between scope, security, reliability, and delivery speed.

Collaborate cross-functionally
• Partner with platform engineering, security, compliance, support, sales, and other product teams to deliver a cohesive partner experience.
• Align internal teams on ownership boundaries and operational processes for incident prevention and response.

Be customer-obsessed
• Engage directly with partner developers and operational teams to understand real production pain (auth failures, webhook issues, visibility gaps).
• Use data and incident learnings to prioritise the highest-risk and highest-impact improvements.

Measure and iterate
• Define success metrics around reliability and operability (e.g., incident rates, auth failure rates, webhook delivery success, support ticket drivers, time-to-resolution, self-serve adoption).

Deliver impact
• Deliver measurable reductions in partner-impacting incidents, improved troubleshooting speed, and stronger security posture that supports enterprise adoption.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Wise Platform Fincrime
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to help build and scale a new fincrime product engineering team. You’ll own the vision and roadmap for partner-specific financial crime controls across fraud, AML, screening, and internal tooling. You’ll work closely with engineering, compliance, operations, partner experience and commercial teams to reduce risk and help Wise Platform scale safely.

What you’ll be doing
• Own the roadmap for Wise Platform fincrime controls and investigator tooling, balancing risk mitigation, operational load, and partner experience.
• Lead cross-functional delivery across engineering, compliance, operations and partner teams. Turn problems into clear plans and ship improvements iteratively.
• Develop deep domain understanding of Wise Platform partner models and how fincrime risks present differently in embedded/correspondent-like use cases versus consumer/business.
• Improve UX and user experience of internal tools and workflows used to review alerts/cases, making investigations faster, safer, and more consistent.
• Use data to drive decisions. Define success metrics, monitor effectiveness (and false positives/ops impact), and continuously tune what we ship.
• Represent Wise Platform across Wise, ensuring alignment with broader control changes and building strong stakeholder relationships with other teams in fincrime domains.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst - WISE Platform - Send for Partners
jobs.description:
ABOUT WISE PLATFORM

Wise Platform takes all of the world-class payments products Wise has built over the last 15 years and enables hundreds of millions of consumers and businesses to access them in the places where they already move and manage their money - with banks and large tech platforms.

Today, we’re already powering payments for some of the world’s top neobanks like Monzo, N26, and Nubank, alongside a growing list of leading global banks such as UniCredit, Morgan Stanley and Standard Chartered, to name a few. In the tech platforms space, we’re powering payments for partners across a whole range of industry verticals and use cases. Whether that’s leading marketplaces like Google, Agoda, or Upwork, workforce management tools like Deel, or investment platforms like Interactive Brokers - we’re bringing the power, simplicity, and transparency of Wise to even more people and places.

And, we’re just getting started! Wise Platform is one of the newest and fastest growing products at Wise. We’re a global and highly cross-functional team, spearheading Wise next phase of growth! 

THE ROLE

As the Senior Product Analyst in Send for Partners, you’ll sit at the centre of one of Wise Platform’s biggest products: helping the world’s largest banks and platforms send money across borders. You’ll work with the Send for Partner’s team to uncover opportunities that shape the product roadmap, measure success of initiatives and performance against KPIs, and work cross functionality to support product features from ideation to scale. jobs.title: Product Lead, Wise for Banks
jobs.description:
We are seeking a strategic, execution-oriented Principal Product Manager / Product Lead to to lead a complex product area within Wise Platform’s Banks portfolio.

You’ll set the product direction, turn ambiguous problems into clear priorities and work closely with our engineering teams to deliver measurable improvements. You’ll combine an understanding of bank partners and their customers with the technical and commercial judgement needed to build payments products that scale.

This is a senior individual contributor role with influence beyond your immediate team and a clear path to leadership. You’ll own your area’s strategy and outcomes, connect priorities across teams and help raise the quality of product decisions across Wise Platform.

Your mission:
• Set a clear product direction. Develop a compelling vision for your area, grounded in customer needs, partner insight and data. Translate it into a focused roadmap, with clear objectives and a considered view of what to build, improve or stop.
• Understand the problems that matter. Spend time with bank partners and their customers to understand their needs, infrastructure and constraints. Work with Sales and Delivery to identify patterns across opportunities and turn those insights into product decisions.
• Make difficult choices. Balance customer value and commercial opportunity with technical complexity, regulatory requirements, risk and operational impact. Explain your decisions clearly and help teams move forward when priorities compete or ownership is unclear.
• Stay close to delivery. Work with Engineering, Design and Analytics from discovery through launch and iteration. Get into the detail of APIs, integrations and payment flows, challenge assumptions, resolve blockers and help the team deliver at pace.

• Help partners succeed. Represent the product credibly with prospective and existing banks. Help Sales and Delivery qualify and unblock strategic opportunities, set realistic expectations and identify solutions that meet partner needs while supporting a coherent product strategy.

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:

• Solve payments problems that span technology, customer experience, commercial needs and regulation.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Manager - WISE Platform
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

You’ll be at the centre of one of Wise Platform’s biggest growth opportunities, working with product, engineering, operations and commercial leaders to shape our product and go-to-market strategy. As part of the vertical leadership team, you’ll shape its priorities, building conviction through your insights and analysis and drive cross-functional stakeholders to action.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role in a fast-scaling “start-up within a scale-up” environment. You’ll turn ambiguous problems into structured analysis, insights into compelling narratives and opportunities into high-conviction product bets.

The role will require you to be hands-on and develop a deep understanding of our products, partners and opportunity areas. You’ll own the verticals performance and be willing to get your hands dirty, helping analysts and cross-functional partners to work through some of the most complex and ambiguous problem areas.

You’ll manage a team from day one, while building and scaling a high-performing product analytics function for the vertical. You’ll set a clear analytics vision and roadmap, develop analysts and establish the data, metrics and ways of working needed to support the vertical as it grows.

You’ll help us answer questions such as:
• Where are our biggest product, growth and commercial opportunities?
• Who should we be building and selling our products and solutions for?
• What products should we build or improve to unlock growth?
• How can we reduce time to revenue and ensure partners scale effectively?
• Where is friction occurring across the onboarding and transaction lifecycle, and how should we address it?
• How should we position and prioritise our products to create the greatest long-term impact?
• How should we structure and resource our teams?

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
• Own the vertical’s growth and performance end-to-end. You’ll define and proactively manage the vertical and sub-teams’ KPIs and metrics suite, ensuring there is a clear understanding of product performance. You’ll identify root causes, undertake deep dives and work with counterparts to turn your insights into actionable recommendations.
• Lead product discovery, market and opportunity sizing for product initiatives, understanding their short- and long-term impact against our KPIs. You’ll use this work to shape strategy, prioritise opportunities and influence product and commercial roadmaps.
• Build and scale a high-performing product analytics function as the vertical grows, setting its vision, priorities, operating model and ways of working. You’ll also build the analytics foundations needed to scale, including reliable data models, clear metric definitions and effective self-serve reporting.
• Lead, coach and develop a team of product analysts from day one, creating a high bar for analytical quality, commercial thinking and impact.

jobs.title: Lead Data Analyst - Wise Business - Commercial & Sales
jobs.description:

The Wise Business account helps small and medium-sized businesses across the world focus on what matters most to them: growth.

jobs.title: Staff Content Designer — Grow Squad (12m FTC)
jobs.description:
How should global money work? How do you take a complex, stressful experience and make it simple, calming even? How do you challenge the way it’s always been done? How do you collaborate in a human-centred way to ship work you’re truly proud of?

These are just a few of the challenges a Staff Content Designer will work on as part of Wise’s global mission to build an open, fair, and human financial system. Right now we move £6 billion every month for over 12 million people. But we're only 2% done — because people without borders deserve money without borders.

What you’ll be doing:

You’ll be working with the cross-functional teams that make up Grow — a squad that’s rethinking how people can earn a return on all of their money, no matter the currency, goal or risk appetite. 

In this role, you’ll focus on enabling Wise customers to earn a return on their money. You’ll invest time in deeply understanding our customers and their needs, so that you can design and deliver experiences that make complex processes like choosing an investment product, understanding gains or paying tax easy and effortless. You’ll build systems that help the squad bring the product to new markets, balancing a global vision with local nuance.

You'll also be part of the Content Guild, and will regularly collaborate with the content community across Wise.

Here’s how you’ll contribute:
• Get to know our customers, building empathy and a deep understanding of their needs
• Use your expertise to discover, design and deliver simple, beautifully crafted, intuitive experiences that customers love
• Influence teams and stakeholders to increase customer-centeredness, creativity, and content quality across the squad
• Work with designers from other squads to build a single, seamless experience for customers

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Deliver impact and ship work you’re proud of
• Own content projects from end-to-end
• Elevate content quality — defining what good looks like in the squad, then helping deliver it
• Be part of a positive change in the world. We’re fixing a broken, greedy system, and putting people and businesses in control of their money

About you:
• You’re an accomplished Staff Content Designer with extensive experience shipping world-class consumer products
• You’re comfortable navigating complexity and ambiguity — and can successfully collaborate in this environment
• You have an eye for quality. You know how to deliver it yourself, and how to support other designers to do the same
• You’re influential, inspiring, and able to work with others in a culture that values autonomy and empowerment
• You’re highly empathetic, both to customers and the people you work with
• You’re a trusted partner who builds effective relationships with your peers across the business

 

Heads up, this probably isn’t for you if:
• Your experience is mostly in marketing content, advertising, copywriting, journalism or social media — and you have no hands-on experience of content design or working in UX

 

We’re people without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We want to work with the best people, no matter their background. So if you’re passionate about learning new things and keen to join our mission, you’ll fit right in. And because we believe that diverse teams build better products, we’d especially love to hear from you if you’re from an under-represented demographic.

jobs.title: Lead Analyst - APAC AML Risk
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Lead Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to partner with our APAC AML product team to help drive data-driven and innovative growth decisions while helping to combat financial crime for our APAC markets. 

The APAC AML product team complements Wise's global AML functions and owns the region's AML outcomes end to end: making sure local risks are understood, controls are calibrated to each market, and every APAC entity stays within risk appetite, while protecting the experience of our good customers.

In this vital role, you will innovate and implement controls that enhance security without compromising user convenience. Most importantly, you’ll collaborate closely with your product managers, designers, data scientists and engineers to bring your insights into real change for our customers!

Your mission:

At Wise our mission is Money Without Borders - instant, convenient, transparent and eventually free. Whether our customers are sending money to another country, spending money abroad, or making and receiving international business payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. 

Here’s how you’ll be contributing to the APAC AML team:

• Proactively contribute to, own, create, track key metrics and results for your product and operational teams, keeping them accountable throughout the quarter
• Work with data scientists in understanding and developing the means for detecting and mitigating financial crime

• Drive the discovery phase by scoping new opportunities and suggesting features, rules and models to combat emerging risks. This includes also supporting typology coverage for APAC
• Quantify risk-growth trade offs - size how controls affect growth, revenue and customer experience to inform AML strategy in APAC
• The role requires collaboration with Product, Data Scientists, Engineering and Operations Team

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Be part of a positive change in the world. We’re fixing a broken, greedy system, and putting people and businesses in control of their money

• Influence the team’s direction. Analysts at Wise enable data-driven decision making and have a large impact by helping their teams to decide what to work on.
• Learn from a global network of professionals. We have a large, diverse team of analysts, data scientists and product managers that you will work with and learn from.

jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Specialist (Investment Products)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced operations professional who understands financial systems, leads complex improvements and helps others deliver. You’ll tackle our most challenging operational problems, bring teams together and take responsibility for making solutions work in practice.
