jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - API Experience & Security - WISE Platform
jobs.description:
Your customers are the developers, security teams, and operational teams at our partners. Companies like Morgan Stanley, N26 and Ramp rely on Wise Platform APIs to run critical payments journeys in production. It’s your job to ensure they can connect securely, operate reliably, and troubleshoot issues quickly — without needing manual support.

As the Senior Product Manager for API Tooling, you will own the roadmap and execution for the API access, security and webhook infrastructure and tooling of Wise Platform API integrations. You’ll focus on reducing partner-impacting incidents (especially auth- and webhook-related), improving observability and self-serve troubleshooting, and modernising the auth and security foundations so the platform can scale safely over the next few years. You will partner and work closely with the Security, Account Access and Wise Platform teams to build API solutions suitable for our enterprise partnerships.

Your mission: Make Wise Platform integrations secure-by-default and reliable in production, with self-serve operational API visibility that reduces failures and support load.

What you’ll be working on
• Own the Wise Platform partner API access, webhook service and WP API security offering, making it easy for developers to securely connect and troubleshoot our APIs.
• Design in partnership with the Security team, credential management, authentication strategies, and secure connection protocols that balance security with developer experience.
• Build and improve webhook reliability, observability, and usability.
• Deliver API and webhook logs and diagnostics tooling that helps partners and internal teams investigate and recover from issues faster.
• Ensure the auth and security infrastructure of Wise Platform is robust and scalable for the long term service demands.

In this role, you will;

Own the roadmap
• Define and execute a roadmap centred on secure access, reliability, and operational excellence in production.

Drive execution
• Work closely with engineering to ship improvements that measurably reduce incidents, support load, and time-to-resolution.
• Make pragmatic trade-offs between scope, security, reliability, and delivery speed.

Collaborate cross-functionally
• Partner with platform engineering, security, compliance, support, sales, and other product teams to deliver a cohesive partner experience.
• Align internal teams on ownership boundaries and operational processes for incident prevention and response.

Be customer-obsessed
• Engage directly with partner developers and operational teams to understand real production pain (auth failures, webhook issues, visibility gaps).
• Use data and incident learnings to prioritise the highest-risk and highest-impact improvements.

Measure and iterate
• Define success metrics around reliability and operability (e.g., incident rates, auth failure rates, webhook delivery success, support ticket drivers, time-to-resolution, self-serve adoption).

Deliver impact
• Deliver measurable reductions in partner-impacting incidents, improved troubleshooting speed, and stronger security posture that supports enterprise adoption.

jobs.title: Staff Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About the Role

At Wise, our Staff Analyst is one of our most senior individual contributor roles in Analytics.

A Staff-level Analyst at Wise is a senior IC who defines and owns the analytical direction for a broad problem space or domain — identifying the right problems to solve, shaping priorities and ways of working, setting the measurement approach, building scalable solutions, and influencing senior stakeholders to drive outcomes across multiple teams.

You'll work closely with teams and leaders across Wise, including Product, Engineering, Operations and other business functions. Rather than being focused on a single team or squad, your impact will span a broader domain, helping to connect priorities, identify opportunities and improve how we use data to make decisions.

You'll connect the dots across teams, identify where approaches are fragmented, and help create more consistent and scalable ways of working, measuring performance and solving problems.

This is a role for someone who can be both a best-in-class technical leader and a strong hands-on deliverer — setting direction and standards while still getting deep into the work when needed.

What you'll do

jobs.title: Staff Analyst - Servicing

jobs.title: Staff Product Analyst – Product Growth
jobs.description:
London 

About the Role

At Wise, our Staff Analyst is one of our most senior individual contributor roles in Analytics.

A Staff-level Analyst at Wise is a senior IC who defines and owns the analytical direction for a broad problem space or domain — identifying the right problems to solve, shaping priorities and ways of working, setting the measurement approach, building scalable solutions, and influencing senior stakeholders to drive outcomes across multiple teams.

In this role, you'll help us fundamentally improve how we understand and measure growth across Global Product. We have a lot of data on what is happening across our products, but we need to get much better at understanding where our growth actually comes from, what is driving it and how the things we build translate into long-term customer and business value.

You'll lead the development of a much stronger understanding of our historical and incremental growth — connecting product launches and investments to the growth we see today, distinguishing the impact of recent initiatives from the momentum created by things we've built in the past, and helping teams understand what is really moving our business forward.

You'll also help us rethink how we use AI and automation across Product Analytics. From experimentation reporting to quarterly KPI updates and performance reviews, there is a significant opportunity to make our analytical processes more scalable, automated and insightful.

Finally, you'll develop a deeper understanding of product adoption across Global Product: how customers evolve as they start using different features, how their behaviours change and what this means for customer value, engagement and the sustainability of our growth.

This is a role for someone who combines exceptional analytical thinking, technical depth and curiosity with a strong interest in building new ways of working. You'll be expected to set direction, build solutions yourself and influence how teams across Global Product understand and drive growth.

What you'll do
• Own the analytical direction for understanding Global Product growth, identifying the biggest gaps in how we currently measure, explain and attribute our growth.
• Build a historical growth explainer model, developing a robust framework to explain where our growth comes from, how different products and initiatives contribute to it, and how much of today's performance is driven by investments made in the past versus more recent activity.
• Connect product investments to business outcomes, helping teams understand the incremental momentum generated by previous launches, the time it takes for impact to materialise and where we are seeing genuine new growth versus underlying momentum.
• Automate our analytical lookbacks, moving beyond manual, retrospective analysis towards scalable approaches that consistently explain what has moved our metrics and why.
• Drive AI deployment across Global Product Analytics, identifying opportunities to use AI and automation to improve the quality, speed and scalability of our analytical work.
• Rethink experimentation reporting, building more automated and insightful approaches to how we report, interpret and communicate experimentation results across Global Product.
• Automate recurring performance reporting, including quarterly KPI updates and other regular analytical processes, reducing manual work while improving the consistency and quality of insights.
• Develop a causal understanding of product adoption, investigating how customers' behaviours, engagement, value and economic contribution change as they adopt different features and products.
• Understand the relationship between adoption and sustainability, identifying which adoption journeys lead to stronger customer outcomes, greater product depth and more sustainable long-term value.
• Partner with Product, Engineering and Analytics leads across Global Product to turn these insights into better investment decisions, product priorities and growth strategies.
• Build scalable data models, analytical frameworks and tools that can be reused across teams, raising the overall standard of how we measure and understand growth.
• Champion technical excellence and mentor other Analysts, helping raise the analytical and technical bar across Wise.

What you'll bring
• Exceptional analytical thinking — you're naturally curious about what drives business performance and can move beyond describing what happened to understanding why it happened.
• Growth and product understanding — you understand product growth, customer behaviour, adoption and the relationship between product usage and long-term customer value.
• Causal inference and measurement expertise — you have experience designing robust approaches to understanding incremental impact, measuring the effects of product changes and separating correlation from causation.
• Strong technical capability — expert SQL, strong data modelling skills and experience building complex analytical models and scalable data solutions.
• AI and automation mindset — you're excited about applying AI and automation to analytical workflows, with experience or strong interest in building practical solutions that improve how teams work.
• Experimentation expertise — you understand experimentation frameworks, how to interpret results and how to build scalable approaches to measuring product impact.
• Strategic thinking — you can identify the biggest gaps in how a business understands its performance, prioritise the most valuable problems and connect analytical work to wider company goals.
• Cross-functional partnership — you've worked closely with Product, Engineering and Analytics teams, influencing how they think about growth and make decisions.
• Senior stakeholder influence — you're comfortable challenging assumptions, communicating complex insights clearly and shaping decisions across multiple teams.
• High autonomy — you thrive in ambiguity, proactively identify opportunities and enjoy building something from the ground up rather than simply executing an existing roadmap.
• Technical leadership without people management — you lead through expertise, standards, frameworks, mentoring and the quality of your own delivery.

jobs.title: Staff Analyst – Sustainability & Pricing

You'll work closely with Product, Finance, Commercial, Engineering and other teams to bring a much clearer understanding of the economics behind our growth. As Wise continues to evolve from a cross-border product into a broader account offering, you'll play an important role in ensuring our pricing remains competitive and attractive to customers while supporting our ambition for sustainable growth and strong contribution margins.

This is a role for someone who can combine deep commercial and analytical thinking with strong technical capability — setting direction while remaining hands-on in the work.

What you'll do
• Own the analytical direction for sustainability and pricing across Global Product, defining the key questions, priorities and analytical approaches needed to understand the economics of our business.

• Shape our cost and revenue allocation frameworks, ensuring we have a consistent and meaningful understanding of the economics of different products, customer journeys and revenue streams.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead - Business Expense Management
jobs.description:

You’ll be joining a growing team that is expanding the way Business customers can use their Wise Account. Time is money, and small businesses cannot waste theirs. They sit within the Spend Squad and are responsible for bookkeeping, business card features and expense management. They offer a solution that allows businesses to manage their team's spending in minutes, and maintain full control over international expenses. We help small businesses collect receipts and information about expenses in the most convenient way, so our customers can focus on their work. jobs.title: Risk Manager - Tooling & Analytics
jobs.description:
As a Risk Manager in Wise’s second line Risk Management Team, you will help make risk management easy to adopt and seamless to use across Wise. 

We help teams understand and manage their risks by building technology, tools and processes that fit naturally into how they work. You will turn stakeholder problems into practical solutions, reducing manual effort and making effective risk management part of everyday decision-making.

You will own the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of Wise’s Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) tool. Alongside this, you will use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and Codex to build solutions, integrations and minimum viable products (MVPs) that solve real problems. You will take solutions from idea through testing and initial release, then work with relevant technical teams to make them reliable, secure and supportable in production.

What You'll Be Doing:
• GRC product ownership: Manage the daily operation within Wise’s GRC tool, ensuring it is reliable, efficient and fit for stakeholder needs. Own its improvement backlog and prioritise changes based on user needs and risk management outcomes.
• Risk management enablement: Work with teams across Wise to understand what makes risk management difficult or time-consuming. Simplify workflows and build solutions that make adoption easier while preserving effective risk oversight.
• AI-assisted development: Use tools such as Claude Code and Codex to design, build and iterate on solutions, automations, integrations and internal tools. Move from a clearly defined problem to a working solution that users can test and adopt.
• Delivery and production readiness: Own solutions beyond the prototype stage. Validate feasibility, test with users and coordinate initial releases. Partner with engineering, security and other relevant teams to establish appropriate testing, access controls, monitoring, documentation and ongoing ownership as solutions move into production.
• Continuous improvement: Gather stakeholder feedback, test ideas and roll out iterative improvements. Measure success through adoption, usability, data quality, time saved and better risk management outcomes.
• Data analysis and reporting: Read, manipulate and analyse large datasets to support risk management. Build dashboards and reports that help stakeholders understand risks, identify issues and take action.
• Training and adoption: Develop clear guidance and deliver practical training so teams can confidently use the GRC tool and supporting solutions.

What You'll Bring:
• Technology and AI-assisted development: You can translate stakeholder needs into practical technical solutions, working with GRC platforms, databases, APIs and AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex. You can test and debug your work and collaborate with specialists to make solutions production-ready.
• User focus: You start with the problems people need to solve, seek feedback and challenge unnecessary complexity. You build tools and workflows that make risk management easier to adopt.
• Analytical

skills:

You are confident handling large datasets, proficient in Excel and comfortable using SQL. Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker or Power BI is valuable.
• Risk knowledge: You understand fundamental risk management concepts and can apply them when designing tools and workflows.
• Collaboration and initiative: You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, manage competing priorities and take ownership of delivery. You are curious about new technologies and proactive in turning ideas into useful solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst - AUP (Fraud Squad)

Here's how you'll contribute to the team:

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer II  - Real Time Data Engineering- Java
jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate Senior Data Engineer II to join our Treasury Global Liquidity team. In this role, you will help design and build the foundations of our real-time liquidity observability stack and core streaming data pipelines that power global financial operations at Wise.

You will be responsible for delivering key infrastructure initiatives, setting the technical streaming strategyand building robust, scalable systems that handle high-velocity financial movement with zero room for error. You will have a direct and measurable impact across multiple Wise products by enabling dynamic, real-time capital positioning as one of the founding engineers of a high-visibility team, laying the groundwork today and scaling the full engineering capability over the next year.

At Wise, we operate in autonomous, cross-functional teams. You will work in a highly collaborative environment, partnering closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Quantitative Analysts, and Treasury Ops.

Engineering at Wise is founded on clear communication, healthy debate to reach technical clarity, and a deep consciousness of system edge cases and failure modes before code hits production.

What will you be working on?

You will transform the financial engineering impact by pioneering our real-time Liquidity Attribution Model (LAM)! You will architect high-throughput Kafka and Flink streaming pipelines that continuously process global bank transactions, dynamically balancing demand against supply intraday. 

This is an opportunity to architect low-latency streaming pipelines that deliver instant, global liquidity visibility across every currency, jurisdiction, and nostro account. 

You'll build the high-octane engine behind our cash positioning, routing high-value transactions instantaneously with fine-grained event controls, fueling ML forecasting models to maximize yield on surplus capital, and bulletproofing our event architecture against out-of-order spikes, network partitions, and schema shifts.

You will also master a cutting-edge Medallion architecture and pairing streaming pipelines with sub-second OLAP querying, empowering Treasury Ops with instant, precise visibility into unencumbered liquidity redefining how global treasury operates at scale long before end-of-day.

The squad operates with high ownership and low ego, thriving on clear, actionable communication that bridges the gap between complex streaming architecture and real-world Treasury impact. 

Navigating high-stakes trade-offs across latency, financial cost, regulatory boundaries, and customer experience is second nature to us. This will give you the opportunity to proactively chase clarity using collaborative RFCs, whiteboard sessions, and direct stakeholder loops to solve ambiguity before it hits production. 

Above all, we lead by example: writing well-tested, maintainable code, rigorous design reviews, and constantly raising the engineering bar together.

A missão desta posição é apoiar a gestão operacional dessa força de trabalho digital: capacity dos agentes, qualidade das saídas, filas de exceção (humano no loop) e indicadores de performance, com informação organizada e decisão orientada a dados. O objetivo é aumentar vendas, produtividade e eficiência, com operação mais previsível e escalável, sem inflar headcount humano na mesma proporção do volume.
No seu dia a dia, você vai:
• Acompanhar o capacity da BPO de agentes (volume que o fleet aguenta, gargalos, ociosidade, picos e necessidade de fallback humano), apoiando decisões e alinhamentos com a liderança.
• Monitorar indicadores operacionais e comerciais: throughput, tempo de ciclo, taxa de acerto, retrabalho, fallback, qualidade, custo por caso e demais KPIs da operação.
• Construir, atualizar e analisar relatórios e diagnósticos, com visão clara de resultados, desvios e oportunidades de melhoria.
• Priorizar o que o agente processa versus o que sobe para humano, mantendo a fila de exceção sob controle.
• Atuar em parceria com o time de Canais: mapear jornada por canal, identificar melhores práticas de atuação dos agentes e garantir visão comercial (conversão, prioridade de fila, o que gera venda).
• Conectar a operação às APIs dos canais (o que plugar, em qual fluxo, com qual regra), alinhando Canais, produto e TI/IA para o agente usar o canal certo, com qualidade e sem quebrar a jornada.
• Apoiar a comunicação entre crédito, quem constrói/ajusta o agente, Canais e demais áreas internas, com prioridade e status claros.
• Atuar com Inteligência Comercial e lideranças no acompanhamento de performance e eficiência, conectando indicadores a planos de ação.
• Interagir com Produtos, Growth, Salesforce, TI, CX, Canais e times de IA/automação, alinhando processo, indicador, API e iniciativa operacional.
• Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua (fluxo, regra, qualidade da instrução ao agente, padronização de rotina).
• Apoiar a estruturação de rotinas, cadências e materiais operacionais — inclusive playbook de incidente e escalonamento.

A posição não treina modelo do zero, não desenvolve API sozinha, não decide crédito sozinha e não substitui gestão de contrato jurídico.
O que buscamos
Obrigatórios:
• Experiência com análise operacional, gestão de indicadores e acompanhamento de operação (BPO, shared services, operação digital ou equivalente).
• Vivência em performance operacional e em construção/análise de relatórios para decisão orientada a dados.
• Visão comercial aplicada à operação: entender como o canal e o agente impactam venda, conversão e prioridade — não só “fila andando”.
• Parceria com times de Canais (ou equivalente): identificar melhores práticas de atuação e traduzir isso em rotina, regra e priorização.
• Letramento em IA aplicada à operação: o que o agente faz, onde erra, quando parar e enviar para humano.
• Noção de API e integração o suficiente para plugar a operação ao canal: saber o que a API entrega, onde entra no fluxo e o que alinhar com TI/Canais — sem precisar ser pessoa desenvolvedora.
• Perfil analítico, com leitura de performance e identificação de oportunidade de eficiência e qualidade.
• Domínio de Excel ou Google Sheets em nível intermediário/avançado.
• Experiência em interação com múltiplas áreas e stakeholders.
• Comunicação clara, organização, senso de prioridade e atuação em ambiente dinâmico.
• Orientação a resultado, produtividade e eficiência, com postura proativa e senso de dono.

Desejáveis:
• Experiência em operações de crédito (imobiliário ou correlatas).
• Vivência com melhoria contínua, otimização e padronização de rotinas.
• Interesse ou experiência com automação, orquestração de fluxos, APIs e soluções de IA na operação.

Sua missão será desenvolver soluções backend de alta performance, seguras e escaláveis utilizando Java/Micronaut. • Construir e manter fluxos financeiros e operacionais críticos do marketplace: cálculo de comissões (take rate), repasses e débitos de sellers, gestão de cashback/benefícios, estornos em lote, workflows de aprovação (maker-checker) e conciliação contábil (SAP/SOX).

• Vivência prática com frameworks modernos para microsserviços (Micronaut e/ou Spring Boot).

• Conhecimento básico ou intermediário de SQL
• Capacidade analítica, curiosidade e interesse em investigar problemas até a causa
• Boa comunicação para transformar análises complexas em explicações simples e acionáveis
• Cuidado com qualidade, privacidade, segurança e uso responsável dos dados dos clientes

• Familiaridade com dashboards e ferramentas de visualização de dados como Tableau e/ou Newrelic

• Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas estratégicas de Design nas frentes de Investimentos e Seguros.

jobs.title: Head of Regulatory Affairs
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Legal at Brex

The Legal team helps the company grow responsibly, advocating for Brex and for the thousands of growing businesses we serve. We provide strategic advice and guidance to all Brex teams, protect Brex, advise on risk, and represent the company externally, negotiating with partners and interacting with regulators. Reimagining the financial system in a highly regulated environment requires creativity and resourcefulness, and we welcome the challenge.

What you'll do

Reporting to the General Counsel, you will lead Brex's Regulatory Affairs function and guide the company's relationships and interactions with its federal and state regulators, including the OCC, the Federal Reserve, FINRA, and state licensing agencies. • Own recruiting delivery for your Engineering teams: pipeline quality, conversion rates, time-to-fill, and candidate experience
• Partner with Engineering managers and directors to translate hiring plans into sourcing, assessment, and closing strategies
• Run weekly pipeline reviews and surface risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to the Director of Technical Recruiting and Engineering leadership
• Drive consistency in interviewer calibration, debriefs, and offer strategy across your team
• Give direct, timely feedback and run effective 1:1s, career conversations, and performance cycles
• Onboard and enable new recruiters and sourcers; raise the craft of the team

• Use data to diagnose funnel problems and drive process improvements

• Demonstrated experience hiring software engineers across multiple levels, including senior and staff-level roles
• Track record of developing recruiters through coaching and direct feedback
• Strong analytical instincts; comfortable reading pipeline data and translating it into action
• Experience as a trusted partner to Engineering managers and senior engineers
• Ability to operate with autonomy and handle ambiguity in a fast-moving, evolving org

Bonus Points
• Experience hiring in multiple geographies, including Brazil or other international hubs
• Experience hiring for AI/ML, Infrastructure, Platform, or Security roles
• Experience navigating recruiting through an acquisition or org integration
• Proficiency with Greenhouse, Gem, LinkedIn Recruiter, or similar tooling

• Contribute to continuous improvement of recruiting processes, inclusive hiring and candidate experience.

• Strong sourcing skills and familiarity with AI tools, recruiting platforms and creative talent networks.
• Ability to assess design portfolios and understand craft, systems thinking and user-centered methods.
• Excellent communication, relationship-building and stakeholder management.
• Data-driven mindset: interprets recruiting metrics and drives process improvements.
• Manages multiple searches and priorities at once.

jobs.description:

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. Recruiting is where every career at Brex begins. We’re the first point of connection for future builders and leaders, helping candidates see what’s possible. We move quickly, think strategically, and take pride in creating a thoughtful, welcoming candidate experience from the very first contact. We don’t just fill roles, we shape the culture at Brex, finding the next generation of builders and leaders.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a Senior Technical Recruiting Manager to lead hiring for Product and Design at Brex. You’ll manage a team of technical recruiters and sourcers, own hiring strategy and delivery for Product Management, Product Design, Design Research, and Design Leadership, and be the trusted talent advisor to our Product and Design leaders.

Design and product talent markets reward recruiters who understand the craft: how to read a portfolio, how to talk about design process and product sense, and how to make a candidate feel the quality of the work before they join. We want a leader who brings that depth and can teach it to a team.

This is a people leadership role. You’ll report to the Director of Technical Recruiting and partner closely with the Chief Product Officer’s leadership team, Design leadership, People Business Partners, Recruiting Operations, Compensation, and Finance as we grow in a post-acquisition environment as part of Capital One.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Technical Recruiters and Sourcers focused on Product Management and Design hiring
• Own hiring strategy and delivery for Product and Design: pipeline quality, conversion rates, time-to-fill, and candidate experience
• Partner with Product and Design leaders to translate hiring plans into sourcing, assessment, and closing strategies
• Shape how we assess design talent, including portfolio review, craft and case-study interviews, and calibration across design and product interviewers
• Build sourcing strategies for thin, high-bar markets, including senior Product Designers, Design Managers, Design Researchers, and Product leaders
• Maintain a clear view of pipeline health; surface risks and recommendations to the Director of Technical Recruiting and leadership
• Drive consistency in interview quality, debriefs, and offer strategy across your team
• Give direct, timely feedback and run effective 1:1s, career conversations, and performance cycles
• Partner with Recruiting Operations, Compensation, and Finance on headcount planning, tooling, and capacity modeling

Requirements
• 6+ years of recruiting experience in high-growth or venture-backed tech companies, including significant Design recruiting
• 2+ years of people management experience leading recruiting teams
• Demonstrated experience hiring Product Designers and Product Managers across levels, including senior, staff, and leadership roles
• Deep understanding of the design craft and portfolio-based assessment, and the credibility to advise Design leaders on process and bar
• Track record of developing recruiters through coaching and direct feedback
• Strong analytical instincts; comfortable reading pipeline data and translating it into action
• Experience as a strategic partner to Product and Design leadership
• Ability to operate with autonomy and handle ambiguity in a fast-moving, evolving org

Bonus Points
• Experience hiring Design Managers, Design Directors, or Head of Design roles
• Experience hiring for Design Research, Content Design, Brand, or Design Systems
• Experience hiring in fintech or B2B SaaS

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $235,944 - $262,160 USD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Credit Card Support

The Role:

Associate, Customer Support

At Gemini, our Credit Card Support Associates play a crucial role in delivering exceptional customer service and ensuring efficient resolution of inquiries. They are dedicated to providing clear, effective support, addressing customer needs with precision, and upholding our high service standards. We are seeking a driven, self-motivated individual with strong interpersonal skills who thrives in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and ready to make an immediate impact by delivering reliable and efficient support to our customers.

Responsibilities:
• Confidently handle customer support calls with warmth, professionalism, and empathy, drawing on experience and active listening to identify the root cause of customer concerns before guiding them toward effective resolutions and delivering an exceptional customer experience.
• Manage inbound customer inquiries and issues through Zendesk, providing timely and effective resolutions while ensuring a high level of service and customer satisfaction.
• Serve as a trusted liaison between customers and cross-functional teams, communicating clearly, advocating for customer needs, and ensuring consistent follow-through to resolution.

• Partner with department heads to maintain accurate, practical runbooks, procedures, and internal documentation that support consistent service and an exceptional customer experience.
• Identify opportunities to improve processes and simplify workflows, taking ownership of projects from initial recommendation through successful completion.
• Provide occasional on-call weekend coverage and adjust weekday schedules as needed to support customer needs and team coverage.
• Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of the Gemini Credit Card product and related policies, translating that knowledge into clear, accurate guidance tailored to each customer’s needs.

Qualifications:
• 3-4 years in a customer support capacity or equivalent.
• Familiarity with Crypto.
• Passionate about providing a great customer experience.
• Confident verbal communication and polished written communication.
• Experience administering and configuring Zendesk Support, Guide and Chat.
• Experience in financial services support and a regulated environment.
• Experience and comfort with solving complex problems from end-to-end.
• Comfort with flexible hours, including weekends, for comprehensive support coverage.
• Basic understanding of Financial Markets and Trading.

• Paid Parental Leave
• Competitive paid time off

In Singapore, we have a hybrid work policy. Employees are expected to work from the office part of the week. We believe our hybrid approach increases productivity through more in-person collaboration where possible. All employees are required to onboard in-person at our office.

At Gemini, we strive to build diverse teams that reflect the people we want to empower through our products, and we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. jobs.title: CRM Manager
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London/UK Remote | 💰£57,000 - £77,000 (Dependent On Experience) + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

About the role

We are looking for a proactive and passionate CRM Manager to help us deliver CRM campaigns across Monzo's products offerings. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of customer engagement and retention with previous experience launching targeted, data-driven campaigns across multiple channels, including email, push notifications, and in-app.

⭐ Our CRM team

We are a fast growing team on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re responsible for designing high-impact communications across our products and the customer lifecycle to bring our Monzo magic to life.

We’re a hands on and highly collaborative team, working with lots of different folks across Monzo to drive innovation and automation of our messaging. We’re driven by data and excited by experimentation. This role is a great opportunity to help shape the future of our engagement strategy and programmes at Monzo.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by…
• Executing customer lifecycle CRM journeys across multiple touch points
• Working closely with team members to collaborate and help deliver a range of campaigns across multiple channels
• Monitoring campaign performance and ensuring campaigns are executed safely
• Supporting Campaign QA (helping to check set-up thoroughly as a second pair of eyes before launch)
• Collaborating with other CRM Managers in developing effective segmentation strategies to target relevant audiences for each campaign
• Delivering campaigns with a test and learn data driven approach
• Owning existing processes and always-on campaigns within the team, and keeping these documented and up to date

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if …
• You have hands on experience in CRM, with a proven track record of designing and implementing successful campaigns and automated journeys
• You have experience using a CRM platform for delivery (Braze, ideally)
• You have Fintech or Financial Services experience
• You have strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, generate hypotheses, and inform strategic decisions, Looker experience is an advantage
• You can demonstrate experience working with product teams across various areas, ensuring strategic alignment and customer-centric initiatives
• You bring excellent organisational and time management skills, with a keen eye for detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
• You can to organise priorities with stakeholders effectively
• You take a collaborative approach, working with all relevant stakeholders to deliver an end result that is right for the customer
• You have a Problem Solving mindset - able to solve potential problems or suggest alternative ways to achieve the desired outcome
• You're excited about what we do at Monzo

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £57,000 - £77,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) 

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps
• 30 minute chat with a Monzo Recruiter
• 30 minute call with the Hiring Manager
• Full Loop: 1 x Role Specific Interview (60 mins) + 1 x Behaviours Interview (45 mins)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

⏳We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

#CM-1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Team

The Service Stability Engineering Team envisions service stability as one of the core competitive strengths of the company's products. By building end-to-end, link-level risk management capabilities, the team aims to achieve sustainable automatic identification and analysis of stability risks, transforming from "reactive governance" to "proactive governance." This approach shifts more stability-related matters forward and addresses them early, preventing issues before they arise and enhancing user experience.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Oversee non-functional aspects of relevant business lines, closely collaborate with business units to ensure service stability.
• Based on data analysis, identify stability risks throughout the entire chain, detect unreasonable architectural designs in advance, uncover root causes of issues, and systematically address problems;
• Explore new technologies, tools, and architectural patterns, and promote the implementation of best practices in application architecture.

What We Look For In You
• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field, with over 8 years of experience in development and architecture.
• Proficiency in Java, hands-on experience with the Spring Cloud microservices technology stack, solid computer science fundamentals, and a grasp of Linux, storage, and network I/O principles.
• Possess experience in high-concurrency distributed system architecture or high-concurrency scenario component design and development, with an understanding of Java concurrency libraries.
• Understanding of core Middleware technologies like Nginx, Redis, ElasticSearch, Kafka, MySQL, Docker and Kubernetes.
• In-depth understanding of the business architecture currently managed, along with a strong methodology for architectural design.
• Capable of rationalizing architectural designs for new business lines and providing targeted optimization suggestions.

Nice-To-Haves
• Proficiency in speaking, reading and writing in both English and Mandarin to collaborate effectively with global and cross-functional team members.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependents
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer — Risk & AI
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

Building machine learning systems for risk at a global crypto exchange is fundamentally different from conventional ML engineering. The data spans on-chain activity, fiat deposits and withdrawals, trading behaviour, account access patterns, device intelligence, identity information, and customer interactions—signals that very few organizations can analyze together.

The problems are complex, adversarial, and constantly evolving. Models must identify emerging fraud patterns, scams, account takeovers, payment abuse, and other forms of financial risk while minimizing disruption to legitimate customers. Success is not measured only through offline model metrics. It is measured through prevented losses, improved approval rates, reduced false positives, faster investigations, and more reliable customer experience.

This role sits within a multidisciplinary risk team of machine learning engineers, data scientists, risk strategy specialists, analytics engineers, product managers, and operations teams. You will work across the full ML lifecycle — from problem formulation, feature engineering, and model development to real-time deployment, monitoring, experimentation, and continuous iteration.

You will also help shape how AI is used across the risk organization. LLM-assisted development, automated model workflows, AI-powered investigations, and intelligent review agents are part of the team’s daily work. We are looking for engineers who already use these tools effectively and can help establish safe, scalable, and production-ready AI practices.

 

What You’ll Be Doing 

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to build models and AI tools that help detect fraud and protect users at a global crypto exchange. You’ll apply deep learning and XGBoost, develop practical AI agents, and use AI coding tools in your daily work.
• Build, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models for fraud and risk detection.
• Improve data quality, features, and model performance, balancing fraud detection with customer experience.
• Develop AI agents to support investigations, summarize cases, retrieve evidence, and automate routine workflows.
• Use AI coding tools to accelerate development, testing, and debugging while reviewing and validating their output.
• Work with engineering, product, and risk teams to deploy solutions and monitor their impact.

 

What We Look For In You
• A strong foundation in machine learning, with hands-on experience in deep learning and tree-based models such as XGBoost or LightGBM.
• Strong Python skills and experience training, evaluating, and deploying models.
• Some practical experience building AI agents or LLM applications, including tool calling, retrieval, or workflow automation. Prototypes and personal projects are welcome.
• Regular use of AI coding tools, with the ability to understand, test, and improve generated code.
• Familiarity with databases and data pipelines for preparing training data and supporting ML workflows.
• Good problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

 

Nice to Haves
• Experience in account takeover (ATO), scam detection, or other fraud and risk use cases.
• Experience with LLM training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and alignment.
• Experience with reinforcement learning algorithms and their practical implementation.
• Experience with real-time ML systems, imbalanced datasets, or model explainability.
• Prior fraud or risk experience is helpful
• Fluency in Mandarin

The Onchain Data team builds the core data and technology infrastructure behind OKX Web3. We connect to diverse blockchain networks and collect, process, govern, interpret, and serve large-scale onchain data, delivering accurate, real-time, and reliable capabilities to Wallet, DEX, Explorer, Risk, CeFi, and AI products.

Our scope includes, but is not limited to:
• Multi-chain data ingestion, parsing, computation, and unified data models;
• Data capabilities for onchain assets, transactions, addresses, tokens, contracts, and projects;
• Blockchain explorers, the Project Marketplace, Onchain Data APIs, bots, and agents;
• Labels, risk detection, risk-control data, and security investigation capabilities;
• DEX trending rankings, token scoring, and other onchain data products;
• Global multi-region deployment, high-availability architecture, performance optimization, and system reliability;
• Deep application of AI in engineering, data analysis, risk investigation, and intelligent operations.

You will work on challenges involving heterogeneous chains, large-scale data, real-time computation, high concurrency, high availability, data accuracy, and complex cross-functional collaboration. Your work can directly improve user experience, asset security, and business growth.

What You May Work On

This is a broad hiring track rather than a single fixed role. Your responsibilities will be matched to your strengths, experience, and interests, and may include one or more of the following:
• Design, build, and evolve onchain data infrastructure, data services, or business systems, taking ownership of the quality and outcomes of critical modules.
• Build multi-chain ingestion, real-time and batch computation, data governance, search, storage, and serving capabilities, continuously improving data accuracy, completeness, and freshness.
• Contribute to blockchain explorers, the Project Marketplace, onchain assets, labels, risk control, DEX rankings, token scoring, and related platforms or products.
• Identify critical technical and business problems, make sound judgments, design solutions, coordinate resources, drive execution, and review outcomes.
• Build highly available, high-performance, scalable global systems, while continuously improving reliability, cost efficiency, delivery efficiency, and user experience.
• Use AI tools deeply and explore agents, intelligent investigation, engineering automation, and intelligent operations, turning successful practices into reusable team capabilities.
• Collaborate with product, data, security, algorithm, operations, and engineering teams to drive cross-functional initiatives to completion.

What We Value Most

Hunger — Curiosity and Drive
• You stay curious about AI, Web3, emerging technologies, and new business domains, and can learn unfamiliar areas quickly.
• You do not wait for instructions when facing a problem; you proactively understand the context, identify solutions, and drive execution.
• You go beyond completing assigned tasks and continue to ask about outcomes, user value, and opportunities for improvement.

Cognition — Cognitive Ability and Judgment
• You can quickly understand complex technical and business problems, build a structured mental model, and identify the core issue and key trade-offs.
• When information is incomplete or the situation is uncertain, you can form sound judgments based on facts and logical reasoning.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

About the Team

The Financial Crime Quality Assurance (QA) team at OKX is part of the Compliance Assurance function and is responsible for reviewing and rating the quality of AML Transaction Monitoring alert disposition and Financial Crime Investigations performed by the Global Financial Crime Investigations Team.

We are a team of risk-focused compliance experts who independently assess investigation quality, promote consistency in decision-making, and ensure compliance with AML/CFT requirements, internal policies, and regulatory expectations. By working closely with Operations, Product, and Compliance teams, we help strengthen financial crime controls and drive continuous improvement across the investigation lifecycle.

About the Opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity to lead the Financial Crime QA team within the Compliance Assurance function of a regulated crypto business. As QA Team Lead, you will manage a team of QA Analysts who review AML Transaction Monitoring alerts, Name Screening, EDD and other financial crime investigations.

You will own the day-to-day delivery and quality of the QA program, set and uphold review standards, and develop your team's expertise. Working closely with Financial Crime Operations, Compliance leadership and Product teams, you will turn QA insights into lasting improvements in investigation quality and the effectiveness of the firm's financial crime controls.

 

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• • 
Team Leadership People Management – Lead, mentor and develop a team of QA Analysts. Set clear objectives, allocate daily workload, manage capacity and productivity, and conduct regular one-to-ones and performance reviews. Support hiring, onboarding and training of new team members, and foster a culture of accountability, integrity and continuous learning.
• QA Program Ownership – Own the end-to-end delivery of QA reviews across Transaction Monitoring, Name Screening, Sanctions, EDD and other AML investigations. Ensure reviews are completed on time, to a consistent standard, and in line with agreed sampling plans and service levels.
• Quality Oversight Second-Level Review – Perform second-level reviews of QA Analyst findings, validate defect ratings and resolve disputes or challenges from Operations. Personally review complex, high-risk or escalated cases, and act as the final QA decision-maker on borderline outcomes.
• QA Framework Methodology – Design, maintain and enhance the QA framework, including scorecards, error taxonomies, risk-based sampling methodologies, procedures and quality standards. Ensure the framework reflects AML/CFT regulatory requirements, internal policies, and emerging crypto-specific typologies.
• Calibration Consistency – Lead regular calibration sessions within the QA team and with Financial Crime Operations to align on policy interpretation, grey areas and scoring methodology, and reduce subjectivity in quality evaluations.
• Management Information Reporting – Produce and present QA MI, dashboards and trend analysis to Financial Crime and Compliance leadership. Identify systemic issues, root causes and emerging risks, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for management and governance forums.
• Stakeholder Management – Act as the primary QA point of contact for Financial Crime Operations leadership, Team Leads, Product, Policy and other Compliance teams. Drive agreement on corrective actions, escalate material control weaknesses, and support internal and external audits and regulatory examinations as required.
• Coaching Quality Improvement – Partner with Operations and Training teams to turn QA findings into targeted coaching, training content and procedural updates. Act as a Subject Matter Expert on AML investigations, crypto typologies and regulatory expectations.
• Innovation AI-Enabled Quality – Drive the adoption and continuous improvement of AI-enabled quality tools such as QA Copilot. Define requirements, lead UAT and process validation, and identify opportunities to increase QA coverage and efficiency through automation.
• AML Projects Program Enhancements – Represent QA in AML projects, process changes and program enhancement initiatives, providing input on control design, quality standards and implementation readiness.
• Ad Hoc Responsibilities – Undertake additional projects and assignments as delegated by the Head of Compliance Assurance or their delegate.

 

 

What We Look For In You
• • 
Bachelor's degree in law, finance, business administration or a related field; a relevant compliance certification (e.g. CAMS, ICA) is strongly preferred
• 10+ years of experience in the financial services industry, with a significant focus on AML/CFT and financial crime compliance
• Experience in the cryptocurrency or digital asset industry is highly preferred, including familiarity with blockchain analytics tools (e.g. Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs) and crypto-specific financial crime typologies
• Proven hands-on experience in AML Transaction Monitoring and Financial Crime Investigations, including alert disposition, case investigation, and SAR/STR decisioning
• Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing, coaching and developing teams of analysts or investigators
• Experience in Quality Assurance and/or Monitoring Testing of AML controls is highly desirable, including designing scorecards, sampling methodologies and QA frameworks
• Strong understanding of global AML/CFT regulatory expectations and sanctions requirements
• Excellent analytical and judgment skills, with the ability to identify root causes and systemic issues and translate them into practical recommendations
• Strong stakeholder management skills and the confidence to challenge, influence and drive agreement with senior stakeholders
• Experience producing management information and presenting findings to leadership or governance forums

jobs.title: セールスエンジニア
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

 

業務について

▼エンプラ・パートナー支援部 セールスエンジニアチームの紹介

セールスエンジニアチームは、PayPayのエンタープライズ領域において、営業とプロダクトを技術面からつなぎ、加盟店・パートナーのPayPay導入および安定したサービス利用を支援するチームです。
PayPayでは、加盟店のシステム環境やビジネスモデルに応じてさまざまな決済接続方式が存在します。セールスエンジニアは営業と連携し、商談段階から技術的な要件整理や接続方式の検討を行い、導入・テスト・リリース、その後の安定運用まで幅広く支援します。
また、個別案件への対応だけではなく、接続時に発生する課題や障害を分析し、再発防止や導入プロセスの改善、営業への技術知識の展開などを通じて、組織全体の技術対応力を高めることも重要な役割です。
私たちは、単に技術的な問い合わせに回答するだけではなく、ビジネスとテクノロジー双方を理解し、技術の力で加盟店・営業・PayPayの事業を前に進める組織を目指しています。

 

▼募集の背景

PayPayの事業拡大に伴い、大手加盟店・パートナーとのシステム接続方式や構成、加盟店から求められる技術要件も多様化しています。特にエンタープライズ領域では、加盟店ごとに異なるシステム環境や要件を理解したうえで、営業・加盟店・パートナー・プロダクトなど多くの関係者と連携し、技術課題を解決していくことが求められます。こうした背景から、既存案件への技術支援にとどまらず、セールスエンジニア組織をリードしていただける方を求めています。

【主な役割】
・技術的な観点から営業案件を前に進める
・複雑なシステム接続における課題を整理・解決する
・導入時の設定・仕様確認を通じて障害や事故を未然に防止する
・発生した問題を分析し、再発防止やプロセス改善につなげる
・将来的な海外展開に向けたTechnical Integrationの知見を蓄積する

 

【具体的な業務内容】
• エンタープライズ加盟店やパートナー企業へのPayPay導入において、営業と連携しながら技術面から案件・組織をリードしていただきます。

1. 新規加盟店・パートナーへの導入支援
・営業商談への同席および技術的な提案支援
・加盟店・PSP・パートナーのシステム構成や要件のヒアリング
・PayPayの決済方式・API・SDK等の仕様説明
・加盟店の要件に応じた接続方式・システム構成の検討
・API/SDK Integrationに関する技術QA
・導入スケジュールや技術課題の整理・管理

2. リリース・安定稼働に向けた技術支援
・リリース前のシステム設定・接続内容の確認
・技術的なリスクの事前検知および事故防止
・加盟店・パートナー・社内関係部署との技術課題の調整
・リリース後の安定稼働に向けたフォロー

3. 決済不具合・障害発生時の技術支援
・決済不具合やシステム障害発生時の営業部門連携
・加盟店・PSP・Payment Gateway・社内プロダクト部門との連携
・営業への技術的な説明・対応方針の整理

4. セールスエンジニアリング機能の高度化
・頻出する技術QAやトラブル事例のナレッジ化

jobs.title: 営業支援担当（人材戦略）
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

 

業務について

▼営業支援部 人材戦略チームの紹介

PayPayの営業支援部 人材戦略チームは、全国展開する営業組織の生産性向上と人件費投資対効果の最大化を目指し、営業人材の採用・育成・評価・人員計画などを横断的に推進しています。
特に、営業人材の早期戦力化に向けて、新人教育の改善、営業現場の課題解決、AIを活用した営業支援などに取り組んでいます。各メンバーが専門性を持ち、現場や社内関係部署と連携しながら、課題の発見から改善施策の実行まで主体的に取り組むチームです。

 

▼募集の背景

PayPayでは、サービスの多様化や営業環境の変化に伴い、営業担当者が早期に成果を出せる育成体制の強化を進めています。
現在、新人向け研修やOJT、AIを活用した営業トレーニングなどを実施していますが、営業現場で実際に起きている課題を把握し、現場の実態に合わせて改善していく取り組みを更に強化したいと考えています。
そこで今回、営業経験を生かし、営業現場と一緒に人材育成や業務改善を進めていただける方を募集します。教育や営業企画の専門経験がなくても、ご自身の営業経験を生かし、新たな領域に挑戦したい方を歓迎します。

 

【具体的な業務内容】

■営業支援部
▽加盟店営業部門向け営業支援
加盟店営業を担当する営業組織を支援する業務となり、各種データの分析や営業プロセスの効率化などの営業活動の後方支援を行います。営業支援部は業務に応じて3チーム（各7名程）で構成されており、メンバー全員がプロジェクトリーダーとして推進する環境となっており、年齢や業務経験問わず活躍しております。

人材戦略チームでは営業現場と連携しながら、営業人材の育成や営業活動の改善に取り組んでいただきます。自身の営業経験を生かして、現場の課題発見から改善策の実行まで幅広く携わるポジションです。

▽具体的な業務内容
・営業現場への訪問・同行、営業担当者へのヒアリングを通じた課題の把握
・営業担当者が成果を出すための営業手法や成功事例の収集・共有
・新人営業担当者向けのOJT、ロールプレイング、教育施策の実行・改善支援
・営業現場の管理者や教育担当者との連携、育成上の課題解決
・営業活動や教育施策の効果確認、改善案の検討
・AIツールなどを活用した営業教育・営業支援の仕組みづくり

▽入社後について
まずはPayPayのサービスや営業活動の流れを理解し、営業現場と関係を構築するところからスタートしていただく想定です。
その後、これまでの営業経験や得意分野を生かしながら、教育施策や営業改善の取り組みに携わっていただきます。
営業教育や企画業務については、既存メンバーと連携しながら習得いただける環境を想定しています。

 

▼本ポジションの魅力

・営業経験を生かしたキャリアチェンジ： 自身の営業経験を、営業人材の育成や組織全体の生産性向上に生かせます。
・営業現場に近い仕事： デスクワークだけでなく、営業担当者と直接関わりながら課題解決に取り組めます。
・企画・改善スキルを習得： 営業経験を軸に、教育、営業企画、業務改善など新しい領域へキャリアを広げられます。
・自らのアイデアを実行できる： 現場で発見した課題について、関係部署と協力しながら改善に取り組めます。
・新しい技術を活用できる： AIなどを活用した営業教育や営業活動の効率化にも挑戦できます。

必要な経験/スキル

・顧客への提案、折衝を伴う営業実務経験（法人営業、代理店営業など）
・営業活動において、自ら工夫しながら課題解決や改善に取り組んだ経験
・社内外の関係者と円滑にコミュニケーションを取り、業務を進められる能力
※営業教育、営業企画の専門経験は必須ではありません。

あると望ましい経験/スキル

・営業メンバーへのOJT、指導、育成などの経験
・営業リーダーやチーム内での新人フォロー経験

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Robinhood Crypto Product Compliance team supports Product teams in developing and launching crypto products and services in alignment with regulatory requirements. The team serves as the primary compliance partner for product initiatives, providing guidance on product design, customer communications, and operational processes related to crypto offerings. Team members work closely with Product, Legal, Risk, Marketing, and Operations teams to support compliant product launches and ongoing enhancements. This team plays a key role in helping Robinhood deliver crypto experiences that meet customer needs while maintaining strong regulatory standards!

As Crypto Product Compliance Lead, you will support the development and enhancement of Robinhood’s crypto products and services. You will lead initiatives responsible for reviewing product designs, customer communications, and operational processes to support compliance with applicable regulations and firm policies. The role includes advising teams throughout the product lifecycle, from ideation through launch and post-launch enhancements. You will also work closely with Product, Legal, Risk, and Operations partners to support regulatory reviews, examinations, and business initiatives related to crypto products.

This role is based in our New York, NY and Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do
• Partner with Product teams and other business partners, including Legal, Risk, and Operations, during the design, testing, launch, and enhancement of crypto products and services.
• Advise on regulatory requirements and operational processes related to crypto products, including consumer protection, AML, sanctions, and financial crimes compliance considerations.
• Develop appropriate compliance framework for new products.
• Review product features, customer communications, and marketing materials to support compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and firm policies.
• Provide timely guidance to business partners on compliance questions, regulatory developments, and product-related issues.
• Support regulatory examinations, inquiries, filings, and internal compliance reviews, including developing and executing compliance testing and monitoring, related to Robinhood Crypto products.

• Passion for Robinhood’s mission to democratize finance for all and interest in crypto products and financial technology.
• 7+ years of experience in financial services, including experience supporting crypto products within compliance, risk, legal, audit, or operations functions.
• Experience with brokerage products.
• Awareness of anti-money laundering, sanctions, and financial crimes compliance requirements related to crypto products.
• Experience advising on consumer protection requirements.
• Experience advising on DeFi projects.
• Strong understanding of MiFID requirements is required.
• Ability to manage projects and coordinate work across technical and non-technical teams in a regulated environment.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting compliance guidance to business partners and leadership teams.
• Familiarity with global crypto regulatory frameworks, including MiCA, is a plus.
• Familiarity with traditional brokerage is a plus.
• Insatiable curiosity.

What we offer
• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
• Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.

jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Prime team's mission is to build Bitstamp's prime brokerage for institutional clients — the platform that lets hedge funds, market makers, and professional trading firms onboard, fund, trade, borrow against, and settle positions at scale. We build the systems that move real institutional money: cross-venue settlement, credit against collateral, matched-book lending, and the bridge that brings tokenized securities to our order book — together with the client- and ops-facing surfaces that make them usable, from institutional onboarding and account configuration to reporting and the backoffice tooling our operations run on every day. These are correctness-critical systems where a wrong answer can't be cheaply undone — getting them right is the whole job.

As a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will own the design and end-to-end delivery of features across that whole surface — from the Prime backend services down to the frontend and backoffice screens that expose them. You'll lead other engineers through problems of high ambiguity, set the technical bar for how we build for failure and not just the happy path, and follow a problem across the full institutional lifecycle rather than stopping at a boundary. Flexibility is the job: some weeks that's a settlement edge case in the backend, others a client onboarding flow or an ops dashboard, and you're happy owning whichever the work needs.

This role is based in our London office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

Requires participation in an on-call rotation to support business needs.

What you’ll do
• Lead the design and end-to-end delivery of features across the stack — from Prime backend services (settlement, on-exchange credit, lending, tokenized securities) through to the frontend and backoffice screens clients and ops teams rely on.
• Own the client- and ops-facing journeys across the institutional lifecycle — onboarding, account configuration, reporting, and the tooling that lets operations run the business safely.
• Author detailed designs and break work into reviewable steps, making failure states, invariants, and recovery explicit before you ship — on flows where a wrong answer moves real money.
• Uplevel the team through design-focused code review and mentorship, and move fluidly between backend and frontend as the work demands rather than handing off at a boundary.

What you bring
• A track record of independently delivering complex, high-ambiguity projects with long-term impact, operating them in production and owning every line you ship.
• Strong full-stack range in production — a modern backend (we work primarily in Python/Django and Go) and a component-based frontend (we use Vue) — with the judgment to know where a given problem is best solved and a genuine willingness to own whatever the feature needs, wherever it lives in the stack.
• Hands-on experience building financial systems — user balances, ledgers, risk engines, settlement, onboarding/KYC, or payments — where correctness is non-negotiable and mistakes are expensive.
• Strong design judgment: you enumerate the failure paths, name your invariants, and can point at the constraint, test, or alert that enforces each one.
• Excellent communication: you drive alignment across teams and stakeholders, give substantive design-level review feedback, and mentor engineers to raise the bar around you.

• Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership

• Aviva Pension Scheme with highly competitive company matching to secure your future

• Build and maintain semantic models and AI agents, held to the same modeling, access, and quality standards as our pipelines.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as other data engineers, people analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders, to translate requirements into production-ready deliverables, and communicate technical trade-offs to non-technical partners.

• Mentor other engineers through code review, modeling standards, and technical guidance.

jobs.title: Client Solutions Consultant - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
At Engine by Starling, we are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology. 

Engine is Starling's software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling, and two years ago we split out as a separate business. 

Starling has seen exceptional growth and success, and a large part of that is down to the fact that we have built our own modern technology from the ground up. This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

As a company, everyone is expected to roll up their sleeves to help deliver great outcomes for our clients. We are an engineering-led company and we’re looking for people who will be excited by the potential for Engine’s technology to transform banking in different markets around the world. Our purpose is underpinned by five values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

Some travel (including international) may be necessary depending on the client and nature of the engagement.

About the role

As a Consultant within our Client Solutions team, you will act as a pivotal bridge between our global clients and Engine's cutting-edge SaaS platform. You will work closely with financial institutions to unpack their strategic challenges, helping them tackle complex hurdles through a technology-centred approach.

Collaborating in tandem with our Product and Engineering functions, you will design and implement robust, forward-looking solutions tailored to client needs, ensuring our partner banks unlock the full power of Engine’s modern banking technology.

In this role, you will be instrumental in guiding implementations from initial discovery through to go-live and operational handover. 

What you’ll get to do:
• Delivery Ownership: Take responsibility for delivering designated workstreams, actively representing the client’s priorities and operational needs during internal planning and decision-making forums.
• Client Relationship & Discovery: Build trusted, lasting relationships across all levels of client organisations. Understand their overarching vision, day-to-day challenges, and strategic priorities, applying your deep knowledge of the Engine product suite.
• Solution Design: Collaborate closely with our product teams and solution architects to design scalable solutions that meet the immediate requirements of the client whilst enhancing capabilities for future partners.
• Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate end-to-end solution delivery alongside our Engineering teams in alignment with overall programme timelines and key milestones.
• Progress & Visibility: Maintain clear reporting on workstream milestones, risks, and progress across internal and client stakeholders.
• Run Transition: Support smooth programme transitions from delivery into business-as-usual (Run), sharing in-depth client context and setting the Run team up for long-term operational success.
• Practice Scaling: Contribute actively to the growth and maturity of the wider Client Solutions function as Engine expands globally, sharing key learnings from implementations to help refine and establish our core delivery methodologies.

Read more about our SeniorClient Solutions Consultant, Cam Jarvis's, time here: https://enginebystarling.com/careers/product-consultant/
• You have experience (3-4 plus years) in client facing roles, in a consulting role, or at a technology company
• You have experience in financial services and technology delivery
• You have experience delivering complex programmes
• You can rapidly understand client problems and present solutions in a structured and informative manner

To succeed in this role, you will bring a balanced blend of hands-on delivery expertise and consultative engagement:
• Core Expertise: Demonstrated experience within Project Management and Product or Technology delivery environments (ideally across SaaS, fintech, or modern digital platforms).
• Analytical & Problem-Solving Capability: A structured, methodical approach to breaking down ambiguous or complex challenges, paired with an inquisitive mindset and a genuine appreciation for the detail of how systems function.
• Technical Curiosity: A strong technical aptitude and curiosity to understand modern software architecture and how technical components come together to create compelling customer propositions.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Adaptable and thoughtful communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and convey technical concepts clearly across diverse audiences—from senior bank executives and consulting partners to software engineers.
• Facilitation

Skills:

Comfortable and engaging when facilitating discovery sessions, scoping workshops, and collaborative working groups.
• Autonomy & Drive: Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable operating with high degrees of autonomy in a fast-paced, scaling environment.
• Adaptable Mindset: Flexible and pragmatic in your approach to delivery, capable of pivoting between different client environments, methodologies, and project frameworks without losing attention to detail.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• First-stage interview a member of the Client Solutions team (45 minutes)
• Second, more in depth, interview to explore how you approach client discovery and solution structuring, with two members of the Client Solutions team (60 minutes)
• Final values & leadership conversation to discuss mutual fit and answer any remaining questions you have about Engine (45 minutes)
• 33 days holiday (including public holidays, which you can take when it works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton

• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks

Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Our mission is to change banking for good. We cannot achieve that without dedicated and passionate people. Our People team supports every stage of the employee lifecycle—from talent acquisition and onboarding to talent development, total rewards, culture, and employee experience.

In this role, you will deliver first-line advice, practical coaching, and guidance to employees and line managers across People services. You will oversee multi-stranded inquiries and support the continuous improvement of core People processes, working closely with People Partners and Centres of Expertise to drive efficiency and a high-quality employee experience.
