• First-Line Employee Relations: Serve as the primary point of contact for low-level ER casework, conducting objective workplace investigations, supporting disciplinary hearings, and managing grievances in alignment with ACAS best practices and statutory guidelines.

• Process Continuous Improvement: Partner with People Partners and Centres of Expertise to identify process bottlenecks, enhance workflows, and elevate overall service delivery.
• Practical ER Knowledge: Demonstrable experience handling low-level disciplinary, grievance, and capability procedures, with a solid grounding in UK employment law.
• Early Dispute Mediation: Proven ability to de-escalate workplace conflict, guide informal resolutions, and coach line managers on sensitive employee conversations.
• Absence & Health Oversight: Hands-on experience coordinating Occupational Health referrals, administering sickness triggers, and managing reasonable adjustments or Group Income Protection cases.

jobs.title: Security Operations Responder
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, Threat Detection Response

Product Security consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.

Threat Detection Response (this role!) focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.

Identity is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.

While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be on the front line of defending Tide. Your primary focus is actively investigating threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform – but we don’t want anyone working the same alert by hand twice. Your goal is to make investigation effective at scale: cutting manual effort through automation, and working hand-in-hand with our Detection Engineering team to improve the true positive / false positive efficacy of what lands in the queue.

When the security queue is empty, you’ll be building – automations, enrichment and your own detections. An open mind and a curious approach are key: every investigation is a chance to make the next one faster and sharper.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be:

Investigating and responding to threats (your primary focus)
• Actively triaging and investigating security alerts and threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform, across AWS, GCP, SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta), internal applications and employee endpoints (Windows, macOS).
• Driving every investigation to a clear, well-evidenced outcome – establishing scope, impact and root cause, and taking containment and remediation actions quickly and confidently.
• Leading the response to complex or high-severity incidents where needed, coordinating across security, IT and engineering teams through containment, remediation and recovery.
• Documenting investigations clearly and consistently, and contributing to the runbooks and investigation standards the whole team works to.

Scaling investigation through automation Improving detection efficacy
• Reducing manual investigation by building SOAR playbooks, security automations and services – from data enrichment and context gathering through to automated response, such as removing phishing emails from employee mailboxes. We want you to run with the “anything is possible” mantra.
• Spotting repetitive work in the queue and turning it into automated workflows, so the team’s time goes on the investigations that genuinely need human judgement.
• Identifying gaps in log sources, parsing and enrichment in the data lake, and working to close them so investigations have the visibility they need.
• Feeding investigation outcomes back to the Detection Engineering team – flagging noisy rules, tuning false positives and highlighting coverage gaps – to continuously improve TP/FP efficacy.
• Tracking investigation metrics (such as MTTD, MTTR, TP/FP rate and automation coverage) and using them to prioritise where to improve next.

Building when the queue is clear
• Writing, testing and shipping your own detections alongside Detection Engineering, following our test-driven, detections-as-code practices.
• Proactively hunting for sophisticated threats across our infrastructure, using threat intelligence and lessons from past investigations to stay ahead of attackers.
• Building or enhancing internal tools that streamline investigation, improve data visibility and increase response efficiency.
• Sharing knowledge and mentoring other members of the team, raising the bar for how we investigate and respond.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
• Significant hands-on experience in security operations, incident response or threat investigation, ideally in a cloud-native environment.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, Threat Detection Response

Product Security consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.

Threat Detection Response (this role!) focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.

Identity is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.

While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be on the front line of defending Tide. Your primary focus is actively investigating threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform – but we don’t want anyone working the same alert by hand twice. Your goal is to make investigation effective at scale: cutting manual effort through automation, and working hand-in-hand with our Detection Engineering team to improve the true positive / false positive efficacy of what lands in the queue.

When the security queue is empty, you’ll be building – automations, enrichment and your own detections. An open mind and a curious approach are key: every investigation is a chance to make the next one faster and sharper.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be:

Investigating and responding to threats (your primary focus)
• Actively triaging and investigating security alerts and threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform, across AWS, GCP, SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta), internal applications and employee endpoints (Windows, macOS).
• Driving every investigation to a clear, well-evidenced outcome – establishing scope, impact and root cause, and taking containment and remediation actions quickly and confidently.
• Leading the response to complex or high-severity incidents where needed, coordinating across security, IT and engineering teams through containment, remediation and recovery.
• Documenting investigations clearly and consistently, and contributing to the runbooks and investigation standards the whole team works to.

Scaling investigation through automation Improving detection efficacy
• Reducing manual investigation by building SOAR playbooks, security automations and services – from data enrichment and context gathering through to automated response, such as removing phishing emails from employee mailboxes. We want you to run with the “anything is possible” mantra.
• Spotting repetitive work in the queue and turning it into automated workflows, so the team’s time goes on the investigations that genuinely need human judgement.
• Identifying gaps in log sources, parsing and enrichment in the data lake, and working to close them so investigations have the visibility they need.
• Feeding investigation outcomes back to the Detection Engineering team – flagging noisy rules, tuning false positives and highlighting coverage gaps – to continuously improve TP/FP efficacy.
• Tracking investigation metrics (such as MTTD, MTTR, TP/FP rate and automation coverage) and using them to prioritise where to improve next.

Building when the queue is clear
• Writing, testing and shipping your own detections alongside Detection Engineering, following our test-driven, detections-as-code practices.
• Proactively hunting for sophisticated threats across our infrastructure, using threat intelligence and lessons from past investigations to stay ahead of attackers.
• Building or enhancing internal tools that streamline investigation, improve data visibility and increase response efficiency.
• Sharing knowledge and mentoring other members of the team, raising the bar for how we investigate and respond.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
• Significant hands-on experience in security operations, incident response or threat investigation, ideally in a cloud-native environment.
• Strong investigative instincts and log analysis skills at scale, with the ability to query a security data lake or SIEM fluently – strong knowledge of one of the following: Splunk, Scanner, Sentinel, SecOps.
• Strong understanding of modern attack and defence techniques which apply to Cloud (AWS, GCP), SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta) and desktop (Windows and macOS) environments, and the ability to map activity to frameworks such as MITRE ATT CK.
• Strong experience in security automation, from writing scripts (e.g. Python) to creating end-to-end automated workflows. Familiarity with SOAR platforms and automating investigation and response tasks.
• Experience writing or tuning detections, and a clear view of what separates a high-fidelity alert from a noisy one.
• Calm, methodical judgement during live incidents, including knowing when and how to escalate.
• An open mind and a curious approach – you enjoy pulling on threads, and you don’t stop at “false positives” without understanding why.
• Hands-on attitude and the ability to drive solutions to completion.
• Passion for passing on knowledge to fellow colleagues.
• Excellent spoken and written communication skills, including clear investigation write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Bonus points if you have a repository showcasing automations, detections or tooling you’ve built.

jobs.title: Staff Content Designer - Send
jobs.description:
How should global money work? How do you take a complex, stressful experience and make it simple, calming even? How do you challenge the way it’s always been done? 

How do you collaborate in a human-centred way to ship work you’re truly proud of?

These are just a few of the challenges a Staff Content Designer will work on as part of Wise’s global mission to build an open, fair, and human financial system. Right now we move £6 billion every month for over 12 million people. But we're only 2% done — because people without borders deserve money without borders.

What you’ll be doing:

The Send squad is central to Wise's mission of building an open, fair and human financial system.

In this role you'll be part of the Pricing squad — the team responsible for how customers understand and experience pricing across all Wise products. Thinking strategically and systematically about pricing, you’ll develop scalable systems that communicate price consistently across the entire consumer experience — from initial price comparisons, to complex promotional mechanics and intricate dynamic pricing scenarios.

You'll also be part of the Content Design Guild, and will regularly collaborate with the content community across Wise.

 

Here’s how you’ll contribute:
• Get to know our customers and their relationship with pricing — empathise and understand how people perceive, compare, and make decisions about financial costs across diverse markets and use cases
• Own the strategic design of pricing systems that scale across all Wise products and markets, thinking systematically about how pricing information, discounts, promotions, and dynamic pricing scenarios work cohesively across the entire customer experience
• Demonstrate sound systems thinking by designing foundational pricing systems, patterns, and frameworks that can be implemented consistently across different product teams while maintaining flexibility for local market needs
• Deploy the full range of content design skills to discover, design, and deliver scalable pricing experiences — working at both the strategic systems level and detailed messaging level to ensure consistency and clarity
• Collaborate across multiple teams and solve complex problems with cross-functional partners — including global and regional product teams, marketing, finance and compliance
• Establish yourself as the go to content designer on pricing related design challenges across the organisation
• Help other designers grow through feedback and skill shares

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Deliver impact and ship work you’re proud of — your work will play a critical role in how customers understand and trust Wise's pricing across all products
• Shape the future — you help decide what opportunities to work on within pricing experience, defining success metrics and taking responsibility for outcomes
• Elevate product quality. You define what 'good' looks like for pricing experiences, setting ambitious goals and high standards for yourself and influencing others
• Be part of a positive change in the world. We're fixing a broken, greedy system by making pricing transparent and fair, putting people in control of their money

About you:
• An accomplished Staff Content Designer with experience shipping world-class consumer products
• Comfortable navigating complexity and ambiguity — and can successfully collaborate in this environment
• Strong cross-functional collaborator, skilled at advocating for design-led approaches and building positive stakeholder relationships
• An evidence based designer who can articulate decisions clearly, credibly, and is able to influence how teams define success metrics
• Experience with AI tools, and see the potential for AI to enhance design processes and user experiences
• Exceptional content craft, systems thinking, and a desire for quality
• Highly empathetic, both to customers and the people you work with
• Willingness to grow, and able to give and receive feedback 

 

Heads up, this probably isn’t for you if:
• Your experience is mostly in marketing content, advertising, copywriting, journalism or social media – and you have no hands-on experience of content design or working in UX

 

We’re people without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We want to work with the best people, no matter their background. So if you’re passionate about learning new things and keen to join our mission, you’ll fit right in. And because we believe that diverse teams build better products, we’d especially love to hear from you if you’re from an under-represented demographic.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Lead - Generative AI Platform
jobs.description:
About

the role:

For our customers, using Wise is as simple as sending money from A to B. Yet behind our app and website is a complex engine of currencies, routes, products and features, generating terabytes of data each day.

The Data Products and Insights squad is at the core of systems that store, process, and leverage data, machine learning models, and generative AI capabilities. Ultimately, this provides real-time insights and innovative ML and AI driven solutions that serve as key drivers for business growth.

Your mission will be to lead the team building and maintaining a platform that enables everyone at Wise to rapidly experiment and bring to production Generative AI based systems, providing tooling, guidance and guardrails so that teams can ensure the safety of our customers and their data.

You will guide the sustainable growth of this critical function, leading other engineering leads and having the opportunity to shape multiple teams across AI enablement and controls.

Your input will directly affect how Wise builds and scales Generative AI capabilities across the company, enabling teams to move with speed and confidence while maintaining reliability, security and operational excellence.

 

How we work:

We operate with a belief in automation, programmatic implementation, and reusable design. We’re looking for people who can step back and think holistically about the ecosystem, but also follow through and help implement the design; drawing on the resources across the rest of the Platform Tribe.

As we grow, it is imperative to protect our customers’ money and navigate complex regulatory requirements world-wide. You will have a focus on running and maintaining services and libraries, making sure we have the right observability and service management elements in place, with an eye for high-availability, assessing and reducing engineering load and devising more effective ways for the team to look after its cloud-based platform.

We need to sustain this growth by continuously iterating on the services we run, with a focus on availability, security, and ease of use. We’re looking for an engineer with relevant experience who can understand and respond to complex requirements and deliver simple solutions to help our teams achieve our mission with speed and confidence.

 

What will you be working on?:
• You are an experienced leader, confident in problem-solving and guiding engineering teams through the complexities of project delivery using both agile and traditional methodologies.
• Great communication skills and the ability to build consensus - you’re comfortable making a case for what you believe we should be doing.
• Experience being a self-starter, self-motivated and collaborative.
• The mindset to solve problems from scratch.
• Comfortable taking ownership of vendor negotiations and explaining costs to the business.
• Willingness to give and take regular feedback - regular feedback is part of our culture.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager - Treasury
jobs.description:
We're looking for an Implementation Manager to join our fast-growing Finance & Treasury Product team in London or Tallinn. This is a unique opportunity to have an impact on Wise's mission by making sure our customers' money stays safe as we launch new products and expand into new markets.

Your mission

Wise customers trust us to keep their money safe. Safeguarding is how we make sure that every penny we hold for customers is protected, in every country we operate in.

Today we run safeguarding across 11 legal entities and client asset protection (CASS) across
6. That means more than 500 bank accounts in scope, 5+ external audits a year, regular internal audit and regulator reviews, and several new legal entities launching every year.

As Wise grows, so does our Safeguarding team. Our global team builds and runs the automated controls and tools that every entity relies on, while regional teams own what happens locally. As the Implementation Manager, you'll connect the two. You'll make sure new products and entities are onboarded into our controls properly, and that incidents are handled quickly and transparently.

You'll work closely with the Safeguarding Product Manager, Safeguarding Engineering and Analytics, Treasury and Regulatory Product Compliance, Finance, Payment and Treasury Operations, and regional controllers around the world.

 

How you'll contribute to our mission

New product reviews, onboarding and approval

- Run the safeguarding review and approval process for new products and product changes, making sure every step is followed and nothing launches without the right controls in place.

- Follow up with product teams, Treasury Regulatory Product Compliance and Finance to keep projects moving.

- Keep a clear, up-to-date tracker of projects that need safeguarding support, and report on their status.

 

New entity launches

- Support new legal entities as they launch, working out how they'll be onboarded into our global systems and controls.

- Define how controls need to be set up locally for each entity, for example safeguarding timings.

- Work with Regional Finance and Compliance so that local controllers are ready to take ownership from day one.

 

Execution and implementation

- Plan and lead the work to integrate new Wise products into our safeguarding systems, together with product managers, engineers, data analysts and operations specialists.

- Own large, complex integrations from start to finish, and support the team with clear documentation: requirements, project plans, resourcing, testing and delivery.

 

Support

- Keep documentation of product flows and safeguarding calculations up to date.

- Get hands-on when things go wrong: help product and engineering teams understand the impact of an incident, drive it to resolution, and improve controls so it doesn't happen again.

jobs.title: Head of SOX - Strategic Projects and Growth
jobs.description:
Key

Responsibilities:

Reporting to the Finance Director for Risk and Control, this role will partner with stakeholders across our fast moving business on change projects and initiatives to ensure SOX is effectively and efficiently embedded. 

Initially this will see you establish a SOX testing team, based in India, to in-source SOX management testing. You will support the creation of the team’s approach, structure and ways of working, facilitating a seamless integration with the existing SOX team and first line of defence stakeholders. Once set up, the team will then move into our BAU structure. Following this you will support a finance systems transformation, to build in the SOX consideration into design and the system roll out. 

You will sit in a broader finance risk and control function dedicated to shaping SOX delivery across the three lines of defence that currently consists of a team of Control Partners and SOX methodology specialists.
• Form and lead a dedicated SOX testing and support team based in India to establish robust long-term operational frameworks.
• Partner with the core SOX team to continuously improve and accelerate operational ways of working.
• Act as the primary controls lead for a major finance systems transformation project.
• Translate complex accounting and Sarbanes-Oxley concepts into simple, actionable language for diverse stakeholders.
• Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and finance teams to embed risk management into day-to-day operations.
• Design and build teams, processes, policies, and ways of working to support SOX compliance.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:

This role will be based out of our London office and is a unique opportunity to enhance the productivity of our legal leadership by managing complex logistics and communications. You will ensure our leaders are prepared, organised and focused on our mission to save billions for customers globally.

This is a unique opportunity to work in a fast-paced, global environment, supporting teams in a company that is changing the way money moves around the world.

Your Mission:
• Inbox & Communications Management: Support senior leaders with email inbox management, helping to triage, prioritise, and draft responses. You will maintain a clear and organised communications flow, flagging urgent matters and ensuring timely follow-up on outstanding items.

jobs.title: Paid Search Manager (B2B)
jobs.description:
At Wise, we're on a mission to empower users to make smarter, more transparent financial decisions. We operate as a collective of autonomous teams, trusting and empowering everyone to take ownership and execute on the things that drive the greatest impact for our users.

The landscape of search is rapidly evolving, driven by generative AI, sophisticated machine learning, and a shift toward in-app discovery. We're looking for a highly strategic, data-driven Paid Search Manager to help us acquire net-new customers for Wise Business across multiple platforms, markets and languages. Your focus will be exclusively on B2B acquisition: helping new businesses and business owners discover Wise and sign up for a Wise Business account. You’ll bring at least 4 years of hands-on paid search experience and should be comfortable working with campaign data, identifying opportunities and turning insights into action. Experience in B2B or business-customer acquisition is highly preferred, alongside an understanding of how business needs, decision-making and conversion journeys can differ from those of personal customers. Working closely with other Paid Search specialists and cross-functional partners, you’ll contribute to the growth of Wise Business while developing your skills in managing increasingly complex, global campaigns.

You will own and shape our search strategy, integrating modern AI capabilities, maximising efficiency across all platforms, and empowering the wider team by sharing advanced insights and fostering a culture of shared learning.

What you’ll be doing: 

Search Strategy & Execution
• Manage and optimise paid search campaigns focused on acquiring net-new Wise Business customers and driving efficient business account sign-ups.
• Work across large-scale Google Ads and Microsoft Ads accounts covering multiple markets, languages and business customer segments, with the potential to expand to new engines and video platforms in the future
• Monitor campaign performance, identify trends and recommend practical actions to increase sign-ups and improve acquisition efficiency.
• Support campaign launches and expansion into new markets, business segments and search or discovery channels.
• Contribute to the overall Business strategy within the Paid Media team, from forecasting, to planning, to delivery
• Proactively looking for both tactical and strategic optimisation opportunities, and translating this into campaign delivery

AI and Automation
• Use platform automation and AI-powered features, such as automated bidding, Performance Max and AI Max, to improve B2B campaign performance and operational efficiency.
• Identify opportunities to make recurring campaign-management and reporting processes more efficient through automation, templates or improved ways of working.
• Stay informed about developments in search marketing, generative AI and the ways business customers discover and evaluate financial services.

Testing and the Business Customer Experience
• Support the end-to-end delivery of structured tests across ad copy, assets, targeting, bidding and landing pages.
• Develop clear hypotheses, monitor results and turn findings into actionable recommendations for business customer acquisition.
• Test messaging that responds to the different needs, challenges and motivations of businesses and business owners.
• Use search-term, campaign and customer-behaviour insights to improve the relevance and clarity of Wise Business advertising.
• Work with colleagues across Marketing, Wise Business, Product and Analytics to help prospective business customers find the information and services most relevant to their needs.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

You will focus on empowering your colleagues by sharing advanced learnings, fostering collaborative problem-solving, and helping to establish strong communication and best-practice processes that elevate the entire team.
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead high-impact, cross-channel initiatives and projects - working closely with SEO, Product, Analyst and Paid Marketing teams - to drive holistic user growth and enhance the overall customer journey.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead - Send Experience
jobs.description:
People should be able to pay anything, anywhere, with Wise.

Send Convenience is building the experience that makes that possible. From sending money home to paying rent, utilities, and taxes, we’re making Wise the account people can rely on for everyday life across borders.

As an Engineering Lead, you’ll lead the team improving how 15M+ customers send money, and opening up new ways for them to pay. Every unnecessary step we remove and every confusing choice we fix makes a difference at that scale.

You’ll own the technical vision and the roadmap with Product and Design: deciding which customer problems matter most, what we build, and how we get it into customers’ hands. You’ll give engineers the context, support, and honest feedback to do their best work.

• You’ve shaped a product roadmap with Product and Design. You use customer feedback and data to decide what matters, make trade-offs, and change direction when the evidence calls for it.
• You bring depth in a product engineering discipline and strong judgement across client and backend systems. You stay close enough to the technology to challenge designs and guide complex decisions.

jobs.title: Group Regulatory Compliance Manager - Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Conflict of Interest, Gifts Hospitality & Entertainment
jobs.description:
Join Wise as a Compliance Manager, playing a pivotal role in shaping and executing our core compliance frameworks within a global, rapidly expanding Fintech. You'll be instrumental in ensuring Wisers globally adhere to regulatory requirements, ethical boundaries, and internal policy frameworks, directly contributing to our sustainable growth and mission of making money borderless. 

Reporting into the Group Regulatory Compliance Team, you will manage a global remit focusing on anti-bribery and corruption, donations, gifts and entertainment, third party due diligence, conflicts of interest, and other general compliance matters. We are looking for an entrepreneurial compliance professional who thrives building things from scratch, is adept at future-proofing programmes as we scale, and who is constantly identifying opportunities to enhance and streamline processes. You will also be comfortable being flexible in your role and picking up work in other areas of the team where required. Work is busy and varied as Wise continues to progress its mission. We are therefore looking for a generalist compliance manager with Anti-Bribery and Corruption and Conflicts of Interest experience

Your Mission
• Policy & Core Ethics Framework Ownership: Design, implement, and maintain the global compliance frameworks for Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC), Gifts, Entertainment & Hospitality (GEH), and Conflicts of Interest, ensuring alignment with local regulations across all our operating jurisdictions, and the design of effective and robust controls. This will include having oversight of how teams across Wise implement processes to support the overall framework.
• Conflicts & Registry Management: Own the operational design and enforcement of our global registers, ensuring associated policies and standards are effectively socialised and embedded across the business.
• EWRA & Governance Reporting: Lead Wise’s Enterprise-Wide Risk Assessment where required. Prepare high-quality governance reports and Management Information (MI) for the Board and Senior Management, highlighting emerging trends and control effectiveness. Act as a trusted partner supporting local Compliance Officers, and other global compliance colleagues on critical cross-border projects and initiatives.
• Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence: Own the framework for vendor and partner compliance. Run robust compliance due diligence checks, review red flag reports regarding third parties and suppliers, and ensure risk-mitigation steps are executed seamlessly alongside Third Party Risk Management.
• Individual Accountability & Regulatory Conduct: Manage and scale Wise's alignment with global individual accountability regimes (e.g., mapping executive responsibilities, overseeing regulatory "Fit and Proper" assessment frameworks, and tracking conduct-related certifications across regional entities) where required.
• Policy Breach Investigations: Oversee the compliance investigation pathway for internal policy breaches, ensuring root-cause analysis is performed to prevent future operational gaps.
• Consumer Protection Frameworks: Provide group-wide compliance horizon scanning, testing, and monitoring against evolving global consumer protection legislation and payment transparency standards.
• Future-proofing, and automation: Actively look for opportunities to enhance, automate, and streamline our activities to replace manual compliance tracking with scalable, automation-first solutions.
• Cross-Functional Partnership & Culture: Partner dynamically with the People Team, Compliance Learning, Third Party Risk Management, and other key internal stakeholders to drive and embed compliance initiatives globally. Support the drafting and delivery of clear, highly engaging Ethics & Compliance presentations across the business.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Build from scratch: You are energised by picking up projects that are work in progress - even blank. You can take ambiguous concepts and engineer clean, robust, and scalable operational workflows from day one. You will build frameworks and processes that are future-proof and scalable.
• Champion a data-driven approach to ethics and conduct risk management, simplifying complex multi-jurisdictional obligations and eliminating operational bottlenecks.
• Drive international impact by collaborating with compliance officer networks across North America, APAC, and Europe to harmonise core ethics standards.
• Inspire and influence stakeholders with clear communication, pragmatic advice, and a passion for creating a highly accountable corporate environment.
• Own project lifecycles end-to-end, building automated tech solutions to track registers, simplify disclosures, and track clear compliance metrics.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager – Financial Crime
jobs.description:
Your Mission:

In this role, you'll be working as part of the Europe and UK regional team. As a licensed institution serving millions of customers in Europe and the UK, preventing financial crime and misuse of Wise is of pivotal importance.

You'll own some of Europe & UK's highest-stakes financial crime controls end to end: from the regulatory requirement, to building the control, to the data that proves the control works. This isn't a policy role. You'll decide what to build, ship it with engineering, and be the person who can answer "is this control actually working?" with evidence.

The bar is high on both sides. A control that misses risk puts our licences at stake. A control that goes too far blocks honest customers and floods our operations teams. Your job is to find the version that does neither. More and more, that means rethinking a control with automation and AI instead of adding another manual step.

What You'll Own
• The roadmap for a set of KYC/CDD, EDD and ongoing controls across Europe and the UK, from discovery through launch and iteration
• Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) for your area. When one trends the wrong way, you find the root cause, ideate a solution and prioritise accordingly
• Turning regulation, audit findings and internal reviews into controls that measurably work, with clear success metrics, guardrails, monitoring and evidence
• Regional fit for global controls. You'll bring improvements from our Global Due Diligence and Financial Crime Prevention teams into Europe and the UK, and push back when the regional answer needs to be different
• Controls that require less manual review and reduce friction for legitimate customers, using AI and automation where they genuinely help
• Controls built into launches, not bolted on afterwards, so every new product or feature in Europe and the UK goes live with the right controls in place

This Role Will Give You the Opportunity to:
• Have a significant impact on the safety and security of Wise and its customers, and on our relationship with our regulators
• Take regulatory requirements and deliver controls that measurably work
• Work on problems where the stakes are real: our licences, our relationships with regulators, and millions of customers' access to their money
• Work where product, regulation and data meet, which few PM roles offer in this depth
• Build practical AI and automation into controls that have to stand up to regulatory scrutiny
• Work with a talented, diverse team to develop and implement innovative ways to prevent financial crime
• Make data-driven decisions about customers in scope of controls, how controls perform and where to invest next
• Influence and motivate a cross-functional team, fostering a culture of ownership, responsiveness, and excellence

jobs.title: Engineering Lead - Personal Onboarding Verification
jobs.description:
The team you will be joining: Personal Onboarding Verification

The Personal Onboarding Verification team is part of the Global KYC and Onboarding Squad. The team is responsible for KYC (Know Your Customer) compliance procedures that our customers go through before using our products. The team achieves this by building systems for identity verification in collaboration with data scientists, data analysts and third parties. Together we’re using computer vision, optical character recognition (OCR), biometrics & facial recognition, large-scale data analytics, and machine learning (ML) models.

Wise operates at global scale, onboarding millions of new customers each year in addition to supporting the needs of our large existing customer-base. Our products provide coverage across 160+ countries and over 40 currencies. The Personal Onboarding Verification team is at the centre of that, building systems that cut through the operational complexity of working under 70+ financial licenses while providing a frictionless onboarding experience wherever in the world our customers may be.

Having product-focused and forward-thinking engineers has allowed Wise to cater to the needs of customers unlike any other business. We already have a world-leading platform and product, but there is more to do.

Your mission:

As an Engineering Lead for Personal Onboarding Verification, you will:
• Lead, coach, and mentor a cross-functional team of engineers, supporting their growth and empowering them to do their best work.
• Be an active contributor to delivery. Support day-to-day execution, get hands-on when the team needs it, and stay in touch with the technology stack. You’ll lead by example.
• Work closely with the function leads in the team (Product, Design, Analytics, Data Science) and your team members to shape the roadmap, set the technical and product vision and ensure the team delivers on product goals in a robust and scalable way.
• Enable your team to succeed by ensuring they are well-resourced, can plan effectively, and are set up to commit to and deliver on their roadmap.
• Have a deep understanding of the tech and product of your teams - building out a clear tech strategy that follows from our product and marketing goals, setting high standards for quality, leading by example.
• Own the health and productivity of the team, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
• Collaborate with other engineering leads and teams across the Squad and other Wise teams to ensure your team’s work is aligned with the wider technical strategy.

jobs.title: Market Abuse and Operations Delivery Specialist
jobs.description:
Wise is expanding its Assets product into stocks and ETFs. 

We’re looking for a Market Abuse and Operations Delivery Specialist to help run day-to-day trading operations for Wise Assets and perform first-line surveillance and investigation of market abuse alerts.

In this role, you will bridge day-to-day trade trading flow operations and market abuse surveillance. You’ll manage assigned operational workflows and review market abuse alerts using agreed procedures, escalating exceptions and complex cases to senior colleagues.

Working closely with Senior Delivery Specialists, Market Abuse Specialists, and second-line Compliance, you will help maintain effective controls by flagging recurring issues and suggesting practical runbook improvements as product volume grows.

Market Abuse Coverage

Core Operations Delivery

• Identify and flag recurring issues, suggest practical workflow or runbook improvements.

jobs.title: Payment Operations Regional Senior Specialist

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Wise for Enterprise

jobs.title: Compliance Manager/Assistant Manager
jobs.description:
We Are

YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually.

YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses. jobs.title: Director, Head of Private Equity
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Partnerships at Brex

The primary focus of the Partnerships team at Brex is to drive net new pipeline and revenue. We originate, launch, and scale partnerships across emerging distribution channels, embedded models, and other strategic bets that accelerate Brex's growth trajectory.

As Brex nears $1B in revenue, we are building a best-in-class Partnerships organization grounded in clear priorities and disciplined execution. Every member of our team directly contributes to top-line growth by expanding Brex's reach across key ecosystems, from technology platforms to financial sponsors who influence large customer networks.Within Business Development, the Private Equity Channel team is responsible for building partnerships with PE firms to drive new customer growth, generate pipeline, and increase engagement and monetization of existing customers.

Over the past 12 months, Brex's PE channel hit an inflection point, turning Tier 1 private equity firms into active referral sources for their portfolio companies due to demonstrable ROI. That model was proven through consistent in-market presence: dinners, conferences, events, and the trust that compounds across repeated value-added touchpoints. The channel is now at a critical scaling moment. With a proven playbook and a growing book of top-tier sponsor relationships, we are hiring a Director to take ownership of the entire PE channel — leading the team, sharpening the strategy, and raising the ceiling on what this channel can deliver.

What You'll Do

We are hiring a Director, Private Equity Channel to lead and scale Brex's PE partnerships organization. Based in New York, you will own the full PE channel strategy: setting direction, managing and growing the team, holding the most senior sponsor relationships, and driving the referral engine that turns PE firms into durable, high-conviction distribution partners for Brex.

This is a player-coach role for a senior operator who has both the relationship credibility to command a room with managing directors and the management instincts to build a team around them. You will inherit a functioning playbook and existing tier 1 partners, and your mandate is to manage these key relationships while building and scaling the team.

Where You'll Work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office, but would involve travel to our other hub locations. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Hire, develop, and manage a team of Partner Managers across East Coast, West Coast, and emerging PE geographies, setting the bar for performance and career growth
• Own the PE channel strategy end-to-end — target firm prioritization, coverage model, engagement motion, and referral conversion — and identify new growth vectors across geographies, firm tiers, and portfolio models
• Build the internal case for channel investment and headcount, presenting performance and roadmap to senior leadership
• Personally own and deepen relationships with the most strategic Tier 1 PE firms, serving as escalation point and executive sponsor across the team's book
• Represent Brex across the PE ecosystem at premier industry events, dinners, and conferences
• Partner with Marketing on field events and content, and with Sales leadership on handoffs and referral-to-close conversion
• Drive internal alignment with Finance, RevOps, and Partnerships on channel prioritization and metrics infrastructure during planning cycles

Requirements
• 8–12+ years of experience in PE business development, financial services sales, partnerships, or a related senior role with consistent, demonstrable exposure to the private equity ecosystem.
• 4+ years of people management experience; track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing BD or sales talent.
• Established senior-level relationships within the New York private equity community; credible with managing directors and partners at leading PE firms from day one.
• Proven channel builder — experience standing up or significantly scaling a partnerships motion, not just maintaining one.
• Strong commercial instincts; able to connect PE relationship activity to pipeline generation, ARR outcomes, and executive-level narratives.
• Excellent written and verbal communication; executive-ready in both internal stakeholder management and external partner engagement.
• High organizational acumen — able to manage a team, a personal book of relationships, and strategic workstreams simultaneously without dropping quality.
• Based in New York; comfortable being in-market regularly for dinners, events, and partner engagements.
• Self-directed and entrepreneurial; able to operate with high autonomy while maintaining tight alignment with Partnerships leadership.

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $316,400 - $395,500. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, T&E
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Design at Brex

Design at Brex creates the experiences that make complex systems feel effortless through thoughtful, scalable design. Whether crafting interfaces, shaping product strategy, or harnessing AI to empower our users, we obsess over quality and clarity. This is a team for designers who want to build, not just talk about building. We ship constantly, use AI to move faster, and care deeply about craft. Product designers at Brex partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, and Go-to-Market teams to solve high-stakes problems for ambitious companies that rely on Brex to run their finances.

What you’ll do

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll lead ambiguous, cross-functional product work from problem definition through shipped execution. You’ll turn complex financial workflows into clear, intuitive experiences that help customers move faster, make better decisions, and trust the systems they use every day.

You’ll be expected to operate with high ownership and low oversight: identifying what needs to be true, breaking ambiguity into actionable paths, facilitating alignment across partners, and shipping iteratively toward measurable customer and business outcomes. You’ll bring strong craft, product judgment, and systems thinking to the work — raising the quality of both the product experience and the way the team designs.

About the team

The Travel Expenses design team designs how employees spend, report, and get reimbursed, and how finance teams set and enforce the rules behind it. Our work covers travel booking, expense management, reimbursements, and the policy and compliance tools that sit underneath them.

Most of our customers don’t think about this software until something goes wrong: a receipt is missing, a reimbursement hasn’t arrived, a trip falls outside policy. Our job is to make those moments clear and quick for employees, and to give finance teams the control and visibility they need without adding work for everyone else. We’re also building AI agents that handle the manual parts of expenses and compliance, and we design how those agents behave, explain themselves, and recover when they’re wrong.

Responsibilities
• Own the design direction for a core area of travel and expenses and set a vision and roadmap for it with Product and Engineering.
• Take loosely defined problems and decide what needs to be true, what to build first, and what to leave out. Turn them into clear scope, milestones, and shippable increments.
• Define the underlying models (states, transitions, edge cases) before designing screens, so the product behaves consistently across surfaces, and bring those models to the other teams that depend on them.
• Plan, run, and synthesize your own research, and use customer feedback and data to make and validate design decisions.
• Design AI-assisted experiences, including how an agent asks for confirmation, explains what it did, and lets people fix mistakes.
• Partner with Product and Engineering as an equal on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs. Raise risks early and keep design involved through build.
• Work across team boundaries on shared components, policy rules, and payment flows. Resolve conflicts before they reach engineering, and represent design in cross-team planning.
• Raise the quality bar for the team through critique, clear standards for content, color, and component states, and contributions to the design system.
• Mentor other designers through feedback, pairing, and sharing how you approach ambiguous problems.
• Present work and rationale clearly to leadership, partners, and customers, and document decisions so others can build on them.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Requirements
• 6+ years of product design experience, with a track record of shipping end-to-end features in fast-paced product teams.
• Strong portfolio of shipped product work, ideally across complex workflows, systems, or customer-facing business software.
• Experience independently leading ambiguous product initiatives and turning loosely defined problems into clear, executable plans.
• Strong product thinking, including the ability to connect design decisions to customer needs, business goals, and measurable outcomes.
• High craft across UX, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and systems thinking.

Design at Brex

Design at Brex creates the experiences that make complex systems feel effortless through thoughtful, scalable design. Whether crafting interfaces, shaping product strategy, or harnessing AI to empower our users, we obsess over quality and clarity. This is a team for designers who want to build, not just talk about building. We ship constantly, use AI to move faster, and care deeply about craft. Product designers at Brex partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, and Go-to-Market teams to solve high-stakes problems for ambitious companies that rely on Brex to run their finances.

What you’ll do

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll lead ambiguous, cross-functional product work from problem definition through shipped execution. You’ll turn complex financial workflows into clear, intuitive experiences that help customers move faster, make better decisions, and trust the systems they use every day.

You’ll be expected to operate with high ownership and low oversight: identifying what needs to be true, breaking ambiguity into actionable paths, facilitating alignment across partners, and shipping iteratively toward measurable customer and business outcomes. You’ll bring strong craft, product judgment, and systems thinking to the work — raising the quality of both the product experience and the way the team designs.

The Travel Expenses design team designs how employees spend, report, and get reimbursed, and how finance teams set and enforce the rules behind it. Our work covers travel booking, expense management, reimbursements, and the policy and compliance tools that sit underneath them.

Most of our customers don’t think about this software until something goes wrong: a receipt is missing, a reimbursement hasn’t arrived, a trip falls outside policy. Our job is to make those moments clear and quick for employees, and to give finance teams the control and visibility they need without adding work for everyone else. We’re also building AI agents that handle the manual parts of expenses and compliance, and we design how those agents behave, explain themselves, and recover when they’re wrong.

jobs.description:
About the role

We’re hiring a data-driven Risk Analyst with strong analytical skills and an investigative mindset. You’ll help reduce fraud losses, improve risk processes, and protect a positive member experience. Alongside your core analytics work, you will also be investigating selected fraud and dispute cases-bringing together case evidence, transaction and account data, and risk signals to support clear, well-documented outcomes.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Analytics, Operational and member Experience partners. The role is a good fit for someone who can move between portfolio-level questions and detailed case review, conduct ground level investigation and data queries , communicate what the evidence supports, and turn findings into better risk decisions and processes.

In this role, you can expect to
• Analyze fraud and loss trends (25%) - Explore data proactively and in response to loss events to identify drivers, quantify opportunities, and recommend ways to reduce losses while minimizing member friction.
• Investigate fraud and dispute cases (30%) - Review assigned cases from intake through resolution or escalation. Bring together relevant member statements, transaction and account history, merchant evidence where applicable, and risk signals. Assess evidence quality and consistency; document what is supported, what remains uncertain, and the recommended next step in accordance with established policies and decision authority. Understand agent SOPs and get familiar with using agent tools with the goal to improve AHT and decision accuracy.
• Improve processes and automation (20%) - Identify and apply AI and automation opportunities across dispute and fraud workflows to reduce repetitive manual work, improve consistency, and accelerate analysis. Partner with relevant teams to test solutions, validate outputs, and ensure appropriate human review and controls before implementation.
• Build reporting and monitor performance (10%) - Develop and maintain actionable dashboards and reports that track risk performance against loss and member-experience metrics.
• Collaborate on ad hoc needs (15%) - Partner with internal stakeholders to answer time-sensitive questions and communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 2+ years of analytical experience, preferably in financial services or fintech.
• 2+ years of experience in Fraud, Compliance, Risk, Investigations, or a related field; relevant case-review or dispute experience is a plus.
• Excellent SQL and advanced google sheets skills; experience with Python is preferred.
• Familiarity with payment processing fundamentals and an interest in fraud typologies, risk trends, or risk strategy.
• Strong critical thinking and attention to detail; you can synthesize information across multiple sources and explain how it supports a conclusion.
• Clear written communication and sound documentation habits, especially when handling sensitive, member-impacting cases.
• Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage analytical work and assigned investigations in a fast-paced environment.
• Proficient using AI-assisted tools and automation to improve productivity, while validating outputs and protecting sensitive information.
• A growth mindset, willingness to learn new tools and processes, and a passion for Chime’s mission.
• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a quantitatively rigorous discipline such as engineering, statistics, mathematics, or economics is preferred.

jobs.description:
About a week before Hurricane Sandy made landfall, the two leading forecast models flatly disagreed: the American one carried the storm safely out into the Atlantic, the European one turned it hard left into New Jersey. The European model wasn't running a better simulation, it was running an ensemble. Hundreds of thousands of people were evacuated on the strength of the spread in forecast distribution, days before any single forecast could have justified moving them, and on October 29th, 2012, Sandy came ashore almost exactly where the models had put it.

At Mercury, we're building the future of financial infrastructure for startups and growing businesses. We're extending credit to those businesses, and we're doing it with proprietary access to some of the best data for understanding a borrower's business, from bank transactions to financial reporting to payroll. We're looking for a Senior/Staff Data Scientists to turn that record into a lending decision, partnering closely with Credit, Product, and Engineering.

In this role, you'll build and own the inference layer behind our small business lending program; you'll ship it into production with the monitoring and documentation that make it trustworthy; and you'll help Credit and Product decide what we should be lending in the first place.

Here Are Some Things You'll Do On The Job:
• Build and own the models behind our lending program - transaction classification, recurring inflow/outflow detection, annual revenue estimation, forecasting with seasonality, anomaly detection, and more
• Turn messy data streams - bank transactions, storefront sales, and more - into a defensible view of a business's health
• Deploy models into a production environment with observability, monitoring, and tests
• Partner with Credit on underwriting policy: what data is asked for, when follow-up information is worth the friction, and how to quantify uncertainty
• Partner with Product on the shape of the product: from principal sizes and pricing to repayment terms
• Assess where predictive modeling actually moves the underwriting program
• Set the technical bar for ML in Credit

You Should:

For Staff:
• Have 7+ years building ML models
• Implemented models that shaped automated decisions with money on the line
• Write production-grade Python
• Have depth beyond classification models; for example: time series and forecasting, anomaly detection, and NLP models
• Be proficient with deep learning, transformers, and LLMs
• Be strong in SQL and at home in a data warehouse
• Be able to explain a model to a credit officer, a model validator, a PM, and an engineer
• Be able to set modeling standards for your data-science colleagues
• Have a quantitative degree, or the equivalent built some other way

For Senior:

• Be strong in Python, with experience working on production-grade services
• Be strong in SQL and at home in a data warehouse

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer - Design Systems
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.description:
"We may say most aptly that the Analytical Engine weaves algebraic patterns just as the Jacquard loom weaves flowers and leaves."

— Ada Lovelace, 1843

What Lovelace saw in the loom was the pattern — flowers and leaves, repeated faithfully, each one begun by a hand that chose it. Mercury is built from patterns too. Every component, every interaction our customers come to trust, starts with someone deciding how it should go, and making it good enough to be used again and again. Tending those patterns, and giving everyone at Mercury the means to weave with them, is the work of our Design System team, and the north star of this role.

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on the Design Systems team, you will build and care for those patterns: the components and foundations that everything else at Mercury is built on. Done well, a single decision here makes every product team faster.

The ground under that work is shifting, though. Software is being built in new ways, and AI is increasingly part of how design systems are made and used. We are looking for someone who is fluent at that intersection: deeply versed in design systems, and equally as serious about what it takes to build a system that holds up at the leading edge of AI.

As part of this role, you will:
• Build and maintain the components, patterns, and foundations (tokens, type, color, layout) that Mercury's product is woven from, holding a high bar for accessibility, performance, and pixel-level craft.
• Lead projects that ship new UI patterns to solve real pain points for product teams, helping them build better experiences faster.
• Develop a design system that's as ready for AI as it is for people, applying the technology to create leveraged outcomes.
• Invest in the design system's prototyping experience, shaping the next iteration of how our design function rapidly prototypes, iterates on the product, and explores new concepts.
• Raise the craft and AI fluency of the people around you, through mentorship and clear best practices.

The ideal candidate for

the role:

We're looking for someone who cares about the foundational work that lets other people do their best work, and who's eager to help define what a design system means in a world where agents build alongside us. A successful candidate will likely have:
• 7+ years of frontend development, with deep experience in React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies.

jobs.title: Workforce Relations Partner (North)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Job Title: Workforce Relations Partner (North)

Reports to: Team Lead, Workforce Relations

Job Purpose

The Workforce Relations Partner is a strategic advisor and subject matter expert responsible for maintaining a fair, compliant, and high-performance workplace culture. This role exists to ensure that independent contractors relations practices not only mitigate risk but also strengthen trust, engagement, and organizational integrity across Moniepoint’s global operations. Will oversee the entire northern region.

Beyond case management, the Workforce Relations Partner acts as a trusted advisor to business leaders and WBPs, providing thought leadership on policy interpretation, conflict resolution, and cultural alignment. The role balances business pragmatism with empathy and legal compliance, enabling leaders to make informed, people-centered decisions that reinforce Moniepoint’s values.

Key Responsibilities
• Partner with leaders, Workforce Business Partners, Legal team and relevant stakeholders to resolve complex independent contractors relations cases with fairness, consistency, and business alignment.
• Provide expert guidance on disciplinary actions, grievances, investigations, and terminations, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and internal policies.
• Act as a strategic consultant to leadership teams, identifying systemic issues and recommending proactive interventions to minimize engagement risks.
• Analyze Workforce Relations trends, patterns, and case data to identify root causes, drive preventive strategies, and inform policy updates.
• Partner with the Employee Relations Partner to design, review, and implement employee relations frameworks, policies, and toolkits across entities.
• Build ER capability across the People Team and business leaders through coaching, education, and practical toolkits.
• Support change management initiatives and culture programs that foster open communication, inclusion, and psychological safety.
• Lead or support sensitive investigations involving complex or high-risk matters, ensuring due process and confidentiality throughout.
• Serve as a trusted voice of objectivity, balancing independent contractor advocacy and organizational needs in every decision.

Qualifications
• 3–6 years of progressive HR or Employee Relations experience, including direct case management in a complex or regulated environment.
• Strong knowledge of labor laws and employment practices across multiple geographies (experience within Africa is an advantage).
• Proven experience managing investigations, conflict resolution, and policy enforcement.
• Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders confidently.
• Must reside in the North.
• Fluent in Hausa. 

Preferred Qualifications
• Professional certification (e.g., CIPM, SHRM, or relevant Legal/ER specialization).
• Experience in fintech, banking, or other high-growth, multi-entity organizations.
• Demonstrated success implementing ER frameworks or leading cross-functional risk mitigation initiatives.

About You
• You’re calm, objective, and grounded — even in high-stakes situations.
• You balance empathy with fairness and have strong judgment on what’s “right” versus what’s “easy.”
• You communicate with clarity and confidence, building trust at every level.
• You think systemically — you see patterns behind cases and design solutions that prevent recurrence.
• You value compliance but see your role as enabling business success, not blocking it.

What Success Looks Like
• You are recognized as a trusted advisor by business and HR leaders on complex ER and compliance matters.
• Consistent, fair, and timely resolution of Independent Contractors relations issues across all entities.
• Reduced recurrence of ER incidents through proactive coaching, early intervention, and data-led prevention.
• Enhanced ER literacy among managers and WBPs through structured education and guidance.
• Policies and practices are perceived as clear, fair, and aligned with Moniepoint’s culture and legal standards.

Why join us
• Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and impactful career growth opportunities.
• Fully remote/flexible work culture backed by continuous support for your learning and professional development.

• Qualitative field research journey auditing: Conduct on-site process shadowing, customer journey reviews, and direct interviews with frontline partner and Monzo teams to evaluate actual operational practices against intended process design.
• Evidence synthesis impact documentation: Triangulate quantitative and qualitative findings to identify structural drivers (tools, policy, capability, or operating model), clearly documenting root causes, customer impacts, and required next steps.

Detailed project and workstream delivery
• Workstream planning direct execution: Own the end-to-end delivery of assigned projects and workstreams, translating strategic approaches into detailed delivery plans (milestones, owners, dependencies) and actively executing hands-on tasks to drive momentum.

Insights, recommendations and business cases

The Partner Risk Manager will remain accountable for the overall strategy, standards, governance and material risk decisions.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

Risk records, controls and monitoring
• Maintain an accurate and joined up record of partner risks, controls, requirements, evidence, owners, actions, subcontractors and dependencies across the global partner estate.
