About This Role

We are building the next-generation Financial Cloud platform, enabling Bybit to deploy and operate regulated financial services across 50+ global sites, each subject to different compliance requirements (EU MiCA, APAC licenses, etc.). Each site is a unique combination of business modules, infrastructure configurations, and compliance controls — managed as versioned, reproducible units.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer for the Financial Cloud Toolchain, you will drive the end-to-end developer experience and deployment automation for this multi-site platform. You will design and build systems that ensure every deployment is reproducible, every dependency is traceable, and every site automatically and safely converges to its declared state.

What You'll Do

Build Release Engineering (40%)
• Design and implement hermetic, deterministic build pipelines that produce reproducible artifacts for all platform modules
• Build and maintain a content-addressable artifact registry with full provenance capabilities (SLSA L3+)
• Implement dependency graph analysis tooling to compute build/deploy blast radius for every change
• Own the Version Set model: define, validate, and promote locked module-version combinations ("Manifests") through environment stages
• Enforce semantic versioning governance and automated compatibility verification across 50+ independently versioned modules

Multi-Site Deployment Orchestration (30%)
• Design a GitOps-based deployment engine that reconciles each site to its target Manifest state
• Build progressive rollout capabilities: canary → regional → global, with automatic rollback on SLO violations
• Implement site-aware configuration rendering: given a site's Manifest + region + compliance tier, produce the complete deployable state
• Create an automated upgrade plan generator: compute safe upgrade paths based on dependency ordering and compatibility constraints
• Operate and evolve the Financial Cloud configuration center and module selection center

Internal Developer Platform (20%)
• Build self-service workflows for module teams: onboard new modules, publish versions, request promotion to production Manifests
• Provide real-time visibility: cross-site version drift, deployment health, dependency freshness, compliance patch coverage
• Design the "Module → Manifest" pipeline: from module selection to validated Manifest generation in ≤30 minutes
• Integrate with internal CI systems to provide selective test execution based on dependency graph analysis

Reliability Compliance Automation (10%)
• Automate compliance evidence generation for regulated deployments (audit trails, SBOMs, change records)
• Design cold-start orchestration that automatically derives correct startup ordering from the dependency graph
• Build chaos testing frameworks to validate site-level DR and failover under real module compositions
• Ensure Phase 1 infrastructure deployment automation ≥95%, Phase 2 data layer ≥90%, Phase 3 business applications ≥90%

──────

What We're Looking For

Must-Have
• 8+ years in platform engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure toolchain development, serving 500+ services or 100+ engineers
• Deep hands-on experience with build systems — you've designed or operated them, not just consumed them
• Track record of building dependency graph tooling — static analysis, runtime tracing, or both — for impact analysis and selective testing
• Experience designing and operating version governance systems: BOM/Manifest models, compatibility matrices, constraint solving
• Production GitOps deployment experience spanning multi-cluster / multi-region environments
• Solid Kubernetes expertise: custom Controllers, Operators, CRDs for platform automation
• Artifact management and supply chain security

experience:

content-addressable storage, SLSA attestation, SBOM generation, artifact signing

Strong Plus
• Experience building an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) with self-service module onboarding and promotion workflows
• Large-scale monorepo governance: code ownership, visibility boundaries, build graph optimization
• Financial or regulated industry

experience:

understanding of compliance-as-code, audit automation, multi-jurisdictional requirements
• Multi-site / multi-tenant SaaS platform experience where each site has a different module composition
• Familiarity with constraint solvers or package manager dependency resolution algorithms (SAT solvers, version unification)
• Cryptocurrency / fintech platform experience, especially exchange or trading infrastructure

Nice-to-Have
• Toolchain development experience in Rust, Go, or Python
• Familiarity with Terraform / Pulumi infrastructure-as-code
• Experience with OPA / Rego for policy-as-code in deployment pipelines
• Experience operating platforms across China / APAC / EU regions with understanding of data residency requirements

Bybit is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, with teams across many countries working around the clock. Our products, markets, and regulations change fast, so how quickly our people learn is a real competitive advantage.

This is a new role. The Head of Learning Development will build one learning engine for the whole company: how new hires get productive, how leaders grow, how engineers and sales teams stay sharp, and how the company comes together at all-hands.

Mission: Help every Bybit employee get up to speed fast, keep growing, and perform at their best, and build the leaders we need as we scale.

Key responsibilities

Learning development
• Build and own Bybit's global learning strategy, tied to business priorities and our values.
• Design and deliver leadership development for first-time managers, senior leaders, and high-potential talent.
• Build core skills programs, including communication, feedback, coaching, and decision-making.
• Own required and compliance training with Legal and Compliance, ensuring completion across all regions.
• Run the learning platform (LMS) and content library; blend live, digital, and on-the-job learning.
• Partner with HR Business Partners on development plans, career paths, and succession.
• Measure learning impact on performance, retention, and readiness, not just attendance.

Employee onboarding
• Own the global onboarding program from offer acceptance through the first 90 days.

• Partner with Talent Acquisition, IT, Workplace Operations, and hiring managers so day one runs smoothly in every location.

All-hands
• Own the company all-hands program: cadence, agenda, content, and speaker preparation.
• Partner with the CEO, executives, and Internal Communications on key messages and storytelling.
• Deliver all-hands across time zones and formats (in person, hybrid, virtual) so every office and team can take part.
• Gather feedback after each session and raise quality and engagement over time.

Technical enablement
• Partner with Engineering, Product, and Security leaders to build learning paths for technical teams.
• Deliver programs on Bybit's platform and architecture, crypto and blockchain fundamentals, security practices, and new tools including AI.
• Build onboarding and certification paths that get engineers productive faster.

Sales enablement

• Build, lead, and develop a global team of learning, onboarding, and enablement professionals.

Engineering onboarding path and a recurring tech-talk program in place

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About Fam (previously FamPay)

Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above
11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.

We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.

Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.

About the role :- 
At Fam, data plays a big role in how we build, improve and scale our products. We're looking for a Data Analyst who enjoys digging into data, asking the right questions and finding insights that others might miss. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Business and Finance teams, helping turn complex datasets into decisions that make a real impact. This is an opportunity to work on diverse problems, take ownership of your analysis, experiment with AI tools and help shape products used by millions of users. If you're curious, analytical and enjoy figuring things out, we'd love to have you on the team.
Must-haves
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics or another quantitative field.
3-5 years of experience in SQL skills with experience writing complex queries involving joins, CTEs and window functions.
Ability to independently extract, clean, structure and analyse large datasets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for identifying trends and patterns.
Ability to interpret data and translate findings into meaningful business and product insights.
Understanding of key product and business metrics.
Comfortable using AI tools to improve analytical workflows, write and optimise queries, automate repetitive tasks and explore new ways of solving problems.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work with multiple stakeholders.
A proactive approach with the ability to take ownership of problems and drive them to closure.
Good-to-haves
Experience working in fintech, consumer internet or high-growth startups.
Familiarity with tools such as Metabase, Looker, Mixpanel or Amplitude.
Working knowledge of Python and Excel.
Exposure to A/B testing, cohort analysis and funnel analysis.
Experience working with large-scale databases such as BigQuery, Redshift or ClickHouse.
Experience experimenting with AI-powered analytics tools and workflows.
Roles & Responsibilities
Extract, analyse and interpret data to answer product and business-related questions.
Work closely with Product Managers to evaluate product performance and identify improvement opportunities.
Analyse user behaviour, funnels, cohorts and key business metrics.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports to track important metrics.
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies and proactively highlight areas that need attention.
Support data-driven decision-making through actionable insights and recommendations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business problems and provide analytical support.
Leverage AI tools to streamline analysis, automate workflows and improve efficiency.
Work on ad-hoc analysis and projects across different teams as business needs evolve.
Why Join Us
Build a category-defining brand for the next generation in India.
Work directly with founders and leadership in a high-visibility role with ownership from day one.
Own partnerships that directly drive business growth and revenue.
Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership culture where builders make an impact.
Work in an AI-native environment with access to the best AI tools to move faster and build smarter.

 
Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck
• Relocation assistance to make your move seamless.
• Free office meals (lunch & dinner).
• Generous leave policy, including birthday leave, period leave, paternity and maternity support, and more.
• Salary advance and loan policies for any financial help.
• Quarterly rewards and recognition programs, and a referral program with great incentives.
• Access the latest gadgets and tools.
• Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family, mental health support.
• Tax benefits with options like food coupons, phone allowances, car/device leasing.

We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.
 
Join Our Dynamic Team
At Fam, our people-first approach is reflected in our generous leave policies, flexible work schedules, comprehensive health benefits, and free mental health sessions. We don’t mean to brag, but we promise you’ll be surrounded by some of the most fun, talented and passionate people in the startup space.
 
Want to see what makes life at Fam so awesome? Check out our shenanigans at @lifeatfam 😛
PS - We’re looking for someone with an AI-native mindset, who actively leverages AI in their day-to-day work, as we encourage and embed it across every level at Fam.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiting Operations Partner
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.description:
At 5:00 a.m. on September 3, 1967, every driver in Sweden moved from the left side of the road to the right. The switch took a morning. Getting ready took four years of public education, and road signs across the country were swapped in one coordinated push. And the roads got safer.

The hard part of a big change is the getting ready: helping people trust something new, then making it feel obvious afterward. That's the heart of recruiting operations at Mercury.

Mercury is building the financial stack for ambitious companies: banking,* payments, credit, and the workflows around them. Our recruiting team hires the people who build it, across engineering, sales, risk, operations, and everything in between. We run on an ATS, sourcing and scheduling tools, interview intelligence, our headcount planning system, Workday, and a growing library of AI workflows we've built ourselves.

In this role, you'll report to our Director of Recruiting and work day to day with our Staff Recruiting Operations Lead. You'll be the accountable owner of the systems our recruiters depend on. You'll lead big changes to how we work, including choosing and moving to new tools when the old ones hold us back. And you'll take our AI work from a set of useful skills to something the whole team runs on. This is a builder role with real autonomy, and what you ship will show up in every hire Mercury makes.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Here are some things you'll do on the job:
• Own our recruiting systems end to end: the ATS, sourcing and scheduling tools, interview intelligence, and the integrations that connect them to Workday and our headcount planning tool.
• Lead large systems changes as the accountable owner, from vendor evaluation through data mapping, the HRIS integration, cutover, and training.
• Manage our recruiting vendors: contracts, renewals, costs, and whether each tool still earns its place.
• Keep the day-to-day running: permissions, offer workflows and approvals, troubleshooting, and the steady stream of "how do I..." questions from recruiters and People Ops. No question is too small.
• Build AI workflows the team relies on, and make them dependable: tested against real examples, documented, and running on schedules or triggers instead of someone's open laptop.
• Build and maintain the recruiting context layer, a clean, current home for process docs, role documents, and playbooks that people and AI agents can both find answers in.
• Work with IT, People Ops, Finance, and our AI team to get changes made, and help the recruiting team absorb a lot of change without losing speed.
• Answer questions about our hiring data with AI tools and little guidance, and turn what you find into changes in how we work.

You should:
• Have 5+ years in recruiting or talent operations at a tech company, including admin-level ownership of an ATS (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, or similar): permissions, offer workflows, and integrations.
• Have built AI workflows or automations that other people use every week. We'll ask you to tell us about one.
• Have led a systems implementation or migration, or a cross-functional project of similar size, from decision to adoption.
• Build the simplest thing that works. You'd rather ship a rough version this week and improve it with feedback than present a perfect plan next month.
• Design for everyone who'll use what you build, from a recruiting coordinator to an executive with thirty seconds to spare.
• Know recruiting from the inside. Full-cycle recruiting experience is a strong plus. At a minimum, you've worked shoulder to shoulder with recruiters and see your job as helping them win.
• Be comfortable getting things done across teams you don't manage: asking for what you need, giving people context, and saying no to work that doesn't matter.
• Experience with Ashby, an ATS migration, or Workday integrations is a strong plus.

Mercury values diversity belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.

Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

jobs.title: Senior Risk Investigator - Fraud Incident Management & Partner Response
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States
jobs.description:
About the Team

Mercury* is building a complete financial stack for startups, and Risk is how we protect our customers, Mercury, and the broader financial ecosystem. You'll join Fraud Operations, part of the Fraud Disputes organization. The team investigates and prevents fraud across every Mercury product, and works hand in hand with Risk Strategy, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and our bank partners. Our investigators, Fraud Enablement team, and BPO partners handle the volume. This role makes sure that when something goes wrong, or when a regulator or bank partner asks hard questions, we respond quickly, consistently, and with evidence.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Role Summary

This is a senior individual contributor role for an investigator who thrives in the hardest, least defined problems in fraud. You will own fraud incident response from detection to postmortem across first-party and third-party fraud, write the memos and responses that our partners and auditors rely on, and be the operational voice of Fraud Operations in partner-bank conversations. You will lead Fraud Operations' response to audit and regulatory observations, and you will help Mercury get ready to operate as a bank, translating what examiners and partner banks expect into the processes, evidence, and documentation our teams need every day.

You don't need to be the deepest domain expert in every fraud typology. You need to be able to hold your own in an incident, ask the right questions, bring the right people in, and turn a messy channel full of data into a clear, defensible, and actionable narrative. You'll work closely with Fraud Investigations and Enablement, Risk Strategy, Compliance, Legal, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering.

What You'll Do

Lead fraud incident management
• Act as incident lead or operational DRI for fraud incidents across all Mercury products, including account takeover, card testing and BIN attacks, mule and ring activity, spikes in fraud behavior, and first-party fraud trends.
• Mobilize incident response, size impact, pull the right people from Fraud Investigations, Enablement, Strategy, Product, and Engineering, and keep everyone aligned on what we know, what we don't, and who owns what.
• Make or tee up decisions with a recommendation attached: containment, customer communication, reimbursement and credit decisions, account actions, and when to escalate.
• Run postmortems and retros for first-party and third-party fraud incidents: root cause, control gaps, remediation owners and dates, and track statuses of each.
• Spot patterns across incidents and turn them into durable fixes in alerts, rules, SOPs, product or tooling change requests, and training instead of one-off responses.

Write the memos and responses partners and auditors rely on
• Draft incident and retro memos for bank partners and internal risk governance: what happened, impact, root cause, controls in place, remediation plan, and timelines.
• Use AI tools to get from raw incident data to a strong first draft quickly, then verify every number and claim against source data before it leaves the team.
• Prepare accurate, concise responses to partner-bank questions, suspicious activity and investigation inquiries, and requests for information.

Coordinate with bank partners
• Be a day-to-day operational point of contact for partner-bank risk, AML, and investigations teams, working alongside Partnerships and Compliance.
• Track open partner requests, commitments, and change-management items, and make sure Fraud Operations responds consistently and on time.
• Bring partner feedback and expectations back to Fraud Operations, Strategy, and Product so controls and processes are built with the partner in mind.

Support audit and exam response for the Fraud domain
• Be Fraud Operations support for audit and regulatory observations: validate accuracy, provide program context, push back where ratings or facts are off, and agree action plans with realistic dates and owners.
• Keep evidence, SOPs, and decision records current so that an audit or exam never becomes a scramble.
• Track issues through governance systems in partnership with Enablement until closure, and confirm the fix worked.

Raise the bar for the team
• Mentor teammates on how to escalate: bring a recommendation and the facts, not just a question.
• Work with Enablement and QC to feed incident learnings into training, scorecards, and playbooks.
• Partner with Strategy and Engineering on tooling and reporting that make incident response faster.

What You'll Bring

Our mobile engineers have a variety of different backgrounds

There are ~60 Android engineers at Monzo and we’re looking for more to join the team. We have several non-graduates; only some of us studied Computer Science; some of us have worked in huge companies; some have only ever worked in startups; others are former consultants. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you.

 Monzo works in small, interdisciplinary teams

We have around 650 engineers out of roughly 5,500 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

We’re searching for product-focused Android engineers to evolve our native mobile app. You’ll take pride in building polished user experiences, and you’ll balance the need for well-tested resilient code with moving fast and iterating. 

You’ll be working on a product that is a part of day to day life for more than 11 million people already, and your work here will shape the way that people interact with their finances.

As an Android Engineer at Monzo you'll work in a small, autonomous product squad alongside iOS Engineers, Backend Engineers, User Researchers, Product Designers, Product Managers, QA Testers, and Data Scientists.

You and your team will be responsible for an overall company goal, rather than building a specific feature - you'll have the opportunity to have impact on both what we build, and how we build it. Mobile engineers at Monzo work on everything from the personal banking product to customer support tools. We also have a small mobile platform squad dedicated to enabling other engineers to move faster.

Every week we meet as an Android discipline to discuss tools, techniques, problems we're encountering across the company and work together to improve our codebase and processes.

You'll report to an engineering manager who will meet with you every 1-2 weeks 1:1. They’re dedicated to helping you grow and develop as an engineer.

Our Android app

Our app is 100% Kotlin, built using MVVM (Model View ViewModel) and Coordinators, and modularised by product feature.

We use RxJava, Retrofit and Moshi for API calls and Dagger for dependency injection. We’re starting to use Coroutines for most new features. Room is our choice for persistence, and we use repositories for interacting with data. We’ve built out our design system with Compose. 

We use GitHub Pull Requests to do code reviews, and write unit tests for our ViewModels, Coordinators, and any other classes which contain logic. We write tests for all of our Compose screens and snapshot test them with Happo. We also use Espresso to test flows, which are executed via our continuous integration system.

We’ve previously written about building Monzo Chat on Android, which goes into detail on some of these elements.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the team

OKX's Global Legal team provides legal advice and guidance to OKX and its affiliated entities across all coverage areas and geographic locations, and supports business growth by working with all teams within the company to help them achieve their goals. We are a high-functioning, collaborative and fast-paced team who enjoys the cutting-edge nature of our work and our industry. Our team of 60+ lawyers are located around the world, and the OKX Chief Legal Officer is based in the United States.

About the Opportunity

This is an essential, high-profile role at one of the fastest-growing global cryptocurrency exchanges in Europe. The Deputy General Counsel will play a central role in proactively shaping OKX's regulatory and legal strategy in the EEA.

 

As Deputy General Counsel and Head of Legal, EEA, you will lead the EEA legal function, working closely with the EEA CEO and other key stakeholders and reporting into the Global Legal team. You will be providing strategic legal and regulatory guidance for OKX’s European entity and supporting business operations across the region. This role combines hands-on legal management, cross-functional advisory, and strategic leadership in an evolving regulatory and crypto landscape.

 

You will be a member of the EU management team and represent the legal function at relevant Board and committee meetings.

 

The right candidate will have direct legal experience and an enthusiastic belief in the digital asset space, 14+ years of experience working for a top-tier law firm, in-house at a financial services or digital assets company or with a financial services regulator and possess excellent writing and analytical skills. The ideal candidate has deep experience in financial services and digital asset regulation, EEA regulation, marketing and advertising, and contract law.

 

We offer a competitive base salary and bonus structure as well as excellent benefits and an opportunity to work in a cutting-edge industry that will be the future of financial services.

What You’ll Be Doing 

Supporting OKX's business expansion in the EEA. This role will be the primary legal point of contact for the OKX EEA entity, and will be called upon to support the business in its licensing and legal efforts to expand into the U.K. Market. The right candidate will also have experience in managing a team and representing OKX in relevant industry associations and promoting OKX's view point in consultation efforts.

Supporting the business in virtually all legal coverage areas, including but not limited to:
• Product development, regulatory matters, IP and trademark enforcement, corporate governance, licensing efforts, token listings for OKX Europe., contract negotiation, compliance legal support, institutional sales and partnerships, and marketing and advertising.

• Cloud security and identity — IAM, network segmentation, secrets management, encryption and key management

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the Team

OKX Internal Audit is the organization's independent third line of defense, reporting to the Board and the Group Audit and Risk Committee on the design and effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal controls across a global, multi-entity crypto exchange. The function executes a risk-based annual audit plan covering financial, operational, technology, security, and regulatory risk, and operates with full, unrestricted access to systems, records, and personnel.

Within Internal Audit, the Platform Infrastructure team sits inside the Global Platform Engineering (GP E) team and owns assurance over the technology foundation that keeps the exchange running: network administration, cloud infrastructure and infrastructure-as-code, containerization and orchestration, middleware services, site reliability and disaster recovery, and the data pipelines feeding OKX's financial and operational systems. Reflecting a multi-cloud environment (AWS, Alibaba Cloud, GCP) supporting live trading, custody, and customer-facing operations on a global scale.

 

About the Role

As Senior Manager, Platform Infrastructure Audit, you'll be a hands-on, deeply technical individual-contributor auditor who owns critical assurance projects spanning the cloud infrastructure and DevOps lifecycle, from platform build and configuration through CI/CD pipelines and hands-on ITGC validation. You'll bring subject matter expertise to both dimensions of AI in scope: auditing AI (assessing how OKX's AI/ML systems are built, governed, and monitored) and auditing with AI (applying AI tools to your own scoping, testing, and reporting) while also flexing into adjacent domains such as cloud security and identity, resilience engineering, secure SDLC, and data engineering. You'll help shape the risk-based audit plan by identifying emerging infrastructure risks, and partner closely with Engineering, SRE, and Security stakeholders to deliver findings and recommendations that hold up in a fast-moving, high-technology crypto environment.

 

What You'll be Doing
• Cloud Infrastructure Platform Engineering Audit (SME): Deep, hands-on expertise auditing cloud platforms (Alibaba Cloud, AWS), containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm).
• AI Use, Adoption Governance: Two dimensions, both required.
• Auditing AI: Assessing how AI/ML systems are built, deployed, and monitored — model and data lineage, training-data provenance and quality, access to models and prompts, human-in-the-loop and approval controls, evaluation and drift monitoring, and alignment to emerging AI governance and regulatory expectations.
• Auditing with AI: A demonstrated bias toward using AI in your own audit work — scoping, evidence review, control testing, script generation, and reporting — and an interest in helping the function build reusable AI-enabled audit tooling.

 

What We Look For in You
• Crypto Blockchain Acumen: Prior experience at a crypto exchange or with a crypto product is preferred.
• Critical Thinking for Complex Environments: A proven capacity to analyze novel technical and control environments unique to crypto, identify intricate root causes, and propose effective, context-specific remediation that engineering teams will actually adopt.
• Breadth Across Adjacent Platform Domains: Demonstrable experience auditing control design and operating effectiveness in several of the following:
• Cloud security and identity — IAM, network segmentation, secrets management, encryption and key management
• Site reliability and resilience — observability, incident and problem management, capacity, backup and disaster recovery
• Software development lifecycle — code review, branch protection, artifact integrity, secure SDLC, third-party and open-source dependency risk
• Data engineering and analytics — integrity and quality of data pipelines and ETL processes
• AI/ML platform and MLOps — model registries, feature stores, inference infrastructure, and the data feeding them

 

Nice to Haves
• Cloud or Security Certifications: AWS or GCP professional-level certification, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), CISA, CISSP, or CCSK/CCSP.
• Crypto and blockchain literacy: regulated financial-services, fintech, or crypto experience.
• Mandarin speaking

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: ICT Risk Oversight Lead
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Bitstamp made history in 2011 as the world’s first regulated crypto exchange. Today, we are entering an ambitious new chapter as part of the Robinhood family. The Risk team's mission is to safeguard Robinhood's operations by providing robust second-line oversight of technology and cyber risk. We focus on protecting our customers and maintaining the trust of regulators and partners. We collaborate with security, engineering, and product teams to ensure our technology arrangements are resilient and secure. Our team values rigorous analysis, open communication, and proactive risk management! Together, we ensure that our digital asset and brokerage services scale safely.

As ICT Risk Oversight Lead, you will serve as a key representative of the second line of defense for cyber and technology risk, providing independent challenge and oversight across technology operations, major change initiatives, risk appetite monitoring, and cyber and IT governance. In this role, you will review whether the business is operating within our risk appetite, assess the effectiveness of technology-related controls, and support regulatory alignment. You will also help strengthen oversight of outsourced and intra-group technology and information security activities. This is an exciting opportunity to report directly to the Head of Risk Authorized Manager and drive the safety of our Luxembourg operations!

In this role, you will review whether the business is operating within risk appetite, assess the effectiveness of technology-related controls, support regulatory alignment, and help strengthen oversight of outsourced and intra-group technology and information security activities.

This role is based in our Luxembourg office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Bitstamp by Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do
• Implement and enhance the ICT Risk Management framework, including policies and procedures, in alignment with Robinhood group standards and Bitstamp's jurisdictional regulatory requirements.
• Provide 2LOD oversight and monitoring across key technology and security initiatives and business-as-usual operations, including the review of and identification of issues, and ongoing review of risk metrics and indicators.
• Carry out risk assessments for new products and for existing systems, processes, and technology arrangements.
• Act in a 2LOD capacity collaborating with the IT and Security organizations, including close partnership with CISO and other relevant stakeholders.
• Enhance the risk appetite framework and KRIs for ICT risks, perform independent reviews, and provide independent challenge to 1LOD.
• Report findings, risk themes, and regular updates through established governance cadences and management bodies.
• Promote ICT risk awareness and help strengthen risk culture across the organization.
• Champion the effective and secure use of AI to support automation, efficiency, and scalable risk management practices.

What you bring
• 8+ years of experience in cyber, technology, or ICT risk, with a strong understanding of second line oversight, control effectiveness, and independent challenge.
• Experience in a highly regulated environment, ideally in financial services, including interaction with regulatory expectations and governance processes.
• Strong understanding of ICT, cyber, and operational risks specific to cryptocurrency and digital asset businesses, including exchange and custody models, third-party dependencies, technology resilience, and heightened regulatory expectations.
• Strong knowledge of relevant ICT and cyber regulatory requirements, including DORA, MiCA, EU AI Act, CSSF expectations, and related European frameworks.
• Experience across technology risk, control assurance, incident response, and internal control environments; technology audit experience is a strong plus.
• Ability to assess complex technology and security risks, provide practical challenge to first-line teams, and influence outcomes across business and technical stakeholders.
• Experience in business continuity, identity and access management, secure software development.
• Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, or CRISC are strongly preferred; ISO 27001, ISO 22301, or similar certifications are a plus.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to build trusted relationships and operate effectively across functions.

What we offer
• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact and bonus programs.
• Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs.

experience:

the timeline at the centre of the app, transaction details and counterparty information, transaction history, statements, and exports. ABOUT THE ROLE 

As an Engineering Manager at Tide, you will lead the Accounts team. You will set its technical direction, own its delivery and reliability, and grow its engineers across backend, mobile, and web.
This is a product-facing platform team. A large share of the work shows up directly in the app, so you will work closely with product and design. It is also a financial system: a transaction that renders wrongly, a statement that does not reconcile, or an export that misses a record is a correctness problem, not a cosmetic one.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
• Leading the Accounts team across backend, Flutter mobile, and Angular web, setting its technical direction and holding it to delivery.
• Defining and maintaining the interface with the ledger: what the ledger guarantees, how Accounts services consume it, and who owns which data and schemas.
• Owning account opening, account management, and account switching (CASS), including the regulatory compliance that comes with them.
• Owning the member-facing transaction experience end to end: the timeline, transaction details, counterparty information, transaction history, statements, and exports.
• Setting technical direction for services that are read-heavy, data-rich, and tightly coupled to the app: performance, pagination and search at scale, data consistency with the ledger, and long-term architecture.
• Owning system stability and operational reliability for your services: SLOs, observability, on-call practice.
• Partnering with product, design, compliance, and operations to make sure what we ship is accurate, supportable, and compliant across all markets.
• Growing engineers at every level, across backend, mobile, and web. The team spans early-career through senior.
• Partnering with other teams at Tide that build on the Accounts platform, such as investment accounts and savings accounts, so the platform meets their needs.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Experience and background
• Meaningful engineering management experience. You have led teams through real delivery, not just been a strong tech lead. What matters is the quality of that experience, not the number of years
• Experience leading product-driven teams. You have worked closely with product and design and been accountable for customer outcomes, not just output
• A solid backend engineering foundation before moving into management, enough to earn credibility with the team and get into the detail when it matters
• Experience leading distributed, remote-first teams across time zones
• Proven experience aligning with senior leadership on deliveries and managing dependencies with neighboring teams
• Strong grasp of distributed systems: data consistency across services, reliability patterns, SLOs and SLAs, observability tooling

Technical depth
• Technically fluent: you can read the code, follow the architecture, and engage meaningfully with design decisions and production problems. You do not need to be shipping features regularly, but you need to understand what your team is building and why.

• Experience with microservices in a cloud-native environment (we are AWS heavy).
• Designing and operating APIs and data services that feed mobile and web clients: latency, pagination, caching, and backwards compatibility with released app versions.
• Relational database engineering, including data modelling and query performance for read-heavy workloads over large transaction histories.
• Event-driven and async systems experience.
• Familiarity with mobile and web delivery (Flutter and Angular, or similar), enough to make good trade-offs with client engineers.
• Exposure to agentic or AI-integrated systems, and engineering practices.

HOW YOU WORK
• You set technical direction and hold others to it. You are the person the team turns to when something is hard.
• You care about the member experience and about correctness in equal measure, and you do not let one erode the other.
• You are a good neighbor to other teams. You make interfaces explicit, agree expectations early, and treat partner teams across Banking as close collaborators.
• You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders (product, design, compliance, operations) without losing precision.
• You develop engineers at every level, with a plan for each person.

OUR TECH STACK:
• Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!)
• Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
• Primary datastores are PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
• Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD and, EKS provided by the Cloud team to run the platform
• DataDog for monitoring, observability and automated SLOs
• GitHub, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines - new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first week
• Angular on Web, Flutter for our mobile app, but from time to time we use Swift and Kotlin
• Fivetran/BigQuery/Looker for the BI insights and Python/FastAPI/Faust + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management 

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
• Competitive Compensation - competitive salary and share options
• Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
• Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
• Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
• Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
• Life Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
• Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
• Volunteering Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
• Learning Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
• WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
• Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
• Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
• Snacks Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

Tidean Ways of Working 

At Tide, we’re Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we’re One Team. Our Working Out of Office (WOO) policy allows you to work from anywhere in the world for up to 90 days a year. We are remote first, but when you do want to meet new people, collaborate with your team or simply hang out with your colleagues, our offices are always available and equipped to the highest standard. We offer flexible working hours and trust our employees to do their work well, at times that suit them and their team.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. Our company is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment, that fosters cooperation in everything we do. This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference with responsibilities across engineering practices in a supportive and rapidly expanding company!

• You have several years of experience as a Software Engineer working with Flutter, native mobile (iOS or Android), or React Native.
• You have experience with popular Flutter libraries, tools and its lifecycle.
• You are passionate about building great products in small, autonomous, agile teams.
• You have a passion for automation tests and experience writing testable code.
• You have experience building sleek, high-performance user interfaces and complex Mobile apps that successfully shipped to customers.
• Experience technically leading Mobile engineers within cross-platform teams, with the ability to develop and mentor less-experienced developers.
• Experience leveraging automation and tooling, focused on Continuous Integration, Delivery and Deployment.

OUR TECH STACK
• We utilise the latest iterations of Flutter and Dart.
• We use popular and trusted plugins, packages, and tools, preferring leveraging existing solutions over reinventing the wheel.
• We adopt a modular approach in building our applications, viewing each small package akin to a Lego block. More on our approach can be found here.
• With Melos, we handle an extensive Dart codebase, featuring over 300 packages and around 2 million lines of code.
• We manage state and dependency injection efficiently using flutter_bloc, get_it and injectable.
• Our application navigation leverages auto_route and flow_builder.
• We approach the backend communication implementation using freezed, json_serializable, retrofit, and dio interceptors. More about this approach here.
• We heavily rely on code generation with mason and build_runner.
• i69n is our tool of choice for localisation. You can find how we do it here.
• We're deeply committed to Behaviour Driven Development (BDD) tests, and we use bdd_widget_test to help us on that. You can find more here.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

jobs.title: Account Manager, Payouts
jobs.description:
Wise Platform powers cross-border payments for banks, enterprise corporations, and global tech platforms. The Payouts team specifically serves high-volume enterprise clients—such as creator economy platforms, content licensing firms, and gig-economy businesses—that rely on Wise’s API infrastructure to send funds globally at scale.

As one of the first three hires on this newly formed team, you will own the entire post-sale lifecycle for North American enterprise accounts. You will be responsible for driving partner onboarding, ensuring smooth API integrations, maintaining account health, and proactively driving net revenue expansion through corridor, currency, and volume growth. In addition to client-facing duties, you will build the foundational account management playbook, escalation paths, and partner health frameworks for this business line.

Key

Responsibilities:
1. Partner Onboarding & Go-Live (30%)
• Partner with Pre-Sales and Implementation teams to project-manage newly signed enterprise accounts from contract execution to first successful payout run.
• Ensure flawless technical go-lives to rapidly transition signed contract value into active processing volume.
2. Account Expansion & Revenue Growth (30%)
• Own net revenue retention and expansion targets across your portfolio, driving adoption of new payment corridors, currencies, payout flows, and additional business units.
• Translate pre-sale business cases into post-sale operational reality, actively growing volume month-over-month.
3. Technical Relationship Management & Portfolio Health (20%)
• Serve as the primary, hands-on point of contact for live enterprise partners (e.g., creator platforms, marketplaces, gig-economy firms).
• Act as a first-line technical resource to triage API batch failures, webhook errors, and settlement discrepancies directly with partner engineering teams before escalating to internal engineering.
• Monitor transaction volume metrics continuously to identify usage anomalies, operational risks, or drop-offs ahead of formal account reviews.
4. Function Building & Operational Excellence (10%)
• Design, test, and implement foundational post-sale processes, including client onboarding playbooks, account health scoring models, QBR formats, and internal escalation paths.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Global Wise Platform teams across Technical Support, Compliance, Pricing, and Product to optimize client experience and workflow efficiency.
5. Risk & Compliance Monitoring (10%)
• Monitor evolving partner business models and payment flows to identify potential regulatory or compliance shifts, partnering with internal Compliance teams to adjust operational setups as needed.

jobs.title: Assets Recovery Paralegal
jobs.description:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Asset Recovery Junior Paralegal to help manage a high volume of recovery cases using established processes, working toward greater independence on routine matters. In this role, the paralegal will manage cases end to end, from registering each case in our internal systems and assessing the debtor’s profile to preparing notifications for the Legal team or our external partners to send.

This person will also support the wider Legal team by helping with side projects when needed. Beyond handling cases, they will suggest process improvements and work with our stakeholders to help reduce future financial losses.

This person has excellent communication skills, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is motivated to help build efficient, scalable processes that protect Wise from legal and financial risk.

 

Your Mission:

This person will have an immediate impact on our team’s capacity to manage a growing volume of cases. This hire will allow us to reduce initial response times, move more quickly on existing cases, and enable senior team members to focus on more strategic, complex matters. This person will be essential in helping us organize and process new cases, ensuring each case receives the necessary attention from day one.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Implementation Manager to join our team in Austin and play a crucial role in growing Wise Platform by delivering our highest impact partner integrations. You’ll be helping achieve our regional growth targets while working closely with our Solutions Engineering, Product, Compliance, Operational and Sales teams to deliver projects efficiently and to a high standard.

In this role, you will be responsible for driving complex implementations with the world’s biggest banks and businesses. From kick off to launch, you will leverage strong program management experience to deliver on time, high quality integrations. 

Across markets you will implement both new and existing solutions, overcoming blockers along the way with in-depth problem solving and strong influencing skills. You should be equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, winning trust from both executive and engineering, external and internal stakeholders.

This role is ideal for an established professional with a track record of delivering complex programs of work in financial services, particularly in the banking and payments sectors. If you are passionate about financial technology and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply.

What You'll Do:
• Lead complex implementation projects for major banks and businesses, managing from kickoff to launch while ensuring on-time, high-quality delivery.
• Overcome project blockers with strong problem-solving and influencing skills, working in both business and technical contexts, and building trust with diverse stakeholders.
• Use governance expertise to manage scope, timelines, and accountability, while identifying risks, solving challenges, and ensuring regulatory compliance.
• Manage delivery risks for deals—including project, financial, compliance, and reputational—ensuring robust mitigation plans are in place.
• Build and nurture excellent relationships with partners, ensure they love the experience we offer them
• Confidently explain financial technology solutions and lead process improvements to enhance project scalability and efficiency

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Have a significant and visible impact on the growth of Wise platform by leading payments partnerships with the world’s biggest banks and businesses.
• Help to scale the Implementation function, by leading initiatives to improve our processes.
• Deliver new and innovative solutions, finding ways to do things that haven’t been done before.
• Travel to work with our teams and meet with prospects around the world.

jobs.title: Payment Operations Global Processing Function Lead
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Function Lead to oversee Global Processing Operations!

As a Function Lead, you'll be a strong people leader with a sharp focus on delivering world-class service at scale across a 24/7 global operating footprint. You'll drive operational excellence through a deep understanding of service delivery, multi-site team development, and continuous process improvement. You'll support and empower Team Leads across our global locations, foster collaboration across stakeholders, and act as a bridge between Global Processing and other payment operation verticals. 

Your Mission

Our mission in Global Processing Operations is clear: We guarantee the seamless flow of customer funds by consistently providing excellent customer experience without any delays. 

In this role, you'll be a key force in executing that mission—leading 24/7 operations, maintaining strict SLA standards across 50+ currencies, minimizing processing losses, and building a sustainable, future-proof operating model.

You will:
• Develop and support Team Leads across our global locations (including Tallinn, Budapest, Austin, Singapore, São Paulo, and Hyderabad) as they scale support and mentor team members, focusing on their growth as proactive leaders.
• Drive service delivery excellence by ensuring strict SLAs and KPIs are consistently met—maintaining our target of solving 90% of cases within 1 hour across all queues
• Ensure long-term scalability by building resilient processes, minimizing processing losses, and managing the migration of operational workloads from regional teams into Global Processing.
• Own and deliver operational plans for 24/7 global queue management, ensuring precision, speed, and seamless handover between global time zones.
• Collaborate cross-functionally to manage operational impact and unlock opportunities to improve customer experience, migrate operational tasks, and streamline processes. 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Make an Impact – Eliminate bottlenecks and streamline processing across critical queues. You'll directly contribute to Mission Zero by making global payment processing faster, more predictable, and frictionless.
• Challenge Yourself – Lead operations for a rapidly scaling global team (spanning 10+ Team Leads and 80+ Specialists and System Experts) handling complex, high-speed multi-currency flows.
• Inspire Teams – As a People Developer, you'll foster an inclusive environment across global sites, partnering with technical and operational leaders to shape how we scale processing operations through 2026 and beyond.

jobs.title: Northam Enterprise and Operational Risk Lead
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Risk Lead to manage the Northam Enterprise and Operational Risk Management team, and drive the implementation and day-to-day management of our Enterprise and Operational risk management frameworks across our US and Canada entities. 

This role is responsible for driving the control mapping exercise, the design and implementation of control monitoring, risk appetite statements, and KRIs. This role will also drive the issue management process, ensuring a culture of proactive self identification and accountability for the remediation of issues. Another important part of this role is to help our Product Managers launch new products faster and safely by identifying the key risks and helping build scalable controls. 

What will you do?
• Manage, coach and mentor a team of four risk management professionals.
• Manage, partner, and influence senior regional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Banking and Compliance to embed the risk function and risk management program.
• Lead the implementation and ongoing management of our Enterprise and Operational Risk Management frameworks across the US and Canada entities, including ensuring compliance with relevant regulations, embedding of the risk and control self assessment process, and issues management.
• Conduct in-depth reviews to identify risks and complete control mapping across our most material processes, and help design scalable controls and a control monitoring & testing program.
• Lead the development and implementation of risk appetite statements, risk tolerance thresholds, and key risk indicators, and work with data analysts and Product managers to create monitoring dashboards.
• Support first line teams in documenting, solutioning, and prioritising control gaps.
• Ongoing oversight of issue remediation activities, including regulatory remediation, using our risk management tool (Audit Board) to ensure appropriate risk focused prioritisation, and help validate closure of remediated issues, including advising on the risk acceptance of issues where appropriate.
• Analysing incidents and producing actionable insights.
• Partnering with ‘first line’ teams across the business to support the launch of new products by ensuring that key risks are identified and mitigated with the right balance of pre-launch and post-launch checks with a focus on ensuring we can continue to ship quality products at pace.
• Coordinate the quarterly residual risk assessment process across the risk taxonomy, including loss and incident reporting, to inform our regional risk profile for reporting to local and global risk committees, and to our local boards.
• Promoting and helping embed a proactive risk culture, making risk meaningful and relevant to everyone at Wise.

jobs.title: High Volume Business Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Responsibilities 

Case Ownership & Resolution
• Take full cradle-to-grave ownership of customer enquiries and issues by default. You are the customer’s single point of contact until the issue is resolved.; you do not "pass the buck." You consistently aim for first contact resolution, demonstrating your commitment to getting the right outcome and not just completing a task.
• Manage a dynamic workflow across different channels, ensuring high-volume demand is met without sacrificing quality.
• Use creative thinking to diagnose complex issues. Move beyond standard operating procedures when needed to find solutions that work for the customer and the business, from both a regulatory and efficiency perspective
• Work closely with other teams, such as KYC and Financial Crime to seamlessly facilitate customer issues and act as an advocate for the customer.

Retention & Loyalty
• Treat every interaction as a retention opportunity. Identify "at-risk" behaviors or sentiments and intervene with high-touch service and real time conversations, anticipating potential needs and likely friction to prevent churn.
• Educate customers on how to get the most out of our products, moving the conversation from "fixing a problem" to "adding value."
• De-escalate friction with professional empathy, transparency and confidence, turning negative sentiment into positive advocacy.
• Participate in initiatives and programmes designed to improve customer retention eg re-contacting self deactivated customers.
• Deliver empowered solutions that solve for tomorrow by proactively addressing future friction points before the customer even identifies them. 

Operational Excellence & Feedback
• Maintain rigorous adherence to High Volume KPI’s.
• Act as a feedback loop for the High Volume Senior Lead and wider management team. Use high-level root cause analysis to identify recurring trends, broken processes, customer education opportunities and product bugs that are driving high contact volumes.
• Document unique case resolutions and creative fixes so individual wins become scalable learnings for the wider team and knowledge base

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
At Wise, we build and launch truly amazing products designed to give our customers smart & impactful solutions to their international money challenges. But creating ground-breaking products is only half the battle - we need everyone to know about them, understand them, and feel genuinely inspired to use them. 

As a Senior Strategist, you will have strong creative judgement to help our target audience understand how Wise solves their international money problems. You will make sense of complex marketing & business problems, bringing together business priorities with customer & market insights to identify where creative can support business growth. You will write excellent, focused & inspiring creative briefs, and work closely with creative teams to deliver campaigns spanning channels such as Paid Social, Paid Display, Audio and more from idea to final execution. 

What you’ll be doing
• Bring clarity to complex marketing problems: Work with product, marketing and regional teams to unpack broad or ambiguous challenges. Ask the right questions, connect the available evidence and establish priorities, defining the problem we need to solve and the role creative can play.
• Find the insight that unlocks the creative: Bring together customer research, market context and performance learnings to identify the motivations, tensions and barriers our communications need to address. Turn these into a clear strategic direction and the change we want to make.
• Write creative briefs that inspire great work: Translate customer & market insights, and creative performance insights into focused, compelling creative briefs with clear objectives, audience insight and proposition. Giving creative teams a clear & inspiring starting point from which to develop bold, distinctive ideas.
• Raise the quality of the work through creative critique: Assess creative concepts and executions against creative briefs - ensuring alignment to insights, and market priorities. Articulate what’s working, what isn’t and why, giving specific, constructive feedback that improves the work while preserving the strength of the idea.
• Reinvent & own customer comms: Lead the strategic direction and storytelling of our quarterly "Mission Update" customer comms - turning company & product updates from functional comms into bold, engaging & memorable moments for our customers.
• Connect data to creative impact: Interpret channel performance data across media channels into clear creative recommendations on what to test, refine, or scale, ensuring every creative asset drives measurable results.

What you’ll bring to the role
• A proven track record in creative strategy, alongside broader marketing experience. You understand how customer needs, product messaging, media placement and commercial objectives come together, and can apply that to defined creative projects.
• A knack for turning functional product messaging into fun, engaging narratives that will get customers using our products.
• Strong creative judgement and an excellent ability to critique work. You can explain why an idea or execution will connect with its audience and deliver on the brief, identify where it falls short, and give actionable feedback grounded in strategy.
• Comfortable interpreting channel performance metrics (i.e. CTR / CPA / conversion ... etc) to understand which creative narratives resonate best, and iterating for maximum impact.
• Excellent collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to unite product, creative, and performance media teams around bold creative ideas.
• A self-starter attitude - comfortable identifying comms gaps & pushing initiatives through to completion
• The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment.

What’s in it for you?

You’ll be part of a team of exceptionally talented marketers who consistently break new ground in the way they engage customers.

Within Wise we operate in a flat structure, you’ll be in charge of your own workload and focus areas, giving you the chance to have a huge impact in one of the UK’s fastest growing & most successful startups.

jobs.title: Network Engineer - Platform Integrations EMEA
jobs.description:
What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Network Engineer to join our Platform Integrations EMEA team, where you'll help expand and maintain direct integrations with payment systems and partners across the region.

What is the Platform Integrations EMEA (PI-EMEA) team?

The Platform Integrations squad sits within the Platform tribe, which designs, builds and operates the foundational direct integration infrastructure that power the product that moves billions of dollars every month. The Platform Integrations EMEA team within PI leads the direct integrations in the EMEA region while also supporting integrations all over the world.

Here’s how you’ll be contributing to the Team?
• Design, implement and maintain integrations between Wise and complex financial systems.
• Develop and design scalable and repeatable architecture with complex regulatory requirements.
• Analyse infrastructure to determine inefficiencies and problems, and create automation and optimisation.
• Collaborate with our larger platform engineering team and alongside product engineering on globally impactful projects.
• Communicate with various stakeholders throughout Wise, plan roadmaps with your team, and work through challenges to determine scope and realistic delivery.
• Work with Leads and Engineers to influence the direction and change current technology implementations, as well as advocate for excellence with third parties.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Work in a modern, cloud heavy environment where remote connectivity is a staple of our tech ecosystem
• Choose your path to impact - we believe people and teams are most empowered when they can act autonomously. So rather than telling you what to do, you’ll work with your team to create a vision of your own. Of course, you can always gather feedback from smart, curious people across Wise but you’ll have the freedom to make your own calls
• Grow as an engineer - understand what problems the business needs to solve and why, then proactively resolve them. We shy away from micro management

• Be part of our mission to make money without borders the new normal

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst - Growth
jobs.description:
Your Mission:

At Wise, we’ve got a clear mission — money without borders. Built by and for people who live global lives. As a FinTech company moving billions of GBP of customer money in over 70 countries, Wise needs bulletproof financials & insights into the growth of the company. We need timely, accurate and scalable financial data to make accurate business decisions inside the company.

Due to continued and rapid growth we’re on the hunt for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Growth and Strategic Finance Team in Shoreditch, London. You’ll be part of the team that helps pilot the rocket ship.

What you’ll be doing:
• Your principal responsibility will be to generate insights that lead us to better decisions for the company and our customers.
• Curating datasets, surfacing metrics, some statistical modelling, and deeper dive analysis that we expect to influence the direction of the team and the company.

• Helping us understand what’s driving our growth at a company or regional level
• Understand our customer segments and cohorts, and how they contribute to our growth
• Tie our customer acquisition and activity to marketing or product initiatives, to measure the realised financial return of those initiatives

Who you are:
• 3 years experience in similar roles
• Mathematical or quantitative background
• Strong SQL skills
• Familiarity with Python/R
• Strong analytical ability
• Decent understanding of stats and statistical modelling
• Data visualisation and storytelling ability
• Ability to self organise and manage stakeholders
• Demonstration of impact/going above and beyond basic role requirements

Desirable
• DBT
• Data modelling in a warehouse context
• Understanding of testing and experimental design
• Legally authorised to work in the UK

Please note that Wise does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

jobs.title: Lead Data Analyst - FinCrime Operations
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an Lead Data Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to partner with our operational teams to help drive data-driven decisions that would support our fast-growing product through scaling and optimising the team.

As an Lead Data Analyst, you'll be driving our analytics efforts in our operations teams, who do everything from support our customers when they need help, to screening for criminal activity, to verifying customer identities at scale. 

Most importantly, you’ll collaborate closely with your operational leads, product managers, designers and engineers to bring your insights into real change for our customers and help drive our mission! 

This is an IC3 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Lead Data Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to partner with our operational teams to help drive data-driven decisions that would support our fast-growing product through scaling and optimising the team.

As a Lead Data Analyst, you'll be driving our analytics efforts in our operations teams, who do everything from support our customers when they need help, to screening for criminal activity, to verifying customer identities at scale. 

Most importantly, you’ll collaborate closely with your operational leads, as well as workforce management, quality, training, and knowledge management, to bring your insights into real change for our customers and help drive our mission! 

Here’s how you’ll be contributing:
• Analytical Capacity Planning and Forecasting. Focus on building and refining analytical models for strategic capacity planning. Take ownership of forecasting efforts to align with business growth and operational demands.
• Data Pipeline Ownership. Take ownership of data pipelines to maintain and improve data flow, ensuring reliability and accuracy.
• Predictive Modeling and Cause and Effect Analysis. Develop and implement robust models to predict outcomes and perform cause and effect analysis to identify key drivers, optimise processes, and enhance decision-making and strategic planning.
• Strategic Support and Analysis. Provide critical insights to assess the operational health of FinCrime function, conduct in-depth cost analysis, and offer detailed analysis of operational metrics (including quality) to understand impacts on customer experiences.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Personal and Business Pricing
jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate Senior Backend Software Engineer to join the Personal & Business Pricing Team.
