You'll work in a highly collaborative environment and gain exposure to a wide range of domains while helping to shape the team's technical direction. You'll partner closely with global and regional product teams to enable new product features and experiments while ensuring our pricing infrastructure remains scalable, reliable and accurate.

What will you be working on?
• Design and build features end-to-end across our pricing services.
• Contribute to architectural decisions and code reviews, raising the bar on quality, reliability and observability.
• Drive initiatives to improve the reliability and scalability of our services, improving the reliability and flexibility of our pricing products.

jobs.title: Fincrime Operations Investigator - Fraud
jobs.description:
The position is based in Budapest and follows a hybrid working model, offering the flexibility to work from home as well as from the office.

As a FinCrime Operations Investigator, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Wise and its customers from financial crime. You will be responsible for investigating and analyzing customer accounts, transactions and activities on our platform to detect and prevent money laundering, fraud, and other illicit activities. You will leverage your expertise to identify suspicious patterns, conduct thorough investigations, and ensure compliance with AML/CTF regulations and internal policies and procedures, all while adhering to Wise’s risk appetite. This role offers a unique opportunity to deepen your expertise in the FinCrime domain, contribute to a rapidly growing global company, and make a tangible impact on protecting our users and the integrity of our platform.

Job Responsibilities
• Conduct in-depth investigations of potentially suspicious activity, utilizing both internal and external data sources.
• Analyze complex financial transactions and customer behavior to identify patterns indicative of money laundering, fraud, or other financial crimes.
• Evaluate and assess alerts generated by transaction monitoring systems and other detection tools.
• Gather and analyze supporting documentation, including KYC information, transaction records, and other relevant data.
• Review and interpret data to identify patterns and potential risks associated with financial crime. Support the team in making informed decisions based on data insights.
• Prepare detailed and comprehensive investigation reports, documenting findings and recommendations.
• Act as a point of escalation for complex FinCrime cases from other operations teams, providing guidance and expertise.
• Mentor and train other team members on FinCrime investigation techniques and best practices.
• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to improve fraud detection rules, processes, and system enhancements.
• Stay up-to-date on emerging FinCrime trends, typologies, and regulatory changes.
• Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders, including compliance, legal, and customer support teams.
• Liaise with financial institutions and law enforcement agencies as needed.
• Participate in ad-hoc projects and initiatives related to FinCrime prevention and detection.
• Maintain accurate and complete records of all investigations and related activities.
• Provide input on process improvements and backlog exercises.
• Complete all company-assigned mandatory, refresher or ad hoc trainings on time and with diligence.
• Customer Communication: Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically with customers via approved channels to obtain necessary details or clarifications for reviews, always upholding our high customer experience standards. A key part of this involves avoiding unnecessary customer contacts and preventing delayed case resolutions. All communication must be precisely tailored to ensure clarity and efficiency.
• KPIs: Take a proactive approach to consistently achieve individual and team targets (KPIs, SLAs, QA), demonstrating a strong commitment to both quality and speed. This includes meeting deadlines reliably, optimizing processing times, and taking full ownership and accountability for all responsibilities to deliver exceptional results.
• Other: Perform additional tasks as assigned by your lead, demonstrating adaptability and a proactive approach. This includes actively participating in meetings, training, and internal events to support broader team and company objectives.

jobs.title: Group Design Lead - Spend
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an exceptional design leader to join our Spend design team. You’ll be working with the cross-functional team that creates a best in class spending experience for users all over the world.

Over the past decade, Wise has built a global payments infrastructure that has revolutionised how money moves around the world. Since 2018, the Spend squad has built one of the most significant debit card products in the world with millions of cards issued in over 40+ countries in 5 continents with more to be added soon. The squad now consists of 6 Product teams based across Singapore, London and Tallinn. The majority of the team is based in Singapore and owns the end to end experience of spending with Wise. onboarding of card customers, starting with the ordering flow to how we ensure that the customer becomes an active card user.

As a Group Design Lead you will lead the team of designers to deliver projects across complex product areas, which enable customers to spend multiple currencies and manage them safely. You will take ownership of the vision setting and becoming accountable for the design quality of our products and processes on the team.

This is a unique opportunity to create impact to complex user experience that involves both digital and physical elements. Our customers love the ease of spending with Wise Cards, at home or abroad. You will be helping to make the experience even better for millions of customers. 

Your mission: 

You’ll be joining a growing team that is expanding the way customers can use their Wise Account. You’ll get to work on solving how customers can spend their international money, when travelling, relocating or at home. You’ll create simple, easy-to-use experiences for a complex financial product that serves 16 million users, from diverse range of backgrounds, across the globe.

 

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:
• Be a cross-functional hero and partner up with the Group Product Manager, Engineering Lead, Analytics Lead, as well as researchers and content designers within your squad
• Get to know Wise customers, building empathy and deep understanding of their needs
• Using the full range of Product Design and leadership skills to guide the designers to ensure that they are designing and delivering the most impactful projects.
• You’ll be influential in your team, increasing customer-centeredness, creativity, and design quality

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Create world-class work. Join a team that's shaping the future for new customers across multiple audiences, collaborating across functions to deliver work that exceeds expectations.
• Delightful experiences. Create deeper connections with our customers through experiences that evoke delightful and emotion.
• Build connections. Partner with product teams to discover customer needs and use those insights to create bold, scalable stories.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Fincrime Analytics
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Analytics manager who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to partner with our financial crime product teams to help drive data-driven and innovative growth decisions while helping to combat financial crime. 

At Wise, we strike a critical balance between user experience and the stringent demands of risk prevention. Our mission within the Risk & Controls team in APAC is to stay one step ahead of emerging risk while ensuring that our customers enjoy a seamless experience. In this vital role, you will innovate and implement controls that enhance security without compromising user convenience.

Most importantly, you’ll collaborate closely with your product managers, designers, data scientists and engineers to bring your insights into real change for our customers and help drive our mission! 

Your mission:

At Wise our mission is Money Without Borders - instant, convenient, transparent and eventually free. Whether our customers are sending money to another country, spending money abroad, or making and receiving international business payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. 

Here’s how you’ll be contributing to the Financial Crime team:
• You’ll expose the vast data on our processes to the product teams across Wise in a meaningful and actionable way in which people can proactively access the information without friction or need for analyst assistance
• Proactively contribute to, own, create, track key metrics and results for your product and operational teams, keeping them accountable throughout the quarter
• Support stakeholders by conducting research, preparing reports, and visualisations
• Work with data scientists in understanding and developing the means for detecting and mitigating financial crime
• Building the framework for managing risk and customer experience at scale
• Drive the discovery phase by scoping new opportunities and suggesting features, rules and models to combat emerging risks
• The role requires collaboration with Product, Data Scientists, Engineering and Operations Team

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Be part of a positive change in the world. We’re fixing a broken, greedy system, and putting people and businesses in control of their money
• Create value from extensive datasets. We have millions of customers, a global set of payment infrastructure and a complex product that customers can use in different ways. There is a tonne of value left to unlock from this data!
• Influence the team’s direction. Analysts at Wise enable data-driven decision making and have a large impact by helping their teams to decide what to work on.
• Learn from a global network of professionals. We have a large, diverse team of analysts, data scientists and product managers that you will work with and learn from.
• Lead and develop a team of 3 analysts: helping them to set priorities, coaching for impact, and maintaining quality standards

jobs.title: Transaction Health Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Transaction Health Senior Analyst to join our Spend Operations team in Singapore. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who wants to solve complex payment problems and help more good customer payments succeed.

You will use payment knowledge, data and stakeholder conversations to find the cause of payment problems. You will identify practical solutions and lead the work from the first signal to a measured result.

Your mission: 

Wise has already pioneered new ways for people to transfer money across borders and currencies. Our customers can also manage their hard-earned money with the world's first platform to offer true multi-currency banking, and they can spend every day using their Wise debit card.

The Spend Operations team is part of the Spend squad. Our mission is to make it reliable, convenient and eventually free to spend anywhere in the world.

We have an operational team that works closely with our dedicated Product and Engineering teams across offices on three continents. We also work with card schemes and other Product, Engineering and Operations teams at Wise.

How You Will Contribute:

Lead Investigations From Start To Finish
• Find important payment problems from payments data, customer reports and stakeholder input.
• Use SQL, Python or a similar language to test hypotheses and find patterns.
• Investigate problems even when the available signal is incomplete.
• Identify where the cause can sit across the payment flow.
• Decide when to continue, narrow, stop or move an issue to another owner.

Find The Right Problems
• Select work based on customer impact, materiality, evidence, ownership and a practical path to action.
• Separate repeatable payment problems from isolated cases.
• Size the impact with the best available customer, payment, spend, cost or operational measures.
• Build concise evidence packs that make the problem clear.

Design And Drive Solutions
• Look beyond the first or most obvious solution.
• Identify practical levers across Product, Engineering, Risk, Operations, merchants, acquirers, processors and card schemes.
• Find the correct decision-maker and make the required action clear.
• Lead stakeholder conversations and resolve unclear ownership.
• Track actions, deadlines and blockers until the work reaches a clear outcome.

Measure Results And Improve How We Work
• Define the success measure before an intervention starts.
• Compare results before and after the action.

jobs.title: Operations Executive / Senior Operations Executive
jobs.description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions. 

About the Role

As the Operations Executive for Malaysia, you will play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence, enhancing customer experience and improving the overall effectiveness of our 24/7 customer service operations.

Working closely with the Customer Service Manager, you will leverage operational data, customer insights and performance analytics to identify opportunities for improvement, develop actionable strategies and drive cross-functional initiatives. You will oversee key operational frameworks, including reporting and analytics, quality assurance, training, knowledge management and workforce performance, while collaborating with stakeholders across Product, Finance, Legal, Compliance and other business functions.

As a key member of the operations leadership team, you will also serve as the Customer Service Manager’s designated backup, supporting day-to-day decision-making, stakeholder engagement and operational continuity in their absence.

You will:
1. Data Analytics, Reporting & Performance Management
• Analyse customer behaviour and operational performance using ticket volumes, call data, CSAT, contact drivers and FX-related data.
• Develop and maintain daily, weekly and monthly reports and dashboards to monitor KPIs, SLAs, quality and customer satisfaction.
• Identify trends, validate hypotheses, investigate root causes and recommend data-driven improvements.
• Evaluate the impact of initiatives on contact volumes, operational efficiency and customer experience.
2. Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement
• Own and enhance the QA programme across calls and email tickets, ensuring alignment with COPC principles and customer, business and compliance standards.
• Establish consistent evaluation frameworks, scoring methodologies and calibration sessions.
• Analyse QA results to identify performance gaps and drive targeted coaching, corrective actions and service improvements.
3. Training & Knowledge Management
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date knowledge bases, SOPs, response templates and operational guidelines.
• Design and deliver onboarding, refresher and product-specific training for agents and Team Leaders.
• Identify knowledge gaps and measure training effectiveness through QA results and operational KPIs.
4. Operations Management & Escalation Support
• Monitor workforce planning, staffing coverage, intraday performance, shrinkage and absenteeism to maintain SLA commitments.
• Support operational projects, process improvements and complex customer escalations, including disputes and chargebacks.
• Participate in 24/7 on-call and weekend escalation rotations, deputising for the Customer Service Manager when required.
5. Vendor & Commercial Management
• Support vendor performance reviews, contract management and commercial optimisation.
• Oversee invoice verification, payment coordination and billing discrepancy resolution.

You are:
• 4–7 years of experience in customer service, contact centre operations or customer experience, preferably within the financial services, fintech or payments industry.
• Demonstrated experience in operational data analysis, reporting and performance management, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
• Hands-on experience in designing, implementing or managing QA programmes, conducting calibration sessions and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
• Experience in developing and delivering training programmes for frontline teams, including onboarding, refresher training and product or process updates.
• Strong understanding of contact centre operations, including SLA management, quality metrics, customer satisfaction, workforce planning and frontline performance management.
• Familiarity with COPC standards or comparable contact centre quality and operational excellence frameworks is an advantage.

Technical & Analytical Skills
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
• Proficiency in spreadsheets and business intelligence or dashboarding tools, with the ability to develop meaningful reports, dashboards and performance analyses.
• Comfortable working with ticketing platforms, knowledge management systems and workplace collaboration tools.
• Ability to identify trends, investigate root causes, test hypotheses and develop data-backed recommendations.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and influence stakeholders through effective data storytelling.

jobs.title: Brand Design Manager, Growth
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Design at Brex

Design at Brex creates the experiences that make complex systems feel effortless through thoughtful, scalable design. Whether crafting interfaces, shaping product strategy, or harnessing AI to empower our users, we obsess over quality and clarity. This is a team where creativity meets high craft, and where designers grow by building for ambitious customers.

What you'll do

Brex is looking for a Manager, Brand Design (Growth) to join the Design team, a cross-disciplinary group of creatives including product designers, brand designers, content design, operations, and marketing strategists. Our team’s mission is to build a category-defining brand and meaningfully move key business metrics by delivering world-class creative.

Reporting into the Executive Creative Director, you’ll lead the designers responsible for Brex’s growth creative across paid social, digital marketing, email and lifecycle marketing (LCM), industry and growth marketing events, and account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns. You’ll bring exceptional brand craft to work that attracts new customers and deepens engagement, using growth experiments and creative testing to learn what works.

This is a hands-on creative leadership role for someone who leads through the work — not around it. We’re looking for a highly conceptual and craft-driven designer who remains deeply involved in execution while mentoring and guiding other designers along the way. Success in this role means influencing both the “what” and the “how”: shaping creative direction and strategy early with marketing partners, while also elevating the quality and rigor of the final output.

You’ll partner closely with producers, channel owners, and marketing leads to proactively shape briefs, prioritize workstreams, and guide projects from concept through execution. The ideal candidate is energized by building something larger than themselves, thrives in highly collaborative environments, and knows how to push creative quality while balancing business goals and team growth.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require three days per week in office - Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Lead creative direction and execution across growth campaigns, paid social, digital experiences, email and lifecycle journeys, industry and growth marketing events, and account-based marketing.
• Manage and mentor the designers responsible for growth creative within the Brand Design team through active creative partnership, hands-on feedback, and close involvement in the work.
• Partner directly with producers to prioritize, resource, and balance work across designers and projects.
• Collaborate closely with growth, lifecycle, events, and account-based marketing partners to shape briefs and influence creative strategy from the earliest stages.
• Contribute to defining the “what” alongside stakeholders — not just executing the “how.”
• Help evolve and steward Brex’s visual identity and brand expression across channels and touchpoints.
• Translate complex business concepts into clear, compelling, and emotionally resonant visual storytelling.
• Maintain a high bar for craft across typography, layout, systems thinking, and visual execution.
• Present work confidently to stakeholders and articulate creative rationale in a thoughtful and persuasive way.
• Push creative boundaries through growth experiments and creative testing, using performance insights to guide iterations while keeping work strategically grounded and operationally effective.

Requirements
• 8+ years of experience in brand design within agency and/or in-house creative teams.
• Experience leading high-impact creative work while remaining deeply hands-on in execution and craft.
• Portfolio demonstrating exceptional concept-driven design work across campaigns, storytelling, brand systems, experiential, and digital experiences.
• Strong leadership and collaboration skills with experience coaching, mentoring, or guiding designers through the work.
• Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and contribute strategically to creative direction and brand development.
• High level of craft across typography, layout, visual systems, art direction, and storytelling.
• Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to clearly articulate creative decisions and rationale.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
• Proficient in Figma.

Bonus Points
• Experience with AI visual creation tools (Nano Banana, Midjourney, etc.)
• Experience with motion and animation tools (After Effects, Jitter, etc.)
• Experience working on both B2B and B2C brands
• Experience leading integrated campaign or experiential work across multiple channels and audiences

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $248,000 - $311,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

jobs.title: Card Risk Strategy Specialist
jobs.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Overview

This is a hands-on, full-cycle role that owns the whole fraud control loop: investigate, analyze, set up rules, monitor, and improve. You will work tickets daily, turn what you find into data-backed fraud rules and strategies, monitor how they perform, and keep refining them. Each stage feeds the next.

 

You will own the card risk control strategy, from set-up through ongoing performance, and be accountable for the fraud rate and the interception rate.

 

Key Responsibilities
1. Investigation
• Handle card risk tickets daily: review rule-triggered alerts, investigate suspicious accounts and transactions, and decide on block, decline, step-up, or card-lifecycle actions within SLA
• Investigate fraud typologies: account takeover, card testing, BIN attacks, merchant collusion, friendly fraud, and first-party abuse
• Assess merchant and transaction risk by MCC risk type, including high-risk merchants and non-card payment flows
• Manage disputes and chargebacks end to end under Visa/Mastercard rules: evidence, representation, pre-arbitration, and arbitration
2. Data Analysis
• Turn investigation findings into patterns: analyze ticket, alert, and transaction data to identify fraud trends, attack vectors, and coverage gaps
• Measure false positives against loss to judge whether existing rules are effective
3. Rule Set-up
• Design and set up fraud rules, velocity limits, and strategies based on the analysis
• Make sure rule triggers and decisions stay compliant; escalate linked AML/sanctions concerns to Compliance
4. Rule Monitoring
• Continuously monitor alert and ticket data after rules go live
• Track and report KPIs: fraud loss rate (bps), chargeback ratio, approval rate, alert handling time, recovery rate
• Keep the programme within scheme monitoring thresholds (e.g. VAMP, ECM/EFM) and support scheme and partner audits
5. Rule Improvement
• Adjust, retire, and add rules in response to monitoring results, balancing fraud loss against false positives and approval rate
• Feed fraud trends back to Product and Engineering to improve onboarding, 3DS, and authorisation controls

Requirements
• 3+ years in card fraud strategy or payments risk at an issuer, EMI, neobank, PSP, or card programme manager
• Proven hands-on experience building and tuning fraud rules and strategies, not only working tickets
• Hands-on knowledge of Visa and/or Mastercard dispute rules, reason codes, and chargeback timelines
• Experience with MCC-based risk, high-risk merchants, and non-card payments
• Strong data

skills:

SQL and Excel/Sheets to pull, slice, and explain fraud trends
• Fluent English; Mandarin or other European languages are a plus

Nice to Have
• Crypto-linked or prepaid/debit card programme experience, including crypto-to-fiat conversion at authorisation
• Card risk control experience across multiple countries/regions
• Experience launching a card programme in a new market or with a new BIN sponsor
• Scheme monitoring programme remediation experience
• Python or BI tooling (Looker, Tableau, Metabase)
• Certifications: CFE, ACAMS, or equivalent

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Brand Strategy Activations is the brand steward at Chime. We own the integrated campaigns that carry the brand, from brief through production to the readout on how the work performed. Outside of campaigns, we run the social-led work, partnerships, and talent that put Chime into culture. Teams across the company rely on Brand every day, and we’re accountable for being the glue that gets great work out the door.

The Head of Brand generates a large volume of ideas and direction. This role is the person who catches it and turns it into work the company can actually execute: a goal, an owner, a brief, a schedule, and a result. If you’ve ever sat in a room and known exactly how a loose idea becomes a shipped campaign, this is that job.

You’ll work across Creative, Media, Social, Partnerships, Insights, Product Marketing, Legal, and Compliance, plus our external agency partners. You’ll be trusted with getting the brand’s biggest moments through a complicated system.

In this role, you can expect to
• Turning vision into workstreams. Take direction from the Head of Brand and define it as goals with scope, owners, success measures, and a timeline. Bring structure to ideas that arrive without it.
• Cross-functional alignment. Secure what each workstream needs from the functions that touch it, and keep every partner team clear on what they owe and when.
• Briefing. Write and own the briefs for your workstreams, following the team’s briefing process so the quality bar is consistent across everything we produce.
• Work-back schedules. Build the work-back for your workstreams, hold the dates, and flag slippage before it becomes a problem.
• Talent and partnerships. Help choose the talent and brand partners who fit Chime, and own how those relationships are set up and run.
• Social. Own how your workstreams come together on social, where most of this work is seen.
• Calendar alignment. Keep the brand calendar coherent against the team’s goals so moments land in the right order and don’t collide.
• Results. Close every workstream with a readout on what it achieved, and carry the learnings into the next brief.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 8+ years experience on both the agency side and the brand side, roughly two to three years in each. You know what it’s like to receive a bad brief and what it’s like to write one.
• A track record of taking an idea that existed only in someone’s head and turning it into a campaign that shipped.
• Strong writing. Briefs, goals, and recaps are the output of this job, and vague writing produces vague work.
• Comfort running several workstreams at once without losing the detail on any of them.
• Experience working with talent, creators, or brand partners, and judgment about which ones are right for a brand.
• Fluency in social, including what performs and why.

jobs.description:
About the role

When people sign up for Chime, we want to know which marketing efforts brought them in and which ones brought in members who stay and use their account. You will set the direction for how Chime answers that question.

You will be the senior analytics leader for paid marketing. You will co-own and help decide how we measure a 9 figure plus paid media budget and how that measurement turns into optimization and allocation decisions. This is a high-visibility role. Marketing, Growth, Finance and executive leaders will treat your work as the main reference for how marketing performs. You will join the Marketing Analytics team and work across Marketing, Finance, Data Engineering and Data Science/ML.

In this role, you can expect to
• Own the paid performance story. Track spend and results across channels every week. Explain why numbers moved, in plain words that a non-analyst can act on.
• Measure new-member offers. Show whether our introductory new member offers bring in better members and whether they are worth the cost. Compare offer groups against fair, matched groups.
• Set the bar for experiments and offers. Define how tests are designed and read, and how we decide whether sign-up offers are worth the cost.
• Improve how we credit marketing channels. Find where our attribution rules fall short, propose better ones, and work with Data Engineering to build and maintain them.
• Turn marketing mix modeling into budget advice. Use the output of our Marketing Mix Model to advise Marketing on how to allocate budget across channels.
• Be a proactive business partner. Work with Marketing, Growth and Finance leaders as a trusted partner. Share insights and recommendations before they ask, and help them decide what to do next.
• Help plan the work ahead. Estimate the likely impact of new marketing ideas so the team can prioritize.
• Use AI to work faster and go deeper. Use AI tools to speed up analysis, check your work, and build things others can reuse.
• Raise the level of the team. Coach senior data scientists, guide contractors and set the quality bar for high-stakes work.

To thrive in this role, you have
• A Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience in analytics or data science, with deep experience in marketing, growth or consumer products
• A track record of setting measurement strategy across several teams, not only delivering analyses within one team
• Deep expertise in marketing measurement: attribution, incrementality, MMM, cost per acquisition and LTV:CAC, including designing these systems from scratch
• Expert-level experimentation and causal inference skills, including knowing when standard methods don’t fit and building approaches that do
• Strong SQL and experience shaping data models and pipelines in large data warehouses (we use Snowflake)
• Advanced Python or a similar language for analysis
• Experience using Marketing Mix Model output to guide budget decisions at significant scale
• Hands-on experience bringing AI tools into analytics work for a team, and good judgment about their limits

jobs.title: Head of Enterprise and Strategic Partnerships
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States
jobs.description:
Before the iPhone existed, Apple went to America's wireless carriers with terms none of them had ever granted: no carrier logo on the device, no carrier software, and control over how it was sold. Verizon walked away. Cingular said yes, reportedly before it had seen a working prototype, and on January 9, 2007 became the exclusive U.S. carrier for a phone the public had not yet seen. Apple gave up the reach of every other carrier, Cingular gave up control it had never surrendered, and both got something worth more. No template could have produced that agreement. People with the relationships, the nerve and a structure in mind did.

(Fun fact. Most people think it was A T, but “Cingular” was the one who negotiated and announced it, and “AT T” is what the carrier was called by the time the phone shipped in June
2007. That’s why most people say “the AT T and iPhone deal.”)

At Mercury, we are looking for the person who will do that for us. We are building the financial layer for ambitious people of all kinds, and the platforms where they already work are where we want to be: the default bank for AI, the core banking* partner for merchants. One signed agreement can put Mercury in front of millions of businesses. We are a company of founders and small teams trying to change the world, and this isn't a fixed role. We expect the nature of work is changing, and a leader paired with AI tools and the autonomy to build can create 10x outcomes: modeling deals, shaping integrations with our product teams and standing up the function as you go. Bring your relationships, and we will bring the product, the team and the room to build something that doesn't exist yet.

About Strategic Partnerships at Mercury

The Strategic Partnerships team drives customer growth, product expansion and strategic advantage through high-impact partner relationships. We have built a strong business through accounting firms, VCs, accelerators, incorporators and e-commerce partners, working closely with Product, GTM, Finance, Legal, Risk and Operations. That motion works. The next chapter is different, and it starts with you.

About the Role

This is a leadership role with a single mandate: land the handful of partnerships that change Mercury's trajectory. You will own Mercury's most ambitious platform relationships, including making Mercury the default bank for AI and the core banking partner for merchants, and you will be measured on deals that create distribution at a scale no direct sales motion can match.

These are one-of-a-kind deals. Nobody has a template for them, so you will design the structure, and neither side will have done anything quite like it before. You will do it largely through relationships you already have, with the senior executives who decide at the world's most important technology companies.

You will build the enterprise partnerships function from scratch, report into Mercury's leadership team and have a direct line to the CEO. As the motion proves out, you will hire and lead the team that runs it.

What You'll Do

Win the deals that matter most
• Own Mercury's top partnership targets across the AI ecosystem and the largest commerce, productivity and vertical software platforms, and make Mercury the financial layer underneath them.
• Open doors personally at the C-suite and senior executive level, using your existing network to get Mercury into rooms that most companies cannot reach.
• Take each deal through its full lifecycle, from first conversation and business case to term negotiation, legal close, integration scoping and launch.

Architect first-of-a-kind structures
• Design bespoke arrangements such as embedded finance programs, deep API and agent integrations, co-distribution models and joint product experiences that create lasting strategic lock-in.
• Use Mercury's full product suite (banking, payments, cards, APIs, MCP and CLI tooling) as strategic currency, matching the right capabilities to each partner's needs.
• Model deal economics for both sides, pressure-test the business case, and align Finance, Product, Engineering, Legal and Risk leadership behind it.

Build the function
• Define the Enterprise partnerships playbook: who we pursue, how we position, how we negotiate and what success looks like a year from now.
• Work with our bank partners and regulators' expectations in mind so that large, complex integrations can launch and scale safely.
• Hire and develop the team as the motion grows.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, Mercury has signed its first platform-scale agreements in AI and commerce, each with a clear integration plan, committed executive sponsors on both sides and measurable distribution. You have built the playbook and the relationships to repeat it.

What We're Looking For
• 15+ years in strategic partnerships, business development or corporate development, including senior leadership at a category-defining technology company or platform.
• A record of one-of-a-kind deals that you personally originated and closed. You can describe the counterparty, the structure, the economics and your own role in detail, and the counterparty would confirm it.
• Personal relationships with senior executives at leading technology companies. You can call decision-makers directly, you have recent history with them, and they will take the meeting.
• Deep experience structuring embedded, API-driven or distribution deals. You understand how technical integrations create commercial moats, and how to negotiate them.
• Strong commercial and financial fluency. You can model economics for both sides, structure complex incentives and negotiate with sophisticated counterparties.
• Executive presence and internal influence. You earn trust from Finance, Product, Engineering and Legal, and you can move a company behind a deal.
• Comfort building from scratch. Mercury has not had a dedicated enterprise partnerships function, and you are energized by that.
• Technical credibility. You do not need to write code, but you can hold a substantive conversation about APIs, integration architecture and what it means to embed financial infrastructure into someone else's platform.
• Strong plus: experience in fintech, payments, embedded finance or AI-native products.

Until November 18, 1883, American railroads ran on dozens of local times. Noon in Chicago was 12:31 in Pittsburgh, and every railroad kept its own clock, so schedules collided and connections failed. That day the railroads agreed on four time zones, and clocks across the country stopped and restarted on a shared standard. Nothing about the trains changed. What changed was that everyone could finally plan against the same clock.

That is the job of the Staff Strategic Operations Program Manager for Go-to-Market (“GTM”) at Mercury.

Mercury builds the financial stack for ambitious businesses: banking*, cards, payments, credit, and the financial workflows that run on top of them. Our go-to-market organization spans Revenue, Marketing, Growth Product, and GTM Data, more than 200 people who acquire customers and help them use more of Mercury. 

To do that, the four teams are building a shared GTM Engine: one view of the customer, every touchpoint logged, attribution everyone trusts, and Campaigns that share targeting and rules across channels. This role owns the whole program end to end. You would be that person, sitting on Mercury’s Strategic Operations team and embedded with GTM leadership.

jobs.title: Credit Risk Manager
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍Dublin | 💶 €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | Hear from the team ✨

⭐

About the team:

Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and the planned launch of new initiatives. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.

We’re looking for a Credit Risk Manager to help drive the credit and growth strategy for our consumer lending products as we grow our business in Ireland. Our credit teams are part of our Credit Discipline which drives a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives analysts the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.

Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Our credit analysts and managers are fully embedded into a product squad alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Marketers, Customer Researchers, Data Scientists etc. This enables us to solve customer problems in a fast paced and innovative way.

🔑 You'll play a key role by:
• Working closely with Borrowing squad leadership to develop and execute an ambitious growth strategy
• Collaborating with people from engineering, marketing, product, risk and control to design and deliver new products and customer journeys
• Leading the development and maintenance of the NPV models and affordability strategies that underpin the Borrowing underwriting decisions
• Monthly monitoring and reporting on Borrowing performance to stakeholders up to executive level
• Collaborating with the Decision Science team to maximise value from our internal and external data through cutting-edge ML models
• Promoting a culture of proactive, high quality analysis and ensure we have the right credit capabilities, infrastructure and talent in place to scale safely

🤩 You should apply if:
• What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!
• You have extensive experience in unsecured lending in Ireland
• You have a deep understanding of lending economics and have experience developing and deploying underwriting strategies and credit models
• You have strong analytical and data capabilities, backed up by technical coding skills. SQL, Python and Looker experience is a plus
• You have experience with the development and maintenance of NPV models
• You have a strong understanding of the regulations that apply to lending in Ireland
• You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are keen for the chance to improve our products and help ship changes to our customers
• You are a strong communicator, able to cut through complex problems and articulate decision points, particularly to senior leadership
• You have experience in project management and coordination across teams
• You work well collaborating in a team with diverse skill-sets and personality types
• You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing a positive impact to our customers and Monzo

🙌 What’s in it for you

💶 A salary range of €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team

🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)

📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences

🏥 Private healthcare scheme

💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%

💛 Wellbeing

benefits:

financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps
• An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team
• An initial video call with the hiring manager
• A series of role specific, case study behavioural interviews
• A final call with senior leadership

This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.

#LI-MOS1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

jobs.title: Deputy Money Laundering Reporting Officer - Malta
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe crypto will help reshape the future and contribute to greater individual freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions of customers access to crypto trading and decentralised applications. OKX is also trusted by institutions seeking secure access to crypto markets and is supported by its Proof of Reserves programme.

Across our global offices, we are united by three core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These values shape how we work and help us create a collaborative, rewarding and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Team

The Compliance function is responsible for promoting a strong compliance culture and supporting the safe, sustainable growth of OKX. We are a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise the business on regulatory obligations, conduct expectations and enterprise risks.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Deputy Money Laundering Reporting Officer (Deputy MLRO) to support the MLRO in overseeing and further developing the organisation’s AML/CFT and financial crime compliance framework within a MiCA-regulated crypto-asset environment. The role will provide exposure to a broad range of financial crime matters, including customer due diligence, transaction and blockchain monitoring, investigations, suspicious activity reporting and regulatory engagement.

The Deputy MLRO will act as a key AML/CFT subject-matter expert across the organisation, providing oversight, advice and challenge to ensure that financial crime risks are appropriately identified, assessed and managed. The role will also support the continuous enhancement of AML/CFT systems and controls, ensuring that they remain effective, proportionate and aligned with the organisation’s evolving products, customer base and risk profile.

Working closely with the MLRO and stakeholders across Compliance, KYC, Transaction Monitoring, Operations, Product, Legal and Risk, the successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining a strong financial crime compliance framework while supporting an efficient and risk-based customer experience.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Support and deputise for the MLRO, including assisting with AML/CFT governance, management and Board reporting, regulatory matters and oversight of the organisation’s financial crime compliance framework.
• Oversee complex AML/CFT investigations and escalations, including transaction monitoring alerts, blockchain activity, higher-risk customer relationships and internal suspicious activity reports, ensuring decisions and rationale are appropriately documented.
• Support suspicious activity reporting processes, including assessment of potential suspicion, preparation and review of external reports where appropriate, and maintenance of appropriate confidentiality and controls against tipping off.
• Provide second-line oversight of KYC, CDD and EDD, including higher-risk customers, Source of Funds and Source of Wealth assessments, customer risk classification, ongoing monitoring and periodic or trigger-based reviews.
• Oversee and enhance transaction and blockchain monitoring controls, including scenario and threshold calibration, effectiveness testing, identification of emerging typologies and initiatives to improve detection quality and reduce unnecessary false positives.
• Provide AML/CFT expertise on crypto-specific risks, including self-hosted wallets, cross-chain activity, DeFi, mixers, privacy-enhancing technologies and other emerging risks, as well as applicable Travel Rule requirements.
• Support regulatory engagement and continuous improvement, including regulatory inspections and information requests, audits, remediation programmes, new product and service risk assessments, AML/CFT training and implementation of relevant regulatory developments.

What We’re Looking For
• Relevant AML/CFT and financial crime experience, preferably gained within a regulated CASP/VASP, crypto exchange, fintech, payments business or financial institution, with experience in a senior AML, financial crime or compliance role considered an advantage.
• Strong knowledge of EU AML/CFT requirements and the risk-based approach, together with a good understanding of the regulatory framework applicable to CASPs, including MiCA and the EU Transfer of Funds Regulation/Travel Rule.
• Practical experience across core AML/CFT disciplines, including CDD/EDD, Source of Funds and Source of Wealth, customer risk assessment, transaction monitoring, investigations and suspicious activity reporting.
• Strong understanding of crypto-assets and blockchain-related financial crime risks, with experience using or interpreting blockchain analytics and transaction monitoring tools considered a strong advantage.
• Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to assess complex customer and transactional activity, distinguish unusual but legitimate behaviour from genuine financial crime concerns, and reach well-reasoned and defensible decisions.
• Excellent judgement, communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the confidence to provide independent challenge, escalate material concerns and communicate effectively with senior management, operational teams, auditors and regulatory authorities.
• Relevant academic or professional qualifications, with a degree in law, finance, economics, compliance, risk or a related field and/or recognised AML/financial crime qualifications such as CAMS, ICA or equivalent considered an advantage.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package.
• Learning and development programmes and an education subsidy.
• Team-building programmes and company events.
• Wellness and meal allowances.
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants.
• Additional benefits that we would be pleased to discuss during the recruitment process.

OKX Statement

OKX is committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, colour, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, non-job-related physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: 経理
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼組織・チームについて

PayPayは、QRコード決済をはじめとする金融プラットフォームを展開し、事業成長とともに新たなサービス・キャンペーンを継続的に創出しています。
経理部は4つのチームで構成されており、今回募集する新事業・ARチームでは、こうした新サービスや各種キャンペーンに伴う会計処理・決算・債権管理を担っています。
チームには、監査法人出身者や上場企業での経理経験者、システム領域に強みを持つメンバーなど、多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーが在籍しており、互いに連携しながらスピード感を持って業務を推進しています。

＜参考URL＞

世界一のフィンテック企業を目指して。経理本部・財務本部のチャレンジを語る

前例のない事業を会計で設計する― アジャイル環境で判断するPayPay経理

▼募集背景

PayPayの事業拡大に伴い、新サービスやキャンペーン施策が増加する中、経理業務の安定運用と業務プロセスのさらなる高度化に向けて、組織体制を強化しています。
本ポジションでは、キャンペーン関連の決算・会計業務の中核として、伝票承認・概算計上・収益認識（IFRS15）などの実務を主体的に担いながら、チームメンバーのサポートや営業部門との連携、業務プロセスの標準化・改善を推進いただける方を募集しています。

▼具体的な業務内容

新事業・ARチームにおいて、新サービスやキャンペーン施策に関する決算・会計業務を中心に、チーム運営や業務プロセスの改善もご担当いただきます。

◆キャンペーン関連の決算・会計業務
• 月次・四半期決算業務（伝票承認、証憑突合、勘定科目・金額の確認、増減分析等）
• IFRS15(新収益認識基準)に基づくキャンペーン施策等に関する会計処理・収益認識の検討
• 債権管理（計上・消込・残高管理）、仕訳起票

◆業務改善・標準化、チーム運営
• 営業部門等と連携した業務プロセスの整理・標準化
• イレギュラー対応における判断基準・運用ルールの策定、マニュアル整備
• 営業部門等の関係部署との調整・折衝
• AI等を活用した業務の自動化・効率化の推進
• メンバーの業務管理、進捗確認および業務遂行のサポート

▼このポジションで働く魅力
• 専門性を活かせる経理業務：
国内最大規模のFintechサービスにおいて、多様なキャンペーンや新施策に伴う会計・決算業務に携わり、収益認識や債権管理などの専門性を発揮できます。
• 仕組みづくりへの関与：
日々の経理業務にとどまらず、業務プロセスの標準化や営業部門との折衝、チーム運営などにも主体的に取り組めます。
• 専門性を発揮できるチーム環境：
多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーと連携しながら、得意領域を活かして長期的に活躍できる環境です。

必要な経験/スキル

上場企業または成長フェーズの企業における経理実務経験（目安：5年以上）をお持ちで、あわせて以下いずれかの経験・スキルをお持ちの方
• 日商簿記2級以上の知識
• 月次・四半期決算業務を自立して遂行した経験（証憑突合、仕訳起票、残高確認、増減分析等）
• Excel（IF・VLOOKUP等の関数、ピボットテーブル）を用いたデータ集計・分析経験
• IFRS15・新収益認識会計基準に関する知識、または主体的に学ぶ意欲

あると望ましい経験/スキル
• 業務プロセスの可視化、マニュアル作成、運用フローの構築経験
• ERPシステム（SAP等）の利用経験

PayPayが求める人物像
• PayPay 5 sensesに当てはまる方

待遇・条件

雇用形態

勤務地

※所属組織のルールおよび業務指示に応じて出社対応頂きます。

勤務時間
• スーパーフレックス制（コアタイム無し）
• 原則：午前9時～午後5時45分（実働7時間45分＋休憩時間 1時間）

給与

• 経験、スキル、業績、貢献度に応じ当社規定により決定

ベネフィット

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The PeopleX Transformation Operations team is reinventing how People services are delivered at Robinhood. We’re moving HR Operations beyond transactional processing to full ownership of the employee lifecycle, using AI and automation to deliver consumer-grade experiences for every employee and manager! We work hand-in-hand with People COEs, People Systems, and Enterprise Technology to drive efficiency. We hold our employee experience to the same high bar Robinhood sets for its customers. Our team is high-performing, fast-moving, and wired to make an impact.

As PeopleX Transformation Manager, you will be the builder at the center of PeopleX’s AI agenda. You’ll coordinate the AI roadmap across People teams, lead the AI Front Door for PeopleX Operations, and design and ship the AI solutions that transform how HR Operations works. You’ll help define what AI-native HR Operations looks like at a company built on technology, with the mandate to set the strategy and the skills to build it. This role requires technical depth, sound judgment, and the drive to move from idea to production in a space where the playbook is still being written.

This role is based in our Chicago, IL, Menlo Park, CA, or New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

• Lead coordination of the PX AI roadmap across People teams — prioritizing use cases by impact, feasibility and risk, and aligning investments into one cohesive strategy in partnership with PX’s AI strategy lead
• Own the AI Front Door for PX Operations — enabling employees, managers, and contractors to get answers and complete HR transactions from request to resolution , with intelligent routing when human support is needed
• Design and build AI agents, automated workflows, and hands-on knowledge solutions across Workday, ServiceNow and the broader PX tech stack
• Partner with People Systems and Enterprise Technology to define requirements, shape platform decisions, and deliver solutions at scale
• Reimagine HR Operations processes across the employee lifecycle — redesigning before automating, so work flows seamlessly from start to finish

• Define success metrics and report measurable impact on efficiency, quality, and employee experience

• 8+ years of experience in HR operations, HR technology or People transformation, including significant time leading technical programs across People, Systems, and Technology teams
• Deep understanding of HR operations and the employee lifecycle, with experience redesigning processes and service delivery models at scale
• Proven track record designing, building and deploying AI solutions in production — agents, LLM-based assistants or intelligent automation — with measurable business impact

jobs.description:

The Capacity Efficiency Engineering team builds the software that manages, governs, and reduces Robinhood's AWS cloud spend across compute, databases, and storage, operating at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and FinOps. We own the full lifecycle of cloud cost, from attribution and forecasting to automation that rightsizes infrastructure at fleet scale and keeps a bursty, latency-sensitive trading platform both reliable and cost-effective. Our work carries CEO-level visibility, has already driven millions of dollars in annualized savings, and is delivered in close partnership with Infrastructure, Finance, and product engineering teams across Robinhood.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will own capacity and efficiency for Robinhood's storage and database fleet, from Aurora clusters to S3 and the caches and volumes in between. You will build the systems that size this fleet to demand: Aurora reader counts and writer sizes set from market hours, declared events, and live load instead of fixed schedules; databases, caches, and volumes rightsized to what they actually use; and S3 data kept in the right storage class, with lifecycle rules that keep growth in check. You will take each from recommendations the Storage team validates to automation that safely applies its own changes in production. This is a 0-to-1 build with measurable impact on reliability at market peaks and on the AWS bill.

 

This role is based in our Bellevue, WA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do
• Build forecast-driven capacity planning for the storage and database fleet, turning traffic history, load tests, and known events (market open, earnings, IPOs, promotions) into plans that scale up ahead and back down after, with an expiry on every temporary capacity hold
• Design and build a capacity planner for Aurora that sets reader counts and writer instance sizes from demand and load signals (IOPS, CPU, connections, replica lag), replacing fixed scaling schedules
• Rightsize databases, caches, and block storage (RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, EBS) on instance size, provisioned IOPS and throughput, and idle capacity, and keep them right-sized as load changes
• Own S3 efficiency at scale: storage class and Intelligent-Tiering strategy, lifecycle and retention policies, noncurrent versions and incomplete uploads, and request costs, using Storage Lens and inventory data
• Take every recommendation to closed-loop automation with guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback, in partnership with the Storage infrastructure team, handling constraints such as AWS capacity shortages, fallback instance types, and connection pooling
• Measure outcomes in cost and reliability (savings against baseline, forecast error, utilization, capacity left behind after events) and share our forecasts with the pod rightsizing system so compute and storage scale together

What you bring
• Deep hands-on experience operating AWS storage and databases at scale, especially Aurora or RDS (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and S3, including replication, read scaling, storage classes, and lifecycle management
• Capacity planning and forecasting

experience:

modeling time-series demand, load testing, and translating traffic into instance counts, sizes, and storage growth
• A track record of rightsizing infrastructure from utilization data (CPU, memory, IOPS, throughput, bytes stored) without hurting latency or availability
• Strong Python or Go engineering, with experience building automation that safely modifies production infrastructure (guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback built in), not just systems that observe and report
• Familiarity with AWS storage and database pricing (S3 storage classes and requests, Aurora I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Reserved Instances) is a strong plus
• Experience with bursty, event-driven workloads (trading, payments, ticketing) or with Spark, Airflow, or Kubernetes is a plus

About the team:

Ongoing Monitoring sits in our first line of defence (1LOD) operations’ department, responsible for monitoring the activity of our SME customers (‘members’) for the purpose of preventing, detecting and reporting sanctions, money laundering, terrorism financing, tax evasion, bribery and corruption, money mules and fraud. 

It's an opportunity to work with an amazing team across multiple geographies, including analysts, team leaders, product and engineering managers, data scientists and operations managers. The role has exposure to many senior stakeholders across the business and is at the heart of what we do to protect our customers.

What we’re looking for: 

Here at Tide, we are looking for someone who
• has a good understanding of Financial Crime Typologies including money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and sanctions evasion, bribery, tax evasion, and suspicious activities reporting.
• is passionate and proactive, who will help ensure Tide is taking all relevant steps to detect and prevent all aspects of financial crime.
• understands financial crime in a global financial set up with specific focus towards UK and Europe Geography.
• has exceptional communication skills in English (both Written and Speaking).
• can use expert judgement to recommend if a case warrants filing of a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) 

This role is a key element of our ongoing monitoring team sitting within the first line of defence. You’ll be responsible for ensuring we put our genuine members first, through monitoring transaction types and behaviours across our customer base, whilst spotting and investigating potentially suspicious activity. 

As an Alert Review analyst you’ll be performing tasks related to the following

Transaction Monitoring Alert Review Analysis:
• Monitor and investigate alerts generated by automated transaction monitoring and sanctions screening systems.
• Conduct comprehensive, risk-based reviews of customer accounts and transaction histories to identify suspicious patterns or activities that deviate from a customer's normal behavior.
• Synthesize information from various sources, including customer profiles (KYC/CDD), public records, adverse media, and internal data.
• Assess the transactional activity in the context of financial crime typologies across a variety of payment types and financial products offered.
• Draft a concise, yet comprehensive report on findings prior to discounting the alert or reporting suspicious activity.
• Contact the member (customer) via email, chat or by phone to seek additional contextual information without tipping off.
• Contact representatives of partner banks via emails in cases where a fin crime investigation is required on Tide’s member

Suspicious Activity Reporting (SAR) Recommendations:
• Draft and present detailed, well-reasoned SAR recommendations to experts responsible for filing SARs to regulatory authorities.
• Construct a clear, concise, and defensible narrative outlining the suspicious activity, the investigative steps taken, and the rationale for the recommendation.
• Ensure all supporting documentation and evidence is accurately compiled and included in the case file for audit purposes.

Sanctions Screening:
• Analyze potential sanctions hits against international lists (e.g., OFAC, EU, UN, HMT) for cross border payment transactions.
• Apply a risk-based approach to differentiate between a true match and a false positive based on criteria like phonetic similarities, aliases, and supporting data.
• Escalate confirmed sanctions hits to management immediately for asset blocking or reporting.

Other tasks as part of the role
• Gain in-depth understanding of the technology and tools that aid in the alert review and analysis.
• Proactively calling out potential efficiencies in our tools and processes used for transaction analysis
• Managing your own case load to meet performance targets (Productivity, Quality and Customer experience)
• Participate in internal and external training programs related to fraud offences detection and prevention and other subjects that may form part of the day-to-day work requirements.
• Treating Tide members fairly by taking responsibility to ensure that their needs are met
• Make recommendations for process improvements to prevent future occurrences of fraud
• Establishing good relationships with various departments throughout the organisation to ensure good operational synergy
• Participate in internal and external training programs related to fraud offences detection and prevention and other subjects that may form part of the day-to-day work requirements.
• Treating Tide members fairly by taking responsibility to ensure that their needs are met

What makes you a great fit: 

You are open to flexible shift timings and patterns, it will be five days working with two days off not necessarily weekends.
• You have 2 to 4+ years of experience in a Transaction monitoring, Financial Crime risk related role in financial services
• You have a keen eye for process improvements, looking how we can work leaner and more robustly.
• You have an analytical mind and are able to digest large data sets and spot patterns and trends with ease
• You have exceptional communication skills, written and verbal. Are able to communicate with our members (including via telephone) , internal stakeholders regulatory bodies if required
• You have C1/C2 level of spoken and written English

What you get in return:
• Group Life Insurance
• 27 days holiday
• 3 days for L D or volunteering time off per year
• We invest in your development with a professional L D budget per year
• Snacks, light food, drinks in the office

THE ROLE:

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.

You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.

As Director of Engineering, KYX you will
• Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines.
• Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius.
• Own KYX Scoring ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring.
• Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework.
• Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access.
• Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member.
• Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
• Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain.
• Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation.
• Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live.
• Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions,
• Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality.
• Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap.
• Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus.

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
• Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
• Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
• Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
• Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
• Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts
• Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.

• Volunteering Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
• Learning Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
• WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
• Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
• Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
• Snacks Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.

• Escalating with judgement: identifying and escalating material control weaknesses and emerging financial crime risks in line with governance protocols, with practical recommendations.
• Driving remediation: taking ownership of audit and compliance monitoring actions through to closure.
• Bridging first and second line: acting as the primary senior liaison between first line operations and the Compliance function, maintaining clear ownership boundaries and a constructive working relationship.
• Ensuring regulatory compliance: across EU and national requirements, including BaFin, ACPR, CSSF, Bank of Spain and Bank of Italy.

• A track record of owning financial crime controls, not just operating them, with the ability to evidence their effectiveness through MI, QA and assurance testing

• Strong analytical and written communication skills, including preparing materials for regulators and senior management

• Set the architectural direction for Tide’s credit platform: scalable, resilient, compliant, and built to launch in new markets quickly.
• Lead the design and delivery of lending products that are fast, reliable and safe for members to use.
• Work with Product, Risk, Compliance and the business to turn the credit roadmap into shipped outcomes.

• Stay close to the code. Get involved in architecture, design and the hard engineering calls.
• Champion engineering fundamentals (system design, security, quality) and AI-native ways of working.
• Mentor engineers and Engineering Managers, building a culture of ownership and learning.
