• Deep experience designing and running microservices, event-driven and distributed systems that are scalable, resilient, fault-tolerant and loosely coupled.
• Track record of embedding AI tooling and LLMs into how engineering teams build, review and ship, with measurable gains in velocity and quality.
• Experience building in regulated environments, where compliance is a design constraint rather than an afterthought.
• Experience launching and scaling products across multiple jurisdictions, with differing regulation, partners and customer needs.
• Breadth of technical knowledge with depth in at least one stack. Experience with ours isn’t essential, but the ability to quickly understand and lead in a new environment is critical.
• Proven track record of delivering complex systems and third-party integrations.
• Ability to translate business goals into a clear technical roadmap and explain the rationale behind technical decisions.
• Strong mentoring skills and the ability to build and inspire high-performing engineering teams.

• Java 17, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices
• Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
• Primary datastores are MySQL and PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
• Docker, Terraform, EKS/Kubernetes used by the Cloud team to run the platform
• DataDog, ElasticSearch/Fluentd/Kibana and Rollbar to keep it running
• GitHub with GitHub actions for Sonarcloud, Snyk and solid JUnit/Pact testing to power the CI/CD pipelines (new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first 2 weeks)

• Direct experience with the CSSF, and a clear understanding of Luxembourg expectations on local substance

The Data Platform Engineering team builds the platform that Tide's data producers and consumers rely on: backend engineers, data engineers, data scientists and, increasingly, AI agents. We own how data is produced, moved, stored, modelled, governed and served across the UK, EU and India, on GCP with BigQuery at the core.

Our mission is to make the right way the easy way: self-service capabilities with quality, security and cost controls built into the infrastructure, judged by whether teams choose to adopt them, not whether we mandate them.

In this role you will

• Apply governance in what you build: residency, PII masking, least-privilege and just-in-time access, retention and erasure, and lineage.
• Set SLOs, freshness and quality checks, and alerting that tells on-call what matters.
• Find the main cost drivers in data platforms and pipelines, and add guardrails and attribution that teams can act on.
• Break work into phases that ship, with clear milestones, a migration path and a way to measure adoption.
• Use AI-assisted development to build and run the platform faster, and help prepare governed, well-described data that agents can use safely.
• Treat internal engineers as customers: write clear documentation and golden paths, and act on their feedback.

• Solid data engineering fundamentals: batch and streaming ingestion, CDC and event-driven patterns, data modelling, and correctness (idempotency, ordering, late data, backfill).
• Strong production engineering in Python and SQL, including building and operating APIs, pipelines or shared libraries.
• Practical infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and CI/CD for data and infrastructure, including IAM across environments.
• Working knowledge of data governance in practice: PII masking, access control, residency, retention and lineage.
• Observability for data pipelines: freshness and quality checks, SLOs, alert thresholds and incident response.
• The ability to justify technology choices against requirements, with an order-of-magnitude view of cost and capacity.
• Hands-on use of AI-assisted development with sound engineering judgement. Experience enabling AI tooling for engineering teams is highly preferred.
• Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to explain trade-offs to engineers and non-engineers across teams and time zones.
• Nice to have:

experience with global, decentralised teams, and in financial services or other regulated environments.

You do not need to match every tool below. Comparable cloud and data tooling experience is welcome.

ABOUT

THE ROLE:

You’ll make the key design decisions, keep the platforms secure, well governed and documented, and drive improvements from design through to rollout. The major platforms in scope are:
• • Google Workspace: identity and access policies, DLP, email security and ChromeOS management
• Netskope (SSE/SASE): SWG, CASB, DLP and ZTNA
• Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune: zero-touch provisioning, compliance, patching and encryption for the Mac and Windows fleet

• Build monitoring, reporting and operational health metrics for workplace platforms, using APIs and automation to identify configuration drift, failures, capacity issues and emerging operational risks before they become incidents.
• Own technical design and architecture decisions for Workplace Technology, including platform standards, technical debt, vendor evaluation, proof of concepts, migration strategy and lifecycle planning.
• Act as L3 escalation for complex incidents, carry out root-cause analysis, and turn what we learn into lasting fixes.
• Support audit and compliance work (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, FCA and DORA requirements) with evidence, controls and documentation.
• Mentor engineers and service desk colleagues, raise the team's technical bar, and write the runbooks and Confluence documentation that let others work independently.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
• Extensive experience with CaC (Configuration as Code) on SaaS platforms.
• Confident scripting in Python, Bash and PowerShell, and comfort working with REST APIs.
• 7+ years in IT or workplace engineering, including at least 3 years at senior level in a cloud-native, SaaS-first organisation of 1,000+ users.
• Deep hands-on Google Workspace administration at enterprise scale, including automation with GAM/GAMADV-XTD3, the Admin SDK APIs or Apps Script.
• Production experience designing and running Netskope or a comparable SSE/SASE platform (Zscaler, Prisma Access, Cloudflare One), including ZTNA and DLP.
• Strong experience with both Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune, running a mixed Mac and Windows fleet end to end.
• Solid grasp of identity and access: SAML, OIDC, SCIM, MFA, conditional access and device trust.
• Clear, confident communication with engineers, stakeholders and non-technical users alike.

Nice to have:
• Admin-level experience with Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, including JSM automation and Assets.
• Experience in fintech or regulated financial services (FCA, DORA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2).
• Working knowledge of GCP and AWS, particularly IAM and networking relevant to ZTNA.
• Relevant certifications (Google Workspace Administrator, Jamf 300/400, Netskope NSK200/300, MD-102, Atlassian ACP).

OUR TECH STACK:
• Google Workspace and Google Cloud Platform
• Netskope (SSE/SASE)
• Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune
• Mac, Windows and ChromeOS endpoints
• Okta
• C1
• Cisco Meraki
• Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management

jobs.title: Presentation Designer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced designer with strong presentation design skills (Figma/Google Slides) to join our in-house Brand and Creative team in London. You’ll bring order and craft to presentations and comms across Wise, building on-brand, scalable systems that elevate every team’s output — with the confidence to train nondesigners to use what you build, and to work closely with senior and C-suite stakeholders under pressure during peak periods.

The ideal candidate is an organised self-starter with at least 4 years of experience in similar in-house teams or branding agencies. We’re looking for a designer with strong craft, communication skills, attention to detail, and a positive, eager-to-learn attitude.

Your mission

Wise exists to build money without borders. Over a decade ago, we challenged the way the world moves money – cutting out hidden fees and making international finance simpler and fairer. Today, we help millions of people and businesses send, spend and manage money across countries with ease, making money simple, accessible and smart for everyone, everywhere.

The Brand and Creative team is made up of 25+ designers, motion designers, copywriters, strategists and creative ops managers based in London and Singapore. Our mission is to bring Wise’s story to life with clarity and creative excellence across every touchpoint. We work to ensure Wise is recognised and trusted worldwide, helping people and businesses move money faster, cheaper, and more transparently.

What you’ll do

The majority of this role will focus on:
• Designing presentations that strengthen our brand internally (Figma and Google Slides). Create visually engaging presentations for internal events and meetings, turning complex information into clear, compelling stories.
• Creating and evolving our presentation templates and systems (Figma and Google Slides). Develop and roll out easy-to-use templates and tools that empower colleagues across Wise to create consistent, on-brand work independently.

You’ll also:
• Design major company-wide events and conferences throughout the year. Collaborate with internal teams on presentations, event branding, signage, and print and digital communications—often with fast turnarounds.
• Work closely with senior stakeholders. Ask the right questions and simplify complex business and product updates, shaping them into impactful presentations for company-wide audiences.
• Support our workplace experience. Partner with the Workplace team to create signage, uniforms, and other branded materials for our offices.
• Provide design support for reports (InDesign). Create polished, on-brand reports and review materials using InDesign when needed.
• Use AI tools to accelerate your workflow. We’re actively incorporating AI into the way our team works, so you should be curious, comfortable experimenting, and keen to find smarter ways of working.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Develop: You’ll be working with a talented and passionate bunch of designers, copywriters and animators. We’re a feedback friendly organisation and you’ll have loads of opportunities to learn and be challenged.
• Bring clarity: You’ll turn complexity into clear, confident narratives, working with senior and C-suite stakeholders
• Have impact: You’ll join our exciting mission to build money without borders and show people that Wise is the smartest way to manage their international money.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst - Grow  - Scalable Platform
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

You’ll be joining the Grow Squad. We manage a complex, multi-product portfolio including Current Accounts, Savings, Investments, and Digital Assets. While other teams focus on acquiring customers, your mission is to ensure we serve them safely, sustainably, and profitably.

 

What You Will Do
1. Work with the Scalable Platform product team
• Scalable platform team is responsible for identifying risks to the Grow squad in the domains of Financial, Regulatory and Operational risks. Examples of these are:
• Liquidity supply and cost,
• defining regulatory requirement for our products,
• and scaling operations to serve our product and customers efficiently
• Building controls and assurance monitoring to ensure risks are sustainably managed
2. Strategy & Governance
• Stakeholder Partnership: You will be the primary data partner for Wise’s Scalable Platform product team giving them the confidence that the Grow squad is operating within safe limits.

jobs.title: Senior Presales Consultant
jobs.description:
We’ll look to you to help drive our growth objectives while consulting closely with our product, sales, and delivery teams to design solutions that we can deliver efficiently and with quality.

As a Senior Presales Consultant, your success will be driven by an ability to understand customer requirements, showcase the Wise Platform value proposition, and earn the trust of key decision-makers.

Experience in Payments or Cross Border Payments is essential.

You will apply your expertise and product knowledge to design scalable payment solutions for our prospective partners, becoming a trusted advisor to the partner and able to influence the agreed solution to ensure it meets the partner’s and our needs. This will require you to work cross-functionally to build strategies to successfully navigate complex sales cycles, deliver product demos, and lead compelling solution presentations. You’ll go deep on the partner’s requirements in order to extract as much information as possible from the partner while analysing the impact of your suggested solution on our internal teams who will take the project through to launch.

You should be equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, winning trust from both executive, compliance and engineering stakeholders.

Your mission:
• You will present our products and vision to executives & technical teams at banks and strategic enterprise partners. Become their trusted advisor.
• You will be accountable to drive revenue alongside the business development team, being a key stakeholder in the sales process from discovery and solution design through to implementation kickoff.
• You will utilise a deep understanding of Wise Platform products and the payments domain to tailor solutions for partners, finding a match between our technology and their requirements.
• You will work on sales collateral, demos, proof of concepts, RFPs, and any other material to help get potential deals over the line.
• You will ensure the viability of solutions by testing and documenting an end to end solution.
• You will share customer feedback to the product teams in Wise Platform to drive roadmaps in order to create more opportunities for growth.

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Scope and design payments partnerships with the world’s biggest banks and enterprises.
• Work with a newly formed Embedded Finance sales team to grow Wise Platform’s presence in this area in EMEA
• Act as the voice of our customers to influence roadmaps and feature prioritisation, continuously improving Wise Platforms’ products and positioning in the market.
• Travel to work with our teams and meet with prospects around the world.

jobs.title: Regional CRM Manager
jobs.description:
The CRM team is a diverse and inclusive crew of problem solvers from all over the world. We form long-term customer relationships through best-in-class communications - so more customers use Wise more often for their international money needs, stay with us longer, and advocate for us sooner. We place the customer at the heart of everything we do so they look forward to our communications because they’ll either be entertained, learn something new or find out about a useful product, service or promotion. 

The team is structured into a Global team centered around our four main customer actions—Send, Hold, Receive, Spend & Grow, and a Regional team split by our key markets in the UK, Europe, North America, Latin America & APAC. So you’ll join a team of CRM specialists identifying regional opportunities to drive product adoption and improve retention, ensuring our lifecycle and adhoc comms are relevant and drive real impact in the UK and Europe.

The Role

We're seeking a versatile CRM Manager in London to help us drive our global B2C lifecycle communications strategy and implementation for the UK & Europe markets. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to shape and execute innovative campaigns, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and make a tangible impact on our customers' experience.
• Develop and manage our UK & Europe CRM strategy, including customer lifecycle management, segmentation and engagement initiatives
• Utilise data and insights to segment customers effectively and tailor communications for maximum relevance and impact
• Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Creative, Engineering & Analytics teams to ensure alignment and seamless execution across multiple channels (email, push notifications, in-product messages)
• Manage internal stakeholder communication and collaboration across various departments
• Design and implement effective customer lifecycle management strategies to drive long-term engagement and loyalty through continuous optimisation
• Analyse campaign performance and use data to identify and implement opportunities for increasing engagement and conversion rates at all stages of the customer’s lifecycle journey
• Ensure compliance with CRM best practices and regulatory requirements while maintaining database health and retention efforts.
• Implement the localisation process for Wise’s international campaigns
• Oversee email calendar management, deliverability, and monthly reporting.

jobs.title: Senior CRM Manager - Advocacy
jobs.description:
We’re all about bringing value to our customers who deserve first-class communications so they make the most of their Wise account.

We’re building money without borders for people and businesses and we need your help to make our Global customer comms best-in-class.

So we’re looking for a Senior CRM Manager to join our CRM team and independently lead, own, and drive CRM strategy and implementation across Invite and Pricing, with a focus on driving commercial growth through referrals and price leadership. 

The Senior CRM Manager will own how we bring Wise’s price advantage to life through CRM — helping customers understand the value they get from Wise and using that value as a railway to advocacy and referrals.

Alongside this, you’ll own and evolve our Invite CRM strategy, identifying the right customer moments, propositions and incentives to encourage more customers to recommend Wise.

Ultimately, your role is to connect price leadership and referrals: demonstrating Wise’s value in ways that help more customers choose Wise, use Wise and recommend Wise to others.

The role will be based in London and will deliver best-in-class customer communications. The role will report into the London CRM team and follow the processes and practices agreed within the CRM team.

CRM at Wise is about making sure we develop the best global and regional lifecycle communications as well as keeping up with demand from other sides of the business.

We’re problem solvers - we work with our Product, Marketing Tech, Analytics, UX Research and Product Marketing teams to define and execute the strategy for product and marketing customer comms, across multiple channels (email, push notifications, in-app messages).

This role requires someone who can not only participate in these wider conversations but also proactively drive their area to achieve significant impact.

Your Mission:
• As an individual contributor, you will excel in both strategic planning and some hands-on execution across our Invite and Pricing plans through CRM channels.
• Develop and independently manage our Invite CRM strategy, including customer lifecycle management, segmentation, incentives and engagement initiatives.
• Own the CRM strategy for Pricing, ensuring customers understand the value they receive from choosing Wise.
• Use price leadership as a railway to referrals, connecting customers’ experience of Wise’s value with advocacy: helping customers recognise the value they receive and giving them compelling reasons and moments to recommend Wise to others.
• Manage internal technical and non-technical stakeholder communication (Product Managers, UX Researchers, Designers, Copywriters, Engineers, Analysts, etc.) effectively influencing and aligning diverse teams.
• Utilise data-driven insights to segment our customers effectively, ensuring that each segment receives tailored and relevant communication and offerings.
• Design and independently manage effective customer lifecycle management strategies to drive long-term engagement and loyalty through continuous optimisation.
• Analyse campaign performance and use data and insights to identify and implement opportunities for increasing engagement and conversion rates at all stages of the customer’s lifecycle journey always with an eye on measurable impact.
• Manage the customer database health with a focus on retention and engagement: make sure all comms are in line with CRM best practices, compliance requirements, through appropriate channels and without errors.
• Responsible for email calendar management, deliverability and monthly reporting.
• Implement the localisation process for Wise’s international campaigns
• Maintain and implement a clear A/B testing plan.

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist (English speaking)
jobs.description:
Here’s how you’ll be contributing to the Customer Support team:
• Expert problem solving: Take full ownership of complex customer cases, using critical thinking to identify the best resolutions and delivering with high accuracy.
• Navigating complex interactions: Handle high-stakes customer conversations with professional and empathetic communication, especially during challenging moments.
• Cross-Team collaboration: Manage appropriate escalations to specialized teams, including KYC, Complaints, and Payment Operations, to ensure holistic case resolution.
• Peer support: Act as a point of contact for your colleagues, providing peer-to-peer support and sharing your knowledge to help the wider team grow.
• Process improvement: Identify and share feedback on processes and product health, contributing to the continuous improvement of the customer journey.
• Flexibility: Cover a variety of shifts to be there when our customers—and the business—need you most.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Risk Intelligence Platform
jobs.description:
Wise moves billions every year for millions of people and businesses across multiple countries and currencies. At that scale, financial crime is constantly evolving — from scams and account takeovers to money laundering and mule networks. Staying ahead of these threats means our automated controls and machine learning models need high-quality, timely insights.

The Risk Intelligence Platform team, part of Risk Machine Learning, builds the tools and automation that help Wise's FinCrime teams develop and improve those models. Our work covers areas such as model experimentation, bias and fairness, automated training-set maintenance, and threshold analysis.

Our main users are Data Scientists and Product Managers across Fraud Prevention, AML and Sanctions. We build the platform and tooling that removes repetitive Engineering work and enables these teams to focus on what matters most: identifying and preventing financial crime effectively at scale.

As part of the team, you'll work at the intersection of Backend Engineering, data and machine learning, solving complex Engineering problems that directly support Wise's FinCrime prevention capabilities.

jobs.title: Internal Audit Senior Manager (Fincrime)
jobs.description:
Are you a Financial Crime assurance leader looking to move away from legacy, manual audit routines and build data-driven, tech-enabled audit practices?

We are looking for an Internal Audit Senior Manager (FinCrime) to join our growing EU Internal Audit team in Brussels. In this role, you won't just run audits, you will directly shape how Internal Audit operates at Wise globally.

You will lead complex FinCrime audit engagements, manage internal and external partner teams, and influence key stakeholders across governance, risk, and control functions.

If you thrive in a fast-paced fintech setting where technology, continuous monitoring, and autonomy take centre stage, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Be Doing (Your Mission)
• Automate & Innovate: Advance our internal audit framework by developing continuous monitoring tools and automated audit routines.
• Shape Strategy: Drive the annual audit plan—defining the audit universe, risk assessment models, and resource budgeting.
• Deliver High-Impact Audits: Lead end-to-end FinCrime audits per the annual plan, turning complex findings into actionable, business-critical insights.
• Align Assurance: Lead strategic cross-functional projects to create a unified, seamless assurance model across Wise.
• Build & Mentor: Empower and guide a high-performing, self-sufficient internal audit team.
• Track Real Progress: Oversee the implementation of audit recommendations and measure the real-world impact of control enhancements.

What We’re Looking For

We know great candidates don’t always tick every single box. If you hold strong assurance experience in financial services and a passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

Core Experience & Expertise
• FinCrime Specialisation: Deep expertise across key financial crime domains (FinCrime risk management, KYC/KYB, EDD, Transaction Monitoring, Screening, and Reporting). Experience with sanctions and financial crime models is a strong plus.
• Regulatory Context: Strong understanding of EU Money Laundering Directives, FATF, and Wolfsberg guidance.
• Assurance & Controls: Proven track record in risk, control, or internal audit roles within Fintech, Tech, or Financial Services.
• Data & Tech Drive: Enthusiasm for leveraging technology, data analytics, and continuous monitoring in audit workflows (hands-on data analytics experience preferred).
• Execution & Leadership: Demonstrated ability to scope audits, lead risk-based testing, manage cross-functional projects, and mentor junior team members.
• Communication: Ability to distill complex risk topics into concise, clear insights for stakeholders at all levels.

Qualifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)
• Relevant professional certification: CAMS, CFE, ICA (Diploma/Cert), or CIA (or equivalent practical experience).

Why Apply?
• Hybrid Working: Flexible balance between home and our Brussels office.
• Modern Fintech Culture: Less red tape, higher autonomy, and an emphasis on data-driven decision-making over manual paperwork.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Platform
jobs.description:
You are a Senior Software Engineer who will be joining the team of world class DevOps Engineers. The team maintains, supports and grows Wise’s Kubernetes based Compute Platform. Your mission will be to lead, design and implement automation around Kubernetes installation, maintenance and monitoring. That includes building microservices, API-s, workflows and documentation. You should be able to mentor your colleagues, lead projects and take ownership on initiatives.

Responsibilities:
• Drive Automation and Efficiency: Innovate and implement cutting-edge automation solutions at both the infrastructure (AWS) and application levels, reducing manual overhead, accelerating deployment cycles, and increasing system resilience.
• Architect and Enhance Our Platform: You will take ownership of significant system components, designing and implementing scalable solutions that handle complex operational loads with high reliability and security.
• Active Collaboration and Leadership: While you will be deeply involved in hands-on technical work, your role also entails leading projects and collaborating with cross-functional teams to share knowledge, mentor peers, and refine our engineering practices.
• Embrace and Extend Cloud-Native Practices: With ongoing investments in AWS and Kubernetes, you will have the opportunity to lead initiatives that expand our capabilities in the cloud-native landscape, from developing Kubernetes operators to enhancing our service mesh infrastructure.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I - Platform - Cloud Foundations
jobs.description:
About the role 

The Cloud Foundations team is responsible for building and maintaining the services that help ensure Wise’s cloud infrastructure meets all the necessary requirements for a growing FinTech business. To this end you will be working with us to develop tooling and provide hands-on technical expertise to design, deploy, and optimise our services in a compliant and cost-effective way on AWS and other major cloud providers.

How we work

We operate on a strong belief in automation, programmatic implementation, and reusable design. We’re looking for people who can step back and think holistically about the ecosystem, but also follow through and help implement the design; drawing on the resources across the rest of the platform tribe.

As we grow, managing our cloud platform becomes increasingly complex at scale. We need to sustain this growth by continuously iterating on the services we run, with a focus on availability, security, and ease of use. We’re looking for an engineer with relevant experience who can analyse complex requirements and deliver simple solutions to help our teams achieve our mission with speed and confidence. 

What will you be working on?
• Build, maintain, and support Wise’s cloud platform.
• Design and implement scalable and secure cloud infrastructure solutions.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and deliver effective outcomes.

What do you need?
• Experience designing, building, and deploying scalable cloud-based solution architectures, preferably on AWS and/or GCP
• Experience with IaC and automating infrastructure provisioning, developer operations, or continuous integration/deployment.
• Strong knowledge of Golang and/or Python
• Proficient in written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate concepts to users and stakeholders, as well as facilitate cross-team collaboration. 

Nice to Have
• Understanding of Kubernetes operator pattern
• Experience with networking within the cloud.
• Experience with one or more observability platforms.
• Knowledge of the financial services industry and/or other regulated industries.

You get back
• The ability to choose your own path to success – you’ll have the freedom to define the vision
• The freedom to have real impact
• The opportunity to inspire teams
• A fun work environment with social activities and events.

 

Interested? Find out more:
• How we work – a practical guide
• DEI @ Wise
• Wise Tech Stack (2025 update)
• See what it's like to work at Wise London!
• Our Engineering career map
• Wise Engineering – https://medium.com/wise-engineering

What do we offer:
• Starting salary: £87,500 - £111,000 + RSUs
• Wise Benefits

Interested in more than one role?

If you're interested in multiple roles, please apply for just one—the one you're most excited about. If you submit multiple applications requiring the same assessment, we'll continue your recruitment journey using your first application, and any duplicate applications will be automatically closed. This helps ensure a fair and consistent interview process. If another role feels like a better fit, you can discuss this with your recruiter during the process.

Expert, Information Security
jobs.location: Barcelona, Spain; Berlin, Berlin, Germany; București, Bucharest, Romania; Vienna, Vienna, Austria
jobs.description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission

As an Information Security Expert, you are a senior individual contributor who sets direction and solves the hardest GRC problems in a regulated fintech environment. You shape our security governance strategy, ensure our control framework remains effective as the business scales, and act as a key advisor to security leadership and senior business stakeholders on risk and compliance decisions. You’ll lead complex, high-impact initiatives (multi-entity, multi-region, regulator/customer-facing), influence across the organisation, and raise the bar for how we design, test, and evidence security controls.

 

What you’ll do
• GRC strategy roadmap: Define multi-year GRC roadmap aligned to business strategy, risk appetite, and regulatory expectations (e.g., DORA readiness, audit strategy, control maturity targets). Drive control framework evolution: rationalize controls, reduce duplication, and ensure proportionality based on criticality, data sensitivity, and business impact. Establish “north star” principles for governance (e.g., minimum control baselines, exception governance, evidence-by-design).
• Executive advisory decision support: Advise leadership on material risk decisions: risk acceptance, remediation prioritisation, control investments, and scope decisions. Produce executive-grade outputs: risk narratives, board/committee materials, and regulator/customer responses with defensible rationale. Facilitate senior stakeholder alignment when priorities conflict (delivery speed vs control rigor; cost vs assurance depth).
• Regulatory, audit assurance leadership (complex scope): Own strategy and approach for major audits/assurance activities (ISO 27001, SOC 2, regulatory examinations, key client due diligence), including scope, positioning, and negotiation. Lead responses to complex audit/regulatory issues: root-cause analysis, corrective action programs, and sustained effectiveness verification.
• Domain SME ownership (one or more, depending on needs): You may be the SME for one or more of: ISMS/ISO 27001 at scale (multi-entity scope, continuous compliance); DORA / operational resilience governance (control mapping, ICT risk integration, testing oversight); Third-party risk for critical ICT providers (oversight model, ongoing monitoring, exit/continuity governance); Security control assurance (testing program design, evidence standards, control health metrics).
• Enablement, standards mentorship: Set standards and reusable artifacts: control narratives, evidence templates, testing methodologies, and playbooks. Mentor specialists and associates; raise organisation-wide capability through coaching and review. Partner with Security Engineering/IT/Compliance to embed controls into workflows (policy-to-automation where possible).

Who you are
• Typically 7–10+ years of experience in information security GRC, audit/assurance, security risk, compliance, software engineering and/ or financial services risk roles.
• Demonstrated ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder GRC programs and successful navigation of audits/regulatory scrutiny.
• Deep working knowledge of ISO 27001, DORA and strong familiarity with adjacent frameworks (SOC 2, NIST CSF, BaIT, COBIT), including how to test and evidence controls.
• Strong technology risk understanding across cloud, IAM, SDLC governance, incident management, vulnerability management, logging/monitoring, crypto/fintech operational processes (as relevant).
• You are able to influence across the organisation and resolve conflicts with a risk-based, outcome-oriented approach.

 

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

The first use case is crypto-backed borrowing and lending in the Bitpanda app, with an eye to then build more sophisticated products and use cases leveraging tokenized commodities, securities, funds, and structured products. You’ll decide which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, and work collaboratively to bring DeFi to Bitpanda customers in a way that feels as simple as the app they already trust. You'll work in a small, senior team with our smart contract engineers and Bitpanda's Legal, Compliance and Risk teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product.

 

What you’ll do
• Design and run the lending markets: set loan-to-value and liquidation thresholds, interest rate curves, caps, and oracles, while also owning monitoring and incident playbooks.
• Bring liquidity and users to permissioned markets and assets: set supply targets, bring in euro liquidity from stablecoin issuers, institutional lenders, curated vaults and market makers, and work out how verified customers reach these markets, without paying for volume.
• Make sure the right DeFi infrastructure is in place, particularly for permissioned tokenized assets: DEX liquidity deep enough for swaps and liquidations, liquidators, oracles and the other building blocks the markets depend on.
• Shape what customers see, sign, and own in the Bitpanda app, including how liquidation and risk are explained, and measure real use: borrowers who come back, bad debt and revenue, not total value locked alone.
• Recommend which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, backed by a business case, and work with Legal, Compliance and Risk from day one on EU consumer credit rules and MiCA.

Who you are
• 6+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on building and scaling DeFi or crypto products.
• You know lending markets in depth: collateral and liquidation mechanics, interest rate models, oracles and how they fail, curation and bad debt. You're at home with the EVM and can read Solidity smart contract code well enough to question engineers about it.
• Demonstrated experience bringing DeFi applications into regulated consumer products and successfully bridging the gap between decentralized and centralized finance.
• Ability to lead through influence, build clear business cases, and write excellent documentation in English. This includes a strong working knowledge of EU crypto regulations (e.g., MiCA) to effectively partner with Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams.

• hands-on experience scaling onchain ecosystem liquidity from scratch
• knowledge of and/or work experience in traditional financial markets

jobs.title: Senior Design Recruiter
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Recruiting at Brex

Recruiting is where every career at Brex begins. We are the first point of connection for future builders and leaders, helping candidates see what is possible. We partner with leaders across the company to find exceptional talent and build high-performing teams. We move quickly, think strategically, and take pride in a thoughtful, welcoming candidate experience from the first contact. We shape the culture at Brex by hiring the designers who define how our products look, feel and function.

What you'll do

This role is responsible for partnering with hiring managers and design leadership to define team needs and role requirements, ensuring alignment on hiring goals across Product Design, Brand Design, and Design Leadership.

You’ll source, engage, and assess world-class design talent through diverse channels, while managing the full recruitment lifecycle from outreach to onboarding. You will develop strategies to attract and retain diverse design talent, proactively building pipelines for both immediate and long-term hiring needs.

You’ll track and analyze key hiring metrics to improve recruiting effectiveness, collaborate cross-functionally to ensure fair and consistent evaluation practices, and champion Brex’s employer brand within the design community. This includes representing Brex at design events, portfolio reviews, and on relevant social platforms

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Responsibilities
• Lead sourcing and outreach for design roles, using recruiting platforms, creative communities, portfolio sites and social networks.
• Recruit across Product Design, Brand/Visual Design and Design Leadership.
• Screen and evaluate portfolios, craft quality, systems thinking and collaboration skills.
• Partner with design leaders to calibrate on craft standards, hiring bar and team composition.
• Coordinate and facilitate interview processes, including portfolio reviews and design exercises, with a high-quality candidate experience.
• Give hiring managers and stakeholders regular updates on pipeline health and progress.
• Keep candidate data accurate in recruiting systems and dashboards.
• Contribute to continuous improvement of recruiting processes, inclusive hiring and candidate experience.
• Help shape and promote Brex's design employer brand.

Requirements
• Proven experience recruiting for design roles (Product Design and Brand Design) in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
• Strong sourcing skills and familiarity with AI tools, recruiting platforms and creative talent networks.
• Ability to assess design portfolios and understand craft, systems thinking and user-centered methods.
• Excellent communication, relationship-building and stakeholder management.
• Data-driven mindset: interprets recruiting metrics and drives process improvements.
• Manages multiple searches and priorities at once.

Bonus points
• Experience recruiting design leaders or building design teams from the ground up.
• Familiarity with compensation strategy and market analysis for design roles.
• Employer branding or talent marketing experience focused on the design community.
• Hiring across multiple geographies (US, Canada, LATAM).

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $126,550 - $158,200. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you'll do
Brex's AI strategy has three pillars: Product AI builds AI into the products our customers use, Corporate AI gives every employee AI tools to work faster, and Operational AI builds the AI that runs the company. The Operational AI team owns the AI systems and internal platforms that make Brex's operations AI-native, from onboarding and KYC automation to AI-powered customer support. We're a small team with a large surface area, and our work directly shapes how fast Brex can onboard, serve, and grow its customers.
As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you'll focus on Agents Platform, Brex's internal platform for building, evaluating, and running AI agents in production. It already powers critical automations in customer onboarding and AI tools for our sales and customer success teams. You'll own its technical direction, help it evolve from simple workflows into agents that take action, and make it the default way Brex ships AI into its operations.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our São Paulo office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week: Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Responsibilities
• Own the technical direction and roadmap of Agents Platform, partnering with Operational AI leadership and the teams that build on it to decide what the platform should do next.
• Design and build new platform capabilities, including tool calling, multi-step agent loops, multi-turn and conversational execution, and secure access to internal Brex data and services.
• Evolve the evaluation and quality system, from datasets and labeling to run comparison and regression testing, so teams can measure and improve non-deterministic systems with production-grade rigor.
• Strengthen the reliability, security, and observability of systems in business-critical flows like customer onboarding, including durable async and batch execution, authorization, cost attribution, and incident response.
• Partner with engineering, operations, and go-to-market teams to launch and scale high-impact agents, translating how they work into clear platform requirements.
• Drive adoption by making the platform easy to build on through clear contracts, paved roads, documentation, and AI-native developer workflows.
• Mentor engineers on the team and across Brex through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing, and help grow the team's technical bench.

Requirements
• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of designing, building, and operating reliable production backend systems.
• Deep, hands-on experience using AI coding tools like Claude Code or Cursor in your daily work, with the judgment to ship faster without lowering the quality bar.
• Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered systems to production, beyond prototypes: orchestrating model calls, enforcing structured outputs, and evaluating quality over time.
• Experience with distributed and asynchronous systems and the reliability concerns that come with them, such as retries, idempotency, backpressure, and observability.
• A platform mindset: you've built shared infrastructure, developer tooling, or paved roads that other engineers adopt, and you care about developer experience and secure-by-default design.
• High ownership and operational excellence, including on-call, incident response, and owning systems end to end.
• Strong written and verbal communication, and the judgment to prioritize across many internal customers, including non-engineers. English proficiency is required, as interviews will be conducted in English.

• Experience building eval frameworks, LLM gateways, or agent platforms used by other teams.
• Experience with Temporal or another durable workflow engine.
• Experience with service and agent authorization, such as RBAC, scoped credentials, or agents acting on behalf of users.
• Production experience with tool use, MCP, retrieval, or agentic loops.
• A background in ML engineering, MLOps, or data infrastructure.
• Experience in fintech or another regulated environment, where auditability and model governance matter.

jobs.title: [EU] Business Development Specialist, Poland
jobs.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

 

The Role

We’re looking for a Business Development Manager to grow Bybit EU’s presence in Poland and contribute to our wider European expansion. You’ll build and manage partnerships with local KOLs, affiliates, creators, crypto communities, and VIP networks—helping partners grow their audiences and delivering measurable results for Bybit.

Key Responsibilities
• Identify and approach potential KOLs, affiliates and crypto communities in Poland.
• Build and manage a strong partnership pipeline, from market mapping and outreach through negotiation, onboarding, and activation.
• Develop trusted relationships with existing partners and help them grow their communities and partnership performance.
• Create localized partnership plans and campaigns that support user acquisition, user activity, trading volume, and revenue growth.
• Monitor partner and campaign performance, assess ROI, and identify ways to improve results.
• Work with Marketing, Product, Compliance, and other internal teams to develop and deliver effective campaigns and partner initiatives.
• Use OSOP to create and manage Campaign 2.0 campaigns.

jobs.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Finance Specialist to join our team and report directly to the Finance Manager. You will help keep our finance operations accurate, timely and well controlled, with a focus on financial close, payments, staff expense claims, tax compliance and audit support.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys working through the details, resolving discrepancies and taking ownership of recurring finance processes. You will work with colleagues across the business and external advisers, while also supporting selected financial and regulatory reporting activities as the team grows.

 

What you’ll do

Financial close and accounting
• Support monthly, quarterly and annual close activities, including journal entries, accruals, prepayments, account reconciliations and balance-sheet schedules.
• Reconcile bank accounts, payment activity, vendor balances and other assigned accounts; investigate differences and follow through to resolution.
• Analyse account movements and unusual transactions, prepare supporting explanations, and escalate matters requiring accounting judgment.
• Maintain accurate accounting records and complete close tasks in line with agreed timelines and review procedures.
• Perform trade and wallet reconciliations as part of the month-end close, comparing trade-level raw data from the Big Data platform with records in NetSuite (NS), reconciling wallet activity and balances, and investigating and resolving any discrepancies with relevant teams.

 

Payments and staff claims
• Review payment requests, invoices and supporting documentation for accuracy, completeness and compliance with company policies.
• Prepare and coordinate payments through established approval workflows, maintaining appropriate controls and segregation of duties.
• Track payment status, resolve rejected or delayed payments, and respond to queries from internal teams and external parties.
• Review and process staff expense claims, including checking receipts, policy compliance, approvals and correct accounting treatment.
• Reconcile payments and expense reimbursements to bank statements and accounting records, and follow up on outstanding items.

 

Tax, regulatory reporting and audit support
• Prepare VAT reconciliations, return schedules and supporting documentation, working with the Finance Manager and external tax advisers as needed.
• Assist with the preparation of corporate tax returns, including gathering financial data, preparing supporting schedules, reconciling tax-related balances and responding to adviser queries.
• Flag uncertain or unusual tax treatments for review and help track applicable filing deadlines.
• Assist with selected financial and regulatory reporting activities, including data gathering, reconciliations, completeness checks and preparation of supporting schedules. The Finance Manager will review reporting outputs and matters requiring judgment before submission.
• Support statutory audits and other internal or external reviews by preparing schedules, gathering evidence, responding to information requests and tracking outstanding items.
• Maintain organised documentation and clear audit trails across accounting, payments, tax and reporting activities.

 

Process improvement and collaboration
• Partner with Finance, Operations and other teams to resolve accounting, invoice, payment and expense-claim issues.
• Identify recurring issues or manual steps and suggest practical improvements to workflows, controls and documentation.
• Support finance process or system changes, including testing and documenting their impact on day-to-day operations.

 

What we’re looking for
• A bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
• At least 3 years of relevant accounting or finance experience, including hands-on involvement in financial close and reconciliations.
• Experience with payment processing, staff expense claims and approval workflows.
• Practical exposure to VAT, corporate tax compliance or preparation of tax return supporting schedules.
• Strong attention to detail, sound organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
• Proficiency in Excel and experience using an accounting or ERP system.
• Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
• A proactive approach to resolving issues, with the judgment to know when to escalate.

 

Nice to have
• Experience in crypto, digital assets, fintech or financial services, particularly in an international or fast-growing business.
• Experience assisting with regulatory reporting or maintaining supporting evidence for regulatory submissions.
• Experience working with external auditors and tax advisers.
• Exposure to multi-entity accounting, cross-border payments or finance process automation.
• Progress towards an accounting qualification such as ACCA, CPA, CA or an equivalent.
• Professional working proficiency in Mandarin.

About the role

This role will play a critical role in shaping Chime’s corporate narrative and reputation as a public company. You'll shape the company’s major moments and how we show up with reporters, investors, policymakers, and corporate stakeholders across quarterly earnings, corporate announcements, executive engagements, and high-stakes issues. 

You're a sharp writer, strategic thinker, reliable partner that stays calm headed when things move fast. You think ahead, catch the details others miss, and can drive a workstream from idea to execution with little direction. You build trust with senior leaders, reporters, and cross-functional partners, and you're excited to grow into a broader role as the function grows.

You'll report to the Director of Corporate Communications and work closely with the rest of the Corporate Affairs team, along with Investor Relations, Legal, Finance, and Chime's leadership.

In this role, you can expect to
• Support our corporate announcements and financial communications: Drive communications for quarterly earnings and major company announcements, working with Corporate Affairs, Investor Relations, Legal, and Finance. You'll help shape the media strategy and own the press materials, briefing books, and outreach.
• Own the corporate narrative: Own our messaging source of truth and help drive how Chime's corporate story evolves. Make sure it shows up clearly and consistently across earnings, announcements, executive platforms, and our owned channels.

• Lead issues management: Own sensitive media inquiries from first triage to resolution. Recommend our response strategy, write statements and responsive materials, and bring together Legal, Risk, Security, and other partners through our issues and incident processes.
• Be our AI champion: Bring innovative, AI-first thinking to the whole communications team. Build and scale the tools and workflows that change how we work. Collaborate with Marketing to drive our broader answer engine optimization (AEO) work and ensure we show up where our stakeholders are looking for information.
• Keep the team running at a high level: Directly manage our agency partners, measure and report on the impact of our work, and keep leadership informed. You'll bring the project management discipline that keeps many workstreams moving at once.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 7+ years of experience in corporate, financial, or executive communications, in-house and/or at an agency. Experience in fintech, financial services, or consumer technology is a plus.

About the role

We are looking for a Product Security Manager to lead a team focused on cloud, application, and AI security within our Product Security organization.

This role is responsible for securing our cloud infrastructure, protecting applications, and enabling safe adoption of AI across our products and internal systems. You will work closely with engineering, product, and platform teams to ensure that Chime applications and systems are designed and operated securely.

While cloud and application security are core pillars of this role, AI security is an increasingly critical area of focus. You will help define how we safely leverage AI technologies while managing risks such as data exposure, misuse, and insecure integrations.

This role operates within a flexible POD model, requiring you and your team to move fluidly across security domains based on business priorities.

• Own the security posture of cloud infrastructure, application systems, and AI-enabled applications across product surfaces

• Define and execute strategy for securing cloud-native architectures and applications at scale
• Establish guardrails and secure design patterns for AI adoption, including safe integration of third-party and internal AI systems
• Identify and mitigate risks related to AI systems, including prompt injection, data leakage, and misuse of models or APIs
• Build scalable controls and automation around identity, access, encryption, and application security, including secure SDLC and vulnerability management processes
• Lead and support response efforts for security incidents related to cloud, application, and AI risks

To begin in this role, you have
• 5+ years of experience in security engineering, with significant experience in cloud and application security
• 2+ years of experience managing or leading security engineers
• Strong understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP), Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and modern infrastructure patterns
• Experience with industry tooling for SAST, DAST, SCA, WAF, and CNAPP
• Experience designing or securing applications that handle sensitive or regulated data

• Strong technical judgment and the ability to go deep in architecture and security discussions when needed
• Experience operating in fast-paced, product-driven environments with shifting priorities

We are hiring a Product Manager to join Chime’s Growth team, focused on Marketing Technology. You’ll sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Marketing, Analytics, and Data, building the platforms and capabilities that help Chime reach members with more relevant experiences and make smarter growth decisions.

This is a role for a PM who can move comfortably between growth strategy and the technical details underneath it. You’ll identify high-value opportunities, translate marketing and member needs into scalable product capabilities, and use data and experimentation to understand what actually drives incremental growth.

In this role, you can expect to
• Own product strategy and roadmap for marketing technology capabilities that support Chime’s growth.
• Partner closely with Marketing to understand growth opportunities and translate them into scalable product and platform capabilities.
• Work deeply with Engineering to define technical requirements, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and build reliable systems that can scale across channels and use cases.
• Partner with Analytics and Data to define success metrics, understand member behavior, and measure the incremental impact of product investments.
• Build and evolve capabilities across areas such as audience segmentation, lifecycle orchestration, personalization, experimentation, measurement, and marketing data activation.
• Develop hypotheses and experiments that help the team learn quickly, improve growth outcomes, and inform longer-term platform investments.
• Bring structure to ambiguous problems, balancing near-term growth opportunities with the foundational technology needed to unlock future growth.

jobs.title: Emerging Talent & Onboarding Program Manager
jobs.description:
Beginnings matter. Whether someone is starting their career or joining a new company, their early experiences shape how quickly they find their footing and how far they can go. A great beginning gives people the context, skills, and confidence to do their best work.

As our Emerging Talent Onboarding Program Manager, you’ll own that moment for nearly everyone who joins Mercury, across new hire onboarding, internships, and a new apprenticeship program. You’ll think as deeply about the experience people have as the systems behind the scenes that make it all work, and you’ll be a visible face of Mercury when people need support most. You’ll build programs that feel distinctly Mercury, using AI and your creativity to rethink how they work from the ground up.

*Mercury is a financial technology company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Here are some things you’ll do on the job:
• Run new hire onboarding. Own the program end to end: the learning arc, facilitator coordination, cohort communications, and feedback. Partner with People Operations on preboarding so the experience starts before day one and every new hire’s first weeks feel useful and welcoming.
• Launch our new apprenticeship program. Design and own program operations and the apprentice

experience:

cohort programming, exec exposure, check-ins at each rotation, and partnerships with host teams.
• Strengthen our internship program. Build on what teams already run with a shared company-wide experience for interns, including onboarding, community, regular check-ins, and a clear point of contact.
• Support managers and mentors. Give the people hosting new hires, interns, and apprentices clear expectations and the resources to do it well.
• Build the systems behind the programs. Use AI, automation, and tooling to reimagine what each program can do, keep quality high as hiring grows, and adapt as the technology evolves. Use feedback and data to see what’s working and improve it.
• Tell the story of emerging talent. Partner with Recruiting, People Operations, and leaders across Mercury to show how we invest in people early in their careers.

You should:
• Have 3–5 years of experience building and running programs, ideally in Learning Development, People programs, early-career talent, or onboarding.
• Be an excellent program manager. You turn ideas into plans, keep many moving pieces organized, and follow through from launch to iteration.
• Be a skilled facilitator. You’ve led sessions or trainings and can turn what people need to know into something they learn.
• Be hands-on with AI. You experiment with new tools, know when they help, and use them to rethink what our programs can do.
• Think in systems. You spot themes across pain points, trace them back to how the program is designed, and solve them systematically.
• Be creative and comfortable with ambiguity. Some programs are established, some are new, and you’re energized by figuring out what fits Mercury.
• Be a clear, warm communicator. You can welcome someone on day one, run a room, and write a crisp message. You own the details, ask good questions, and stay open to changing your mind.

Experience with early-career, university, internship, apprenticeship, or employee onboarding programs is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Group Creative Director - Brand Narrative
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.description:
In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront. Over the next nine minutes, Powers of Ten traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into the microscopic world inside a human hand. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together. 

That’s the kind of creative thinking we’re looking for at Mercury: finding a compelling idea inside something complex, then bringing together the people and crafts that make it unforgettable.

We’re looking for a Group Creative Director to build and lead Brand Narrative, a new team within Brand Creative. You’ll turn company strategy, product truths, customer insight, and cultural observations into original concepts for our most important launches, campaigns, and brand moments. You’ll originate ideas yourself and stay closely involved as they become finished work.

Your background might be in art direction, design, or copywriting. What matters is your ability to develop exceptional concepts, recognize the best idea wherever it comes from, and bring the whole creative studio together to make it real. Whatever your starting discipline, you’ll bring deep experience in film-led storytelling.

You’ll lead Brand Narrative in close creative partnership with your peers leading Brand Design and Writing. Together, you’ll shape concepts, language, and visual expression from the beginning, bringing distinct perspectives and shared ownership to the work. You’ll contribute strong ideas of your own, invite others to challenge and improve them, and build on theirs. This is a role for someone who enjoys making work together, not developing ideas in isolation and handing them off.

You’ll also shape what Brand Narrative becomes. That means building its culture, developing its people, and establishing ways of working that make the entire studio more creatively ambitious. The opportunity is to make great work while building a team that can keep making it.

What you’ll do

In your first year, your focus will be roughly 70% leading creative development for our highest-priority launches and campaigns, and 30% building the Brand Narrative function.
• Originate and lead big creative ideas. Partner with Product Marketing and Brand Marketing on the brief, then turn the agreed audience, opportunity, and product proof into original creative concepts. Develop ideas that can take distinctive forms across film, social, out-of-home, digital, experiences, and partnerships.
• Bring ambitious concepts to life with your creative peers and the full studio. Work side by side with the Brand Design and Writing leads and their teams from the earliest explorations through delivery. Develop ideas together, exchange thoughtful critique, and make creative choices that draw on each discipline’s expertise. Stay hands-on, contribute through your own craft, and partner closely with Motion and Production throughout. For film, remain closely involved through scripts, visual development, production, and the final edit.
• Build audience and distribution thinking into the idea. Shape concepts around how people will discover, watch, and share the work. Work with marketing partners to consider channels and viewing contexts from the beginning, so the work belongs where people encounter it rather than simply being resized to fit.
• Push beyond the first good answer, and learn quickly. Lead thoughtful concept development and critique. Use rough scripts, prototypes, and AI tools to test ideas quickly, learn, and move the strongest work forward. Know when to keep exploring and when to commit, then protect what makes an idea interesting through feedback and production.
• Find opportunities before a brief arrives. Bring curiosity about Mercury’s products, customers, and the wider world. Develop proactive ideas and cultural opportunities that give the brand something meaningful to say or do.
• Help decide where creative ambition matters most. Partner early with Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, Product Design, Comms, and Insights. Help identify which moments deserve our largest creative investment, present recommendations to senior leadership, and use results from marketing and insights partners to inform what comes next.
• Build and lead Brand Narrative. Define the team’s purpose, priorities, creative standards, and ways of working. Help hire and develop the team, shaping its structure and capabilities. Set clear expectations, and coach people to grow their judgment and conceptual strength.
• Create a culture where the best idea wins. Make room for experimentation, honest feedback, and contributions across disciplines. Lead with generosity and conviction, share ownership of the work, and help people challenge one another without making creativity a competition for credit.
• Build practices that strengthen the work. Establish a clear path from insight and an agreed brief to concept and execution, with useful critique and close collaboration throughout. Develop relationships with external creatives and agencies who can add a distinctive perspective or capability when needed.

What you’ll bring
• A strong creative foundation in art direction, design, or copywriting. Your portfolio shows original concepts developed into ambitious, well-crafted work across multiple formats. You can explain what you contributed, how the idea evolved, and how collaboration made it better.
• Deep film experience. You’ve developed film-led ideas from concept through production, with strong instincts for story, scripts, performance, pacing, and sound. You understand how these choices work together to make an audience feel something, not just make a film look good.
• A track record of deep creative collaboration with design and writing peers. You’ve led ambitious multidisciplinary work from concept through production by building trusted partnerships. You bring a clear point of view, listen closely, work through creative disagreements constructively, and recognize when someone else’s approach makes the work stronger. You can show how your collaborators shaped the outcome, not just what you personally originated.
• Strong taste, cultural awareness, and product curiosity. You can get close to a complex business or product, find the human truth within it, and turn that understanding into something clear, surprising, and memorable.
• Experience developing creative people and shaping how a team works. You give specific, useful feedback, set a high bar with care, and create an environment where people can take creative risks. You’re excited to build a new function, including the everyday practices that give it a culture.
• Clear communication and sound judgment. You can rally people around an ambitious concept, explain why it deserves investment, and navigate competing perspectives without losing the idea. You take ownership in ambiguous situations and balance creative ambition with the need to move work forward.

What success looks like

A year in, you’ll have led major launches and film-led campaigns from original concept through finished work, with Brand Design and Writing as creative partners from the beginning. The studio’s disciplines will have shaped the work together, with audience and distribution informing the creative approach.

Brand Narrative will have a clear identity, shared creative standards, and working practices that help people test and develop stronger ideas together. Alongside planned launches, you’ll have established a pipeline of proactive opportunities that gives Mercury more ways to express its product ambition with originality and cultural relevance.

Please include a portfolio featuring film-led work and broader campaign concepts. We’d love to understand your role in developing the ideas, the choices you made through production, and how you brought the work to life with others.
