jobs.title: Senior Financial Control Analyst
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

Senior Financial Control Analyst

📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

⭐ Our Financial Control Team:

Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges!

Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by… 

We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.

We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.

Your day-to-day:
• Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.
• Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.
• Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.
• Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.
• Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.
• Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.
• Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.
• Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.
• Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.
• Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…
• You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment
• You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards
• You have a great eye for detail
• You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls
• You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors
• You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds
• You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)
• You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process
• You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment
• What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰£56,000 - £75,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) 

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Data Platform
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Engineering Manager to lead one of our Data Platform teams, currently undergoing a fundamental transformation from a traditional, service-oriented model into a product-oriented platform team focused on automation, scalability, integration, and developer enablement.

As Engineering Manager, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating this transition, guiding the team through a challenging but high-potential journey.

You will be responsible for shaping and executing long-term technical and organizational strategies that enable scalable ownership models across the company, allowing teams to safely and autonomously leverage platform capabilities. Your leadership will be key to evolving a team with strong operational foundations into a high-impact, autonomous group of engineers who deliver reliable and compliant platform solutions, empower development teams, and contribute to the broader platform ecosystem. You will have end to end ownership of the team’s scope, including strategy, execution, and organizational design.This role is an opportunity to shape the future of our Data Platform, defining how teams across the company build, operate, and scale data and AI-driven products in a compliant and reliable way.

In this role, you will:
• Define and drive the strategic evolution of the team towards building a modern, scalable data platform that enables advanced data and AI use cases by default, without requiring bespoke solutions or direct platform team involvement
• Enable development teams to safely and autonomously leverage data and platform capabilities through robust tooling, guardrails, and well-defined interfaces.
• Establish a long-term roadmap that aligns data platform capabilities with emerging AI use cases, product needs, and regulatory constraints.
• Build and grow a high-performing, cross-functional team capable of delivering reliable, scalable, and compliant platform solutions
• Shape the team’s culture by promoting initiative, critical thinking, technical leadership, and shared responsibility across the platform.
• Coach and develop engineers to strengthen their skills across data, infrastructure, and platform engineering, while raising the bar on ownership and delivery.
• Take a proactive role in performance management, ensuring the team continuously evolves towards autonomy, maturity, and impact.
• Act as a key liaison between Engineering, Product, Security, and other stakeholders to represent the team’s roadmap and priorities.

What you need to be successful

Background
• Proven experience leading high-impact engineering teams in a Platform, Infrastructure, Machine Learning Engineering context, ideally within regulated, complex technical environments.
• Strong track record in transforming teams, developing both skills and mindset to support long-term strategic goals.
• Experience with public cloud providers, ideally AWS, and an understanding of how cloud-native services impact data architecture and operations.
• Prior exposure to or working knowledge of Machine Learning workflows or MLOps lifecycles is a definite plus, though not required.

Skills
• Strong understanding of data platform architectures and the trade-offs involved in building and operating them at scale.
• Familiarity with platform engineering principles and practices, including automation, observability, IaC, and secure-by-default design.
• Previous experience with AI/ML platform concepts (e.g., feature stores, model deployment patterns, model training pipelines, generative AI) to effectively empathize with and support AI/ML stakeholder teams is advantageous.
• Strong leadership in people and performance management, with experience coaching engineers and influencing team culture.
• Ability to navigate complex environments, balancing speed, reliability, and risk, with an understanding of regulatory constraints as a plus.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to create alignment across engineering, product, and business.
• Strategic thinker with the ability to translate long-term vision into clear plans and team evolution.
• Full professional proficiency in English.

What’s in it for you
• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
• Vacation days vary depending on your location of work. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
• The opportunity to work on a data platform that enables real AI use cases at scale, with space to innovate and shape how these capabilities are built and adopted across the company..
• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are:

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

Founded in 2013, N26 now has more than 8 million customers in 24 markets. We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.

jobs.title: Director, Model Risk — AI & Fraud
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Model Risk Director focused on Fraud and AI to join OKX’s Model Risk Management (MRM) function. As a senior member of the second line of defense (2LOD), this leader will provide independent oversight and effective challenge of fraud models used to detect, prevent, and manage fraud risk across OKX’s products and customer journeys.

 

The role will lead end-to-end validation of fraud models, from conceptual soundness, data and implementation review to outcomes analysis, performance monitoring, and remediation follow-up. The portfolio may include supervised machine learning models, anomaly detection, graph and network analytics, rules-based or hybrid systems, and AI-enabled fraud applications.

 

The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on experience in fraud model validation, strong quantitative judgment, and practical experience assessing AI/ML models. This person will partner closely with Fraud, Risk, Product, Data Science, Engineering, Compliance, and Audit teams while maintaining the independence of the MRM function.

 

This is a hands-on, builder role: the successful candidate will independently establish the fraud model validation capability from the ground up, personally execute validations, and play a leading role in assessing AI-enabled systems.

 

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Establish and own the independent validation framework for fraud models and AI-enabled decision systems across OKX products, covering conceptual soundness, data quality, implementation, and outcomes analysis, in line with SR 26-2 and equivalent model risk frameworks.
• Assess model conceptual soundness, intended use, assumptions, and limitations.
• Personally execute end-to-end model validations as the technical expert, including independently reproducing results through hands-on data analysis and code review.
• Assess AI/ML and generative AI applications, including LLM-based and agentic systems, for robustness, reliability, explainability, and appropriate human oversight, applying strong applied AI evaluation expertise.
• Perform ongoing monitoring review and periodic revalidation to ensure sustained model performance through changing fraud patterns and business conditions.
• Provide effective challenge to model owners; communicate conclusions, limitations, and risk ratings clearly to senior management and governance forums, and track remediation through closure.
• Build and continuously mature the fraud model validation capability, standards, and workflows within MRM.

 

What We Look For In You
• Master’s or Ph.D. in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
• 10+ years of quantitative, fraud risk, or model risk experience, with a recognized track record as a hands-on technical expert who personally delivers independent validations of models and decision systems.
• Excellent communication and judgment, including the ability to explain quantitative findings to senior audiences and constructively challenge model owners.
• Practical experience with statistical and machine learning methods; proficiency in Python and SQL; working knowledge of SR 11-7 or equivalent model risk and AI governance frameworks.
• Experience with AI/ML governance and controls, including explainability, fairness, robustness, ongoing monitoring, or generative and agentic AI applications in fraud operations.

 

Nice to Haves
• Experience establishing validation frameworks, methodologies, or capabilities in settings where they did not previously exist.
• Strong applied AI capability: hands-on experience evaluating or building ML/LLM-based systems in production, including prompt engineering, evaluation harnesses, fine-tuning assessment, or agentic AI workflows; able to run red-team style testing on AI applications.

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

OKX Statement:

OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
• The salary range for this position is $200,000 - $300,000
• The salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. In addition to the salary, a performance bonus and long-term incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, as well as a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. 急成長する事業を経理面から支えるとともに、NASDAQ上場企業として求められる経理・開示体制のさらなる強化に向けて、組織体制を拡充しています。

jobs.title: 連結経理（生命保険会社のIFRS導入プロジェクトマネジメント）
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼募集背景

PayPayグループにおける生命保険事業の拡大に伴い、グローバル基準（IFRS）に準拠した最新の経理・決算体制の構築を推進しています。
本ポジションでは、生命保険事業における経理・決算の知見を活かし、IFRS導入に向けた会計方針の策定からシステム・業務プロセス・内部統制の整備まで、プロジェクトを推進いただける方を募集しています。
プロジェクト完了後も整備した経理・決算体制の運用高度化や、新たな保険サービスの提供に伴う会計処理の検討などを担っていただく想定です。各関係者と連携しながら、生命保険事業の成長を支える経理基盤づくりに継続して携わっていただきます。

＜参考URL＞

世界一のフィンテック企業を目指して。経理本部・財務本部のチャレンジを語る

前例のない事業を会計で設計する― アジャイル環境で判断するPayPay経理

▼具体的な業務内容

PayPayグループにおける生命保険会社のIFRS導入プロジェクトを中心に、会計方針の策定からシステム・業務プロセス・内部統制の整備まで、幅広くプロジェクト推進に携わっていただきます。
これまでのご経験・専門性に応じて、以下の業務を担当いただきます。
• IFRS（特にIFRS17）に基づく会計方針の検討・策定
• IFRS導入に向けた決算プロセス・業務フローの設計・整備

• IFRS導入を上流から一貫して経験できる：
会計方針の策定からシステム・業務プロセス・内部統制の整備まで、IFRS導入に幅広く携わることができます。

導入プロジェクトの完了後は経理・決算体制の運用高度化や、新たな保険サービスに伴う会計処理の検討などに継続して携わることができます。

経営陣とも連携しながら、PayPayグループの生命保険事業の成長を支える経理・決算体制の構築に携わることができます。

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

The People Systems team builds and maintains secure, scalable HR technology that supports employees across the company. The team partners closely with People Operations, Compensation, Payroll, Finance, and Enterprise Technology to deliver reliable systems and improve how employees experience internal tools. The focus is on improving system performance, enabling new capabilities, and supporting company growth through thoughtful system design. This team plays a key role in supporting acquisitions and expanding global workforce operations.

As an Applications Developer, Workday, you will help configure, maintain, and enhance Workday solutions across key HR functions, focusing on Payroll, Absence, Time tracking, Benefits and core HCM. You'll work closely with business partners to understand their needs, translate requirements into system configurations, and build solutions that simplify processes and improve the employee experience. You will be the subject matter expert in this space, as well as help identify opportunities where automation and AI can help improve processes.

• Configure, maintain, and enhance Workday modules, including Payroll, Absence, Time Tracking, Benefits and HCM, ensuring systems are reliable and scalable.

• Work alongside Payroll to drive US and International payroll configuration, help troubleshoot payroll errors, support ongoing payroll processing
• Partner with Benefits to own and scale Workday configuration of Benefit plans, enrollment events, Open Enrollment readiness, integration updates

• Strong understanding of HR processes and how Workday supports People Operations, Payroll, Compensation, and related business functions.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience partnering with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
• Familiarity with Workday integrations (including PECI, RaaS, EIBs), data flows, APIs, and tools such as Workday Studio is a plus.
• Interest in leveraging automation and modern AI tools to improve workflows and drive operational efficiency.

Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The Role

As a SoFi Investment Specialist, you will support existing SoFi members and new customers by providing product education, account assistance, and operational support across SoFi's suite of investment services.

SoFi offers Brokerage, Robo Advisor, and retirement account solutions. In this role, you will help members understand these products, navigate account processes, and access the resources they need to manage their investment accounts.

You will play an important role in delivering an exceptional member experience while maintaining accuracy, professionalism, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

What you will do
• Provide member support through inbound phone calls, chat, and email.
• Educate members about SoFi Invest products, including Brokerage, Robo Advisor, and retirement accounts.
• Assist members with product-related questions involving equities, options, and margin.
• Troubleshoot operational and technical issues related to SoFi Invest products and services.
• Support members with account opening, funding, transactions, and general account maintenance.
• Explain investment account features, processes, terminology, and available services.
• Provide information about account activity and investment performance in accordance with established procedures and regulatory guidelines.
• Help members understand the features and differences between Brokerage and Robo Advisor accounts.
• Identify member needs and provide accurate information about available products and services.
• Monitor account activity and complete operational tasks with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
• Collaborate with management and product teams to identify opportunities to improve processes and member experience.
• Follow established compliance procedures and maintain all required professional licenses.

What you will need
• Required FINRA licenses: One of the following combinations:
• Series 7, Series 63, and Series 65; OR
• Series 7 and Series 66.
• All required licenses must be active and maintained throughout employment.
• Previous experience in financial services, preferably in a customer-facing or member support environment.
• Knowledge of investment products and financial concepts, including equities, options, and margin.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently.
• Ability to understand member needs and provide accurate, timely support.
• Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working independently and collaboratively.
• Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.
• A customer-first mindset and commitment to delivering an excellent member experience.
• Must successfully complete the required FINRA fingerprint-based background check.

Preferred Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent education and relevant professional experience may be considered.
• Experience supporting brokerage, investment, or wealth management accounts.
• Familiarity with investment account operations and financial services platforms.

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description:
The role

As a Backend Developer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the backend infrastructure of our applications, ensuring high performance, security, and scalability. You’ll work closely with the rest of the engineering team to tackle complex technical challenges and build solutions that can handle the unique demands of a crypto wallet app. 

Core

responsibilities:
• Design and implement scalable and robust backend services.
• Develop APIs and integrate third-party services and Solana RPCs.
• Manage databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and ensure data integrity and security.
• Implement caching mechanisms using Redis for improved performance.
• Work with PrismaJS for efficient database access and management.
• Deploy and manage applications on cloud platforms (DigitalOcean, Google Cloud Platform).
• Utilize BullJS for background job processing and Cron for scheduling tasks.
• Write unit and integration tests using Jest to ensure code quality and reliability.
• Collaborate with frontend developers and other team members to ensure seamless integration.
• Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in web development and blockchain.
• Design and implement a microservices architecture for scalability and maintainability.

jobs.title: SEO Specialist
jobs.description:
The role

We're looking for a Senior SEO Specialist to own and advance Solflare's organic search strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.

We already have a solid SEO foundation in place. Your role won't be to start from scratch, but to build on what's working, identify untapped opportunities, and take our organic visibility to the next level.

You'll work on a large-scale website with potentially millions of indexed or indexable pages, where technical SEO, content strategy, and smart prioritization can have a significant impact.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who enjoys both strategic thinking and getting things done. You'll collaborate directly with experienced colleagues across Marketing, Product, and Engineering, with the autonomy to shape how we approach organic growth.

Core

responsibilities:
• Own and evolve our SEO strategy - Build on our existing foundation, identify growth opportunities, and translate them into a clear, actionable roadmap.
• Drive organic search performance - Improve rankings, qualified organic traffic, and visibility for Solflare and its products across global markets.
• Lead technical SEO initiatives - Identify and prioritize opportunities related to crawling, indexing, site architecture, internal linking, and performance across a large-scale website.
• Optimize for traditional and AI-powered search - Develop approaches to improve Solflare's visibility in Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other emerging discovery platforms.
• Shape our content SEO strategy - Work with content creators and other stakeholders to ensure landing pages, product pages, and editorial content are built around search intent and measurable organic growth opportunities.
• Strengthen off-page SEO - Identify and execute opportunities to improve domain authority, backlink quality, and competitive positioning.
• Improve product discoverability - Support organic visibility for Solflare's browser extension and other relevant product discovery channels.
• Measure what matters - Monitor performance, turn data into actionable insights, and continuously refine priorities based on impact.
• Collaborate across teams - Partner with Marketing, Product, and Engineering to turn SEO opportunities into implemented improvements.

jobs.title: Senior Java Software Engineer - Intelligent Operations
jobs.description:
Starling is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way.

We’re a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We’re a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. We employ more than 3,000 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

Our technologists are at the very heart of Starling and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Starling is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, discovering, to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five Starling values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Starling - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. In Technology, we're asking that you attend the office a minimum of 1 day per week.

Our Engineering Environment

Starling engineers are excited about helping us deliver new features, regardless of what their primary tech stack may be. Hear from the team in our latest blogs or our case studies with Women in Tech.

We value people being engaged and caring about customers, caring about the code they write and the contribution they make to Starling. People with a broad ability to apply themselves to a multitude of problems and challenges, who can work across teams do great things here at Starling, to continue changing banking for good.

We're seeking a highly motivated and experienced engineer to play a key role in our Customer Service Engineering Group. You should have a strong understanding of delivering robust and scalable code, applying best practices, and a proven track record of delivering high-quality software. Experience with AWS and Postgres is highly desirable. 

We’re open-minded when it comes to hiring and we care more about aptitude and attitude than specific experience or qualifications. We are very open about how we deliver software. For the most part we code in Java, and though we are looking for someone with at least 7 years of commercial experience with Java, you need not be an expert! We believe in clean coding, simple solutions, automated testing and continuous deployment. If you care enough to find elegant solutions to difficult technical problems, we’d love to hear from you.

The main part of our Tech Stack is listed below, we don't ask that you have experience in all of this, but if you do, that's great!
• Java, which makes up the majority of our backend codebase
• Postgres
• AWS & GCP - we're cloud-native
• Distributed service based architecture
• Kubernetes (EKS)
• TeamCity for CI / CD (lots of teams are releasing code 15-20 times per day!)
• Terraform and Grafana

Our process:

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• Initial phone call - ~45 minutes
• Take home technical test to be discussed in the technical interview - ~3 hours
• Technical interview - ~1.5 hours
• Final Interview - ~40 minutes
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

About us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Starling is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Starling are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice.

By submitting your application, you agree that Starling may collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

jobs.title: Vendor Management & Outsourcing Analyst
jobs.description:
Trust is the first of a new breed of banks in Singapore – digitally native and focused on delivering a delightful customer experience. You will work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment to solve new and interesting challenges each day. Together with our Trust team, you will help shape the future of our bank.

As a Vendor Management Outsourcing Analyst you'd be able to work on and solve many interesting challenges which we are facing, learn new ways of working, and help build delightful high quality products for our customers.

 

Job Description 

This role will work with the Trust Technology team, SCB and vendors to support the assessment of risk, outsourcing and associated matter relating the Third-party vendor engagements.

 

The Role Responsibility: 

Strategy
• Ensure all required risk management processes (new and on-going) are performed periodically as specified by governance standards.
• Be the point of contact for the Vendor team and Contract owners for all required risk approvals and ensure compliance to vendor onboarding procedures.
• Support Outsourcing and materiality assessments for vendor services, and ongoing governance to comply with regulatory requirements.

 

Business Support
• Support Business Functions to complete risk assessments and service review meetings based on implemented Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) governance and oversight processes.
• Support management of ongoing monitoring activities including service review meetings with the Contract Owners.
• Support the reviews and approval of new and incremental services to be contracted under the TPRM Framework.
• Support line 1.5 (one point five) and 2nd line of defence oversight of third-party risks, validating and/or escalating, as appropriate, third-party risks in alignment with the TPRM Framework and the Board-approved risk appetite.
• Ensure Contract Owners are mitigating identified risks associated with third parties in accordance with the TPRM Framework.

 

Processes
• Ensure that all third-party relationships are captured in a centralised inventory in a timely manner.
• Ensure and assess compliance to TPRM Framework and adherence to related policies and standards.
• Communicate and train TPRM requirements, including country regulatory expectations.

 

Risk Management
• Escalate identified issues to relevant risk committees as necessary.
• Prepare reports of third-party risk oversight activities to key stakeholders and relevant risk committees.
• Support audit reviews as directed.
• Identify issues and root causes of incidents including oversight/facilitations of third-party risk mitigation actions.
• Support BAU functioning of the Third-Party Risk Committee and follow up on key tasks as appropriate.

 

Cross Functional Engagement
• Partner with stakeholders (including but not limited to Contract Owners, Supply Chain Management (SCM) team and relevant SMEs) to effectively coordinate and execute third party risk management controls.

 

Skill

Target proficiency level

Risk Control / Audit 

Advanced

Third Party Risk / Outsourcing regulatory requirements

Advanced

MS Office Excel, PowerPoint

Advanced

Problem Solving

Core

Change management skills

Basic

ERP systems such as SAP, Ariba

Core

 

Key Stakeholders
• Trust Bank Technology Team
• Global SCB Supply Chain Team
• Trust Bank Finance Team
• Cross functional teams during category management development and strategic sourcing events. This includes, but not limited to, Business stakeholders, Technology Innovation, Legal, Compliance, Tax, Risk and Finance

 

Our Ideal Candidate:
• Minimum 3+ years of working experience with Third Party Risk Control or broad vendor management experience
• Previous experience of working within the Financial Services sector is an advantage.
• Ability to develop creative solutions to problems and work with the larger team.
• Energy and desire to succeed; follows through on commitments; pushes self and others to deliver exceptional results.
• Strong collaboration, consensus building, problem resolution and communication skills are a prerequisite.

jobs.title: Head of Business Operations - North America - Wise Platform
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Head of Business Operations to serve as the regional operational engine and strategic lead for Wise Platform in North America. In this high-visibility leadership role, you will step into a critical environment to transform regional partner operations, turning and keeping operational metrics consistently "green" and transitioning manual workflows into automated infrastructure. Your role entails balancing high-level regional strategy with hands-on execution. You will drive cross-functional alignment across product, compliance, and core servicing teams (KYC, Support, Payment Operations), directly lead an established Partner Operations team, and partner with commercial leads to scale operating models for new banking and enterprise partners.

Responsibilities
• Regional Operational Governance & Turnaround: Own regional servicing performance and SLAs across North America, performing deep-dive diagnostic assessments to isolate root causes and restore distressed partner operations.
• Cross-Functional Influence Without Authority: Establish matrix leadership over non-direct reporting servicing domains (Payment Operations, Enterprise Support, KYC/FinCrime, Compliance) to align roadmaps, capacity planning, and SLA prioritization.
• Product & Engineering Alignment: Build rigorous, data-driven ROI business cases comparing operational capacity trade-offs against engineering hours to convince Product teams to automate systemic operational bottlenecks and case-routing flaws.
• Customer Success Management: Directly lead, mentor, and scale an established team of 4–5 Partner Operations Managers, steering regional operations away from reactive firefighting toward structured, long-term scalable partnerships.
• Commercial Integration & Scaling: Partner with regional Commercial, Deal-Flow, and Delivery teams to build scalable operational frameworks and incubate setups for new enterprise clients and platform feature launches.
• Incident & Escalation Management: Serve as the senior operational escalation point for Tier 1 bank partners during high-stakes situations, structuring post-mortems and preventative frameworks to systematically eliminate repeating operational failures.

jobs.title: Senior Growth CRM Specialist
jobs.description:
As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a Senior CRM Lead to own and elevate our Americas customer lifecycle strategy. 

Your Mission:

You will hold the vision for how we communicate with customers in Latin America. You will bridge the gap between our high-level CRM strategy and tactical execution, ensuring our customers receive the right message, at the right time, through the right channel.
• Mentorship: You will foster a culture of experimentation, autonomy, and continuous learning, helping your team grow their careers at Wise.
• Define the LatAm Strategy: You will own the end-to-end lifecycle strategy for our customers in LatAm. You will build sophisticated, automated journeys that drive activation, cross-sell and retention.
• Drive Commercial Impact: You will be responsible for key CRM metrics-improving conversion rates, reducing churn, and increasing lifetime value. You will use data to prove the value of your and your team’s work.
• Stakeholder Partnership: You will be the primary voice for LatAm CRM across the company. You will partner deeply with Product Managers, Product Marketing, Regional Leads, Analytics, and Creative teams to ensure our communications are aligned with product roadmaps and customer needs.

Responsibilities

Customer Interaction & Service Delivery

● Meet service goals in all the KPIs eg. case resolution, productivity and quality measures across all channels (eg- phone, chat, emails, etc).

● Communicate clearly and professionally with customers across all channels, adapting tone and style based on customer and context while maintaining composure and professionalism.

● Take ownership for the resolution of contacts, using critical thinking skills to identify the appropriate responses.

● Maintain a customer-focused mindset to resolve contacts, using active listening and empathy to understand the unique requirements of each case and tailoring responses to ensure resolution.

● Understand how to manage and diffuse escalating customer interactions.

● Manage appropriate escalations to other Servicing teams including KYC, Complaints and PayOps.

Knowledge & Skills

● Possess advanced knowledge of all our products and processes, including segment specialisation for Consumer or Business.

● Demonstrate strong grammar, spelling, and typing speed.

● Maintain a holistic view of the customer journey.

● Aligning support provided to customers with the Wise mission.

● Gain and build knowledge and contribute to the team discussions - sharing ideas and information

 

Process, Compliance & Improvement

● Keep records of customer interactions according to company standards by following the standardised case handling processes.

● Identify opportunities to improve processes and escalate appropriately.

● Comply with the company values and Code of Conduct.

Team Collaboration & Professional Development

● Have a feedback mentality, being able to give and receive feedback in a constructive manner.

● Provide peer-to-peer support to help colleagues resolve cases where appropriate.

● Accountable for their own development with the support of Wise’s professional development infrastructure in line with the Career Map.

● Identify the appropriate routes to escalate and share feedback within and across teams.

● Build foundation for advancement into Senior Specialist or Team Lead roles.

Qualifications:

Experience:

* Has a minimum one year customer support experience in a contact centre and a desire to continue to grow their career with Customer Support.

* Experience working across multiple channels (phone, chat, email)

 

Adherence: Proven track record of meeting quality standards in a contact centre role.

 

Language: Fluent in English and in Arabic

 

Communications: Strong communications skills and empathy, with the ability to manage difficult conversations with customers.

 

Technical

requirements:

Flexibility:

* Flexibility in working hours/shifts (day, night, weekend, public holidays shifts). Specialists may be required to attend team calls, including video interaction with other offices

* Able to understand the direct contribution of consistent presence and schedule adherence to holistic business needs.

 

Mindset:

* Self starter, able to work independently with knowledge resources, proactive, solution oriented, ownership mindset.

* Great fit to our values and company culture.

* Able to keep up with constant change, patient, and flexible.

* Willingness to use emerging technology where appropriate

 

Feedback: Open to feedback and coaching, with a clear desire for continuous improvement.

 

Security: Understanding and following data security procedures is critical, especially as data privacy regulations evolve.

 

Inclusivity: Commitment to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment

 

Compliance:

* Must be legally authorized to work in the assigned location.

* Required to complete successful background screening.

jobs.title: Paid Search Senior Manager
jobs.description:
At Wise, we're on a mission to empower users to make smarter, more transparent financial decisions. We operate as a collective of autonomous teams, trusting and empowering everyone to take ownership and execute on the things that drive the greatest impact for our users.

Search is changing quickly as generative AI, machine learning and in-app discovery reshape how people find products and services. We are looking for an experienced, strategic and hands-on Paid Search Senior Manager to own our channel strategy and execution across a complex, global business. You will turn our growth objectives into clear plans, KPIs and investment choices, then stay close to delivery to make sure the work creates measurable customer and business impact.

You will bring deep paid search expertise, sound judgement and a test-and-learn mindset. You will improve how we use platforms, automation and emerging technologies, and raise the quality of work across the team by sharing your knowledge and leading by example.

Responsibilities;

Search Strategy & Execution
• Own the end-to-end paid search strategy and execution for your remit. Translate business and customer objectives into a clear quarterly plan, channel KPIs, priorities and measurable outcomes, adapting as market conditions and evidence change.
• Make and explain investment and budget allocation recommendations within agreed business guardrails. Forecast the expected impact, monitor delivery against plan and make timely trade-offs to improve customer acquisition outcomes.
• Lead performance across large-scale Google Ads, Microsoft Ads and Apple Ads accounts. Set direction for campaign structure, targeting, bidding and optimisation across markets and languages, and assess opportunities in emerging search and discovery channels.
• Use automation, scripts, APIs and AI-enabled platform capabilities where they solve a clear customer or operational problem. Evaluate new approaches critically, measure their effect and share practices that improve efficiency or performance.
• Shape a disciplined experimentation approach across search ads, extensions and landing-page journeys. Use customer and performance insights to prioritise tests, interpret results and apply learnings to campaign decisions.
• Maintain and improve reporting and forecasting. Identify tactical and strategic opportunities, quantify their expected impact and translate them into practical delivery plans against acquisition targets.

Team Leadership & Collaboration
• Collaboration & Team Empowerment: Act as a key strategic partner and subject matter expert within the team. You will focus on empowering your colleagues by sharing advanced learnings, fostering collaborative problem-solving, and helping to establish strong communication and best-practice processes that elevate the entire team.
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead high-impact, cross-channel initiatives and projects - working closely with SEO, Product, Analyst and Paid Marketing teams - to drive holistic user growth and enhance the overall customer journey.

jobs.title: FinCrime Operations Team Lead
jobs.description:
As a FinCrime Operations Team Lead you will develop and oversee the daily operations of a team of FinCrime Operations Analysts or Specialists. Your primary purpose is to ensure the effective mitigation of financial crime risks associated with Wise's customers, while maintaining a strong focus on operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and a customer-centric approach. You will foster a high-performing team, drive operational excellence, and act as a subject matter expert in KYC/AML/Fraud/Screening and financial crime prevention. You will be responsible for ensuring your team meets performance targets, maintains or elevates quality standards, and contributes to a culture of continuous improvement within the FinCrime Operations organization.

The FinCrime Operations Team Lead is a dual-focused leader, combining strong people leadership with domain and operational expertise. You will be instrumental in building and refining processes that prioritise customer impact while maintaining focus on the evolving risks within the financial services industry, specific product vulnerabilities, and the requirements set by regulations and partners. This includes supporting the development of compliant and scalable processes and possessing an understanding of financial crime risks associated with our customers, products, and tooling.
• Team Leadership: You will lead by example, driving a customer-focused mindset across your team and the wider fincrime organization. You are instrumental in fostering a high-performance, results-driven culture defined by strong ownership and accountability. This involves building and nurturing high-performing teams that value knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and adaptability in our change-oriented environment. Fincrime Operations Team Lead demonstrates strong capabilities in timely conflict resolution and fosters open communication and guides effective mediation to ensure a positive working environment. You should be visible and actively engaged in team management. Your focus is on unifying the team behind shared goals (and wider FinCrime/servicing strategies) and driving collective actions.
• People management: Coach and develop a strong team of FinCrime Operations Analysts or Specialists with varying levels of experience, providing tailored guidance, and taking swift, decisive action to manage performance issues effectively, ensuring sustained excellence and growth. Provide regular, constructive, and actionable feedback to your direct reports. Coach and mentor team members to support their growth, develop their skills, and help them reach their full potential. Design and manage performance or development plans in identified areas. Conduct career map check-ins and make recommendations for demotions, promotions, salary raises, and other role related decisions.
• Operational management: You will oversee the daily operations of the team, ensuring adherence to relevant regulations and internal policies and processes. Identify and propose opportunities for process and tooling improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase operational efficiency or to ensure effective cross-team collaboration on joint initiatives. Provide guidance and support on complex, high-risk cases and escalations. Be on top of timely admin related tasks including but not limited to scheduling, training, hiring, interviewing, organising team activities, and others.
• Performance management: Measure team and individual KPIs and ensure performance targets and quality standards are consistently met while maintaining focus on customer experience and adherence to internal guidelines. Drive high-quality results for both the team and individuals, continuously enhancing overall quality outcomes. Conduct timely quality reviews, ensuring high decision accuracy and effectively communicate the importance of quality assurance. Conduct regular and impactful one on one coaching sessions (usually on a weekly or biweekly basis), provide clear and actionable feedback. Ensure tasks are managed timely and aligned with the team’s goals. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best practices and enhance overall team spirit. Addresses underperformance promptly through coaching and setting SMART goals, and ensures all interventions are well-documented. Understand and be able to articulate how to move key metrics at team and individual level through efficient performance and task management.
• Expertise sharing: Be a subject matter expert in financial crime areas with the ability to obtain and maintain sufficient subject matter expertise required to train, develop and coach your team. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, domain-specific processes and best practices. Apply a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Perform and support deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership. Assist senior leadership with reviews and developing our processes, task management and in other operational areas as requested to ensure compliant and effective servicing function
• Issue Management and Escalation : Escalate tooling or processing incidents, high-risk customer issues, control weaknesses, or other material problems to direct leadership in a timely and informative manner, following established protocols.
• Planning and execution: Be accountable for driving your direct team's performance outcomes, ensuring key performance indicators (KPIs) are consistently met and enhanced. Possess strong knowledge of team processes and tooling, leveraging data to support initiative execution. This involves taking full ownership of your team's results, setting targets for improvement, and providing insights to stakeholders. Set and progress towards goals, adeptly identifying and resolving blockers or issues, whether performance or metric-related, to optimize output and results.
• Stakeholder management and communication: Collaborate closely with stakeholders ensuring clear communication and coordination of actions. Your initiatives and reports are well documented and you choose the right platforms to communicate to a wider audience in a timely manner. The documentation has a clear scope and includes potential impact in different areas. You can communicate confidently with difficult stakeholders on varied operational or domain related topics. Proactively work on improving cross-team communication and collaboration, acting as the liaison between different layers of the organization and your own team. Employ impactful and inspiring communication skills, unifying individuals behind shared goals, and leverage strong presentation skills to convey vision and progress.
• Other: Perform additional tasks as assigned by your lead, demonstrating adaptability and a proactive approach. This includes actively participating in meetings, trainings, workshops, and internal events to support broader team and company objectives.

jobs.title: Senior Compliance Specialist - AML/Fraud Controls
jobs.description:
Wise is looking for a Senior Compliance Specialist to join our North America Financial Crime Compliance Oversight team in Austin, TX. Reporting to the Deputy BSA/AML Officer, you'll be an individual contributor and subject matter expert for AML and Fraud controls across the US and Canada.

You'll provide independent second-line challenge, translate regulatory and risk requirements into practical controls, and partner cross-functionally (e.g. with Product, Operations, etc) to identify gaps and drive improvements. 

Your Mission:
• Provide second-line oversight of AML and Fraud controls across the US and Canada, including customer due diligence, investigations and fraud risk controls.
• Review and challenge first-line control design, performance and changes, including new products or features; recommend proportionate improvements and escalate material issues.
• Advise regional and global teams on applicable US and Canadian AML/CTF requirements and Wise policies, translating obligations into practical control expectations.
• Use MI, KRIs and control evidence to identify trends, exceptions and gaps; agree actions and track remediation through closure.
• Contribute to financial crime risk assessments and horizon scanning, helping ensure relevant AML/Fraud developments are reflected in controls.
• Support suspicious activity/transaction reporting governance, including the US SAR Committee where relevant, and provide clear analysis and control feedback.
• Prepare concise, decision-ready documentation and support responses to auditors, regulators and partners within your scope.
• Own medium-complexity work end to end and share expertise through onboarding, coaching and knowledge sharing.

A Bit

About You:
• Theory. You have strong working knowledge of US and Canadian AML/CTF requirements and hands-on experience with AML and Fraud controls in a financial institution, fintech, money services business or consulting environment.
• Practice. You have experience reviewing, challenging or improving controls and investigations, and can connect regulatory requirements, risk and customer impact.
• Judgement. You can identify material issues, make sound risk-based recommendations, and know when to decide independently or escalate.
• Ownership. You manage medium-complexity work from start to finish, prioritise competing deadlines and keep stakeholders aligned with minimal direction.
• Communication. You write and speak clearly, simplify complex information and can constructively challenge stakeholders across Operations, Product and Compliance.
• Delivery. You are proactive, thorough and data-minded. You follow actions through to closure and leave a clear record of the risk, decision and rationale.
• Teamwork. You build strong relationships, welcome feedback and share your expertise to help others succeed.
• Travel. You are willing to travel to other Wise offices as required (around 10%).
• You must already be legally authorised to work in the US; Wise cannot provide visa sponsorship for this role.
• This is not a remote position. This full-time role is based in Austin, TX, with three days of in-office work.

Nice to haves:
• Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS), or similar professional certification.
• Experience contributing to financial crime or enterprise risk assessments.
• Experience with suspicious activity/transaction reporting, transaction monitoring and/or fraud investigations.
• Experience using MI/KRIs, control effectiveness testing, model validation or tuning to identify risk and drive action.
• Experience training, onboarding or mentoring colleagues

Key

benefits:
• Salary range: $82,000 - $110,000 USD annually.
• Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
• Medical, dental, & vision insurance - including HSA and FSA options.
• Company-paid: Life Insurance, AD&D Insurance, Short & Long-Term Disability, and an EAP program.
• 25 days of PTO + 11 paid banking holidays + 10 paid sick days + a paid volunteer day, annually.
• 16-weeks of paid parental leave, after a year with us.
• 401k with up to a 4% employer match.
• 6-week paid sabbatical after 4 years with us.

We're people without borders - without judgment or prejudice, too. We want to work with the best people, no matter their background. So if you're passionate about learning new things and keen to join our mission, you'll fit right in.

Also, qualifications aren't tha

t important to us. If you've got great experience, and you're great at articulating your thinking, we'd like to hear from you.

And because we believe that diverse teams build better products, we'd especially love to hear from you if you're from an under-represented demographic.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Graph Risk Intelligence
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Principal Product Manager to lead the Graph Risk Intelligence team. You will define how Wise ingests, stores, computes and learns from connected data, then turn that strategy into capabilities that teams can use in production.

You will build close relationships with PMs, data scientists, engineers and operational teams to understand their goals and constraints. You will balance immediate use cases with the long-term platform, focusing on speed of experimentation, cost efficiency, reliability and measurable improvements in decision quality.

This is a senior individual contributor role with influence across Risk Intelligence and the wider organisation. The initial team will include an engineering lead, machine learning engineers and backend engineers. You will give the team clear problem statements, stay close to the technical work and create the product principles for engineers and data scientists to own important problems.

 

Your mission

Set the product direction. Create a clear vision and strategy for graph capabilities at Wise. Translate it into a focused roadmap across data ingestion, storage, computation, signal generation, modelling, analytics and serving.

Understand the users and problems that matter. Work directly with data science, engineering and operations teams to understand how they investigate relationships, build models and make decisions. Find common needs that should be solved once as a platform.

Make graph experimentation easier. Help teams ingest and augment graph data, test graph signals and move successful ideas from experimentation into reliable production use.

Advance graph intelligence. Guide and enable the use of graph algorithms and graph-based machine learning, including when simpler heuristics or classical methods are the better choice. Make the technical and product trade-offs understandable to others.

Make difficult choices. Balance efficacy, speed, platform reuse, engineering complexity, model risk, operating cost and maintenance. Explain priorities clearly and decide what to build, improve or stop.

Stay close to delivery. Work with engineering and machine learning from discovery through experiment, launch and iteration. Challenge assumptions, contribute to technical design, remove blockers and help the team deliver at pace.

Lead adoption across Wise. Build alignment with teams in anti-financial crime, underwriting, customer support, finance and customer relationship management. Identify dependencies early and help teams adopt shared graph capabilities successfully.

Own measurable outcomes. Define the metrics for platform adoption, experimentation speed, model performance, cost, reliability and user outcomes. Use evidence to assess progress and determine what to improve next.

 

What this role offers

Build a new product area. Establish the team, its operating model and its product strategy from the ground up.

Work on high-impact problems. Shape how Wise uses connected data and advanced techniques to improve risk decisions and customer outcomes.

Influence several parts of Wise. Create reusable capabilities that can support anti-financial crime, underwriting, customer support, finance and customer relationship teams.

Learn with strong technical teams. Work closely with machine learning engineers, backend engineers, data scientists and product teams that are exploring advanced methods.

Shape the next stage of Risk Intelligence. Help the area learn where deeper research investment can create practical value for Wise.

jobs.title: Senior Product Compliance Manager - KYC & Onboarding
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Lead Data Analyst, Customer Support
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Lead Data Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders. You will partner with our Customer Support organisation to help drive data-driven decisions that improve customer outcomes while managing cost to serve and team capacity.

Customer Support is the largest customer-facing area in Servicing. It is where cost to serve, AI and automation, and the alignment between Operations and Product come together. You will measure whether changes to channels, self-serve flows and AI agents are working for customers, and you will be a trusted analytical voice for CS Operations, CS Product and WFM.

As a Lead Data Analyst, you will own key parts of the customer support metric tree, measure the impact of automation and AI, and run experiments and causal analyses that show what really changed. You will also help make sure the team's metrics are defined once, owned clearly and trusted by everyone who uses them.

This is a great opportunity for an analyst who has a keen understanding of customer problems, strong product thinking and is passionate about creating convincing analyses. You will also be part of the Servicing Analytics community of 86 analysts and a wider community of 150+ analysts at Wise, where you can collaborate on cross-team projects, share knowledge and help improve how analytics works across the company. 

This is an IC3 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
• Collaborate with senior stakeholders across Customer Support and effectively communicate your insights into real change for our customers. Join us in working towards our mission.
• Own key areas of the CS metric tree, for example contact rate, first response, resolution, CSAT, repeat contact and cost per contact, and make sure they roll up cleanly into Servicing's Cost and Convenience toplines.
• Support target-setting and tracking with Ops and Product leaders, so the team can see whether targets are being hit, not just set them.
• Measure AI agent, self-serve and deflection impact. Estimate addressable volume, actual deflection and cost saved, and the effect on CSAT, repeat contact and quality.
• Monitor automation quality. Support calibration and drift monitoring on quality scoring so automated decisions stay trustworthy.
• Support capacity planning and forecasting with WFM, including demand forecasts, staffing models, SLA and wait-time trade-offs, and regional and outsourcing mix.
• Make trade-offs explicit. Show the impact on customer outcomes, operational cost and team capacity in every channel and staffing recommendation.
• Build and maintain high-quality data models and pipelines in SQL and dbt, and review analytical work from colleagues to keep the bar high.

jobs.title: KYC Operations Associate Analyst - Business
jobs.description:
Join the Revolution at Wise as a KYC Operations Associate Analyst!

Are you ready to be more than just an employee? At Wise, we're not just offering a job; we're inviting you to be part of a financial revolution! We're looking for a passionate and detail-oriented KYC Operations Associate Analyst to join our dynamic team. 

About the Role

As a KYC Operations Associate Analyst, you'll be at the forefront of ensuring Wise adheres to the highest regulatory and compliance standards. You'll play a crucial role in protecting our customers and maintaining the integrity of our platform by conducting thorough customer due diligence, analyzing customer activities, and meticulously maintaining our KYC records. If you're eager to develop your career in the KYC domain, this is the perfect opportunity to make a real impact! 

What You’ll Do
• Customer and Business Onboarding: Dive into initial and ongoing Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) reviews. You’ll make critical risk-based decisions, ensuring our risk mitigation standards are met. You’ll also get to collect, analyze, and verify customer information against KYC/AML guidelines, gaining a deep understanding of potential risks associated with various customer types. This involves assessing everything from customer identity documents and online company registries to complex business structures, ultimate beneficial ownership, and customer source of wealth documentation, plus adverse media screening.
• Transaction Monitoring and Periodic Reviews: You’ll review customer transaction history, providing key insights into customer behavior patterns that could indicate risks. You'll also conduct periodic reviews, analyzing changes in customer history and account usage to keep us one step ahead.
• Documentation and Record Keeping: Accuracy is key! You’ll ensure customer records are not only accurate but also updated as required. You’ll maintain organized and detailed records of customers and the decisions made during the KYC process, all while complying with data privacy regulations and internal data security protocols.
• Risk Assessment and Escalation: You’ll perform and document customer risk assessments based on the information you gather. When you identify activities that exceed our internal risk tolerance, you’ll escalate them to the relevant teams. You’ll also be vigilant in identifying potential money laundering and fraudulent activities, filing Suspicious Activity Reports with proper documentation and rationale.
• Customer Communication: You’ll communicate effectively with customers through various channels (phone, email, and chat), providing top-notch service and support.
• KPIs and More: You'll perform your tasks within the expected key performance indicators set by the leadership team, and you'll tackle other position-related tasks assigned by your lead. You’ll also participate in meetings, training, and internal and external events, contributing to our collaborative environment.

jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist - Agentic AI / AML
jobs.description:
Lead Data Scientist - Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Handling & Prevent

We’re looking for a Lead Data Scientist (IC3) to join our Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Handling & Prevent team in London.

This role is a unique opportunity to work on the AI and intelligence systems at the core of our operational handling and prevention work. You'll help build and automate components of our operational systems using Generative AI, LLMs and agentic AI approaches, establish robust LLM evaluation pipelines, and build solutions that reduce financial crime risk. What you build will have a direct impact on Wise’s mission and millions of our customers.

The AML Handling & Prevent team offers an exciting environment for applying cutting-edge Generative AI, Agentic AI and machine learning architectures. This team is dedicated to enhancing our financial crime mitigation operations through advanced tooling, automated evaluation frameworks, prompt optimisation and increasingly autonomous AI workflows, aiming to streamline reviews and simplify the work of our operations staff. As a Lead Data Scientist (IC3), you will drive technical strategy across handling and prevent initiatives, architect robust AI systems, establish post-deployment monitoring, and lead complex automation initiatives to reduce financial crime risk across Wise.

Here’s how you’ll be contributing:
• End-to-End AI Automation & EDD LLMs: Lead the development and deployment of AI models designed to augment operational workflows (e.g. Business and Consumer EDD LLMs), specifically targeting the automation of case summaries, red flag generation, risk classifications, document requests and agentic workflows.
• Evaluation Framework & Labeling Taxonomy: Establish labeling taxonomies and guidelines with EDD SMEs, construct evaluation datasets, and implement automated eval harnesses to systematically measure accuracy, precision, recall, and failure modes.
• Prompt Optimization & Experimentation: Audit existing prompts and run structured experiments (few-shot, chain-of-thought, context ordering) within a hypothesis-driven testing framework to reduce hallucinations, formatting errors, and prompt drift.
• Agentic AI Systems: Help design and develop AI workflows that can reason across multiple steps, use tools and contextual information, and support complex operational processes safely and reliably.
• Shadow Testing & Monitoring: Design shadow mode deployments and parallel execution testing to safely evaluate prompts and AI workflows at scale, while implementing post-deployment monitoring for data and output drift.
• Full-Stack Deployment: Take ownership of the production pipeline by writing and deploying production-ready Python services. You must be willing to bypass engineering bottlenecks to ship value quickly while maintaining code quality.
• Human-in-the-Loop Architecture: Design systems where AI provides recommendations and drafts, ensuring human operators retain the final decision-making authority for critical financial crime mitigation assessments.
• Strategic Demand Deflection: Go beyond ticket handling by analyzing upstream data to create strategies that deflect financial crime attempts before they reach the operations team, effectively reducing manual workload.
• Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Set technical direction, mentor Senior and Junior Data Scientists, foster a product-focused mindset, and guide the team through complex technical implementations, architectural decisions, and AI governance standards.

A bit

about you:
• Experience implementing, training, testing and evaluating performance of Machine Learning systems;
• Strong Python knowledge. A big plus for proven familiarity and experience with OOP principles;
• Some hands-on experience developing or working with GenAI / LLM solutions. You don’t need to be an LLM specialist, but you should have professional exposure to areas such as prompt engineering, evaluation, LLM-powered workflows or Agentic AI;
• Knowledge and experience developing and evaluating GenAI / LLM solutions, including automated eval harnesses and prompt engineering;
• Experience with statistical analysis, experiment design, and failure mode analysis in ML or LLM systems;
• A strong product mindset with the ability to work independently in a cross-functional and cross-team environment;
• Good communication skills and ability to get the point across to non-technical individuals and SMEs;
• Strong problem solving skills with the ability to help refine problem statements and figure out how to solve them.

Some extra skills that are great (but not essential):
• Familiarity with automating operational processes via technical solutions, for example Large Language Models, AI agents or multi-step AI workflows
• Experience implementing fine-tuning, reinforced learning alignment and evaluation techniques within an LLM training pipeline.
• Familiarity with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph or similar.
• Experience designing tool-using agents, orchestration workflows or human-in-the-loop AI systems.
• Willingness to get hands dirty reading many, many historical operational cases.
• Working knowledge of Java.

We’re people without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We want to work with the best people, no matter their background. So if you’re passionate about learning new things and keen to join our mission, you’ll fit right in.

Also, qualifications aren’t that important to us. If you’ve got great experience, and you’re great at articulating your thinking, we’d like to hear from you.

And because we believe that diverse teams build better products, we’d especially love to hear from you if you’re from an under-represented demographic.

jobs.title: Analyst, KYC
jobs.description:

YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually.

jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission

Run Bitpanda's paid acquisition hands-on and make experimentation the way we work. You will own the daily operation of our Meta, TikTok and Google campaigns across European markets, run a weekly creative-testing cadence with our in-house Studio, and prove what works with incrementality tests rather than platform dashboards.
