jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Lending
jobs.location: New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
jobs.description:
About the role

Chime’s Lending org builds the products and platforms that give members access to fair, transparent credit and liquidity when they need it most, from Earned Wage Access through MyPay, to flexible overdraft with SpotMe, to longer-term Instant Loans, and the platforms that power credit decisions, funding, repayments, and servicing behind the scenes.

We operate some of Chime’s most consequential systems. Our teams build real-time money movement and decisioning infrastructure at scale, including underwriting and eligibility, ledgering and reconciliation, capital markets workflows, repayment systems, and financial transactions that must be correct, resilient, and auditable.

As a Senior Software Engineer in Lending, you’ll work at the seam between member-facing products and the platforms that make them possible. This is a role for engineers who want to own more than a single service or feature area. You’ll lead technical initiatives that cut across products, platforms, and partner teams, helping shape how Lending evolves as a system, not just how one team ships.

You’ll design and build backend systems where correctness, reliability, speed, and operational rigor matter deeply. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Risk, Data Science, Analytics, Finance, and Operations to turn ambiguous opportunities into durable solutions, influence technical direction across team boundaries, and help raise the bar for how Lending engineers build together.

Why join Lending?

Work on systems that matter

The products and platforms we build directly impact millions of members and sit at the center of Chime’s mission to help everyday people unlock financial progress. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

Own a bigger surface area

This role is designed for engineers who want broader scope. You won’t be limited to a narrow feature lane. You’ll work across product experiences and shared infrastructure, helping connect strategy, systems, and execution across Lending.

Build where product and platform meet

Some of the most interesting engineering work happens in the seams: where member experience depends on credit strategy, where product velocity depends on platform leverage, and where financial correctness meets business speed. This role sits in the middle of those seams and gives you meaningful influence over how they scale.

Operate in a fast-moving, high-accountability environment

Lending is a fast-paced fintech environment where we care about moving quickly and building well. We value thoughtful design, strong engineering judgment, high-quality code, and operational excellence. We also actively use AI where it can improve quality, speed, and leverage.

Grow your technical leadership

At L5, you’ll be expected to do more than deliver strong execution. You’ll lead through ambiguity, drive alignment across teams, shape architecture and engineering patterns, and improve how the org operates over time. This is a strong role for engineers who want to expand their influence and prepare for even larger technical scope.

In this role, you can expect to
• Lead end-to-end architecture and delivery of backend systems that connect member-facing lending products with shared platforms such as Credit Risk, Capital Markets, Repayments, servicing, and core financial systems
• Drive complex, cross-team initiatives from problem definition through architecture, implementation, rollout, and iteration, especially where multiple teams or domains need to move in sync
• Own technical problems with real business and member impact, and bring structure, momentum, and clarity when the path is not obvious
• Define and evolve APIs, integration patterns, and data contracts so product teams can move faster without compromising safety, correctness, or reuse
• Design for scale, resiliency, observability, and operational excellence, with strong handling of failures, retries, reconciliation, auditability, and edge cases
• Identify opportunities to turn one-off product needs into reusable platform capabilities that unlock future velocity across Lending
• Partner closely with Product, Design, Risk, Data Science, Analytics, Finance, and Operations to translate ambiguous problems into practical, high-leverage technical solutions
• Influence how product and platform teams work together by clarifying ownership, reducing integration friction, and improving the quality of technical decision-making across boundaries
• Participate in on-call and incident response, and lead efforts to turn production lessons into lasting improvements in systems, tooling, and engineering practices
• Mentor other engineers through design reviews, technical feedback, and hands-on partnership, helping raise the leadership capacity of the broader org
• Contribute to roadmap and strategy conversations by identifying where platform investments can unlock multiple product outcomes over time

To thrive in this role, you have
• 8+ years of experience building and operating production software at scale, with a strong track record of owning backend systems end-to-end
• Strong backend engineering fundamentals, ideally with Ruby on Rails or a comparable framework, and experience building APIs and distributed systems in production
• Experience with transactional databases, asynchronous processing, caching, and large-scale application architecture
• Strong system design judgment and the ability to make sound tradeoffs across correctness, scalability, resiliency, speed, and long-term maintainability
• A track record of leading complex projects that span multiple teams, systems, or business workflows
• Experience working in fintech, lending, banking, payments, risk, or other high-integrity domains where correctness, traceability, and operational rigor matter deeply
• A high-ownership mindset and comfort operating in ambiguity, including the ability to create clarity, drive alignment, and move important work forward without waiting for perfect structure
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across engineering and cross-functional teams in a low-ego, effective way
• A product mindset and strong instincts for connecting technical decisions to member experience and business outcomes
• Experience mentoring engineers and helping teams raise the bar on design quality, testing, operational excellence, and engineering ownership
• Curiosity, sound judgment, and a genuine desire to understand systems deeply and improve them over time

Nice-to-have
• Experience with lending or credit systems such as underwriting, eligibility, line assignment, limits, repayments, collections, servicing, or decisioning
• Experience with financial platform domains such as capital markets workflows, reconciliations, ledgering, accounting interfaces, partner integrations, or bank integrations
• Familiarity with experimentation, analytics, and data-informed systems used to safely evolve decisioning and product strategy over time
• Experience helping product teams adopt shared platform capabilities through strong APIs, abstractions, internal tooling, or platform patterns

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning Platform
jobs.description:
About the role 

Chime’s Machine Learning Platform (MLP) team builds and operates the infrastructure, tooling, and developer experience that powers machine learning across the company. We enable data scientists and ML engineers to develop, train, deploy, and monitor models reliably and efficiently.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Machine Learning Platform team, you will design and build scalable systems spanning traditional machine learning and emerging AI workloads, including model training, feature computation, real-time inference, foundation-model access, evaluation, and agentic orchestration. You’ll work at the intersection of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, applied machine learning, and AI product engineering.

This role focuses on creating secure, reliable, and reusable platform capabilities that help teams choose the right approach, from conventional predictive models to LLM-powered and multi-step agentic systems, while maintaining strong standards for evaluation, observability, governance, privacy, and cost efficiency.

In this role, you can expect to
• Design, build, and operate scalable ML and AI infrastructure on AWS.
• Design and operate shared platform capabilities for LLM and agentic workloads, including model access, prompt and configuration lifecycle, retrieval, tool integration, state management, and workflow orchestration.
• Build evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems, including offline benchmarks, regression testing, online quality signals, human feedback, and failure analysis.
• Establish observability, reliability, and governance for models and agents, covering traces, model and prompt versions, tool calls, latency, token usage, quality, safety, privacy, and cost.
• Help teams make principled architecture decisions across traditional ML, LLM-powered applications, and agentic workflows, and contribute to the platform’s technical roadmap.
• Build distributed training, batch inference, and large-scale processing systems using frameworks such as Ray or Spark.
• Build and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform.
• Support and evolve the feature store and feature pipelines.
• Develop data ingestion and streaming systems using technologies such as Kinesis, Kafka, Flink, or Spark.
• Improve CI/CD workflows for ML models, AI applications, and platform components.
• Partner closely with Data Science and ML Engineering teams to improve developer experience.
• Participate in on-call rotations to support production systems.

To thrive in this role, you have
• Knowledge of the machine learning development lifecycle, including data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
• Experience designing distributed systems and large-scale data or compute platforms on AWS using frameworks such as Spark or Ray.
• 5+ years of experience in ML or AI infrastructure, platform engineering, distributed systems, or production ML systems.
• Working knowledge of LLM application patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, tool calling, agent orchestration, and evaluation of non-deterministic systems.
• Experience designing production systems that integrate ML or foundation models through reliable APIs, workflows, and data contracts.
• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and infrastructure as code.
• Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
• Strong programming skills in Python, Go, Scala, Java, or similar languages.
• Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, version control, code review, and observability.

Nice-to-have
• Experience shipping LLM-powered or agentic systems to production.
• Experience with one or more of the following: model gateways, prompt lifecycle management, retrieval or vector search, tool execution, and agent orchestration frameworks.
• Experience building evaluation, tracing, and observability capabilities for non-deterministic AI systems.
• Familiarity with managed or self-hosted foundation model infrastructure, such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent platforms.
• Experience operating GPU-based workloads and optimizing training or inference performance and cost; CUDA experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.location: Chicago, IL, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
jobs.description:
About the role

Every Chimer’s laptop is a door into our systems, and you’d own the platform that decides whether that door opens. We’re looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to take the reins on our macOS fleet — Jamf Pro, AutoPkg, zero-touch provisioning — and to sit shoulder-to-shoulder with Security on device trust, so posture checks happen before anyone touches corporate data. We’ve built our access platform entirely in the cloud (Jamf, AutoPkg, Okta, osQuery, CrowdStrike), and there’s a lot still to define: you’ll often be the one framing the problem and getting people aligned on a direction, not waiting for a spec. You’ll report to our IT Engineering Manager and join an after-hours/on-call rotation for critical endpoint issues — we’ll walk you through exactly what that looks like during the interview process.

The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $152,000 and up to $210,000. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience

In this role, you can expect to
• Own our Jamf Pro environment end to end — configuration profiles, smart groups, policies, MDM commands, and the change standards that keep it all sane — and set the technical direction for where it goes next.
• Run the AutoPkg pipeline that gets software onto the fleet: recipes, overrides, trust verification, automated import into Jamf, plus packaging, patching, and disk encryption globally.
• Make day one work for new Chimers through zero-touch provisioning and enrollment (ADE, Setup Assistant, bootstrap workflows) that just happens without anyone filing a ticket.
• Leverage AI and automation tools to accelerate script development, troubleshoot complex endpoint issues, and scale operational workflows.
• Write the scripts and integrations (Python, Swift, Bash, Go, plus vendor APIs) that delete manual IT work — and build them so other engineers can adopt them instead of rebuilding them.
• Partner with Security to push our Zero Trust model forward, wiring device posture into Okta so device health is a real factor in authentication and app access.
• Bring our compliance story to life — CIS-style benchmarks applied with a documented, risk-based rationale, plus the metrics and reporting that show the real inventory, health, and compliance state of every device.
• Lead work that crosses IT Support, Security, and People, act as Tier 3 for the gnarliest endpoint problems, and mentor the engineers and technicians around you through documentation, guidance, and example.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 8+ years managing macOS at scale with an enterprise MDM (Jamf Pro, Kandji, Mosyle) and/or open-source tooling (Munki, Puppet, Chef).
• Real production experience with AutoPkg — building and operating recipes, overrides, trust controls, and automated promotion into an MDM.
• Familiarity with AI-assisted development and prompt engineering to drive efficiency in automation, documentation, and troubleshooting.
• Deep knowledge of Apple’s MDM protocol and Configuration Profile specs, including where Declarative Device Management is taking things.
• Command of macOS internals: installers and packages, LaunchDaemons and LaunchAgents, the preferences subsystem, system extensions, built-in security tooling (Endpoint Security Framework, SIP, XProtect, Gatekeeper, openBSM), and unified logs.
• Fluency in at least one scripting or general-purpose language (Python, Swift, Bash, Go) for automation and API work, and a solid grasp of Zero Trust / BeyondCorp and how endpoint posture feeds access decisions.
• A track record of decisions that span multiple systems, where you have to weigh scalability, compliance, cost, and what someone will have to maintain three years from now.
• Comfort in ambiguity and the communication skills to match — you can define a problem, bring stakeholders along, and write the kind of documentation that scales understanding across a distributed team. Bonus points if you bring Jamf Certified Admin (300/400), Terraform or other IaC for SaaS and MDM config, osQuery/CrowdStrike experience, Okta device trust integrations, or Windows endpoint management (Intune, PowerShell, MSI packaging) — Windows is a smaller slice of our fleet.

jobs.description:
About the role

Chime’s Lending org builds the products and platforms that give members access to fair, transparent credit and liquidity when they need it most, from Earned Wage Access through MyPay, to flexible overdraft with SpotMe, to longer-term Instant Loans, and the platforms that power credit decisions, funding, repayments, and servicing behind the scenes.

We operate some of Chime’s most consequential systems. Our teams build real-time money movement and decisioning infrastructure at scale, including underwriting and eligibility, ledgering and reconciliation, capital markets workflows, repayment systems, and financial transactions that must be correct, resilient, and auditable.

As a Software Engineer in Lending, you’ll work at the seam between member-facing products and the platforms that make them possible. This is a role for engineers who want to own more than a single service or feature area. You’ll lead technical initiatives that cut across products, platforms, and partner teams, helping shape how Lending evolves as a system, not just how one team ships.

You’ll design and build backend systems where correctness, reliability, speed, and operational rigor matter deeply. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Risk, Data Science, Analytics, Finance, and Operations to turn ambiguous opportunities into durable solutions, influence technical direction across team boundaries, and help raise the bar for how Lending engineers build together.

Why join Lending?

Work on systems that matter

The products and platforms we build directly impact millions of members and sit at the center of Chime’s mission to help everyday people unlock financial progress. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

Own a bigger surface area

This role is designed for engineers who want broader scope. You won’t be limited to a narrow feature lane. You’ll work across product experiences and shared infrastructure, helping connect strategy, systems, and execution across Lending.

Build where product and platform meet

Some of the most interesting engineering work happens in the seams: where member experience depends on credit strategy, where product velocity depends on platform leverage, and where financial correctness meets business speed. This role sits in the middle of those seams and gives you meaningful influence over how they scale.

Operate in a fast-moving, high-accountability environment

Lending is a fast-paced fintech environment where we care about moving quickly and building well. We value thoughtful design, strong engineering judgment, high-quality code, and operational excellence. We also actively use AI where it can improve quality, speed, and leverage.

In this role, you can expect to
• Independently own and deliver features end-to-end
• Design, develop, test, refactor and scale backend implementations of new and existing consumer product features
• Work with the mobile team to design and build strong, resilient APIs that power the member facing mobile app
• Collaborate with cross functional teams to understand member pain points and come up with solutions
• Proactively identify opportunities for improving the reliability and scalability of our systems
• Work across the engineering team to improve and uphold high technical standards
• Grow into owning larger components of the system over time

To thrive in this role, you have
• 3+ years building and operating production software at scale
• Experience with Ruby on Rails (or comparable frameworks) designing and running APIs
• Strong grasp of relational databases and caching, including safe schema changes/migrations
• Familiarity with distributed systems fundamentals (async processing, idempotency, retries, backfills) and exposure to high-scale architectural patterns
• Commitment to maintainable, well-tested code — including improving existing systems, not just shipping new ones
• Excellent cross-functional communication: clarifying requirements, weighing tradeoffs, delivering incrementally
• Curiosity about how things work, with a product mindset geared toward experimentation and measuring impact
• Interest in data-driven systems and third-party data integration (fintech/risk experience a plus)
• Start-up experience a plus

The Financial Crimes Senior Analyst is responsible for the oversight of KYC and watchlist screening operations, including OFAC, to identify false positives and positive matches.

• Reaches out to customers to understand customer behavior and to obtain any additional details pertinent to evaluating activities under review, if needed.

jobs.title: Sr. Growth Product Marketing Manager, Chime Enterprise
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're hiring a Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to own and drive measurable growth outcomes across Chime Enterprise's B2B2C funnel — the path that turns eligible employees at our employer partners into enrolled, funded, and engaged Chime members.

Chime Enterprise is Chime's B2B business, with a vision to be the premier HR benefits platform dedicated to holistic financial wellness. Our flagship product, Chime Workplace, gives employers an all-in-one financial wellness suite at no cost — spanning capital management (including MyPay at Work), capital growth, credit building, and rewards and loyalty (Salt). Sales and Customer Success win and onboard employer partners; once a partner is live, we gain access to their workforce — their eligible employees. Converting those eligible employees into Chime members is the challenge this role owns, and mastering it unlocks one of the most powerful and defensible distribution channels at Chime.

This role is embedded directly within the cross-functional Chime Enterprise growth effort and operates as the growth owner, not just a marketing advisor. You'll sit at the intersection of growth strategy, experimentation, performance analysis, and product marketing craft: identifying opportunities, prioritizing and running experiments, and driving metric movement against clear goals. While the role retains core product marketing strengths — research, positioning, and messaging — it goes further by owning results and tradeoffs.

In this role, you can expect to

Growth Ownership Strategy
• Own end-to-end growth strategy and outcomes for Chime Enterprise's employee-side funnel, from opportunity sizing through roadmap delivery against quarterly and annual goals.
• Serve as the embedded growth lead for Enterprise, co-owning planning with Enterprise Product, Engineering, and Analytics and with Growth Marketing's channel teams.
• Build a repeatable model for converting eligible employees into members that scales across partners rather than being rebuilt deal by deal.

Funnel Experimentation
• Drive performance across the B2B2C funnel — worksite awareness, enrollment, funding, direct deposit, and early retention — with deep ownership of employer landing pages, eligibility flows, and in-product onboarding.
• Own the Enterprise experimentation roadmap, designing reads that hold up at partner-sized cohorts and deciding what to scale, iterate, or sunset.
• Lead creative and messaging execution for experiments and launches across paid, lifecycle, and owned surfaces.

Offers Qualified Acquisition
• Own incentives, promotions, and offers that drive qualified acquisition of primary banking relationships — balancing cost per enrollment, activation quality, and long-term value, within partner agreement and compliance guardrails.
• Partner with Lifecycle to connect enrollment, onboarding, and retention into one journey.

GTM Measurement
• Lead GTM for employer launches, building the playbooks, campaign kits, and reporting that Sales, Customer Success, and GTM/Ops reuse at every go-live.
• Track pacing against goals and translate results into clear briefs and recommendations for Enterprise and Growth Marketing leadership.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 8+ years of experience in growth marketing, product marketing, performance marketing, or a related role (level dependent).
• Proven experience driving measurable growth through experimentation and optimization, including owning a funnel metric end to end.
• Experience marketing to end users through a partner, employer, or channel relationship — B2B2C, workplace or benefits marketing, marketplace, or embedded distribution — and comfort operating when you don't fully control the audience or the channel.
• Strong analytical skills; ability to define success metrics, track performance, extract insights, and reason clearly about statistical confidence when sample sizes are constrained.
• Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams, plus commercial partners like Sales and Customer Success.
• Strong storytelling and communication skills — able to translate insights into action, and to speak credibly to both internal stakeholders and external HR partners.
• Strong executive communications and the ability to influence and instill confidence.
• Nice to have:

HR tech, benefits, payroll, or earned wage access experience; familiarity with tools like Looker, Braze or Customer.io, and web experimentation platforms; comfort operating in a regulated environment.

About the Role

As a Senior Instructional Designer, you will join Chime’s Operations and Member Experience Learning Development team to design highly engaging, interactive, and modern learning strategies and experiences for our agents across our BPOs. You will apply your knowledge of adult learning methodologies to drive business outcomes through the development of a broad range of innovative learning solutions (e.g. instructor-led, virtual instructor-led, digital, self-paced, micro-learning, social learning) that promote transfer, retention, and application. You are a creative and analytical problem solver, and you have a passion for customer service. 

Your work - execution and continuous improvement - will impact thousands of BPO employees and millions of Chime members. This role requires someone who thrives in a flat, fast-moving organization using lightweight processes, creative ideas, and quick iteration to make a significant impact. 

In this role, you can expect to
• Act as a learning consultant to our Disputes Experience line of business; gaining a deep understanding of the business and metrics to craft and recommend learning strategies to drive strong business outcomes.
• Proactively collaborate with team members, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to identify training needs and objectives.
• Flex your analytical muscle to evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs and uncover opportunities to enhance agent skills and performance through learning
• Apply adult learning principles and instructional design standard methodologies to create engaging interactive learning solutions and compelling course content, material/media (audio, video, simulations, games, etc.)
• Own the end-to-end design and development of learning content, including modes of assessment to measure the effectiveness and application of training.
• Analyze and apply trends and standard methodologies in instructional design and learning technologies to continue to elevate all agents' learning experiences.
• Design learning that reflects an understanding of the diversity of learning styles to ensure that your learning solutions resonate with our increasingly global and diverse audience. 

To thrive in this role, you have
• You have an eye for design, a serious obsession with learning and a proven ability to tie learning events to measurable outcomes that reflect our mission and culture.
• Subject matter expertise in adult learning theory and instructional design best practices in all modalities with the ability to convert strategies to effective and engaging learning experiences.
• 7+ years of experience designing and developing multi-modality learning (eLearning, instructor-led, video, etc.), including system simulations, branching scenarios, and other in-depth e-learning solutions
• Experience analyzing source material and creating design documents to share with developers
• Experience leveraging AI tools in your daily workflow to accelerate learning outputs, while evaluating those outputs to maintain learning quality and business outcomes
• Experience working in an agile and waterfall (ADDIE) design environment
• Excellent communication and relationship skills with strong capabilities to partner with team members across all levels.
• Strong data analysis skills with experience designing an evaluation strategy using data/metrics to meet business and learning objectives and drive performance improvements.
• Demonstrated experience designing and developing high-impact blended learning solutions in 2 or more learning authoring tools: i.e. Articulate 360 (Rise Storyline), Camtasia, Adobe Captivate, Adobe Premiere Pro, iSpring Suite, Canva, etc.
• Ability to create and manage clear project plans outlining stakeholder responsibilities, timelines, needs, and risks.
• Experience driving outcomes through vendor partnerships and contact centers is a plus.
• Strong aptitude in graphic design, video and audio production is a plus.
• Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally, approx. 10% of the time.

jobs.title: Staff AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role

Chime's Data Science Machine Learning team builds the models, services, and platforms behind how millions of members manage and grow their financial lives. We're hiring a Staff AI/ML Engineer on our Lending and Cashflow team to lead the modeling behind cash flow underwriting and surface member insight: using members' transaction and deposit data to make fair, accurate credit decisions for people that traditional credit scores often miss.

In this role, you'll build and deploy machine learning systems on some of the richest transactional and behavioral data in fintech, turning it into the credit decisions behind products like MyPay, Instant Loans, and SpotMe. This is a highly applied role: you'll own problems end to end, from framing the question through to a model running in production and moving a metric that matters, and you'll set the technical direction for how Chime underwrites with cash flow data.

In this role, you can expect to
• Lead the design, training, and deployment of deep learning and classical ML underwriting models that turn members' transaction and cash flow data into credit decisions, from approval and line assignment to loss forecasting
• Take models from problem framing through to production — training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration — and stay accountable for how they behave once they're live
• Design and improve the systems around the model: feature pipelines, batch and real-time inference, monitoring, and retraining
• Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Risk to turn ambiguous business problems into ML solutions, and to make sure the solution is the right one
• Connect model performance to member outcomes and business metrics, and use experimentation to prove impact
• Set the technical roadmap for Lending ML and raise the bar across the team through design reviews, mentorship, and shared standards for model development, validation, and governance
• Help identify where AI/ML creates measurable impact for members — and where a simpler answer is the better one

To thrive in this role, you have
• A track record of leading the design and deployment of deep learning models in production, including multi-quarter initiatives that span teams, with a solid grasp of architecture choice, training dynamics, and evaluation, and the judgment to make model design choices
• Solid machine learning fundamentals: classical modeling, evaluation design, and knowing which metric actually answers the question in front of you
• Hands-on experience across the end-to-end ML lifecycle — training, experimentation, optimization, deployment, and monitoring
• Comfort with messy real-world data, including label definition, leakage, class imbalance, and train/serve skew
• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and distributed compute such as Spark or PySpark
• Working knowledge of modern ML infrastructure — AWS and tools such as SageMaker, Airflow, Kafka, Redis, and Snowflake — and an MLOps mindset for keeping production systems healthy
• The ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments, influence technical direction beyond your own team, and explain model decisions clearly to engineers, risk partners, and senior leaders

Nice-to-have

Experience in either of these is a plus:
• Credit or underwriting models, and familiarity with model governance, explainability, and fairness requirements, such as adverse action reason codes and fair lending testing
• Cash flow or alternative-data underwriting: building credit features from bank transaction data, such as income and expense detection, balance trends, and transaction categorization
• Deployed transformer models in production

About the role

Chime is looking for an engineering leader to help manage and guide one of the Cards engineering teams within the Spending, Saving Investing (SSI) organization. SSI is on a mission to make Chime the top choice for everyday spending by building innovative, reliable, and member-first financial tools. Our work empowers members to manage their money with confidence, spend smarter, and improve their long-term financial health.

We're hiring Tech Lead Managers (TLM) for multiple squads in Cards. In this role, you can expect to
• Manage and develop a squad of 4-5 engineers: Hiring, 1:1s, career coaching, managing for performance
• Own delivery for your squad end to end, from sprint planning and delivery commitments through service SLAs and operational health
• Write and ship code alongside your team, authoring pull requests that land in production
• Be accountable for the squad's technical direction, architecture, and quality bar, either via a tech lead on the squad, or by taking on the tech lead role yourself.
• Use AI coding agents and tooling to raise both your own leverage and your squad's, and establish the practices that make that durable for the team

• Build growth paths for the engineers on your squad towards the higher IC levels or a future TLM role
• Contribute to broader SSI and Chime engineering initiatives as a member of the engineering leadership team

To thrive in this role, you have
• 2+ years in people management responsibilities.
• Current, hands-on coding ability and the desire to keep it. You are writing code today and want a role where that continues.
• A track record of using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor to accelerate real delivery, and of getting a team to adopt them with measurable impact on output

As a Tech Lead Manager within our Growth and Marketing team, you will lead a talented group of data scientists and machine learning engineers to develop innovative growth and marketing models. jobs.title: Tech Lead Manager, Platform
jobs.description:
About the role

We're looking for a Technical Lead Manager (TLM) to lead our CI/CD team, the group that owns how every Chime engineer builds, integrates, and safely ships code. Your team owns the integration and delivery surface: source and code intelligence (GitHub, Sourcegraph), continuous integration and build (CircleCI, Qlty), artifacts (Artifactory), and the release-safety layer that gets changes to production without breaking it. Your team's mission is continuous, safe, reliable, and efficient integration and delivery of features. Every merge and every deployment at Chime runs through what your team builds.

This is a player-coach role. Under Chime's Builder Operating Model, the TLM is a single accountable owner at the team level. You own both delivery and people for a small team, and you stay hands-on in the codebase. You'll spend about 40%+ of your time building, authoring PRs that land in production, with the remainder split across people management, planning, and other business processes. You'll lead a team of 4 engineers, own the roadmap for a high-leverage platform surface, and be directly accountable for the reliability of the pipelines and release systems in the critical path of every Chime team. You're expected to use AI coding agents and workflows to keep planning, operations, and delivery overhead low so you can stay in the code and operate the team.

In this role, you can expect to
• Build and ship, hands-on. Author and review PRs that land in production. Own the team's technical direction, architecture, and quality bar; partner with senior ICs and lead technical design discussions and technical planning.
• Lead and grow the team. Own full people management for the team: 1:1s, career coaching, performance feedback, promotion decisions, and hiring. Build an inclusive, high-trust team and own its health and engagement. Mentor engineers toward Staff or a future TLM path.
• Own the CI/CD platform. Set direction and delivery for the build and integration systems (GitHub, CircleCI, Artifactory, Sourcegraph, Qlty etc): fast, reliable, self-service pipelines with strong documentation and low-friction adoption so every product team ships faster with less support burden.
• Be accountable for safe delivery at scale. Own the release-safety toolkit (Release Guard, canaries and progressive delivery, feature flagging with Tuner, and rollback) and the operational discipline behind it: incident prevention, incident response, SLAs, and blameless learning for systems in the critical path of every deploy.
• Balance the platform-team tension. Weigh new capabilities against keep-the-lights-on work, security remediation, and dependency upgrades, and make those trade-offs legible to engineers, cross-functional partners, and leadership.
• Champion AI-driven velocity. Use AI coding agents and tooling to scale yourself and your team across planning, coding, and ops/triage, and introduce workflows that measurably improve team velocity.
• Own cross-functional coordination. Serve as the XFN point of contact for your platform's capabilities. Coordinate inbound requests and outbound dependencies, partner with client engineering teams and sibling platform teams (Release Enablement, Developer Foundations) on scope and delivery commitments, and tie-break technical decisions.
• Partner across the Platform Org. Work closely with product engineering teams, security, Core Infrastructure, and other Engineering Services leaders on shared roadmaps, dependencies, and other initiatives.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 5+ years of software engineering experience and 2+ years leading or managing engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development, with the appetite and ability to stay hands-on in the codebase.
• A track record of delivering CI/CD, build/release, or developer-productivity systems: continuous integration, build pipelines, artifact management, or progressive delivery.
• Hands-on experience with CI systems (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or comparable), build pipelines, and artifact management in production (must-have).
• Hands-on technical depth you can still exercise: you author and review production PRs and can lead technical design, not just delegate it. Strong development experience in Ruby, Go, Python, or comparable languages.
• Experience with progressive and safe delivery: canaries, release gating, feature flagging, and rollback strategies.
• Strong understanding of operating production systems at scale: reliability, observability, incident response, and the operational discipline platform ownership demands.
• The judgment to balance delivery velocity against safety, reliability, and technical-debt realities, and the communication skills to make those trade-offs clear to engineers and executives alike.
• Demonstrated use of AI coding agents and tooling to accelerate development and team velocity, with a concrete example of the impact on your team's output.
• A customer-obsessed mindset toward internal developers. You measure success by the productivity and reliability experienced by the engineers who build on your platform.
• Excellent written and verbal communication and a collaborative, low-ego approach to cross-team leadership.
• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Argo CD, or GitOps-based deployment in production.

Nice to haves
• Experience with code intelligence and quality tooling (Sourcegraph, Artifactory, code-quality and linting systems).
• Familiarity with common monitoring, logging, and observability platforms (e.g., Datadog).
• Experience in financial services or other high-reliability, regulated environments.

jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a Senior Associate, Compliance Model Governance on the Compliance team, you'll own quantitative testing, monitoring, and data quality for the AI and statistical models that power Coinbase's financial crime compliance programs, including transaction monitoring models. You'll sit between Compliance, Data Science, and Engineering, designing the tests, building the pipelines and dashboards that track model health, and ensuring every model in production is defensible to Internal Audit and regulators.

What you'll do:
• Design and execute quantitative testing for AI and ML models before and after launch, including input data quality testing, variance and stability testing, and performance testing for agentic and LLM-based systems, producing documentation that holds up to independent model validation and regulatory examination.
• Build and maintain monitoring pipelines and dashboards that track model inputs, outputs, and downstream outcomes (e.g., SAR performance metrics), applying statistical tests to detect drift and degradation and delivering clear health readouts to model owners and Compliance leadership.
• Own data lineage for compliance-critical data elements, designing data quality checks that feed Compliance's data quality control framework and partnering with Engineering to trace data from source systems to control consumption.
• Write production-quality SQL and Python pipelines, diagnosing and fixing pipeline bugs and leading data migrations that support external regulatory reporting.
• Build detective monitoring scenarios that test whether compliance controls are working, writing and validating the underlying SQL logic.
• Prepare testing evidence, model documentation, and walkthroughs for Internal Audit, model validators, and regulators, responding to findings and tracking remediation to closure.

Required Skills and

Experience:
• 4+ years of experience in data science, model risk, quantitative analytics, or data engineering, ideally in financial services, fintech, or another regulated setting.
• Strong grounding in applied statistics (hypothesis testing, drift and stability measures, sampling, confidence intervals) with hands-on experience evaluating ML models, including testing LLM-based or agentic systems (e.g., accuracy against human-reviewed samples, variance across runs, input and payload monitoring).
• Advanced SQL and Python skills with experience building monitoring dashboards and working in cloud data environments (e.g., Snowflake or Databricks), including data lineage tracing and data quality rule design.
• Demonstrated ability to write testing and model documentation that withstands independent review, and to communicate technical results clearly to non-technical compliance stakeholders and auditors.
• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

The Enterprise Architecture team turns business objectives into technology decisions across Coinbase's business systems including custom-developed, third-party applications, and agentic automations, partnering with business functions and engineering teams to buy, build, and scale software applications with a focus on design patterns, technical debt, and security. • Cybersecurity: Proficient in security best practices including authentication, authorization, encryption, integration key management, and logging.
• Technical Debt Management: Significant experience in leading efforts to identify, monitor, and strategically reduce technical debt across the enterprise.

Être une banque traditionnelle n’est tout simplement pas notre genre. Alors nous relevons le défi de faire preuve de créativité en offrant des solutions bancaires novatrices aux Canadiens.
 
Comment? Avec une équipe talentueuse de challengers curieux qui savent s’adapter et remettre en question le statu quo. Si redéfinir l’avenir des services bancaires vous tient à cœur et que vous souhaitez le faire en ayant du plaisir, cette occasion pourrait être idéale pour vous.

Our team is made up of inquisitive and agile minds that find smarter ways of doing things. If you’re not afraid of taking on big challenges and redefining the future, you belong with us. La personne assure également la gestion des appels entrants et accompagne les clients dans le cadre des enquêtes en cours, en veillant à ce que les incidents potentiels soient adéquatement analysés, documentés, suivis et escaladés conformément aux procédures établies.
 
En tant qu’expert-conseil en matière de prévention de la fraude, le titulaire contribue à l’identification et à la réduction des risques criminels grâce à une approche rigoureuse, structurée et basée sur l’analyse de renseignements. Il participe activement à la détection des tendances, à la production d’analyses et à la génération d’informations stratégiques, tout en assurant le respect des politiques internes, des normes de conformité et du programme de prévention de la fraude d’EQ Bank.

They will provide subject matter expertise and oversight of criminal risk by following a disciplined and intelligence-based approach to detection and research of activities and events in alignment with EQ Bank’s fraud program and standards to ensure compliance as well as support trending, analysis and insights generation.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States
jobs.description:
Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. Since we launched Mercury in 2019, our customer base has grown to over 400,000 startups and small businesses from all around the world. At our core, we believe that everyone deserves access to the solutions they need to help their businesses thrive.

As a Sales Development Representative at Mercury, you'll be the first point of contact for founders and finance teams exploring our products. You'll research and prioritize inbound and outbound leads, run thoughtful outreach across email, phone, and LinkedIn, and have discovery conversations to understand what each prospect needs. When there's a fit, you'll hand qualified opportunities to our Account Executives and work closely with them to sharpen our messaging and improve how we find and win customers.

There's no better seat from which to learn how businesses work. You'll talk to founders every day, build real fluency in business banking* and the broader finance stack, and see how a high-growth company turns pipeline into revenue. We put a lot of effort into helping our SDRs grow, with hands-on coaching, clear expectations, and a defined path to what's next. If you're ambitious, coachable, and excited to build a career in tech sales or beyond, this is a place to start and a place to stay.

This might be the right role for you if:
• You’re the kind of person who thrives on hitting targets metrics.
• Your aspirations are focused on becoming the top-performing salesperson in the industry.
• Hearing “no” doesn’t scare you, it only fires up your motivation. You remain relentlessly optimistic, always fueled with energy and determination.

You will:
• Be the face of our company, reaching out to potential customers and introducing them to Mercury.
• Conduct research to identify and target potential customers while collaborating with the sales team to develop and implement outreach strategies.
• Cold call, social and email prospecting to generate interest and schedule meetings.
• Qualify leads to ensure they meet our ideal customer profile.
• Build relationships with prospects to understand their needs and pain points and schedule meetings with the sales team.

jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍 Barcelona, Spain | 💰 Base salary for this role is depending on experience + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits 
Hybrid model: 3 days a week in the office

 ⭐ Our Mobile Engineering team

 

Our mobile engineers have a variety of different backgrounds

There are ~60 Android engineers at Monzo and we’re looking for more to join the team. We have several non-graduates; only some of us studied Computer Science; some of us have worked in huge companies; some have only ever worked in startups; others are former consultants. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you.

 Monzo works in small, interdisciplinary teams

We have around 650 engineers out of roughly 5,500 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.

 

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

We’re searching for product-focused Android engineers to evolve our native mobile app. You’ll take pride in building polished user experiences, and you’ll balance the need for well-tested resilient code with moving fast and iterating. 

You’ll be working on a product that is a part of day to day life for more than 11 million people already, and your work here will shape the way that people interact with their finances.

As an Android Engineer at Monzo you'll work in a small, autonomous product squad alongside iOS Engineers, Backend Engineers, User Researchers, Product Designers, Product Managers, QA Testers, and Data Scientists.

You and your team will be responsible for an overall company goal, rather than building a specific feature - you'll have the opportunity to have impact on both what we build, and how we build it. Mobile engineers at Monzo work on everything from the personal banking product to customer support tools. We also have a small mobile platform squad dedicated to enabling other engineers to move faster.

Every week we meet as an Android discipline to discuss tools, techniques, problems we're encountering across the company and work together to improve our codebase and processes.

You'll report to an engineering manager who will meet with you every 1-2 weeks 1:1. They’re dedicated to helping you grow and develop as an engineer.

Our Android app

Our app is 100% Kotlin, built using MVVM (Model View ViewModel) and Coordinators, and modularised by product feature.

We use RxJava, Retrofit and Moshi for API calls and Dagger for dependency injection. We’re starting to use Coroutines for most new features. Room is our choice for persistence, and we use repositories for interacting with data. We’ve built out our design system with Compose. 

We use GitHub Pull Requests to do code reviews, and write unit tests for our ViewModels, Coordinators, and any other classes which contain logic. We write tests for all of our Compose screens and snapshot test them with Happo. We also use Espresso to test flows, which are executed via our continuous integration system.

We’ve previously written about building Monzo Chat on Android, which goes into detail on some of these elements.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…
• You care about the impact your work has on our customers, and optimise for outcomes rather than the number of lines of code you output
• You’re excited about and have experience in programming in Kotlin
• You’ve shipped and iterated on at least one app in the Play Store
• You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
• You love turning excellent design into beautiful products
• You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
• You have an understanding computer science principles

We're on the look out for L30 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our Engineering Progression Framework you will be interviewed across the whole framework, so if you're not sure what level you're aiming for chat to your recruiter!

Our interview process involves three main stages:
• Initial Call
• Take home task or pair coding exercise
• Final interview including a system design and a behavioural interview 

This process should take around 2-3 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

There’s a detailed blog on the interview process, for extra details, hints and tips.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. 

If you're successful in applying for this role, we'll work with you to find a start date. In some cases, there might be a delay in when you can be released from your current role so that we can make sure things continue to run smoothly. We’ll be sure to communicate this with you and keep you updated.

This role sits at the heart of our Control Discipline change agenda, building the controls product platform that powers safe growth at Monzo.

At Monzo, we don’t treat risk and controls as a bureaucratic governance process. We treat our control framework, tools, and data pipelines as an internal product - designed to give engineers, product managers, and business leads the ability to ship fast - and safely.

We are looking for a Senior Controls Product Manager to join our newly established Controls Product Enablement team within our Controls Discipline. Sitting at the intersection of Product, Risk, Data, and Engineering, you will act as the Product Lead for Monzo’s core risk lifecycles (Issues, RCSAs, Controls, Policy, Reg Traceability). 

You won't just write requirement docs for someone else to build - you are a builder yourself. You’ll prototype low-code tools, leverage AI models, interrogate data pipelines, and architect automated workflows to turn manual risk friction into seamless, automated self-service.

⭐ Our Controls team

The role will sit within the Controls Product Enablement team which is part of the wider Controls Discipline in Monzo’s 1st line of defence Our teams work closely with cross-functional teams across the organisation including Technology, Data, Product, Operations as well and Risk Compliance (the 2nd line of defence). 

As this is a newly established team (wherein you’ll have two direct reports already working in the team as data and automation specialists), this role holder needs to bring a flexible and adaptable mindset, as well as a willingness to deal with ambiguity as the team establishes its operating rhythm and embeds itself within the wider business.

🔑 What you’ll do (Your Product Ownership Scope)…
• Own the Controls Product Roadmap: Define the vision, strategy, and backlog for Monzo’s internal risk products, replacing static, manual cycles with smart, data-driven platforms (SmartSuite, Zango, Looker, and native AI integrations).
• Hands-on Prototyping Automation: Directly design, prototype, and build automated workflows, API integrations, and low-code/no-code solutions. You'll take an idea from a problem statement to a working MVP before partnering with core Engineering (if necessary) to scale or industrialise it.
• Pioneer AI in Risk Management: Champion AI adoption across the discipline. Experiment with LLM prompting, custom agents, and automated evidence-gathering tools to solve complex control problems and dramatically reduce manual drag for Monzo staff.
• Build for Real-Time Risk Intelligence: Drive the shift from annual "point-in-time" assessments to continuous, automated monitoring. Design data triggers (e.g., incident spikes, change flags) that alert risk owners in real time.
• Product Enablement Adoption: Ensure high-impact adoption. Work closely with first line risk owners and Risk Partners to deliver clear "write once" guidance, intuitive UI/UX workflows, and enablement that allows teams to self-serve effortlessly.
• Drive Execution Delivery: Maintain momentum across the team’s delivery plan (guiding 2 specialised data/automation direct reports), keeping senior stakeholders engaged and removing blockers without bureaucratic overhead.

jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£79,000 - £93,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

About the team:

Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Model Validation team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Model Validation Manager to join us!

Our Credit Model Validation team provides independent oversight and challenge to our model development teams in the first line of defence. We help Monzo grow safely and make sure the models we use are fit for purpose, appropriately governed and deliver good outcomes for our customers. You’ll join our validation squad and provide expert independent validation and oversight across a broad suite of credit models.

This is a generalist role rather than one focused on a particular model type. You’ll work across models used for impairment, capital, stress testing, forecasting and credit decisioning, including IFRS 9 PD, LGD, EAD and economic response models; decision science scorecards and origination PD models; and Net Present Value (NPV) / unit economics models.

Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is broad expertise in credit risk modelling and model risk management. You’ll have hands-on experience in model validation and/or development within financial services, and be comfortable getting into the data and code to form an independent view across different model types.

Your day-to-day
• Leading hands-on independent validation across Monzo’s credit model portfolio - covering models used for IFRS 9 impairment, capital and stress testing, forecasting, credit decisioning and unit economics - and making sure they are fit for purpose, appropriately governed and performing as expected
• Reviewing and challenging key model-led credit risk assessments, including impairment adequacy, ICAAP and stress testing, using independent analysis to assess assumptions, limitations and impacts
• Developing a deep understanding of Monzo’s credit models and how they are used, and using this to provide impactful input and challenge to model developers and users
• Contributing to making model validation more consistent, scalable and technology-enabled - building reusable analytical tools and tests, experimenting with AI-assisted approaches and helping the team embed them safely
• Reviewing ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure our lending models perform within our risk thresholds, and providing support to our first line of defence teams when action is required
• Performing statistical analyses, model replication and challenger work where appropriate to test assumptions, assess performance and strengthen validation conclusions
• Improving and helping to embed our Model Risk Framework, including our policies, standards, model inventory, governance and validation approach. This means making sure we follow up-to-date regulatory expectations and that our processes remain proportionate and relevant as modelling techniques evolve
• Writing clear and impactful model validation reports, and presenting the findings and actions in relevant committees
• Partnering with colleagues in first line of defence credit strategy, modelling and finance teams - and with wider risk teams across Monzo - to support effective model governance and consistent validation standards across the organisation

You should apply if you:
• Have a strong background and practical experience in credit model development and/or validation across a range of model types. You’ll have meaningful experience with IFRS 9 impairment, Internal Ratings Based (IRB) or other capital models, alongside broader exposure to several areas such as stress testing, economic response, forecasting, decision science scorecards or NPV / unit economics modelling
• Understand model risk management in practice, including independent validation, model governance, ongoing monitoring, model change and issue management, and how regulatory expectations apply across the model lifecycle
• Are impact-driven and want to improve how validation is done, not only complete individual reviews. You can turn repeatable work into practical methods, tools or guidance that improve quality and consistency across the team.
• Are curious about AI and automation, and can assess where they add value, the risks they introduce, and the controls and human oversight needed. Experience with AI-assisted analytical or coding tools is useful, but not essential
• Are data driven, with strong analytical skills and deep knowledge of statistical techniques for credit and model risk. Strong SQL and Python skills are essential. You can produce clear, reusable and tested code, using collaborative practices such as version control, peer review and documentation. Experience with Tableau, Looker or similar is a plus.
• Can assess models in the context of how they are used - including accounting, capital, credit strategy, risk appetite and customer outcomes - and can distinguish technical model performance from the wider risks of relying on the model
• Have strong written and verbal communication skills, and are able to articulate problems and solutions using clear and simple language. This is particularly important for breaking down complex issues and priorities to non-experts
• Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and can provide effective and respectful challenge

Our technology stack

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):
• Google Cloud Platform for all of our analytics infrastructure
• dbt and BigQuery SQL for our data modelling and warehousing
• Python for data science and machine learning
• Go to write our application code
• AWS for most of our backend infrastructure

The interview process:

Our interview process usually involves up to four main stages via Google Meet:
• An initial call with our recruiter
• A call with our Senior Model Validation Manager, the hiring manager for the role
• A role-specific call with colleagues from our credit modelling and model risk teams. We’ll share a short case study in advance, but you won’t need to submit a written response; we’ll use it to guide the discussion during the interview.
• A behavioural interview
• 🙌 What’s in it for you

• 📍 This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

• Has delivery experience and is able to guide the squads in achieving their outcomes.
• Focuses on outcomes over processes, who optimises for the highest impact and leverage.
• Is able to input, understand and challenge engineering decisions - but to empower the team to make those decisions themselves
• Has an understanding of what good looks like for a high-performing team of engineers and ability to chart a course to get there
• Is able to to coach people to achieve their goals
• Has a natural ability to inspire and motivate a team

At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead marketing strategy and execution, to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we aim to build and market category-leading products. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.

This is a player/coach role. You'll own Product Marketing for a Collective: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and guiding how launches land in the market. If you love influencing what gets built as much as how it's communicated, you'll feel at home here.

Where you could join:
• Wealth is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new kinds of wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work to make growing money (finally) feel simpler and more useful for everyday customers.
• MonzOS is the intelligence layer of Monzo: an AI-powered operating system that helps customers find the right product, insight or action at the right moment. It brings together personalisation, recommendations, search and in-app discovery to make Monzo feel more useful every time someone opens the app. This is a role for someone who is excited by the challenge of making Monzo feel simple, trusted and indispensable in people’s financial lives.
• EU is building Monzo for millions of customers across Europe, taking what people love about Monzo in the UK and making it work brilliantly in new markets. This role will lead consumer market insight and competitor discovery for new countries, while supporting growth in already-live markets like Ireland and Spain. This is a role for someone who loves figuring out how to win a market: turning customer insight, competitor analysis and local context into practical, provocative choices for product and marketing.

• Shape what gets built. You'll use market intelligence to shape product strategy across multiple areas, bringing a perspective that changes what we build and in what order. You'll sit alongside Product leadership, driving commercial outcomes through product differentiation.
• Define positioning that moves the business. You'll ensure every product starts with a customer problem, differentiated positioning, and a proposition worth talking about. You’ll demonstrate that positioning will shift customer perception and move revenue at scale.
• Own how we go to market. You'll decide when products launch, with what mechanic, and in what order, so launches across the Collective add up to more than a run of releases. You'll improve how PMM works by embedding AI into our workflows, tools, and playbooks. On the manager track, you'll also be accountable for the development, performance, and careers of a small team.

🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London or UK Remote | 💰 Senior Engineer (L50) £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Technology - Engineering 

About our Engineering Teams:

We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.

These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.

We contribute to open source software as much as possible. Our blog is a good place to learn even more about what we do!

Your day-to-day 

This role is all about collaborating with your team to make a difference to your customers. As a backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside other disciplines like product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! 

Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.

They’re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need! 

Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.

How we work 💻

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches treat Thursdays 🍽️

Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨

If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

You should apply if:
• you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product
• you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day
• you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
• you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
• you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software
• you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).
• you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing

We're on the look out for L50 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our Engineering Progression Framework - we will interview you across the whole frame work, so if you are not sure what level you are aiming for please chat to your recruiters! 

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

What you’ll be working on: 

We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge, you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below:
• Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here)
• Cassandra for most persistent data storage
• Kafka for our asynchronous message queue
• Kubernetes and Docker to schedule and run our services
• Envoy Proxy for RPC
• AWS for most of our production infrastructure and GCP for most of our data infrastructure
• React for our public web apps and internal tools
• We also have physical datacenters with actual cables to connect to various third parties

The Interview Process:

Our interview process involves three main stages:
• Initial Call
• Take home task or pair coding exercise
• Final interview: including a system design and a behavioural interview 

Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. 

One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see here.

What’s in it for you:

💰 £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

✈️We can help you relocate to the UK 

✅We can sponsor visas.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here 

 

We're usually always hiring for Backend Engineers, so there's no closing date for this job.

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.
