• Growth Pipeline Ownership: Own Meta + emerging channel budgets, CAC efficiency, conversion, and downstream pipeline/revenue across self-serve and sales-led motions.
• Signal Measurement Strategy: Partner with Data and Marketing Ops to improve conversion signals, CAPI, and offline conversion tracking, enabling platforms to optimize toward higher-quality customers.
• Structured Experimentation: Build and execute a continuous, hypothesis-driven testing framework across audiences, bidding strategies, optimization events, landing pages, and creative concepts; document learnings to turn paid social into a predictable acquisition channel.
• Full-Funnel Growth: Build paid social strategies that create demand at the top of the funnel and efficiently convert it through retargeting and lower-funnel programs.
• Creative Strategy: Translate performance data into creative hypotheses and partner with Brand and Design to test, iterate, and scale winning concepts.
• Audience Strategy: Use first-party data, intent signals, modeled audiences, lookalikes, and platform automation to identify and scale high-value audiences.
• Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Analytics, Marketing Ops, Field / Events team, PMM, and Sales to connect paid social performance programs to downstream pipeline and revenue outcomes.

Requirements
• 5+ years of growth or performance marketing experience, with deep hands-on expertise managing and scaling Meta as a primary acquisition channel.
• Demonstrated experience owning a paid social channel end to end, including strategy, budgets, forecasting, campaign architecture, optimization, and performance reporting.
• Relentlessly analytical: Deep understanding of unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback periods), attribution modeling, and how to connect platform metrics directly to down-funnel business impact.
• Experience running full-funnel paid social programs, from awareness/video and demand generation through conversion and pipeline.
• Strong expertise in audience strategy and platform automation, including first-party audiences, lookalikes, broad targeting, retargeting, and automated campaign products.
• Strong understanding of conversion signals and measurement, including Meta CAPI, server-side tracking, attribution, conversion-event strategy, and CRM/offline conversion data.
• Demonstrated experience building structured experimentation roadmaps across creative, audiences, bidding, optimization events, and new platform capabilities.
• Strong creative judgment and experience writing briefs and translating performance data into actionable creative recommendations.
• Excellent communicator who can operate autonomously and influence cross-functional partners across Brand, PMM, Design, Analytics, Engineering, Marketing Ops, and Sales.

Bonus Points
• Experience in fin-tech marketing or marketing to finance professionals.
• Familiarity with product-led growth or hybrid demand models.

Compensation

Product at Brex

 

The Product team is at the forefront of Brex's mission to empower employees anywhere to make better financial decisions. With a deep understanding of the business, we identify and scope the most impactful opportunities for Brex to tackle. We align cross-functional teams—including Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design—on key decisions, set strategy, and drive products from inception to launch.

What you’ll do

 

Travel is one of the most complex—and stressful—areas of company spend. Growing companies must keep bookings moving, travelers supported, policies enforced, payments working, and expenses organized after every trip.

As Senior Product Manager, you will own and scale Brex Travel, our integrated travel experience. You will build across discovery, booking, trip organization, group travel, servicing, payments, and reconciliation—connecting every stage to Brex Card and Expense Management.

You will turn travel technology, inventory, and servicing partners into a cohesive Brex product. Across Engineering, Design, Operations, Partnerships, and GTM, you will drive adoption, bookings, volume, and reliability while using AI to reduce traveler and administrator effort.

Where you’ll work

 

This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Own the strategy and roadmap for the Brex Travel experience.
• Build the journey across discovery, booking, trip organization, group travel, servicing, payments, and reconciliation.
• Connect Travel with Brex Card and Expense Management so booking context flows through payment and accounting.
• Turn partner technology, inventory, and servicing capabilities into a differentiated Brex product.
• Own adoption, repeat usage, bookings, travel volume, conversion, and reliability.
• Improve payment, change, disruption, and support workflows for travelers and administrators.
• Use AI across planning, booking, trip management, servicing, and reconciliation to remove work.
• Align Engineering, Design, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, Sales, and Customer Success around outcomes.

Requirements
• A track record of owning and growing an end-to-end product.
• Experience in travel, online booking, marketplaces, or another operationally complex domain.
• Strong customer judgment alongside fluency in backend systems and operations.
• Experience building on partner, platform, inventory, or servicing infrastructure.
• Quantitative ownership of adoption, bookings, volume, conversion, or comparable marketplace metrics.
• Fluency in servicing, payments, reconciliation, reliability, and exception handling.
• Practical judgment about how AI can reduce customer and operational effort.
• Travel product experience is strongly preferred; adjacent marketplace, payments, booking, or complex consumer-product experience can translate.

Compensation

 

The expected salary range for this role is $184,000 - $230,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

As the Deputy Chief Regulatory Officer, you'll serve as the second-in-command of the Market Regulation Department for Coinbase's CFTC-registered designated contract market. What you'll do:
• Own the day-to-day leadership of CDE's Market Regulation Department as second-in-command, providing continuity and decision-making in the Chief Regulatory Officer's absence
• Drive CDE's compliance posture across all applicable CFTC regulatory requirements including, but not limited to, Part 38, 39, 40 of the Commodity Exchange Act, identifying gaps and implementing corrective actions
• Lead the management of internal and external examinations and audits, coordinating responses and ensuring timely resolution of findings
• Partner with CDE trade surveillance personnel to review escalated cases, assess potential rulebook violations, and determine appropriate enforcement actions
• Strengthen cross-functional alignment by advising CDE personnel and partner teams on DCM Core Principles, CFTC regulations, and CDE's rulebook and policies

Required Skills and

Experience:
• 7+ years of experience providing compliance and regulatory support for CFTC-registered designated contract markets (DCMs) or derivatives clearing organizations (DCOs)
• Demonstrated hands-on experience interpreting and applying CFTC Parts 38, 39, and 40 in a DCM and/or DCO environment, with the ability to discuss specific regulatory requirements and their practical application to exchange operations, rulebook governance, and compliance programs.
• Demonstrated experience engaging directly with senior CFTC staff, including the Division of Market Oversight, Division of Clearing and Risk, and Market Participants Division
• Deep knowledge of CFTC Core Principles with proven ability to analyze and apply to ensure DCM maintains compliance with applicable regulations
• Strong grasp of market fundamentals, trading practices, investigative and surveillance techniques, sufficient to evaluate complex potential violations
• Proven ability to synthesize regulatory observations into clear written memoranda, reports, and information requests for stakeholders at all levels, including regulators

Finance Analytics builds Coinbase's financial data and reporting foundations so Finance, Accounting/Controllership, Treasury and FP A can run accurate, timely and auditable operations. • Accounting exposure, either formal (accounting/finance degree or coursework, CPA/CMA) or hands-on work with Accounting/FP A teams, such as supporting month-end close, reconciliations or financial reporting.
• Expert SQL (window functions, complex aggregations, optimization) and strong Python (OOP, reusable frameworks). No production ETL or SQL experience = reject.

• Modern data warehouse/lakehouse experience (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift). Snowflake is not required; no comparable warehouse experience = reject.

jobs.title: Senior People Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About People Talent

People and Talent support the entire MetaMask community. We strive to be the destination employer of choice for our ecosystem. That goal is embedded in all the work we do to attract, retain and support our amazing talent. By joining our team you'll be working with a diverse group of incredible individuals who put 'people first' and are designing and building the workplace of the future.

This role sits within our People Operations, Data Systems ('PODS') team, which operates as a cohesive, global team within People Talent. We drive operational excellence across the employee lifecycle by streamlining processes, strengthening programs and policies, and building scalable, intuitive systems that empower teams to do their best work.

We delight our customers (employees, managers, and partners) by delivering a dynamic and engaging people experience that evolves with creativity, curiosity, and accountability. Through intentional process design, thoughtful automation, and a commitment to service excellence, PODS builds scalable, sustainable people programs that support our teams and the business.

What you'll do

As a Senior People Operations Associate, you will be a day-to-day owner of global People Operations, serving as our subject matter expert for Europe, while also contributing to the programs and systems work of the PODS team and leading People Operations projects from scoping through delivery. You will manage the employee lifecycle from pre-boarding through offboarding, administer leaves, keep employee data accurate in our HR systems, and help ensure our practices remain compliant with local labor law and GDPR. Just as importantly, you will look for ways to make that work more scalable by documenting processes, enabling self-service, and applying automation and AI wherever they improve accuracy, efficiency, and the employee experience.

Employee Lifecycle Operations
• Manage end-to-end lifecycle processes globally, including pre-boarding, onboarding, employee changes, internal transfers, and offboarding.
• Prepare and process employment contracts, amendments, and new-hire documentation in line with local requirements, partnering with Legal where needed.
• Administer parental, medical, and other statutory and company leaves, as well as benefits, across multiple countries.
• Coordinate with Payroll on hires, terminations, compensation changes, and leaves to ensure timely and accurate processing.
• Partner with Employer of Record (EOR) providers and other external vendors (such as payroll, benefits, and immigration counsel) to onboard, support, and manage employees, including in countries where we do not have a local entity.
• Support immigration and relocation processes in partnership with external counsel, including tracking work authorization and ensuring documentation is complete.

HR Systems, Data Compliance
• Maintain accurate employee records in our HRIS (ADP Workforce Now), performing regular audits, reconciliations, and data cleanup.
• Serve as the subject matter expert for European labor law and data privacy requirements, including GDPR, and help ensure compliance across the countries where we operate, escalating risks appropriately.
• Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers on policy, leave, and process questions, balancing empathy with compliance.

Process Improvement, Automation Documentation
• Identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone processes and propose or implement automation and AI-enabled solutions, particularly for employee self-service and routine request management.
• Create and maintain clear documentation, including guides, FAQs, and process maps, that enable employees, managers, and the People team to self-serve.
• Lead and own global and regional People projects end to end, from scoping through delivery, such as system enhancements, policy rollouts, and support for new entity openings, working with Finance, Legal, and Payroll.

Would be great if you brought this to the role

People Operations Compliance
• Experience in People/HR Operations in a global or multi-country environment, ideally in a fast-paced or scaling organization.
• Strong working knowledge of UK and European employment practices, statutory leave, and GDPR / UK GDPR considerations.
• Hands-on experience with onboarding, offboarding, employee lifecycle changes, and leave administration.
• Familiarity with immigration processes and global hiring or relocation support is a plus.
• Experience working with Employer of Record (EOR) providers and other third-party vendors, including managing vendor relationships and resolving issues across multiple providers.
• Experience drafting, updating, and maintaining employee policies and documentation.

Systems, Data Technical Skills
• Hands-on experience with an HRIS, ideally ADP Workforce Now.
• Strong attention to detail and a track record of maintaining data integrity through audits and reconciliations.
• Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills (lookups, pivot tables, data validation) for reporting and analysis.
• Comfort experimenting with automation and AI tools, such as workflows, bots, scripting, or AI-enabled features within existing tools.

Collaboration Communication
• Clear, professional communication with employees, managers, and cross-functional partners such as Payroll and Legal.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent requests, anticipating bottlenecks before they affect deadlines.
• Discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information.
• A service-oriented mindset with the ability to balance responsiveness with thoughtful, scalable solutions.

Experience Background
• 5+ years of experience in People Operations, HR Operations, HR Administration, or a related role.
• Extensive experience supporting employees in the UK and Europe, along with exposure to other regions, is strongly preferred.
• Fluency in English is required; a second major European language is a plus.
• Comfortable working independently and driving work from idea to execution.
• Experience leading or owning projects from scoping through delivery, including coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and driving work to completion.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and improve efficiency — they do not replace human judgment. A human recruiter or hiring manager reviews every candidate, and all final hiring decisions are made by people, not AI.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cards
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.description:
As the story goes, in 1949 Frank McNamara finished dinner at a New York restaurant and found he'd left his wallet in another suit. His fix was a card that let members eat now and pay later. That card became Diners Club, widely credited as the first multipurpose charge card. It was a piece of cardboard and a promise: the restaurant trusted the card, the card trusted the member, and someone had to make sure the money actually moved.

More than seventy-five years later, the promise hasn't changed, but the machinery has. When a Mercury customer taps their card, the request goes from the merchant's terminal through an acquirer and a card network to us. In a fraction of a second, we check the balance, apply the customer's spend controls, screen for fraud and say yes or no. After that comes clearing, settlement, disputes and reporting, and every cent has to reconcile.

Cards are the way Mercury customers spend money. The Cards Integration team owns the whole Mercury card, not just the swipe: issuance, physical card shipping, spend controls, lifecycle management, authorization, money movement, settlement and reporting, and the infrastructure underneath. We're a full-stack team, and our job is to make the Mercury Debit and IO cards reliable, correct, useful, and innovative.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thinks deeply about systems architecture, cares about the customer experience, and will dive into any problem to move the team forward. We value high ownership, working in pairs and teams rather than alone, and attention to detail. Those matter when you run systems held to four nines of reliability, and everyone around you will care about them too.

In this role, you will
• Lead projects from idea to tech spec to implementation to launch, working with your PM, EM, tech lead, and teammates at each stage. When you lead a project, it's yours to see through.
• Learn how debit and credit cards actually work under the hood (authorization, clearing, settlement, disputes) and use that knowledge every day.
• Build features across the stack, from the card experiences customers use to the backend systems that move money.
• Help keep our operations excellent. Our systems are some of the most observable at Mercury, and with great observability comes great responsibility.
• Mentor other engineers and raise engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, and collaboration.
• Work with product, design, operations, risk, compliance, sales, and many other teams.

You should
• Have strong full-stack experience, a product mindset, systems thinking, and a knack for getting things across the line.
• Have made architectural decisions on complex systems, and be able to explain your reasoning and the trade-offs.
• Be excited to put new features in customers' hands, and care just as much about keeping existing ones working like a charm.
• Care about correctness in systems where failure has real financial consequences.
• Communicate clearly, handle ambiguity well, and enjoy mentoring others.
• Be comfortable with our tech stack (Haskell and TypeScript) or be ready to learn.
• Bonus: experience in fintech, payments, or card issuing.

We encourage you to try our demo site if you're interested in applying for the role.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. jobs.title: Data Scientist (Fraud)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

About this role:

We're looking for a Data Scientist to sit at the heart of how we fight fraud — building the models, experiments, and detection systems that protect millions of customers and merchants across our platform. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of machine learning, product, and engineering, where your work will directly shape how Moniepoint detects and responds to emerging fraud threats.

You are a data-driven, intellectually curious Data Scientist who is energized by hard problems in fraud and financial crime. You'll prototype and ship ML models, design experiments, and uncover new fraud signals across our ecosystem — partnering closely with engineers, product managers, and analysts to turn your work into production-grade systems.

Responsibilities:
• Prototype, evaluate, and help produce machine learning models for fraud detection; own their ongoing monitoring and retraining cycles.
• Design and run experiments to measure the impact of fraud interventions, balancing customer experience against loss reduction.
• Size fraud typologies across our product lines to inform prioritization and investment decisions.
• Build and maintain anomaly detection systems to surface novel fraud vectors before they scale.
• Work closely with fraud operations, engineers, product managers, and data analysts to translate model outputs into real-world mitigations.

Experience Background:
• A strong foundation in statistics with a degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar).
• 3+ years of experience in data science, decision science, or risk analytics within fraud, payments, or financial crime.
• Hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.
• Fraud, risk, or financial services experience is a strong plus.
• Solid grounding in data science fundamentals: experimentation, statistical inference, model evaluation, and feature engineering.
• Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams with high ownership expectations.

Skills Competencies:
• Proficiency in Python and SQL; comfort working across the full model development lifecycle.
• An investigative instinct — you enjoy digging into data to find patterns others miss.
• The ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders and translate insights into action.

What Success Looks Like

in This Role:
• Production-grade ML models and anomaly detection systems that effectively surface and mitigate novel fraud vectors before they scale.
• Well-designed experiments that successfully balance customer experience against fraud loss reduction.
• Clear sizing of fraud typologies that effectively drives product prioritization and strategic investment decisions.
• Seamless cross-functional alignment where technical model outputs are consistently translated into real-world fraud mitigations.

Why Join Us?
• Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We've built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
• Learning: We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
• Compensation: You'll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (UX)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

As a Senior Product Designer, you will shape financial experiences that millions of people rely on every day. Designing for money means designing for trust, often for people on low-end devices and unreliable internet connections, where a confusing screen can cost someone a sale. Your job is to take complex, ambiguous problems and turn them into experiences that are simple and trustworthy.

You will join one of our product teams, working either on the products our customers use on POS, mobile and web, or on the operational tools our teams use to serve them. You will work alongside a product manager and engineers, with support from researchers and content designers.

What you'll do
• Lead design for a customer-facing product or an operational tool, from discovery through launch and the improvements that follow.
• Frame the problem with your product and engineering partners before designing the solution.
• Think in systems, creating templates and patterns that can be configured and reused across products and platforms, and help evolve our design system.
• Design for accessibility and inclusion from the start, so our products work for everyone, whatever their ability, device or level of digital literacy.
• Turn complex customer and business problems into simple journeys people can trust, crafted down to the smallest detail.
• Stay with the work through build so that what ships matches what was designed, then measure its impact and keep improving it.
• Present your work with conviction and defend your decisions with clear reasoning, to designers, partners and leadership.
• Prototype early and test with real customers and real data, changing direction when the evidence says so.
• Raise the quality of design around you through critique and mentoring.

What you need to succeed
• 7+ years of product design experience, leading complex, ambiguous projects end to end with minimal direction.
• A portfolio of shipped work that shows exceptional craft and clear thinking: the problem, your role, your decisions and what changed as a result.
• A record of framing the problem with product and engineering partners, not only designing the solution.
• Strong interaction and visual design skills across mobile and web, with a sharp eye for hierarchy, typography, layout and detail.
• Strong systems thinking: you design flexible templates and reusable patterns that adapt through configuration rather than one-off screens.
• A deep commitment to accessibility and inclusive design, with strong knowledge of the standards and shipped work that shows it.
• The ability to use both research and data to inform and evaluate design decisions.
• The confidence to advocate for your design decisions and hold your ground with senior stakeholders, in writing and in person, while staying open to better evidence.
• Experience giving useful critique and helping other designers grow.
• Hands-on experience using AI tools to explore and prototype faster, while owning the judgment and the quality of the result.

Nice to have
• Experience designing for POS terminals is a strong plus.
• Experience in financial services, multiple markets or operational tools is also welcome.

What you’ll get
• A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will impact millions of users.
• Career growth opportunities.
• A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration.
• Competitive compensation and benefits.
• Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources.

What to expect in the hiring process
• Application portfolio review: we look for strong UX case studies that showcase process, research, impact, and leadership.
• Preliminary phone call with the recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, interests, and expectations.
• Interview with a design team member: a discussion about your experience, approach to design, alignment with our mission, and a portfolio walkthrough.
• Design Challenge: an advanced exercise to assess problem-solving, UX/UI craft, and strategic thinking.
• Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership about your ability to think strategically, collaborate across teams, and drive business and user impact through design.

How to apply:

Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your best work - preferably with fintech or SaaS-related projects. Your portfolio should clearly demonstrate impact, including measurable improvements in user experience, business metrics, or engagement. We want to see end-to-end product thinking, including research, wireframes, prototypes, and final execution.

jobs.title: Workforce Business Partner (Lagos)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Job Title: Workforce Business Partner (Lagos)

Reports to: Team Lead, Workforce Partner

Job Purpose

The Workforce Business Partner (WBP) serves as a strategic partner to business leaders, driving the alignment of people strategy with business priorities. This role exists to ensure that every people-related initiative — from performance enablement and workforce planning to leadership effectiveness — is executed with precision, empathy, and measurable impact.

Beyond traditional HR delivery, the WBP acts as a trusted advisor, shaping organizational health and fostering a culture of accountability, engagement, and inclusion. The role bridges the gap between business needs and people solutions, ensuring that talent is positioned as a key enabler of growth and innovation.

Key Responsibilities
• Partner with business leaders to translate organizational goals into actionable people plans that drive capability, performance, and retention.
• Lead workforce planning and organizational design discussions to ensure the right structure, roles, and talent are in place to meet current and future needs.
• Coach and influence leaders on talent strategy, performance management, and Independent Contractor engagement to strengthen leadership effectiveness and team culture.
• Act as a trusted advisor on IC relations matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and business-aligned resolutions in collaboration with the Workforce Relations COE.
• Analyze people data and insights to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, presenting data-driven recommendations to business leaders.
• Champion change management and communication strategies that support transformation, adoption, and continuous improvement within business units.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies and local labor laws while promoting a positive, high-performance culture. 

Qualifications
• 2–4 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2 years in a Business Partnership or advisory capacity.
• Demonstrated experience working in fast-paced, matrixed, or multinational environments.
• Strong understanding of core HR functions — performance management, people relations, organizational design, and workforce planning.
• Proven ability to use HR data and analytics to inform decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience supporting technical or commercial business units in a fintech, banking, or tech environment.
• Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and leading complex change initiatives.

About You
• You’re a strategic thinker who sees the big picture but executes with precision.
• You build trust quickly and communicate with empathy, clarity, and confidence.
• You thrive in ambiguity and can balance multiple stakeholders with ease.
• You’re data-driven — you make decisions grounded in insight, not intuition.
• You’re committed to continuous improvement, always seeking better ways to drive business impact through people.

What Success Looks Like
• You have established yourself as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, influencing key people and organizational decisions.
• Business units under your support demonstrate improved engagement, retention, and performance outcomes.
• You’ve delivered a measurable improvement in workforce planning accuracy and performance management effectiveness.
• Leaders actively seek your input on strategic and people-related matters, not just HR processes.
• You’ve successfully embedded at least one COE-led initiative (e.g., new policy, performance framework, or workforce process) within your business unit with strong adoption and feedback.

Why join us
• Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and impactful career growth opportunities.
• Fully remote/flexible work culture backed by continuous support for your learning and professional development.

Job Title: Workforce Business Partner (North East)

Reports to: Team Lead, Workforce Partner

Job Purpose

The Workforce Business Partner (WBP) serves as a strategic partner to business leaders, driving the alignment of people strategy with business priorities. This role exists to ensure that every people-related initiative — from performance enablement and workforce planning to leadership effectiveness — is executed with precision, empathy, and measurable impact.

Beyond traditional HR delivery, the WBP acts as a trusted advisor, shaping organizational health and fostering a culture of accountability, engagement, and inclusion. The role bridges the gap between business needs and people solutions, ensuring that talent is positioned as a key enabler of growth and innovation.

Key Responsibilities
• Partner with business leaders to translate organizational goals into actionable people plans that drive capability, performance, and retention.
• Lead workforce planning and organizational design discussions to ensure the right structure, roles, and talent are in place to meet current and future needs.
• Coach and influence leaders on talent strategy, performance management, and Independent Contractor engagement to strengthen leadership effectiveness and team culture.
• Act as a trusted advisor on IC relations matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and business-aligned resolutions in collaboration with the Workforce Relations COE.
• Analyze people data and insights to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, presenting data-driven recommendations to business leaders.
• Champion change management and communication strategies that support transformation, adoption, and continuous improvement within business units.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies and local labor laws while promoting a positive, high-performance culture. 

Qualifications
• 2–4 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2 years in a Business Partnership or advisory capacity.
• Demonstrated experience working in fast-paced, matrixed, or multinational environments.
• Strong understanding of core HR functions — performance management, people relations, organizational design, and workforce planning.
• Proven ability to use HR data and analytics to inform decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience supporting technical or commercial business units in a fintech, banking, or tech environment.
• Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and leading complex change initiatives.

About You
• You’re a strategic thinker who sees the big picture but executes with precision.
• You build trust quickly and communicate with empathy, clarity, and confidence.
• You thrive in ambiguity and can balance multiple stakeholders with ease.
• You’re data-driven — you make decisions grounded in insight, not intuition.
• You’re committed to continuous improvement, always seeking better ways to drive business impact through people.

• You have established yourself as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, influencing key people and organizational decisions.
• Business units under your support demonstrate improved engagement, retention, and performance outcomes.
• You’ve delivered a measurable improvement in workforce planning accuracy and performance management effectiveness.
• Leaders actively seek your input on strategic and people-related matters, not just HR processes.
• You’ve successfully embedded at least one COE-led initiative (e.g., new policy, performance framework, or workforce process) within your business unit with strong adoption and feedback.

Why join us
• Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and impactful career growth opportunities.
• Fully remote/flexible work culture backed by continuous support for your learning and professional development.

jobs.title: Lead Technical Product Manager — Machine Learning Platform
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager for our Machine Learning Platform within the Intelligent Operations Platforms segment. In this role, you will define the long term vision, platform architecture, and execution strategy for core Machine Learning infrastructure across N26. Your work will enable squads across the bank to automate risk assessments, prevent financial crime, and scale operational efficiency.

Our ML Platforms team serves as the central nervous system for real-time, data-driven decisioning. We build and scale horizontal ML capabilities that allow critical functions including Financial Crime, Credit Risk, and Core Operations to execute with absolute precision at scale. As a Lead Product Manager, you will drive multi-squad strategy, transforming complex predictive models into resilient, compliant, sub-second scoring systems.

In this role, you will
• Drive the Core ML Platform Vision: Define and execute the multi-year roadmap for the central Machine Learning platform, ensuring alignment with broader engineering architecture and executive business goals.
• Lead High-Volume ML Portfolios: Oversee complex predictive ML capabilities supporting high-throughput banking systems, focusing on real-time transaction monitoring, automated credit risk scoring, and operational workflow decisioning.
• Scale Enterprise MLOps Infrastructure: Own the platform tooling and standards across the full ML lifecycle. Drive strategic decisions around feature stores, real-time feature extraction pipelines, model registries, automated retraining triggers, and CI/CD for ML.
• Establish Model Evaluation and Governance: Define robust offline and online model evaluation frameworks, shadow deployment mechanics such as champion and challenger testing, and real-time monitoring for model drift, inference latency, and data quality degradation.
• Bridge Technical Leadership and Compliance: Partner closely with Principal Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Security, and Legal stakeholders to ensure models meet strict European banking governance, explainability, and auditability standards.
• Elevate and Mentor the PM Function: Serve as a functional leader within the product organization. Establish best practices, PRD standards, and self-service ML integration blueprints while mentoring Product Managers in the team.

What you need to be successful

Background Experience
• 7+ years of Product Management experience in a technology-driven environment, with at least 4 years deeply focused on building, scaling, and managing core Machine Learning platform capabilities or data infrastructure.
• High-Volume B2C Scale: Proven track record of shipping ML products within high concurrency and low latency environments such as FinTech, payment processors, or high-scale consumer tech platforms.
• Strategic Portfolio Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading multi-squad initiatives, shaping platform strategy across cross-functional engineering triads, and presenting to C-level executives and regulatory bodies.

Technical Domain Skills
• Deep ML and MLOps Literacy: Hands-on understanding of predictive ML methodologies including classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and ranking. This must be paired with architectural mastery of modern MLOps pipelines such as Kafka event streams, feature stores, vector databases, and automated retraining.
• Analytical and Evaluation Rigor: Highly proficient in defining model performance metrics like precision, recall, ROC-AUC, and F1-score, with a clear ability to translate them into business ROI such as reduced false-positive fraud blocks or manual review cost savings.
• Latency and System Trade-Offs: Strong ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between real-time inference and batch scoring, feature compute complexity and latency SLAs, and model accuracy versus explainability.
• Financial Governance and Compliance: Deep understanding of regulatory constraints around automated financial decisioning, model transparency, data privacy under GDPR, and audit trails in regulated environments.

Traits
• Platform Visionary: Ability to abstract domain-specific requirements into reusable horizontal ML services consumed by multiple engineering squads.
• Decisive Technical Leader: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, making high-stakes technical trade-off decisions, and prioritizing foundational infrastructure investments alongside feature delivery.
• Uncompromising Quality Standard: High bar for system resilience, monitoring, and fail-safe mechanisms, recognizing that core banking engines demand 99.99% reliability.

What’s in it for you
• Accelerate your career growth by leading core infrastructure at one of Europe’s premier digital banks.
• Employee benefits including a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, fitness wellness discounts, and public transportation subsidies.
• A Premium N26 bank account subscription for you, plus subscriptions for friends and family.
• An additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
• High autonomy to drive the ML technical agenda, working with a diverse, international team of peers.
• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500 strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position.

Equal Opportunities

We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.

We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26.com.

Visit our website to learn more about Diversity, Equity, Inclusion at N26.

jobs.title: Head of UK Legal, Deputy General Counsel
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by technology. Founded in 2017, we are revolutionising world systems through our cutting-edge digital asset exchange, Web3 portal and blockchain ecosystems. We reshape the financial ecosystem by offering some of the most diverse and sophisticated products, solutions, and trading tools on the market. Trusted by more than 50 million users in 180 countries globally, OKX empowers every individual to explore the world of Web3. With our extensive range of products and services, and unwavering commitment to security and reliability, we provide an essential trading platform for the world's investors and institutions. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. As strong believers in the value of blockchain technology, we are committed to building a more inclusive and open financial future and we know that starts with the people who build it.

 

About the team

OKX's Global Legal team provides legal advice and guidance to OKX and its affiliated entities across all coverage areas and geographic locations, and supports business growth by working with all teams within the company to help them achieve their goals. We are a high-functioning, collaborative and fast-paced team who enjoys the cutting-edge nature of our work and our industry. Our team of 60+ lawyers are located around the world, and the OKX Chief Legal Officer is based in the United States.

 

About the opportunity 

As Deputy General Counsel and Head of Legal, UK, you will lead the UK legal function, working closely with the UK CEO and other key UK stakeholders and reporting into the Global Legal team. You will provide strategic legal advice to the UK business and work closely with global legal colleagues and senior business leaders on regulatory, commercial and strategic matters.

 

You will be a member of the UK management team and represent the legal function at relevant Board and committee meetings.

 

The right candidate will have direct legal experience and an enthusiastic belief in the digital asset space, 14+ years of experience working for a top-tier law firm, in-house at a financial services or digital assets company or with a financial services regulator and possess excellent writing and analytical skills. The ideal candidate has deep experience in financial services and digital asset regulation, U.K. licensing, marketing and advertising, and contract law.

 

We offer a competitive base salary and bonus structure as well as excellent benefits and an opportunity to work in a cutting-edge industry that will be the future of financial services.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Supporting OKX's business expansion into the United Kingdom. This role will be the primary legal point of contact for the OKX U.K. entity, and will be called upon to support the business in its licensing and legal efforts to expand into the U.K. Market. The right candidate will also have experience in government and regulatory relations and will be responsible for ensuring OKX is a valued contributor to the developing legal frameworks in the sector. This will include representing OKX in relevant industry associations and promoting OKX's view point in consultation efforts.
• Supporting the business in virtually all legal coverage areas, including but not limited to product development, regulatory matters, IP and trademark enforcement, corporate governance, licensing efforts, token listings for OKX U.K., contract negotiation, compliance legal support, institutional sales and partnerships, and marketing and advertising;
• Analyzing and advising on the legal risk of new and existing digital assets and managing the legal component of the new asset review process;
• Collaborating with product and business development teams to achieve company-wide projects and goals; and
• Managing legal requests from all areas of the business and effectively advising on legal concepts and legal risk with an eye towards the strategic goals of business leaders.
• You will be working from OKX's London office three days a week. You may work remotely two days a week.

What We Look For In You
• Law degree at a top-tier law school and qualified to practice law in the U.K.
• 14+ years of legal experience at a top-tier law firm and/or in-house legal team, preferably in the cryptocurrency/digital assets and/or financial services industry.
• Experience advising on digital asset and blockchain technology legal issues and have a basic understanding of the relevant legal and regulatory landscape.
• Experience working with the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and obtaining U.K. financial services and/or crypto exchange licenses.
• Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, growth-stage and multi-cultural environment.
• Ability to effectively advise and build trust with business teams.
• Ability to navigate through a rapidly-changing legal landscape and deal with legal ambiguity.
• Ability to work in a high-functioning legal team and feel comfortable in a collaborative working environment.
• Self-starter, quick learner who is highly driven, proactive, responsive and precise.
• Experience working on cross-jurisdictional matters and a global legal team.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependents
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Infrastructure Architect
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

Lead infrastructure architecture and core platform development for the AI Native era, covering CI/CD, AIOps, observability, and monorepo engineering. Build platforms that support multiple programming languages across host-based and containerized environments.

Use platform engineering, intelligent tooling, and automated quality controls to enable developers and AI agents to work together, improving developer productivity, software quality, and production reliability.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Infrastructure Architecture and Evolution: Define platform architecture, technical standards, and roadmaps, balancing scalability, reliability, security, and cost. Lead critical component design, hands-on development, and implementation across teams.
• AI Native Engineering Capabilities: Connect code, documentation, dependencies, test results, and runtime data into usable engineering context. Expose capabilities through APIs, CLIs, and SDKs for developers and agents to understand and review code, run tests, and resolve issues. Establish task evaluations, output validation, and execution permissions.
• Infrastructure for Multiple Languages: Build extensible toolchains, dependency management, testing, and delivery capabilities for ecosystems such as Go, Java, Python, C++, and Rust. Use standard protocols and SDKs to support communication across languages, interface compatibility, and consistent telemetry, reducing platform integration effort.
• Monorepo and Build Systems: Define repository structure, module boundaries, dependency policies, and code ownership to support changes across modules and independent service releases. Apply practices from systems such as Bazel and Buck2 to deliver incremental and reproducible builds, affected-test selection, remote caching, and remote execution.
• CI/CD and Quality Engineering: Build shared platforms for builds, tests, artifacts, and releases across hosts and containers. Improve configuration governance, automated quality gates, progressive delivery, health verification, and rollback to shorten delivery cycles and reduce change risk.
• Observability and Reliability: Unify metrics, logs, traces, and profiling, linking telemetry to code, configuration, dependencies, and deployments. Establish SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and alerting practices, and feed production findings back into engineering quality improvements.
• AIOps and Automated Remediation: Combine telemetry, topology, change history, and operational knowledge to enable anomaly detection, incident investigation, root cause analysis, and controlled remediation. Use incident replay, evaluation, and feedback to reduce recovery time and repetitive operational work.

What We Look For In You
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. At least 8 years of infrastructure or platform engineering experience, including 3 years in architecture or technical leadership.
• Deep expertise in at least one of CI/CD, build systems, observability, or AIOps, with experience designing, implementing, and operating large production systems.
• Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, distributed systems, and troubleshooting. Experience with deployment, configuration management, resource isolation, and production diagnostics in host-based and Kubernetes environments.
• Experience building infrastructure for multiple languages, with an understanding of toolchain, dependency, and runtime differences. Ability to design shared platform interfaces and extensible language integrations.
• Familiarity with open-source infrastructure practices originating at Google or Meta, such as build and dependency management with Bazel or Buck2, or cross-language communication and interface contracts with gRPC and Protocol Buffers. Experience evaluating, integrating, or optimizing relevant technologies.
• Experience with automated testing, quality gates, and release engineering, using observability and reliability measures to improve delivery workflows.
• Practical experience applying LLMs or agents to engineering workflows, including context construction, tool use, task orchestration, evaluation, and safe execution.
• Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, Java, C++, or Rust, with strong hands-on coding and debugging skills. Ability to drive implementation through design reviews, technical guidance, and collaboration across teams.

Nice to Haves
• Experience at Google, Meta, or other leading technology companies, and a background in infrastructure, developer productivity, or AI Native engineering platforms, are preferred.
• Leading large monorepos, build platforms supporting multiple languages, remote execution platforms, or enterprise developer productivity platforms.
• Building AI-powered code review, test generation, incident diagnosis, or automated remediation systems and validating them in production.
• Operating large environments spanning hosts and containers, improving software supply chain security, or contributing to relevant open-source projects. 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

This role focuses on strengthening OKX US' first line of defense while serving as the primary operational engine and bridge between the US business and control functions. Operating in a highly fluid environment, this position bridges the gap between hands-on internal controls and strategic US market execution.

You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with control functions across every aspect of the US business, from managing KYC/KYB onboarding pipelines and marketing content reviews to leading US executive reporting and customer support alignment. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, moves comfortably between granular risk management and growth strategy, and elevates organizational maturity to sustain OKX’s growth, integrity, and regulatory excellence.

 

 

What You’ll Be Doing 

Controls Partnership Operational Strategy
• KYC / KYB Pipeline Remediation: Support Compliance-managed KYC and KYB onboarding pipelines, identifying friction points, accelerating throughput between business units and Compliance, and resolving operational friction.
• Risk Governance and Coordination: Serve as the key liaison to the US Risk organization, providing assistance in the monitoring of KRIs and the implementation of the risk framework.
• Customer-Facing Content Governance: Lead the cross-functional workflow for Compliance and Legal reviews of growth assets, including marketing campaigns, product launches, promotional materials, and client communications.
• Client Support Compliance Alignment: Partner closely with Client Support and Compliance to streamline escalated customer workflows, ensure client support operations reflect regulatory requirements, and resolve customer-impacting compliance bottlenecks.
• Controls Product Management: Work with Legal, Compliance, and Risk to understand key risks associated with new product launches, and utilize relationships with Product to promote innovation and product delivery.

 

Local Market Governance
• Executive Reporting: Lead and coordinate reporting for executive meeting cadences, including soliciting updates and insight from business and control leads to present a cohesive view of US market performance and opportunities.
• Policy Procedures: Support the drafting and upkeep of operational policies and procedures. Prepare regular risk, control, and operational performance reporting for senior leadership.
• First-Line Defense Leadership: Represent business operations in first-line risk management activities, supporting RCSAs, maintaining risk registers, and ensuring control effectiveness.

 

What We Look For In You
• Experience:

3+ years of progressive experience in Strategic Operations, Program Management, Compliance Operations, Governance, or Risk Management within fintech, crypto/web3, or heavily regulated financial services.
• Fluidity Growth Mindset: A "builder" mindset with high comfort in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments. Ability to pivot smoothly from tactical execution (tracking pipeline bottlenecks) to strategic alignment (launching new market initiatives).
• Incident Process Acumen: Proven track record leading cross-departmental incident response, mapping workflows, and executing post-incident remediation.
• Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management: Superior written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships across control and first line teams.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer / バックエンドエンジニア (Core Banking System)
jobs.description:
About PayPay

PayPay is a FinTech company that has grown to over 75M (as of August 2026) users since its launch in
2018. Our team is hugely diverse with members from over 50 different countries.

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_ 

We dare to believe that we do not need a clear vision to create a future beyond our imagination. PayPay will always stay true to our roots and realize a vision (future) that no one else can imagine by constantly taking risks and challenging ourselves. With this mindset, you will be presented with new and exciting opportunities on a daily basis and have the opportunity to grow and reach new dimensions that you could never have imagined. We are looking for people who can embrace this challenge, refresh the product at breakneck speed and promote PayPay with professionalism and passion.
※ Please note that you cannot apply or be selected in parallel with PayPay Corporation, PayPay Card Corporation and PayPay Securities Corporation.

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50か国の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_

我々は自分たちの想像を超える未来を創るためにあえて明確なビジョンは必要ないと考えています。常にDay1であるスタンスを忘れずに、誰もが想像できないようなビジョン（未来）を実現していくのがPayPayです。
この壮大なビジョンに前向きに取り組み、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、自ら課題発見し、周囲と協力して新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

※ PayPay株式会社へご応募いただく際にはPayPayカード株式会社、PayPay証券株式会社へ併願応募はご遠慮いただいております。ご了承ください。

 

▼関連コンテンツ

【PayPayが仕掛ける金融革命】米国ナスダック上場は通過点／デジタル金融プラットフォームに進化／決済・投資・貯蓄・保険などすべてPayPay／内製でシステム開発する理由／グローバル標準の金融サービス

 

Job Description

About the Organization/Team・組織/チームについて

PayPay Bank is responsible for developing the financial infrastructure that supports the financial services of the PayPay Group.
Our team is driven by our in-house engineers, from the design and development of the core system to its operation.

Our role is not just to develop functions, but to:
- Evolve the system while maintaining high reliability
- Design an architecture that anticipates future service expansion
- Create the development organization and development process itself

Because it is a new organization, you can proactively participate in technology selection and the creation of development culture.

※ After joining the company, you are expected to be seconded to PayPay Bank as a member of the above project.

PayPay銀行は、PayPayグループの金融サービスを支える金融基盤の開発を担っています。
私たちのチームは、コアシステムの設計・開発から運用までを自社エンジニアが主体となって推進しています。

単に機能を開発するだけではなく、
・高い信頼性を維持しながらシステムを進化させること
・将来のサービス拡張を見据えたアーキテクチャを設計すること
・開発組織や開発プロセスそのものをつくること
までが私たちの役割です。

新しい組織だからこそ、技術選定や開発文化づくりにも主体的に関わることができます。

【Engineering for New Bank Project】Recruiting Factbook

※入社後に上記プロジェクトメンバーとしてPayPay銀行への出向を予定しています。

 

Background of Recruitment・募集の背景

At the PayPay Group, we are accelerating the evolution of financial services across payments, banking, cards, and securities.

The banking system that forms the foundation for this requires more than ever:
- Flexibility
- Scalability
- Development speed
- High quality

To continue meeting these technical demands, we are broadly recruiting not only engineers with experience in financial system development but also backend engineers with experience in large-scale web services and platform development.

PayPayグループでは、決済・銀行・カード・証券を横断した金融サービスの進化を加速しています。

その基盤となる銀行システムには、これまで以上に
・柔軟性
・拡張性
・開発スピード
・高い品質
が求められています。

こうした技術的な要求に応え続けるため、金融システム開発の経験を持つエンジニアだけでなく、大規模Webサービスやプラットフォーム開発の経験を持つバックエンドエンジニアも広く募集しています。

 

Job Responsibilities・具体的な業務内容

Design of highly reliable financial infrastructure
- System design to achieve high reliability as a financial platform
- Backend development that balances performance and stability

Design with a view of the entire system
- Architecture design
- Middleware selection
- Design of integration with infrastructure

Continuous improvement
- Performance improvement of microservices
- Monitoring
- Alert improvement
- Failure analysis

高信頼な金融基盤の設計
・金融プラットフォームとして高い信頼性を実現するシステム設計
・パフォーマンスと安定性を両立するバックエンド開発

システム全体を見据えた設計
・アーキテクチャ設計
・ミドルウェア選定
・インフラとの連携設計

継続的な改善
・マイクロサービスの性能改善
・モニタリング
・アラート改善
・障害分析

 

Attractiveness of This Position・本ポジションの魅力

[Tech Challenges]

In this position, you will face technical challenges unique to financial systems.

- Highly available and highly reliable system design
- Modernization utilizing legacy assets
- Performance design to support high-volume transactions
- Architecture design anticipating future scalability

Opportunity to be involved in the modernization of financial infrastructure
While maintaining the reliability of the financial system cultivated over many years, we will advance architecture improvements and feature expansions.

Mission-critical system development
Because it is a financial system where downtime is not permitted, you can experience design and implementation that consider high availability, performance, and fault tolerance.

Ability to design the entire system
You will be involved in the design of not only implementation but also:
- Architecture
- Middleware
- Infrastructure

Scale unique to the PayPay Group
You will be involved in system development that supports the financial services of the entire PayPay Group, not just the bank itself.

【Tech Challenges】
このポジションでは、金融システムならではの技術課題に向き合います。

・高可用・高信頼なシステム設計
・レガシー資産を活かしたモダナイゼーション
・大量トランザクションを支える性能設計
・将来の拡張性を見据えたアーキテクチャ設計

金融基盤のモダナイゼーションに携われる
長年培われた金融システムの信頼性を維持しながら、アーキテクチャの改善や機能拡張を進めます。

ミッションクリティカルなシステム開発
停止が許されない金融システムだからこそ、高可用性・性能・耐障害性を考慮した設計・実装を経験できます。

システム全体を設計できる
実装だけでなく、
・アーキテクチャ
・ミドルウェア
・インフラ
まで含めた設計に携われます。

PayPayグループならではのスケール
銀行単体ではなく、PayPayグループ全体の金融サービスを支えるシステム開発に携われます。

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer / クラウドインフラエンジニア
jobs.description:
About PayPay

PayPay is a FinTech company that has grown to over 75M (as of August 2026) users since its launch in
2018. Our team is hugely diverse with members from over 50 different countries.

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_ 

We dare to believe that we do not need a clear vision to create a future beyond our imagination. PayPay will always stay true to our roots and realize a vision (future) that no one else can imagine by constantly taking risks and challenging ourselves. With this mindset, you will be presented with new and exciting opportunities on a daily basis and have the opportunity to grow and reach new dimensions that you could never have imagined. We are looking for people who can embrace this challenge, refresh the product at breakneck speed and promote PayPay with professionalism and passion.
※ Please note that you cannot apply or be selected in parallel with PayPay Corporation, PayPay Card Corporation and PayPay Securities Corporation.

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50か国の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_

我々は自分たちの想像を超える未来を創るためにあえて明確なビジョンは必要ないと考えています。常にDay1であるスタンスを忘れずに、誰もが想像できないようなビジョン（未来）を実現していくのがPayPayです。
この壮大なビジョンに前向きに取り組み、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、自ら課題発見し、周囲と協力して新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

 

▼関連コンテンツ

【PayPayが仕掛ける金融革命】米国ナスダック上場は通過点／デジタル金融プラットフォームに進化／決済・投資・貯蓄・保険などすべてPayPay／内製でシステム開発する理由／グローバル標準の金融サービス

 

 

Job Description

About the Organization/Team・組織/チームについて

PayPay Bank is responsible for developing the financial infrastructure that supports the PayPay Group's financial services.
Our team drives the entire process, from core system cloud infrastructure design and construction to operations and standardization, led by our own engineers.
Beyond simply building and maintaining infrastructure, our role encompasses:
• Evolve our infrastructure while maintaining high reliability
• Design cloud architectures for future scalability and high-volume transactions
• Build development organizations and cloud deployment processes themselves

As this is a newly established organization, you will have the opportunity to proactively engage in promoting standardization and building culture.

※ After joining the company, you are expected to be seconded to PayPay Bank as a member of the above project.

PayPay銀行は、PayPayグループの金融サービスを支える金融基盤の開発を担っています。
私たちのチームは、コアシステムのクラウドインフラ設計・構築から運用・標準化までを自社エンジニアが主体となって推進しています。
単にインフラを構築・維持するだけではなく、
• 高い信頼性を維持しながらインフラを進化させること
• 将来のサービス拡張や大量トランザクションを見越したクラウドアーキテクチャを設計すること
• 開発組織やクラウドデプロイプロセスそのものをつくること

までが私たちの役割です。
新しい組織だからこそ、標準化推進や文化づくりにも主体的に関わることができます。

【Engineering for New Bank Project】Recruiting Factbook

※入社後に上記プロジェクトメンバーとしてPayPay銀行への出向を予定しています。

 

Background of Recruitment・募集の背景

At PayPay Group, we are accelerating the evolution of financial services across payment, banking, card, and securities.
The banking system that serves as the foundation for these services requires unprecedented levels of:
• Flexibility
• Scalability
• Development speed
• High quality

With the rapid expansion of our infrastructure's importance and scale accompanying business growth, we are looking for Cloud Infrastructure Engineers to support mission-critical systems and improve development efficiency and stability.

PayPayグループでは、決済・銀行・カード・証券を横断した金融サービスの進化を加速しています。
その基盤となる銀行システムには、これまで以上に
• 柔軟性
• 拡張性
• 開発スピード
• 高い品質

が求められています。
事業成長に伴いインフラ基盤の重要性と規模が急速に拡大しており、ミッションクリティカルなシステムを支え、開発効率と安定性を向上させるクラウドインフラエンジニアを広く募集しています。

 

Job Responsibilities・具体的な業務内容

Architect and Build Robust, Scalable, and Stable Infrastructure
• Architect cloud infrastructure that achieves high reliability as a financial platform
• Architect and build multi-zone infrastructure with AWS regional level failure tolerance
• Maintain and evolve an infrastructure base where patching and upgrades can be easily implemented without service downtime

Promote Security and Automation
• Provision secure infrastructure in collaboration with Security Engineers
• Promote and standardize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and other tools

Continuous Improvement of Development Environment and Deployment Processes
• AWS deployment automation to ensure fast and secure delivery of cloud services to developers
• Provide means for developers to easily deploy AWS resources through automation
• Improve observability, monitoring, alerting, and failure analysis

高信頼・高拡張なクラウドインフラの設計・構築
• 金融プラットフォームとして高い信頼性を実現するクラウドインフラアーキテクチャ設計
• AWSのリージョンレベルの障害にも耐えうるマルチゾーン・耐障害性インフラの設計・構築
• パッチ適用やアップグレードを、サービス停止なしで容易に実施できるインフラ基盤の維持・進化

セキュリティと自動化の推進
• セキュリティエンジニアと連携した、安全なインフラ環境の構築
• Terraform等を用いた Infrastructure as Code (IaC) の推進・標準化

開発環境・デプロイプロセスの継続的改善
• 開発者へクラウドサービスを迅速かつ安全に提供するための AWS デプロイ自動化
• 開発者が AWS リソースを容易にデプロイできる仕組みの提供
• 可観測性（Observability）の向上、モニタリング、アラート改善、障害分析

Tech Stack
• AWS:
• VPC, NLB, EKS, ECS, EC2, Lambda, Cloudfront, RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, Opensearch, S3, CloudWatch, Cognito, SQS, KMS, Secret Manager, KMS, MSK, SES, Transfer Family, Shield, WAF, GuardDuty, IAM Identity Center, WorkSpaces, CloudFormation, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect etc
• Other services
• Terraform, Github Actions, Prometheus, Grafana, Atlantis, ArgoCD, OpenTelemetry, Backstage, Pagerduty

Attractiveness of This Position・本ポジションの魅力

［Tech Challenges］

In this position, you will face technical challenges unique to financial systems:
• High-availability and high-reliability cloud architecture design
• Infrastructure change management and release design achieving Zero Downtime
• Multi-account governance and security design for large-scale AWS environments
• Modernization of cloud infrastructure with an eye toward future scalability and cost optimization

Modernization of Financial Infrastructure

Improve architecture utilizing the latest AWS services, Kubernetes, and IaC while maintaining the reliability of long-established financial systems.

Mission-Critical System Development

Experience large-scale infrastructure design and construction considering multi-region support, high availability, and fault tolerance for financial systems where downtime is not permitted.

Ability to Design the Entire System

Involved in overall infrastructure design including container platforms (EKS/ECS), networks, storage, and CI/CD pipelines.

Scale Unique to the PayPay Group

Evolve large-scale infrastructure supporting financial services across the entire PayPay Group, not just for the bank alone.

［Tech Challenges］

このポジションでは、金融システムならではの技術課題に向き合います。
• 高可用・高信頼なクラウドアーキテクチャ設計
• サービス無停止（Zero Downtime）を実現するインフラ変更管理・リリース設計
• 大規模なAWS環境におけるマルチアカウント統制とセキュリティ設計
• 将来の拡張性とコスト最適化を見据えたクラウド基盤のモダナイゼーション

金融基盤のモダナイゼーションに携われる

長年培われた金融システムの信頼性を維持しながら、最新のAWSサービスやKubernetes、IaCを活用したアーキテクチャの改善を進めます。

ミッションクリティカルなシステム開発

停止が許されない金融システムだからこそ、マルチリージョン対応や高可用性・耐障害性を考慮した大規模インフラの設計・構築を経験できます。

システム全体を設計できる

コンテナプラットフォーム（EKS/ECS）、ネットワーク、ストレージからCI/CDパイプラインまで含めたインフラ全体の設計に携われます。

PayPayグループならではのスケール

銀行単体ではなく、PayPayグループ全体の金融サービスを支える大規模インフラ基盤の進化に携われます。

 

Required Experience/Skills・必要な経験/スキル
• 5+ years of extensive technical hands-on and architecture design experience with infrastructure/platform using AWS
• Broad practical experience with AWS computing, networking, storage, and analytics services
• Experience with Terraform based infrastructure as code (IAC) on AWS
• Experience in production level infrastructure change management and releases for high traffic business-critical systems
• Experience in Cloud infrastructure and platform systems availability, performance and cost management
• Experience with multi-account operations for large-scale AWS environments
• Strong understanding of cloud security best practices in Fintech Industry
• Demonstrated skill in programming and scripting languages, including Python, Shell Scripting, Go, and Rust
• Excellent oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills
• Japanese business proficiency equivalent to JLPT N1 or N2
