• Create the development organization and development process itself

Because it is a new organization, you can proactively participate in technology selection and the creation of development culture.

※ After joining the company, you are expected to be seconded to PayPay Bank as a member of the above project.

PayPay銀行は、PayPayグループの金融サービスを支える金融基盤の開発を担っています。
私たちのチームは、コアシステムの設計・開発から運用までを自社エンジニアが主体となって推進しています。

単に機能を開発するだけではなく、
• 高い信頼性を維持しながらシステムを進化させること
• 将来のサービス拡張を見据えたアーキテクチャを設計すること
• 開発組織や開発プロセスそのものをつくること

までが私たちの役割です。

新しい組織だからこそ、技術選定や開発文化づくりにも主体的に関わることができます。

【Engineering for New Bank Project】Recruiting Factbook

※入社後に上記プロジェクトメンバーとしてPayPay銀行への出向を予定しています。

 

Background of Recruitment・募集の背景

We are accelerating the modernization of PayPay Bank’s customer-facing website and internal back-office systems.

To support this transformation, we are looking for hands-on and collaborative Frontend Engineers who can take ownership of product delivery, work closely with cross-functional teams, and help us build scalable foundations for future development.

You will have the opportunity to contribute not only to individual product features, but also to frontend architecture, development processes, and engineering standards across the organization.

PayPay銀行の顧客向けWebサイトおよび社内バックオフィスシステムのモダン化を加速度的に推進しています。

この変革を支えるため、プロダクトのデリバリーに責任を持ち、クロスファンクショナルなチームと密に連携しながら、将来の開発に向けたスケーラブルな基盤構築を推進できる、ハンズオンで協調性のあるフロントエンドエンジニアを募集しています。

個別プロダクトの機能開発にとどまらず、組織全体のフロントエンドアーキテクチャ、開発プロセス、エンジニアリング標準の策定・向上にも貢献いただける環境です。

 

Job Responsibilities・具体的な業務内容
• Work with Product Managers, Designers, Backend Engineers, and QA Engineers to deliver features.
• Review product requirements and Figma designs, and suggest improvements.
• Design and implement frontend solutions using Vue.js and TypeScript.
• Align API requirements with Backend Engineers.
• Work with QA Engineers on testing and issue resolution.
• Monitor released features and resolve production issues.
• Participate in code reviews and improve frontend best practices.
• プロダクトマネージャー、デザイナー、バックエンドエンジニア、QAエンジニアと協力して機能をリリースする。
• プロダクト要件やFigmaのデザインをレビューし、改善案を提案する。
• Vue.jsおよびTypeScriptを用いてフロントエンドのソリューションを設計・実装する。
• バックエンドエンジニアとAPI要件をすりあわせる。
• QAエンジニアと連携してテストを実施し、課題を解決する。
• リリースされた機能をモニタリングし、本番環境の課題を解決する。
• コードレビューに参加し、フロントエンドのベストプラクティスを向上させる。

 

Attractiveness of This Position・本ポジションの魅力

[Tech Challenges]

Legacy System Modernization

Some important banking services still run on legacy JSP systems. Their business rules and workflows may be spread across old code, documents, and team knowledge.
Frontend Engineers work with Product Managers and business teams to understand the current behavior, clarify hidden requirements, and simplify complex workflows. 
Based on this understanding, engineers propose modern and maintainable technical solutions.

The challenge is not simply rewriting old code. It is to:
• Understand the existing business rules and dependencies.
• Decide what should be kept, improved, or removed.
• Design modern frontend architecture and API integrations.
• Migrate step by step without disrupting banking operations.
• Turn complex legacy systems into solutions that are easier to maintain and develop.

一部の重要な銀行サービスは現在もレガシーなJSPシステムで動作しています。ビジネスルールやワークフローは、古いコードやドキュメント、チームのノウハウに分散している場合があります。
フロントエンドエンジニアはプロダクトマネージャーやビジネスチームと連携して現状の動作を理解し、隠れた要件を明確にして複雑なワークフローをシンプルにします。
その理解に基づいて、モダンで保守性の高い技術的ソリューションを提案します。

単に古いコードを書き直すだけでなく、以下に取り組むことが課題であり面白さです：
• 既存のビジネスルールや依存関係を理解すること。
• 維持・改善・削除すべきものを判断すること。
• モダンなフロントエンドアーキテクチャとAPI統合を設計すること。
• 銀行業務に支障をきたすことなく段階的に移行すること。
• 複雑なレガシーシステムを、開発や保守が容易なソリューションへと刷新すること。

End-to-End Ownership

For new features, you will not only receive a design and implement it.
You will be involved from the beginning to the end:
• Understand the product idea.
• Suggest product and design improvements.
• Review Figma designs with Designers.
• Design the frontend solution.
• Align API requirements with Backend Engineers.
• Implement and test the feature.
• Support QA and release.
• Monitor the feature after release.

You will have the freedom to propose solutions and take ownership of your feature.

新機能の開発において、単に提示されたデザインをそのまま実装するだけではありません。
最初から最後までのすべてのフェーズに関わることができます：
• プロダクトアイデアの理解
• プロダクトおよびデザインの改善案の提案
• デザイナーとのFigmaデザインのレビュー
• フロントエンドソリューションの設計
• バックエンドエンジニアとのAPI要件のすりあわせ
• 機能の実装およびテスト
• QAサポートおよびリリース
• リリース後のモニタリング

自由にソリューションを提案し、自らの機能にオーナーシップを持って取り組むことができます。

Open Engineering Culture

We encourage engineers to identify problems and create improvement proposals.
You can propose improvements to the product, user experience, architecture, or development process.
We also keep meetings simple and protect engineers’ focus time.

エンジニアが課題を発見し、改善提案を作成することを推奨しています。
プロダクト、ユーザー体験、アーキテクチャ、開発プロセスなどに対して自由に改善を提案できます。
また、会議はシンプルに保ち、エンジニアの集中できる時間を確保しています。

 

Project Examples・プロジェクト事例

Shared Pagination Standard / 共通ページネーション標準

Identified pagination inconsistencies across back-office systems and proactively collaborated with designers to establish a company-wide pagination standard, driving UI consistency and improving developer efficiency.

バックオフィス画面におけるページネーションの課題を主体的に発見し、デザイナーと連携して全社共通の標準UI仕様を確立。
UI/UXの統一と開発効率の向上を実現しました。

 

Tech Stack

We select the best combination of tech at times.

｜TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS
｜Vue.js, React, single-spa, JSP
｜AWS, GH Actions, Terraform
｜GitHub, npm/yarn, Webpack, Jest, i18n, Storybook
｜Sentry, Kibana, Google Analytics, Firebase
｜Figma, PlantUML, draw.io, Miro
｜Slack, Zoom, Confluence, Jira

 

Required Experience/Skills・必要な経験/スキル
• At least 4 years of industry experience developing secure web frontend applications in JavaScript and/or other transpile-to-JavaScript languages.
• At least 1 year of industry experience with VueJS (preferred), or React.
• Software engineering best practices and computer science knowledge.
• Business level of English.
• Hands-on experience with AI/LLM tools (e.g., ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, CodeWhisperer, or similar) in professional software development.
• JavaScriptおよび／またはJavaScriptへトランスパイルされる言語を用いた、安全なWebフロントエンドアプリケーション開発の実務経験4年以上
• Vue.jsまたはReactを用いた実務経験1年以上
• ソフトウェアエンジニアリングのベストプラクティスに関する理解、およびコンピュータサイエンスの基礎知識
• ビジネスレベルの英語力
• ChatGPT、GitHub Copilot、Gemini、CodeWhispererなどのAI／LLMツールを活用した、プロフェッショナルなソフトウェア開発における実務経験

 

Desired Experience/Skills・あると望ましい経験/スキル
• Experience with frontend performance monitoring and optimization.
• Experience with iOS or Android development, either with the native toolkits or with a framework such as React Native.
• Experience with designing server side RESTful APIs.
• Experience with web hosting infrastructure such as CDNs.
• Ability to conduct business in Japanese (native-level proficiency or equivalent to JLPT N1/N2).
• Proven track record of integrating AI-assisted development into system design and delivery.
• Contributions to AI-related open-source projects or automation of workflows with AI is a plus.
• フロントエンドのパフォーマンス監視および最適化の経験
• iOSまたはAndroidの開発経験。ネイティブツールキット、もしくはReact Nativeなどのフレームワークを使用した開発を含む
• サーバーサイドのRESTful API設計の経験
• CDNなどのWebホスティングインフラに関する経験
• 日本語での業務遂行が可能な方（母国語、または日本語能力試験N1／N2相当）
• AI支援開発をシステム設計およびデリバリーに統合した実績
• AI関連のオープンソースプロジェクトへの貢献、またはAIを活用したワークフロー自動化の経験があれば尚可

 

Desired Candidate Profile・求める人物像
• Individuals who can logically structure their thoughts and communicate effectively
• Individuals who can approach everything with a strong sense of ownership
• ものごとを論理的に組み立ててコミュニケーションが取れる方
• 当事者意識をもって何事も取り組むことができる方

PayPay 5 senses
• Please refer PayPay 5 senses to learn what we value at work

 

Working Conditions 

Employment Status
• Full Time

Office Location
• Hybrid Workstyle
※ You will be expected to work in the office, in alignment with organizational guidelines and team objectives.
• LIFE in JAPAN FACTBOOK

Work Hours
• Super Flex Time (No Core Time)
• In principle, 9:00am-5:45pm + 1h break (actual working hours: 7h45m + 1h break)

Holidays
• Every Sat/Sun/National holidays (In Japan)/New Year's break/Company-designated Special days

Paid leave
• Annual leave (up to 14 days in the first year, granted proportionally according to the month of employment. Can be used from the date of hire)
• Personal leave (5 days each year, granted proportionally according to the month of employment）
＊PayPay's own special paid leave system, which can be used to attend to illnesses, injuries, hospital visits, etc., of the employee, family members, pets, etc.

Salary
• Annual salary paid in 12 installments (monthly)
• Based on skills, experience, and abilities
• Reviewed once a year
• Late overtime allowance

※Payroll payment can be changed to digital salary payment “PayPay Paycheck” for an amount set by you

Benefits
• Social Insurance (health insurance, employee pension, employment insurance and compensation insurance)
• 401K
• Translation/Interpretation support
• VISA sponsor + Relocation support

 

待遇・条件

雇用形態
• 正社員

勤務地
• Hybrid Workstyle
※所属組織のルールおよび業務指示に応じて出社対応頂きます。

勤務時間
• スーパーフレックス制（コアタイム無し）
• 原則：午前9時～午後5時45分（実働7時間45分＋休憩時間 1時間）

休日
• 土日祝日、年末年始および会社指定日

休暇（法定休暇および会社福利厚生）

• パーソナル休暇（毎年度５日間付与/初年度入社月により3日間もしくは5日間付与）
※PayPay独自の特別有給休暇制度で、本人/家族/ペットなどの病気/ケガ/通院付き添い等にご使用頂けます。

給与

※給与支給について、一部をPayPayアカウントで受け取ることが可能です（給与デジタル支払いに対応）

ベネフィット
• 社会保険（健康保険、厚生年金、雇用保険、労災保険）

jobs.title: Product Designer / プロダクトデザイナー
jobs.description:
About PayPay

PayPay is a FinTech company that has grown to over 75M (as of August 2026) users since its launch in
2018. Our team is hugely diverse with members from over 50 different countries.

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_ 

We dare to believe that we do not need a clear vision to create a future beyond our imagination. PayPay will always stay true to our roots and realize a vision (future) that no one else can imagine by constantly taking risks and challenging ourselves. With this mindset, you will be presented with new and exciting opportunities on a daily basis and have the opportunity to grow and reach new dimensions that you could never have imagined. We are looking for people who can embrace this challenge, refresh the product at breakneck speed and promote PayPay with professionalism and passion.
※ Please note that you cannot apply or be selected in parallel with PayPay Corporation, PayPay Card Corporation and PayPay Securities Corporation.

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50か国の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_

我々は自分たちの想像を超える未来を創るためにあえて明確なビジョンは必要ないと考えています。常にDay1であるスタンスを忘れずに、誰もが想像できないようなビジョン（未来）を実現していくのがPayPayです。
この壮大なビジョンに前向きに取り組み、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、自ら課題発見し、周囲と協力して新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

※ PayPay株式会社へご応募いただく際にはPayPayカード株式会社、PayPay証券株式会社へ併願応募はご遠慮いただいております。ご了承ください。

 

▼関連コンテンツ

【PayPayが仕掛ける金融革命】米国ナスダック上場は通過点／デジタル金融プラットフォームに進化／決済・投資・貯蓄・保険などすべてPayPay／内製でシステム開発する理由／グローバル標準の金融サービス

 

 

Job Description

About the Organization/Team・組織/チームについて

【Product Designer for New Bank Project】Recruiting Factbook

You will be joined to the Product Design Team at PayPay Bank.
PayPay Bank’s services go beyond simply managing assets and savings; they are designed to support users at key moments in their lives, such as when making major purchases or managing retirement savings.
Product designers deliver an optimal user experience at these crucial touchpoints in users’ lives, helping to improve their day-to-day lives.

※ After joining the company, you are expected to be seconded to PayPay Bank as a member of the above project.

配属先組織は、PayPay銀行のプロダクトデザインチームです。
PayPay銀行のサービスは、資産の管理や貯蓄にとどまらず、大きな買い物や老後資産の運用など、人生の重要な場面でユーザーをサポートする役割を担います。
プロダクトデザイナーは、ユーザーの人生における重要なタッチポイントで最適なUXを提供し、ユーザーの日常生活をより良いものにアップデートします。

※入社後に上記プロジェクトメンバーとしてPayPay銀行への出向を予定しています。

Background of Recruitment・募集の背景

With rapid business growth, the number of employees is also expanding rapidly, and strengthening the organizational structure for business growth is an urgent task.
【Related Interview】Beyond the Interface: Redefining Financial UX at PayPay Bank

事業成長に伴い、従業員数も急拡大しており、事業成長に向けた組織体制の強化が急務とされています。
【関連インタビュー記事】銀行という体験をどうデザインするのか ー PayPay銀行プロダクトデザイン部が挑む金融UX

Job Responsibilities・具体的な業務内容

You will join the project to work alongside Product Managers, engineers and senior product designer to develop new features and improve existing ones, prioritizing the user experience above all else. This role offers various opportunities to take on challenges in delivering a brand-new banking experience to users.
• Comprehensive UX/UI Design: End-to-end design for the PayPay Bank consumer app, mini-apps within the PayPay app, web services, LINE mini-apps, and PayPay Bank corporate apps/web services
• Concept Development: Create design concepts using frameworks such as user personas and customer journey maps
• Design Execution: Produce UX flows and UI designs based on established concepts
• Research Analysis: Conduct quantitative and qualitative research and analysis using surveys and interviews
• Optimization Design Systems: Propose improvements based on data from numerical analysis tools, and manage/maintain the design system

プロジェクトに参画して、プロダクトマネージャーやエンジニアと共に、ユーザー体験を第一に考えた新機能の開発や、既存機能の改善を行います。
ユーザーに新しい銀行の体験を届けるための様々なチャレンジが可能です。
• 一般ユーザー向けのPayPay銀行アプリ、PayPayアプリ内のミニアプリ、Webサービス、LINEミニアプリ、法人向けのPayPay銀行アプリ、WebサービスにおけるトータルなUX/UIデザイン
• ユーザーペルソナ、ジャーニーマップの作成などフレームワークを用いたデザインコンセプトの作成
• コンセプトを元にしたUXフロー、UIデザイン
• アンケートやインタビューを用いた定量・定性調査、分析
• 数値分析ツールを用いた分析と改善の提案、およびデザインシステムの運用
• その他、デザインワークショップの開催など、プロダクトデザインに関わる幅広い業務

 

Attractiveness of This Position・本ポジションの魅力

① Influence on a Massive User Base・ユーザーへの影響力

PayPay Bank serves over 10 million users (as of April 2026).
Immediately following a service release, you will receive direct user feedback and see the impact of your work, allowing you to truly feel the scale of your influence.

PayPay銀行は1000万人のユーザー（2026年4月末時点）にご利用いただいています。
サービスのリリース後、すぐにユーザーのフィードバックや効果を得ることができ、影響力を実感することができます。

② Growth Opportunities・成長機会

You will stay at the forefront of the rapidly evolving online banking industry, learning the latest technologies and trends to fuel your professional development. 
Furthermore, you will have opportunities to collaborate and exchange insights with designers across the group—including PayPay, PayPay Card, and PayPay Securities—giving you access to a wealth of Fintech expertise and cross-industry trends.

急成長中のネットバンク業界での最新技術やトレンドを学び、プロフェッショナルとして成長を実感できます。
また、グループ企業であるPayPay、PayPayカード、PayPay証券のデザイナーと連携、情報交換ができ、フィンテック企業の様々なノウハウやトレンドを学ぶことができます。

③ Opportunities for Challenge・チャレンジの機会

As of June 2025, our organization has transitioned to an environment that enables more user-driven product development. Proposals regarding workflows and design ideas aimed at delivering superior UX are highly welcomed, offering ample room for creative and strategic challenges.

2025年6月より、よりユーザードリブンでプロダクト開発を行える環境へと組織が変化しています。
良いUXを提供するためのワークフローやデザインアイデアの提案が歓迎される環境であり、多くのチャレンジが可能です。

Required Experience/Skills・必要な経験/スキル
• 3+ years of professional experience in UX/UI design for mobile applications (iOS/Android) and mobile web.
• Practical proficiency in UX/UI design using Figma and Adobe tools.
• Proven track record in product releases, effectiveness measurement (analytics), and iterative improvement.
• Business conversation level in Japanese
• 3年以上のモバイルアプリ（iOS/Android）、モバイル WebのUX/UIデザインの実務経験
• Figma、Adobeを用いたUX/UIデザインの実務経験
• プロダクトのリリース、効果測定、改善の実務経験
• ビジネスレベルの日本語会話

 

Desired Experience/Skills・あると望ましい経験/スキル
• Practical experience applying HCD (Human-Centered Design) or Design Thinking methodologies.
• Experience facilitating design workshops.
• Experience conducting user research using both qualitative and quantitative methods.
• Experience operating in-house services.
• Experience leading projects from requirements definition through prototyping to final visual design.
• Experience building and maintaining design systems.
• Conversational level in both Japanese and English
• HCD（人間中心設計）やデザイン思考を活用したデザインの実務経験
• デザインワークショップのファシリテーション経験
• 定性、定量的な調査を用いたユーザーリサーチ実施経験
• インハウスでの自社サービス運用経験
• 複数のプロジェクトにおいて要件定義からプロトタイピング、ビジュアルデザインまでを担当した経験
• デザインシステムの構築、運用経験
• 日本語、英語の2言語が日常会話レベルで可能

 

Desired Candidate Profile・求める人物像
• Adaptable: You are flexible and enjoy taking on new challenges.
• Proactive: You can identify issues independently and have the drive to propose and implement solutions.
• Business-Minded: You can map out optimal design strategies with a user-centric mindset while remaining committed to business goals.
• Collaborative: You value teamwork and can communicate smoothly with colleagues across different functions.
• Leadership: You possess the leadership skills necessary to involve those around you and guide projects to a successful conclusion.
• 柔軟性があり、新しいことへのチャレンジが好きな方
• 自ら課題を発見し、改善方法を提案、実現まで持っていける力のある方
• ユーザー中心の考え方で最適なデザイン戦略を描き、ビジネスにコミットする意欲のある方
• チームワークを重視し、他職種とのコミニュケーションを円滑に行える方
• 周囲を巻き込みプロジェクトを成功に導く高いリーダーシップをお持ちの方

PayPay 5 senses
• Please refer PayPay 5 senses to learn what we value at work

 

Working Conditions

jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50か国の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_

我々は自分たちの想像を超える未来を創るためにあえて明確なビジョンは必要ないと考えています。常にDay1であるスタンスを忘れずに、誰もが想像できないようなビジョン（未来）を実現していくのがPayPayです。
この壮大なビジョンに前向きに取り組み、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、自ら課題発見し、周囲と協力して新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

※ PayPay株式会社へご応募いただく際にはPayPayカード株式会社、PayPay証券株式会社へ併願応募はご遠慮いただいております。ご了承ください。

PayPay is a FinTech company that has grown to over 75M (as of August 2026) users since its launch in
2018. Our team is hugely diverse with members from over 50 different countries.

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_ 

We dare to believe that we do not need a clear vision to create a future beyond our imagination. PayPay will always stay true to our roots and realize a vision (future) that no one else can imagine by constantly taking risks and challenging ourselves. With this mindset, you will be presented with new and exciting opportunities on a daily basis and have the opportunity to grow and reach new dimensions that you could never have imagined. We are looking for people who can embrace this challenge, refresh the product at breakneck speed and promote PayPay with professionalism and passion.

※ Please note that you cannot apply or be selected in parallel with PayPay Corporation, PayPay Card Corporation and PayPay Securities Corporation.

業務について/Job Description

PayPayでは、ダイナミックで多才なプロフェッショナルが集まるPMOチームの新たな仲間を募集しています。 私たちのミッションは、PayPayの成長を支えるエンジニアリング・プロジェクトポートフォリオを俯瞰し、最適化すること。単なる「管理」に留まらず、各メンバーが特定のプロダクトラインを担当し、自ら現場に飛び込んで、大規模かつ複雑なプロジェクトを成功へと導く「実行力」が求められるポジションです。

PMOチームのモットーはリソースの穴埋めではなく、オペレーションの改善や仕組み化を通じて、組織全体に新たな価値を創出することが私たちの存在意義です。

PayPay is seeking a PMO team member to join a vibrant multi-disciplined team.
The team’s main responsibility is to oversee PayPay’s engineering team’s project portfolio.
Within the team each member is assigned to one, or more, PayPay product lines and is required to roll up their sleeves and directly manager large complicated projects and also those need an extra bit of help.

The PMO team’s motto is ‘not just a spare pair of hands’; keeping this in mind, each member is expected to add value as well as create value by identifying opportunities for improvement in operational practices.

業務内容
• ポートフォリオ管理： ダッシュボードを活用し、プロダクトポートフォリオの健全性を可視化・把握
• 戦略的プロジェクトの推進： 経営戦略に直結する重要プログラムおよびプロジェクトのリード
• ロードマップ策定支援： 四半期ごとのプロダクトロードマップの計画立案から実行までの徹底サポート
• ステークホルダー・マネジメント： 経営陣に対する定期的かつクリアな進捗報告と意思決定支援
• 組織プロセスの継続的改善： PMOチームへの新しいアイデアの提供、および業務フローの高度化
• スキルトランスファー： 社内全体のプロジェクトマネジメントスキルの育成・ボトムアップ
• 全社戦略の浸透： 担当プロダクトラインに対する、全社的なイニシアチブの導入と定着

Key Responsibilities
• Utilise existing dashboards to understand the product portfolio
• Manage strategically important programs and projects
• Manage and support quarterly product roadmap planning and execution
• Provide regular progress reports to management
• Contribute to the PMO team with new ideas and enhancements to working practices
• Train and develop the project management skills of the wider team within PayPay
• Rollout company initiatives to the product lines assigned to you

PayPay PMOチームで働く上で魅力的な点
• グローバルな環境: 多様な国籍のメンバーと協力しながら、グローバルスタンダードな環境で働くことができます。
• 圧倒的な経験値： プロジェクト、プログラム、ポートフォリオというあらゆるレイヤーで多様な経験を積むことができます。
• 進化し続ける環境： 決して現状に満足せず、常に変化し、挑戦し続けるダイナミックなチームです。
• 自己成長と達成感： 自身の成長がそのまま事業の成長に直結する、高いキャリア満足度を得られます。
• 「不可能」を「可能」にする： 日本最大級の決済プラットフォームで、誰も成し遂げたことのない難題をクリアする醍醐味があります。

Attractions of Working on the PayPay PMO Team
• Collaborate with a highly diverse, multinational team and sharpen your skills in a truly global-standard workplace.
• Gain diverse work experience at the project, program, and portfolio levels
• Be a part of a dynamic team that never sits still
• Fulfilment and career satisfaction from personal growth
• Deliver the impossible

必要な経験/スキル
• [プロジェクトマネジメント経験]
- プロジェクトマネジメント経験5年以上
- プログラムマネジメント経験3年以上
- ポートフォリオマネジメントの経験
- 大規模かつ複雑なプロジェクトの管理経験
• [関連学位または資格]
- 経営学、コンピュータサイエンス、数学、または同等の分野で学士号以上を取得
- PMP、PRINCE2、または同等のプロジェクトマネジメント/PMO認定資格
• [問題解決能力]
- 確立された方法論を用いた体系的かつ規律あるアプローチ
• [ツールの習熟度]
- Microsoft Project、JIRAなどのプロジェクトマネジメントツールに関する実務知識
• [語学力]
- 日本語（母国語）
- 英語（日常会話レベル）

Qualifications

- At least 5 years of project management experience
- At least 3 years of program management experience
- Exposure to portfolio management
- Experience managing large-scale, complex projects.
• [Related Degrees or Certifications]
- Bachelor's degree or higher in business administration, computer science, mathematics, or an equivalent field
- PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management/PMO certification
• [Problem-Solving Skills]
- Systematic and disciplined approach utilising established methodologies
• [Tool Proficiency]
- Working knowledge of project management tools such as Microsoft Project and JIRA.
• [Language Skills]
- Japanese (native language)
- English (conversational-level)

• 長期プロジェクト（複数年単位）に携わった経験
• 多国籍・グローバルチームでの実務経験

• 先見性をもったマインドセット（Forward-thinking）

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description:
About PayPay

PayPay is a FinTech company that has grown to over 75M (as of August 2026) users since its launch in
2018. Our team is hugely diverse with members from over 50 different countries.

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_ 

We dare to believe that we do not need a clear vision to create a future beyond our imagination. PayPay will always stay true to our roots and realize a vision (future) that no one else can imagine by constantly taking risks and challenging ourselves. With this mindset, you will be presented with new and exciting opportunities on a daily basis and have the opportunity to grow and reach new dimensions that you could never have imagined. We are looking for people who can embrace this challenge, refresh the product at breakneck speed and promote PayPay with professionalism and passion.
※ Please note that you cannot apply or be selected in parallel with PayPay Corporation, PayPay Card Corporation and PayPay Securities Corporation.

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50か国の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_

我々は自分たちの想像を超える未来を創るためにあえて明確なビジョンは必要ないと考えています。常にDay1であるスタンスを忘れずに、誰もが想像できないようなビジョン（未来）を実現していくのがPayPayです。
この壮大なビジョンに前向きに取り組み、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、自ら課題発見し、周囲と協力して新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

※ PayPay株式会社へご応募いただく際にはPayPayカード株式会社、PayPay証券株式会社へ併願応募はご遠慮いただいております。ご了承ください。

 

▼関連コンテンツ

【PayPayが仕掛ける金融革命】米国ナスダック上場は通過点／デジタル金融プラットフォームに進化／決済・投資・貯蓄・保険などすべてPayPay／内製でシステム開発する理由／グローバル標準の金融サービス

 

 

Job Description

About the Organization/Team・組織/チームについて

【Product Designer for New Bank Project】Recruiting Factbook

You will be joined to the Product Design Team at PayPay Bank.
PayPay Bank’s services go beyond simply managing assets and savings; they are designed to support users at key moments in their lives, such as when making major purchases or managing retirement savings.
Product designers deliver an optimal user experience at these crucial touchpoints in users’ lives, helping to improve their day-to-day lives.

※ After joining the company, you are expected to be seconded to PayPay Bank as a member of the above project.

配属先組織は、PayPay銀行のプロダクトデザインチームです。
PayPay銀行のサービスは、資産の管理や貯蓄にとどまらず、大きな買い物や老後資産の運用など、人生の重要な場面でユーザーをサポートする役割を担います。
プロダクトデザイナーは、ユーザーの人生における重要なタッチポイントで最適なUXを提供し、ユーザーの日常生活をより良いものにアップデートします。

※入社後に上記プロジェクトメンバーとしてPayPay銀行への出向を予定しています。

Background of Recruitment・募集の背景

With rapid business growth, the number of employees is also expanding rapidly, and strengthening the organizational structure for business growth is an urgent task.
【Related Interview】Beyond the Interface: Redefining Financial UX at PayPay Bank

事業成長に伴い、従業員数も急拡大しており、事業成長に向けた組織体制の強化が急務とされています。
【関連インタビュー記事】銀行という体験をどうデザインするのか ー PayPay銀行プロダクトデザイン部が挑む金融UX

Job Responsibilities・具体的な業務内容

You will join the project to work alongside Product Managers, engineers and senior product designer to develop new features and improve existing ones, prioritizing the user experience above all else. This role offers various opportunities to take on challenges in delivering a brand-new banking experience to users.
• Comprehensive UX/UI Design: End-to-end design for the PayPay Bank consumer app, mini-apps within the PayPay app, web services, LINE mini-apps, and PayPay Bank corporate apps/web services
• UX Strategy Concept: Design high-level UX strategies based on project goals, and create design concepts using frameworks such as user personas and customer journey maps
• Holistic Decision-Making: Communicate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and stakeholders to make strategic decisions based on a holistic view of the overall UX across PayPay Bank
• Research Optimization: Conduct quantitative and qualitative user research, and propose improvements based on data from numerical analysis tools
• Leadership Quality Control: Mentor junior designers, oversee the team's deliverables for quality assurance, maintain the design system, and foster a productive working environment
• 一般ユーザー向けのPayPay銀行アプリ、PayPayアプリ内のミニアプリ、Webサービス、LINEミニアプリ、法人向けのPayPay銀行アプリ、WebサービスにおけるトータルなUX/UIデザイン
• プロジェクトゴールや銀行の戦略（KGI/KPI）に基づく、利益とUXのバランスを考慮したハイレベルなUX戦略設計
• ユーザーペルソナ、ジャーニーマップの作成などフレームワークを用いたデザインコンセプトの作成、UXフロー、UIデザインのファイナライズ
• 担当領域にとどまらず、PayPay銀行全体のUXを俯瞰的にとらえた意思決定、およびPM・エンジニア等ステークホルダーとの密な連携
• 定期・定性調査（アンケート・インタビュー等）を用いたユーザーリサーチの実施、数値分析ツールを用いた改善提案
• チームの成果物のクオリティコントロール、ジュニアデザイナーのメンタリング、デザイン業務環境の整備、デザインシステムの運用

Attractiveness of This Position・本ポジションの魅力

① Influence on a Massive User Base・ユーザーへの影響力

PayPay Bank serves over 10 million users (as of April 2026).
Immediately following a service release, you will receive direct user feedback and see the impact of your work, allowing you to truly feel the scale of your influence.

PayPay銀行は1000万人のユーザー（2026年4月末時点）にご利用いただいています。
サービスのリリース後、すぐにユーザーのフィードバックや効果を得ることができ、影響力を実感することができます。

② Growth Opportunities・成長機会

You will stay at the forefront of the rapidly evolving online banking industry, learning the latest technologies and trends to fuel your professional development. Furthermore, you will have opportunities to collaborate and exchange insights with designers across the group—including PayPay, PayPay Card, and PayPay Securities—giving you access to a wealth of Fintech expertise and cross-industry trends.

急成長中のネットバンク業界での最新技術やトレンドを学び、プロフェッショナルとして成長を実感できます。
また、グループ企業であるPayPay、PayPayカード、PayPay証券のデザイナーと連携、情報交換ができ、フィンテック企業の様々なノウハウやトレンドを学ぶことができます。

③ Opportunities for Challenge・チャレンジの機会

As of June 2025, our organization has transitioned to an environment that enables more user-driven product development. Proposals regarding workflows and design ideas aimed at delivering superior UX are highly welcomed, offering ample room for creative and strategic challenges.

2025年6月より、よりユーザードリブンでプロダクト開発を行える環境へと組織が変化しています。
良いUXを提供するためのワークフローやデザインアイデアの提案が歓迎される環境であり、多くのチャレンジが可能です。

Required Experience/Skills・必要な経験/スキル
• 6+ years of professional experience in UX/UI design for mobile applications (iOS/Android) and mobile web.
• Practical proficiency in UX/UI design using Figma and Adobe tools.
• Proven track record in product releases, effectiveness measurement (analytics), and iterative improvement.
• Business conversation level in Japanese
• 6年以上のモバイルアプリ（iOS/Android）、モバイル WebのUX/UIデザインの実務経験
• Figma、Adobeを用いたUX/UIデザインの実務経験
• プロダクトのリリース、効果測定、改善の実務経験
• ビジネスレベルの日本語

Desired Experience/Skills・あると望ましい経験/スキル
• Practical experience applying HCD (Human-Centered Design) or Design Thinking methodologies.
• Experience facilitating design workshops.
• Experience conducting user research using both qualitative and quantitative methods.
• Experience operating in-house services.
• Experience leading projects from requirements definition through prototyping to final visual design.
• Experience building and maintaining design systems.
• Conversational level in both Japanese and English
• HCD（人間中心設計）やデザイン思考を活用したデザインの実務経験
• デザインワークショップのファシリテーション経験
• 定性、定量的な調査を用いたユーザーリサーチ実施経験
• インハウスでの自社サービス運用経験
• 複数のプロジェクトにおいて要件定義からプロトタイピング、ビジュアルデザインまでを担当した経験

About the team + role

Robinhood is seeking a Senior Manager, Valuation to lead and execute valuation analyses for private company investments, minority equity stakes, and other illiquid financial instruments held across the organization. This role will partner closely with Technical Accounting Financial Reporting (TAFR), Corporate Development, and the RHV Private Markets Valuation Committee to ensure valuations are well-supported, defensible, and compliant with US GAAP (ASC 820, ASC 321/323) and SEC reporting requirements. This role reports into Technical Accounting Financial Reporting (TAFR) leadership and works closely with the RHV Private Markets Valuation Committee.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY, and Chicago, IL office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

Financial Modeling Valuation Analysis
• Build and maintain complex financial models (DCF, comparable company/precedent transaction analyses, OPM/PWERM, Monte Carlo simulations) to support fair value measurements of private company investments and other illiquid holdings.
• Perform quarterly and event-driven valuations for private equity/venture-style investments, including waterfall/allocation analyses across complex capital structures (preferred stock, SAFEs, convertible notes, warrants).
• Develop and refine valuation methodologies in line with AICPA Private Equity and Venture Capital Valuation Guidelines.

Governance Reporting
• Prepare valuation memos and supporting documentation for presentation to the RHV Private Markets Valuation Committee and Audit Committee.
• Partner with TAFR to ensure valuation conclusions are properly reflected in consolidated financial statements and SEC disclosures (10-Q/10-K, 8-K as applicable).
• Serve as a key point of contact for external auditors (EY) on valuation-related audit requests, walkthroughs, and testing.

Cross-Functional Partnership
• Collaborate with Corporate Development, Legal, and Investor Relations on new investment structuring, follow-on financings, and exit/liquidity events to assess valuation impacts.
• Advise on the accounting and valuation implications of new or complex investment structures (e.g., tiered/contingent consideration, equity-linked instruments).

Process Controls
• Maintain and enhance internal controls (SOX) over the valuation process, including documentation standards, model governance, and data source validation.
• Drive continuous improvement of valuation templates, market data inputs, and benchmarking practices.

What you bring
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.
• 10+ years of relevant experience in valuation, financial modeling, investment banking, or private equity/venture capital, with a focus on private company or illiquid investment valuation.
• Demonstrated expertise in building and auditing complex financial models (DCF, comparable company analysis, option pricing models, waterfall/allocation models).
• Strong working knowledge of US GAAP fair value measurement guidance (ASC 820) and its application to private investments.
• Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting valuation conclusions to committees, auditors, or senior stakeholders.
• Advanced proficiency in Excel/financial modeling; familiarity with valuation software or platforms a plus.

You will own payroll tax processing and reporting across US, Canadian, and global entities, keeping us compliant with local, state, federal, and international regulations. You will configure and test withholding tax setups in Workday, reconcile liabilities, and lead quarter-end, year-end, and audit readiness. An early focus will be resolving legacy tax account discrepancies and putting in place the reconciliation foundation we need to scale, so your work will shape how this function runs for years to come! You will also partner with teams across Finance, Engineering, and People to deliver accurate reporting and analysis.

• Own withholding tax configuration in Workday, including setup, mapping, and maintenance of state, local, and international tax tables, and partner with Corporate Engineering to test changes in sandbox before production release.
• Run payroll tax processing and reporting across weekly, bi-weekly, and international payroll cycles, including multi-state and internationally mobile employees, and support payroll transitions from M A activity.
• Verify accuracy after each payroll with parallel reconciliations, and reconcile payroll tax liabilities weekly across US, Canadian, and global entities, along with quarterly returns filed by third-party providers.
• Resolve and permanently close out legacy tax discrepancies and historical imbalances, including GL payroll clearing account variances and unclaimed payroll check (escheatment) requirements.
• Lead quarter-end and year-end execution, including W-2s, T4s, and global equivalents, plus corrections and amended returns (W-2C, Form 941-X), and prepare for payroll tax audits with the IRS, CRA, HMRC, and state and local authorities.

• Hands-on experience configuring and maintaining payroll tax rules in an enterprise ERP (Workday Payroll preferred) and working with third-party tax filing providers such as ADP SmartCompliance.
• Solid understanding of payroll tax reconciliation, including liability reconciliation, quarter-end and year-end filings, and corrections and amendments.
• Advanced Excel skills for data analysis and reconciliations, plus comfort using AI tools to streamline reconciliations and filings.
• An analytical approach to untangling ambiguous tax scenarios with limited guidance.

The Data Platform organization builds and operates the systems that power how data is stored, moved, and consumed across Robinhood. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

The AI Platform Agentic Apps team builds the agent platform behind every AI agent at Robinhood. Today it gives a growing number of engineers and employees an AI teammate that ships code, queries data, and runs operational workflows on their behalf. We're building toward the same platform powering the agents millions of customers interact with directly, in real time. These agents don't just answer questions — they're designed to take real action across carefully curated meta harnesses. This is agentic AI at real scale, in a regulated financial environment, and it will change how Robinhood works!

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer on the AI Platform Agentic Apps team, you will design and build the harness that every agent at Robinhood runs on. A critical part of the role is making those agents trustworthy at scale: trajectory-level evals that measure how an agent reasons and acts, and action guardrails — permission models, approval gates, and sandboxing — built as platform primitives that other teams adopt. You'll be a technical anchor on a growing, high-caliber team, collaborating with product, infrastructure, and fellow ML engineers to take ambitious ideas from zero to one and into production. You'll help define the team's technical direction, mentor engineers, and shape how Robinhood decides an agent is ready to ship. This role offers a rare combination of technical depth, platform-scale impact, and the satisfaction of building systems that genuinely don't exist anywhere else.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
• Design and build the core of Robinhood's agent harness — orchestration, tool integrations, context and memory management — so one platform can safely power both high-trust internal agents and tightly scoped customer-facing ones.
• Ship agentic applications end to end on that harness, from an ambiguous problem to a production agent that takes real action on behalf of employees or customers, and feed what you learn back into the platform.
• Build trajectory-level evaluation systems that score how an agent got to an answer, not just the answer — tool-call correctness, planning and recovery, multi-step task completion — backed by simulation environments and synthetic task generation.
• Architect action guardrails as platform primitives: least-privilege tool scoping, permission models, human-approval gates for high-risk or irreversible actions, step and budget limits, sandboxing, and rollback.
• Make evals and guardrails products other teams adopt — SDKs, CI regression gates on prompt, model, and tool changes, continuous red-teaming, and production tracing that closes the loop from real traffic back into eval sets and guardrail models.
• Set the technical bar through architecture reviews, code reviews, and mentorship, and be the person who can make — and defend with data — the "don't ship" call.

WHAT YOU BRING
• 10+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or ML-focused software engineer, with strong Python and distributed-systems fundamentals and a track record of shipping LLM-powered systems to production at scale. A Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
• Hands-on experience building agentic systems end to end — tool use, orchestration, context management, multi-step planning — on top of frontier models, in production.
• Deep expertise evaluating agents: you've built trajectory-level evals, tool-call scoring, and simulation environments, and you can articulate why final-answer accuracy is insufficient for systems that act.
• Demonstrated expertise designing action-level guardrails — permission and tool-scoping models, approval gates, blast-radius controls, and sandboxing — for agents operating in systems where mistakes have consequences.
• Rigor in evaluation methodology: golden datasets, rubric and LLM-as-judge grading and their failure modes, statistical significance with small N, offline-to-online metric correlation, and eval data versioning and contamination control.
• Proven ability to build platforms, not just models: you've shipped eval, safety, or agent tooling that other engineering teams adopted, and you have the judgment to know when to build versus buy.

• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career

What you’ll do:

• Manage the Special Investigations pipeline, including intake, triage, prioritization, assignment, escalation, and timely resolution of matters requiring enhanced investigative expertise.

Your work will span three connected areas: establishing shared Data Trust capabilities, raising the reliability of data across batch and low-latency environments, and applying those foundations to a semantic context layer for trusted analytics and AI. This is an individual contributor role with broad organizational impact. You will personally contribute code, prototypes, architecture, and operational improvements while setting technical direction across engineering, data, security, privacy, legal, risk, analytics, and product teams. You will build reusable enterprise capabilities and reference patterns that partner teams can adopt, while domain teams retain ownership of their application-specific use cases and serving paths.

What you will own:
• Data Trust architecture and strategy: Define and execute the technical direction for data contracts, metadata and catalog modernization, lineage, data quality, privacy, and access controls. • Declarative enforcement primitives: Build platform services, libraries, and reference patterns that make contracts, quality rules, privacy policies, and access requirements versioned, testable, observable, and automatically enforceable across the data lifecycle.

It also supports regulatory examinations and engagement with federal banking regulators and OFAC.

• Assess possible sanctions violations. Lead internal investigations and advise on voluntary self-disclosures to OFAC under the Economic Sanctions Enforcement Guidelines.
• Prepare and submit specific license requests, interpretive guidance requests, and other correspondence to OFAC. Advise on how general licenses apply.
• Advise on BSA/AML requirements, including customer due diligence (CDD), beneficial ownership, Customer Identification Program (CIP), suspicious activity reporting (SAR), currency transaction reporting (CTR), recordkeeping, and FinCEN requirements.
• Review and advise on SoFi's sanctions and AML policies, procedures, risk assessments, and screening methods. Partner with Compliance to keep the program effective and in line with regulatory expectations.
• Give legal guidance on new products, features, partnerships, and markets, such as payments, cross-border activity, digital assets, and fintech partnerships. Identify sanctions and AML risks and practical ways to reduce them.
• Support regulatory examinations, inquiries, and enforcement matters with the OCC, Federal Reserve, FinCEN, OFAC, and other agencies.
• Review and negotiate sanctions and AML provisions in vendor, partner, and commercial agreements.

• Create and deliver training on sanctions and AML legal requirements for internal teams.
• Manage outside counsel on sanctions and AML matters.

What you'll need:

• 7 to 10 years of legal experience, with substantial and direct focus on U.S. economic sanctions (OFAC) and BSA/AML regulation.
• Specific, demonstrated OFAC expertise, including:
• In-depth knowledge of OFAC regulations (31 C.F.R. Chapter V), sanctions programs, and enforcement practice.
• Hands-on experience preparing license applications, voluntary self-disclosures, and responses to OFAC subpoenas or administrative inquiries.
• Experience advising on screening, blocking and rejecting decisions, and sanctions compliance program design consistent with OFAC's A Framework for OFAC Compliance Commitments.
• Strong working knowledge of the BSA, the USA PATRIOT Act, the Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020, and FinCEN regulations.

Preferred

Build and lead the Credit Operations function

Lead Commercial small-balance CRE underwriting and portfolio management

jobs.title: Staff Credit Policy Analyst – Condo, Co-op & Project Review
jobs.description:

The Role

As a Staff Credit Policy Analyst– Condominium, Co-op Project Review Strategy for Home Loans, you will lead credit policy strategy, governance, and execution, with a primary focus on condominium and co-op project review strategy, including warrantable and non-warrantable condominium programs.

This role will support SoFi’s broader residential lending platform across Conforming, Government, CES, Home Equity, Portfolio, Jumbo, Non-Agency, and other specialty products. You will develop and maintain policy frameworks governing condominium and co-op project eligibility, non-warrantable condominium lending, project-level risk assessment, documentation requirements, exceptions, investor compliance, and escalation practices.

You will serve as a strategic partner to Credit Risk, Credit Operations, Capital Markets, Product, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and Technology. The role will translate complex credit, regulatory, investor, and market requirements into clear policy, effective controls, scalable processes, and executable business rules.

What You’ll Do

Credit Policy Leadership Strategy
• Lead the development, governance, and continuous improvement of credit policies across SoFi’s home lending products.
• Own the strategy and policy framework for condominium and co-op project reviews, including warrantable and non-warrantable condominium lending.
• Establish policy standards aligned with SoFi’s risk appetite, investor requirements, portfolio objectives, and business strategy.
• Monitor changes in agency, investor, regulatory, market, and project-level risk requirements and recommend appropriate policy changes.
• Evaluate opportunities to expand or refine condominium and co-op lending while maintaining appropriate credit, collateral, legal, operational, and concentration controls.
• Partner with senior leadership to identify emerging project-level and broader credit risks and develop proactive risk-management strategies.
• Lead initiatives that improve policy clarity, decision consistency, operational efficiency, customer experience, and portfolio performance.

Condominium, Co-op Non-Warrantable Project Strategy
• Develop and maintain eligibility standards for warrantable and non-warrantable condominium and co-op projects.
• Establish requirements for project financials, budgets, reserves, insurance, assessments, litigation, structural conditions, ownership composition, commercial space, investor concentration, marketability, and project governance.
• Define the risk framework for non-warrantable condominium lending, including eligible project characteristics, prohibited or restricted conditions, documentation requirements, review standards, escalation criteria, and applicable risk mitigants.
• Evaluate the appropriate use of loan-level and project-level mitigants, including LTV, CLTV, credit profile, reserves, DTI, property type, occupancy, geographic concentration, project exposure, and other relevant risk factors.
• Develop standards for limited, streamlined, full, and enhanced project reviews.
• Establish requirements for complex projects, including projects with significant litigation, inadequate reserves, insurance concerns, commercial-use exposure, structural issues, construction or conversion risk, investor concentration, or other elevated risk factors.
• Provide senior guidance on complex and judgmental project reviews and determine when additional diligence or escalation is required.
• Develop consistent decisioning and exception practices for ineligible, conditionally eligible, and non-standard projects.
• Monitor project-level performance, exceptions, defects, concentrations, and market trends to inform policy changes and portfolio strategy.
• Partner with Capital Markets and Product to assess investor eligibility, execution considerations, pricing implications, and portfolio strategy for warrantable and non-warrantable projects.

Policy Governance Cross-Functional Leadership
• Define and maintain the credit policy governance framework, including approval processes, documentation standards, version control, change management, and implementation requirements.
• Serve as a key liaison between Credit Risk, Credit Operations, Capital Markets, Product, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and Technology.
• Represent Credit Policy in governance committees, product development discussions, investor meetings, and cross-functional steering groups.
• Provide senior leadership with clear recommendations on policy changes, risk acceptance, investor requirements, and operational impacts.
• Ensure policy decisions are supported by appropriate analysis, documented rationale, and clear ownership.
• Align policies, procedures, underwriting guidance, exception standards, training materials, and system logic.
• Clearly communicate policy changes and ensure they are implemented consistently across affected teams.

Policy Implementation System Enablement
• Translate credit policy requirements into clear underwriting guidance, business rules, decision logic, and operating procedures.
• Partner with Technology and business stakeholders to implement policy within Encompass LOS, credit decisioning engines, project review tools, and other systems.
• Support routing and decisioning logic based on borrower, loan, property, project, and risk attributes.
• Oversee user acceptance testing, policy-related releases, implementation controls, and post-production validation.
• Ensure automated decisioning logic, internal guidelines, and investor requirements remain synchronized.
• Identify opportunities to improve the use of automation, third-party tools, specialized reviews, and risk-based decisioning.
• Develop policy documentation, job aids, training materials, and decision frameworks that support consistent execution.

Risk Management, Controls Performance Monitoring
• Establish appropriate controls for condominium, co-op, and non-warrantable project review, including documentation, approval, escalation, exception, and quality-control requirements.
• Partner with Internal Audit, Enterprise Risk, Compliance, and examination teams to ensure policy controls are effective and well documented.
• Support responses to OCC examinations, investor reviews, quality-control findings, and other oversight activities involving credit policy or project review.
• Identify policy, process, and control deficiencies and lead remediation efforts through completion.
• Develop and monitor key risk indicators related to project review, exceptions, defects, turnaround times, policy adherence, concentrations, and portfolio performance.
• Review project review outcomes, overrides, exceptions, and defects to identify control weaknesses, training opportunities, or required policy changes.
• Use data, operational feedback, investor input, and portfolio performance to recommend policy, process, technology, or risk appetite changes.
• Conduct periodic reviews of project eligibility and non-warrantable condominium strategy based on market conditions, credit performance, investor demand, and risk trends.

Collaboration Team Development
• Provide subject-matter expertise, mentorship, and direction to policy analysts, underwriters, project review staff, and cross-functional partners.
• Support the development of consistent interpretation and application of project review policy.
• Build strong working relationships with Credit Operations and other teams responsible for project review, underwriting, fulfillment, and risk execution.
• Foster a culture of sound judgment, accountability, consistency, documentation, and continuous improvement.
• Help develop scalable processes and capabilities to support growth in condominium, co-op, non-warrantable, and other specialty lending products.

What You’ll Need
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
• 8+ years of residential mortgage experience, including significant experience in underwriting, credit policy, credit risk management, or condominium and co-op project review.
• Deep knowledge of condominium and co-op project eligibility, project review requirements, financial analysis, insurance, litigation, reserves, assessments, and project-level risk factors.
• Demonstrated experience evaluating or developing policy for non-warrantable condominium or other non-agency project lending.
• Experience interpreting and applying Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA, and other investor or regulatory requirements.
• Proven ability to lead or influence credit policy across multiple mortgage products, including Conventional, Government, Home Equity, CES, Portfolio, Jumbo, Non-Agency, or Non-QM products.

• Strong understanding of residential credit risk, real estate risk, collateral risk, exception management, and regulatory expectations.
• Experience partnering with Credit Operations, Underwriting, Product, Technology, Capital Markets, Legal, and Compliance teams.
• Experience working with Encompass LOS, project review platforms, credit decisioning systems, or similar technology.
• Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently, exercise sound judgment, and lead initiatives across a matrixed organization.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience leading condominium, co-op, non-warrantable, or project review policy at a bank, mortgage lender, agency, investor, or mortgage servicer.
• Experience with agency project review tools and methodologies, including CPM or comparable project review platforms.

• Experience leading policy modernization, credit transformation, or digital underwriting initiatives.

• Strong data fluency using Excel, Tableau, SQL, or similar tools.
• Demonstrated ability to use data and portfolio performance insights to drive policy recommendations and executive decision-making.

jobs.title: Group AML & CTF Manager
jobs.description:
As a Group AML & CTF Manager at Wise, you will help shape Wise’s Anti-Money Laundering (‘AML’) and Counter Terrorist Financing (‘CTF’) strategy and framework at a global level. You will be providing second line of defence oversight of key AML & CTF control areas including Transaction Monitoring, AML/CTF Investigations, Reporting, and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD).

This role sits within Wise’s Group Financial Crime Compliance Team, positioned within the Second Line of Defence. This role is pivotal in ensuring Wise’s compliance with global financial crime regulations, as well as ensuring Wise’s AML/ CTF systems and controls are robust and effective in mitigating financial crime risk.

What You'll Be Doing:

Governance & Oversight
• Support in the development of Group AML & CTF policies ensuring alignment with international financial crime regulatory requirements (e.g., FATF, UK Bribery Act, US FCPA, etc).
• Scrutinising and challenging the implementation of new controls or changes to existing controls in the AML & CTF framework to ensure design and operating effectiveness.
• Oversight of results from and collaboration with Financial Crime Quality Assurance (‘QA’), Financial Crime Compliance Monitoring and Testing (‘CMT), and Internal Audit (IA).
• Support the Group Financial Crime Governance & Risk Team with the development and monitoring of AML & CTF Management Information (‘MI’), resulting in the publication of trend analysis reports on a global and regional level for senior management.
• Support the Group Financial Crime Governance & Risk Team with oversight on Global AML & CTF issues and incidents, including raising self identified issues, the review and approval of action plans, due dates, and the validation of actions.
• Attendance at relevant AML & CTF related forums and committees to report on progress and key areas of concern as well as add insights. (i.e., quarterly planning sessions, domain level governance etc).

Risk Management
• Work with colleagues in Product and Product Compliance teams to design and implement controls that manage the AML & CTF risks faced by Wise.
• Support in the development and maintenance of risk assessments, coverage assessments, control assessments and gap analysis.
• Ongoing check/challenge/oversight of our Transaction Monitoring controls and EDD controls including supervised and unsupervised machine learning models, static rules and AI solutions.
• Support the Group Financial Crime Governance & Risk Team on the development and maintenance of:
• Country Risk Assessment;
• Industry Risk Assessment;
• Customer Risk Assessment;
• AML & CTF Risk Taxonomies;
• AML & CTF Key Risk Indications (‘KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (‘KPIs).

 

Advisory and Support
• You will be responsible for collaborating with a number of Group, and Regional Teams across Compliance, Product Compliance, Product, and FinCrime Operations, this includes:
• Providing AML & CTF subject matter expertise (i.e., remediation activities, responding to general ad-hoc compliance escalations and queries).
• Reviewing and approving new AML & CTF systems and controls, as well as material changes to existing AML & CTF systems and controls, ensuring systems and controls align with global regulatory requirements, as well as effectively mitigating financial crime risk.
• Supporting Product, and Product Compliance on large-scale AML & CTF initiatives requiring cross-functional collaboration.
• Reviewing and approving Product Risk Assessments conducted by Product Risk and Compliance, ensuring the assessment appropriately identifies and mitigates money laundering and terrorist financing risk, as well as aligning with Regional Compliance Teams.
• Supporting Regional Financial Crime Compliance Teams in relation to any AML & CTF tasks, reviews, escalations, and breaches.
• Leading ad-hoc reviews assessing the adequacy and effectiveness of Wise’s AML & CTF systems and controls, identifying enhancement opportunities and providing detailed recommendations.

Knowledge and Awareness
• Review and approval of AML & CTF related procedures and operational guidelines.
• Support the Knowledge Delivery Team and FinCrime Ops developing training needs assessments and skills assessments.
• Support the Knowledge Delivery Team with the delivery and approval of group-wide AML & CTF training material, ensuring the material is adequate, and up-to-date, as well as monitoring training completion.
• Support the Knowledge Delivery Team with the oversight and approval of role-specific AML & CTF tailored training.

What You'll Bring:
• 5+ years experience in financial crime compliance (2LoD experience required), specifically in AML & CTF, with experience at a global financial organisation and/or consultancy.
• Strong understanding of global financial crime regulations, risk management frameworks, and control environments as related to AML/CTF.
• Strong communication skills, with the proven ability to collaborate with a wide-number of people, and the capability to influence cross-function teams and stakeholders.
• Proven ability working independently and taking the lead on a range of AML & CTF initiatives, projects, and reviews.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess AML & CTF risks.
• Relevant degree or certifications (e.g., ACAMS, ICA) are preferred.
• International travel may be required.

jobs.title: External Reporting Senior Manager
jobs.description:
The Finance team is critical in supporting the Wise mission of money without borders.

We’re looking for a EXTERNAL REPORTING SENIOR MANAGER to join us. 

As a External Reporting Senior Manager in the Finance team, you will contribute to our mission by ensuring timely preparation of Group financial statements ensuring compliance with reporting regulations.

Job Description
• Own preparation and delivery of quarterly and annual financial statements in accordance with relevant accounting standards US GAAP and IFRS
• Own monthly consolidation: review mappings, inter-company eliminations, FX translation, equity, and consolidation journals
• Prepare EPS calculation, and notes for share-based compensation, operating segments, cash flow, income taxes, and other complex areas of quarterly and annual financial statements.
• Draft and update primary statements and notes under US GAAP and/or IFRS; maintain dual-GAAP bridges where applicable
• Run disclosure checklists and tie-out packages; ensure internal consistency across sections
• Manage review cycles and comment resolution; escalate blockers and drive decisions to meet filing dates
• Coordinate inputs with FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Investor Relations, Risk/Compliance, and Regional Finance leads
• Operate and evidence key SOX/ICFR and disclosure controls; remediate deficiencies and optimise control design
• Help to coordinate external audit process: manage deliverables lists, process walkthroughs, sample testing requests, and ad hoc resolution of audit queries specific to your domain
• Run reporting work-stream stand-ups; maintain timelines, RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies), and status dashboards

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Drive impact at a global scale – Facilitate the preparation of our external reporting across multiple entities with differing regulatory requirements.
• Own your own path to success – You’ll have a high level of autonomy and responsibility.
• Work in a team – You’ll have an opportunity to work together with like-minded, highly experienced and results oriented people.
• Inspire teams with your ideas, strategy, knowledge and self-starting attitude.
• Grow with the role – You will have the opportunity to develop your leadership skills as the business and Finance function grows in complexity.

Qualifications
• Theory – You have a professional finance qualification (e.g. ACA or equivalent) with +6 years of proven post qualification experience. Detailed knowledge of US GAAP and SEC reporting is a must, with demonstrable experience or strong familiarity in these areas.
• Practice – You have demonstrable experience preparing or reviewing (i.e through audit) publicly listed Annual Reports and Accounts (ARA) and 20-F/10-K. You have external reporting/consolidation experience, including multi‑currency and multi‑entity consolidations in listed-company environments. You have strong experience with consolidation/reporting and disclosure management tools, XBRL tagging, and ERPs. You have advanced excel and strong document management/version control skills.
• Love getting things done – You’re not afraid to roll up your sleeves and take responsibility to do whatever needs doing to solve problems. You are highly accurate, detail-oriented, and demonstrate strong ownership and leadership in project management.
• Collaborative and influencing skills – You work well in an international team environment, and know how to have an impact through others. You have partnered with complex internal and external stakeholder groups and have strong communication skills.
• Stakeholder management – You exhibit exceptional coordination skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with multiple international and cross-functional teams, demonstrating flexibility and a proactive approach.

Nice to have
• Experience with capital markets transactions (IPO, debt/equity offerings, prospectuses/circulars)
• Financial services/fintech industry exposure
