jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Affirmative for Women
jobs.description:
We are expanding our Latin American teams by establishing a new São Paulo engineering hub, building multiple new, high-impact engineering teams on the ground. We are looking for ambitious and highly skilled Staff Software Engineers to join these LatAm engineering teams, contributing to the first wave of talent in this hub. This is a unique opportunity to be a foundational member of our São Paulo engineering hub, helping to shape our local culture, processes, and technical direction. You will play a crucial role in expanding our product across Latin American markets, covering Onboarding (Consumer & Business) and Money Movement capabilities by integrating with local partners, connecting with local payment schemes, and building seamless customer journeys across the region, while collaborating closely with our global teams, including helping to shape our global KYC/KYB and money movement systems.

Your Role:

As a Staff Software Engineer based in our new São Paulo engineering hub, you will be a core contributor within one of the LatAm engineering teams, focused on building robust and scalable capabilities for Onboarding (Consumer & Business) and Money Movement across the diverse Latin American region. You will be instrumental in implementing integrations with banks, payment providers, identity/business verification vendors, and other local partners, connecting our platform to various local payment systems, optimizing onboarding funnels, and handling the complexities of moving money across countries, within your team's specific area of focus.

This role requires a high level of technical and product excellence and a passion for building high-quality, scalable, and compliant solutions tailored for the unique financial infrastructure and regulatory landscape of Latin America. You won't just be writing code; you will be involved in proposing solid technical designs, participating in code and design reviews within your team, and collaborating closely with engineers in other global offices to build the core infrastructure that unlocks and grows new markets across LatAm, especially in the area of global KYC/KYB and money movement systems.

You will have the chance to significantly contribute to the technical direction for your team's domain, help build a best-in-class engineering organisation right here in São Paulo, leveraging your experience to mentor and coach less experienced team members as we grow the engineering teams in this new hub. You will also collaborate closely with other engineering teams being established in São Paulo, and with global teams in other locations.

 

What You'll Be Doing:
• Design, develop, test, and deploy features and services to enable Consumer & Business Onboarding and Money Movement capabilities in existing and new Latin American markets, within your team's focus area.
• Implement integrations with local banks, payment providers, identity/business verification vendors, and financial partners across the region.
• Connect the Wise platform to various local payment schemes and networks across Latin America.
• Automate and improve onboarding workflows and compliance checks (KYC/KYB) for different customer types across the region.
• Propose and advocate for high-quality technical designs and solutions for both Onboarding and Money Movement that are scalable, reliable, and compliant with the diverse regulations across Latin American markets.
• Participate in code and design reviews within your team, providing constructive feedback to maintain and elevate our engineering standards.
• Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and engineers in our other global offices, to align on product vision and technical implementation for regional expansion and contribute to the evolution of our global KYC/KYB and money movement systems.
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to Onboarding, Money Movement, cross-border payments, and local integrations in LatAm markets.
• Contribute to the technical strategy and roadmap for the LatAm domain.
• Act as a technical mentor for less experienced engineers within your team and contribute to the technical growth of the São Paulo engineering hub.
• Stay updated on relevant LatAm market trends to inform product development and ensure compliance.

jobs.title: Group Financial Crime Screening Manager
jobs.description:
As a Group Financial Crime Screening Manager, you will help shape Wise’s Financial Crime strategy and framework, by advising on and overseeing Wise’s Politically Exposed Persons (“PEPs”) and Adverse Media (“AM”) processes, systems and controls, and framework. This role sits within Wise’s Group Financial Crime Compliance Team specifically under the CDD/EDD domain, positioned within the 2nd Line of Defence. This role is pivotal in ensuring Wise’s compliance with global financial crime regulations, as well as ensuring Wise’s systems and controls are robust and effective in mitigating financial crime risk.

What You'll Be Doing:

Risk Management:
• Support in the development and maintenance of Wise’s financial crime typology mapping to ensure Wise has a globally comprehensive view of the financial crime risks that are relevant to it and work with Product Compliance to ensure mitigation coverage thereof at the point of onboarding and continuously thereafter.
• Ongoing check/challenge/oversight of our Control Framework
• Support Product, Product Compliance, Engineering, Ops with:
• Advising on the development and maintenance of the PEP & AM control framework including:
• Local regulatory compliance
• In-flight project activities
• Advisory & Support
• Key Risk Indications (‘KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (‘KPIs).
• You will be responsible for collaborating with a number of Group, and Regional Teams across Compliance, Product Compliance, Product, and FinCrime Operations, this includes:
• Provide subject matter expertise (i.e., remediation programmes, leading the response to general ad-hoc compliance escalations etc).
• Reviewing and approving new systems and controls, as well as material changes to existing systems and controls, ensuring systems and controls align with global regulatory requirements, as well as effectively mitigating financial crime risk.
• Supporting Product, and Product Compliance on large-scale initiatives requiring cross-functional collaboration.
• Assisting on ad-hoc reviews assessing the adequacy and effectiveness of Wise’s systems and controls, identifying enhancement opportunities and providing detailed recommendations.
• Reviewing and approving Product Risk Assessments conducted by Product Risk and Compliance, ensuring the assessment appropriately identifies and mitigates money laundering and terrorist financing risk, as well as aligning with Regional Compliance Teams. 

Governance & Oversight:
• Support in the development of Group Financial Crime policies and procedures ensuring alignment with international financial crime regulatory requirements (e.g., FATF, UK Bribery Act, US FCPA, etc).
• Oversight of results from and collaboration with Financial Crime Quality Assurance (‘QA’), Financial Crime Compliance Monitoring and Testing (‘CMT), and Internal Audit (IA).
• Support with oversight on Global PEP & AM issues and incidents, including raising self identified issues, the review and approval of action plans, due dates, and the validation of actions.
• Ad-hoc attendance at relevant related forums (i.e., quarterly planning sessions, Ops Steer etc).

Knowledge and Awareness:
• Support in the review and approval of related procedures and operational guidelines.
• Support the Knowledge Delivery Team and FinCrime Ops training needs assessments and skills assessments.
• Support the Knowledge Delivery Team with the oversight and approval of group-wide training material, ensuring the material is adequate, and up-to-date, as well as monitoring training completion.
• Support the Knowledge Delivery Team with the oversight and approval of role-specific tailored training

What You'll Bring:
• 5+ years experience in financial crime compliance, with a focus on Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) and Adverse Media (AM) on consumers and legal entities, and with a global financial organisation and/or consultancy. Relevant certifications (e.g., ACAMS, ICA) are preferred.
• In-depth knowledge of global financial crime regulations, risk management frameworks, and control environments.
• Excellent communication skills, with the proven ability to collaborate with a wide-number of people, and the capability to influence cross-function teams and senior stakeholders.
• Proven ability working independently and supporting on a range of CDD & EDD, including PEPs, AM, KYC and KYB initiatives, projects, and reviews.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess financial crime risks.
• International travel may be required.

jobs.title: Group Risk Lead - Assets Risk
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Risk Lead to join the Global Risk team at Wise and focus on enabling our Wise Assets product to meet its strategic objectives. This is a second line role and will report into the Head of Risk Product Governance.

Wise Assets is an investment product that allows eligible customers to earn a return on their money by investing it in the market rather than holding it as cash. It is a self-directed feature within the Wise multi-currency account where funds are placed into money market funds or stocks managed by third-party fund managers.

YOUR MISSION

You will partner with the Head of Risk Product Governance and the wider Risk organisation to strengthen and continuously evolve the risk management programme supporting Wise Assets.

You will help ensure that risk frameworks are effectively embedded into the product lifecycle, operational processes, and strategic decision-making, while enabling Wise Assets to scale responsibly across multiple jurisdictions.

You will provide independent challenge, oversight and guidance to ensure risks are identified early, appropriately assessed, transparently reported, and effectively managed through enhancements to the control environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Implement and embed Wise’s Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF), associated policies, standards and methodologies across the Wise Assets product ecosystem, ensuring alignment with product developments and appropriate prioritisation of regulatory requirements. This will include establishing and maintaining risk appetite for Assets.
• Partner with first line teams and co-ordinate with regional risk colleagues to ensure risk management practices are consistently applied and operating effectively across product, operational and governance processes.
• Provide independent second line oversight and challenge on risk assessments, control design, control effectiveness and residual risk decisions relating to Wise Assets activities and initiatives.
• Support product growth and innovation by reviewing new products, features, market expansions and strategic initiatives, providing pragmatic risk advice and recommending proportionate mitigation strategies.
• Apply ERMF methodologies, including RCSAs, to drive risk and control mapping and assessment activities, ensuring key risks, controls, dependencies and monitoring mechanisms are clearly identified and maintained.
• Oversee control assurance activities and monitor the effectiveness of key controls, identifying areas of weakness, emerging risks, or control gaps requiring remediation.
• Own and coordinate issue management activities for Wise Assets, including tracking remediation plans, challenging delivery timelines, escalating delays or material concerns, and ensuring actions are completed in line with enterprise standards and policy requirements.
• Monitor key risk indicators, operational incidents, control failures and emerging trends to proactively identify deteriorating risk exposures or areas requiring management intervention.
• Support the development and delivery of risk training and awareness initiatives across Wise Assets, helping strengthen risk culture and risk ownership within the business.
• Produce high-quality risk reporting and insights for governance committees and senior stakeholders, ensuring reporting is data-driven, clear, actionable and focused on material risk themes.
• Report on risks operating outside approved appetite thresholds, including escalation of significant exposures, thematic concerns, or persistent control weaknesses.
• Provide qualitative and quantitative analysis of incidents, issues and remediation activities impacting Wise Assets, including trend analysis and escalation where required.
• Consolidate risk insights across regions to support enterprise-wide reporting and contribute to effective decision-making at Group governance forums.
• Build strong relationships with Product, Compliance, Operations, Engineering, Legal, Audit and Regional Risk teams to ensure risk management supports commercial growth while maintaining robust governance standards.

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineering Team Lead - Financial Crime
jobs.description:
About

the role:

Wise protects millions of customers and billions in transactions from fraud, money laundering and financial crime. Our ML systems are the front line of defense - operating at a global scale of 100K requests/minute under strict sub-50ms latency SLAs. We need an exceptional technical leader to own how these models are engineered, shipped and scaled.

We're hiring a Senior ML Engineering Lead to build and grow Wise's Risk Modelling engineering pillar. You will own the full model lifecycle standard for financial crime detection - from offline experimentation to production deployment and real-time monitoring and build the team to execute it. Your job is to build the automated engineering ecosystem and organisation that scales this safely to hundreds of models.

This is a rare greenfield leadership role with strong investment and engagement from Wise's CTO and senior leadership.

 

How we work:

Risk ML sits within Wise's FinCrime organisation, owning the full ML and AI foundation for financial crime detection. We're have three dedicated pillars - Feature Platform, Learning Loop and Risk Modelling. You'll lead the Risk Modelling pillar, leading a team of Senior ML Systems Engineers and Applied ML Engineers.

We operate with high autonomy and low hierarchy. You'll own the engineering strategy end-to-end - from architecture decisions and infrastructure design through to hiring, team culture and cross-platform partnerships. We value leaders who shape direction and build teams, not just manage delivery.

 

What will you be working on?:

The Model Factory: Architect the declarative pipeline that turns a configuration file into a deployed, monitored model - the engineering backbone for scaling to hundreds of models

The Experimentation Engine: Establish the reusable path from research (partnering with DS Research) to high-throughput production for traditional and modern architectures 

Model Operations: Build the infrastructure for automated retraining, drift detection, threshold simulation/management and audit trails - the operational layer required to run hundreds of models safely at scale

The Team: Recruit, lead and mentor a world-class team of ML engineers. Establish a high-performance, engineering-first culture from scratch - setting hiring standards, technical bar and growth paths

Cross-Platform Partnership: Define and navigate the partnership with key platform teams - owning the build vs consume decisions for your pillar

 

What do you need?:

You've explicitly led or built an ML Engineering or model lifecycle automation team (not just used one) at a high-growth company - you defined the standards that other engineering teams followed

System-level and mathematical depth: you can design a model factory architecture, review a training pipeline & debug a runtime inference latency regression

Experience in high-throughput environments where latency constraints are tight and model failures carry massive financial consequences

Track record of hiring and developing senior engineers - you've built a team, not just inherited one

Ability to navigate ambiguity and make architecture-level decisions with incomplete information - this is a greenfield build, not an optimisation role

Strong enough technically to guide and review across deep learning, ML systems and production infrastructure - you lead through depth, not just delegation

Nice to Have:

Experience at a tier-1 fintech or payments company

Experience with graph-based methods (GNNs, entity resolution) in production

Foundation model fine-tuning or LLM evaluation experience

Experience establishing ML engineering practices in organisations transitioning from classical ML to deep learning

 

Interested? Find out more:
• How we work – a practical guide
• DEI @ Wise
• Wise Tech Stack (2025 update)
• See what it's like to work at Wise London!
• Our Engineering career map
• Wise Engineering – https://medium.com/wise-engineering

What do we offer:
• Starting salary: £135,000 - £175,000 + RSUs
• Wise Benefits

jobs.title: Banking Operations Function Lead – Europe & SWIFT
jobs.description:
About the role

Wise relies on banking partners to move customers’ money around the world. When those partners are slow, unavailable or make mistakes, payments get delayed or fail, customers are affected and costs and risks increase.

As Wise grows, we need a clear view of how our partners are performing, where problems are emerging and what needs to improve. We need strong teams that hold partners accountable, influence internal priorities and turn recurring issues into lasting fixes.

That’s why this role exists. You lead Banking Operations across your assigned regions, building a capable, independent team while staying hands-on with critical partners and complex issues. You use data and operational insight to monitor performance, anticipate risks and hold banking partners accountable for high standards of service, quality and reliability. You set priorities and bring the right people together to turn recurring problems into lasting fixes—delivering fewer payment delays, failures and incidents, lower risk exposure and stronger control over partner costs.

Activities performed on the job
• Set direction and resources. Own the regional Banking Operations strategy and multi-quarter roadmap within the shared global operating model. Set clear OKRs and priorities, and align capacity, budget, skills and coverage with regional needs and growth.
• Co-lead the global Banking Operations operating model. Work with fellow Function Leads to build and maintain shared standards, KPIs, dashboards, playbooks, reporting and operating routines. Agree cross-regional priorities, maintain clear decision rights, escalation paths and backup coverage, and scale proven regional improvements globally.
• Build a strong, independent team. Lead hiring, onboarding, performance, development and succession. Coach operational judgement, partner negotiation and delivery. Address performance gaps and strengthen ownership.
• Own critical partners and escalations. Manage a small portfolio and act as the senior regional escalation point. Lead complex investigations and incident recovery, clearly communicating customer and commercial impact, risks, decisions needed and lasting fixes.
• Improve partner performance. Use data and Partner Health assessments to monitor processing speed, failure rates, availability, incidents and control gaps. Identify risks, prioritise improvements, agree operational SLAs and service commitments, hold partners accountable and verify results.
• Influence roadmaps and launches. Be the regional point of expertise for Banking Operations. Work with Banking, Product, Engineering, Payops and other teams to turn customer and operational problems into business cases with quantified impact, urgency, options and recommendations. Resolve dependencies, ensure launch readiness and track improvements through delivery, adoption and measurable impact.
• Build scalable ways of working. Contribute to shared governance, dashboards, playbooks, reporting and operating routines. Ensure clear partner records, decision rights, escalation paths and backup coverage. Give stakeholders visibility into partner health and share proven regional improvements globally.
• Manage risk and partner costs. Ensure processes within scope meet Wise policies and relevant regulatory requirements. Work with accountable teams to close control gaps, validate fee discrepancies, secure corrections or recoveries and prevent recurring losses.
• Use technology and AI effectively. Adopt approved tools and automation with clear ownership, appropriate safeguards and verified benefits relative to cost.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead - Recommend Team (Backend Focused - Hands on)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Engineering Lead to join our Recommend team in the London office.

At the Recommend team, we aim to grow the Wise customer base through Referrals and Word of Mouth. We make it easy and rewarding for customers to recommend Wise to their friends, family and connections, through both our referral programme and experiences that encourage organic recommendations. 

From building referral platforms, to creating a smooth onboarding experience for referred customers and building reward mechanisms, we own the whole journey until the first international money needs are met. Our team is dedicated to building the best recommendation journey and diverse reward mechanisms to solve customers' first international money needs in a way that’s clear, easy and delightful. Our team is diverse and is made of software engineers (frontend, backend, mobile), data analysts, and designers and more who collaborate on a daily basis to continuously improve customer experience with recommendation journeys at Wise.

As an Engineering Lead you will:
• Lead, coach, and mentor a team of driven engineers, supporting their growth and empowering them to do their best work.
• Work closely with the Product Manager and your team to shape the roadmap, set the technical and product vision around three levers: reach customers at the right moment, make it easy for them to advocate, and ensure customers feel recognised and rewarded for recommending Wise
• Own the technical strategy and delivery of our referral and word of mouth platform, including being hands on at times. Architect for scale and resilience the core technology that empowers any team to launch flexible, incentivised campaigns, and guides every referred customer to their first successful task at Wise.
• Enable your team to succeed by ensuring they are well-resourced, can plan effectively, and are set up to commit to and deliver on their roadmap.
• Stay and remain very close to the tech and product - setting high standards for quality, and leading by example.
• Own the health and productivity of the engineers in your team, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
• Own the hiring, growth and development of your team and its impact at Wise.
• Work with Marketing, Regional and other product teams across Wise, so as to offer new incentives and campaigns adapted to different use-cases and markets.
• Keep an overview of the wider Scalable Growth space and think about engineering as a whole, including how other teams can build on our platform and tooling.
• Understand the team's systems deeply enough to be hands-on when needed, and join the team's on-call rotation for our critical services.

What do you need?
• You are proactive and opinionated. You demonstrate that you tackle challenges head-first; you take the lead and are comfortable with taking action outside your strict remit if needed in order to ensure that the goal is achieved. You have strong opinions held loosely and with proven experience in transforming teams’ ways-of-working.
• You have proven experience in leading and mentoring software engineers. You enjoy helping others grow and succeed.
• You have a strong product and customer mindset and experience building customer facing products. You demonstrate that you are a peer to your Product manager: partnering in Product Discovery, challenging your peer, striving for urgency to find quick ways to validate while building for the long-term once value is proven. You are comfortable with wearing multiple hats when needed including Product, Design and Analytics.
• You possess strong technical expertise or background in OOP Languages (Java or similar) and modern technology stacks. You are comfortable with getting hands-on, diving in code to assist the team and show the way.
• You have experience working with other functions like Frontend and/or Mobile engineers
• You have experience working with and building distributed, high scalability systems, event-driven, asynchronous and microservice architectures. You have strong experience in decoupling systems without disrupting business continuity.
• You have experience in domains of promoting virality amongst users and complex interactions amongst them (e.g. referrer - referee, social media sharing, seller - buyer, driver - passenger) etc.
• You're a great communicator who can articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• You thrive in a collaborative environment and have experience working effectively with cross-functional peers like data science, designers, product managers, and analysts.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead - Comparison Team (Data Focused)
jobs.description:
About the role

We are looking for a talented Engineering Lead to join our Comparison team, part of the Onboarding & Scalable Growth squad

Comparison is about transparency, helping customers understand the real cost of sending money and why Wise is the better choice. You'll own the systems that collect pricing data from competitors and make it accessible across Wise. That data serves two customers: customer-facing comparison experiences (web pages, widget, calculator and the public API), and competitive intelligence that helps Marketing, Regional and Pricing teams shape their strategy.

This means creating the underlying technology that enables Wise to build intelligent and resilient (self-healing) scrapers at scale (thousands) operating with minimal manual intervention. It also includes building reliable data pipelines, and APIs that teams depend on. Accuracy and trust are non-negotiable.

The comparison team is small but growing: full-stack and backend engineers working with Product, Analytics, Design and Comparison Operations. The work covers the whole stack, from data collection pipelines and backend services to the React/Next.js experiences customers see. We're looking for a lead who is comfortable on both sides and is excited by data-heavy products and is driven to build a scalable and reliable data collection framework.

As an Engineering Lead, you will:
• Lead, coach and mentor the engineers in your team. You'll own their health, growth and productivity, and grow the team as it scales.
• Work closely with the Product Manager to shape the roadmap and technical vision across our three growth levers: reach (collect pricing in new markets and new products), convert (enhance our comparison web pages, widget and calculator) and retain (introduce comparison in the logged-in experience).
• Own the reliability, accuracy and scalability of our competitor data platform and the public Comparison API, from collection and validation through to how the data is served.
• Own the technical strategy and delivery of our intelligent scraping platform. Architect and scale the core technology that empowers teams to deploy thousands of intelligent, self-healing, and resilient scrapers, minimizing manual maintenance while maximizing data accuracy.
• Push forward how we use AI in our data pipeline, for example LLM scrapers, automated quality control and AI-assisted ways to fix scrapers. Make sure we adopt it safely, measurably and at scale.
• Give feedback on technical designs and help the team make data-driven decisions, using experiments and our North Star metric (Comparison-sourced new customers) to decide what to build next.
• Partner across Wise, including Marketing, Compliance, SEO, Regional, and Pricing teams, to establish clear operating models, request triage, and governance so that comparison data is trusted wherever price proof matters, while balancing customer-facing and internal user needs with clear trade-offs.
• Keep an overview of the wider Scalable Growth space and think about engineering as a whole, including how other teams can build on our data and tooling.
• Understand the team's systems deeply enough to be hands-on when needed, and join the team's on-call rotation for our critical services.

What do you need?

We are fully aware that it is uncommon for a candidate to have all skills required and we fully support everyone in learning new skills with us. So if you have some of those listed below and are eager to learn more we do want to hear from you!
• A track record of leading, coaching and mentoring driven, high-performing teams. Experience setting up ways of working that help a team deliver fast while improving reliability and quality.
• A strong product mindset and a passion for UX. You prioritise work with customers in mind and make data-driven decisions to fix customer pain points
• Great communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences
• Experience designing and operating scalable, resilient systems that handle large amounts of data and traffic, with a focus on observability, data quality. You can demonstrate how you reduced manual operational work while maintaining reliability and correctness
• The ability to break down complex projects into incremental milestones that deliver customer value, especially when you're entering a new product area or market
• Knowledge of and experience with Java and Spring Boot, event-driven microservices architectures (for example Kafka) and relational databases
• Experience with, or a strong interest in, applying LLMs in production: data extraction, evaluation and observability, and guarding against hallucination
• Hands-on experience designing and operating systems that collect and validate data from changing or unreliable external sources (e.g. web scraping, third-party integrations).
• Experience running experiments (A/B testing) and working closely with analysts is a plus

jobs.title: Privacy Operations Lead
jobs.description:
At Wise, our customers rely on us to handle their data carefully. Our global Privacy team helps make that happen while keeping things simple for customers and Wisers.

As our Privacy Operations Manager, you’ll run the day to day work behind our global privacy operations. That includes data subject rights requests (“DSRRs”), third party privacy due diligence, records of processing activities (“ROPA”) and privacy risk reporting.

You’ll improve how the team works at scale - simplifying processes, reducing manual work and giving senior governance forums clear information about privacy risk

You’ll work across Legal, Product, Engineering, Third Party Management, Security, Customer Service and Complaints teams to remove blockers and keep privacy operations running smoothly as Wise grows.

 

What you’ll do:
• Run the team handling DSRRs, making sure work is prioritised, queues remain healthy and requests are completed accurately and within statutory deadlines. Provide regular coaching and feedback, helping people build their skills and progress in their careers.
• Improve DSRR workflows, quality assurance (“QA”) checks, guidance, templates and tooling so the team can handle growing volumes and more complex cases with less manual work and consistently high quality.
• Run privacy due diligence for our vendor and commercial partners, Maintain ongoing vendor reviews and periodic reassessments based on privacy risk, working with Third Party Management and Security.

Work with Product, Engineering and other technical teams to make sure updates reflect changes to systems, data flows and infrastructure, and maintain the evidence and audit trails needed for internal reviews and regulatory enquiries.

Use quantitative and qualitative indicators to highlight trends, backlogs, vendor risk and emerging issues, and act as the main operational point of contact working with Privacy Counsel on complex or high-risk cases.

jobs.title: Risk Manager

jobs.title: AML Senior Product Compliance & Risk Manager - APAC
jobs.description:

You’ll work closely with local Product Compliance & Risk (PC&R), Compliance, and Risk stakeholders from across our different APAC markets - as well as APAC and global Product and Engineering teams.

jobs.title: Senior/Lead Product Engineer II - Contacts Team
jobs.description:
The Contacts team is a core team at Wise, dedicated to making adding, finding, and managing your recipients as easy as possible. We own this experience end-to-end: from the scalable platform securing tens of millions of bank accounts customers send to, to the intelligent search algorithms and local integrations (like Pix) that power discovery, all the way to the customer-facing screens where users interact with their counterparties. What will you be working on?

You will be part of an autonomous team, driving the technical vision for the backend solution powering the recipient’s user experience. You will help us scale-up and build a world class recipient management product.

What do you need?

We are fully aware that it is uncommon for a candidate to have all skills required and we fully support everyone in learning new skills with us. So if you have some of those listed below and are eager to learn more, we do want to hear from you!
• You get things done
• You have experience working with large scale distributed systems

jobs.title: COO
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Airtm is a dynamic and rapidly-growing fintech company that operates in over 100 countries, providing innovative financial solutions to users worldwide. Our platform leverages cutting-edge technology to bridge traditional financial systems with the digital age, enabling seamless and secure money transfers, currency exchange, and digital payments.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Chief Operating Officer (COO) to join our executive team and lead the operational aspects of Airtm. As COO, you will play a pivotal role in scaling our operations, improving efficiency, and driving the company's growth trajectory while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities
Operational Leadership - Provide visionary leadership to the operations team, overseeing day-to-day activities, setting clear objectives, and driving continuous improvement across various functions, including customer support, data and analytics, compliance, and internal processes.
Strategic Planning - Collaborate with the CEO and other senior leaders to develop and execute the company's overall strategic plan. Translate strategic goals into actionable operational plans that align with the company's mission and growth targets.
Scalability and Efficiency - Identify opportunities to optimize processes, streamline workflows, and enhance scalability. Implement best practices and operational standards to support the company's expansion into new markets and regions.
Cross-Functional Collaboration - Foster effective communication and collaboration among different departments, including engineering, product development, growth, and finance, to ensure a cohesive approach to achieving company goals.
Performance Monitoring and Reporting - Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) for various operational functions and regularly track, analyze, and report on these metrics to the executive team. Use data-driven insights to inform decision-making and drive operational improvements.
Talent Development - Build and mentor a high-performing operations team, nurturing a culture of innovation, accountability, and professional growth. Identify skill gaps and implement training and development programs as needed.
Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field; MBA or relevant advanced degree is a plus.
- Proven track record of at least 10 years in senior leadership roles within the fintech or financial services industry, with a focus on operations and scalability.
- Demonstrated experience in successfully leading and managing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, global environment.
- Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to translate vision into actionable plans.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively at all levels of the organization.
- Data-driven mindset with proficiency in using analytics to drive operational decision-making.
- Entrepreneurial spirit and a passion for driving innovation and disruption in the fintech space.
Location

The COO position is remote with the expectation of quarterly travel for team meetings.

Join us at Airtm

If you are a strategic thinker, a collaborative leader, and have a deep passion for revolutionizing the financial services industry, we invite you to join our team. As the COO of Airtm, you will have the opportunity to make a lasting impact on our global operations, drive growth, and shape the future of digital finance.
To apply, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are excited about the opportunity to lead operations at Airtm.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Small Business
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

Sales is the growth engine at Brex. We bring in new customers, expand existing relationships, and drive the company’s bottom line. With unlimited territories and uncapped opportunity, your ambition sets the ceiling. We win together, celebrate often, and reward performance. If you want to sell a category-defining product with real ownership, this is your team.

What you’ll do

As an Account Executive, you will be working with founders, co-founders, C-Suite Executives, controllers, and VP’s of Finance to continue generating net-new revenue and growing the Brex brand. You will manage a full pipeline and ensure success on every level.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

• Become trusted account advisors by managing accounts and being strategic in both inbound and outbound sales
• Engage with businesses at all points of the sales cycle - including prospecting, product demonstrations, onboarding, and close.
• Develop strategic plans on how to close more companies and generate more revenue
• Focus on self-development with daily training and enablement
• Work closely with Startups Ambassadors to bring in referrals

Requirements
• 18+ months of outbound B2B SaaS sales experience, including 6+ months of closing experience
• Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota, President's Club, or top 10% of your team
• Comfortable running discovery and closing conversations with C-suite decision makers
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $122,026 - $152,533. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

What you'll do

As an Underwriting Analyst, your goal is to support our underwriting processes for our card products and grow your skills as a credit professional. This is a role that requires strong communication, time management, financial analysis, and teamwork. You will partner cross-functionally with our Sales, Customer Experience, Engineering, and Product teams to contribute to meeting organizational goals, and will have the opportunity to develop into more senior credit responsibilities over time.

Responsibilities
• Own and work assigned cash-based underwriting queues, including account reviews, limit changes, and credit-related requests.
• Evaluate customer creditworthiness and repayment capacity using bank statements, transaction data, cash-flow trends, and other business information.
• Analyze cash balances, revenue, burn, runway, utilization, and transaction activity to identify evolving credit risk.
• Make sound, risk-based recommendations within delegated authority, balancing customer impact with responsible exposure management.
• Clearly communicate underwriting decisions, rationale, and information requirements to internal partners and, when needed, customers.
• Partner with Sales, Customer Experience, Credit Policy, Risk, Data, Product, and Engineering to resolve complex cases and improve the end-to-end credit experience
• Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve underwriting quality, efficiency, and consistency.
• Use data, spreadsheets, and AI-enabled tools to streamline routine work and surface actionable insights.
• Partner with cross-functional teams to improve tools and workflows that support cash-based underwriting.

Requirements
• Passionate about credit and underwriting decisions on commercial exposures for small to large businesses
• Strong analytical rigor and attention to details
• Customer centric and passionate about thinking through customer needs and working with them while balancing risk exposures
• Ability to communicate technical problems in an elegant and tactful way

Bonus Points
• Familiarity with quantitative credit risk models, probability of default (PD), and loss given default (LGD) concepts
• Familiarity with underwriting or credit-risk tooling and workflows.
• Experience using SQL, Hex, spreadsheets, or similar tools to analyze data and identify trends.
• Familiarity with banking regulations and global markets
• Experience using Salesforce or comparable case-management tools

MetaMask is building the infrastructure for a decentralised web. Our TechOps team keeps that infrastructure running — reliably, securely, and at scale. As a Senior Systems Administrator, you'll own the technical backbone that our engineers, product teams, and operations depend on every day.

jobs.description:
Linus Yale patented the modern pin tumbler lock in 1861, and hotels took to it immediately. The clever part was never the lock; it was master keying. The same door opens for a guest with one key and the manager with another, each cut to a different depth of authority. It solved the problem every growing building has, and introduced a new one, because now a single key opens everything.

The hard part was never the lock. It's deciding who gets which key.

Mercury is built for the building class: those who act on their ambition, who see something that doesn't exist and decide to make it real with their time, money, and team; whether that's a side project or a scaling unicorn. We build the financial stack for them, backed by elegant and intelligent software meant to work from day one to scale.

Deciding who gets a key is only half the job. The other half is what people do once they’re inside. Mercury becomes much more valuable when multiple people can work in it together, and the Users team makes that happen. We bring employees, finance teams, and accountants into Mercury safely, and we make it easy for them to get real work done alongside the founder: submitting receipts, paying bills, closing the books, and handing off tasks. Today, much of that interaction is thin. We want it to be rich, clear, and trustworthy, so founders never hesitate to invite their team and never wonder who did what. 

This is a customer-facing product role. The permissions foundation is strong; your job is to build the collaboration experience on top of it.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

What you’ll do:
• Own the experience of collaboration on Mercury - when a founder adds an employee, finance team, or accountant, we need to consider the roles, permissions, and product experiences that help them get work done
• Make it easier for a founder to bring their whole team onto Mercury: find out why they hesitate, and make invitation obvious, easy, and high-trust
• Make the work itself better: receipts, bills, bookkeeping, approvals, and handoffs between founders, employees, and accountants, with richer conversations, attachments, and a precise history of who did what
• Take it everywhere: build for the experience across email, Slack, iMessage, and wherever people are interacting about finance
• Build for scale: work with our largest customers to understand how they manage employee spend and financial operations as they grow, delivering critical functionality that empowers teams from three people to three thousand
• Shape where this space goes as our product ambition grows and the kinds of users we support change, agents among them

What we need from you:
• 5+ years of relevant product management experience, preferably on collaboration products where multiple people work together, comment, and hand off work, or on platform teams accountable for identity, roles, and authorization
• Taste and the judgment to balance product against platform. Permission models usually get more powerful by getting more complicated, and the opportunity here is to refuse that trade. This is arcane overhead at most companies; we'd like it to be a reason customers choose us
• Strong customer empathy across founders, employees, finance teams, and accountants, and the ability to design for each of them
• Product teams should want you in the room early. On a team that is driving proactive collaboration about how we unblock collaboration for our customers
• A point of view on agentic action, and on which parts of this get harder when the actor isn't a person
• A track record of turning ambiguity into a clear point of view, independently

About the opportunity:

We are looking for an experienced, commercially aware, and regulatory-savvy compliance professional to join us as Head of Compliance and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO).

The role will be instrumental in building the compliance programme from the ground up, and embedding a culture of compliance across the organisation.

Broader team management responsibilities will be added in due course for regulatory strategy, operational execution, and governance.

Key

Responsibilities:

Regulatory Engagement
• Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant regulatory bodies.
• Ensure the organisation meets all applicable governance requirements, including fit and proper obligations for Approved and Designated Persons.
• Monitor and interpret regulatory developments relevant to virtual assets, and advise senior management and the Board accordingly.

Compliance Programme Development Management
• Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive compliance framework aligned with local requirements, FATF recommendations, and international best practice for virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
• Develop, review, and update all internal policies and procedures covering AML/CFT, KYC, customer due diligence (CDD), enhanced due diligence (EDD), transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, data protection, cybersecurity compliance, and safeguarding of client assets.
• Establish and oversee the compliance monitoring programme, including periodic testing, gap analysis, and reporting to senior management and the Board.
• Prepare and present regular compliance reports to the Board and relevant committees, including on regulatory changes, compliance breaches, and remediation progress.
• Ensure compliance considerations are integrated into new product design and operations from the inception phase by driving solutions that balance commercial outcomes and innovation, while maintaining a robust compliance posture using a clear risk-based approach.
• Review technical documentation, user journeys, and product flows to ensure compliance risks are addressed; provide clear, actionable and solution-focused advice during the product lifecycle.
• Build and scale compliance policies governing advertising, social media campaigns, influencer partnerships, and product launches.
• Partner with Legal, Product, and Marketing teams to operationalize a timely review process for client-facing assets and go-to-market materials.

AML/CFT MLRO Duties
• Act as the designated MLRO, with full statutory responsibility for overseeing the organisation's AML/CFT framework.
• Receive, review, and assess all internal Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) from staff, and make informed decisions on whether to file external disclosures with competent local authorities.
• Oversee and continuously improve the transaction monitoring programme, with support from global compliance and product functions.
• Ensure robust sanctions screening against all applicable lists, including OFAC, UK OFSI, UN, EU, and applicable local sanctions designations.
• Oversee customer risk scoring, risk-based KYC/CDD processes, and enhanced due diligence for high-risk customers, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and customers from high-risk jurisdictions.

Governance Culture
• Act as a key member of the senior leadership team, providing compliance input on new products, services, partnerships, and business initiatives.
• Champion a strong compliance culture across the organisation through training, communications, and leadership by example.
• Design and deliver AML/CFT and compliance training programmes for all staff, ensuring completion records are maintained.
• Ensure that the organisation's compliance obligations are adequately resourced, and advise the Board on staffing, systems, and budget requirements.
• Establish and maintain a compliance manual, risk register and oversee the escalation and resolution of compliance incidents and breaches.

Reporting Recordkeeping
• Prepare and submit all required regulatory reports and notifications to relevant authorities within stipulated deadlines.
• Ensure that all compliance records, SAR documentation, KYC files, and transaction monitoring records are maintained in accordance with applicable retention requirements.
• Support and facilitate any inspections, supervisory visits, or regulatory examinations.

What We Look For in You

Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
• Professional certification in compliance or AML is strongly preferred (e.g. CAMS, ICA Certificate/Diploma in AML or Compliance, CFE, or equivalent).

Experience
• Minimum of 8 years of experience in compliance, AML, or financial crime prevention, with at least 3 years in a senior or leadership compliance role.
• Demonstrated in-house experience working within virtual asset service providers (VASPs), cryptocurrency exchanges, fintech firms, or regulated financial institutions.
• Prior experience as an MLRO or Deputy MLRO is highly desirable.
• Experience engaging directly with financial regulators and the financial intelligence unit
• Hands-on experience building compliance programmes from the ground up in a start-up or scaling environment is a significant advantage.
• Familiarity with the regional regulatory framework and requirements is strongly preferred.

Knowledge Skills
• Deep understanding of FATF Recommendations and their application to virtual asset service providers, including the Travel Rule (FATF Recommendation 16)
• Strong knowledge of crypto-specific AML typologies.
• Proficiency with blockchain analytics and transaction monitoring tools (e.g. Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs, or equivalent).
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and French.
• Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify and articulate complex risk scenarios clearly.
• Demonstrated ability to engage constructively with regulators, external auditors, and law enforcement.
• High degree of personal integrity and sound professional judgment.

Nice to Have
• Experience in cryptocurrency or blockchain compliance programs.
• Experience working in a multi-national financial institution setting.
• Familiarity with compliance technology and analytics tools.
• Prior exposure to multi-jurisdictional compliance oversight.
• In-depth knowledge of crypto products, including spot trading, derivatives, staking, lending/borrowing, DeFi, and stablecoins.

jobs.title: Head of Tax Information Reporting
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX is hiring a Head of Tax Information Reporting to build and run our global tax information reporting function. The function covers the OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF), the EU's DAC8 directive, the amended Common Reporting Standard (CRS 2.0), FATCA, and US Form 1099-DA across multiple reporting entities and a large global user base, with annual reporting across the EU, Brazil, and other CARF jurisdictions.

 

Most of the work is data: getting the right user, transaction, and balance data out of our platform, reconciling it, and turning it into accurate filings. You will own the relationship with our reporting vendor, the data specification that feeds it, and the quality checks that decide whether a file goes out.

 

You will run a central function that owns policy, data, vendor, QA, and submission for every entity in scope. Each reporting entity names an accountable signatory. Local compliance and entity leads are consulted on local requirements and support registration where the law requires a local filer. You will work closely with Product, Data Engineering, Finance Operations, Group Tax, Legal, Data Privacy, and the local entity leads.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Own the end-to-end CARF, DAC8, CRS 2.0, FATCA, and 1099-DA reporting cycle for every OKX entity in scope: population definition, self-certification coverage, data extraction and reconciliation, file production, QA, filing, corrections, and tax authority queries.
• Define and own the data specification that feeds the tax platform vendor: which users, which transactions, which balances, how they are aggregated by user and jurisdiction, and how they reconcile to the ledger. Work with Product and Data Engineering to build and test the pipeline.
• Build and run the QA framework. Reconcile every file to source, validate it against the OECD XML schema and local variants, sample-test self-certification reasonableness checks, and run cross-entity consistency checks for users who hold accounts with more than one OKX entity. Nothing files without your release.
• Manage the tax platform vendor: contract scope, delivery calendar, test cycles, output validation, issue resolution, and the annual renewal decision.
• Set the group reporting policy and interpret the regimes for OKX: reportable crypto-assets, transfers to unhosted wallets, staking and reward income, retail payment thresholds, residency tie-breakers, and TIN rules, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and external tax advisers.
• Own the global tax self-certification design in onboarding, including validation rules, refresh triggers, and the backlog remediation program for existing users, working with Compliance and Product.
• Define the process for restricting undocumented accounts under DAC8 and CARF, including reason codes and customer communications, with restrictions applied automatically in Product and monitored by the central team.
• Maintain the entity-by-entity readiness tracker covering domestic enactment, registration, self-certification coverage, and deadlines. Report weekly to the CCO and monthly to the CARF steering committee.
• Hands-on leader. Build a small, senior team, scaled through the reporting vendor and outside advisers. Coordinate with and train local compliance and entity leads.
• Support independent testing by Compliance Monitoring, Risk, and Internal Audit, and support tax authority examinations with complete, reproducible records.

What We Look For In You
• 7+ years in tax information reporting, tax operations, or regulatory data reporting at a global exchange, broker, bank, fintech, or digital asset platform, including at least 3 years leading a team.
• Hands-on experience in a global, distributed digital asset business: you have worked with exchange or wallet transaction data, multiple legal entities, and users spread across many jurisdictions. This is required.
• Strong data skills. You can write SQL, define data specifications for engineers, reconcile large transaction datasets to a ledger, and find the gap when the numbers do not tie. You have built or run data quality controls on reporting output.
• Working knowledge of CARF, DAC8, CRS, and FATCA, including due diligence rules, self-certification requirements, reportable transaction categories, and the XML schemas used for exchange. Direct CARF or DAC8 implementation experience is strongly preferred given live DAC8 obligations and upcoming CARF reporting.
• Experience managing a tax reporting vendor or reporting platform, including scoping, testing, and holding the vendor to a delivery calendar. the tax platform vendor experience is a plus.
• Experience building a function from a small base: writing the policy, designing the controls, hiring the team, and running the first cycle.
• Ability to explain data and tax issues plainly to executives, engineers, and local compliance officers, and to run a steering committee.
• Judgment on when to escalate, comfort working across US, EU, and Asia time zones, and a record of meeting hard filing deadlines.

Nice to Haves
• Experience with US Form 1099-DA or 1099-B production, backup withholding, or Qualified Intermediary reporting.
• Experience with the DAC8 60-day account restriction process or equivalent undocumented account remediation at scale.
• Familiarity with GDPR requirements for sharing customer data with tax authorities, including data protection impact assessments.
• Python or similar scripting for data validation, and experience with data warehouse tools such as Databricks.
• Experience working inside a Three Lines Model, including supporting second-line monitoring and Internal Audit.
• A CPA, chartered tax adviser, or equivalent; or a degree in data science, computer science, or accounting.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Senior Manager PR and Communications APAC
jobs.description:
About The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial Senior Manager, Communications PR, APAC to help drive OKX’s communications and media relations activities across the region.

This is a hands-on role for someone with strong media relationships, excellent storytelling skills and a proven ability to deliver high-impact PR campaigns. You’ll work closely with regional business leaders, marketing and product teams, and the global communications function to support major announcements, strengthen OKX’s reputation and generate meaningful media coverage.

We’re looking for a proactive self-starter who thrives in fast-moving environments, can independently manage communications initiatives from planning through execution, and knows how to turn business developments into compelling stories. Experience in or a passion for cryptocurrency and digital assets is a strong advantage.

Candidates based in Hong Kong, Singapore and Australia are encouraged to apply. Remote arrangements may also be considered in selected APAC locations. We operate with regional flexibility and a results-first culture, with a focus on impact and outcomes.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Support the development and execution of OKX’s APAC communications strategy, delivering impactful PR campaigns and initiatives across key regional markets.
• Work closely with regional business leaders, marketing, product, legal and compliance teams to identify and execute communications opportunities aligned with business priorities.
• Leverage and expand relationships with journalists, editors and influential industry voices across APAC, particularly in Australia and Singapore, as well as global tier-one media covering the region.
• Proactively identify, pitch and secure compelling stories in leading business, financial, broadcast, technology and crypto publications, driving consistent, high-quality media coverage.
• Manage communications for regional product launches, business announcements, partnerships and executive thought leadership initiatives.
• Collaborate with the global communications team to support international announcements and adapt global campaigns for APAC audiences.
• Identify and activate PR opportunities through OKX’s global partnerships, including McLaren F1 Team and Manchester City Football Club.
• Develop high-quality press releases, media pitches, executive briefing materials, talking points, messaging and other communications content.
• Support regional executives with media interviews, speaking opportunities and thought leadership activities.
• Manage PR agency relationships and coordinate external partners to deliver against agreed objectives.
• Support issues management and crisis communications, working closely with regional stakeholders and the global communications team.
• Monitor media coverage, track PR performance and report on results, with a focus on coverage quality, reputation and business impact.

What We Look For In You
• 8–12 years of experience in PR and communications, ideally within financial services, fintech or technology.
• Strong, established media relationships across APAC are highly valued, particularly in Australia and Singapore, as well as connections with global tier-one business, financial and broadcast media covering the region.
• Demonstrated success securing high-quality coverage in leading international and regional publications and delivering impactful PR campaigns.
• Excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex business and technical developments into clear, compelling narratives.
• Experience supporting product launches, corporate announcements, executive communications and thought leadership initiatives.
• Experience in financial and investment communications is an advantage.
• Experience in cryptocurrency, digital assets or Web3, or a genuine passion for the industry, is a strong advantage.
• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively with senior executives and cross-functional teams.
• A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to work independently, identify opportunities and deliver results in a fast-moving environment.
• Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities across different markets.
• Experience managing PR agencies and external communications partners.
• Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism or a related field.
• Fluent in English; proficiency in other regional languages is an advantage.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees’ growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: コーポレートガバナンス担当
jobs.description:
PayPayについて

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは現在約50か国以上の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。従業員は数千名をすでに超えていますが、まだまだ会社は成長段階であり「未完成」です。「PayPay」の提供に当たっては、インド最大の決済サービス事業者であるPaytm社と連携し、同社の顧客本位のテクノロジーを活用して日本におけるスマホ決済を構築しサービスを拡大していきます。

わたしたちの最大のライバルは“現金”です。この困難な課題に前向きに取り組み、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、自ら課題発見し、周囲と協力して新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼チーム・組織紹介

PayPayにおいて、適切かつスピーディな意思決定を支援し、事業成長と企業価値向上を両立させるコーポレートガバナンス体制の構築・運営を担うチームです。
私たちが大切にしているのは、事業を止める「守りの管理」ではなく、経営や事業の意思決定を前に進める「攻めのガバナンス」です。既存のルールや会議体を運用するだけでなく、経営陣や事業部門と連携し、会社やグループの成長に合わせた仕組みづくりと改善を推進しています。

▼募集背景

事業の急速な拡大や新規事業の推進、グループ会社の増加など、会社が大きく変化・成長する中で、会社運営の仕組みも継続的に見直していく必要があります。
今後のさらなる成長に向け、既存の枠組みにとらわれず、意思決定プロセスの改善やグループ横断プロジェクトの推進を担っていただける方を募集します。

▼具体的な業務内容
• コーポレートガバナンスの企画・運営
・事業拡大や新規事業に対応したガバナンス体制の設計
・決裁権限の見直し、会議体の運営改善・効率化など、意思決定プロセスの最適化
・会社運営協定書の締結、会社設立に関する事務
• グループ横断・全社プロジェクトの推進
・出資・増資・減資・株式譲渡などのコーポレートイベントにおける関係部門との調整、進行管理
・連結経営・グループ管理の高度化に向けた施策の企画・推進
• 子会社管理
・事前承認や各種申請への対応
・子会社とのコミュニケーションを通じた課題の把握、解決に向けた支援
※週3回程度、東京オフィス（四谷）への出社があります。

▼本ポジションの魅力
• 会社の意思決定に直結する経験：
経営陣や各事業部門と連携し、重要事項の意思決定プロセスや全社的な課題の解決を推進できます。
• 事業成長を支える「攻めのガバナンス」を創る手応え：
既存ルールの運用にとどまらず、成長スピードを保ちながら適切な意思決定を実現する「攻めの仕組みづくり」に挑戦できます。
• PayPayグループ全体に関わるダイナミックなプロジェクト推進：
コーポレートイベントやグループ管理体制の高度化など、複数の部門・会社を巻き込むプロジェクトを通じて、幅広い経験を積めます。

必要な経験/スキル

以下のいずれかに関わった実務経験をお持ちの方
• 会社運営、コーポレートガバナンス、会議体運営、決裁・稟議プロセスの企画・運営・改善
• 全社・部門横断プロジェクトの企画・推進、PMO
• 子会社管理やグループ会社との調整・支援

あると望ましい経験/スキル
• 複数の部門や関係者を巻き込み、合意形成や課題解決を進めた経験
• グループ会社を含む全社的な業務改善・体制整備に携わった経験

PayPayが求める人物像
• PayPay 5 sensesに当てはまる方

待遇・条件

雇用形態
• 正社員

勤務地
• Hybrid Workstyle
※所属組織のルールおよび業務指示に応じて出社対応頂きます。

勤務時間
• スーパーフレックス制（コアタイム無し）
• 原則：午前9時～午後5時45分（実働7時間45分＋休憩時間 1時間）

休日
• 土日祝日、年末年始および会社指定日

休暇（法定休暇および会社福利厚生）
• 年次有給休暇(初年度14日間、入社月に応じて按分付与。入社日から使用可）
• パーソナル休暇（毎年度５日間付与/初年度入社月により3日間もしくは5日間付与）
※PayPay独自の特別有給休暇制度で、本人/家族/ペットなどの病気/ケガ/通院付き添い等にご使用頂けます。

給与
• 年俸制（一部固定残業代含む）
• 経験、スキル、業績、貢献度に応じ当社規定により決定
• 毎年1回見直し
• 時間外勤務手当、深夜勤務手当有
※給与支給について、一部をPayPayアカウントで受け取ることが可能です（給与デジタル支払いに対応）

ベネフィット
• 社会保険（健康保険、厚生年金、雇用保険、労災保険）
• 企業型確定拠出年金制度

jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role 

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards!

Robinhood's Customer Experience team is committed to providing an outstanding customer experience. In your role as an Advanced Services Representative, you will be empowered to help our customers with some of their most complex issues. jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards!

Robinhood's Customer Experience team is committed to providing an outstanding customer experience. In your role as an Advanced Services Representative, you will be empowered to help our customers with some of their most complex issues. jobs.title: Senior Java Software Engineer II - Continuous Delivery (CD)
jobs.description:
Every day, Wise engineers deploy thousands of changes across hundreds of services. The Continuous Delivery team builds the platform that helps them do this safely, without turning delivery controls into a bottleneck.

That challenge is becoming more important as AI-assisted development increases the volume and speed of software changes. We need to maintain strong safety and reliability standards while adapting our delivery platform to code and configuration increasingly produced with AI tools and agents.

About the role 

You’ll join the team responsible for Wise’s Continuous Delivery platform. You’ll work primarily in Java & Go, extending Spinnaker and building the services and integrations around it.

This is a hands-on engineering role with scope to influence the platform’s technical direction. You’ll take problems from discovery and design through to implementation and operation, working with teams across Platform Engineering and the wider company.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys distributed systems, shared infrastructure, and problems where a seemingly small design decision can affect hundreds of services. You should be comfortable using deployment data, reliability metrics, and engineer feedback to decide where the team should invest.

What you’ll work on
• Design, build, and operate capabilities within Wise’s Continuous Delivery platform.
• Evolve our use of the Open Source CD tool Spinnaker and contribute improvements upstream where appropriate.
• Build reliable guardrails that help engineers deploy changes safely with minimal manual effort.
• Improve the shared foundations of the platform in partnership with other Platform Engineering teams.
• Use telemetry and feedback to understand how the platform performs and where engineers experience friction.
• Work directly with engineering teams as they adopt new deployment patterns and platform capabilities.
• Contribute to technical design, code reviews, documentation, and the development of other engineers.

What you’ll bring
• Strong experience building and operating production systems in Java.
• Experience designing distributed services and APIs, including testing, monitoring, and failure handling.
• Practical experience with a cloud platform such as AWS or GCP.
• Experience working with containers and an orchestration platform such as Kubernetes.
• A track record of automating operational work and building repeatable tooling.
• Experience owning shared or mission-critical infrastructure.
• The ability to turn complex requirements into understandable, maintainable solutions.
• A willingness to challenge existing approaches, share what you know, and learn from others
• Experience discovering complex problems across multiple teams and business functions

You do not need previous Spinnaker experience. We’re more interested in strong engineering fundamentals and experience operating systems at scale.

Nice to have
• Experience with Spinnaker or another large-scale CI/CD platform.
• Practical experience applying SRE principles, such as service-level objectives, error budgets, and automated incident prevention.
• Familiarity with observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic, or distributed tracing.
• Knowledge of cloud networking and security.
• Experience working in a regulated environment or with standards such as PCI DSS.
• Experience with capacity planning, performance testing, or load testing.
• Experience producing clear technical documentation and architecture diagrams.

What you’ll get
• Meaningful influence over a platform used by engineers across Wise.
• The opportunity to solve engineering problems at company-wide scale.
• Scope to contribute to open source software.
• Support to develop your technical leadership and help other teams improve how they deliver software.
• A flexible working environment and regular team and company events.

Interested? Find out more:
• How we work – a practical guide
• The Wise Tech Stack (2025 update)
• Our Engineering career map
• Scaling our Infrastructure; how we make it work
• Wise Engineering on Medium

What do we offer:
• Starting salary: £87,500-£111,000 + RSU

jobs.title: Senior II/Lead Software Engineer - Global KYC and Onboarding
jobs.description:
We are the Global KYC and Onboarding squad in the Servicing department and we have a mission: to enable teams at Wise to expand and fine-tune the business in a "config change" manner all across the globe, while remaining compliant and safe for the customers. There are three teams in the squad: Business Onboarding Verification, Personal Onboarding Verification and Wise Platform Verification (our B2B platform).

 

The scale we operate at: In FY2025, 15.6 million people and businesses used Wise, we onboarded over 5.9 million new customers (~500k/month), and moved £145.2bn across borders (~£400m/day) across 160+ countries and 40+ currencies. Our verification systems aren't supporting tools — they're core production infrastructure that protects customers, enables growth, and must stay reliable under constant change in regulations, policies, and evolving threat patterns.

 

 All of the teams are diverse, cross-functional groups passionate about solving complex problems with elegant solutions. We bring together backend and frontend engineers, mobile developers, designers, data analysts, and product managers who collaborate closely to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Our teams are responsible for the critical verification journeys that business and personal customers complete before using Wise's products. We own the entire verification lifecycle – from document collection flows and automated review systems to agent tooling and compliance monitoring. We operate with high ownership in a bottom-up, transparent culture, make data-driven decisions, and celebrate both technical excellence and customer impact. Right now we're focused on building KYC/FinCrime as a configuration-driven product, refactoring and building new scalable microservice systems, and increasing automation using ML/AI where it genuinely improves decisioning, review quality, and operational efficiency — with safe fallbacks and clear observability. 

As IC4, you'll shape architecture across the squad's services, lead the technical direction on initiatives like the configuration-driven KYC platform, and raise the engineering bar through mentorship and cross-team influence. As a team that touches both regulatory requirements and customer experience, we have unique opportunities to innovate in a space traditionally resistant to change.

 

By joining one of our teams, you'll directly impact these customers by transforming a traditionally frustrating experience into one that's fast, intuitive, and fair. Your code will help individuals and small businesses access global banking faster, enable entrepreneurs to pay international employees on time, and allow people like you and your teammates support their families across borders without friction. We're not just building verification systems – we're removing barriers that stand between our customers and their financial freedom.

We need like-minded engineers in all the teams in the squad, so we'll use the interview process to discover where your unique skills shine brightest. Ultimately, we want to match you with the team that perfectly aligns with your experience and sets you up for success!

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Manager - Compliance
