jobs.title: Product Director - Onboarding Experience
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Product Lead to lead our Onboarding experiences at Wise. This role will oversee three of the most important teams in Wise: Consumer Onboarding, Account Setup, and Account Access & Recovery. Your mission is to ensure that every new customer - personal or business - can join Wise easily, securely, and with full clarity on how to get value from our products.

 

This is a high-impact leadership role where you’ll work across product, engineering, design, analytics, compliance, operations and marketing to dramatically improve conversion, eliminate drop-offs, and build a world-class onboarding experience for all our customers. You’ll report to the Onboarding & Scalable Growth Director and lead a team of talented PMs across the domain.

 

As the onboarding experiences lead, you’ll lead multiple cross-functional product teams responsible for:
• Driving conversion for new personal customers: ensuring customers get to their first successful transaction quickly and with confidence
• Eliminating drop-off across flows like signup, KYC, profile creation, and pricing understanding and transaction creation.
• Owning the entire login, account recovery, and 2FA experience - one of the most sensitive and high-contact areas in our funnel
• Improving the UX across onboarding journeys, especially for complex or regulated flows
• Balancing growth with security, compliance, and operational scalability

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Make global impact: You’ll shape how millions of people and businesses experience Wise for the first time — and help them understand the value we offer in the most growth oriented teams we have in Wise
• Drive measurable outcomes: You’ll own core product metrics like conversion rate, onboarding contact ratio, and 2FA cost per user — and be responsible for improving them
• Own the UX: You’ll need a sharp eye for UX quality and the ability to collaborate deeply with design and research to ship exceptional user journeys that can raise the bar in Wise
• Collaborate across the org: Partner with compliance, security, operations and marketing to align on shared goals and deliver cohesive experiences
• Build and lead a high-performing team: You’ll support 3–4 PMs and their teams, helping them prioritise ruthlessly, move quickly, and focus on outcomes
• Act as a leader – You will build and inspire your own team, but also other teams to contribute to our mission. Inspire teams with your ideas, knowledge and self-starting attitude

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — Support Tooling
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Support Tooling team in Tallinn.

The team builds and maintains the systems that enable our Customer Support agents to help millions of Wise customers efficiently, reliably and at scale.

Our goal is to make customer support as seamless as possible by providing agents with the right tools, information and workflows to resolve issues effectively, while ensuring that our systems remain secure, scalable and easy to maintain.

You'll take ownership of the core tooling our Support agents use every day, working on a complex, distributed Java system with opportunities to improve how we support our customers.

As part of a new workstream, you'll work closely with Product colleagues to help shape the future of our agent tooling — balancing new product capabilities, technical improvements and long-term reliability.

What you'll be working on:
• Owning and evolving a complex Java backend system, taking responsibility for technical decisions, development, testing and deployment.
• Solving distributed-systems challenges involving concurrency, service-to-service communication, data consistency and reliability.
• Improving the tools used by Customer Support agents, helping them resolve customer issues more efficiently and deliver a better customer experience.
• Driving technical improvements and managing tech debt, making pragmatic decisions about when to prioritise new features, maintenance and long-term system health.
• Partnering closely with Product Managers and operational stakeholders to understand problems, influence priorities and help shape the team's roadmap.
• Contributing to the user experience, working with React where needed to improve the interfaces and workflows used by our agents.
• Taking end-to-end ownership of meaningful Engineering initiatives, from identifying opportunities through to production delivery.

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Implementation Manager - Servicing (Fincrime)
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an exceptional, battle-tested Program Manager / Delivery Leader to join our Implementation Management team. In this role, you will take single-threaded ownership of high-stakes projects across product, engineering, compliance, and operations.

You will not merely track tasks or facilitate meetings. You will act as an empowered Driver and Integrator—a domain-smart program leader who deeply understands technical and operational context, stress-tests assumptions, anticipates cross-workstream collisions, and ensures our control environment meets regulatory expectations sustainably and on time.

What You’ll Do
• Lead Cross-Domain Initiatives: Take single-threaded ownership of high-impact, cross-squad projects—ranging from high-stakes compliance and regulatory commitments to core platform migrations, control rollouts, product launches.
• Drive Program Management Lifecycle: Hold the pen on end-to-end program governance. Author clear program briefs and plans, define clear outcomes, structure exception-led delivery forums, and maintain appropriate program artefacts and drive accountability across teams.
• Guide Informed Decision-Making: Build a solid understanding of the domain you own (AML, KYC, Fraud, Screening etc) and technical architectures you align with. Use this context to stress-test plans, challenge assumptions, anticipate cross-workstream collisions, and guide senior stakeholders through critical trade-offs.
• Drive Pragmatic, Hands-On Delivery: Work comfortably at the intersection of product delivery and technical systems. You don't need to review deep technical specifications, but you are comfortable reading architecture diagrams, asking challenging technical questions or creating simple dashboards.
• Leave the Place Better Than You Found It: Assume every process executed today will be repeated tomorrow. Document workflows, automate manual steps, eliminate administrative friction, and establish telemetry to scale future execution across the organization.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Lead - Identities and Attributes
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly accomplished Senior Engineering Lead to take the helm of one of our core teams within the Identity Risk Platform squad.

This is a critical, high‑impact leadership role where you will simultaneously drive architectural strategy and scale the team responsible for Wise’s core identity layer, the foundation on which all risk, onboarding, and servicing decisions are built, powering Wise’s global risk platforms and customer experience.

Key leadership focus
• Architectural ownership

You will be the technical authority for the design, delivery, and operational excellence of our core Identity and Attribute domains and related APIs – high‑throughput, low‑latency services that are the backbone of the Identity Risk Platform, and power all product and risk teams.
• Domain bridge

You will operate as the primary technical interface between Product squads, Risk/FinCrime, and Verification providers, ensuring clean, reusable API contracts and a unified identity view.
• Team foundation & growth

You’ll be instrumental in hiring, mentoring, and leading a multi‑level engineering team, setting the standards and practices that become the foundation for the whole Identity Risk Platform.
• Data Integrity & Scale: You’ll own schemas and data contracts for people, businesses, roles and attributes, and drive data quality, lineage, and auditability so that identity data is trustworthy, explainable, and compliant across its full lifecycle.

What will you be working on?

As Senior Engineering Lead for the Identities and Attributes team, your focus will span technical strategy, architectural execution, and team leadership within a high‑stakes, cross‑functional domain.
• Evolution of our Identity domains:

Leading the design and evolution of our core Identity and Attributes domains. This involves defining robust API contracts and data schemas, making identity data risk‑aware by design, managing attribute acquisition & lifecycle, powering new onboarding & product experiences.
• Driving Data Governance:

Establishing and enforcing technical standards for Data Lineage, Data Quality, and Auditability within the Identity Risk Platform. You'll ensure the platform meets stringent regulatory and compliance requirements.
• Scaling the Team and Culture:

Actively managing and mentoring the current engineering team (IC2-IC4), while driving the recruitment strategy to grow the team. This includes defining clear roles, efficient processes, and a high-performance engineering culture.
• Strategic Stakeholder Alignment:

Serving as the key technical partner to Product, FinCrime, and other Engineering Leads. You will champion the architectural vision for the platform, ensuring technical decisions align with both business agility and security requirements.
• Platform Resilience:

Ensuring the platform is built for high availability, low latency, and massive scale, managing the operational health (SLAs/SLOs) of a critical, real-time risk service.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer - Wise Platform
jobs.description:
Wise Platform helps banks, software companies, and large enterprises use Wise's infrastructure to offer their customers cross-border payment products through our API. We're a cross-functional team across sales, implementation, product, engineering, compliance, and analytics, based in New York, London, and Singapore.

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Partner Experience team in London.

The Partner Experience team builds and runs the systems that let enterprise partners go live faster and manage their day-to-day operations in one place. 

We own the Partner Portal (used by many big banks to manage transfers, report fraud, handle compliance requests, and manage their teams) and the backend services behind partner onboarding, permissions, and communication. Most of what we build is new. There's no existing playbook for enterprise partner tooling at this scale, so you'll be designing systems from scratch more often than maintaining existing ones.

How we work:

We're a small team that ships frequently and iterates on real partner feedback. Engineers own features from technical discovery and design through to production support. We work closely with our PM and designer to understand partner needs, and with adjacent teams (API Experience, Account Discovery, KYC, FinCrime) to pull their capabilities into the portal.

We investigate before we build. That means managing ambiguity, understanding the existing systems, APIs and dependencies before writing code. We keep process light: quick standups, focused 1:1s, and quarterly planning.

What will you be working on?:
• Backend microservices for partner-facing features: fraud reporting, case management, RFI handling, audit logging, and transaction visibility.
• The permissions and role-based access control system that governs what partners can do in the portal.
• SSO (SAML 2.0) integration for enterprise partners, including solving identity mapping between partner systems and Wise.
• The communication layer services between Wise and partners, extending them to handle new case types and workflows.
• API design for partner-facing endpoints. We care about consistency, documentation, and making them usable without hand-holding.
• Work with FinCrime, Compliance, and KYC teams to bring sanctions RFI workflows and fraud reporting into the portal.
• Technical discovery: mapping existing systems, evaluating dependencies, producing design documents that become the team's source of truth.
• Production support and debugging when live partner issues come up.

jobs.title: Campaign Manager
jobs.description:
We Are

YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions. 

You Will
• Own the full-funnel campaign strategy for the Malaysia market, translating business objectives into integrated plans that drive user acquisition, transaction volume, user active rates, and long-term user engagement.
• Drive new user acquisition by overseeing integrated marketing campaigns across media, influencer, and offline channels - ensuring every campaign delivers measurable growth at an efficient cost-per-acquisition.
• Plan and govern monthly spending campaigns and always-on promotions end-to-end, ensuring structured campaign setup, accurate tracking, clear measurement frameworks, and disciplined post-campaign analysis.
• Grow user active rates by designing activation and re-engagement campaigns with data, product, and cross-functional teams - converting new users into active ones and keeping active users active.
• Oversee BAU KOL and influencer strategy - set the direction for YouTrip's always-on KOL engine, guide the team's execution, and personally steward top-tier KOL relationships to ensure a consistent flow of organic and paid content beyond campaign moments.
• Lead and develop a high-performing team, providing day-to-day coaching, performance management, and career development to ensure both individual growth and collective team impact.
• Lead the partnership campaign agenda - collaborating and negotiating with strategic partners (banks, OTAs, eCommerce platforms, lifestyle brands) to co-create campaigns that amplify visibility, deepen engagement, and unlock new audiences.
• Manage and optimize the campaign budget across paid media, influencer, partnership, and CRM channels to maximize ROI and hit acquisition, activation, and retention KPIs.
• Be the point of contact for internal and external stakeholders - aligning cross-functional teams (content, data, product, design, finance) and representing YouTrip with partners, agencies, and influencers.
• Work closely with in-house design and creative teams to deliver high-quality, on-brand campaign assets across all touchpoints.
• Champion a test-and-learn culture through A/B tests, segmentation, and behavioral analyses that inform smarter, more personalized user journeys.
• Translate data into action - monitor performance, lead post-mortems, and sharpen next-round execution with actionable insights.

You Are
• You have 5+ years leading consumer-facing campaigns end-to-end, with 1 - 2 years of people management. You set direction, delegate well, and elevate your team.
• A full-funnel marketer - You understand how acquisition, activation, retention, and partnerships connect, and you can build campaigns that move all the levers, not just top-of-funnel awareness.
• Comfortable with performance dashboards, forecasts, and budgets. You translate data into clear decisions.
• You generate sharp campaign ideas grounded in consumer insight and collaborate well with creative and design teams.
• You are warm, professional, and level-headed. You build trust with partners, agencies, and internal teams, and negotiate without burning bridges.
• You juggle multiple campaigns, partners, and stakeholders without losing sight of timelines, budgets, or quality.
• You have a strong awareness of emerging trends, platforms, KOLs, and consumer behaviors.
• You set ambitious goals, own the results, and aren't afraid to course-correct when the data demands it.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About us:

Branch is on a mission to empower workers with financial freedom. We do this by helping companies accelerate payments and providing working Americans with accessible, free financial services. We’re committed to building and delivering more inclusive, transparent, and frictionless financial products.

Our goal of empowerment extends to our own employees, too. Have a great idea? Share it today and it might just get implemented tomorrow. As a member of our team, your voice and creativity matter—and they can directly impact our products, company, and culture. 

We not only focus on attracting great talent from across the country, but also on building teams that help that talent thrive. That means valuing a diversity of opinions and working styles, while creating a shared belief in innovation, initiative, and winning together.

Come join our team as we develop new ways to improve the lives of working Americans.

About

the role:

Branch helps millions of workers get paid faster and manage their money better. Our team is responsible for the data that drives many critical processes at Branch, including money movement, automated fraud response, and client reporting.

We're looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team. In this role, you’ll work with other engineers and stakeholders to build and maintain the pipelines that power the rest of Branch. You'll deliver new pipelines and build the underlying components (hooks, utilities, internal libraries) that future pipelines will be built from.

This is a great role for someone with a few years of data engineering experience who's ready to grow into more end-to-end ownership. Our team is small, high-trust, and values clarity, maintainability, and getting the details right.

What You'll Do:
• Build and maintain data pipelines that other teams and customers rely on
• Integrate with internal and external APIs to send and receive data
• Orchestrate and automate workflows using Airflow on Kubernetes
• Implement unit tests, monitoring, and alerting to ensure data reliability
• Improve the observability and efficiency of existing pipelines
• Monitor production pipelines, debug issues, and document root causes
• Work with stakeholders to clarify requirements and validate assumptions
• Contribute to design discussions and surface functional gaps early

What We're Looking For:

Required
• 3+ years of Data Engineering experience
• 3+ years of Airflow experience
• Proficiency in Python and SQL
• Working knowledge of our existing tech stack: Snowflake, Airflow, DBT, GCP
• BS in Computer Science or related field

Nice to Have
• Experience in fintech, payments, or a related industry
• Experience with managing Airflow

Compensation:

The base salary range for this role is $135-145k. The salary range displayed reflects an average base salary range for the position across all the U.S. The base salary offered to an applicant could be higher or lower based on each applicant's specific skill set, depth of experience, relevant education or training, etc. 

Location:

This position is classified as REMOTE within the United States of America.

We are unable to hire candidates located outside of the domestic U.S.

Benefits:
• Market-leading medical, dental, and vision insurance
• Stock options
• Free Premium-Tier Origin Financial Wellness subscription
• Monthly home-office stipend
• 401k (TransAmerica)
• 12-weeks paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents
• Flexible time off + sick and safe time
• 11 paid company holidays
• Branch@Branch Same Day Pay Option

Identity Verification

As part of our application process, you'll receive a separate email from Greenhouse shortly containing a unique identity verification link. This step, powered by Persona, helps us confirm applicant identities and keep our hiring process secure for everyone. 

Upon identity verification, all biometric data is deleted. If you need support completing this application, please reach out to Careers@branchapp.com

Working at Branch

A remote-first company with employees located throughout the U.S., Branch emphasizes transparency, accountability, and trust to create a collaborative environment where our product, engineering, marketing, customer support, customer success, and sales teams can all thrive together. Learn more about what we do in this video!

Our collaborative spirit has helped us become an award-winning FinTech company, with Branch’s innovation and workplace recognized across industries. Branch has been honored by Inc., the Webby Awards, Benzinga FinTech Awards, FinTech Breakthrough Awards, Top Workplaces USA, Great Places to Work, and EY Entrepreneur of the Year, Heartland, among others. 

Learn more about our culture, approach, technology, and people here: https://www.branchapp.com/about

 

Branch is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Must be currently authorized to work in the USA without sponsorship or transfer.

No third-parties, please.

View how Branch collects your personal data here.

jobs.title: Commercial Account Executive
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team.

What you’ll do

As a Commercial Account Executive, you’ll fuel Brex’s growth by winning net-new revenue from small to mid-sized businesses. In this high-volume, fast-paced role, you’ll prospect, build strong partnerships, and close deals by showing the unmatched value of Brex’s all-in-one Financial Operating System—Corporate Card, Expense Management, and Travel.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in one of our Brex offices — San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Vancouver, or Salt Lake City. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Responsibilities
• Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Own the end-to-end sales process from outbound prospecting to discovery, product demos, and closing deals.
• Pipeline Generation Management: Consistently source and qualify leads to maintain a strong, reliable pipeline.
• Value-Based Selling: Clearly communicate ROI and business value by understanding each prospect's goals and aligning Brex’s solutions to their needs.
• Customer-Centric Problem Solving: Build trust through insight and service, helping prospects navigate challenges and unlock growth.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales Development, Product, and Underwriting to create a smooth and impactful buyer experience.

Requirements
• 1+ years of closing experience in B2B SaaS sales, ideally in a high-volume or new business-focused role
• A high-performing SDR/BDR background with a strong track record of sourcing and qualifying opportunities due to high self-prospecting requirements in role
• Strong ability to communicate value and ROI to small or mid-sized business stakeholders
• Consistent quota attainment and a history of top-tier performance
• A proactive, self-motivated approach with a focus on results and customer impact

Bonus points
• Familiarity selling financial software (Expense Management, ERP, AP Automation, T E, Accounting Software, Banking, etc.)

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $136,000 - $170,000. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team.

What you’ll do

As a Commercial Account Executive, you’ll fuel Brex’s growth by winning net-new revenue from small to mid-sized businesses. In this high-volume, fast-paced role, you’ll prospect, build strong partnerships, and close deals by showing the unmatched value of Brex’s all-in-one Financial Operating System—Corporate Card, Expense Management, and Travel.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in one of our Brex offices — San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Vancouver, or Salt Lake City. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Responsibilities
• Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Own the end-to-end sales process from outbound prospecting to discovery, product demos, and closing deals.
• Pipeline Generation Management: Consistently source and qualify leads to maintain a strong, reliable pipeline.
• Value-Based Selling: Clearly communicate ROI and business value by understanding each prospect's goals and aligning Brex’s solutions to their needs.
• Customer-Centric Problem Solving: Build trust through insight and service, helping prospects navigate challenges and unlock growth.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales Development, Product, and Underwriting to create a smooth and impactful buyer experience.

Requirements
• 1+ years of closing experience in B2B SaaS sales, ideally in a high-volume or new business-focused role
• A high-performing SDR/BDR background with a strong track record of sourcing and qualifying opportunities due to high self-prospecting requirements in role
• Strong ability to communicate value and ROI to small or mid-sized business stakeholders
• Consistent quota attainment and a history of top-tier performance
• A proactive, self-motivated approach with a focus on results and customer impact

Bonus points
• Familiarity selling financial software (Expense Management, ERP, AP Automation, T E, Accounting Software, Banking, etc.)

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $172,890 - $192,100. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Legal at Brex

The Legal team helps the company grow responsibly, advocating for Brex and for the thousands of growing businesses we serve. We provide strategic advice and guidance to all Brex teams, protect Brex, advise on risk, and represent the company externally, negotiating with partners and interacting with regulators. Reimagining the financial system in a highly regulated environment requires creativity and resourcefulness, and we welcome the challenge.

What you'll do

You will help us build, globally scale, and continuously improve Brex's spend management software products, including budgets, spend policies, approvals, and audit and controls from the earliest stages of ideation through launch—translating complex regulatory, card network, and bank partner requirements into practical product decisions and helping teams move fast without compromising on compliance. You'll help advise on the regulatory and commercial issues that arise across software and fintech products—data privacy, contracting, intellectual property, AI and automation, and consumer- and commercial-protection requirements—providing strategic advice on risk and ambiguity as we design and ship new features. You'll also collaborate closely with cross-functional partners (including privacy, security, compliance, marketing, sales, and partnerships) to find creative solutions to business problems. You know how to break a project down into first principles and see it from concept to release, and you understand when to solve a problem in-house.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Serve as the embedded legal partner to engineering, product, and design teams building spend management software—budgets, policies, approvals, and audit and controls—advising in real time as features are designed and built
• Provide pragmatic, actionable advice on requirements and best practices for existing and new spend management software features
• Advise on the regulatory and commercial implications of product architecture, data flows, automation and AI features, integrations, and feature design, helping teams make sound build-versus-defer decisions
• Advise a variety of cross-functional partners on critical credit, lending, and card network regulatory questions
• Advise a variety of cross-functional partners on critical software, data privacy, and product regulatory questions
• Advise on product and marketing collateral, customer communications, and disclosures for spend management software products
• Draft, update, and maintain customer agreements, terms, disclosures, and feature-level terms for spend management software
• Support data handling, integration, and partner arrangements as they relate to product launches

Requirements
• 4+ years working experience in a combination of law firms and technology or fintech companies, ideally advising on credit card, lending, and commercial matters for regulated financial or technology products
• Familiarity with federal, state, and international credit, lending, and card laws and regulations, including TILA/Regulation Z, ECOA/Regulation B, UDAP/UDAAP, card network rules (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), and required disclosures
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, both internal (memos, guides, presentations) and external (customer agreements, terms, disclosures, customer communications)
• Ownership mentality and comfort working on complex matters that require sound judgment
• Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
• Law degree and admitted to practice in at least one jurisdiction
• Willingness to be a team player who pitches in to help out on other products and topics; one of our key tenets is "One Brex"

Bonus Points
• Prior in-house counsel experience at a scaling fintech, payments, or software company
• Experience advising on AI and automation features
• Experience negotiating with or managing bank partner and card network relationships
• Experience interacting directly with regulatory agencies

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $220,000-$270,000 USD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Product Data Platform
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you’ll do

This opportunity is on our Product Data Platform (PDP) team, which builds and operates the high-performance data, query, and search infrastructure that powers critical Brex product experiences, including AI-powered data products like our agentic reporting experience. PDP's mission is to make Brex customizable, scalable, and reliable for finance teams, and that requires deeply optimized, production-grade distributed systems.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll shape the technical direction of the platform across multiple teams. Your mandate is to identify the highest-impact architectural problems across the data products group, including the cross-cutting ones that fall between teams, and drive them to resolution. You'll be accountable for the group's technical quality, move between long-horizon strategy and hands-on execution, and lead through influence rather than authority.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday.

As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Lead technical strategy for critical PDP initiatives, balancing long-term architecture with near-term delivery across multiple teams.
• Identify and resolve systemic performance, consistency, and scalability problems, including cross-team gaps no single team can own.
• Own architecture direction for query performance: query plans, execution paths, cost models, indexing strategies, and schema and access-pattern design.
• Design and evolve distributed systems with thoughtful tradeoffs around consistency, latency, caching, cost, and failure modes.
• Raise the technical bar across the group through design reviews and architecture decisions, and dive in hands-on where it matters most, including P95/P99 latency issues in production.
• Proactively identify scaling risks and reliability gaps, and turn findings into plans the group aligns behind.
• Mentor senior engineers and grow the next generation of technical leaders within PDP.
• Contribute directly on high-stakes initiatives and critical path decisions, primarily in the JVM ecosystem (Kotlin/Java).

Requirements
• 8+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems at scale, including as a technical leader on multi-team initiatives.
• Track record of leading architecture and delivery for large-scale distributed systems in a platform or infrastructure environment.
• Deep hands-on expertise with relational databases (Postgres or Aurora strongly preferred), including query plan analysis, indexing strategies, and real-world optimization.
• Ability to drive ambiguous, cross-cutting problems to resolution without a defined charter.
• Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence stakeholders and align teams without direct authority.
• Experience mentoring senior engineers.

Bonus
• Hands-on experience with OpenSearch / Elasticsearch or similar systems in production.
• Experience with streaming data platforms (Flink, Kafka) or semantic/analytics layers in production.
• Experience with multi-tenant or data-heavy platforms in regulated environments.
• Experience building platform foundations for AI or agentic product experiences.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $300,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity.

jobs.title: Growth MarTech Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities
1. MarTech Architecture, Tracking, Auditing & Proactive Enrichment
• Web Tracking, Debugging & Ad Signal Routing: Own the end-to-end web tracking architecture across Google Analytics (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM). Define and document Data Layer requirements for the engineering team to implement, and ensure accurate web tracking signals and conversion events are seamlessly routed back to key ad platforms via GTM.
• App Tracking & MMP Integration: Partner closely with the engineering team to implement, test, and maintain tracking across mobile apps (AppsFlyer, Firebase) for SDK events and Server-to-Server (S2S) events. Architect a standardized event taxonomy, oversee SDK integrations, and manage overall AppsFlyer health.
• Ad Platform Tracking Optimization: Take deep ownership of exactly how ad platforms consume our data. Partner closely with internal User Acquisition (UA) channel owners to unblock tracking bottlenecks, troubleshoot platform-specific signal loss, and proactively enrich tracking signals (e.g., passing backend LTV scores or customized events back to ad platforms). Act as the technical authority who translates complex media platform requirements into actionable tracking solutions to maximize campaign performance.
• Comprehensive Stack Auditing & Enrichment: Lead end-to-end audits of the tracking and reporting foundation to resolve data gaps, latency issues, and discrepancies across tracking tools, internal BI, and ad platforms. Move beyond routine maintenance by establishing automated QA monitoring to instantly detect event drop-offs or tracking anomalies, while strictly managing privacy-centric tracking and consent routing.
2. Advanced Measurement, Attribution & Incrementality Analysis
• Attribution Strategy & MMM: Support the build of measurement solutions across the full attribution spectrum—from foundational models (Last-Touch) to advanced frameworks (Multi-Touch Attribution [MTA] and Media Mix Modeling [MMM]). Partner with Data Science and Engineering to ensure clean, structured signal data is feeding into these models. Help operationalize these measurement models and triangulate insights across these frameworks and growth metrics to evaluate true user acquisition performance.
• LTV & Cohort Analytics: Analyze user acquisition performance, customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), and user cohorts. Translate these complex data sets into actionable insights to scale high-performing channels and inform broader growth strategies.
• Incrementality Testing & Analysis: Support the design, implementation, and analysis of incrementality tests to measure the true causal impact of growth efforts and validate overall ROI.
3. Data Engineering Collaboration & Advanced BI
• Data Pipeline Collaboration: Partner with Data Engineering to manage growth data requests, ensuring event streams are clean, structured, and accurately mapped into growth data pipelines.
• Advanced SQL & Data Modeling: Write complex SQL to mine large datasets, build custom tables, and execute high-velocity ad-hoc analysis.
• Dashboarding & AI Automation: Build and maintain automated dashboards using Tableau and Databricks. Integrate AI Agents to streamline reporting workflows and surface deeper, more actionable insights for leadership and business teams.
4. Cross-Functional Project Management
• Technical Translation: Collaborate with Growth, Product, Engineering, and Data teams to translate complex marketing and analytics use cases into precise technical requirements and actionable project tickets.
• Internal Documentation: Create, scale, and maintain comprehensive internal documentation covering our tracking architecture, event taxonomies, and growth data schemas.

Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Statistics, Marketing, or a related quantitative field.
• 4+ years of dedicated experience in MarTech tracking, growth analytics, and digital marketing data analysis. Experience in Crypto, FinTech, or Technology is a strong plus.
• Deep, hands-on proficiency with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM), with the ability to define Data Layer requirements, route ad tracking signals, and debug network setups.
• Deep expertise in ad platform signals and mechanics. You must know exactly how ad platforms consume data and have hands-on experience solving platform-specific tracking challenges, including Meta CAPI, AEM, Google conversion signals, event postbacks to DSPs and ad networks.
• Deep expertise in mobile app tracking, specifically with AppsFlyer and Firebase, including experience standardizing event taxonomies and overseeing both SDK and Server-to-Server (S2S) event integrations.
• Understanding of advanced attribution frameworks (MMM, MTA) and proven experience designing and executing incrementality tests (holdouts, conversion lift studies).
• Understanding of digital marketing economics, including user acquisition optimization, customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), cohort analysis, and paid media strategies.
• Understanding of CDP/CRM tools (e.g., Segment, Braze) and how they route data signals to downstream channels and systems.
• Understanding of privacy-centric tracking mechanisms (e.g., Google Consent Mode, SKAdNetwork).
• Advanced SQL skills for mining large datasets, creating custom tables, and executing ad-hoc analysis, alongside mandatory hands-on experience with Databricks and Tableau.
• Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex marketing and business needs into precise technical tickets for Engineering and Data teams.
• Strong organizational skills with experience building comprehensive internal technical documentation and managing multiple high-priority projects in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Senior Information Security Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
About Fam (previously FamPay)

Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above
11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.

We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.

Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.

Role OverviewWe are seeking a proactive and detailed-oriented IT Risk & Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for executing cybersecurity risk assessments for our third-party vendors, suppliers, service providers and internal IT risk management processes. You will collaborate closely with IT, Engineering, Procurement, Legal, and Risk teams to identify, evaluate, and mitigate technology and vendor risks across the organization.

Must-Haves

Experience:

3 to 5 years of dedicated experience in IT risk management, cybersecurity, third-party risk management (TPRM), or information security governance.
IT Risk Knowledge: Strong understanding of internal IT general controls (ITGC), access control, disaster recovery, cloud security concepts, and data protection principles.
Framework Familiarity: Working knowledge of industry frameworks and standards, such as RBI Framework for Outsourcing of Payment and Settlement-related Activities by PSOs, RBI MD on Cyber Resilience & Digital Payment Security Controls, ISO 27001, ISO 31000, and NIST CSF.
Artifact Evaluation: Demonstrated ability to review vendor reports, security certifications, penetration test summaries, and questionnaires.
Analytical & Communication

Skills:

Excellent analytical, organizational, and documentation skills with the ability to communicate risk findings clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
Ownership: Proven ability to manage multiple vendor assessments and internal risk tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Good to Haves
Professional certifications or active progress toward certifications such as CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI etc.
Prior experience working in financial services, technology, or other regulated environments.
Hands-on experience using GRC tools or dedicated Third-Party Risk Management platforms.
Basic awareness of AI-enabled features in GRC or risk tools
Experience supporting IT disaster recovery exercises or business continuity planning.

Roles & Responsibilities
1. IT Risk Management
Risk Assessment & Identification: Execute internal IT risk assessments across IT infrastructure, cloud environments, business applications, and operational workflows.
Risk Register Maintenance: Maintain and regularly update the enterprise IT Risk Register, tracking risk treatment plans, remediation timelines, and risk acceptance approvals.
Internal Controls Evaluation: Assess the effectiveness of internal IT controls, including access management, backup and disaster recovery, change management, and data security.
KRI & Risk Reporting: Monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and assist in preparing periodic risk reports and metrics for management and oversight committees.
2. Third-Party Cyber Risk Management (TPRM)
Vendor Risk Assessments: Perform end-to-end cybersecurity risk assessments for third-party vendors, suppliers, and external service providers.
Artefact Review & Analysis: Review vendor security documentation, including reports, certifications, penetration testing summaries, architecture diagrams, and security policies.
Questionnaire Evaluation: Review and evaluate vendor responses to cybersecurity questionnaires, due diligence requests, and risk evaluations.
Risk Quantification & Tracking: Assign vendor risk ratings, document identified gaps, establish remediation action plans, and track vendor progress on outstanding risk items.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Procurement, Legal, and stakeholder teams during vendor onboarding, ongoing monitoring, and contract reviews.
Incident Monitoring & Escalation: Monitor vendor-related security incidents and advisory alerts, escalating potential issues in accordance with incident response protocols.

Why Join Us
High ownership: Define and drive Fam’s IT risk posture from the ground up—shaping IT, IS & outsourcing risk frameworks.
Org-level impact: Influence decision-making at the highest levels, working cross-functionally with security, legal, engineering, vendors and leadership to embed a strong risk and compliance culture across the org.
Zero to one opportunity: Build scalable, audit-ready systems and processes in a fast-moving startup environment where your work directly enables product innovation and regulatory trust.
Mission-driven: Be part of India’s first payments platform purpose-built for teenagers and young adults—balancing growth with trust, responsibility, and user safety.
 
 
 
 

 
Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck
• Relocation assistance to make your move seamless.
• Free office meals (lunch & dinner).
• Generous leave policy, including birthday leave, period leave, paternity and maternity support, and more.
• Salary advance and loan policies for any financial help.
• Quarterly rewards and recognition programs, and a referral program with great incentives.
• Access the latest gadgets and tools.
• Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family, mental health support.
• Tax benefits with options like food coupons, phone allowances, car/device leasing.
• Retirement perks like PF contribution, leave encashment and gratuity.
 
Here’s all the tea on FamApp ☕️
FamApp focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI & card payments to everyone above 11 years old. Our flagship Spending Account, FamX, seamlessly integrates UPI and card payments, enabling users to manage, save, and learn about their finances effortlessly.
 
Revolutionizing Payments and FinTech
FamApp has enabled 10 million+ users to make UPI and card payments across India, removing the inconvenience of carrying cash everywhere. Users get to customise their FamX card with doodles, which lets them add a personal touch to their payments.
 
Trusted by leading investors
We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.
 
Join Our Dynamic Team
At Fam, our people-first approach is reflected in our generous leave policies, flexible work schedules, comprehensive health benefits, and free mental health sessions. We don’t mean to brag, but we promise you’ll be surrounded by some of the most fun, talented and passionate people in the startup space.
 
Want to see what makes life at Fam so awesome? Check out our shenanigans at @lifeatfam 😛
PS - We’re looking for someone with an AI-native mindset, who actively leverages AI in their day-to-day work, as we encourage and embed it across every level at Fam.

About Fam (previously FamPay)

Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above
11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.

We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.

Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.

jobs.title: Field Credit Officer (Delta)
jobs.description:
About Us: 

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

Job Title: Field Credit Officer 

Reports to: Regional Credit Manager 

Employment Type: Outsourced 

Work Mode: Onsite

About this role: 

As a Field Credit Officer, you would be saddled with the duty of onboarding and managing businesses that would access our credit products. You would be tasked with growing your loan portfolio while maintaining profitability by ensuring that all loans are repaid as and when due. As a result, you would play a vital role in the assessment of these businesses during their credit application and leverage innovative tools we have developed to help you monitor their performance during the course of the loan.

You would also be responsible for making deductions from several information sources about the 5Cs of credit, with capacity, character, and capital as major priorities. Make recommendations to management before, during, and after the disbursement of a loan facility as to the best actions to be taken, considering several economic factors.

Responsibilities:
• Identify and onboard viable businesses within your assigned geographical area to open business accounts with Moniepoint
• Engage customers to ensure optimal usage of accounts to allow them to qualify for access to credit
• Review and approve (or decline) loan requests by thoroughly analyzing all the data available
• Embark on physical visitation to potential borrowers’ business places for evaluation of business books, taking inventory and turnover into consideration
• Meet gross loan portfolio targets and portfolio profit targets by maintaining a healthy number of loan customers while ensuring that all loans in portfolio are performing
• Monitor active loan portfolio to ensure continued use of business account and loan repayment performance
• Perform all other credit-related functions as may be assigned by a supervisor 

Experience Background:
• Minimum of an OND in any business-related discipline
• Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a sales role for credit products in a financial institution
• Demonstrable knowledge of credit risk analysis
• Good knowledge of financial analysis is an added advantage 

Skills Competencies:
• Apt attention to details
• Proven simple/complex analytical skills
• Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
• Agility and perseverance 

What success looks like

in this role:
• Consistent achievement of gross loan portfolio targets and portfolio profit targets.
• Maintaining a healthy, performing loan portfolio with minimized default rates through rigorous physical visitations and monitoring.
• Successful onboarding and engagement of viable businesses that actively utilize Moniepoint business accounts.
• Accurate credit risk assessments based on key factors like capacity, character, and capital. 

Why join us:
• Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.
• Opportunity to work with Africa’s fastest-growing fintech and make a direct impact on business growth across the region.
