jobs.title: Senior Principal, Talent Marketing
jobs.description:
About us

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times as Africa's fastest-growing fintech, Moniepoint is trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of dollars in transactions monthly. Having built resilient, high-volume financial infrastructure that powers commerce across emerging markets, Moniepoint is embarking on its next phase of global scale.

About this role

As our Senior Principal, Talent Marketing, you will be the strategic architect responsible for establishing Moniepoint's talent brand and candidate pipeline in new markets from scratch. Where Moniepoint is not yet an established consumer brand, you will solve complex talent acquisition problems by understanding how senior engineers, engineering managers, and technical leaders think, connect, and evaluate career moves across Europe. Working from a blank piece of paper with high autonomy, you will translate our global Employer Value Proposition (EVP) into localized, high-converting talent marketing strategies. You will bridge the gap between Talent Acquisition, Engineering Leadership, and Brand - combining developer community immersion, high-touch physical events, and targeted campaigns that turn brand discovery into qualified, closed engineering hires.

 

Responsibilities
1. Zero-to-One Market Entry Tech Hub Architecture
• Define European Hub Talent Strategy: Architect and lead the talent go-to-market strategy for Moniepoint's newest engineering hubs (principally Poland and Spain), crafting localized narratives that appeal to discerning software engineers.
• Anchor the 'Founding Team' Narrative: Position early European engineering cohorts as foundational builders, creating compelling narratives around technical scale, system complexity, and ownership that resonate with elite technical talent.
• Navigate Market Nuances: Diagnose and navigate country-specific developer dynamics—recognizing that developer communities in Poland, Spain, and the UK behave differently and require tailored engagement models rather than copy-pasted playbooks.
2. Developer Community, Ecosystem Event Activation
• High-Impact Physical Virtual Presence: Conceive, curate, and lead our physical presence at key developer conferences, engineering meetups, hackathons, and university partnerships across target markets.
• End-to-End Pipeline Activation: Ensure events are never vanity exercises; architect end-to-end follow-up systems and talent nurture funnels that convert event attendees into active, screened pipelines for our TA partners.
• Developer Platform Immersion: Leverage deep knowledge of where engineers consume information (e.g., GitLab/GitHub communities, tech forums, Discord/Slack groups, Meetup, Eventbrite) to drive authentic engagement.
3. Strategic Hiring Campaigns Technical Enablement
• Targeted Campaign Architecture: Partner with TA leads and Engineering Directors to identify acute hiring bottlenecks and build agile, multi-channel marketing campaigns that address specialized, hard-to-fill tech disciplines.
• Technical EVP Translation: Translate technical architecture, distributed systems challenges, and fintech infrastructure realities into authentic, intellectually rigorous technical messaging that outshines local competitors.
• Recruiter Enablement Narrative Toolkits: Equip our technical sourcing and recruitment teams with high-leverage narrative assets—outbound pitch decks, technical one-pagers, culture collateral, and messaging sequences that double recruiter outreach conversion.
4. Performance, Analytics Optimization
• Hiring-Centric Metrics: Discard vanity metrics. Evaluate every initiative against pipeline contribution, qualified applicant rates, candidate quality score, cost-per-hire, and time-to-fill.
• Budget Oversight: Own and allocate dedicated talent marketing budgets with extreme commercial discipline—scaling programs that drive measurable hires and rapidly decommissioning initiatives that underdeliver.
• Paid Acquisition (Tactical Lever): Oversee and strategically deploy paid recruitment marketing spend across relevant technical platforms and channels when targeted outbound and community channels require acceleration.
5. Strategic Leadership Scalability
• Strategic Thought Partnership: Serve as the trusted advisor to the Head of Talent Acquisition, VP of Engineering, and Brand Leadership on talent market intelligence, competitor positioning, and developer sentiment.
• Playbook Documentation: Establish and document Moniepoint's global talent expansion playbook, creating scalable frameworks that will be deployed across future international markets.
• Mentorship Functional Growth: Provide strategic guidance to broader TA and brand team members, with the opportunity to mentor or direct junior talent marketing specialists as the function scales.

Experience Background
• 8+ Years of Talent Marketing Leadership: Experience leading talent marketing, technical recruitment marketing, or developer relations/advocacy, with substantial time dedicated to hiring software engineering and product disciplines.
• European Market Expertise: Demonstrated experience building talent brand presence and hiring pipelines across European tech ecosystems (particularly Central/Eastern Europe such as Poland, and Western/Southern Europe such as the UK or Spain).
• Zero-to-One Market Entry Track Record: Proven success entering new geographies or scaling talent brand where the employer brand was nascent or non-existent, creating playbooks from a blank sheet of paper.
• Fintech Scale Exposure: Experience in hyper-growth fintech, high-frequency/payments infrastructure, or high-scale distributed systems environments.
• International Collaboration: Experience collaborating with international founding teams or distributed tech hubs across emerging and mature markets.

Skills Competencies
• Mastery in Event-Driven Pipeline Activation: Extensive hands-on experience designing and executing physical and digital developer events and architecting the subsequent candidate nurturing journey that yields hires.
• Deep Engineering Domain Fluency: Genuine understanding of software engineering culture, tech stacks (distributed systems, backend, infra, DevOps), and developer channels (Meetup, Eventbrite, GitLab/GitHub, Reddit, tech conferences).
• Comfort with Substantial Ambiguity: High agency and entrepreneurial drive; ability to make decisive bets, test hypotheses, and build structure in fast-moving, high-growth environments.
• Strategic Campaign Design: Ability to connect high-level EVP strategy to pragmatic, sprint-based talent acquisition sprints that deliver on an aggressive hiring plan (500+ tech hires).
• Paid Digital Campaign Optimization: Direct experience running and optimizing paid digital recruitment advertising campaigns independently across social and developer networks.

What success looks like in this role
• First 30 Days (Discovery Immersion): Map the competitive landscape and developer talent dynamics in Poland and Spain. Establish alignment with technical hiring leads (PEP, Engineering Directors) and TA leads to define immediate priority pipelines. Audit existing employer brand collateral and identify localized messaging gaps for European tech hiring.
• First 90 Days (Initial Market Entry Quick Wins): Launch the first pilot physical event / developer meetup presence in Poland with a complete post-event pipeline conversion funnel. Roll out the European Recruiter Enablement Toolkit (localized pitch decks, outreach sequences, and technical one-pagers). Launch targeted marketing sprints for top 3 hardest-to-fill senior technical roles.
• First 6 Months (Hub Establishment Pipeline Ramp): Position Moniepoint as a recognized, compelling engineering hub in Poland, supporting the identity and pride of the founding engineer cohort. Consistently contribute qualified, pre-warmed candidate pipelines directly supporting the ramp toward 500 tech/product hires. Prove multi-channel attribution showing which community and marketing initiatives are yielding quality hires.
• Year One (Global Expansion Playbook): Complete Moniepoint's International Talent Expansion Playbook, ready to be deployed across future tech hubs. Measurably decrease time-to-fill and increase direct outbound response rates across all European technical roles. Solidify Moniepoint's reputation as an employer of choice for Europe's most ambitious engineers.

Why join us
• High-Impact Mission: Play a career-defining role in building the engineering backbone of Africa's fastest-growing fintech as it scales globally.
• True Ownership Dedicated Resources: Autonomy to build from scratch with dedicated budget backing and direct executive sponsorship.
• Front-Row Seat to Tech Hub Creation: Help build engineering hubs from their inception, shaping culture, talent standards, and brand identity.
• Competitive Executive Package: Competitive base salary (calibrated for Senior Principal level), performance bonuses, comprehensive private healthcare, and pension schemes.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.title: Team Lead, System Administrator
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint is an all-in-one financial services platform for emerging markets and the second-fastest-growing company in Africa.

Since 2019, Moniepoint’s technology has powered over 3 million people, offering personal and business banking, payment, credit and business management tools to help them succeed. Moniepoint processed $182 billion in 2023, and currently processes the majority of the POS transactions in Nigeria. 

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

About the Role

The Team Lead, Systems Administration, is a senior individual contributor who also leads the IT infrastructure team tactically. This role is responsible for both the hands-on delivery of complex systems work and the orchestration of team priorities, standards, and output quality. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in networking, cloud infrastructure, security, and automation with the leadership capability to coach a team, enforce SOPs, and drive measurable operational excellence, including leveraging AI tools to optimise how the team works.

This role sits at the Team Lead level in Moniepoint's Talent Architecture. Success is defined not only by personal technical output, but by the team's consistent performance and delivery against infrastructure-wide targets.

Scope Decision Horizon

Leads the IT infrastructure team tactically. Success is the orchestration of people and priorities to ensure the team's immediate output aligns with the broader roadmap.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

Team Leadership Operations
• Lead, coordinate, and coach a team of Systems Administrators, ensuring consistent output quality and adherence to SOPs.
• Manage team workload, prioritise tasks across competing demands, and ensure SLA compliance across all infrastructure functions.
• Conduct regular 1:1s, deliver direct and specific performance feedback, and actively develop team members' technical skills.
• Design and enforce team workflows and escalation paths, ensuring quality is consistent regardless of who executes the task.
• Own team-level metrics: system uptime (99.9%+), ticket SLAs, incident response times, and end-user satisfaction.
• Identify gaps in team capability or process and proactively close them through training, tooling, or workflow redesign.

Infrastructure Management
• Design, implement, and maintain a robust IT infrastructure, including servers and virtualisation platforms (Proxmox).
• Administer and optimise Windows Server, Linux systems, and hybrid cloud infrastructures.
• Maintain comprehensive system documentation, network diagrams, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Plan and execute system upgrades with minimal downtime; optimise for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.

Cloud Network Infrastructure
• Design, deploy, and manage cloud network environments across GCP, OCI, and Azure, Outpost, including VPCs, subnets, peering, firewall rules, and private connectivity.
• Administer and optimise BGP routing policies, virtual routers (vRTF), and F5 load balancers across the enterprise network and cloud environments.
• Configure, manage, and troubleshoot enterprise networking infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points).
• Implement and maintain network security protocols, VLANs, VPNs, and network segmentation across on-premise and cloud environments.
• Manage DNS, DHCP, Directory as a Service, and other core network services.
• Monitor network performance, analyse bandwidth utilisation, and implement QoS policies.

AI Tools Workflow Automation
• Manage, maintain, and evaluate AI tools used across the IT and infrastructure function, ensuring reliability, access control, and appropriate use.
• Build and maintain automation workflows using n8n and similar platforms to optimise repetitive operational processes.
• Design and implement AI-assisted workflows for network deployment, incident triage, and infrastructure monitoring.
• Coach team members on responsible AI integration, when to use AI tools, how to validate outputs, and where human review is required.
• Identify opportunities to reduce manual toil through intelligent automation and continuously improve the team's automation capabilities.

Telephony Unified Communications
• Administer and maintain the xCALLY PBX platform, including call routing, IVR configuration, queue management, and agent provisioning.
• Troubleshoot telephony incidents end-to-end: SIP trunks, PBX dial plans, voice quality, and carrier integration.
• Coordinate with ISPs and telecom carriers to ensure uptime and quality of voice services across all sites.

Automation Scripting
• Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to eliminate repetitive tasks and improve operational efficiency.
• Utilise Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Ansible) for consistent and scalable infrastructure deployment.
• Build and maintain monitoring and alerting solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, and Nagios.
• Document automation and tooling clearly enough for an Associate-level team member to execute independently.

Security Compliance
• Implement and enforce IT security policies, access controls, and data protection measures across on-premise and cloud environments.
• Manage endpoint security solutions, patch management, and privileged access management.
• Manage user authentication systems, including SSO, MFA, and identity governance.
• Lead incident response: manage security events, conduct Root Cause Analyses (RCA), and implement permanent fixes.

User Endpoint Technical Support
• Oversee onboarding and offboarding procedures, ensuring seamless first-day experiences and complete account lifecycle management.
• Administer Google Workspace, including user provisioning, group management, Drive policies, and app integrations.
• Manage MDM solutions for corporate devices across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android.
• Provide or oversee expert-level L2/L3 support, ensuring timely resolution and minimal user disruption.
• Manage IT asset inventory, lifecycle, and procurement coordination.

Qualifications, Competencies Skills

Education Experience
• Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
• 5+ years of proven experience in systems administration, infrastructure, or network engineering roles.
• At least 2 years of formal or informal team leadership, including coaching, delegation, and performance feedback.
• Relevant industry certifications (CompTIA, Cisco, Microsoft, GCP/Azure/OCI cloud, Linux) are highly desirable, but not compulsory.

Technical Skills
• Advanced proficiency in Active Directory / Directory as a Service (e.g., JumpCloud); Linux/Unix administration (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian).
• Cloud networking expertise across GCP, OCI, and Azure: VPCs, subnets, load balancers, private service connect, VPN gateways, and cloud firewall management.
• Deep understanding of TCP/IP, BGP routing protocols, switching, VLANs, and enterprise network architecture across data centre and WAN environments.
• Hands-on experience with virtual routers (vRTF), F5 load balancers, and enterprise networking equipment (Cisco, Ubiquiti).
• Virtualisation experience with Proxmox; data centre operations including rack and stack, power, cooling, and structured cabling.
• Experience administering xCALLY PBX or equivalent enterprise telephony/unified communications platforms.
• Proficiency in scripting: Python, PowerShell, Bash; experience with Ansible and Terraform.
• Hands-on experience with n8n or equivalent workflow automation platforms for building and managing operational automations.
• Experience managing AI tools within an IT environment, including access control, integration, and responsible use governance.
• Experience with monitoring tools (Grafana, Prometheus, Nagios, PRTG) and endpoint/MDM management platforms.
• Proficiency in Google Workspace administration: user and group management, Drive, Gmail, Meet, and third-party app integrations.
• Advanced infosec tooling experience (e.g., CrowdStrike); knowledge of Disaster Recovery protocols and DR drills.
• Experience with Jira Service Management; understanding of SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs.

Leadership Soft Skills
• Proven ability to lead a technical team: delegate effectively, deliver feedback, and develop others.
• Exceptional analytical and systematic troubleshooting approach; moves fast without compromising rigour.
• Strong documentation discipline — produces SOPs and runbooks clear enough for junior team members to execute.
• Candid communicator: surfaces risks early, documents dissent, and challenges direction constructively.
• Customer-obsessed: identifies and permanently resolves recurring pain points, not just individual tickets.

Working Conditions
• This role may require occasional weekend or after-hours work to perform system maintenance, upgrades, and respond to critical incidents.
• Physical requirements may include lifting equipment up to 50 lbs.

What we can offer you
• Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
• Learning: We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
• Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, and health insurance.

What to expect in the hiring process
• A technical interview with a member of the Infrastructure team.
• A take-home assessment
• A behavioral and technical interview with a member of the executive team.

jobs.title: AI Enablement Project Director
jobs.location: Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR; Singapore, Singapore
jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

We are seeking a hands-on Director of AI Enablement to identify high-value business problems, deliver AI solutions in real operational environments, and turn proven approaches into reusable enterprise capabilities.

The role combines the business immersion and problem discovery of a Deployment Strategist, the technical delivery capability of a Forward-Deployed Engineer, and the product judgment required to standardize successful solutions. You will work directly with teams such as Compliance, Legal, Risk, Customer Service, Operations, and GBS, in partnership with Product, Engineering, Data, Security, and Infrastructure.

Success is measured by business impact and sustained adoption—not the number of pilots launched.

What You’ll Be Doing
1. Find and Prioritize High-Value Problems
• Embed with business teams and frontline users to understand their workflows, decisions, data, constraints, and pain points.
• Separate root causes from symptoms and determine whether the right answer is process redesign, better data, automation, AI, or a combination of these.
• Prioritize opportunities based on business value, user reach, risk, feasibility, time-to-value, and reuse potential.
• Translate ambiguous needs into clear problem statements, target outcomes, success metrics, and executable plans.
2. Build and Deliver Solutions

We’re looking for a Senior Visual Designer to join the Visual System Team, the team responsible for how OKX looks and feels across every product surface, including mobile and web. You’ll work at the intersection of brand expression and product design, crafting the visual layer that makes OKX products feel distinctive, coherent, and trusted.

This isn’t a role where you receive a finalized wireframe and simply apply a visual layer. You’ll be involved early, shaping how features are visually conceived, how brand moments are integrated into product flows, and how visual systems scale across an ecosystem of products used by millions.

You’ll work within OKX’s Visual Systems infrastructure alongside the Design System and Content System teams, contributing to scalable visual frameworks including illustration guidelines, motion principles, iconography standards, and brand-in-product patterns that raise quality across the entire product.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Design product visual experiences. Create high-quality visual and UI designs for OKX products across trading, wallet, payments, and social features. Own the visual execution of key product surfaces, from concept through to pixel-perfect delivery. Balance beauty with clarity in a domain where trust and usability are non-negotiable.
• Contribute to visual systems. Work within and contribute to OKX’s visual systems, including shared illustration styles, motion tokens, color systems, iconography, layout patterns, UI components, and design tokens. Your work should strengthen the system, not create one-off exceptions. Think in terms of reusable, scalable assets and patterns, not just individual
• Bridge brand and product. Translate brand direction into in-product visual experiences. Work with the Brand Design team to ensure that visual identity is consistent from marketing to core product, while adapting it thoughtfully to product goals, user needs, and performance metrics. You’ll help create room for the product’s own visual expression without going off-brand.
• Design product campaigns and key moments. Create engaging visual experiences for in-product campaigns, launches, and feature moments. These should feel distinctive and expressive while remaining native to the product experience and aligned with the broader brand.
• Use AI tools in your design workflow. Actively integrate AI into your daily practice using generative tools for ideation, exploration, variation, prototyping, and asset production. You’re expected to experiment with AI-assisted workflows and bring what works back to the team. This is a core part of how we work, not an optional extra.
• Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner with product designers, engineers, and product managers to ensure visual design decisions are grounded in user needs and technically feasible. Participate in design reviews, give and receive critique constructively, and communicate your rationale clearly.
• Pitch and present. Propose creative concepts to team leads and stakeholders. Articulate the reasoning behind visual choices, not just what you designed, but why it is the right solution for the user and the brand.

What We Look For In You

• Experience taking product experiences from wireframes to polished, production-ready UI. You understand how visual design supports usability, hierarchy, trust, product goals, and measurable outcomes, not just aesthetics.

• Exceptional visual craft across typography, color, composition, layout, interaction, and detail. You have a clear point of view, make thoughtful design decisions, and care about the polish that separates good from great.
• Experience creating or contributing to scalable design systems. You understand tokens, components, patterns, and how to create a coherent visual language across a product.
• Comfortable working at the intersection of brand and product. You can translate brand direction into product experiences that meet user and business needs while leaving room for distinctive product expression.

You use AI with strong creative judgment, refining outputs rather than relying on unedited generated assets, and look for ways to make visual work more scalable.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Visual Designer to join the Visual System Team, the team responsible for how OKX looks and feels across every product surface, including mobile and web. You’ll work at the intersection of brand expression and product design, crafting the visual layer that makes OKX products feel distinctive, coherent, and trusted.

This isn’t a role where you receive a finalized wireframe and simply apply a visual layer. You’ll be involved early, shaping how features are visually conceived, how brand moments are integrated into product flows, and how visual systems scale across an ecosystem of products used by millions.

You’ll work within OKX’s Visual Systems infrastructure alongside the Design System and Content System teams, contributing to scalable visual frameworks including illustration guidelines, motion principles, iconography standards, and brand-in-product patterns that raise quality across the entire product.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Design product visual experiences. Create high-quality visual and UI designs for OKX products across trading, wallet, payments, and social features. Own the visual execution of key product surfaces, from concept through to pixel-perfect delivery. Balance beauty with clarity in a domain where trust and usability are non-negotiable.
• Contribute to visual systems. Work within and contribute to OKX’s visual systems, including shared illustration styles, motion tokens, color systems, iconography, layout patterns, UI components, and design tokens. Your work should strengthen the system, not create one-off exceptions. Think in terms of reusable, scalable assets and patterns, not just individual
• Bridge brand and product. Translate brand direction into in-product visual experiences. Work with the Brand Design team to ensure that visual identity is consistent from marketing to core product, while adapting it thoughtfully to product goals, user needs, and performance metrics. You’ll help create room for the product’s own visual expression without going off-brand.
• Design product campaigns and key moments. Create engaging visual experiences for in-product campaigns, launches, and feature moments. These should feel distinctive and expressive while remaining native to the product experience and aligned with the broader brand.
• Use AI tools in your design workflow. Actively integrate AI into your daily practice using generative tools for ideation, exploration, variation, prototyping, and asset production. You’re expected to experiment with AI-assisted workflows and bring what works back to the team. This is a core part of how we work, not an optional extra.
• Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner with product designers, engineers, and product managers to ensure visual design decisions are grounded in user needs and technically feasible. Participate in design reviews, give and receive critique constructively, and communicate your rationale clearly.
• Pitch and present. Propose creative concepts to team leads and stakeholders. Articulate the reasoning behind visual choices, not just what you designed, but why it is the right solution for the user and the brand.

What We Look For In You
• 4–6 years of experience in visual design, UI design, a digital-focused role within a brand team, or a related discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating strong craft, modern taste, and attention to detail.
• Experience taking product experiences from wireframes to polished, production-ready UI. You understand how visual design supports usability, hierarchy, trust, product goals, and measurable outcomes, not just aesthetics.
• Strong UI and digital design fundamentals across product, responsive web, and mobile experiences. Mobile-first experience is essential.
• Exceptional visual craft across typography, color, composition, layout, interaction, and detail. You have a clear point of view, make thoughtful design decisions, and care about the polish that separates good from great.
• Experience creating or contributing to scalable design systems. You understand tokens, components, patterns, and how to create a coherent visual language across a product.
• Comfortable working at the intersection of brand and product. You can translate brand direction into product experiences that meet user and business needs while leaving room for distinctive product expression.
• AI-forward in your practice. You actively use generative tools for ideation, exploration, prototyping, and production, and are excited to experiment with new workflows. You use AI with strong creative judgment, refining outputs rather than relying on unedited generated assets, and look for ways to make visual work more scalable.
• A clear, collaborative communicator who can articulate design rationale and work effectively with product designers, engineers, product managers, and Brand Design.
• Proficiency in Figma and prototyping tools, with the ability to communicate interaction and motion intent through high-fidelity prototypes.
• Experience creating light animation is a strong plus. Experience with 3D software or a genuine willingness to learn is also highly valued.

What Sets You Apart
• Experience designing for fintech, crypto, or trading platforms — you understand the visual language of trust, precision, and data density.
• Strong visual. illustration and interaction idea skills — you can create original visual assets, not just compose them.
• An exceptional eye for layout, composition, and hierarchy. You can turn ideas into clear, high-quality visual solutions quickly and decisively.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, balancing speed with a high bar for craft and attention to detail.
• Experience working with globally distributed teams across offices and time zones.
• Familiarity with how visual design integrates with front-end implementation. You understand CSS, design tokens, and component architecture well enough to collaborate effectively with engineers.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

jobs.title: DX企画推進担当
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼組織・チームについて

データやテクノロジーを活用し、PayPayグループの経営管理を高度化することをミッションとしています。
グループ全体の経営・事業状況をタイムリーに把握できる環境の実現に向けて、経営管理に必要なデータ基盤の整備やKPIダッシュボードの構築を推進しています。また、AIや各種テクノロジーを活用した経営管理業務の自動化・効率化にも取り組んでいます。

▼募集の背景

事業規模・領域の拡大に伴い、経営管理に必要なデータやKPIも多様化しており、グループ全体を横断した経営管理基盤のさらなる高度化を進めています。
本ポジションでは、経営管理に必要なデータ基盤の整備から、経営KPI・重要指標を可視化するダッシュボードの企画・構築までを推進いただける方を募集しています。

▼具体的な業務内容

経営の意思決定を支えるデータ基盤およびKPIダッシュボードの企画・構築を中心に、経営管理領域のDXを推進いただきます。
• 経営層向けKPIダッシュボードの要件定義・構築
• クラウド型予算管理システムの運用・保守、追加改修の推進
• RPA等の自動化ツールの運用、および活用領域の拡大に向けた企画・実装
• AI等を活用した経営管理業務の高度化（Python・生成AIを活用した機械学習、自動化・効率化など）
• 事業拡大や経営管理要件の変化に応じた、グループ経営を支える経営管理基盤の構築および各種プロジェクトの企画・推進

※PayPayのグループ会社へ出向いただくケースがございます

▼本ポジションの魅力
• 経営の意思決定に直結するDX： 
KPIダッシュボードやデータ基盤の構築を通じて、自らの仕事が経営判断や事業運営に活かされる手応えを得られます。
• 上流から実装まで一気通貫： 
企画・要件定義から構築・運用改善まで携わり、経営課題をテクノロジーで解決する経験を積めます。
• データ・AIを横断した専門性：
 BI・データ活用を軸に、生成AIや自動化などにも領域を広げ、経営管理×テクノロジーの専門性を高めることができます。

必要な経験/スキル

以下のいずれか、または複数の実務経験お持ちの方（目安：5年以上）
• Tableau、Sigma等のBIツールを用いたダッシュボードの設計・構築経験
• SQLを用いたデータ抽出・分析、およびBigQuery、Snowflake等を活用したデータテーブル・クエリの実装経験
• 経営管理システム等における要件定義、設計・開発、導入・運用の経験
• システム開発・導入プロジェクトの企画・PM・PMO経験
• RPA等の自動化ツールを活用した業務改善・DX推進経験
• ChatGPT、Gemini等の生成AIを活用した業務改善・DX企画の経験

あると望ましい経験/スキル
• データ基盤の構築からBIによる可視化まで、一貫して携わった経験
• 予算管理・管理会計システムの開発・導入・運用経験
• 生成AIを活用した経営管理業務・経営管理基盤の高度化経験

• 事業会社において、ビジネス部門と連携した、システム開発・データ活用の推進経験

PayPayが求める人物像

jobs.title: Head of Indirect Tax
jobs.description:
Starling is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way. Read more about Our Story here.

We’re a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We’re a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. We employ more than 3,000 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Starling - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of our London office so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. We're asking that you attend the office a minimum of 10 days per month. 

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Head of Indirect Tax (or an experienced Senior Manager ready to take the next step in their career) to join our growing tax team, reporting directly to the Group Director of Tax. As a central leader within the tax function, you will take overall responsibility for managing the group’s UK and international indirect tax affairs spanning strategic tax planning, international expansion, structuring and transactions, as well as indirect tax compliance and governance.

This is a high-visibility leadership role during an ambitious phase of scaling for the Starling Bank group. You will lead indirect tax strategy across our core UK banking operations, our global Software-as-a-Service banking platform (Engine by Starling), overseas entities and branch networks, new financial product developments, and strategic corporate transactions.

Responsibilities

The role involves a wide range of responsibilities and high-impact opportunities in a rapidly scaling fintech environment, including:
• Leading the group’s indirect tax strategy and compliance, proactively identifying opportunities and navigating statutory changes across UK and international jurisdictions.
• Supporting high-profile corporate projects including IPO planning, group reorganisations, acquisitions, international expansion, and transfer pricing.
• Championing strategic VAT planning and optimisation across the group, anticipating emerging indirect tax developments and requirements that could impact our operations.
• Establishing, monitoring, and continually refining the group's Indirect Tax Risk Management & Governance Framework, ensuring rigorous alignment with Senior Accounting Officer (SAO) requirements, anti-facilitation of tax evasion controls, and internal audit standards.
• Managing relationships with external professional advisers, ensuring high-quality, efficient, and cost-effective delivery.
• Partnering closely with Finance, Engineering, and Technology teams to optimise and automate ERP tax engines (e.g. NetSuite, Workday), auditing and configuring automated VAT determination logic, general ledger mapping, and digital invoice matching to support Making Tax Digital (MTD) and international real-time e-invoicing standards.
• Delivering clear, commercially minded indirect tax advice and structured training to Commercial, Product, and Finance teams regarding indirect tax implications and new product rollouts.
• Leading all engagements with tax authorities, overseeing routine inquiries, formal audits, and proactive dispute resolution.
• Substantial post-qualification experience in UK indirect tax within financial services (such as retail banking, lending, payment institutions, or fintech), featuring demonstrable experience leading complex Partial Exemption calculations.
• Comprehensive knowledge of international indirect tax frameworks, including EU B2B place-of-supply rules, reverse charge mechanics, and Fixed Establishment risk management.
• Proven ability to act as a trusted adviser to executive leadership (CFO, Head of Tax, General Counsel), translating complex indirect tax regulations into actionable commercial strategy and clear briefings.
• Professional qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CTA, or equivalent, backed by strong core accounting knowledge.
• Collaborative, self-motivated leadership approach with exceptional organisational ability, meticulous attention to detail, and a pragmatic attitude toward indirect tax risk management.
• A commercial, solution-focused mindset, alongside the ability to communicate technical indirect tax matters clearly to both tax specialists and non-tax stakeholders.
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships

 About Us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway.

We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Starling Bank is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Starling Bank are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

By submitting your application, you agree that Starling Bank may collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

You will work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment to solve new and interesting challenges each day. Together with our Trust team, you will help shape the future of our bank.

You will work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment to solve new and interesting challenges each day. Together with our Trust team, you will help shape the future of our bank.

Job Description

jobs.title: Data Analytics Manager - Risk & Controls
jobs.description:
The Platform Engineering Tribe:

We are the driving force behind Wise, making sure everything runs smoothly. We support our engineering teams so they innovate, build and ship great code quickly and confidently. Our expertise spans Data, Machine Learning, Incident and Risk Management, Hardware, and System Efficiency, all designed to foster an unparalleled Engineering Experience.

The Role:

We are looking for an experienced Lead Data Analyst/Analytics Manager to join our Platform Engineering and Security team. This role will be pivotal in shaping how we use data to manage security and risk. You will build robust data pipelines that support continuous control monitoring and turn insights into strategic opportunities—all within Wise’s secure and compliant framework.

The completeness and effectiveness of our controls are critical to regulatory compliance. Your work will provide assurance that our security posture is clearly defined, well understood, and robust. You will both look at maintenance of existing controls, and ensuring their effectiveness vs working with teams to increase coverage

You will also manage 1-2 analysts and help define the data strategy for our Risk pillar, working closely with partners across the team.

How you’ll contribute:
• Scale and improve our risk data infrastructure to enable our global teams to dissect metrics at granular levels to proactively identify and mitigate against drivers of risk.
• Building out the metrics to monitor our controls and ensure that they are performing as required, as well as supporting control testing processes.
• Establish control efficiency frameworks by analysing whether controls are effectively reducing risk while not adversely impacting growth.
• Partner with product, engineering, product risk and compliance and other cross-functional stakeholders to influence decisions with data around global controls and risk.
• Partner closely with Security / Cyber Security to ensure local and infra risk typologies are monitored and appropriately managed. 

What will you be working on?
• Control Requirements & Continuous Monitoring: Partner closely with control owners across security domains (such as Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Data Governance, etc.) to translate abstract compliance and testing requirements into concrete, measurable metrics, SLAs, and continuous monitoring dashboards.
• Opportunity Sizing: Utilise data to identify opportunities for enhancing compliance processes, mitigating risks, and driving higher efficiency throughout the organisation
• Last-Mile Delivery: Ensure dashboards and controls remain accurate, reliable, and useful after launch. Investigate data issues and missed SLAs, update queries where needed, and work with upstream data and programme owners to resolve gaps and improve data quality
• Build and Optimise Pipelines: Develop, optimise, and maintain data pipelines using Python, REST APIs, DBT, and Airflow to ensure seamless data flow for compliance and risk management.
• People Management: Manage and support one or two analysts working across the security and risk space, helping them develop while ensuring high-quality delivery.

jobs.title: Head of Global Partnerships - Cards
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Head of Global Card Expansion to own one of the most important parts of Wise's global payments infrastructure.

You'll own the partnerships that underpin both how customers spend with Wise and how they pay Wise. Your decisions will shape the future of the Wise Card, our card funding capabilities, and the commercial partnerships that support millions of customers around the world.

This isn't a traditional partnerships role. You'll own Wise's global strategy across Visa, Mastercard, and our acquiring partners, ensuring they enable our mission. You'll shape how we launch the Wise Card into new markets, how customers fund their Wise Account using cards, and how we build commercial partnerships that improve customer outcomes while strengthening the economics of our global card programmes.

You'll work across Product, Banking & Expansion, Treasury, Finance, Compliance, Legal and Engineering to solve complex problems and help Wise continue to scale globally.

Your mission:

Own Wise's global card partnerships:
• Own our executive relationships with Visa, Mastercard, our issuer banking partners and strategic acquiring partners. Define how Wise works with these organisations globally, aligning commercial strategy, product priorities and expansion goals to create long-term competitive advantage.
• You'll represent Wise in commercial negotiations, product forums and strategic planning, while ensuring our partnerships continue to support Wise's ambitious growth plans globally.

Build and scale the world's best global card programme:
• Define the strategy for Wise's global card programmes across issuing and card acceptance.
• Lead complex commercial negotiations covering network economics, incentives, issuer partnerships, acquiring relationships and long-term commercial frameworks. Own the commercial models that underpin our card business and continually improve the economics of how customers spend with Wise and fund their Wise Account.
• You'll be equally comfortable negotiating a multi-year commercial agreement, reviewing an issuer agreement with Legal, supporting due diligence for a new BIN sponsor or working through scheme documentation to enable a new card feature.

Enable global expansion:
• Partner with regional Banking & Expansion teams to launch the Wise Card into new markets and new legal entities.
• Work directly with regional Visa and Mastercard teams and local partners to define market strategy, remove blockers and accelerate launches. You'll understand that successful expansion requires balancing global consistency with local market realities and you'll enjoy getting into the details to make things happen.

Build compliant, scalable card programmes:
• Work closely with Compliance, Financial Crime and Legal teams to ensure our card partnerships and programmes remain compliant as Wise scales.
• You'll understand how scheme rules, AML and financial crime requirements, issuer obligations and local regulation intersect, and you'll work directly with partners to solve regulatory challenges that enable launches rather than slow them down.
• You're comfortable owning regulatory conversations with external partners and know that strong commercial partnerships are built on strong compliance foundations.

Be Wise's card ecosystem expert:
• Become the company's go-to expert on the global card ecosystem.
• You'll understand the technical, operational and commercial detail behind card schemes, issuer processing, acquiring, settlement, interchange, network economics, certification, digital wallets and payment acceptance.
• You'll use that expertise to influence product strategy, advise Engineering and Product teams, and identify new opportunities for Wise to improve the customer experience.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Own some of Wise's most strategic external partnerships and represent Wise with senior leaders across Visa, Mastercard, issuer banks and global acquiring partners.
• Shape the future of one of Wise's fastest-growing products by influencing how the Wise Card expands globally.
• Lead commercial negotiations that directly improve customer outcomes and the economics of Wise's global card programmes.
• Work on complex international launches, partnering with regional teams to bring new card products and payment capabilities to market.
• Solve difficult commercial, technical and regulatory challenges across multiple markets where no playbook exists.
• Define how Wise partners with the global card ecosystem for the next decade while remaining hands-on in making that strategy a reality.

jobs.title: Analytics Senior Manager - Risk & Controls
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Analytics manager who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to partner with our financial crime product teams to help drive data-driven and innovative growth decisions while helping to combat financial crime. 

At Wise, we strike a critical balance between user experience and the stringent demands of risk prevention. Our mission within the Risk & Controls team in APAC is to stay one step ahead of emerging risk while ensuring that our customers enjoy a seamless experience. In this vital role, you will innovate and implement controls that enhance security without compromising user convenience.

Most importantly, you’ll collaborate closely with your product managers, designers, data scientists and engineers to bring your insights into real change for our customers and help drive our mission! 

Your mission:

At Wise our mission is Money Without Borders - instant, convenient, transparent and eventually free. Whether our customers are sending money to another country, spending money abroad, or making and receiving international business payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. 

Here’s how you’ll be contributing to the Financial Crime team:
• You’ll expose the vast data on our processes to the product teams across Wise in a meaningful and actionable way in which people can proactively access the information without friction or need for analyst assistance
• Proactively contribute to, own, create, track key metrics and results for your product and operational teams, keeping them accountable throughout the quarter
• Support stakeholders by conducting research, preparing reports, and visualisations
• Work with data scientists in understanding and developing the means for detecting and mitigating financial crime
• Building the framework for managing risk and customer experience at scale
• Drive the discovery phase by scoping new opportunities and suggesting features, rules and models to combat emerging risks
• The role requires collaboration with Product, Data Scientists, Engineering and Operations Team

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Be part of a positive change in the world. We’re fixing a broken, greedy system, and putting people and businesses in control of their money
• Create value from extensive datasets. We have millions of customers, a global set of payment infrastructure and a complex product that customers can use in different ways. There is a tonne of value left to unlock from this data!
• Influence the team’s direction. Analysts at Wise enable data-driven decision making and have a large impact by helping their teams to decide what to work on.
• Learn from a global network of professionals. We have a large, diverse team of analysts, data scientists and product managers that you will work with and learn from.
• Lead and develop a team of 3 analysts: helping them to set priorities, coaching for impact, and maintaining quality standards

jobs.title: Senior Business Manager - Liquidity Management
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. We are seeking a Senior Business Manager to drive the design, development and delivery of new products for the Liquidity team. The successful candidate will be working closely with liquidity managers, engineers and stakeholders for day-to-day support/running/problem solving of the business. The candidate will gain exposure to trading strategies supported by liquidity teams ranging from delta-one to volatility products traded in orderbook, over-the-counter or de-centralized. It’s a unique opportunity for one to contribute his/her expertise and grow with the industry.

 

What You’ll Be Doing:
• Support the development of liquidity business as a problem solver
• Coordinate with multiple teams (Legal, Compliance, Risk, Audit, Finance) to do complete business analysis ensuring proper control in place, and related matters are properly and timely addressed
• Overview the projects for business growth and provide support on planning, execution and coordination
• Identify key business points related to risk, compliance and operations, design procedures and workflows to enhance
• Conduct detail feature and risk analysis to facilitate technical design by engineering team

What We Look For In You:
• Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, computer science, or related field
• Solid experience in business management or business analyst, preferably in financial services or trading technology
• Strong understanding of trading systems end-to-end logic in financial markets
• Experience with agile project development methodologies
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
• Fluent in both English and Chinese

 

Nice to haves:
• Familiarity with blockchain and cryptocurrency exchanges

 

Perks and

Benefits:
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

 

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter - Non Tech
jobs.description:
As a Senior Recruiter at Wise you’ll be responsible for hiring the best talent for Servicing teams in Hyderabad. You’ll own talent management, helping servicing to scale to enable Wise to achieve our mission - money without borders. You’ll be a key member of the recruitment team with a focus on delivering exceptional talent while keeping candidate and hiring manager experience front and centre of what you do. 

Culture is everything to us at Wise and identifying, finding and selecting the best talent to support our highly collaborative and non-hierarchical culture is key. As a Senior Recruiter you are vital to the overall success of Wise. The right person will have an excellent knowledge of talent management and understand how to partner effectively.

Your mission:
• You’ll help us scale our Fincrime/KYC/CS/AML teams over the next few years so we can help more customers save money using Wise
• You’ll manage candidates end-to-end ensuring they receive the best possible experience in line with Wise values, even if they weren’t successful (you never know, the perfect role might come up later), and build a strong talent network locally and internationally
• You’ll build and develop relationships with with hiring teams, guiding them through processes
• Always seeking growth opportunities, not afraid to step outside of your comfort zone and take a risk
• Collaborate with sourcers to understand the candidate market and engage the best talent
• Use data to support your hiring recommendations, as well as using it to retro processes, figure out the blockers to hiring, communicate how these can be overcome and continually optimise the process to make sure it is globally scalable
• You'll partner with hiring teams and other People teams (e.g. People Operations), to support various initiatives (e.g. referral programs, talent mapping, salary benchmarking, etc)

jobs.title: Director, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Marketing at Brex

The Marketing team tells the Brex story, turning product innovation into customer obsession. We develop messaging, shape the brand, and bring our platform to life through thoughtful, compelling content. Our team spans Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, and Brand Marketing, and works cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Business Development, and Design to drive growth and build trust.

What you'll do

You will lead Brex's performance marketing strategy and paid media investments, driving customer acquisition, revenue growth, and brand awareness across an expanding portfolio of channels.

Partnering with the Senior Director of Growth Marketing, you will scale an established acquisition engine, build an in-house center of excellence for performance and brand media buying, and lead a growing team of performance marketers. You'll own the strategy and financial performance of our media investments, balancing near-term revenue outcomes with longer-term demand creation.

With significant growth investment following Brex's acquisition by Capital One, you'll have the opportunity to shape a rapidly expanding media budget, accelerate experimentation across emerging channels, and build more sophisticated measurement capabilities to inform investment decisions.

Responsibilities
• Own Brex's paid media strategy and investment across Brand and Growth, accountable for qualified pipeline, self-serve signups, and the revenue they produce. Brand sets campaign vision and brand KPIs; you turn them into full-funnel media plans.
• Manage and optimize a growing, multimillion-dollar media budget, balancing acquisition volume, LTV, and incremental revenue contribution.
• Build an in-house digital media center of excellence, transitioning brand media buying from a traditional agency model while strategically leveraging platforms and managed services.
• Scale existing paid search and paid social programs (LinkedIn, Meta), while expanding investment in YouTube, connected TV, programmatic, and other upper-funnel channels.
• Develop an integrated full-funnel investment strategy, connecting demand creation and brand awareness to downstream acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.
• Partner with Marketing Operations, Data, and Finance to improve measurement, forecasting, budget pacing, and investment allocation across channels.
• Translate existing attribution and customer journey data into actionable insights, building reporting and analytical frameworks that inform media strategy and optimization.
• Drive rapid experimentation across channels, audiences, and creative, identifying opportunities to restructure underperforming campaigns and scale successful investments.
• Partner with Brand and Creative teams to develop high-performing static and video advertising, providing actionable feedback on messaging, formats, and creative effectiveness.
• Lead and develop a growing performance marketing team, establishing clear accountability, scalable execution practices, and AI-enabled workflows to increase operating leverage.

Requirements
• 8+ years of experience in performance marketing, paid acquisition, or digital media, with demonstrated experience scaling multichannel advertising programs.
• Direct experience managing $30M+ in annual paid media spend (~$3M monthly), with measurable impact on customer acquisition and revenue growth.
• Deep expertise in performance marketing and acquisition economics, including LTV, ROI, incremental revenue, and revenue-based optimization.
• Proven ability to develop full-funnel media strategies, connecting upper-funnel brand investments to measurable improvements in downstream demand, conversion, and revenue.
• Deep hands-on expertise in outline video, connected TV, programmatic, and brand media, plus strong paid social experience across LinkedIn and Meta. Working knowledge of paid search.
• Strong financial acumen, including budget ownership, forecasting, investment modeling, and data-driven allocation of spend across channels.
• Strong analytical judgment and experience translating attribution, customer journey, and campaign performance data into actionable investment decisions.
• Demonstrated ability to assess and improve campaign structure, channel strategy, and creative performance through rigorous testing and rapid iteration.
• Strong creative judgment, with experience partnering with Brand and Design teams to develop and optimize performance-oriented static and video advertising.
• Experience leading and developing high-performing teams, with a hands-on leadership style and the ability to scale execution without unnecessary organizational complexity.
• A curious, action-oriented approach to problem-solving, with a track record of challenging existing strategies, making decisions with imperfect information, and executing quickly.

Bonus points
• Experience scaling performance marketing in both high-volume B2C or product-led growth (PLG) environments and B2B, sales-led businesses.
• Experience transitioning media buying from an agency-led model to an in-house team, including evaluating managed-service partners.
• Experience developing incrementality testing, media mix modeling, or advanced full-funnel measurement frameworks.
• Experience in fintech, financial services, or high-growth technology companies.
• Experience leveraging AI and automation to improve media execution, analysis, and team productivity.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $221,480 to $276,850. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate's location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Lead, Operations & Growth
jobs.description:
About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Regional Operations

The Role:

Lead, Operations Growth

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented candidate to join Gemini’s Singapore team, sitting at the intersection of our Singapore operations and growth mandate. The role is designed to align toward a more generalist skillset to broadly support the Singapore business covering the following areas:
• Working with our highest value clients to enable a seamless and world class experience on Gemini
• Owning key processes for the Singapore entity such as outsourcing management
• Leading execution on our local growth efforts and customer reactivations

You will collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Compliance/Legal, and Customer Support teams to achieve the above.

Responsibilities:

Operations Process Management
• Take ownership of our Outsourcing processes and governance practices and ensure adherence to MAS requirements.
• Run monthly/quarterly processes check-ins with key stakeholders across audit, compliance, legal, and management and ensure we identify and plug any gaps.
• Assess and own the material and reporting for this process by working with stakeholders to enhance and improve our monitoring and reporting.
• Work closely with our audit and compliance teams to understand the latest regulations with regard to any MAS mandates in this area.
• Work with counterparts across various teams such as risk, product, compliance to identity gaps, come up with a plan to plug them, and finally ensure they are completed.
• Assess and monitor all SLAs with regard to operational and outsourcing based processes.

Growth Activation
• Work closely with Singapore leadership to drive our Singapore growth agenda across product and local activation.
• Own the Singapore growth roadmap and execute the plan by working cross functionally with stakeholders across marketing and product.
• Monitor Singapore’s performance and run weekly/monthly growth meets to take stock and plan next steps.
• Support the Gemini team during Token 2049 and other major industry events, coordinating promotions, activations, and on-the-ground support to maximise impact.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for Gemini’s top-tier VIP traders, ensuring their issues are resolved promptly, effectively, and with the highest standard of care.
• Conduct regular check-ins and meetings with VIP clients to understand their evolving needs, gather feedback, and proactively address potential friction points.
• Champion the voice of the VIP customer internally, bringing structured feedback and insights back to the broader product and operations teams.
• Organise and facilitate product workshops tailored to VIP customers, giving them early insight into new features and gathering high-signal feedback.
• Plan and execute VIP trader events and dinners, creating meaningful touchpoints that strengthen client relationships and deepen loyalty.

Qualifications:
• 6–8 years of experience in financial operations/ growth and marketing/client-facing roles within financial services, fintech, or crypto.
• Good understanding of crypto platforms, operations, client support and management.
• Experience running growth plans using channels such as content, events, PR, and reactivation programs.
• Project management experience running cross functional mandates.
• Ability to be data driven and comfortable working with numbers.
• Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with high-value clients or stakeholders.
• Highly organised, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities under time pressure.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to convey complex issues clearly and professionally.
• A collaborative mindset with experience working across cross-functional teams, including technology and product teams.
• Passion for crypto and Web3; prior experience in a crypto exchange or digital asset environment is a strong plus.
• Experience planning or supporting industry events (e.g., Token 2049, Consensus) is advantageous.

It Pays to Work Here

We take a holistic approach to compensation at Gemini, which includes:
• Comprehensive health plans covered at 100% for employees and dependents
• Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant
• Paid Parental Leave
• Competitive paid time off

In Singapore, we have a hybrid work policy. Employees are expected to work from the office part of the week. We believe our hybrid approach increases productivity through more in-person collaboration where possible. All employees are required to onboard in-person at our office.

At Gemini, we strive to build diverse teams that reflect the people we want to empower through our products, and we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Equal Opportunity is the Law, and Gemini is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a specific need that requires accommodation, please let a member of the People Team know.

jobs.title: Regional Security Officer (North East)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

What We Do

At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Job Purpose

The Regional Security Lead ensures that our mission never stops. You are the guardian of our physical spaces, ensuring that every Moniepoint office is a sanctuary where our team can build and create without worry.

By leading regional security operations, managing on-ground teams, and proactively identifying risks, you provide the stability and safety that allows financial happiness to thrive. You don't just react to incidents; you build the systems that prevent them.

Key Responsibilities
• Safeguard our People and Assets: Lead the implementation of security policies that protect our team, offices, and equipment across your region.
• Master the Environment: Conduct regular security assessments to spot vulnerabilities and design innovative strategies to reduce risk.
• Lead the Front Line: Supervise and mentor private security guards and armed police personnel, ensuring they perform their duties with mastery and respect.
• Build Strong Alliances: Act as our primary liaison with law enforcement and emergency services, ensuring we always have a seat at the table during emergencies.
• Investigate and Solve: Lead the response to security breaches and accidents, providing clear, factual reports that help us learn and improve.
• Empower the Team: Design and deliver training programs that equip our security personnel and employees with life-saving protocols.
• Innovate for Safety: Stay ahead of security trends and technology (like CCTV and access control) to keep our regional operations modern and resilient.
• Support Business Resilience: Provide expert guidance on asset recovery and fraud investigation when the business needs your mastery.

Qualifications
• Professional Background: Should have at least 5 years of experience successfully leading a security team in a guard services/physical security company or have 5 years of experience as an ex-commissioned service personnel supervisor—either in the military, police, or paramilitary.
• Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Criminology, Psychology, Criminal Justice, or a related field.
• Certification: You hold a recognized security certification such as CPP, PSP, or CPO.
• Integrity: A clean criminal record and the ability to pass a comprehensive background check are essential.
• Language Culture: You speak the local dialects of the major tribes in your assigned region, allowing you to connect with the community.
• Good experience working with automated security systems like CCTV cameras, burglary alarm systems, etc.

About You
• You are a Hero: You are driven by mastery and the desire to protect others. People count on you to come through when things get tough.
• You are Relatable: You don’t hide behind technical jargon. You communicate clearly and build trust with everyone, from the security guards to the executive team.
• You are Proactive: You don’t wait for things to go wrong. You have the "Creator" spirit, always looking for better ways to secure our future.
• You are composed: In high-pressure situations, you are the calmest person in the room. You lead with facts, not emotions.

What Success Looks Like
• Zero Preventable Incidents: Our regional offices remain safe, secure, and fully operational.
• High Readiness: Security personnel are well-trained and respond to drills or real-world events with 100% precision.
• Strong Community Ties: You have built a network of local stakeholders that helps Moniepoint navigate regional risks effectively.
• Operational Excellence: Security technology is 100% functional, and documentation is factual, honest, and actionable.

What we can offer you
• Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all voices are heard, and we look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
• Learning: We have a learning- and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training.
• Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, and an annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process
• A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
• An interview with the hiring team.
• An interview with a member of our executive team.

Moniepoint Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.
