jobs.title: Regional Security Officer (South West)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

What We Do

At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Job Purpose

The Regional Security Lead ensures that our mission never stops. You are the guardian of our physical spaces, ensuring that every Moniepoint office is a sanctuary where our team can build and create without worry.

By leading regional security operations, managing on-ground teams, and proactively identifying risks, you provide the stability and safety that allows financial happiness to thrive. You don't just react to incidents; you build the systems that prevent them.

Key Responsibilities
• Safeguard our People and Assets: Lead the implementation of security policies that protect our team, offices, and equipment across your region.
• Master the Environment: Conduct regular security assessments to spot vulnerabilities and design innovative strategies to reduce risk.
• Lead the Front Line: Supervise and mentor private security guards and armed police personnel, ensuring they perform their duties with mastery and respect.
• Build Strong Alliances: Act as our primary liaison with law enforcement and emergency services, ensuring we always have a seat at the table during emergencies.
• Investigate and Solve: Lead the response to security breaches and accidents, providing clear, factual reports that help us learn and improve.
• Empower the Team: Design and deliver training programs that equip our security personnel and employees with life-saving protocols.
• Innovate for Safety: Stay ahead of security trends and technology (like CCTV and access control) to keep our regional operations modern and resilient.
• Support Business Resilience: Provide expert guidance on asset recovery and fraud investigation when the business needs your mastery.

Qualifications
• Professional Background: Should have at least 5 years of experience successfully leading a security team in a guard services/physical security company or have 5 years of experience as an ex-commissioned service personnel supervisor—either in the military, police, or paramilitary.
• Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Criminology, Psychology, Criminal Justice, or a related field.
• Certification: You hold a recognized security certification such as CPP, PSP, or CPO.
• Integrity: A clean criminal record and the ability to pass a comprehensive background check are essential.
• Language Culture: You speak the local dialects of the major tribes in your assigned region, allowing you to connect with the community.
• Good experience working with automated security systems like CCTV cameras, burglary alarm systems, etc.

About You

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Partnerships (Listing & Tokenization)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

 

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

 

Role Overview

OKX is seeking an experienced and highly capable Senior Manager to develop OKX's partnerships with token projects and on-chain ecosystems globally. The core responsibilities of this role include: (1) partnering with high-potential early-stage blockchain and token projects through launch support and reward campaigns, (2) developing partnerships with tokenization platforms and other key players for RWA projects, and (3) expanding the ecosystem partnership around X Layer, OKX's on-chain network.

 

This position requires strategic judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and strong execution - combining market insight, professionalism, and cross-functional leadership.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Source, evaluate, and negotiate collaboration opportunities with high-potential early-stage Web3 projects across sectors (Web3, AI, infrastructure, etc.) and partnerships for RWA initiatives, owning end-to-end project and relationship management, and coordinating with internal teams on follow-on opportunities across OKX's ecosystem.
• Drive ecosystem growth on X Layer by building collaborations and overseeing deployments with partners (e.g. activation programs and campaigns).
• Contribute to the exploration and launch of new initiatives and collaboration formats aligned with team goals, working with Product, Operations, and Legal to build processes.
• Maintain a high standard of project quality, due diligence, and compliance awareness across all engagements.
• Research and track competitor moves and market trends across launch platforms and tokenization projects globally, translating findings into strategy and new initiatives.

 

What We Look For In You
• 5+ years of experience in business development, launch/growth platforms, venture investment, or partnership management within crypto and/or traditional finance.
• Demonstrated ability to identify, structure, and execute high-stakes collaborations with global partners and stakeholders.
• Solid crypto-native foundation: strong understanding of token economics, project evaluation, onchain ecosystems, and market dynamics.
• Understanding of tokenization and the RWA space, and genuine interest in how real world assets are brought onchain; direct RWA or tokenization experience is a strong plus.
• Ability to operate in new and evolving business lines — comfortable with ambiguity, quick to learn unfamiliar domains, and able to build processes from scratch.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to engage both Web3 founders and global institutional partners.
• Fluent in English and Chinese (Mandarin required, Cantonese is a plus).
• High level of integrity, professionalism, compliance awareness, and sound judgment.

 

Why Join OKX
• Contribute directly to one of the most strategic and visible teams within OKX, at the frontier where crypto innovation meets traditional assets coming onchain.
• Help define new collaboration models and asset ecosystems from the ground up, with real infrastructure and resources behind them
• Work with a high-performing global team shaping OKX's next generation of Web3 and RWA initiatives.

 

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Disclaimer: Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About us:
Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.
The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.
Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.
As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies. 

About the Role
We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to build and lead security at Airtm, reporting to the VP of Engineering. You'll own the security posture of the systems that move people's money across borders, from application code and cloud infrastructure to identity, vendors, and incident response. You'll set the strategy, build the team and the practices around it, and stay hands-on enough to make the hard technical calls yourself.
Our stack is TypeScript/Node.js microservices on Kubernetes (AWS), with React front ends, organized into autonomous product teams. Security here works as an enabler embedded in how teams ship, not a gate at the end. AI-assisted development is core to how we build, so you'll be expected to use AI tooling fluently for security work, and to define how we adopt AI agents and LLM-powered systems safely.

Key Responsibilities
Security Strategy & Roadmap: Define and own a risk-based security strategy for a financial platform; prioritize investment by real threat and business impact, and report on posture to executive leadership and the board
Incident Response: Own detection, response, and recovery for security incidents; maintain runbooks, lead incidents and post-incident reviews, coordinate with forensics, legal, and communications, and turn every incident into lasting improvements
Application Security: Embed security into the SDLC with threat modeling, secure design reviews, SAST/DAST/dependency scanning, and secure coding standards that engineers actually adopt
Cloud & Infrastructure Security: Partner with Infrastructure to harden AWS, Kubernetes, networking, and CI/CD pipelines; own IAM and least-privilege access, secrets management, and security in Terraform and GitOps workflows
Detection & Monitoring: Build the detection and alerting capability that finds malicious activity early, across application, infrastructure, and access logs, and tune it to keep signal high
Crypto & Key Security: Own the security model for key management, wallet and custody operations, and the blockchain integrations our payment rails depend on
Fraud & Account Security Collaboration: Work with Product and Risk teams on account takeover, abuse, and transaction-level controls
AI Security: Define guardrails for AI coding tools and for AI agents and LLM pipelines we build or deploy, including agent permissions, prompt injection, data exposure, and tool-access boundaries
Compliance & Assurance: Own our security compliance program (SOC 2 and related frameworks), audits, and customer and partner security questionnaires, aiming to make compliance a byproduct of good engineering rather than a separate burden
Vendor & Third-Party Risk: Run vendor risk assessments and security due diligence for partners, investors, and acquirers
Vulnerability & Patch Management: Establish clear SLAs by severity and keep remediation moving across teams without becoming a bottleneck
Team Building & Mentorship: Hire, grow, and lead security engineers; build a security champions network inside product teams; raise the security bar across all of engineering
On-Call & Escalation: Participate in and help shape the security escalation path for production incidents

Required Qualifications
8+ years of experience in information or application security, including 3+ years leading security teams or functions
Demonstrated experience leading incident response for real, high-stakes incidents, including coordination with external forensics and counsel
Strong knowledge of AWS security and Kubernetes security (IAM, network segmentation, RBAC, secrets management, container and image security)
Hands-on experience with application security in a microservices environment: threat modeling, secure code review, and dependency and supply-chain risk
Experience building detection and monitoring capabilities (SIEM, log analysis, alerting; Datadog or similar)
Experience owning or leading a compliance program such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI-DSS, including audit cycles
Ability to read and review TypeScript/Node.js code and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform); you don't need to be a full-time developer, but you need to be credible with engineers
Experience securing CI/CD pipelines and software supply chains
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) for security work, and a clear point of view on the risks of AI-generated code and agentic systems
Strong communication skills; able to explain risk to engineers, executives, regulators, and customers, and to write policies and runbooks people follow
Sound judgment under pressure; able to make fast, defensible calls with incomplete information
Nice to Have
Background in fintech, payments, remittance, or crypto environments, especially key management, custody, and blockchain security
Experience with fraud, account takeover, and abuse prevention
Experience securing AI agents and LLM-powered systems in production (prompt injection defenses, tool-permission models, eval and red-teaming approaches)
Hands-on offensive security experience (penetration testing, red teaming) or running bug bounty programs
Experience with cloud-native security tooling (CSPM, runtime protection, policy-as-code such as OPA/Kyverno)
Familiarity with regulatory requirements for money transmission and financial services across multiple jurisdictions
Security certifications (CISSP, CISM, OSCP, AWS Security Specialty)
Experience supporting investor, buyer, or enterprise due diligence on security posture
Experience building a security function from a small base in a fast-growing engineering org

What We Look For
Beyond the technical skills, we're looking for a leader who:
Takes ownership of security outcomes, stays calm and clear in an incident, and communicates early when risk is rising
Treats security as a partnership with engineers, building guardrails and paved roads rather than gates and tickets
Has good judgment about risk, knowing when to stop a release, when a small risk is worth the speed, and how to explain the tradeoff to the business
Improves the team around them, through mentorship, champions, and making secure choices the easy ones
Collaborates across boundaries, working with Product, Infrastructure, Legal, Compliance, and Support as one team
Knows when (and when not) to lean on AI tooling, and brings rigor to how we adopt it safely

jobs.title: Accountant Partnerships Manager
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Partnerships at Brex

Sales is the growth engine at Brex. We bring in new customers, expand existing relationships, and drive the company’s bottom line. With unlimited territories and uncapped opportunity, your ambition sets the ceiling. We win together, celebrate often, and reward performance. If you want to sell a category-defining product with real ownership, this is your team.

What you’ll do

Brex’s Accounting Channel is undergoing exponential growth, and we are looking for a partner manager to accelerate the team. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of shaping and expanding our market presence, driving a critical engine of our company's success. We're on the hunt for a dynamic professional who excels at forging powerful alliances in the accounting and OCFO ecosystems. You’ll be responsible for building strong relationships, cultivating partnerships from the ground up, seamlessly integrating new partners into our ecosystem, and consistently hitting targets by transforming these connections into a steady stream of client referrals. If you have a history of exceeding expectations and a passion for creating mutually beneficial business relationships, this could be your chance to make a significant impact in a fast growing environment.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Identify, cultivate, and deepen relationships with high-potential accounting firms
• Craft and implement tailored go-to-market strategies for each partner
• Facilitate smooth onboarding of new partners and their teams
• Drive client referrals from our accounting partners to fuel revenue growth for Brex
• Serve as a product expert, articulating our value proposition to partners
• Be the connective tissue for partners to the Brex ecosystem
• Work cross-functionally across marketing, growth, direct sales, and product engineering to drive co-marketing opportunities, onboard new clients, and inform our product roadmap
• Conduct regular performance reviews with key partners
• Identify and build relationships with multiple stakeholders within accounting firms
• Become an expert in Brex's product, features, and workflows and augment the voice of our Accounting Partners

Requirements
• 3+ years in a closing sales or partnerships role
• Demonstrated track record of consistently hitting targets and quotas
• Ability to identify client needs through thoughtful questioning, active listening, and analysis; including but not limited to shared mutual referral goals, enablement sessions, and MBR/QBRs where necessary
• Ability to deliver tailored, consultative solutions that align with partner’s needs and business goals
• Ability to evaluate partnership performance, identify areas for optimization, and implement data-driven solutions
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with excellent listening skills
• Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment
• Proven ability to build trust and credibility with internal and external stakeholders.
• Passion for community events and activations with partners

Bonus points
• Experience in collaborating with accounting firms
• Accounting background (CPA certification or relevant industry experience is a plus)

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $135,600 - $169,500. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

What you’ll do

As a member of the Account Protection Team within Risk and Credit, you will help protect Brex and its customers from fraud, financial crime, and account takeover risk. You will solve complex risk problems alongside a high-performing team while delivering a thoughtful, clear, and customer-centered experience.

The ideal candidate has experience with B2B customer communications and fraud operations, including KYC, terms-of-service adherence, enhanced identity verification, regulatory and reputational risk evaluation, and account takeover mitigation. You will own customer communications related to fraud and financial crime prevention, balancing risk mitigation with a strong customer experience.

This team operates between 6:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. PT. Candidates must be available to work scheduled hours within this coverage window.

Where you’ll work

This role will be fully remote and based in Vancouver. There will be some in-person training required in our Vancouver office.

Responsibilities
• Access systems and document actions taken to service customers efficiently and accurately.
• Determine appropriate actions under established procedures to protect Brex and customer assets; partner with management on complex cases.
• Communicate professionally with customers, merchants, financial institutions, and other parties to obtain information or documentation needed to assess potential fraud.
• Support cross-functional teams, including CX, Fraud Operations, KYC, and Cash Operations, to ensure appropriate action is taken on high-risk accounts.
• Speak with fraud victims using appropriate, empathetic talking points while safeguarding both the customer and Brex.
• Review and assess the validity of customer documentation.
• Place and receive calls escalated by cross-functional teams or team leads.
• Partner effectively across teams to resolve complex issues and escalated situations.
• Contribute to projects and initiatives that reduce fraud-related complaints and create a more seamless customer and fraud-support experience.
• Adhere to applicable regulatory, legal, and internal policy requirements.
• Extract, analyze, and clearly present operational data.
• Work effectively across email, phone, and chat support channels.

Requirements
• Experience in customer experience, operations, and risk management.
• Experience in fraud prevention, account protection, or financial-crime operations.
• Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
• Sound judgment, strong attention to detail, and the ability to make consistent decisions using established procedures.
• Proactive approach and ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
• Availability to work assigned shifts between 6:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. PT.

Bonus points
• Experience in financial services, fintech, Big Four, accounting, or a related financial services environment.
• Experience in dispute resolution.
• Experience using Salesforce or comparable case-management tools.
• Extensive client-facing experience, particularly in fraud-support environments.
• Experience evaluating identity-verification or financial documentation.

Compensation

The expected pay range for this role is $28.00–$30.00 CAD per hour. Starting hourly pay depends on factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demand, and internal pay parity.

If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

What you’ll do

Payment Partner Operations owns the operational foundation for Brex’s external partner ecosystem. You’ll define how we launch, manage, measure, and improve partner programs, from operating models and SLAs to reporting, fee reconciliation, issue management, and performance reviews.

You’ll work closely with Payment Partnerships, Operations, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and external partners to build scalable, well-controlled programs that deliver reliable outcomes for customers and the business.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our São Paulo office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Define and own the operating model for partner management, including processes, decision rights, governance, documentation, and escalation paths.
• Establish partner SLAs, KPIs, reporting cadences, and performance-review mechanisms; hold internal and external stakeholders accountable to them.
• Build reporting that provides clear visibility into partner performance, operational health, volume, quality, incidents, risks, and opportunities.
• Own fee reconciliation and related controls, ensuring partner invoices, contractual terms, payment calculations, and internal records are accurate and resolved on time.
• Lead operational readiness for new partners, products, workflows, and program changes, including requirements, launch plans, testing, training, and post-launch monitoring.
• Manage partner incidents and escalations, coordinate root-cause analysis, and drive durable corrective actions.
• Identify process gaps and automation opportunities that improve partner experience, reduce manual work, and strengthen control quality.
• Partner with Finance, Legal, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Partnerships to resolve complex issues and translate partner needs into scalable operational solutions.
• Create executive-ready updates that synthesize performance, risks, financial impacts, and recommended actions.

Requirements
• 3+ years of experience in partner operations, payments operations, financial operations, vendor management, or a related role in fintech, banking, or another regulated environment (ideally 1+ years of direct partner experience).
• English proficiency/fluency, both written and speaking (note: interviews will be conducted in English)
• Demonstrated experience building operating programs, not just managing established workflows.
• Strong experience defining SLAs, KPIs, and governance structures and using them to improve external-partner performance.
• Experience with fee, invoice, or financial reconciliation processes, including investigation and resolution of discrepancies.
• Strong analytical skills and comfort using spreadsheets, data tools, SQL, or similar tools to build reporting and identify trends.
• Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior internal and external partners.
• Sound judgment, strong attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, high-stakes situations.
• A builder mindset with a bias toward scalable processes, clear ownership, and AI-centric automation.
• All applications must be submitted in English

Bonus Points
• Experience in payment rails, banking partnerships, card networks, fintech infrastructure, or money movement.
• Experience managing third-party vendors or regulated financial-services partners.
• Experience with audit-ready controls, compliance requirements, and contractual-performance obligations.
• Experience applying AI or automation to reconciliation, reporting, quality assurance, or operational workflows.

jobs.title: Field Credit Officer (Edo)
jobs.description:
About Us: 

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

Job Title: Field Credit Officer 

Reports to: Regional Credit Manager 

Employment Type: Outsourced 

Work Mode: Onsite

About this role: 

As a Field Credit Officer, you would be saddled with the duty of onboarding and managing businesses that would access our credit products. You would be tasked with growing your loan portfolio while maintaining profitability by ensuring that all loans are repaid as and when due. As a result, you would play a vital role in the assessment of these businesses during their credit application and leverage innovative tools we have developed to help you monitor their performance during the course of the loan.

You would also be responsible for making deductions from several information sources about the 5Cs of credit, with capacity, character, and capital as major priorities. Make recommendations to management before, during, and after the disbursement of a loan facility as to the best actions to be taken, considering several economic factors.

Responsibilities:
• Identify and onboard viable businesses within your assigned geographical area to open business accounts with Moniepoint
• Engage customers to ensure optimal usage of accounts to allow them to qualify for access to credit
• Review and approve (or decline) loan requests by thoroughly analyzing all the data available
• Embark on physical visitation to potential borrowers’ business places for evaluation of business books, taking inventory and turnover into consideration
• Meet gross loan portfolio targets and portfolio profit targets by maintaining a healthy number of loan customers while ensuring that all loans in portfolio are performing
• Monitor active loan portfolio to ensure continued use of business account and loan repayment performance
• Perform all other credit-related functions as may be assigned by a supervisor 

Experience Background:
• Minimum of an OND in any business-related discipline
• Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a sales role for credit products in a financial institution

Your goal is to raise financial operating efficiency and data quality, give management reliable BI and actionable insight, and help build the financial systems and internal controls the company needs as it scales.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build, not just coordinate. You should be comfortable with ambiguity, complexity, and senior stakeholders.

• Own financial BI and decision support. Build a unified financial and operational metrics framework with consistent definitions and dashboards covering revenue, cost, profit, budget execution, cash flow, and operational efficiency.

• Improve data quality and control. Strengthen reconciliation, exception handling, and data lineage so that definitions are consistent and key numbers are traceable.

About The Opportunity

Our mission is to drive OKX’s trading volume and revenue by building growth products and campaigns that attract users, convert them into traders, and keep them engaged.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own growth initiatives across user acquisition, new-user campaigns, trading campaigns, and user reactivation. You will combine a mature growth approach, crypto industry knowledge, and strong hands-on AI capabilities to deliver measurable business results. Using AI effectively is a core expectation of this role, from uncovering opportunities and developing product solutions to improving campaign operations.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Own Growth Strategy and Business Results
• Define and execute the product roadmap for growth campaigns to increase platform trading volume and revenue.
• Identify growth opportunities across acquisition, activation, trading conversion, retention, and reactivation.
• Prioritize initiatives based on business impact, user needs, and implementation effort.
• Build and Scale Growth Products
• Design acquisition, new-user, trading, and reactivation campaigns that encourage users to register, fund their accounts, start trading, and develop sustained trading habits.
• Build reusable campaign, task, and incentive platform capabilities to support efficient execution across global markets.
• Partner with Trading and regional teams to align growth initiatives with relevant products and local user needs.
• Use AI to Improve Product Development and Growth Operations
• Integrate AI into daily workflows across user and market research, data analysis, product planning, prototyping, and campaign operations.
• Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows and automate repetitive tasks to accelerate delivery and improve output quality.
• Identify opportunities to embed AI capabilities into growth products and internal platforms, working with technical teams to bring them to life.
• Evaluate the accuracy and business value of AI outputs, and share effective practices to improve the team’s capabilities.
• Continuously Improve Growth Performance
• Use business data and user feedback to identify issues and improve product and campaign performance.
• Evaluate contributions to trading volume, revenue, and retention while managing incentive costs and improving ROI.
• Lead Cross-Functional Execution
• Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Trading, Risk, Compliance, and regional teams to deliver growth initiatives from concept through launch and iteration.
• Align stakeholders on priorities, business goals, and dependencies to drive complex projects to completion.
• Bring Industry and Market Insights into Product Decisions
• Understand crypto users’ needs, trading behavior, and motivations for participating in campaigns.
• Monitor market developments and competitor growth strategies to inform product decisions and identify new opportunities.

What We Look For In You
• More than 3 years of relevant experience in growth product management, with hands-on ownership of acquisition campaigns, new-user campaigns, trading campaigns, or related growth products.
• Strong hands-on proficiency with AI tools is required. You regularly use AI to solve real business problems and can demonstrate concrete examples of how it has improved your productivity, decision-making, or product outcomes.
• The ability to build and improve AI-assisted workflows, break complex problems into actionable steps, critically evaluate AI outputs, and apply sound judgment to the results.
• A proven track record of business impact, with measurable improvements in trading volume, revenue, user activation, or retention.
• A mature growth methodology and practical experience, with the ability to identify opportunities, develop effective solutions, and continuously improve business results.
• Broad experience across companies and business environments, with the ability to adapt proven practices to new contexts and execute at scale.
• Strong familiarity with the crypto industry, including centralized exchanges, trading products, user behavior, and common growth mechanics.
• Strong familiarity with OKX, including its core products, trading experience, user journeys, and competitive positioning.
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data and user insights into clear product decisions.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience leading complex projects across teams.
• High learning velocity, strong ownership, and a proactive approach to learning and applying new AI capabilities.

Nice-To-Haves
• Direct experience building growth products at a crypto exchange or trading platform.
• Experience scaling acquisition, new-user incentive, or trading campaigns across multiple markets.
• Experience balancing growth incentives with profitability, risk controls, and long-term user value.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.description:
PayPayについて

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50か国の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_

我々は自分たちの想像を超える未来を創るためにあえて明確なビジョンは必要ないと考えています。常にDay1であるスタンスを忘れずに、誰もが想像できないようなビジョン（未来）を実現していくのがPayPayです。
この壮大なビジョンに前向きに取り組み、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、自ら課題発見し、周囲と協力して新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼財務戦略部の紹介
財務戦略部では、M A、資本政策、資本市場対応などを通じて、PayPayの持続的な成長を財務面から支えています。
メンバーおよびマネージャーは投資銀行出身者で構成される少数精鋭のチームです。論点整理やアウトプットの品質に高い基準を持ちながら、一人ひとりが案件全体を主体的にリードできる環境があります。フラットな組織で、裁量を持って業務に取り組めます。

▼募集の背景
PayPayはNASDAQ市場への上場を果たし、さらなる事業拡大・成長に向けて、インオーガニック成長の実現と、それを支える資本政策の重要性が一層高まっています。
M A・投資案件の推進や資本市場対応を、機動的かつ継続的に推進できる体制の強化に向けて、本ポジションでは、M A、資本政策、資本市場対応において、社内外の関係者を巻き込みながらプロジェクトを主体的に推進いただける方を募集しています。

【具体的な業務内容】

PayPayの財務本部において、財務戦略（資本政策・資本市場・投資等）に関する業務をご担当いただきます。
※以下には、将来的に担当いただく可能性のある業務も含みます。
※週2回程度、東京オフィス（四谷）への出社があります。
• 資本政策の立案・実行
• 株式の新規発行・売出し、増減資、譲渡等に関する業務
• 資本市場調達（CP・社債）の企画・運営・管理、および格付機関対応

• 法律・会計・税務アドバイザー、証券会社などの金融機関、格付機関との折衝・調整

▼本ポジションの魅力
• 一気通貫で推進：
少数精鋭のチームだからこそ、業務の一部分に限定されず、案件全体を見渡しながら主体的に推進することができます。
• 上場企業×成長フェーズ：
NASDAQ上場企業としての資本市場対応に加え、事業拡大に伴うM A・投資など、企業価値向上に直結する財務戦略に携わることができます。

jobs.description:

Job

jobs.title: Principal Implementation Manager - Wise Platform Verification
jobs.description:
About The Team

The Global KYC and Onboarding squad works to make onboarding into Wise safe, compliant, efficient, and scalable. Within that squad, Wise Platform Verification focuses on verification for Wise Platform partners and their customers.

Wise Platform Verification supports customers who access Wise through our partners. The domain spans different partner models, markets and operational routes. Parts of it are still difficult to measure and rely on fragmented or manual processes. This role will help the team build a reliable view of performance, identify the highest-value problems and establish better ways of working. When these flows are unclear or manual, partners can face delays, customers can hit avoidable friction, operations teams carry unnecessary work, and controls become harder to audit.

The team is building a more scalable verification model for Wise Platform: explicit requirements, better control monitoring, clearer operational flows, stronger automation, and partner-ready processes that can grow with Wise Platform.

 

About The Role

We are looking for an Implementation Manager to bring analytical rigour and process discipline to Wise Platform Verification. You will use data to understand how verification works across partners, identify the biggest sources of friction and operational cost, and lead improvements from diagnosis through implementation and measurement.

Your mission is to turn complex partner-verification problems into measurable implementation plans, trusted metrics, clear operating models, repeatable rollout playbooks, and automation opportunities. You will work across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Product Compliance, Risk, Partner Due Diligence and Operations teams, regional teams, and partner-facing teams to make sure verification changes launch safely, work operationally, and are measured after release.

This is not a coordinator-only role. You will create structure where it does not exist yet: map processes, define KPIs, identify root causes, challenge data quality, build launch scorecards, design operating cadences, and help move manual workflows toward automation.

 

What you will own
• Map Wise Platform verification processes end to end, including partner models, control triggers, evidence flows, operational routing, RFIs, exceptions, and recovery paths.
• Identify process and automation opportunities that reduce manual review, avoidable partner RFIs, misrouting, operational rework, and partner/customer disruption.
• Define implementation plans for high-priority verification changes, including scope, owners, milestones, risks, launch gates, runbooks, training, adoption, monitoring, and escalation paths.
• Build trusted KPI definitions, dashboards, launch scorecards, and weekly/monthly performance narratives that help the team make decisions.
• Partner with Analytics and Data Science to validate data quality, segment impact, size populations, measure outcomes, and distinguish true performance changes from reporting or process artifacts.
• Partner with Engineering to turn operational needs into implementable requirements while understanding technical constraints, dependencies, rollout paths, and migration risks.
• Partner with Product Compliance, Risk, and Ops to make sure process changes meet control objectives, remain auditable, and work for the teams reviewing cases.
• Support automation and process migration work, including moving fragile manual processes and legacy workflows toward scalable product or platform patterns.
• Lead root-cause analysis for operational issues and partner-impacting verification pain points, then track fixes to closure and prevent recurrence through standards, monitoring, and documentation.

 

What success looks like in the first 6-12 months:
• WPV has clearer process maps and ownership for the highest-impact partner verification workflows.
• High-priority process changes launch with implementation plans, metrics, launch gates, runbooks, monitoring, and adoption tracking.
• Manual review and partner RFI pain points are sized, prioritised, and converted into a practical automation or process-improvement backlog.
• Partner Due Diligence, Operations, and partner-facing teams have clearer routing, context, escalation paths, and feedback loops.
• The team can trust its core operating metrics and use them for prioritisation, launch readiness, and post-launch learning.
• Operational incidents and recurring process issues lead to documented root causes, owners, fixes, and prevention mechanisms.
• Legacy process or service ownership issues are mapped and sequenced with clear migration or handover plans.

 

This role gives you the opportunity to:
• Work on one of the most important scaling problems for Wise Platform.
• Build the operating system for partner verification across product, engineering, compliance, risk, data, and operations.
• Improve how partners and their customers move through verification, while keeping controls robust and auditable.
• Turn manual and fragmented workflows into measurable, repeatable, automatable processes.
• Become an expert in partner verification, operational automation, risk controls, and platform-scale implementation.

jobs.title: Director of Analytics - Customer Support
jobs.description:
Customer Support is the largest customer-facing area in Servicing. It is also where cost to serve, AI and automation, and the alignment between Operations and Product meet. We're looking for a Head of Customer Service Analytics who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders. You will lead all analytics for Wise's customer support operation: CS Ops, CS Product, and WFM and capacity planning.

You'll be accountable for the CS metric tree and for measuring the impact of automation and AI. You'll also build a team that improves CS cost and customer outcomes together, rather than trading one off against the other. Analytics at Wise is a core leadership engine, not a service desk. You'll be a strategic peer to CS Operations and CS Product leadership. You'll co-author OKRs, broker trade-offs between Ops and Product, and be the analytical voice in the room.

You'll lead a team of around 9 analysts and WFM specialists across London, Tallinn and Budapest, and build its first layer of analytics leads (AL2). You'll sit within the Ops & Mitigation analytics leadership group, as part of the 86-strong Servicing Analytics community and a wider community of 150+ analysts at Wise.

This is an AL3 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
• Own the CS metric tree: contact rate → channel → first response → resolution → CSAT / repeat contact → cost per contact. It should roll up cleanly into Servicing's Cost and Convenience toplines.
• Make sure every CS metric has one definition and one owner in the metric store, and retire conflicting legacy dashboards.
• Set and govern CS targets with Ops and Product leadership, so we can show whether targets are being hit, not just set them.
• Own impact measurement for AI agents, self-serve and contact deflection: addressable volume, actual deflection, cost saved, and the effect on CSAT, repeat contact and quality.
• Run the experimentation and causal-inference approach for CS. Use A/B tests for customer-facing changes. Use diff-in-diff, RDD or synthetic control for ops rollouts.
• Keep automation quality trustworthy through calibration and drift monitoring on quality scoring.
• Own CS capacity planning and forecasting with WFM: demand forecasts, staffing models, SLA and wait-time trade-offs, and regional and outsourcing mix.
• Hold the three-way trade-off of customer outcomes, operational cost and team capacity, and make it explicit in every channel and staffing decision.
• Lead, coach and grow the team, and build its first AL2 layer. Set the bar for analytical quality and stakeholder impact.
• Own the CS analytics headcount plan and hiring. Sit on Servicing Analytics leadership and hiring panels.
• Shift analyst time from recurring reporting towards decision-driving work, by moving reporting into the metric store and self-serve.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

For everyone, everywhere.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
The team you will join: Fraud Risk Team

Join the Fraud Risk team, where we are dedicated to preventing fraud before it happens and keeping Wise customers safe in real time. Our mission is to stop fraudulent activity at the point of attempt by running instant checks on transfers and customer profiles, making accurate risk decisions with minimal friction. We build scalable, low-latency systems, improve our detection and decisioning tooling, and partner closely with fraud specialists to continuously raise the bar on prevention using data, automation, and AI-driven signals to reduce losses and protect legitimate customers.

Our vision:
• Create an automated, real-time fraud prevention experience that blocks bad activity while keeping genuine customers moving.
• Build fast, reliable risk decisioning capabilities for transfers and profiles, optimised for accuracy, latency, and scale.
• Foster a strong partnership between fraud prevention specialists and the product/engineering team to translate expert knowledge into effective controls.
• Use AI-driven detection and decisioning, and work closely with Data Scientists to productionise models and signals, improving precision, reducing false positives, and lowering operational costs.

What will you be working on?
• Real-World Impact: Shape and build the systems that prevent fraud and scams through real-time transfer and profile decisioning.
• Technical Ownership: Own the technical roadmap and deliverables of key projects in our prevention domain, delivering them predictably and with clear customer impact.
• Domain & Platform Evolution: Build deep expertise across our technical and fraud domains, driving continuous improvements in latency, reliability, and decision quality across our decisioning platform.
• System Health: Address technical debt, keep risk within appetite, and enforce Wise's engineering best practices (observability, security, Kafka/DB usage, testing).
• Engineering Leadership: Multiply team impact by mentoring engineers, sharing knowledge to eliminate single points of failure, leading onboarding, and interviewing future talent.
• Cross-Team Collaboration: Contribute beyond the team through guilds and cross-team engineering efforts to reduce duplicated work across fraud and risk domains.

Overview of the Current Team: The Fraud Risk team is a passionate group of prevention-focused crime fighters based in Budapest and Tallinn. We're a mix of engineers and fraud specialists committed to making Wise a safer platform through fast, accurate decisions on transfers and customer profiles. Our collaborative environment encourages innovation, ownership, and teamwork, making it an exciting place to work on cutting-edge solutions in fraud prevention.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I - Product Eligibility

Implementation at Brex

Implementation transforms new customers into power users. We lead the onboarding experience for companies adopting Brex Empower, helping them shift from outdated processes to a modern, employee-first approach. It’s a role that blends customer empathy, project management, technical expertise, process design, and change management. We take personal ownership of our customers' long-term success, and we set customers up thoroughly so they can be with ‘Brex for life’. As strategic advisors, we build trust, drive solutions with tenacity, deliver results fast, and work cross-functionally to make adoption seamless for customers.

What you’ll do

The Implementation Consultant role on the Commercial team supports our small to mid-sized customers through their onboarding journey, helping them get up and running on Brex with guidance and structured support. As an initiator on the team, you’ll develop your product knowledge, sharpen your project management skills, and build the foundation for a career in implementation consulting.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Organize and facilitate customer meetings by managing agendas, capturing notes, tracking action items, and setting clear expectations throughout the implementation lifecycle.
• Support customers in understanding their business needs and configuring Brex to address them, translating basic requirements into product configurations with guidance.
• Manage straightforward stakeholder communication and assist with timelines and deliverables to keep implementations on track.
• Assist with spend migrations and support end user adoption during deployment, helping customers feel confident and prepared for go-live.
• Introduce integration concepts to customers, provide relevant guides for connecting Brex with external systems, and engage Technical Consultants for more complex integration or troubleshooting needs.
• Coordinate handoffs between AE/CSE and CSM, providing basic documentation to ensure continuity of the client relationship.
• Deliver standard change management templates to customers in preparation for go-live, and lead training sessions with supervision as needed.
• Collaborate within the Implementation team and contribute feedback on the client experience when asked, supporting process improvements over time.

Requirements
• 4+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, ideally within a SaaS organization or a consulting firm that delivers SaaS services.
• Some exposure to project coordination or structured implementation work.
• Strong communication skills, both with customers and internal stakeholders.
• Comfort working across technical and non-technical workstreams with guidance.
• Organized and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of urgency in driving tasks to completion.
• Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally to resolve issues.

Bonus points
• Experience in Financial, Expense Management, or ERP software.
• Familiarity with any of the following domains: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Billing, Expense Management, Travel, Procurement, or Corporate Card programs.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $119,328 - $149,160 USD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. jobs.title: Lead, Compliance Quality Assurance
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Job Title: Lead, Compliance Quality Assurance

Department: Regulatory Compliance 

Reports to: Head, Compliance Quality Assurance

About this role 
As the Lead, Compliance Quality Assurance, you are the tactical backbone of our quality assessment framework. You will spearhead the day-to-day operations of our QA Assessor team, transforming quality assurance into a catalyst for operational excellence.

Through rigorous standard enforcement and precision-based calibration, you will ensure that Moniepoint’s critical divisions including KYC/Due Diligence, AML, LEA, Transaction Monitoring, and Fraud consistently meet SLAs and regulatory policy standards. Acting as the final line of defense against compliance drift, you are dedicated to maintaining flawless execution, high-velocity accuracy, and total regulatory integrity across all operational touchpoints.

Responsibilities
• Supervise, train, and manage QA Assessors, ensuring consistent grading and execution through regular file calibration exercises.
• Lead the secondary review process across the 'Six Pillars' (AML/Transaction Monitoring, Regulatory Control/LEA, and Forensic Fraud), identifying vulnerabilities in accuracy, speed, and regulatory compliance.
• Maintain a centralized Compliance Defect Log and translate QA findings into actionable weekly feedback for operational Team Leads to drive continuous improvement.
• Perform deep-dive analyses on compliance misses to differentiate between system threshold errors and investigator oversight, recommending necessary process adjustments.
• Assist in coordinating internal and external audits by providing evidence of QA testing integrity and ensuring high-quality, audit-ready data. 

Experience Background
• 2–4 years of progressive experience in Compliance QA, Financial Crime Investigation, or EDD/CDD within a FinTech, or commercial bank.
• Must have at least 2 years of experience in a supervisory or team lead capacity.
• Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. 

Skills Competencies
• Advanced proficiency in Compliance tools and data analysis using SQL and Excel.
• Comprehensive understanding of Nigerian regulatory frameworks (AML/CFT), instant payment fraud, card/POS fraud typologies, and legal protocols for handling Law Enforcement Agency (LEA) and CDD, EDD and Customer screening.
• Professional certification such as DCP, CAMS, CFE, or ICA International Diploma is an added advantage. 

What success looks like in this role
• Maintenance of flawless execution, high-velocity accuracy, and total regulatory integrity across all operational touchpoints.
• Consistent meeting of SLAs and regulatory policy standards across KYC/Due Diligence, AML, LEA, Transaction Monitoring, and Fraud divisions.
• Prevention of compliance drift through rigorous standard enforcement and precision-based calibration.
• Transformation of quality assurance processes into a true catalyst for operational excellence. 

Why join us
• Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.
• Fully remote work culture and support for professional development.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

As a Senior Business Analytics Manager, you'll use data to strengthen Compliance across three priorities: Trusted Data, Growth Enablement, and Proactive Risk Prevention. You'll help ensure that regulatory reports, audit responses, and legal evidence are reliable, traceable, and reusable, while transforming customer, transaction, and financial data into actionable insights.

 

You'll partner with Compliance, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Business teams to build trusted data foundations, automate recurring requests, and create metrics that reveal operational effectiveness and compliance friction. You'll also conduct root cause and control-gap analysis, help remove compliance-related business roadblocks, support market and licensing initiatives, and surface risks before they are identified externally.

 

What You'll Be Doing:
• Facilitate and govern internal and external data requests across OKX global entities, ensuring timely, first-time-right delivery for regulatory reporting, audits and exams, and legal evidence.
• Build and maintain request records, evidence and definition libraries, and data-governance records to improve data reliability, traceability, and reusability.
• Productize high-frequency recurring requests into automated or self-service data pipelines, improving turnaround time and cost efficiency.
• Build and automate Compliance dashboards based on North Star metrics as well as input and guardrail metrics to provide transparency into operational effectiveness, customer and platform risk, and business friction.
• Conduct deep-dive, root-cause, and control-bypass analyses to proactively identify and prevent compliance risks.
• Partner with Compliance, Business, Marketing, and local market teams to remove compliance-related roadblocks in current operations and support new markets, licences, applications, and market-access assessments.
• Collaborate across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Finance to continuously improve data pipelines and analytics products.

 

What We Look For In You:
• Relevant working experience of at least 7 years. (must)
• Proficiency in database management systems like MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or PostgreSQL. (must)
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. (must)
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. (must)
• Hands-on experience with machine learning algorithms and AI tools. (nice to have)
• Strong compliance domain knowledge, including KYC, AML, the Travel Rule, insider trading controls, and regulatory requirements across jurisdictions. (nice to have)
• Experience supporting regulatory reporting, regulatory examinations, and internal or external audits. (nice to have)
• Preferred industries are Fintech, Digital Payment, Tech companies. (nice to have)

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependents

jobs.title: Channel Sales Manager - North America
jobs.description:
Channel Sales at Wise Platform is a high-growth function. As part of our strategy to scale globally, we are expanding the team with a dedicated manager based in Austin, Texas to look at scaling the function in North America. 

Our team’s goal is to accelerate the adoption of Wise Platform by leveraging a trusted strategic channel partner ecosystem to win new deals, shorten sales cycles, and scale through channels.

As the Channel Sales Manager (NAM), you will build, scale, and operationalise our channel sales function across the region. You will focus on identifying, structuring, and nurturing relationships across top-tier core banking providers, payment platforms, system integrators (SIs), and strategic consultancies.

Key Responsibilities
• Channel Partnership Enablement & Operations: Own the governance, cross-market NAM coordination, and end-to-end lifecycle of new and existing partners - including commercial alignment, technical onboarding, contracting and launch.
• Core Banking & Vendor Ecosystem Development: Identify and build strategic relationships with top-tier core banking providers and payment platforms to create pre-integrated connectors and scalable GTM pathways.
• System Integrator & Consultancy Strategy: Build and execute go-to-market alliances with global and regional SIs and consultancies that deploy technology for banks in the broader NAM region.
• BD Alignment & Pipeline Generation: Work closely with the Business Development team - passing on qualified leads, partner-sourced opportunities, and account intelligence collected through channel activities to accelerate direct deal flows.
• Ecosystem Assessment & Immediate Impact: Take immediate ownership of active regional partner relationships and execute a comprehensive ecosystem assessment across NAM players to map out high-priority channel partners for discovery to bring into active execution..
• Commercial Metrics & KPIs: Drive key commercial success metrics, targeting partner-sourced pipeline, time-to-live through repeatable integrations, and long-term transaction volume flowing through NAM channels.

What You Will Learn & Career Growth
• High-Visibility Impact: Work directly alongside NAM commercial leads and global leadership to shape and scale the regional channel strategy from the ground up.
• Cross-Functional Exposure: Collaborate daily across BD, Pre-Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal to build scalable commercial models.
• Industry Transformation: Drive long-term impact on Wise Platform’s sales opportunities and sales cycle by shifting regional GTM from direct outreach to scalable, pre-integrated partner channels.

jobs.title: SAR Quality assurance specialist
jobs.description:
As a Quality Assurance Specialist with a focus on SAR Reporting at Wise, you are responsible for providing expert, objective assurance on the quality and effectiveness of our operational processes and controls. Your core function is to ensure risks are identified, assessed and mitigated in line with policy requirements, and to identify weaknesses, assess risk materiality and report outcomes. You will apply your risk expertise and critical thinking to conduct holistic and detailed reviews in line with agreed methodologies and KPIs, and make recommendations to drive continuous improvement. This role plays an integral part in helping Wise achieve its mission of Money WIthout Borders, through effective and value-add assurance.

This is a role for specialist who has had experience with external suspicious activity reporting, regulatory compliance and FIUs.

Activities performed on the job
• Conduct holistic, risk-based reviews using test scripts and scorecards to assess risk outcomes, compliance with global and regional policies, relevant guidance and risk appetite.
• Assess risk, materiality and root causes for each finding, providing clear and robust reasons aligned to policy compliance and/or risk mitigation.
• Participate in calibration exercises to share findings, best practice and ensure consistent, correct decisions are made across the team.
• Clearly communicate outcomes to stakeholders covering key risks, issues, root causes, and recommendations, maintaining robust records and audit trails.
• Analyse, assess and communicate emerging themes and trends, recommending opportunities for continuous improvement.
• When assigned, scope, plan, and execute root cause analysis or targeted investigations.
• Contributes to team collaboration and knowledge sharing to enhance team capabilities.
• Take a proactive approach to consistently achieving individual and team targets (KPIs, SLAs), demonstrating a strong commitment to both quality and speed. Meet deadlines, optimise processing times and take full ownership and accountability to deliver results.
• Perform additional tasks as assigned by your lead, demonstrating adaptability and a proactive approach. This includes actively participating in meetings, training, and internal events to support broader team and company objectives.
• Embody and uphold Wise’s values in daily interactions.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer II - Wise for Banks
jobs.description:
About the role

We’re looking for a senior engineer who enjoys understanding a customer’s problem, designing a solution and taking responsibility for how it performs in production.

This is a hands-on role with substantial ownership. You’ll have the autonomy to move work forward, alongside colleagues who contribute through shared design, reviews and pairing.

You will:
• Own solutions from problem to production. Work with product managers and engineers to understand partner needs, shape the approach, and design, build, test and operate backend services.
• Make thoughtful technical decisions. Explain tradeoffs clearly and balance delivery time, reliability and maintainability, including when the information available is incomplete.
• Build across system boundaries. Work with other teams to agree clear interfaces and understand how changes affect the wider payment journey.
• Improve the systems you operate. Strengthen testing and observability, diagnose production issues, and use what you learn to make services more dependable.
• Help the team succeed. Contribute across workstreams, share domain knowledge and help other engineers grow through reviews, pairing and mentoring.

Our backend stack includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka and PostgreSQL. You’ll deepen your understanding of funding, settlement and currency conversion, using that knowledge to make better product and engineering decisions. As the team’s scope grows, there will be opportunities to take on broader technical ownership and influence how we build.

jobs.title: Workplace Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
We are seeking an energetic, highly organised, and proactive Workplace Operations Coordinator to join

our team in Singapore. Sitting at the heart of our office culture, this role plays a critical part in curating a

welcoming, inclusive, and collaborative community environment for our employees.

You will combine day-to-day building operations and facilities management with creative community

management—delivering an outstanding destination workplace that supports our hybrid working model.

The ideal candidate brings a continuous improvement mindset, strong financial literacy, high-volume

event/logistics coordination skills, and a passion for operational excellence.

Community Management & Employee Experience
• Community Culture & Engagement: Curate a welcoming environment for our employees; build strong relationships to proactively gather feedback, anticipate team needs, and deliver outstanding customer service.
• Event Strategy & Execution: Plan, coordinate, and execute creative workplace events, social activities, and mission-aligned initiatives to promote networking and employee wellbeing. Evaluate events based on attendance, satisfaction, and impact.
• Workplace Communications: Keep the employee community informed regarding local building updates, guidelines, and upcoming events using Slack and agreed internal channels.
• Onboarding & Amenity Guidance: Confidently lead and deliver engaging Workplace Onboarding Sessions every 2 weeks for new hires. Guide employees on using office amenities to maximise productivity.
• Food & Beverage Offerings: Curate and manage pantry, food, and beverage offerings, ensuring quality, presentation, and variety align with company standards.

Front Desk, Visitor Experience & Mailroom
• Welcome & Front Desk: Cover the front desk during core business hours, providing a warm arrival experience for employees and visitors while answering daily queries.
• Mail & Logistics: Receive, sort, scan, and distribute incoming mail; coordinate third-party courier services for outgoing packages.
• Helpdesk Operations: Monitor and resolve employee workplace helpdesk tickets promptly and efficiently.

Building & Facilities Operations
• Operational Excellence: Perform regular walkthroughs to inspect space quality, pre-empt risks, maintain inventory, and enforce an uncompromising level of workplace cleanliness and etiquette.
• Landlord & Building Management: Partner directly with building management on day-to-day landlord issues, vendor supervision, and access control.
• Vendor & Financial Management: Coordinate local vendors, perform invoice processing, and track budgets. Identify opportunities for cost optimisation and vendor rationalisation.
• Event Logistics: Ensure event setups meet operational requirements, including site logistics and landlord permissions.

Health & Safety Compliance
• Compliance & Safety: Partner with the Workplace Safety Team to ensure compliance with relevant safety standards, specifically overseeing risk assessments, fire safety, first aid, and accident reporting.

Process & Project Support
• Continuous Improvement: Collaborate with immediate colleagues to identify operational process optimisations and support local workplace projects.

jobs.title: Senior Partner Operations Manager - APAC - Wise Platform
jobs.description:
As a Senior Partner Operations Manager, you'll own the operational strategy and execution for a portfolio of high-value enterprise partners on Wise Platform - driving continuous improvement in their payments’ experience, so partners stay operationally stable and ready to grow.

That breaks into two parts:
• Owning the operational strategy: You set and drive the strategy behind improving operational performance and volume retention for your partner portfolio - working to improve the partnership operations, in close partnership with the Account Management team (who own the commercial relationship).
• Resolving root causes of issues identified: You put that strategy into action day-to-day, working with cross-functional teams across operations, product, tech, legal, compliance, implementation, and business development to keep partners stable and unlock growth.

You will be co-owning Wise Platform partner revenue retention and operational performance, working closely with the Account Management team and Wise operational teams to ensure Wise Platform Partners get the most value from our partnership, are operationally stable and can expand to new products and solutions. 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Co-own revenue retention, operational performance, and relationships for your Enterprise platform partners - leading operational initiatives with internal teams to unblock growth opportunities. In practice, this means driving operational performance analysis and working to smooth out operations for the partners in your portfolio. You'll address operational concerns on the partnership as the final escalation point, spotting and resolving recurring friction patterns, while managing stakeholders and running business review meetings. You'll also propose solutions for partners looking to improve their operational state and support them through execution - ultimately removing the operational obstacles standing in the way of growth.
• Partner with Account Managers to drive retention targets by improving transfer success, reducing operational issues, lowering contact rates, and enhancing overall partnership scalability. To do this - we expect you to use data insights to track performance, proactively addressing risks, and implementing initiatives that improve key retention metrics, ensuring long-term partner satisfaction and minimising churn.
• Own operational success plans and data-driven business reviews, including helping manage Quarterly Business Reviews, to maximise the value partners get from Wise. Build plans aligned to key metrics (success rates, contact rates, customer satisfaction), holding both partners and internal teams accountable to timelines. Regularly present data analysis and progress updates to partners, using the insights to shape ongoing strategic improvements.
• Advocate for partner needs by providing feedback to internal teams, influencing product roadmaps, and ensuring our platform evolves to meet the complex needs of enterprise banking and fintech clients.
• Optimise internal and external processes, using data-driven insights to identify recurring challenges and implement solutions that scale operations and improve partner experiences.
• Develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders at partner organisations, ensuring alignment on operational goals and fostering long-term, strategic collaboration. Influence the partners to implement the endpoints & webhooks to help automate internal & partner’s support operational teams by sending the data via API to our partner.
• Analyse the quality of the servicing we provide to our partners and their customers. Getting the feedback from partners and reviewing how internal procedures and SLAs help partners and their end-users get the most efficient service from Wise. Identify and raise the key improvement areas.
