jobs.title: FinCrime Operations Senior Lead - AML Investigations
jobs.description:
As a Financial Crime Operations Senior Lead, you will be responsible for developing and managing a team of Financial Crime Operations Team Leads and Specialists for specific SME areas. Your key objective is to ensure the effective assessment and mitigation of risks related to high-risk customers, while strictly adhering to AML/CFT regulations and aligning with Wise’s risk appetite and internal policies. The specialists on your team will possess an in-depth understanding of the unique risks associated with complex business structures, varied customer types and activities, and country-specific challenges, as well as the strategies required to mitigate these risks effectively.

In this leadership role, you will act as a vital connector between your operational team, which includes team leads and specialists, and Wise's senior leadership. This involves clearly communicating the overarching strategic objectives to your team and transforming these goals into actionable and pertinent directives that drive process optimization and performance improvement.

You'll be instrumental in aligning Wise’s overall mission and strategy with performance expectations, ensuring that your team’s efforts are efficiently strategized and executed for optimal success. This includes developing and owning a strategic roadmap spanning several quarters your team, enhancing processes, and cultivating a positive and empowering work environment. You will support your team’s growth and independence through comprehensive training, mentoring, coaching, delegation, and recognition.

As an experienced operations manager, you will design and implement customer-focused processes while maintaining a vigilant awareness of the risks inherent in the financial industry, specific product offerings, and regulatory requirements. Your approach will ensure that Wise's operations continually meet the expectations of our partners and regulatory bodies.

Your mission:
• Leadership and people development: Drive team performance and cultural excellence to support sustainable business growth. Lead by example, demonstrating values and work ethic that inspire accountability, proactive problem-solving, and a growth mindset. Manage and develop a high-performing team by role modeling success behaviors. Focus on cultivating a high-performance culture through talent development, career check-ins, and recommendations for growth. Build strong teams by hiring, coaching, and fostering skills and competencies. Promote continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and inclusion to empower your team to innovate and excel.
• Performance management: Foster a culture of excellence in your team by consistently meeting KPIs and SLAs in our metrics-driven environment. Refresh performance expectations to match business needs and address underperformance with clear action plans. Implement strong performance frameworks, provide actionable feedback, and ensure every team member operates efficiently.
• Operational management: In this role, you'll turn high-level plans into actionable changes and lead your team to success. You'll create phased implementation plans to minimize disruption and set clear metrics to track progress. Focus on optimizing team structure by managing recruitment and strategically placing staff. Continuously identify and address redundancies and inefficiencies. You'll develop scalable, compliant processes and collaborate with product and operational teams to enhance customer experience, boost automation, and meet financial and service goals. Strong data literacy is essential for analyzing complex data and making informed decisions. Governance is crucial; you'll escalate issues promptly, provide clear updates to senior leadership, and contribute to a customer-focused culture that balances regulatory objectives with excellent customer service.
• Quality assurance: Ensure the highest quality standards for your group's tasks by making decisions within established frameworks. Lead root cause analysis, turn insights into improvements, and mitigate risks. Ensure quality standards are integrated into processes, tools, and initiatives. Understand impacts, focus on findings, and propose actions for better outcomes. Collaborate with other functions, offering expertise to enhance processes and elevate quality across the team and organization
• Domain knowledge and expertise: Be a subject matter expert in Financial Crime areas with the ability to train and coach your team. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of our regulatory obligations and internal policies. Apply a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Be able to represent the operational team processes and policies when working with internal auditing and testing parties. Retain an understanding of the wider Financial Crime and regulatory landscape and take on best practices to your team. Own operational incident management: from initial detection to response and remediation. Liaise effectively with functions and stakeholders, ensuring clear and timely communication throughout. Be responsible for developing action plans, driving remediation efforts, and providing context and subject matter expertise during and after incidents. The Senior Lead supports product-related incident management, ensuring a response to all critical events.
• Project management: Effectively Lead projects from start to finish, prioritizing tasks and maintaining documentation. Communicate milestones, address blockers, and delegate tasks while monitoring progress. Articulate project impact and value, and engage with stakeholders from technical teams to senior management. Negotiate and influence cross-functional teams to drive momentum and align with strategic goals.
• Planning and execution: Ensure operational area plans are set in place and provide insights to other stakeholders. Take full accountability in delivering, updating and making sure your area is making progress on their goals by measuring the effectiveness of the output of the team. There is a clear strategy within your domain that is connected with the wider organisational key objectives, including impactful OKRs and goals based on these plans, and being able to confidently present plans to varied audiences.
• Stakeholder management and communication: Lead complex projects with multiple stakeholders, setting priorities and ensuring timely delivery. Partner with Product to support group objectives and advocate for customer success. Manage diverse relationships, anticipate issues, and share key insights. Engage stakeholders promptly and lead discussions effectively. Communicate clearly and tailor messages to the audience, using data to deliver impactful and concise messages. Adapt to diverse stakeholders with confidence, ensuring professional and effective interactions.

jobs.title: Fraud Strategy Associate
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Operations at Brex

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

What you'll do

As a Fraud Strategy Associate, you’ll own the end-to-end integrity of Brex’s fraud and risk ecosystem across credit, deposit, and card payment rails. You'll find patterns, trace root causes, and build the detection logic, automations, and reporting that keep fraud in check without adding friction for customers. You’ll design your own solutions, see fraud across every product vertical, and partner with Risk, Data Science, Engineering, and Product to build prevention into the product itself. 

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our Sao Paulo office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

Strategic Analysis Detection
• Data Mining: Use SQL and Python to mine large-scale data, and apply LLM-based tools to detect and automate the identification of fraudulent patterns across credit, deposit, and card payment rails.
• Vendor and Rule Optimization: Design and refine automated detection logic to proactively mitigate risk while maintaining a frictionless experience for legitimate customers.
• Emerging Threat Intelligence: Stay ahead of industry trends and regulatory shifts to rapidly deploy new defensive strategies against novel fraud vectors.

Operational Excellence Process Ownership
• Workflow Architecture: optimize the internal processes for fraud investigations, ensuring operational discipline, case visibility, and high-fidelity documentation.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the strategic bridge between Risk Leadership, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, and Product teams to integrate fraud-prevention infrastructure into the core product lifecycle.
• Tooling Infrastructure: Define and manage the technical requirements for internal AI-driven tools and third-party risk-reduction platforms.

Metrics, Reporting Performance
• KPI Management: Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as false positive rates, fraud capture rates, and operational turnaround times.
• Executive Dashboards: Build and maintain scalable reporting suites to provide real-time visibility into fraud exposure and program effectiveness for senior stakeholders.
• Impact Assessment: Conduct deep-dive post-mortems on fraud incidents to quantify financial impact and recommend structural process improvements.

Requirements
• Technical Mastery: Capable with SQL and/or Python for data wrangling, statistical modeling, and automation.
• Industry

Experience:

3+ years of experience in fraud strategy, risk operations, or data-driven business operations within a financial services or high-growth fintech environment.
• Operational Mindset: Proven ability to build scalable processes and manage complex projects from data exploration through to operational rollout.
• Communication: Exceptional ability to synthesize complex analytical findings into clear, executive-level strategic narratives.

Bonus Points
• Advanced Certification: Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) designation.
• Experience with Snowflake, Salesforce, and data visualization platforms like Hex.
• Experience managing fraud risk and operational workflows for products spanning multiple geographic jurisdictions.
• Experience utilizing AI tools to enhance internal operational efficiency.

 

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Business Operations, Senior Associate
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

We're hiring for opportunities across Consumer, Institutional, Base, and Stablecoins and will work through placement / fit through the interview process. As a Business Operations Senior Associate on the Business Operations Strategy team, you'll partner directly with senior leadership on Coinbase's highest-priority strategic and operational challenges. You'll work primarily with product and sales leaders, structuring complex problems, building quantitative business cases, and translating data into executive-level recommendations that shape product and segment strategy.

What you'll do:
• Structure complex, ambiguous strategic problems for Coinbase's leadership team and develop actionable recommendations backed by data and quantitative modeling.
• Build business cases and financial models that identify new opportunities and directly inform Institutional product and go-to-market strategy.
• Develop and maintain a deep understanding of competitive positioning, peer benchmarks, and the evolving crypto landscape to sharpen strategic recommendations.
• Design and implement experiments to validate hypotheses, measure impact, and drive measurable changes across Institutional products.
• Own problems end-to-end, from initial framing through analysis, recommendation, and implementation, not just the slide deck.
• Strengthen team capabilities by improving existing processes, frameworks, and operational tooling.

Required Skills and

Experience:
• 5+ years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, or product strategy, with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end strategic workstreams.
• Proven ability to build quantitative models and business cases that have directly influenced executive or leadership decisions.
• Familiarity with institutional finance, capital markets, or crypto/digital assets markets.
• Track record of delivering clear, concise written and verbal recommendations to senior stakeholders in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
• Exposure to SQL and BI tools (e.g., Hex, Superset, Looker) or crypto analytics tools (e.g., Dune Analytics, Etherscan) is a plus but not required.
• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.title: (Senior) Strategy Associate
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a highly analytical and driven Strategy Associate / Senior Associate to join our team. At Crypto.com, our #1 core value is "Think Clearly." We are looking for individuals who can not only design exceptional strategies but critically evaluate them, identifying nuances that others might miss.
If you are looking to step away from traditional corporate strategy or consulting constraints—where months are spent drafting 100-page presentations for endless committee reviews—and want to make a real, immediate impact, this role is for you.

Life @ Crypto.com
 
Empowered to think big. Try new opportunities while working with a talented, ambitious and supportive team.
Transformational and proactive working environment. Elevate employees to find thoughtful and innovative solutions.
Growth from within. We help to develop new skill-sets that would impact the shaping of your personal and professional growth.
Work Culture. Our colleagues are some of the best in the industry; we are all here to help and support one another.
One cohesive team. Engage stakeholders to achieve our ultimate goal - Cryptocurrency in every wallet. 
 
 
Are you ready to kickstart your future with us? 
 
Benefits
 
Competitive salary 
Medical insurance package with extended coverage to dependents 
Attractive annual leave entitlement including: birthday, work anniversary
Work Flexibility Adoption. Flexi-work hour and hybrid or remote set-up
Aspire career alternatives through us. Our internal mobility program can offer employees a diverse scope. 
Work Perks: crypto.com visa card provided upon joining 
 
Our Crypto.com benefits packages vary depending on region requirements, you can learn more from our talent acquisition team.

Founded in 2016, Crypto.com serves more than 150 million customers and is the world's fastest growing global cryptocurrency platform. Our vision is simple: Cryptocurrency in Every Wallet™. Built on a foundation of security, privacy, and compliance, Crypto.com is committed to accelerating the adoption of cryptocurrency through innovation and empowering the next generation of builders, creators, and entrepreneurs to develop a fairer and more equitable digital ecosystem.
 
Learn more at https://crypto.com. 
 
Crypto.com is an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating an environment where opportunities are presented to everyone in a fair and transparent way. Crypto.com values diversity and inclusion, seeking candidates with a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills that complement and strengthen our team.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Deposits Portfolio
jobs.description:
Join a Challenger
At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions. 

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.

What's kept us moving? The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity. 

We can’t wait to get to know you! 

The Work
 
The Product Manager, Deposits Portfolio develops and implements product strategies to drive customer engagement with the payments and spending portfolio, supports the development and launch of new products to market, optimizes existing processes, and improves the customer experience. The role requires deep understanding of the product construct, a customer-centric approach, and the ability to use data to identify opportunities to evolve the deposit portfolio. The Product Manager supports new projects from ideation through implementation, development, and launch, working with multidisciplinary teams and strategic partners. 

What we offer [For full-time permanent roles]
 
💰 Competitive discretionary bonus 
✨ Market leading RRSP match program
🩺 Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits
📝 Employee Share Purchase Plan
👶🏽 Maternity/Parental top-up while you care for your little one
🏝 Generous vacation policy and personal days

jobs.title: IRオフィサー
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼IRチームの紹介
米国NASDAQ市場への上場を機に、四半期決算開示をはじめ、国内外の投資家・アナリストとのコミュニケーションを担うIR活動を推進しています。
今後は、国内外での社債調達、格付取得、M Aなど、IR・資本市場に関わる領域がさらに広がっていきます。
社長・CFOをはじめとする経営陣と近い距離で議論しながら、事業戦略や財務・資本政策への理解を深め、企業価値向上に関わることができる環境です。少数精鋭のチームで、一人ひとりが裁量と責任を持って業務を推進しています。

▼募集の背景

PayPayの事業成長や経営戦略を資本市場へ適切かつタイムリーに発信し、国内外の投資家との信頼関係を構築していくことは、企業価値向上において重要な役割を担っています。
本ポジションでは、決算準備を含めたプロジェクト管理においてオーナーシップを持って業務を推進いただくとともに、IR資料の作成、市場・競合分析、IR戦略の企画など、幅広い業務をお任せします。
また、海外IRへの同行や海外機関投資家との面談など、英語で投資家と直接コミュニケーションする機会も多く、グローバルな視点とコミュニケーション力をお持ちの方を求めています。

【具体的な業務内容】
• 決算説明資料などIR関連資料の作成
• 国内外の機関投資家・アナリストとのコミュニケーション（海外IRへの同行、投資家面談等）
• 市場・競合・業績分析、および分析を踏まえたIR戦略・施策の企画
• 社長・CFOをはじめとする経営陣や社内関係部門との連携・折衝

▼本ポジションの魅力
• 経営陣に近い立場で、企業価値向上に直結するIR業務に携わることができます。
• 海外IRや機関投資家との対話を通じて、NASDAQ上場企業ならではのグローバルなIR経験を積むことができます。
• 事業戦略、財務・会計、資本政策、M Aなど、IRを軸にコーポレートファイナンスの幅広い知見を身につけることができます。

必要な経験/スキル
• 複数の関係者を巻き込みながら、プロジェクトや業務を自律的に推進した経験
• ビジネスレベル以上の英語力（海外IR同行、海外機関投資家との面談対応がスムーズに可能なレベル）
• 基本的なPCスキル（Excel、PowerPoint、Word）
※IR業務の実務経験は必須ではありません。

あると望ましい経験/スキル
• 上場企業におけるIR業務の経験
• 金融機関、監査法人、経理・財務等でのプロジェクト・マネジメント経験
• 株式市場や資本市場に関する業務経験
• 海外機関投資家とのコミュニケーション・対応経験

PayPayが求める人物像
• PayPay 5 sensesに当てはまる方

待遇・条件

雇用形態
• 正社員

勤務地
• Hybrid Workstyle
※所属組織のルールおよび業務指示に応じて出社対応頂きます。

勤務時間
• スーパーフレックス制（コアタイム無し）
• 原則：午前9時～午後5時45分（実働7時間45分＋休憩時間 1時間）

休日
• 土日祝日、年末年始および会社指定日

休暇（法定休暇および会社福利厚生）
• 年次有給休暇(初年度14日間、入社月に応じて按分付与。入社日から使用可）
• パーソナル休暇（毎年度５日間付与/初年度入社月により3日間もしくは5日間付与）
※PayPay独自の特別有給休暇制度で、本人/家族/ペットなどの病気/ケガ/通院付き添い等にご使用頂けます。

給与
• 年俸制（一部固定残業代含む）
• 経験、スキル、業績、貢献度に応じ当社規定により決定
• 毎年1回見直し
• 時間外勤務手当、深夜勤務手当有

※給与支給について、一部をPayPayアカウントで受け取ることが可能です（給与デジタル支払いに対応）

ベネフィット
• 社会保険（健康保険、厚生年金、雇用保険、労災保険）
• 企業型確定拠出年金制度

Other Information:

jobs.title: Partner Operations Manager
jobs.description:
As a Partner Operations Manager, you'll own the operational strategy and execution for a portfolio of high-value banking and fintech partners on Wise Platform — driving continuous improvement in how payment solutions are delivered, so partners stay operationally stable and ready to grow.

That breaks into two parts:
• Owning the operational strategy: You set and drive the strategy behind improving operational performance and volume retention for your partner portfolio — continuously improving how payment solutions are delivered, in close partnership with the Account Management team (who own the strategic relationship).
• Executing cross-functionally: You put that strategy into action day-to-day, working with Wise operational teams plus product, tech, legal, compliance, implementation, and business development to keep partners stable and unlock growth.

You will be owning Wise Platform partner volume retention and operational performance, working closely with the Account Management team and Wise operational teams to ensure Wise Platform Partners receive the most value from our product, operationally stable and ready to grow. You will also work with other functions, including product management, tech, legal, compliance, implementation and business development.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Co-own revenue retention, operational performance, and relationships for your Enterprise platform partners - leading operational initiatives with internal teams to unblock growth opportunities. In practice, this means driving operational performance analysis and working to smooth out operations for the partners in your portfolio. You'll address operational concerns on the partnership as the final escalation point, spotting and resolving recurring friction patterns, while managing stakeholders and running business review meetings. You'll also propose solutions for partners looking to improve their operational state and support them through execution - ultimately removing the operational obstacles standing in the way of growth.
• Partner with Account Managers to drive retention targets by improving transfer success, reducing operational issues, lowering contact rates, and enhancing overall partnership scalability. To do this - we expect you to use data insights to track performance, proactively addressing risks, and implementing initiatives that improve key retention metrics, ensuring long-term partner satisfaction and minimizing churn.
• Own operational success plans and data-driven business reviews, including helping manage Quarterly Business Reviews, to maximize the value partners get from Wise. Build plans aligned to key metrics (success rates, contact rates, customer satisfaction), holding both partners and internal teams accountable to timelines. Regularly present data analysis and progress updates to partners, using the insights to shape ongoing strategic improvements.
• Advocate for partner needs by providing feedback to internal teams, influencing product roadmaps, and ensuring our platform evolves to meet the complex needs of enterprise banking and fintech clients.
• Optimize internal and external processes, using data-driven insights to identify recurring challenges and implement solutions that scale operations and improve partner experiences.
• Develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders at partner organizations, ensuring alignment on operational goals and fostering long-term, strategic collaboration. Influence the partners to implement the endpoints & webhooks to help automate internal & partner’s support operational teams by sending the data via API to our partner.
• Analyze the quality of the servicing we provide to our partners and their customers. Getting the feedback from partners and reviewing how internal procedures and SLAs help partners and their end-users get the most efficient service from Wise. Identify and raise the key improvement areas.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Analyst (Data Activation)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Digital Analyst specialising in Marketing Data Activation to join our Digital Analytics team. This is a technical Individual Contributor role at the intersection of Digital Analytics, Marketing Technology and Data Engineering.

You’ll help us build and operate the data activation capabilities that allow Wise Marketing teams to safely use our first-party customer and event data across advertising platforms.

A big part of your role will focus on our Reverse ETL ecosystem: working with data in our data warehouse, building and improving SQL/dbt models, configuring activation pipelines, improving monitoring and helping ensure the data we send to Marketing platforms is accurate, reliable and well governed.

You’ll think about the whole system: where data comes from, how it is modelled, how customer marketing identifiers are resolved, how it is activated, how we know it arrived successfully and what happens when something breaks.

You’ll work closely with Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers, Marketing Analysts, Paid Media teams and other technical stakeholders to build a Marketing activation capability that is scalable, observable and easy to use.

You will also contribute to the wider Digital Analytics stack, including technologies such as Google Tag Manager, server-side tracking, Singular and other Marketing measurement and data infrastructure.

What you'll be doing
• You’ll take technical ownership of Paid Media activation through our data warehouse, Reverse ETL and the surrounding data ecosystem.
• You’ll help move us away from manual checks towards proper production monitoring and observability of our marketing activation pipelines.
• You’ll use SQL and dbt to build and maintain Marketing-specific datasets used for customer audiences, conversion signals and other activation use cases.
• You’ll work with Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering on modelling patterns, architecture and standards, while developing increasing ownership of the Marketing-specific transformation layer.
• When something goes wrong, you’ll help diagnose where in the chain the problem exists. You’ll take an end-to-end view of the service without needing to own every underlying system.
• You’ll help teams understand whether a requirement is best solved through warehouse-based activation, our real-time tracking stack, an MMP such as Singular, another integration pattern or work from an upstream Engineering/Data team.

jobs.title: Internal Comms Designer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced designer with strong presentation design skills (Figma/Google Slides) to join our in-house Brand and Creative team in London. You’ll bring order and craft to presentations and comms across Wise, building on-brand, scalable systems that elevate every team’s output — with the confidence to train nondesigners to use what you build, and to work closely with senior and C-suite stakeholders under pressure during peak periods.

The ideal candidate is an organised self-starter with at least 4 years of experience in similar in-house teams or branding agencies. We’re looking for a designer with strong craft, communication skills, attention to detail, and a positive, eager-to-learn attitude.

Your mission

Wise exists to build money without borders. Over a decade ago, we challenged the way the world moves money – cutting out hidden fees and making international finance simpler and fairer. Today, we help millions of people and businesses send, spend and manage money across countries with ease, making money simple, accessible and smart for everyone, everywhere.

The Brand and Creative team is made up of 25+ designers, motion designers, copywriters, strategists and creative ops managers based in London and Singapore. Our mission is to bring Wise’s story to life with clarity and creative excellence across every touchpoint. We work to ensure Wise is recognised and trusted worldwide, helping people and businesses move money faster, cheaper, and more transparently.

What you’ll do

The majority of this role will focus on:
• Designing presentations that strengthen our brand internally (Figma and Google Slides). Create visually engaging presentations for internal events and meetings, turning complex information into clear, compelling stories.
• Creating and evolving our presentation templates and systems (Figma and Google Slides). Develop and roll out easy-to-use templates and tools that empower colleagues across Wise to create consistent, on-brand work independently.

You’ll also:
• Design major company-wide events and conferences throughout the year. Collaborate with internal teams on presentations, event branding, signage, and print and digital communications—often with fast turnarounds.
• Work closely with senior stakeholders. Ask the right questions and simplify complex business and product updates, shaping them into impactful presentations for company-wide audiences.
• Support our workplace experience. Partner with the Workplace team to create signage, uniforms, and other branded materials for our offices.
• Provide design support for reports (InDesign). Create polished, on-brand reports and review materials using InDesign when needed.
• Use AI tools to accelerate your workflow. We’re actively incorporating AI into the way our team works, so you should be curious, comfortable experimenting, and keen to find smarter ways of working.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Develop: You’ll be working with a talented and passionate bunch of designers, copywriters and animators. We’re a feedback friendly organisation and you’ll have loads of opportunities to learn and be challenged.
• Bring clarity: You’ll turn complexity into clear, confident narratives, working with senior and C-suite stakeholders
• Have impact: You’ll join our exciting mission to build money without borders and show people that Wise is the smartest way to manage their international money.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I - Risk Control & Governance
jobs.description:
Job Description

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Engineer to join the Risk & Control Governance team / Risk Assessment Group. You'll be instrumental in building the governance, assurance, and data foundations that ensure every risk decision at Wise is consistent, explainable, auditable, and continuously monitored.

This role works at the intersection of the Risk API platform, Product, and Financial Crime (FinCrime) teams — offering a unique opportunity to build the systems that give Wise confidence in every risk assessment it operates at scale.

You will be the driving force behind the platform's trustworthiness and integrity, focusing on:
• Data Governance: Building and maintaining data ownership, lineage, and quality monitoring systems that ensure every risk decision is powered by trusted data.
• Control Assurance: Designing continuous monitoring and validation systems that verify controls perform as intended — including trigger validation, drift detection, coverage analysis, and control health scoring.
• Auditability & Explainability: Implementing end-to-end audit trails, change history tracking, and explainability tooling that enables one-click regulatory evidence generation.
• Scalable Solutions: Designing robust, high-throughput solutions that handle large volumes of data and can be quickly understood and scaled across multiple distinct risk domains.

 

What will you be working on?

You will join the team at a pivotal moment, with your contributions being immediately visible and critical to the success of the entire Risk Assessment platform's governance layer.

The core challenge for the team — and your immediate focus — is to build the assurance and governance foundations that the platform currently lacks, ensuring every control can answer: Was the right trigger used? Was the right data available? Was the right decision made? Is the control still effective?

 

Your immediate impact will be to:
• Build Data Trust: Implement data quality monitoring, data contracts, and lineage tracking that give the organisation full traceability from risk decisions back to source data.
• Deliver Continuous Assurance: Design and build automated monitoring systems that continuously validate control effectiveness — detecting drift, false positives/negatives, and coverage gaps before they become incidents.
• Enable Auditability: Create audit trail infrastructure and explainability tooling that dramatically reduces the effort required for regulatory reporting and compliance evidence generation.
• Integrate with Risk API: Work closely with the Risk API team to embed governance and assurance capabilities into the core platform, ensuring clean integration points and shared data contracts.

Qualifications

What do you need?
• Strong Backend Engineering: Proven experience building high-throughput, data-intensive systems in any language. Hands-on expertise with Kafka, SQL and NoSQL databases, and designing for scale and reliability.
• Data Engineering Aptitude: Experience with data quality frameworks, pipeline orchestration, or lineage tracking. You understand what it takes to make data trustworthy at scale.
• Systems Thinking: Ability to reason about complex distributed systems, identify failure modes, and design solutions that are both robust and operationally simple.
• Ownership & Autonomy: Comfortable operating with ambiguity, defining your own work from high-level objectives, and driving delivery end-to-end without close direction.
• Collaborative Mindset: Ability to work effectively across team boundaries — particularly with the Risk API team, Product, and FinCrime stakeholders — to align on contracts, data models, and integration patterns.

Additional information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

jobs.title: FinCrime Operations Team Lead - AML Investigations
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an AML Investigations Team Lead to join our team in Tallinn. This role is a unique opportunity to have an impact on Wise’s mission by helping identify suspicious activity and ensuring Wise remains compliant. You will play a crucial role in advancing our mission of Money Without Borders by leading a team of investigators in Tallinn and collaborating with a larger team distributed across five different offices worldwide.

Your mission is to lead and support your team in identifying and analyzing suspicious payment patterns, ensuring compliance with regulatory obligations, and fostering a strong sense of community within the team. As an AML Investigations Team Lead, your primary duties include building and developing your team, optimizing operational processes, and collaborating with other teams to enhance efficiency and customer experience.

Here’s how you’ll be contributing to the AML Investigations team:

Leadership:
• Build, lead, and develop a team of AML Investigators with a strong sense of community and shared purpose.
• Empower your team by providing the necessary tools and training to excel in their roles.
• Foster a positive and inclusive work environment, adapting your leadership style to meet the needs of your team members.

Performance and Operations:
• Measure and work towards improving team KPIs, ensuring the team meets performance metrics and regulatory standards.
• Initiate and support operational process changes to enhance team performance and efficiency.
• Collaborate with other leads, product teams, and developers to manage the operational impact of changes and identify opportunities for automation and improved customer experience.

Team Development:
• Facilitate ongoing professional growth by setting personal development plans and leveraging available resources.
• Lead by example, establishing a team identity built on trust, high standards, and accountability.
• Recognize and celebrate team contributions, motivating and inspiring individuals to excel.

Culture and Well-being:
• Foster a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture by exemplifying Wise’s values and supporting a healthy work-life balance.
• Regularly check in on the team's well-being, offering constructive feedback and navigating conflicts effectively.
• Build a work environment rooted in trust, respect, and inclusivity.

jobs.title: Channel Sales Manager - APAC
jobs.description:
Channel Sales at Wise Platform is a high-growth function. As part of our strategy to scale globally, we are expanding the team with a dedicated manager based in Singapore to look at scaling the function in APAC. 

Our team’s goal is to accelerate the adoption of Wise Platform by leveraging a trusted strategic channel partner ecosystem to win new deals, shorten sales cycles, and scale through channels.

As the Channel Sales Manager (APAC), you will build, scale, and operationalise our channel sales function across the region. You will focus on identifying, structuring, and nurturing relationships across top-tier core banking providers, payment platforms, system integrators (SIs), and strategic consultancies.

Key Responsibilities
• Channel Partnership Enablement & Operations: Own the governance, cross-market APAC coordination, and end-to-end lifecycle of new and existing partners - including commercial alignment, technical onboarding, contracting and launch.
• Core Banking & Vendor Ecosystem Development: Identify and build strategic relationships with top-tier core banking providers and payment platforms to create pre-integrated connectors and scalable GTM pathways.
• System Integrator & Consultancy Strategy: Build and execute go-to-market alliances with global and regional SIs and consultancies that deploy technology for banks across Southeast Asia, India, and the broader APAC region.
• BD Alignment & Pipeline Generation: Work closely with the Business Development team - passing on qualified leads, partner-sourced opportunities, and account intelligence collected through channel activities to accelerate direct deal flows.
• Ecosystem Assessment & Immediate Impact: Take immediate ownership of active regional partner relationships and execute a comprehensive ecosystem assessment across APAC players to map out high-priority channel partners, starting with system integrators across SEA and India.
• Commercial Metrics & KPIs: Drive key commercial success metrics, targeting partner-sourced pipeline, time-to-live through repeatable integrations, and long-term transaction volume flowing through APAC channels.

What You Will Learn & Career Growth
• High-Visibility Impact: Work directly alongside APAC commercial leads and global leadership to shape and scale the regional channel strategy from the ground up.
• Cross-Functional Exposure: Collaborate daily across BD, Pre-Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal to build scalable commercial models.
• Industry Transformation: Drive long-term impact on Wise Platform’s sales opportunities and sales cycle by shifting regional GTM from direct outreach to scalable, pre-integrated partner channels.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer - Customer Risk Assessment
jobs.description:
At Wise, we’re on a mission to make financial services faster, simpler, and more accessible for everyone. But to achieve our mission, we also need to safeguard our platform against financial crime and ensure our customers' money is safe.

For our customers, using Wise is as simple as sending money from A to B. Yet behind our app and website is a complex engine that must navigate strict regulatory requirements worldwide. The Customer Risk Assessment team is at the absolute core of this effort. We are building the centralized platform that gives Wise deep visibility into any customer and their associated financial crime (fincrime) risk. By tying together all fincrime topologies into a unified view, we empower teams to make fast, accurate decisions.

Your mission will be to help build out this centralized platform, tying complex risk signals together while also owning the common components of risk mitigation. You will directly impact how Wise scales its compliance operations, enabling us to move with speed and confidence without ever compromising on the safety of our customers.

How we work:

We’re a cross-functional team of backend and frontend engineers working hand-in-hand with Product Managers, Analysts, and Designers. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do. We value ownership, open feedback, and a commitment to building stable, scalable systems while embracing fast-paced learning and iteration.

We operate with a belief in automation, programmatic implementation, and reusable design. We’re looking for engineers who can step back and think holistically about the entire fincrime ecosystem, but also follow through and help implement the design. You won't just be handed a list of Jira tickets; you will be expected to understand the underlying problems, challenge the proposed solutions, and propose simple, effective solutions that protect our customers' money.

What will you be working on?:

You’ll be having a real-world impact by building the systems that enable Wise to evaluate customer risk globally. Specifically, you will:
• Build the full stack: Design, develop, and deploy resilient backend microservices in Java (Spring Boot) and build intuitive, accessible frontends using React and TypeScript.
• Create a 360-degree risk view: Build the centralized tools that aggregate data across multiple fincrime topologies, giving our teams full visibility into customer risk profiles.
• Drive risk mitigation: Own and develop the common components of our risk mitigation handling, ensuring our Servicing Agents have scalable, standardized workflows.
• Scale operations: Break down complex bottlenecks in our servicing and compliance processes, delivering adaptable platform solutions that other Wise product teams can evolve to fit their specific needs.
• Take ownership: Take full ownership of the product journey—from identifying a problem and empathizing with stakeholders, to creating an execution plan and shipping it to production.

jobs.title: Internal Audit Manager - Fincrime
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Internal Audit Manager (FinCrime) to join our specialist FinCrime team within Wise Internal Audit. The FinCrime team has a global remit and works collaboratively with regional teams. This role is based in Singapore.

Your main task will be completing financial crime internal audits. You will be responsible for planning, assigning, and supervising the operational activities of the team as well as completing your own tasks. You will make recommendations to improve governance, risk management and internal controls. Your responsibilities will vary audit to audit and will include completing design and operating effectiveness testing yourself, as well as oversight of other team members. 

You will also complete issue validation testing by designing and conducting testing of implemented control improvements. 

The role presents a great opportunity to focus on the development and delivery of audit engagements in a fast paced environment, focussed on data driven audit techniques and continuous auditing. Relevant experience working in assurance, risk or control roles and deploying technology enabled assurance is key to driving the internal audit agenda.

Your mission
• Support the implementation and operation of the internal audit assurance framework.
• Deliver audits per the audit plan to ensure timely and relevant audit outcomes.
• Support building a strong and self-sufficient internal audit team.
• Monitor the implementation of Internal Audit recommendations by the teams and measure the effectiveness of the improvements.
• Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders, internally and externally.

A bit about you

Skills:
• You have proven experience working in risk, control or assurance and you want to continuously improve how to get the job done.
• You can plan and scope audits including designing and executing comprehensive, risk based test plans and identify areas for improvement in well written reports. Your work meets quality standards and you can oversee others to do the same.
• You seek to use data analytics and technology in your work and decision making processes. Practical experience in data analytics preferred.
• You demonstrate attention to detail but can summarise key messages succinctly, verbally and in writing, adjusting your style and level of information based on the target audience.
• You have a good understanding of the current financial crime regulatory environment, including Corruption, Drug Trafficking and Other Serious Crimes (Confiscation of Benefits) Act (CDSA), Financial Services and Markets Act 2022 (FSMA), Wolfsberg guidance and MAS guidance.
• You have strong experience and specialism in financial crime topics including FinCrime risk management, KYC/KYB, Customer and Enhanced Due Diligence, Fraud, Transaction Monitoring, Screening and Reporting.
• You are able to work independently, you assume responsibility and you make your own judgement.
• You take ownership over complex areas and solve problems with no or very limited guidance and know when to escalate and ask for support.
• You have very strong coordination skills and you are able to hold teams accountable for meeting deadlines and delivering high quality outputs.
• You are agile and adaptable to change.
• You are collaborative - you enjoy sharing your knowledge and upskilling others.

jobs.title: Brex Rotational Program
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. jobs.description:

We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Marketing at Brex

Marketing tells the story of Brex to the world. From acquisition to activation, we translate product value into business results. Our team spans Revenue, Product, and Brand Marketing, and works closely with nearly every function at Brex. We move fast, experiment often, and think deeply about customer behavior. If you want your creativity to drive growth and shape perception, this is the place.

What you'll do

Brex is looking for a strategic, data-driven Senior Field Marketing Manager to build and lead the field marketing motion for our Commercial segment.

Commercial represents one of Brex's largest growth opportunities. This role will be responsible for developing the segment strategy, identifying the markets and audiences with the greatest potential, and creating integrated programs that generate new pipeline and accelerate existing opportunities.

You will operate as the marketing lead for the Commercial business, partnering closely with Sales to understand their goals, test new approaches, and build repeatable programs that can scale. Your campaigns may include executive and customer events, industry programs, direct mail, digital experiences, partner activations, webinars, account-based plays, and other creative approaches.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial judgment with hands-on execution. You are comfortable analyzing pipeline and campaign performance, presenting to Sales leadership, and managing multiple campaigns and stakeholders.

Where you'll work

This role will be fully remote and based in the United States.

Responsibilities
• Own the field marketing strategy, annual plan, budget, and pipeline goals for the Commercial segment
• Partner with Commercial Sales leadership and set the planning rhythm across Marketing, Sales, and SDR
• Analyze account, pipeline, industry, geographic, and performance data to identify the highest-potential audiences
• Build integrated campaigns that combine in-person, digital, partner, content, direct mail, and account-based tactics
• Shape event strategy, from regional programs to targeted dinners. For larger experiences, partner with the Events team while owning the audience, objective, Sales plan, and pipeline outcome
• Test new campaign ideas, define success upfront, and turn what works into repeatable plays and documented playbooks
• Track results (pipeline, conversion, ROI) and present them to senior Marketing and Sales leaders

Requirements
• 7+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, demand gen, account-based marketing, or a related role, ideally in SaaS, fintech, or another high-growth technology company
• Experience owning marketing strategy for a defined customer segment, region, industry, or sales organization
• A track record of sourcing and accelerating pipeline through integrated programs
• A strong understanding of the B2B sales cycle and the ability to translate Sales priorities into focused marketing strategies
• Fluency in marketing and pipeline metrics, including the ability to analyze campaign performance, diagnose gaps, and clearly explain results
• Strong project management and executive communication skills, with comfort juggling multiple programs in a fast-paced environment
• Willingness to travel up to 40% for events, Sales meetings, and customer programs

Bonus points
• Experience building a field marketing motion or entering an underdeveloped segment
• Experience marketing to companies in the Commercial or emerging mid-market segment
• Familiarity with finance, fintech, spend, payments, ERP, or procurement audiences
• Experience using Salesforce and marketing analytics platforms to assess funnel performance and campaign impact
• Experience developing a business case for additional investment or team growth based on demonstrated results

jobs.description:

We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Operations at Brex

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our São Paulo office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

What you'll do

As an Underwriting Analyst, your goal is to support our underwriting processes for our card products and grow your skills as a credit professional. This is a role that requires strong communication, time management, financial analysis, and teamwork. You will partner cross-functionally with our Sales, Customer Experience, Engineering, and Product teams to contribute to meeting organizational goals, and will have the opportunity to develop into more senior credit responsibilities over time.

Responsibilities
• Own and work assigned cash-based underwriting queues, including account reviews, limit changes, and credit-related requests.
• Evaluate customer creditworthiness and repayment capacity using bank statements, transaction data, cash-flow trends, and other business information.
• Analyze cash balances, revenue, burn, runway, utilization, and transaction activity to identify evolving credit risk.
• Make sound, risk-based recommendations within delegated authority, balancing customer impact with responsible exposure management.
• Clearly communicate underwriting decisions, rationale, and information requirements to internal partners and, when needed, customers.
• Partner with Sales, Customer Experience, Credit Policy, Risk, Data, Product, and Engineering to resolve complex cases and improve the end-to-end credit experience
• Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve underwriting quality, efficiency, and consistency.
• Use data, spreadsheets, and AI-enabled tools to streamline routine work and surface actionable insights.
• Partner with cross-functional teams to improve tools and workflows that support cash-based underwriting.

Requirements
• Passionate about credit and underwriting decisions on commercial exposures for small to large businesses
• Strong analytical rigor and attention to details
• Customer centric and passionate about thinking through customer needs and working with them while balancing risk exposures
• Ability to communicate technical problems in an elegant and tactful way

Bonus Points
• Familiarity with quantitative credit risk models, probability of default (PD), and loss given default (LGD) concepts
• Familiarity with underwriting or credit-risk tooling and workflows.
• Experience using SQL, Hex, spreadsheets, or similar tools to analyze data and identify trends.
• Familiarity with banking regulations and global markets
• Experience using Salesforce or comparable case-management tools

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Access & Authorization (Platform)
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Access Authorization team within the Platform group, you'll help shape the systems customers use to securely access Coinbase. This team builds and operates distributed services at the intersection of security, identity, developer infrastructure, and customer experience. You'll design foundational authentication and authorization capabilities that balance strong security with a simple experience, creating leverage across every Coinbase product and partner integration.

What You'll Do:
• Own end-to-end design, implementation, and operation of capabilities across authentication, OAuth, sessions, tokens, 2FA, account recovery, and edge authorization.
• Build secure, low-latency Go and gRPC services used across Coinbase's web, mobile, API, and partner experiences, with strong observability, failure testing, and measurable SLOs.
• Lead technical designs for complex initiatives such as signed authorization tokens, passkeys, biometric recovery, device-aware authentication, and mobile OAuth.
• Partner with product, security, fraud, and infrastructure teams to balance customer conversion, account protection, regulatory requirements, and engineering constraints.
• Simplify integration patterns and build self-service tooling that enables product teams to adopt access and authorization capabilities safely at scale.
• Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar through design reviews, pairing, code reviews, and on-call participation.

Required Skills and

Experience:
• 5+ years of backend software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Go or a comparable systems-oriented language, including building and operating reliable, high-throughput distributed services in production.
• Demonstrated experience designing secure APIs and reasoning about authentication, authorization, session management, trust boundaries, and token handling (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWTs, PKCE, or related standards).
• Proficiency with gRPC, Protocol Buffers, and data stores such as Redis or DynamoDB, with strong operational instincts using metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and SLOs to run critical services.
• Track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects from technical design through production rollout, with clear written and verbal communication that aligns engineering, security, product, and infrastructure partners.
• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

What you'll do:
• Write high-quality, well-tested code that ships to production and directly impacts Coinbase customers.
• Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers to turn technical and product vision into delivered features.
• Participate in code reviews, providing and receiving feedback that raises the quality bar for your team.

jobs.location: New York, New York; Miami, Florida; Remote (USA)
jobs.description:
About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Compliance

Compliance at Gemini is a team dedicated to managing the next generation of financial crime prevention in a complex and evolving regulatory environment. We are a diverse group of technology, legal, and operational professionals who develop new approaches to solving classic problems using cutting edge tools and processes.

The Role:

Head of Consumer and Lending Compliance

In this role, you will lead the compliance program for Gemini’s deposit and lending products, including the first-in-class crypto rewards credit card and business credit card. You will be responsible for creating a comprehensive strategy to scale the program and support the business in delivering product features in a compliant and consumer-friendly way. The ideal candidate will have a deep knowledge of consumer finance regulations, be solutions-oriented, and have experience operating in a fast-moving environment. Superior communication skills are essential, as this individual will be required to communicate effectively with various stakeholders, including product, technology, legal, risk, as well as banking partners and regulators. This role reports directly to Gemini’s Global Chief Compliance Officer and has a direct line of communication to the Board.

Responsibilities:
• Oversee the consumer compliance program in accordance with applicable laws and regulations (e.g., UDAAP, ECOA, FCRA, TILA, etc.)
• Serve as the primary advisor to the credit card business and other horizon banking and lending products, providing guidance on new product development, product changes, and marketing initiatives
• Manage a team of compliance professionals responsible for monitoring and testing, complaint management, third party oversight, issue management, compliance reporting, and customer-facing communications, among other areas
• Provide regular reporting to the Board of Managers and other governance committees
• Serve as the primary liaison between Gemini and its sponsor bank partner
• Respond to internal and external audits, examinations, and regulatory inquiries related to credit card card operations
• Oversee risk assessments for consumer banking products, identifying potential areas of risk and working cross-functionally to manage such risks
• Serve as the Fair Lending Officer overseeing the company’s fair lending program
• Ensure proper oversight of vendors and other third parties that present potential compliance or regulatory risk
• Oversee remediation plans for high priority issues to ensure timely remediation and remedy of any compliance-related issues
• Remain up-to-date on regulatory changes and landscapes, best practices and developments in the industry and ensure our implementation is both compliant and forward thinking
• Provide timely and accurate advice and guidance to the Gemini’s staff on issues arising from compliance policy areas and subject matter within the responsibility of the Compliance Department

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree. CRCM or Juris Doctor preferred
• 10+ years of compliance experience in credit, banking, fintech, or other financial regulatory compliance industry and at least 4+ years of experience overseeing a consumer compliance program is a must
• Experience supporting a fast-scaling business
• Possess deep knowledge and real world application of all lending and banking laws and regulations including UDAAP, TILA, TISA, ECOA, FCRA, EFTA, MLA, SCRA, GLBA, and CAN-SPAM
• Proven track record of providing oversight and strategic vision for the entirety of a Compliance Management System (CMS)

It Pays to Work Here

 

The compensation benefits package for this role includes:
• Competitive starting pay
• A discretionary annual bonus
• Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant
• Comprehensive health plans
• 401K with company matching
• Paid Parental Leave
• Flexible time off

Salary Range: The base salary range for this role is between $150,500 - $215,000 in the State of New York. This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

In the United States, we offer a hybrid work approach at our hub offices, balancing the benefits of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Expectations may vary by location and role, so candidates are encouraged to connect with their recruiter to learn more about the specific policy for the role. Employees who do not live near one of our hubs are part of our remote workforce. All employees, however, are required to onboard in-person at one of our office locations.

At Gemini, we strive to build diverse teams that reflect the people we want to empower through our products, and we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Equal Opportunity is the Law, and Gemini is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a specific need that requires accommodation, please let a member of the People Team know.

jobs.title: Senior Fraud Data Scientist (Credit Card)
jobs.location: New York, New York; Miami, Florida; Remote (USA)
jobs.description:
About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Risk Engineering (Fraud Operations)

The Fraud Operations team is committed to protecting our users by stopping bad actors, safeguarding funds, and upholding the integrity of Gemini’s digital asset marketplace - all while operating at scale to deliver a seamless experience for our users. Our diverse team brings expertise across technology, legal, risk, data, and operations, leveraging advanced tools and analytics to protect users and disrupt fraud. We collaborate closely with product, engineering, operations, and compliance teams to manage risk effectively and support sustainable business growth.

The Role:

Senior Fraud Data Scientist (Credit Card)

As a Senior Fraud Data Scientist, you will play a critical role in protecting Gemini and our customers from emerging fraud risks. You’ll lead initiatives to strengthen our fraud prevention strategies, design and implement effective rules and controls, and proactively mitigate risk before it impacts our platform. Your work will range from evaluating fraud exposure to driving cross-functional projects that enhance detection capabilities and safeguard customer trust.

You are strategic, detail-oriented, and collaborative, with the ability to navigate complex risk landscapes while balancing prevention with a seamless customer experience. You thrive in fast-paced environments, excel at working independently, and bring deep subject matter expertise in fraud trends and mitigation techniques.

This role requires strong experience with fraud detection systems, risk management methodologies, and regulatory frameworks. You’ll partner closely with teams across product, engineering, operations, and compliance to deliver impactful improvements to risk controls. Strong analytical and technical skills are essential, including expert level proficiency in SQL (and other data tools), along with the ability to design, manage, and measure the effectiveness of fraud prevention rules.

This role requires on-call rotations.

Responsibilities:
• Program Development: Design and lead the development of end-to-end fraud prevention and detection strategies, including procedures, fraud rules, and controls.
• Risk Analysis: Conduct sophisticated data analysis on large datasets (structured and unstructured) to identify emerging fraud trends, patterns, and potential risks.
• Monitoring Optimization: Continuously monitor fraud prevention system performance, measure key risk metrics, and implement data-driven enhancements to improve accuracy and reduce false positives.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with data science, risk operations, product, engineering, and customer support teams to integrate fraud prevention into products and services.
• Project Management: Oversee initiatives aimed at advancing fraud detection systems and optimizing operational processes.
• Reporting Communication: Develop and deliver clear, actionable reports and insights for leadership and stakeholders, highlighting fraud risk exposure and the effectiveness of strategies and controls.

Minimum

Qualifications:
• 5+ years in fraud strategy, program management, or related risk management roles.
• Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in SQL, Python, Looker, and other data analysis and visualization tools.
• Hands-on experience with fraud detection and monitoring platforms, with the ability to analyze data and identify emerging fraud patterns.
• Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Track record of working effectively across cross-functional teams (e.g., product, engineering, operations, compliance) to achieve shared goals.
• Comfortable making sound decisions in ambiguous or rapidly changing environments; skilled at using data to drive informed choices.
• Demonstrated ability to lead and execute projects spanning multiple teams, balancing priorities and driving results.
• Strong critical-thinking skills with the ability to stay composed under pressure and resolve complex issues.
• Hands-on experience with fraud transaction monitoring for credit card or debit card.

Preferred

Qualifications:
• Strong expertise in detecting and mitigating fraud risk, including account takeover, synthetic identity, distributed attacks, payment fraud, and collusion.
• Proven experience addressing and preventing fraud in digital channels and card-not-present environments.
• In depth knowledge of ACH risks, including reversal flows and related vulnerabilities.
• Background working in fast paced, high growth environments, ideally within fintech or other technology driven industries.
• Comprehensive understanding of scam, phishing, and social engineering threats with experience implementing effective mitigation strategies.
• Knowledge of dispute representment requirements and industry best practices.
• Proven ability to thrive in fast paced, technology driven environments and adapt quickly to change.
• Familiarity with financial markets, banking, or digital asset exchanges.

Reporting to the GM Product, the Senior Product Manager will have the opportunity to shape Judo’s lending products from strategy through to execution. You’ll contribute to the roadmap, identify opportunities and develop new ideas, while staying close to the delivery, implementation and ongoing improvement of our products. Working across different teams, you’ll help turn ideas into meaningful improvements for our customers and the business.

Now, about this role…
• Work with the Product team to manage and optimise Judo’s lending products as commercial portfolios, balancing customer, banker, shareholder and regulatory needs.
• Shape lending product strategy and roadmaps, enhancing existing propositions and identifying new customer, growth and commercial opportunities.
• Use customer, financial, risk and market insights to drive portfolio performance, pricing, proposition development and better customer outcomes.
• Lead complex product initiatives end to end, from discovery and design through to execution and delivery, including product migrations, portfolio clean up, remediation and continuous improvement.
• Own and contribute to product governance, risk and regulatory requirements, balancing customer, commercial and compliance outcomes.
• Build trusted relationships across the business, partnering with teams to deliver product improvements and bring new ideas to life, while constructively challenging established thinking.

jobs.title: Compliance Manager

jobs.title: Head of BI & Analytics
jobs.location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
jobs.description:
Kuda, which means ‘love’ in Shona, is more than a fintech - it’s a movement to make financial services accessible, affordable, and truly rewarding for every African.

Backed by over $100 million from some of the world’s most respected investors, we’re building a smarter alternative to traditional banking - offering seamless money transfers, business banking, and instant access to credit, all through your device.

At Kuda, we don’t just build products - we build people. We share the love in how we collaborate, carry everyone along as we grow, break boundaries to challenge what’s possible, and show up every day committed to doing better.

If you’re driven by purpose, excited by impact, and ready to help redefine the future of finance in Africa, you’ll feel right at home here.

Role overview

Kuda is looking for a Head of BI & Analytics to lead our BI & Analytics function, delivering the trusted reporting and product insight that drive decisions across the business. You will lead a BI Engineering team scaling our semantic layer as the single, tested source of truth, and an Analytics team embedded in product squads driving deeper product insight and more advanced analytics.

You will lead adoption of our next-generation BI platform, expand self-serve and agentic AI use across the organisation, and set the strategy for how AI changes BI & Analytics work. You will work closely with the Heads of Product, CX, Marketing and Data Engineering.

Responsibilities
• Lead and develop a team spanning BI Engineering, pricing and product analytics, setting clear goals and raising the quality bar.
• Own the BI strategy and roadmap, including implementing our semantic layer in our new BI platform and extending governed, tested gold-layer domains as the single source of truth for core reporting.
• Drive adoption of the BI platform and agentic AI across Kuda, leading change management with product, CX, marketing and operations teams so trusted, self-serve data is used in everyday decisions.
• Own core business reporting and KPI definitions, ensuring accuracy, consistency and clear ownership across functions.
• Support the design and tracking of company and team OKRs.
• Develop the Analytics team as it deepens engagement with product squads: shaping roadmaps, experimentation, and the move from descriptive reporting to more advanced analytics.
• Help shape product and commercial strategy by building the analytical cases for decision making, and by partnering with Product and Finance to quantify trade-offs and expected impact.
• Support/ own forecasting and financial modelling, building models such as customer lifetime value, revenue and unit economics that inform planning and leadership decisions.
• Define Kuda's strategy for how AI will change BI & Analytics, from AI-assisted analysis and development to governed semantic models that AI agents can query reliably, and lead delivery within data privacy guardrails.
• Work closely with Data Engineering on data landing in our warehouse staging layer, agreeing standards for modelling, testing, deployment and release so new data products reach production quickly and reliably.
• Uphold and improve development best practices: version control, code review, documentation, data testing and monitoring, and retirement of reports and dashboards that are no longer used.
• Partner with the Heads of Product, CX, Marketing and Data Engineering to turn business questions into clear priorities, and present findings and recommendations to senior leadership.
• Proven experience leading data teams of managers, engineers and analysts, including developing people and managing performance.
• Strong SQL, with enough hands-on depth to review the team's work and set the technical standard.
• Strong understanding of data development practices, including how tables and models are built, tested, versioned and deployed into a data warehouse.
• Experience designing or scaling a semantic layer or governed metrics layer, and defining KPIs that the business trusts.
• Strong forecasting and modelling experience, including models such as lifetime value, revenue or unit economics that support commercial and product decisions.
• Experience shaping product strategy with data, for example through pricing, proposition or tier design, and influencing senior decision-makers.
• Track record of driving adoption of BI tools and data products among non-technical teams, including through change management and influencing without authority.
• Ability to partner with senior stakeholders, challenge priorities constructively and communicate clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Clear perspective on how AI is changing BI & Analytics, and the ability to turn it into a practical, responsible plan.

Nice to have
• Experience with BigQuery, Looker and Dataform (or dbt).
• Experience in fintech, banking or other financial services.
• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted analytics or agentic AI in a BI context.
• Experience with experimentation and advanced analytics methods in a product setting.
• Knowledge of African markets.
• Bachelor's degree in CS, Statistics, Business, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field.

At Kuda, our people are the heart of our business, so we prioritize your welfare. We offer a wide range of competitive benefits in areas including but not limited to:

💜A great and upbeat work environment populated by a multinational team

👴Pension

📈Career development & growth

😁Competitive annual leave plus bank holidays

🎁Competitive paid time off (Parental, Moving day, Birthday, Study leave etc)

💖Medical insurance

🥇Award winning L&D training

💒 We are advocates of work-life balance, working in a hybrid in office schedule

Kuda are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Kuda is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent.

We don’t regard colour, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
