jobs.title: Information Security Analyst - SecOps Response
jobs.description:
Starling is the UK's first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! Our vision is fast technology, fair service, and honest values. All at the tap of a phone, all the time.

We are about giving customers a new way to spend, save and manage their money while taking better care of the planet which has seen us become a multi-award winning bank that now employs over 2800 across five offices in London, Cardiff, Dublin, Southampton, and Manchester. Our journey started in 2014, and since then we have surpassed 3.5 million accounts (and four account types!) with 350,000 business customers. We are a fully licensed UK bank but at the heart, we are a tech first company, enabling our platform to deliver brilliant products.

Our technologists are at the very heart of Starling and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Starling is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, discovering, to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five Starling values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Starling - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. In Technology, we're asking that you attend the office a minimum of 1 day per week.

About the Role

We’re seeking a passionate and skilled Incident Responder to join our growing Security Operations team, and proactively defend Starling’s customers, assets, and systems against emerging threats. This role will be supporting our 24/7 operational capabilities (On-call rota).

Reporting to the Information Security Lead - SecOps Response, the analyst’s main responsibilities include:
• Conducting incident response activities to investigate and contain cyber security incidents
• Developing and maintaining incident response and readiness processes
• Analyse logs from a variety of sources (e.g. cloud, endpoint, network) to identify root cause and determine next steps for containment, eradication and recovery
• Plan and participate in Tabletop Exercises
• Document notes, analysis findings, containment steps, and cause for each security incident
• Work together with other teams in the organisation to analyse, contain, eradicate and recover from cyber security incidents
• Present investigation findings to technical and non-technical audiences
• Support the wider SecOps team with detection engineering and threat hunting
• 3+ years experience in a cyber incident response and digital forensics function
• Experience in handling incidents
• Experience in cloud forensics (GCP, AWS)
• Experience in endpoint and server forensics (Windows, MacOS, Linux)
• Experience in network forensics
• Experience with forensics data acquisition, disk forensics and memory forensics
• Experience in supporting and planning Tabletop Exercises

jobs.title: Group Compliance Monitoring & Data Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Purpose

Establish and own the analytics and technical reporting capability within Core Compliance. This senior individual contributor combines analytics engineering depth with the judgement to set direction, translate complex Compliance processes into dependable data products, and drive delivery across organisational boundaries.

The role adds dedicated technical expertise and hands-on delivery capacity to extend what Group Compliance can monitor, analyse and report.

Working closely with the CCSDE Lead and other relevant leads, this person will establish the Core Compliance analytics repository and delivery approach in line with wider Wise analytics best practices. They will own implementation for Core Compliance systems and tools where capability or capacity gaps exist, and lead the coordination of changes that require delivery by established analytics or Engineering teams.

Scope

The role owns the technical quality and delivery of the analytics assets established within its agreed Core Compliance remit. Other analytics and Engineering teams retain their existing responsibilities for shared platforms, datasets and wider analytics delivery. Changes to those capabilities are agreed and implemented with their owners.

Existing analytics teams retain their request-collection processes. This role works within Group Compliance to identify and deliver capability improvements and provide senior technical engagement on analytics issues.

Responsibilities

Own the technical foundations for Core Compliance analytics
• Design and establish the Core Compliance repository and analytics delivery setup, working with Engineering and analytics partners on the use of dbt, Airflow, Snowflake and Lightdash within the existing Wise environment.
• Make and document design decisions for models, transformations, orchestration and reporting: source selection, data grain, keys, historical changes, refresh dependencies and recovery behaviour.
• Establish GitHub development and review practices, automated checks, release procedures, access arrangements and documentation aligned with wider standards. Ensure the setup can support multiple use cases and be maintained by others.
• Agree the interfaces, dependencies and support responsibilities with the teams that own shared infrastructure and upstream datasets.

 

Deliver and operate models pipelines and reporting
• Write SQL and dbt models, implement workflow orchestration in Airflow, and build reporting in Lightdash on Snowflake for systems and tools within the Core Compliance remit.
• Take work through discovery, design, implementation, validation, release and ongoing improvement. Exercise technical judgement on when to reuse an existing capability, extend a local model or coordinate an upstream change.
• Address practical engineering concerns such as incremental processing, historical accuracy, duplicate or late data, safe reprocessing and query performance where they affect the use case.
• Define and implement checks for completeness, accuracy, freshness and reconciliation, together with actionable failure notifications and documented recovery procedures for the components owned by Core Compliance.
• Investigate issues through the data flow, resolve defects within the role's ownership and work with upstream owners on source or platform issues.

Develop trusted metrics and actionable analysis
• Create ad hoc analysis, reports, dashboards and metrics across CCSDE and CMT, connecting the output to the monitoring, oversight or operational decision it needs to support.
• Translate process concepts such as reporting deadlines, ownership, workflow status, ageing and completion into explicit metric definitions and data models. Account for exceptions and changes over time.
• Validate analytical results against source records, explain material limitations and ensure that colleagues can understand and use the outputs with confidence.
• Establish reusable definitions and reporting assets where needs recur, with documented lineage, ownership and quality expectations. Retain the ability to answer new questions quickly through focused analysis.

Set priorities and lead delivery across teams
• Identify the most valuable gaps in Core Compliance's monitoring and reporting capability and develop a prioritised delivery roadmap with the relevant leads.
• Act as the principal Core Compliance contact on analytics issues, bringing the technical understanding needed to establish scope, resolve unclear ownership and agree implementation approaches with partner teams.
• Drive dependencies and cross-team decisions through to delivery. Make trade-offs between immediate analytical needs, maintainability and partner capacity, and communicate their implications clearly.
• Coordinate updates and implementations owned by other teams while remaining accountable for defining the Core Compliance need and validating that the resulting capability meets it.

Apply AI and agentic workflows with technical judgement
• Use approved AI tools and agent harnesses in analytics and development workflows, including SQL and dbt development, test generation, documentation, data investigation and review.
• Develop useful GitHub-based working practices and agentic workflows that improve delivery speed and consistency, with clear review, testing and access boundaries.
• Evaluate generated code and analytical outputs against source data and expected behaviour. Assess the practical benefit of these workflows and share effective approaches with colleagues.

jobs.title: Core Compliance Systems, Data & Enablement (CCSDE) Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
Purpose

Support the CCSDE Lead in delivering reliable, effective Compliance workflows through Compliance systems. The CCSDE Lead sets design and engineering direction; this role translates that direction into tested workflow changes, dependable access administration and responsive support for Compliance officers.

The role takes ownership of day-to-day execution within agreed designs and controls, identifies recurring problems and helps improve how Compliance teams use Compliance systems.

Scope
• Deliver Compliance systems workflow and automation changes. Configure workflows, fields, forms, routing and business rules under the CCSDE Lead's design direction. Clarify requirements, identify dependencies, execute business acceptance testing and document results before release. Maintain the workflow and automation register, including business purpose, owner, dependencies, last test date and fallback process. Identify unused or duplicate workflows for retirement.
• Execute Compliance access management. Run joiner, mover, leaver and periodic access recertification processes across relevant Core Compliance systems. Maintain approval and completion records. Coordinate privileged access requests with UT and Privacy under agreed controls, escalating exceptions to the appropriate owner.
• Maintain documentation and the knowledge base. Keep runbooks, wikis, troubleshooting guidance and process documentation current. Review content for staleness and ensure documentation is updated alongside material releases.
• Support Compliance officers using Compliance systems. Act as the first point of contact for user and process questions, including form selection, known workarounds, access queries and initial investigation of workflow or business-rule issues. Capture reproducible evidence and escalate technical defects or platform issues to UT. Track resolution times, recurring themes and adoption issues.
• Deliver training and change communication. Prepare user guidance, onboard Compliance officers and communicate workflow changes to affected regional teams. Support training and adoption for AI agents used by Compliance, following approved guidance.
• Contribute to maintaining the regional feedback network. Coordinate regional champions or equivalent contacts, gather feedback and identify work happening outside established systems. Translate findings into clear improvement proposals for the CCSDE Lead.
• Contribute operational and access data. Provide accurate information to the Data, Metrics & MI Forum when relevant, including support trends, access activity and workflow adoption.

 

Decision rights

The role owns execution within agreed designs, priorities and access controls. Design decisions, material exceptions and changes to control requirements are escalated to the CCSDE Lead or the relevant control owner.

P1 - Compliance systems, workflow and controls
• Workflow and automation configuration changes: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery, under the Lead's design direction.
• Business acceptance testing: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery.
• Workflow and automation register maintenance: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery.

P3 - Access, systems and knowledge governance
• Joiner, mover, leaver and access recertification execution: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery.
• Documentation, runbooks and staleness reviews: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery.

P5 - Operations, enablement and regional experience
• Compliance officer support: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery.
• Compliance systems and AI agent training and change communication: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery.
• Regional feedback and tracking work outside established systems: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - North America Risk Prevention
jobs.description:
The team you will be working with: North America Risk Prevention

The North America Risk team is a critical engine within Wise, focusing on our largest and most dynamic market: North America.

 

About the Team 

Our mission is to protect our customers and the business by staying ahead of financial crime. We handle billions of volume through robust risk and fraud prevention systems that operate at the speed of our customers. 

What we do
• Real-Time Decision Making: We leverage cutting-edge machine learning to run risk assessments instantly, every time a customer uses the calculator (create a quote for a transaction), ensuring a seamless yet secure experience
• Enabling Unique Features: We own the risk infrastructure for Instant ACH, one of our most unique and high-value features in the US market. Instant ACH provides instant transfers despite the payment network not supporting that
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Software Engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Scientists collaborate on a daily basis to design new rules, refine ML models, and provide critical support to our chargeback and fraud investigation teams
• Future-Proofing: While focused on fraud today, we are expanding our scope to handle comprehensive risk types in the US and Canada, including Sanctions and AML (Anti-Money Laundering)

How we work

The team is distributed across Budapest and Austin. We work closely with our US-based colleagues to understand the North American market and customer needs, with occasional travel to the US to foster in-person collaboration.

 

What does it take?
• 4+ years of experience with Java, Kotlin, or other JVM-based languages, with deep knowledge of the Spring framework.
• Obsession with Latency: You can design technical solutions that optimize for both throughput and speed. You understand what it takes to keep p99 end-to-end latency under 1 second for real-time risk & fraud checks, even when handling billions of transaction volumes.
• Data & Distributed Systems: Deep understanding of JDBC, database internals, and query optimization. You have hands-on experience with Kafka, Kafka Streams, or Apache Flink to handle real-time event processing.
• Infrastructure: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and designing scalable, resilient distributed systems.
• Product & User Focus: You prioritize work with the customer in mind, using data to fix pain points (like false positives). You understand that risk checks happen every time a user touches the calculator, and you care about that UX.
• Ownership: You take end-to-end ownership of your projects, from the initial idea to monitoring it in production.
• Communication: You can articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
• Cross-Functional collaboration

experience:

You are comfortable working daily with Data Scientists to put models into production and with Data Analysts to refine rule sets.

 

It is even better if You have
• ML Fluency: Since we deploy models for Instant ACH and transaction monitoring, familiarity with machine learning basics: data pipelines, feature engineering, precision/recall.
• Data Lake

Experience:

Experience with OLAP databases or data lakes (like Apache Iceberg) with Kafka ingestion is an advantage.

 

What does success look like?
• Impact on Financial Crime: You will understand the specific fraud vectors and how your code directly prevents financial loss while keeping good customers happy.
• Scaling for the Future: You’ll help raise the automation level of our platform, preparing our systems to handle new risk types in the US and Canada, such as Sanctions screening and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) and other controls.
• Operational Excellence: You’ll contribute to a culture of "you build it, you run it," ensuring our real-time monitoring systems are robust and reliable for the North American market.
• Global Collaboration: You’ll find your place by building strong relationships with the wider engineering tribe and our US stakeholders, understanding the "why" behind every feature we build.

jobs.title: Head of KYC Operations - EMEA
jobs.description:
Your mission

Your mission is to lead the KYC Operations Function organization to Ensure its Compliance and Provide Instant Service with best-in-class Quality. And to do this in a scalable, cost-efficient manner, working in partnership with other Wise teams and functions, most prominently with Wise Product and Compliance. 

What you’ll be doing

In this role, you will lead a team of Area Leads and their functional areas to drive strategic direction and operational excellence. You are responsible for setting and executing strategic objectives, building high-performing teams, and ensuring they meet operational and quality targets. The role usually involves overseeing 150+ employees across multiple locations both Internally and Outsourced, ensuring achieving the organization's mission, and aligning operational strategies with business goals 

You will need to ensure the top-notch delivery in your team’s Quality, Compliance, Speed and Cost of Operations. Some examples of your Success metrics might include but not be limited to:
• For the Customers: Quality of KYC Function processes (false positive and negatives), Resolution of customer-facing cases, Response SLA, KYC-related appeals upheld
• For Wise: False Positives, False Negatives, Customer Attrition during onboarding, Handling Time, Risk Indicators, Cost per Contact
• For Wisers: Engagement Score, Attrition, Rewards

 

A few ways in which you’ll contribute to Wise’s success in this role

Setting the Strategy for KYC Operations Function
• Lead the design of the vision and strategy for your team, aligned with the overall Servicing Strategy, in making the processes more compliant, faster, better and more scalable, with a clear customer focus

Building the best processes
• Build and develop a robust and compliant customer onboarding program
• Build the necessary support systems for the processes: Metrics, Targets, Governance
• Utilize data and user research to optimize our on-boarding experience and transform how we currently fight financial crime and fulfill regulatory obligations
• Drive improvement initiatives and manage an efficient process while providing continuous effective risk management and control
• Manage and optimize 3rd party services and outsourced vendors across the KYC operating model
• Work closely with our Risk and Compliance teams to align on risk appetites and capabilities to support the growth of the business

Nurturing a great team
• Ensure that the right KYC Operations Function organization and the right leaders are in place
• Build and develop a people strategy that allows execution upon the vision - cross functions and locations
• Revamp the People management processes together with the People Operations team - skills, career paths, performance management
• Oversight of team's budgets and high level reporting.
• Set KPIs and developmental objectives across the current team of 150+ people (regional teams across across the globe)

Partnering with Product
• Work closely with Product teams to ship and deliver best in market KYC products and experiences to our customers 

This is not intended to be an exhaustive list. As the overall lead of this function, you are expected to take on, and hold accountability for, anything that is required in order to deliver on the mission and the performance of this function.

jobs.title: KYC Operations Team Lead - Consumer
jobs.description:
Role & Job purpose

As a KYC Operations Team Lead you will oversee the daily operations of a team of KYC Analysts. Your team is responsible for conducting thorough customer due diligence reviews, analysing various customer and business activities, and ensuring that our KYC records are kept up to date according to our internal policies. The KYC Operations Team Lead is a people lead with a mindset focused on building processes that put our customers first while being aware of the risks surrounding the industry and the wider regulatory environment.

 

Job Responsibilities
• Team Leadership

Lead by example and drive a customer focused mindset across your team. Promote a culture of ownership and accountability. Build high-performing teams that value knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
• People management

Coach and develop a strong team of KYC Analysts. Come up with initiatives to help your team to grow their skills, behaviours, and competencies. Design and manage development plans on identified opportunities. Conducts career map check-ins and makes recommendations for promotions, salary raises, and other decisions.
• Operational management

Identify and propose opportunities for process improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase operational efficiency. Provide guidance and support on complex, high-risk cases and escalations, which may include acting as a direct point of contact for customers via email, phone, or video call during sensitive inquiries, interviews, or escalations.
• Performance management

Measure team KPIs and ensure performance targets and quality standards are met while maintaining focus on customer experience. Conduct regular one on one coaching sessions, usually on a weekly or biweekly basis. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best practices and enhance overall team spirit.
• Expertise Sharing

Be a subject matter expert in your area with the ability to train and coach your team on operational topics. Maintain a good understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, and applying a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Able to perform deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership.
• Planning and execution

Ensure key performance indicators are being met and provide insights to other stakeholders. Take full accountability in delivering your own initiatives and making sure your team is making progress on their goals.
• Stakeholder management and communication

Collaborate closely with your stakeholders ensuring clear communication and coordination of actions. You communicate mindfully and professionally while choosing the right formats and platforms to convey your message to a wider audience in a timely manner. Your initiatives and reports are well documented and it has a clear scope that includes potential impact in different areas.

Implement and maintain a robust quality assurance framework for your team. Conduct regular checks and reviews of your team’s casework to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to the highest standards of our policies and regulatory obligations. Provide targeted coaching and constructive feedback based on quality findings to drive continuous improvement. Analyse quality metrics to identify trends, address root causes of errors, and develop initiatives that enhance the team's overall performance and mitigate risk.

jobs.title: Spend Operations Supply Chain & Delivery Function Lead
jobs.description:
Your mission: 

Wise is building a scalable, transparent, and cost-efficient card issuance supply chain. We’re looking for a Supply Chain Function Lead – Card Issuance to own the multi-year strategy for card manufacturing and delivery, design the operating model for a high-performing global supply chain function, and lead our partner portfolio end-to-end—from selection and governance to commercial negotiations and performance.

A core part of this role is senior partner stakeholder management: you’ll represent Wise externally, keep vendors accountable to outcomes, and influence partner priorities and behaviours to protect Wise’s customer experience, cost, and resilience goals.

What you’ll do

Set strategy & build the operating model
• Define and drive the 1–3 year strategy for card manufacturing and delivery—balancing service levels, product experience, cost-to-serve, and transparency.
• Design the operating model for a scalable global supply chain function (team structure, governance cadence, escalation paths, decision forums, metrics/scorecards).
• Own the monitoring roadmap (coverage, controls, ROI) so issues are detected early and resolved through clear ownership.

Own the partner portfolio & drive vendor accountability (critical)
• Lead the global partner portfolio strategy (manufacturer + delivery partners), including multi-vendor coverage and concentration risk management.
• Establish high-impact vendor governance:
• performance scorecards (SLA, quality, lead times, loss/damage, scan compliance, complaints, transparency)
• structured escalation and remediation playbooks
• root-cause expectations and corrective action plans with deadlines
• Represent Wise in senior partner forums and ensure Wise priorities are executed
• Proactively identify underperformance and lead exec-level decisions: invest / fix / replace, including transition planning and risk-managed migrations.

Lead commercial negotiation & contract strategy
• Negotiate contracts end-to-end with a strong commercial stance: pricing models, volume tiers, indexation, cost drivers.
• Build robust contract architecture: SLAs/KPIs with meaningful remedies (credits/penalties/step-in rights), auditability, data transparency, and strong exit/transition clauses.
• Continuously challenge cost-to-serve while protecting customer experience.

Influence cross-functionally & deliver change
• Partner with Product, Ops, Risk, Compliance, Finance and Customer Support to define requirements and design scalable solutions.
• Lead cross-functional programmes for supply-chain changes (launch readiness, risk assessment, communications, stakeholder alignment).
• Communicate clearly to senior stakeholders using data-driven narratives and crisp trade-offs.

Lead and grow the function
• Hire, coach and develop the supply chain team; build capability, set standards, and drive performance.
• Set a high bar for ownership, transparency and execution—internally and with partners.

What success looks like
• A clear 1–3 year supply chain strategy and annual plan with measurable targets.
• A resilient partner portfolio with primary/secondary coverage per region and tested transition playbooks.
• Measurable improvements in vendor performance: stronger SLA attainment, fewer delivery exceptions, better scan/comms transparency, and reduced cost-to-serve.
• Executive dashboards that enable fast decisions and clear accountability.

jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Specialist - APAC Payments
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Product Operations Specialist - APAC Payments to join our APAC Regional Payment Operations team in Singapore.

Payments Product Operations turns recurring customer and operational friction into scalable Product change. In this senior individual-contributor role, you will own a meaningful part of the APAC portfolio. Your assignment may change with regional priorities and could include a market portfolio, Product domain, new direct integration or complex cross-market opportunity.

This is a hands-on role. You will set direction and influence senior decisions, but you must also be comfortable working in the detail: exploring data, writing SQL, investigating root causes, defining requirements and driving execution through to adoption and measurable impact.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Regional Operations, as well as other cross-functional teams across Wise. You will also help raise the standard of strategic, analytical and Product-facing work across the Payments Product Operations team.

What you’ll do
• Own the direction and outcomes for an assigned part of the APAC portfolio, aligned with regional priorities and the Payments Product Operations Technical Lead.
• Identify, investigate and prioritise material customer, payment-performance and operational problems; establish root causes, size their impact and recommend addressable interventions.
• Shape roadmaps and technical solutions with Product and Engineering, balancing customer impact, scalability, risk, effort and business value.
• Build compelling business cases and recommendations that secure senior stakeholder support and investment.
• Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives end to end - from discovery and solution design through operational readiness, delivery and benefit validation - while remaining hands-on with requirement gathering, data analysis and implementation.
• Design scalable workflows, tools and controls that reduce recurring customer friction, manual work, operational cost or risk.
• Lead or support complex launches such as new markets, direct integrations and material payment-system changes.
• Identify and test automation and AI opportunities with appropriate validation, controls, human oversight and benefit measurement.
• Develop reusable approaches and mentor Payments Product Operations Specialists to take on broader and more complex ownership.

The role will give you the opportunity to
• Own high-impact opportunities across an evolving APAC portfolio.
• Influence Product direction through customer insight, operational evidence, technical understanding and business value.
• Lead work from an ambiguous problem to a delivered solution with verified impact.
• Work on strategically important changes including new markets, direct integrations, partner improvements, automation and scalable payment capabilities.
• Apply modern data, automation and AI tools to real operational and customer problems.

jobs.title: Director, Marketing Operations
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Marketing at Brex

The Marketing team tells the Brex story, turning product innovation into customer obsession. We develop messaging, shape the brand, and bring our platform to life through thoughtful, compelling content. Our team spans Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, and Brand Marketing, and works cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Business Development, and Design to drive growth and build trust.

What you'll do

You will lead the systems, data, and operations that turn demand into qualified sales conversations and help Marketing make better investment decisions. Your operating mandate runs from lead capture through qualified meetings; your measurement mandate extends through pipeline and closed revenue.

Partnering with the Senior Director of Growth Marketing, you will build the team and set the technical roadmap for a more reliable, scalable funnel across enterprise sales and self-serve motions, including Brex and Capital One integrations.

In your first year, you will establish baselines and targets with Growth Marketing, Revenue Operations, and SDR leadership to improve meaningful follow-up, routing accuracy, qualified meetings, and meeting-to-opportunity conversion, while building trusted funnel data and faster campaign delivery.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in one of our hubs: San Francisco, New York, Seattle, Salt Lake City, or Vancouver. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end marketing funnel from demand capture through sales handoff, including qualification, enrichment, scoring, routing, automation, and measurement.
• Partner with SDR, RevOps, Product, Engineering, and Data Science to improve funnel throughput, speed-to-lead, conversion, and reliability.
• Design scalable workflows across sales-led and self-serve motions, including emerging Capital One lead sources.
• Own the marketing technology ecosystem and integrations across Marketo, Salesforce, LeanData, web/CMS, analytics, advertising, and other GTM platforms.
• Set the architecture and operating standards that ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and connected.
• Lead major platform improvements and evaluate new capabilities, including CDP and AI-enabled workflows.
• Own the quality and governance of marketing and prospect data, including identity, enrichment, segmentation, taxonomy, and attribution.
• Establish trusted funnel and performance measurement in partnership with RevOps, Finance, Data, and Engineering.
• Translate data into recommendations that improve marketing efficiency, sales handoffs, and investment decisions.
• Lead and develop the Marketing Operations team while establishing clear priorities, operating rhythms, service levels, and accountability.
• Build scalable processes for intake, prioritization, capacity planning, documentation, and execution.
• Serve as a highly autonomous thought partner to Growth Marketing leadership and drive alignment across Marketing, Sales, RevOps, Product, Engineering, and Finance.

Requirements
• 8+ years in marketing operations, revenue operations, or growth operations, including 3+ years leading and developing a team.
• Measurable improvements to lead-to-meeting conversion, with experience supporting both enterprise sales and self-serve or product-led motions.
• Deep hands-on architecture experience in Marketo or an equivalent marketing automation platform, plus strong Salesforce fluency and shared platform ownership with Revenue Operations.
• Experience designing scalable lifecycle, scoring, routing, campaign taxonomy, and data governance practices.
• Strong measurement judgment, including understanding attribution limitations, plus SQL and BI fluency to investigate performance independently.
• A track record of using pipeline or forecast models to inform decisions and aligning cross-functional partners on execution.
• Experience managing martech vendors and increasing team capacity through automation and reusable processes.
• Experience running marketing systems as production infrastructure, including monitoring, incident response, and change control on revenue-facing workflows.
• Experience running intake and prioritization for a team serving many internal stakeholders, with capacity planning that holds up under pressure.

Bonus points
• Experience in fintech, financial services, or another regulated environment.
• Technical partnership with Product and Engineering on signup flows or identity resolution.
• Experience with holdouts, incrementality testing, or media mix modeling.
• Experience with marketing financial planning and reporting.
• AI or agent-assisted workflows with measurable results.
• Hands-on experience with LeanData, Qualified, Hex, a customer data platform, or integration and workflow tools such as Retool.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $185,320 - $231,650. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate's location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

As an Enterprise Account Director, you’ll own a portfolio of high-value accounts within Brex’s Enterprise segment. Your role will be pivotal in fostering business expansion and ensuring sustained client success through disciplined execution, strategic influence, and consultative engagement.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. Responsibilities
• Drive revenue growth across your book by strategically increasing card adoption and expanding client use of Brex’s Spend Management suite (Expense Management, Bill Pay, Travel, and global payments)
• Drive long-term retention by understanding client health and business needs, proactively developing and executing strategies to mitigate churn risk and solidify partnerships
• Proactively identify and prioritize expansion opportunities by analyzing account performance, usage headroom, and competitive signals
• Lead renewal and expansion cycles end-to-end, from early account strategy through negotiation and close, ensuring strong commercial outcomes
• Build executive-level relationships and multi-thread across stakeholders (finance, procurement, and operations) to strengthen account resilience, act as a trusted advisor, and uncover new areas for adoption and growth
• Operate with ownership, anticipating client needs, addressing risks early, and taking accountability for revenue and retention outcomes
• Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Solutions Consultants, Underwriting, RevOps, and Product to deliver unified client outcomes
• Maintain rigorous sales discipline with consistent pipeline hygiene, accurate forecasting, and comprehensive account planning.
• Surface insights and advocate for clients internally, influencing product roadmap and operational improvements
• Solve complex problems with judgment and creativity, converting competitive threats or risks into opportunities for retention and expansion

Requirements
• 10+ years of B2B closing experience in SaaS, payments, or financial technology
• Proven success managing enterprise-level accounts with complex deal cycles, executive engagement, and multi-threaded relationships
• Consistent record of exceeding quota and delivering top performance in competitive sales environments
• Demonstrated mastery of renewal and expansion cycles, including high-value negotiations and competitive displacements
• Track record of driving net revenue growth through upsell, cross-sell, and adoption of multi-product solutions
• Proficiency with sales tools and systems such as Salesforce, Outreach, and Gong, with strong pipeline and forecast discipline

Preferred qualifications
• Deep knowledge of corporate cards, underwriting, rewards, or credit risk management
• Experience selling financial operations platforms (expense, travel, AP, or global payments)
• Recognition as a top performer (President’s Club, top stack rank, etc.) in prior roles
• Exposure to enterprise procurement processes and competitive SaaS/fintech sales cycles

Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

Sales is the growth engine at Brex. We bring in new customers, expand existing relationships, and drive the company’s bottom line. With unlimited territories and uncapped opportunity, your ambition sets the ceiling. We win together, celebrate often, and reward performance. If you want to sell a category-defining product with real ownership, this is your team.

What you’ll do

As an Enterprise Client Sales Executive, you’ll own a portfolio of high-value accounts within Brex’s Enterprise segment. Your role will be pivotal in fostering business expansion and ensuring sustained client success through disciplined execution, strategic influence, and consultative engagement.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Wednesday and Thursday. We currently require three days per week in office - Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Drive revenue growth across your book by strategically increasing card adoption and expanding client use of Brex’s Spend Management suite (Expense Management, Bill Pay, Travel, and global payments)
• Drive long-term retention by understanding client health and business needs, proactively developing and executing strategies to mitigate churn risk and solidify partnerships
• Proactively identify and prioritize expansion opportunities by analyzing account performance, usage headroom, and competitive signals
• Lead renewal and expansion cycles end-to-end, from early account strategy through negotiation and close, ensuring strong commercial outcomes
• Build executive-level relationships and multi-thread across stakeholders (finance, procurement, and operations) to strengthen account resilience, act as a trusted advisor, and uncover new areas for adoption and growth
• Operate with ownership, anticipating client needs, addressing risks early, and taking accountability for revenue and retention outcomes
• Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Solutions Consultants, Underwriting, RevOps, and Product to deliver unified client outcomes
• Maintain rigorous sales discipline with consistent pipeline hygiene, accurate forecasting, and comprehensive account planning.
• Surface insights and advocate for clients internally, influencing product roadmap and operational improvements
• Solve complex problems with judgment and creativity, converting competitive threats or risks into opportunities for retention and expansion

Requirements

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Application Security
jobs.description:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About the role

MetaMask is a self-custody wallet that does not hold users’ private keys. Blockchain transactions are generally irreversible, meaning a vulnerability in the product or its software delivery chain can lead directly to financial losses for users. As a result, MetaMask attracts sustained attention from financially motivated attackers and sophisticated supply chain actors.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Application Security to lead application security across the MetaMask extension, mobile app, Snaps, backend services, DeFi primitives, stablecoins, and supporting smart contracts.

The role covers architecture, code, dependencies, build and release controls, security testing, and vulnerability disclosure. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the strategy and operating model, lead a small senior team, and remain directly involved in code review and threat modelling.

You will report to the Head of Security and work closely with MetaMask Engineering leadership to ensure security risks are understood, owned, and addressed.

Responsibilities

Leadership and planning
• Lead and develop the Application Security team, including hiring, performance management and career development, while remaining directly involved in technical work.
• Set the Application Security strategy, annual goals and quarterly OKRs in line with company objectives and the approved Target Operating Model. Define and track KPIs to measure performance and progress.
• Report AppSec progress, coverage, remediation performance and material gaps to Security leadership and contribute to Risk Committee reporting.

Secure design and delivery
• Define security review requirements across development and release, assess whether they are met and escalate unresolved risks.
• Lead threat modelling and security design reviews across clients, APIs and backend services, including authentication, key management, signing and delegated actions. Assess trust boundaries across the full system and participate in architecture and RFC reviews.
• Define software supply chain security requirements and work with engineering teams to implement and validate controls for dependencies, builds, artefacts and publishing.
• Lead security code reviews across MetaMask applications and smart contracts, working with engineers and relevant specialists to address findings.
• Define and evolve the secure development lifecycle to incorporate AI agents, including their access, actions and human review requirements. Set security standards for AI development tools, generated code and AI components in products.
• Integrate security testing into development and delivery workflows, including static and dynamic analysis, dependency scanning, secrets detection and AI scanning. Evaluate tools and validate their findings.
• Help engineers prevent recurring vulnerabilities through secure coding guidance, reusable libraries, training and the security champions programme.

Vulnerability management and external testing
• Own application vulnerability assessment, triage, prioritisation and remediation tracking within the organisation’s vulnerability management framework. Correlate findings across clients, services and supporting infrastructure with the relevant owners to assess combined impact. Ensure findings have clear owners and deadlines, verify fixes and escalate overdue risks.
• Set the scope and proposed investment for bug bounty, penetration testing and AI security scanning based on risk and results. Manage external providers, researcher relationships, rewards and payouts, and coordinate vulnerability disclosure.

Assurance and incident support
• Provide evidence of application security controls for audits and assurance reviews, and support customer and partner due diligence.
• Provide application security expertise during incidents, including vulnerability analysis and remediation support.

Qualifications

Required:
• At least eight years in application security or software engineering with a security focus, including two years leading people.
• Strong practical code review skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, Go or Solidity across browser extensions, mobile applications and backend services, with the ability to identify vulnerabilities and work with engineers to fix them.
• Proven experience securing applications across clients and backend services, including distributed authentication, authorisation and key management.
• Experience building or substantially improving an AppSec programme, including security reviews, automated testing, AI scanning, vulnerability management and developer support, with sound judgement on where AI adds value and how to validate its findings.
• Practical experience securing software supply chains, including dependency policies, software composition analysis, npm, artefact integrity and CI/CD.
• Experience running bug bounty and penetration testing programmes, including selecting and managing external providers.
• Working knowledge of EVM smart contract security, including common vulnerabilities, review methods, upgrade and admin controls, and assessing external audits.
• A record of delivering security improvements through engineering teams outside your reporting line.
• Clear written communication, from actionable threat models to concise summaries of risk for executives.

Preferred:
• Offensive security qualifications such as OSCP, OSWE or OSWA, or a proven record in bug bounty programmes or CTF competitions.
• Experience securing browser extensions or mobile applications.
• Experience securing development workflows that use AI, or AI components in production applications.
• Experience in crypto, Web3 or another sector facing sustained attacks, such as fintech, payments or infrastructure.
• Knowledge of or a strong interest in applied cryptography.
• Familiarity with attacks by state actors against software companies, particularly DPRK supply chain and social engineering campaigns.
• Experience providing evidence of secure development controls for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 assessments.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

MetaMask is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself, which can be found on our page.

MetaMask may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, or conducting initial candidate assessments. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and improve efficiency — they do not replace human judgment. A human recruiter or hiring manager reviews every candidate, and all final hiring decisions are made by people, not AI.

It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants may be required to submit to background and identity verification checks, including but not limited to employment, education, criminal record checks, and other such checks as determined necessary by the company.

jobs.description:

2019. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, it powers most of the country’s Point of Sale (POS) transactions. Through its subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes $22 billion monthly for its customers while operating profitably.

About the role

We’re looking for a Copywriter to join our Creative team.This role is for you if you’re a strong writer, a curious thinker, and a customer-focused creative who knows how to turn ideas and insights into clear, engaging copy that people understand and act on.

You’ll work across Marketing, Product, Growth, CRM, Social, and Design to create communications for Moniepoint’s products and customers, from campaigns and product launches to CRM, social media content, performance ads, and everything in between, to develop messaging that supports acquisition, engagement, retention, and customer loyalty.

About you:

• Adaptable :You can move between a campaign headline, product script, CRM campaign, or performance marketing copy, without losing the core idea or brand voice

What we can offer you

What to expect in the hiring process

• A take home assessment
• Final interview + Assessment presentation

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.title: Finance & Accounting Analyst
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX Brazil is building its finance function from the ground up while preparing for supervision by the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) under the new virtual asset service provider (SPSAV/PSAV) framework. We are looking for a Finance Accounting Analyst to join our Brazil team and take ownership of core day-to-day accounting, accounts payable, and tax-compliance operations.

You will work alongside the Senior Finance Manager and the Finance Accounting Specialist, in a role where accuracy, documentation, and discipline matter. Our books will soon be reviewed by a regulator, not only by auditors. This is a strong opportunity for someone early in their career who wants hands-on exposure to financial regulation, crypto, and Brazil’s tax reform.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Accounting Month-End Close
• Prepare monthly close activities, including journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, prepayments, and recurring accounting schedules.
• Prepare and review intercompany journal entries and reconcile intercompany balances with affiliates to ensure accuracy and consistency.
• Maintain close checklists and supporting documentation in FloQast and NetSuite, meeting group reporting deadlines.
• Support the local Portuguese-language books, helping keep entries aligned with Brazilian GAAP and the BCB chart of accounts (COSIF) as we prepare for regulated status.
• Accounts Payable Expense Management
• Process vendor invoices, employee reimbursements, and weekly payment batches in line with internal policies and approval matrices.
• Validate vendor documentation and apply the correct tax treatment before payment.
• Review withholding taxes on vendor payments (IRRF, PIS/COFINS/CSLL, INSS, ISS), and keep payment files and supporting documents audit-ready.
• Tax Compliance Support
• Issue electronic invoices for company operations, ensuring accuracy and compliance with municipal and federal requirements.
• Support the monthly review of VAT and CIT calculations and maintain supporting documentation.
• Support tax-to-accounting reconciliations and coordinate with our outsourced accounting firm on filings and information requests.
• Help us follow and prepare for the Brazilian tax reform (IBS/CBS) transition, including the impact on invoicing, vendor payments, and ERP configuration.
• Audit Controls
• Support external audit and group-level audit requests: prepare PBC lists, schedules, and reconciliations.
• Follow documented controls and flag exceptions or gaps. Contribute to SOPs and process improvements as we build a controlled environment suited to a regulated entity.

What We’re Looking For
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (CRC registration is a plus).
• 3+ years of experience in accounting, preferably in financial services, fintech, crypto, or big 4.
• Solid knowledge of IFRS and BR GAAP/CPC. Familiarity with tax is a plus.
• Hands-on experience with month-end closing, reconciliations, and AP processes.
• Strong attention to detail, a sense of ownership, and the discipline to document your work.
• Intermediate-to-advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups); Power Query is a plus.
• Hands-on, responsible use of AI tools to improve speed and quality of work, while validating outputs and protecting sensitive data.
• Professional proficiency in English: you will work daily with international teams and prepare documentation for the group in English.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with international teams across time zones.

Nice to Have
• Experience in an institution regulated by the BCB or familiarity with COSIF.
• Exposure to crypto or digital assets, or interest in learning about them.
• Experience with NetSuite, FloQast, or similar ERP/close tools.
• Exposure to intercompany transactions or transfer pricing.
• Experience with external audits.

 

Perks Benefits

• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependents
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the Team

We sit on the front lines of OKX's security and compliance mission. Our charter is to build the flexible, scalable, and intelligent AI systems that detect and prevent identity fraud, account takeover, and large-scale organized abuse — in real time and at the scale of a global financial platform. We own the core identity-risk capabilities that decide, millions of times a day, whether an account can be trusted: identity trust signals, behavioral risk modeling, relationship and cluster intelligence, and face, liveness and document verification. We work shoulder-to-shoulder with Product, Risk, Compliance, and Engineering to turn the hardest adversarial problems in crypto into production-grade defenses that protect good users and the open financial system.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and own key identity-risk and trust models at OKX. You will build models that combine identity verification results, device and geo data, and user behavior into trust and risk signals, and use graph and clustering methods to uncover organized, industrialized fraud. This is an end-to-end, research-to-production role: you will own algorithms in your domain and ship models into real-money, high-risk, large-scale production environments.

You will be a hands-on technical contributor who works closely with Product, Risk, and Compliance, and who helps raise the technical bar of the team. Your domains span:
• Identity trust risk modeling — fusing verification scores, device, geo, and behavioral data into identity-quality and trust signals.
• Cluster relationship intelligence — graph and clustering methods to identify account farms, mass registration, and coordinated attacks.
• Behavioral risk modeling — behavioral features and sequence models for account takeover and abnormal-session detection.
• Biometric multimodal signals — face embeddings, liveness/anti-spoofing, DeepFake and injection defense, document forgery and AIGC detection, used as inputs to identity trust and the risk layer.
• AI agents — applying agentic AI to scale investigation, detection, and operational defense.

What You'll Be Doing
• Build identity trust risk models: Design and ship coarse-to-fine risk models that fuse face/liveness/document verification scores, device, IP and geo signals, and behavioral data, for high-concurrency real-time decisioning.
• Uncover organized fraud with graph clustering: Build entity graphs across accounts, devices, faces, documents and templates, and apply community detection, clustering, and GNN methods to detect fraud rings and large-scale abuse.
• Develop behavioral features sequence models: Engineer real-time and offline behavioral features, and build sequence models to detect account takeover, bot/script behavior, and abnormal sessions.
• Leverage biometric multimodal signals: Turn biometric features (face embeddings, face quality, liveness and anti-spoofing results) and document-forgery and DeepFake signals into reliable identity-trust inputs for risk decisions, including biometric similarity for cross-account linkage and duplicate-identity detection. Work with the face, liveness, and document teams, or build models yourself.
• Drive execution collaboration: Deliver measurable results while managing ambiguity; partner with backend, product, infrastructure, risk, and compliance teams to integrate models into the production decision chain. Own metric definitions, the balance between false positives and missed fraud, pass rate, monitoring, and drift handling.
• Advance applied R D: Experiment with graph learning, multimodal fusion, and AI agents; stay current with academic and industry advances and translate them into practical defenses.
• Raise the technical bar: Contribute to design reviews, share applied-AI best practices, and mentor junior engineers.

What We Look For
• 5+ years of hands-on experience building risk-control, fraud-detection, or identity-trust models, including significant experience deploying ML systems into production.
• Graph clustering expertise: Experience applying graph mining, community detection, clustering, or GNN methods to fraud or abuse detection.
• Behavioral modeling: Solid experience with behavioral feature engineering and sequence modeling, including real-time feature pipelines.
• Deep AI/ML expertise: Strong proficiency with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow, and solid experience with production ML systems.
• Strong technical coding

skills:

Strong coding ability (e.g., Python, SQL) and the system-level thinking to design end-to-end solutions with high availability and low latency.
• Adversarial mindset: Understanding of how fraudsters adapt, and how to evaluate and iterate defenses against evolving attacks.
• Collaboration: Strong communication skills, with experience working across engineering, product, and risk teams.
• Education: Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in identity verification, KYC/KYB, AML, face-payment or payment risk control, or biometric security.
• Hands-on experience with face recognition, liveness/anti-spoofing, OCR, document parsing, fake-ID detection, or media forensics.
• Experience with graph databases or graph computing (e.g., Neo4j, GraphX) and real-time graph features.
• Knowledge of data and AI/ML infrastructure (e.g., Spark, Flink, Kafka, Airflow, Snowflake).
• Familiarity with MLOps best practices: monitoring, retraining, and continuous improvement of production models.

PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼業務推進本部の紹介

業務推進本部は事業の成長を支える「攻め」と「守り」の両輪として、PayPayの決済・金融・データ領域を横断し、「安心・安全」かつ「効率的な業務オペレーション」を実現する組織です。オペレーション戦略立案、企業データ活用、リスク管理、AIやテクノロジーを活用し多岐にわたる領域で業務変革を推進し、PayPayの安心・安全な金融サービス基盤を支えます。 

業務推進本部 Recruiting FactBook

今回の募集ポジションは【基盤企画部】となります。
AIの活用を前提とした次世代の業務オペレーション基盤の企画と開発をリードしていただきます。また、業務オペレーションの効率化と品質向上を目的に、テクノロジーを駆使した自動化・システム化をリードしていただきます。現場の課題を構造的に把握し、RPA・ワークフローシステム・データ連携基盤・AIソリューションなどを用いて、業務のDX（デジタルトランスフォーメーション）を推進します。

▼基盤企画部の役割とミッション
・役割：AI・データ分析・システム開発の知見を活かして、PayPayの業務オペレーションを抜本的に進化させるために、先端技術を取り入れながら新しいITソリューションを次々に企画し開発自体を推進していきます。20代後半～40代の20名ほどの組織です。
・ミッション：IT投資効果を最大化することでPayPayグループ事業へ貢献することが部全体のミッションとなります。

※他社よりも圧倒的なスピードで、最新技術を取り入れた基盤の企画や、実開発の経験を積むことが出来ます。

▼募集の背景
キャッシュレス決済を中心に急拡大を続けるPayPayは、今、新たな金融・生活サービスへと事業領域を大きく広げています。この変革期において、私たちは業務構造を再定義し、盤石な成長基盤を築くことを急務としています。そこで、プロセス設計、基幹データ整備、リスク管理といった多岐にわたる領域で、経営戦略に直結するテーマを自ら企画し、推進できる方を募集します。PayPayの未来を共に創り上げていく、意欲あるあなたの挑戦をお待ちしています。

【具体的な業務内容】

PayPayの成長を支える多様な業務変革を推進。今回は2つのポジションで採用募集をしており、または複数領域を担当いただきます。いずれの領域においても、単なる改善に留まらず、変革を仕組み化し推進する力が求められます。

《具体的な業務内容》

①機械学習エンジニア
PayPayが保有する大規模な決済・ユーザー・加盟店データを活用し、機械学習・AIによって、不正利用対策やAML、各種審査業務の高度化・自動化を推進していただきます。単なる機械学習モデルの開発にとどまらず、業務課題の理解から、データ分析、モデル設計・開発、システムへの実装、運用・継続的な改善までを一貫して担い、AI・データの力でPayPayのオペレーションを変革していくポジションです。

・アカウント乗っ取り（ATO）など、不正利用の検知・防止を目的とした機械学習モデルの設計・開発・改善
・AML領域におけるリスク検知・スコアリング等のAI／機械学習モデルの開発
・ユーザー・加盟店等に関する各種審査業務の高度化・自動化に向けたAIモデルの企画・開発
・大量の決済・ユーザー・加盟店データを活用した特徴量設計、データ分析、モデル評価
・開発した機械学習モデルの業務システムへの実装、および本番運用を見据えた仕組みの構築
・モデルの精度・効果のモニタリングおよび継続的な改善
・業務担当、データサイエンティスト、エンジニア、リスク・コンプライアンス部門などとのクロスファンクショナルな連携

②業務領域エンジニア
PayPayの「AI民主化・開発の民主化」を支える技術基盤を構築し、AI・データ・クラウド技術を活用した業務オペレーションの抜本的な変革を推進していただきます。特に、業務の自動化・高度化を実現する次世代業務基盤をはじめとした基盤の開発・展開を担い、人による作業を前提とした従来の業務プロセスから、AIやシステムが自律的に処理を行う新たな業務オペレーションへの転換を目指します。単に決められたシステムを開発するだけではなく、業務部門とともに課題を発見し、解決策の企画・設計からPoC、開発、実装、業務への導入までを一貫して担うポジションです。技術と業務の双方を理解し、PayPayグループのオペレーション変革を実現する実働部隊として活躍していただきます。

・次世代業務基盤の設計・開発・テスト、およびPayPayグループへのスケール展開
・生成AI（LLM）やAI Agent、自然言語処理などを活用した業務自動化・業務支援機能の企画・開発
・業務特化型RAGなど、生成AIを業務へ組み込むためのシステム・データ設計および実装
・各種業務システムやSaaS、AI、データ基盤を組み合わせたEnd-to-Endの業務自動化
・業務部門の課題分析、およびシステム・AIを活用したTo-Be業務プロセスの設計
・データ連携基盤、API、ETL／データパイプラインなど、業務自動化に必要となる機能の設計・開発
・PoCによる技術検証から本番開発・導入、運用を見据えた継続的な改善
・エンジニア、データサイエンティスト、機械学習エンジニア、業務担当など、他部門とのクロスファンクショナルな連携

 

▼本ポジションの魅力

・圧倒的なスピードで進んでいく、様々な規模の開発プロジェクトに携わることが出来ます。
・生成AIや新しいフレームワークなど、先端技術を取り入れた基盤構築の企画と実装にチャレンジできます。
・専門性を持つ幅広い部署のメンバーと共に、企画・実行力を磨ける環境です。
・自身が企画立案したソリューションが全社やグループ会社に展開されます

 

必要な経験/スキル

①機械学習エンジニア
・Pythonを使った開発経験
・機械学習の基本的な知識と、モデルの学習・評価経験
pandas、scikit-learn、PyTorchなどを用いたデータ分析・モデル開発経験
・学習データの加工、特徴量の設計、評価指標の選定経験
・Gitを使ったチーム開発経験
・開発したモデルをAPIやバッチなどで業務システムに組み込んだ経験

②業務領域エンジニア
・Java、Pythonなどを用いたアプリケーション開発経験
・APIやバックエンドサービスの設計・開発経験
・要件に基づく設計、実装、テストの経験
・SQLやデータベースを用いた開発経験
・Gitを使ったチーム開発経験
・業務要件を整理し、システムの機能やデータ構造に落とし込んだ経験

 

あると望ましい経験/スキル

①機械学習エンジニア
・モデルの本番運用、再学習、精度監視などの経験
・AWS、GCP、Azureなどのクラウド利用経験
・Docker、CI/CD、ワークフロー管理などの開発・運用経験
・生成AI、自然言語処理、検索・レコメンド、画像認識など、募集対象に合った領域の経験
・業務部門と要件を整理し、評価方法や導入効果を決めた経験

②業務領域エンジニア
・クラウド環境でのシステム開発・運用経験
・Docker、CI/CD、コンテナオーケストレーションなどを用いた開発経験
・認証・認可、権限管理、監査ログなどの設計経験
・大規模利用を想定した性能設計、負荷対策、スケール展開の経験
・データ連携、ETL、データパイプラインの設計・開発経験
・機械学習や生成AIを利用するサービス、API、業務機能の開発経験
・データ品質、個人情報、機密情報の取り扱いを考慮した設計経験

※①・②ともに共通としてあると望ましいスキル
・業務データの構造や意味を整理し、データモデル・スキーマを設計する

jobs.title: Data Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
About PayPay

PayPay is a FinTech company that has grown to over 75M (as of August 2026) users since its launch in
2018. Our team is hugely diverse with members from over 50 different countries.

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_ 

We dare to believe that we do not need a clear vision to create a future beyond our imagination. PayPay will always stay true to our roots and realize a vision (future) that no one else can imagine by constantly taking risks and challenging ourselves. With this mindset, you will be presented with new and exciting opportunities on a daily basis and have the opportunity to grow and reach new dimensions that you could never have imagined. We are looking for people who can embrace this challenge, refresh the product at breakneck speed and promote PayPay with professionalism and passion.

※ Please note that you cannot apply or be selected in parallel with PayPay Corporation, PayPay Card Corporation and PayPay Securities Corporation.

 

Job Description

The Data Infrastructure team builds and operates the platform that powers data workloads across PayPay Group. We own the Databricks Lakehouse environment, the cloud infrastructure underneath it, and the tooling that keeps it running — from workspace provisioning and access governance to monitoring, alerting, and incident response.

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and data platform engineering. You'll design and build AWS infrastructure using Terraform, support Databricks workspace and account operations, and improve platform reliability through SRE practices. Day to day, that means writing IaC, responding to operational issues, shipping platform services, and working directly with data engineers across the group to keep their workloads running smoothly.

We're looking for someone who can carry projects independently, thinks about systems beyond the ticket in front of them, and wants to go deeper on data infrastructure as a discipline. You don't need to know Databricks on day one — but you should be comfortable with AWS, Terraform, and the fundamentals of running production infrastructure.

Main Responsibilities
• Design, build, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure using Terraform, following IaC and GitOps practices
• Operate and improve the Databricks Lakehouse platform — workspace provisioning, configuration management, and day-to-day reliability
• Build and maintain platform services and tooling that support data engineers across PayPay Group companies
• Strengthen system reliability through SRE practices: monitoring, alerting, dashboarding, and incident response
• Implement and enforce data governance and security controls in line with compliance requirements
• Collaborate with data engineering teams on infrastructure needs for their projects and workloads
• Participate in on-call rotation and operational support for the data platform

Qualifications
• 5+ years of experience in infrastructure or platform engineering
• Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code workflows
• Working knowledge of AWS — IAM, VPC, S3, EC2, and multi-account setups
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent)
• Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, or similar)
• Scripting ability in Python and/or Shell
• Solid fundamentals in Linux/Unix, networking (DNS, HTTP, basic OSI model), and security best practices

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Databricks, EMR, or other data platform technologies
• Exposure to Kubernetes and GitOps tooling (EKS, ArgoCD)
• Familiarity with Kafka or event-based data ingestion patterns (CDC, batch consumption)
• Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect)
• Experience with Spark, Hadoop, or large-scale data processing frameworks
• Background in platform engineering — building internal tooling, developer experience, or self-service infrastructure

PayPay 5 senses
• Please refer PayPay 5 senses to learn what we value at work.

Working Conditions 

Employment Status
• Full Time

Office Location
• Hybrid Workstyle
※ You will be expected to work in the office, in alignment with organizational guidelines and team objectives.
• LIFE in JAPAN FACTBOOK
 

Work Hours
• Super Flex Time (No Core Time)
• In principle, 9:00am-5:45pm + 1h break (actual working hours: 7h45m + 1h break)

Holidays
• Every Sat/Sun/National holidays (In Japan)/New Year's break/Company-designated Special days

Paid leave
• Annual leave (up to 14 days in the first year, granted proportionally according to the month of employment. Can be used from the date of hire)
• Personal leave (5 days each year, granted proportionally according to the month of employment）
＊PayPay's own special paid leave system, which can be used to attend to illnesses, injuries, hospital visits, etc., of the employee, family members, pets, etc.

Salary
• Annual salary paid in 12 installments (monthly)
• Based on skills, experience, and abilities
• Reviewed once a year
• Late overtime allowance

※Payroll payment can be changed to digital salary payment “PayPay Paycheck” for an amount set by you

Benefits
• Social Insurance (health insurance, employee pension, employment insurance and compensation insurance)
• 401K
• Translation/Interpretation support
• VISA sponsor + Relocation support

jobs.title: 経営企画担当（事業管理(FP&A)）/ リーダー候補
jobs.description:
PayPayについて

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50か国の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_

我々は自分たちの想像を超える未来を創るためにあえて明確なビジョンは必要ないと考えています。常にDay1であるスタンスを忘れずに、誰もが想像できないようなビジョン（未来）を実現していくのがPayPayです。
この壮大なビジョンに前向きに取り組み、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、自ら課題発見し、周囲と協力して新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

◆組織・チームについて

経営企画部では、PayPayグループの事業成長と収益性向上を支えることをミッションとしています。
短期・中長期の経営計画策定や進捗管理、各種KPI・損益の予実分析、経営陣への報告・改善提案を通じて、経営課題の解決や戦略施策の実行を支援しています。また、これらを支える管理会計基盤の整備・運営にも取り組んでいます。
チームには、事業会社・金融機関・コンサルティングファームなど、多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーが在籍しています。それぞれの専門性を活かしながら、経営陣や各事業部門と近い距離で、グループ全体の経営課題に取り組める環境です。

▼募集の背景

PayPayグループの事業規模・領域の拡大に伴い、経営計画の策定や予実管理など、グループ全体を見据えた経営管理機能のさらなる高度化を進めています。
本ポジションでは、中長期事業計画・年度予算の策定やKPI・損益分析を中心に、経営課題の特定から改善施策の検討・推進まで、FP A領域を主体的に担っていただける方を募集しています。

【具体的な仕事の内容】

PayPayの経営企画部門において、中長期事業計画・年度予算の策定、予実管理を中心としたFP A業務をご担当いただきます。
• 中長期事業計画・年度予算の策定
• 経営上の重要アジェンダや特命プロジェクトの推進
• 月次KPI・損益の着地見込作成、実績分析・予実差異分析、および経営層向けレポーティング
• 決算に伴う会計処理や会計方針の変更に関する検討、経理部門との調整
• 管理会計システムの運用および改善推進
• 収益性改善に向けた財務管理プロセスの設計・構築・運用改善
• 株主、経営層向けの個別報告・分析対応

▼本ポジションの魅力
• 経営の意思決定に直接関与：
経営陣と近い距離で、経営計画の策定や業績分析を通じて、重要な経営判断や事業成長に貢献できます。
• 分析から改善施策まで一気通貫： 
予実管理やKPI分析にとどまらず、収益性改善に向けた施策の検討・推進まで携わり、FP Aの専門性を高められます。
• Fintechグループならではの経営テーマ：
決済・カード・銀行・証券など複数の金融事業を横断し、幅広い経営課題に取り組むことで、経営企画としての経験を広げられます。

必要な経験/スキル

以下のいずれかの実務経験をお持ちの方（目安：3年以上）
• 事業会社における経営企画・事業企画・FP A・管理会計等の経験
• コンサルティングファームにおける経営管理・財務戦略・事業計画策定等の支援経験
• 証券会社の投資銀行部門（IBD）・リサーチ部門、またはFAS等における財務分析・事業分析の経験

あわせて、以下のスキル・経験をお持ちの方
• 財務諸表や事業KPIを用いた分析、および経営課題の特定・改善提案に関するスキル
• 社内外の関係者と連携しながら、業務やプロジェクトを推進した経験

あると望ましい経験/スキル
• 管理会計システムの導入・改善、AIを活用した業務高度化の経験
• ビジネスレベルの英語力
• USCPA・MBA・証券アナリスト等の資格
