We’re looking for a Lead Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to partner with our financial crime product teams to help drive data-driven and innovative growth decisions while helping to combat financial crime. 

At Wise, we strike a critical balance between user experience and the stringent demands of risk prevention. Our mission within the AML team is to stay one step ahead of money laundering activities while ensuring that our customers enjoy a seamless experience. In this vital role, you will innovate and implement controls that enhance security without compromising user convenience.

Most importantly, you’ll collaborate closely with your product managers, designers, data scientists and engineers to bring your insights into real change for our customers and help drive our mission! 

This is an IC3 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.

Your mission:

At Wise our mission is Money Without Borders - instant, convenient, transparent and eventually free. Whether our customers are sending money to another country, spending money abroad, or making and receiving international business payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. 

Here’s how you’ll be contributing to the Financial Crime team:
• You’ll expose the vast data on our processes to the product teams across Wise in a meaningful and actionable way in which people can proactively access the information without friction or need for analyst assistance
• Proactively contribute to, own, create, track key metrics and results for your product and operational teams, keeping them accountable throughout the quarter
• Work with data scientists in understanding and developing the means for detecting and mitigating financial crime
• Building the framework for managing risk and customer experience at scale
• Drive the discovery phase by scoping new opportunities and suggesting features, rules and models to combat emerging risks
• The role requires collaboration with Product, Data Scientists, Engineering and Operations Team

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Be part of a positive change in the world. We’re fixing a broken, greedy system, and putting people and businesses in control of their money
• Create value from extensive datasets. We have millions of customers, a global set of payment infrastructure and a complex product that customers can use in different ways. There is a tonne of value left to unlock from this data!
• Influence the team’s direction. Analysts at Wise enable data-driven decision making and have a large impact by helping their teams to decide what to work on.
• Learn from a global network of professionals. We have a large, diverse team of analysts, data scientists and product managers that you will work with and learn from.

jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist - Receive Risk
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Lead Data Scientist to join our growing Receive Team in London. 

This role is a unique opportunity to work behind the scenes of company transactions, understand how we mitigate risk and at the same time provide our customers with the seamless service they deserve. What you build will have a direct impact on Wise’s mission and millions of our customers.

Role Overview:

As a Lead Data Scientist on the Receive team, you will leverage your expertise in data science to identify, design and deploy models that improve how customers receive and add money with Wise. Your work will help us make better decisions, improve customer outcomes, and build scalable data science capabilities for a growing product area. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, analytics, operations and risk management. 

Key

Responsibilities:
• Lead the development and deployment of machine learning models and data science solutions to improve Receive product performance across different Wise markets
• Analyse large volumes of customer, transaction and product data to identify trends, patterns, risks and opportunities
• Design and implement experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of product changes, decisioning systems and customer experience improvements
• Build scalable modelling approaches that support better prioritisation, personalisation, risk management and operational decision-making
• Collaborate with analysts, product managers, engineers, operations and risk teams to translate business requirements into actionable data science solutions
• Develop robust data pipelines, algorithms and tools to support production-grade modelling and decision-making
• Stay informed about the latest advancements in data science, machine learning, and payment fraud prevention techniques to ensure state-of-the-art capabilities in the Spend domain

A bit

about you:
• Proven track record of deploying models from scratch, including data preprocessing, feature engineering, model selection, evaluation, and monitoring
• Solid knowledge of Python, and ability to make and justify design decisions in your code. You know how to use Git to collaborate with others (e.g. opening Pull Requests on GitHub) and are able to review code. Ability to read through code, especially Java. Demonstrable experience collaborating with engineering on services
• Experience working with large datasets and data processing technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, SQL)
• Familiarity with anomaly detection, supervised and unsupervised learning methods, and real-time data analysis
• Experience with statistical analysis and good presentation skills to drive insight into action;
• A strong product mindset with the ability to work independently in a cross-functional and cross-team environment
• Good communication skills and ability to get the point across to non-technical individuals;
• Strong problem solving skills with the ability to help refine problem statements and figure out how to solve them

Some extra skills that are great (but not essential):
• Experience with MLOps tools: Airflow, MLflow, AWS SageMaker, AWS S3, AWS EMR, CI/CD
• Prior experience in the fraud domain and a strong understanding of fraud detection techniques
• Experience designing and deploying LLM-based solutions in production

We’re people without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We want to work with the best people, no matter their background. So if you’re passionate about learning new things and keen to join our mission, you’ll fit right in.

Also, qualifications aren’t that important to us. If you’ve got great experience, and you’re great at articulating your thinking, we’d like to hear from you.

And because we believe that diverse teams build better products, we’d especially love to hear from you if you’re from an under-represented demographic.

jobs.title: Principal Executive Recruiter
jobs.description:
Our Board & Executive Talent Team enables us to deliver on our mission by ensuring we have the best leaders for our current & future needs. 

We’re looking for an experienced Executive Recruiter to join us. You’ll partner with our senior leaders to hire exceptional engineering, product, data and design leaders who will shape the future of Wise. 

What you’ll do.
• Own and drive executive search strategies for critical leadership roles globally.
• Advise senior stakeholders on candidate requirements, market dynamics and search strategy.
• Develop inclusive search strategies to identify and engage exceptional leadership talent.
• Assess executive talent, identifying leaders who will thrive in Wise’s environment and have a meaningful impact on our business.
• Partner with senior stakeholders to shape hiring and succession strategies.
• Build long-term relationships with executive talent, maintaining external leadership pipelines.
• Guide candidates through our hiring process, delivering an exceptional candidate experience.
• Negotiate and close executive offers.
• Partner with talent development leads and people partners to develop strategies to minimise succession risks, build external succession pipelines and maintain long term relationships with passive candidates.
• Partner with leaders and People Partners on org design, leveling, and location strategy based on macro external market intelligence.
• Diagnose systemic interview/assessment issues and influence leaders to adopt structural changes. Lead comprehensive Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) delivering predictive forecasting and competitor threat analyses.
• Design and audit global recruitment processes, working cross-regionally to untangle complex roadblocks.
• Pioneer AI-first solutions, leveraging AI to map competitor org charts and automate talent trend analysis.
• As a recognised expert in your field, you will develop a trusted advisor relationship with hiring managers and key stakeholders across our people and recruitment teams.
• You will use market & competitor intelligence, to ensure that we identify, target, and engage with key talent.
• You’ll continuously advocate our inclusive hiring practices and help drive our diversity sourcing initiatives.
• Acting as a mentor to others, you will seek growth and share what you learn.
• We are a fast growing team and company. You will be expected to lead and contribute to broader talent initiatives across the organisation.

The experience, background and competencies needed to succeed in this role.

Function

skills:
• You are an experienced executive / senior leadership recruiter with a proven track record of driving organisational change at pace, creating structure out of ambiguity, role modeling TA best practice, and leading complex end-to-end leadership searches.
• You have significant experience recruiting senior leaders across engineering, product, data and/or design within a product-led technology company, with particular expertise in engineering leadership recruitment.
• Proven ability to operate as a trusted adviser to senior leaders..
• You consistently deliver an exceptional experience for candidates.
• Experience in org design, leveling, and location strategy.
• Experience designing and auditing global recruitment processes.
• Demonstrated expertise in pioneering AI-driven talent solutions and advanced mapping techniques.

Ways of working:
• You’re curious and show high agency, continuously looking for ways to improve how we hire, assess, and develop leadership talent.
• You use data, market insight, and evidence with agility to shape decisions and quickly adapt to changing priorities.
• You thrive with high autonomy in ambiguous environments, taking full accountability for outcomes.
• You collaborate seamlessly across the People team and build trusted partnerships with senior leaders to deliver measurable business impact.

We support flexible working. During your onboarding you’ll spend more time in our London office, to build relationships across the business. Once established, you’ll typically spend around three days a week in the office.

We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer to join our Platform Integrations APAC team, where you'll help expand and maintain direct integrations with payment systems and partners across the region.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Data at Brex

Our Scientists and Engineers work together to make data — and insights derived from data — a core asset across Brex. But it's more than just crunching numbers. The Data team at Brex develops infrastructure, statistical models, and products using data. Our work is ingrained in Brex's decision-making process, the efficiency of our operations, our risk management policies, and the unparalleled experience we provide our customers.

What you'll do

As a Data Engineer at Brex, you will be a core contributor in transforming raw data into actionable insights for various departments across the organization. You'll collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and business units to create efficient data models, pipelines, and analytics frameworks that drive the business forward. You also play a leading role in the design, implementation, and maintenance of Core Data tables, our high-quality, curated data source for a wide range of analytic applications. 

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Design, build, and maintain data models and pipelines that scale with the growing number of services, products, and changes in the company.
• Collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Data Analysts, and Business teams to understand their data needs, translating them into robust, efficient, scalable data solutions that enable ease of predictive analytics, data analysis, and metrics formulation.
• Maintain data documentation and definitions, building and ensuring that source-of-truth tables remain high quality for data science and reporting applications.
• Develop and enable integration with various data sources, allowing for more data-driven initiatives across the company.
• Apply best practices in data management to ensure the reliability and robustness of data utilized across various analytics applications.
• Set and proliferate company-wide standards for data relating to structure, quality, and expectations.
• Act as a liaison between the technical and non-technical teams, bridging gaps and ensuring that data solutions align with business objectives.
• Use agentic AI where it speeds up pipeline and quality work, without skipping validation.

Requirements
• 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field such as Analytics Engineering.
• Advanced knowledge of databases and SQL with the ability to efficiently stage, process, and transform data.
• Experience integrating and orchestrating data workflows with various modern data tools and systems.
• Experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and data warehousing solutions.
• Experience working with a data warehouse such as Snowflake.
• Experience with a data workflow orchestrator tool such as Airflow.
• Experience with a programming language such as Python.
• Experience with agentic AI.
• Exceptional quantitative and analytical skills.
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with various stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.

Nice to have
• Familiarity with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar platforms.
• Solid dbt in production: models, tests, docs, and collaboration in a shared repo.
• AI-ready data: Metrics and dimensions are clear and reusable so AI-assisted analysis does not fork definitions.
• Experience with Salesforce data integration. 

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $120,800 - $151,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Manager, Portfolio Credit Risk
jobs.description:
Now, about this opportunity…

We're looking for a Manager, Portfolio Credit Risk to play a key role in strengthening Judo's credit risk management framework and supporting the continued growth of our portfolio.

Reporting to the Head of Portfolio Credit Risk, you'll lead critical portfolio risk analytics, expected credit loss (ECL) assessment activities and provision stress testing, helping ensure our credit risk methodologies remain robust, fit-for-purpose and aligned to evolving business needs. You'll work closely with teams across Risk, Finance, Investor Relations and senior business stakeholders, delivering insights that support informed decision-making and strong risk outcomes.

This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise, strategic thinking and stakeholder influence in a role that directly contributes to Judo's long-term success.

If that excites you, this just might be your dream job:
• Lead the ongoing enhancement and governance of Judo's IFRS 9 / AASB 9 Expected Credit Loss (ECL) methodology and provisioning framework.
• Oversee portfolio credit risk analytics, provision assessments and stress testing activities, delivering meaningful insights to support executive decision-making.
• Assess provision adequacy and emerging portfolio risks, providing constructive challenge and independent risk perspectives.
• Drive continuous improvement of credit risk models, methodologies, reporting and governance frameworks.
• Partner with Finance, Investor Relations and Risk teams to support internal and external reporting requirements, including regulatory obligations.
• Present analysis and recommendations to senior management, risk committees and executive stakeholders.
• Identify opportunities to automate, streamline and enhance risk reporting, analytics and processes.
• Support the development of portfolio risk capabilities across the broader Credit Risk function.
• Foster a collaborative team environment focused on learning, development and continuous improvement.
• Role model Judo's values and contribute positively to our culture.

jobs.title: Investment Analyst MBA Intern, Robinhood Ventures (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

Robinhood Ventures’ vision is to build a new kind of venture capital platform, making the best private companies in the world accessible to retail investors everywhere in service of Robinhood's broader mission to democratize finance for all. Through our publicly traded funds in Robinhood Ventures Fund I and Robinhood Ventures Fund II we’ve already invested in companies like OpenAI, Databricks, Ramp, and more - and we’re just getting started.

As an Investment Intern in Robinhood Ventures you will be a core part of our lean team. You will research, evaluate, and support investments across the Robinhood Ventures platform, with a focus on late-stage investments. 

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do
• Research and sourcing - You’ll research markets and sectors that you believe we should be paying attention to, and then identify the key companies in them that Robinhood Ventures needs to meet.
• Investment evaluation - You’ll be a key part of the deal team for investments we evaluate. You’ll own core diligence workstreams like the financial model, competitive analysis, and help shape investment theses.
• Platform building - You’ll work with teams across Product, Operations, Marketing, Legal, and more to help build experiences in the Robinhood app to further differentiate Robinhood Ventures for both retail investors and portfolio companies. 

What you bring
• Currently enrolled in a full-time MBA program
• Prior experience in investment banking, private equity, or finance at a high-growth company, with fluency in financial modeling, valuation analysis, and market research; late-stage investing or venture capital experience is a plus
• Intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated interest in emerging technologies and the private companies driving them — you proactively form opinions on key trends and companies
• An existing network in the startup ecosystem, or the drive to build one, that can help Robinhood Ventures identify and connect with promising companies
• Proven ability to work independently in lean, high-output environments, with experience collaborating across cross-functional teams

What we offer
• Market competitive compensation structure
• Quarterly lifestyle wallet for personal wellness, learning and development, and more
• Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not
• Time away including company holidays, paid time off, and sick time
• Lively office environment with catered meals, fully stocked kitchens, and geo-specific commuter benefits

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected hourly range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - FX Markets
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer II with deep systems thinking, data engineering expertise, and a product-oriented mindset to join our Treasury FX function — spanning both the Market Data and Risk Engineering teams.

Our team builds the real-time infrastructure that powers Wise's FX pricing, risk management, and trade execution. We aggregate market data from Bloomberg and Reuters, compute live exposure and VaR, execute hedges worth tens to hundreds of millions of pounds daily, and protect the business from adverse currency movements. Our systems are tier- 1 and serve 50+ internal consumers with sub-second freshness across 50+ currency pairs.

You will be the technical anchor across both engineering teams, owning the architectural direction of 14+ production services, from rate ingestion and distribution, through real-time risk calculation, to automated hedge execution. The primary mission: build Wise's first semi-automated trade and hedge execution platform in close coordination with FX dealers, quantitative researchers, and treasury controllers.

We operate on a strong belief in automation, programmatic implementation, and reusable design. We're looking for people who can step back and think holistically about the ecosystem, but also follow through and help implement the design; drawing on the resources across the rest of the Finance & Treasury tribe.

Our stack is polyglot and modern: Java 21 + Spring Boot 4.x, Python 3.12, Apache Flink (streaming), Kafka, gRPC + Protobuf, and Bloomberg/Reuters real-time feeds. This isn't typical CRUD — it's real-time financial infrastructure where a 1bps improvement in hedging efficiency saves millions.

We need a seasoned engineer who can architect streaming data pipelines, collaborate with quants on model productionisation, drive reliability across mission-critical systems, and translate complex business requirements from traders and risk managers into elegant technical solutions.

What will you be working on?

You will own the technical direction and architectural evolution of Wise's FX engineering stack, with immediate focus on:
• Architecting a semi-automated hedge execution platform, from exposure decomposition through model-driven hedge proposals to programmatic trade execution on external partners
• Building real-time streaming pipelines with Apache Flink for portfolio-split exposure computation, tenor interpolation, and hedge lifecycle event processing
• Evolving our rate infrastructure for 10x throughput with FX Forwards, new corridors, NDFs and work on cross-provider deviation alerting

jobs.title: Senior Product Analytics Manager (AL2), SEND
jobs.description:
The role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Analytics Manager to set the strategic direction for analytics in our Global Send Experience Squad. You’ll help the squad decide where to focus, which customer problems to solve and how Wise can grow its global money transfer business, which today drives 5% of all cross-border transfers in the world for personal customers.

You’ll work closely with Product, Design and Engineering to lead discovery across the remittance space: building a deep understanding of customer needs, finding the biggest opportunities and turning them into a clear product strategy. You’ll influence decisions across the factors that shape whether customers choose to send money with Wise—including price, speed and convenience—throughout the whole customer lifecycle, from a customer’s first transfer to the choices they make as a returning customer.

You’ll lead a group of senior analysts. Your focus will be on setting the team’s direction and helping the squad make its most important strategic decisions. You’ll coach analysts to partner closely with teams on day-to-day product questions, while staying hands-on with the most complex and consequential opportunities yourself.

You’ll help us answer questions such as:
• Where are the biggest opportunities to grow money transfers around the world?
• What matters most to customers when they decide where, when and how to send money?
• How do price, speed and convenience shape customers’ choices and behaviour?
• How could an AI-powered concierge help customers find and complete the right transfer, while making the experience simpler and more personal?
• How can we make the experience work better for both new and returning customers?
• Which customer problems should we solve to make the biggest difference to growth and customer value?
• How should we focus our product strategy to grow our money transfer revenues 10x over the next few years?

What you’ll be doing
• Set the strategic direction for the squad. Partner with Product, Design and Engineering to build a clear view of customer needs, market opportunities and the choices Wise should make next.
• Lead discovery and opportunity finding. Explore customer behaviour and the end-to-end transfer journey to identify unmet needs, friction and growth opportunities. Help the squad understand not just what is happening, but where it has the greatest opportunity to act.
• Influence the whole customer decision. Bring an analytical perspective to how customers weigh price, speed and convenience when choosing how to send money, across both new and returning customer journeys.
• Turn opportunities into product priorities. Size customer and commercial opportunities, develop clear points of view and help teams make focused, evidence-based choices about what to build and why.
• Lead and develop a group of senior analysts. Set a high bar for analytical thinking and impact, coach analysts in their work and careers, and create the conditions for them to support their teams effectively.
• Enable strong day-to-day squad decisions. Coach analysts to work closely with their product teams, bring useful insights into planning and discovery, and help teams learn from product changes and customer behaviour.

• Bring people together around a shared view. Communicate complex evidence clearly, influence senior stakeholders and help cross-functional teams turn strategic choices into action.

jobs.title: Lead QA Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Lead QA Engineer, you'll own testing strategy and quality standards across our most important work; Deciding what should be automated, what needs a human eye, where the real risk is hiding, and acting on it. You'll work hands-on across both manual and automated testing, splitting your time based on what a given release actually needs, while mentoring other engineers and acting as the go-to voice on quality across projects. You've got the critical thinking skills to chase down a hard bug yourself, know when to ask for help and delegate, and the range to set direction for how the whole team approaches quality. You seek to help your coworkers and do so regularly.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead test strategy and quality standards across multiple projects, deciding what warrants automated coverage versus focused manual and exploratory testing.
• Build and maintain automated test suites in Playwright, and use BrowserStack to validate compatibility across browsers, devices, and platforms.
• Define and run deep manual and exploratory testing on new, ambiguous, or high-change-rate work where automation isn't the right investment yet.
• Translate requirements into concrete test plans and acceptance criteria, catching gaps in the requirements themselves before they become gaps in the product.
• Act as the technical point of contact for quality with stakeholders: communicate risk, resolve disagreements about scope, and negotiate realistic testing timelines.
• Write clear, actionable defect reports in Jira, drive them to resolution, and verify fixes actually hold up under retest rather than just passing a second glance.
• Use Jira's linking and epic structure to keep testing work traceable, and flag workflow friction in the board with the team before it slows down the SDLC.
• Mentor other QA engineers in both manual technique and automation practice, including how to write tickets clearly and so well that they need no follow-up clarification, raising the bar on testing across the team, not just on your own projects.
• Step into any project at any phase to assess its quality risk and recommend a concrete path forward.
• Stay ahead of testing tools and practices worth adopting, and bring the right ones into real workflows deliberately.
• Operate and champion the use of AI tooling with an understanding that its output is useful, but not infallible. You treat AI as a tool, not a coworker.

Craft Leadership Balance

Estimated 60% leadership, 40% craft.

Qualifications

Required
• 6-8 years of experience in software quality assurance or testing, ideally with exposure to consulting or multi-stakeholder environments.
• Strong, hands-on experience with Playwright for building and maintaining automated test suites and frameworks.
• Experience using BrowserStack (or a comparable cross-browser/device testing platform) to validate compatibility across platforms.
• Deep grounding in manual, exploratory, and regression testing, with the judgment to know when automation is and isn't the right investment.
• Proven ability to translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, actionable test plans and acceptance criteria.
• Strong Jira practice: writing tickets so well that no follow-up or clarification is needed, using issue-linking for traceability, and spotting workflow friction before it becomes a team-wide problem.
• Experience testing across a range of CMS or SaaS platforms rather than a single stack, since our client environments vary and this role needs to move between them.
• Exceedingly strong communication skills, including presenting technical risk and testing tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. It cannot be stressed enough how important this item is: communication is the whole ballgame.
• Prior experience as a technical or testing lead on large or multi-phase projects.

Preferred
• Familiarity with performance testing (e.g. Lighthouse) and accessibility testing (e.g. Axe, WCAG guidelines).
• Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
• Experience with structured test-case formats (e.g. Gherkin) and test case management tooling.
• A track record of debugging and performance investigation at scale.
• Creation and implementation of SDLC processes and norms at project and team scales.

Why Current

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We’re a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You’ll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, contribute to meaningful digital experiences, and help shape the future of engineering within a growing agency environment.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, AI Trading
jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

OKX's Trading Products team owns the core trading experience across Spot, Margin, and Perpetual/Futures — spanning the full user journey from pre-trade decision-making, through order execution, to post-trade settlement and risk management. As our trading volumes and product complexity continue to grow globally, we are looking for a Trading Product Manager who can own and evolve both the user-facing trading experience and the underlying trading mechanics that power it.

This role sits at the intersection of product design and trading logic. You will work on how users discover, price, place, and manage trades (pre-trade / trade / post-trade), while also owning the correctness and soundness of the core mechanisms beneath the surface — margin models, funding rate formulas, liquidation logic, risk parameter design, and order/matching behavior. You will work closely with engineering, risk, quant, and design teams to ship trading features that are intuitive for users and rigorous under the hood.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Start from users and the market to uncover real trading-experience needs — Continuously surface user pain points through user research, behavioral data, community feedback, and conversations with active traders, ensuring product direction is grounded in real signal rather than internal assumptions.
• Benchmark against industry best practices to build best-in-class trading product competitiveness — Continuously track developments in crypto and traditional finance markets and the latest moves from leading products, translating external insight into concrete product opportunities that keep our trading experience and competitiveness ahead of the industry.
• Build and continuously refine the end-to-end trading experience — Own the full journey across pre-trade (market data presentation, decision-support tools, leverage/margin setup, risk disclosures), trade (order flow, execution feedback, order book/depth interaction), and post-trade (position management, PnL display, settlement statements) — from defining requirements through to shipping the solution.
• Drive efficient cross-team collaboration with mature program-management execution — Bring a complete product methodology, independently write rigorous PRDs, and lead alignment and coordination across engineering, risk, quant, design, and compliance. Own the full project lifecycle — from requirements definition and solution design, through development scheduling, to launch validation and post-launch review — ensuring every stage closes the loop with a clear outcome, without relying on others to drive progress.
• Apply rigorous quantitative thinking to understand and reason about trading mechanics — Bring strong logical reasoning and quantitative analysis skills, with the ability to learn fast and quickly master core trading mechanisms such as margin, leverage, funding rates, and liquidation. Candidates with a deep understanding of trading systems are preferred.

What We Look For In You 

We are open to two types of candidates for this role:

(a) Experienced Trading Practitioners
• Prior hands-on experience in trading — either within crypto (exchange product, quant, trading desk) or in traditional finance (equities, futures, FX, derivatives) — with direct exposure to how trading products and mechanisms are designed and operated.
• Solid understanding of core trading concepts: margin/leverage, order types, market microstructure, risk management, and P L mechanics.
• Comfortable reading and reasoning through trading formulas (e.g. mark price, funding rate, liquidation price) and translating them into clear product logic.

(b) High-Potential Talent
• Strong quantitative/analytical foundation — a background in mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, with strong academic performance.
• High self-drive and fast learning ability — demonstrated track record of picking up complex, technical domains quickly and independently, even without prior trading experience.
• Genuine intellectual curiosity about financial markets and trading mechanics, with the rigor to work through formulas and edge cases rather than relying on surface-level understanding.

Common requirements for both profiles:
• 3+ years of product management experience (or equivalent hands-on experience in quant/trading roles for candidates from profile (a)).
• Strong technical intuition — comfortable discussing system architecture and data flows with engineers, and reasoning through quantitative models. You don't need to be a developer, but you think with the rigor of one.
• Excellent communication skills — able to write a precise, technically sound PRD, and to explain complex trading mechanics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• High agency and execution velocity — comfortable operating in ambiguity, moving from open question to shipped solution, and making decisions with incomplete information.
• Genuine passion for crypto and trading — actively uses trading products, understands order types and market microstructure, and can explain how margin, leverage, or liquidation mechanics work. Ideally, you have skin in the game.
• Proficiency in Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with internal engineering and product stakeholders in the China-based R D center.

Nice-To-Haves
• Experience with derivatives products (perpetual futures, options) either as a builder or an active trader.
• Familiarity with risk parameter design (margin tiers, liquidation engines, insurance funds) at an exchange or financial institution.
• Quantitative modeling experience (e.g. Python, SQL) sufficient to validate trading formulas or backtest mechanism changes.
• Prior work in a high-growth crypto exchange, trading firm, or fintech company.
• Fluency in English is preferred to better support communication with global product and business stakeholders.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, TradingView (Growth & Trading Experience)
jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Product Manager with a deep understanding of TradingView users, strong commercial judgment, and experience driving product growth. You will grow OKX's business within the TradingView ecosystem by identifying the most promising customer segments, defining why traders should choose OKX, and finding effective ways to acquire, activate, and retain them, with accountability for measurable business outcomes.

Your first priority is to establish how the business can grow and which opportunities warrant investment. You will validate growth hypotheses through user research, data analysis, and focused experiments before committing substantial engineering resources. Those insights will shape the product roadmap, investment priorities, and the TradingView integrations and trading experience improvements you deliver with engineering and partners.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Define the Growth Strategy and Business Opportunity — 

Identify high-potential customer segments, trading use cases, and market opportunities within the TradingView ecosystem. Assess competitive positioning, platform selection drivers, and OKX's differentiated value proposition. Build growth hypotheses and business cases that consider audience size, revenue potential, acquisition cost, and expected return, then set business goals, priorities, and a phased growth plan.
• Understand Users and the Trading Conversion Journey — 

Use interviews, behavioral data, and community feedback to understand how traders discover platforms, use charts and indicators, set alerts, connect accounts, place orders, and manage positions. Identify what motivates or prevents users from choosing OKX, making their first trade, and returning. Develop customer segments and conversion funnels, and turn insights into clear product, positioning, and lifecycle opportunities.
• Validate Growth Hypotheses and Improve Conversion and Retention — 

Design measurable experiments across acquisition, account connection, first successful trade, repeat trading, and reactivation. Use existing capabilities, onboarding, trader education, value proposition testing, and targeted campaigns to validate opportunities. Define success metrics, experiment costs, and criteria to scale or stop; expand approaches that work and use the evidence to inform subsequent product investment.
• Drive Go-To-Market and Ecosystem Partnerships — 

Work with marketing, regional, lifecycle, and TradingView partner teams on acquisition and go-to-market plans. Evaluate ecosystem visibility, communities, creators, educational content, and joint campaigns as potential channels. Define the customer proposition, distribution approach, conversion journey, and partner objectives, and assess channels by the active traders, retention, and business contribution they generate.
• Translate Growth Evidence into Product Delivery and Integration — 

Translate validated user needs and growth opportunities into a product roadmap, PRDs, and acceptance criteria. Define the minimum scope and engineering priorities required to achieve the business objective. Work with OKX engineering and TradingView technical teams to assess API integration, account authorization, market data, and order and position synchronization, and drive the necessary adaptation, testing, and launch to address specific conversion, trust, or retention problems.
• Own Business Outcomes and Continuously Refine Investment — 

Own metrics for newly acquired trading users, first-trade conversion, active traders, retention, incremental trading volume, and revenue contribution, taking acquisition, incentive, and delivery costs into account. Separate the effects of market conditions, incentives, and product improvements. Review growth initiatives and feature investments, reallocate resources based on results, and track connection success and trading reliability as measures of experience quality.

What We Look For In You
• Relevant product management experience in trading, fintech, or digital assets, with a track record of measurable product growth. You can explain how you identified opportunities, developed a growth strategy, and improved acquisition, trading conversion, retention, or revenue, including your personal contribution and results.
• A deep understanding of TradingView users and their practical use of charts, indicators, watchlists, alerts, and trading workflows. You can explain why different traders choose a platform, switch terminals, abandon an order, or continue using a service, and validate those insights through research and data.
• Strong commercial judgment and growth strategy skills. You can segment customers, assess opportunities, define differentiated positioning, select distribution channels, and build business cases. You validate demand and a credible path to growth through research and focused experiments before substantial engineering investment.

jobs.title: Payments Director
jobs.description:
Starling is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way.

We’re a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We’re a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. We employ more than 3,000 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

Our technologists are at the very heart of Starling and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Starling is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, discovering, to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five Starling values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Starling - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. In Technology, we're asking that you attend the office a minimum of 1 day per week.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Payments Director to lead our Payments function and ensure that our payments services operate safely, reliably and in line with our regulatory and scheme obligations.

Sitting within Technology and reporting to the Chief IT Control Officer, this is a senior leadership role with responsibility for providing effective oversight and control of the Bank’s payments ecosystem. You will lead the Payments team, ensuring payment risks are understood and appropriately managed, regulatory and scheme requirements are met, and our critical third party relationships are effectively governed.

You will work across Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance and the wider business providing clear ownership and leadership when issues arise and helping us maintain a resilient, well controlled payments environment as the Bank continues to grow.

Why this role matters:

Payments are at the heart of our customers’ experience and are one of the most critical services we provide.

At Starling, we want to move quickly and continue to innovate, but we also need to ensure that our payments services remain safe, resilient, compliant and well controlled.

As Payments Director, you’ll play a central role in achieving the balance. You’ll bring together technology, risk, regulation, suppliers and schemes to ensure we understand our exposures, respond effectively when things go wrong and continue to strengthen our payments capability as the bank grows.

What you'll get to do

You will provide leadership and oversight across the Bank’s payments activities, with particular responsibility for:
• Payment risk and control - ensuring risks across the payments estate are identified, assessed and effectively managed, with a strong and proportionate control environment.
• Regulatory and scheme compliance - ensuring the bank understands and meets its obligations relating to payments, including applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards and payment scheme rules
• Scheme Management - owning and overseeing key relationships with payment schemes and networks, including Mastercard, ensuring obligations are met and changes, issues and risks are appropriately managed
• Supplier and third party management - providing effective oversight of critical payment suppliers and partners, ensuring appropriate performance, governance, risk management and escalation arrangements are in place
• Incident Management - providing senior leadership and oversight of payment incidents, ensuring issues are managed effectively from identification through to resolution, with appropriate stakeholder communication, root cause analysis and remediation.
• Operational Resilience - ensuring payment services are resilient and recoverable, with appropriate contingency arrangements, testing and oversight of critical interdependencies
• Change and emerging risk - assessing the risk and control implications of changes to payment products, platforms, regulation, schemes and suppliers, ensuring appropriate controls are embedded from the outset.
• Governance and reporting - providing clear and insightful reporting on payment risks, incident, supplier performance, compliance and emerging issues to senior management and relevant governance forums.
• Leadership - leading and developing a high performing payments team, establishing clear accountability and building strong relationships across Technology and the wider bank.

You will bring significant leadership experience within payments, ideally gained within a bank, fintech, payments provider or similar regulated financial services environment.

You will have a strong understanding of the payments landscape and the risks associated with delivering critical payment services. You’ll be comfortable operating at the intersection of technology, operations, risk and regulation, and able to translate complex payment issues into clear decisions and outcomes.

We are looking for someone who can demonstrate:
• Deep knowledge of payment services, payment schemes and associated regulatory requirements
• Strong experience of payments risk management, controls, and governance
• Experience managing relationships with card schemes, payment networks, processors and other critical third parties
• A strong understanding of technology and operational risk within a regulated environment
• Experience leading the response to significant payment or technology incidents and driving effective remediation
• Knowledge of operational resilience and the management of critical services and third party dependencies
• Strong stakeholder management skills with the credibility to influence senior leaders, suppliers, schemes and other external parties
• The ability to provide constructive challenge while remaining pragmatic and commercially aware
• Proven experience leading and developing teams in a fast-moving environment.

Interview Process

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• First stage with the two members of the Payments/Cards and Tech Risk teams ~ 45 minutes
• Second stage with additional members of the Payments/Cards and Tech Risk, including the Chief Technology Risk Officer ~ 1 hour
• Final stage with the deputy CIO ~ 45 minutes
• 33 days holiday (including public holidays, which you can take when it works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell
• up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Incentives refer a friend scheme
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

About us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Starling is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Starling are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 

When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. By submitting your application, you agree that Starling will collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we will process, where we will process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Operations at Brex

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

What you'll do

You'll lead the Product Operations team and own the operational readiness for Brex's product launches: the enablement that must be in place before a customer ever touches a new feature. You'll also own Brex's product knowledge, the Help Center, and our internal knowledge base, plus the measurement that tells us whether it lands.

This is a role for someone who combines product manager, data, and operations skills and behaviors. You'll inherit a team that has already automated a large share of its own workflow, with a suite of production agents running much of the recurring work. Your job is not only to keep that running, but to push it further: expand what AI carries and reinvest the capacity it frees into the judgment work only people can do. We want to raise our evidence bar by using key metrics to hold ourselves accountable, focus on where the impact is greatest, and celebrate our wins. We treat AI as leverage, not as a deliverable, and we measure it by how it improves our efficiency and the quality of our deliverables.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities:

Launch readiness and enablement
• Own launch readiness, ensuring documentation, release notes, training, and tooling are ready for each release. Adapt processes and team capacity as EPD’s release cadence evolves.
• Lead and improve OLAB, the weekly cross-functional board that assesses launch impact and aligns teams on readiness.
• Engage early in launches, using customer and product insights to shape the product experience.
• Lead customer-facing escalations and crisis response, establishing a single source of truth, coordinating communications, and running retrospectives.

Documentation and product knowledge
• Own the lifecycle and quality of product documentation, keeping Help Center articles, internal knowledge, service descriptions, and implementation guides accurate, current, and clear.
• Partner with leadership and Engineering to structure and maintain product knowledge for people and AI systems.

jobs.title: MLRO, Indonesia
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced, commercially aware, and regulatory-savvy compliance professional to join us as Head of Compliance and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO).

The role will be instrumental in building the compliance programme from the ground up, and embedding a culture of compliance across the organisation.

Broader team management responsibilities will be added in due course for regulatory strategy, operational execution, and governance.

 

 

What You’ll Be Doing 

Regulatory Engagement
• Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant regulatory bodies.
• Ensure the organisation meets all applicable governance requirements, including fit and proper obligations for Approved and Designated Persons.
• Monitor and interpret regulatory developments relevant to virtual assets, and advise senior management and the Board accordingly.

Compliance Programme Development Management
• Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive compliance framework aligned with local requirements, FATF recommendations, and international best practice for virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
• Develop, review, and update all internal policies and procedures covering AML/CFT, KYC, customer due diligence (CDD), enhanced due diligence (EDD), transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, data protection, cybersecurity compliance, and safeguarding of client assets.
• Establish and oversee the compliance monitoring programme, including periodic testing, gap analysis, and reporting to senior management and the Board.
• Prepare and present regular compliance reports to the Board and relevant committees, including on regulatory changes, compliance breaches, and remediation progress.
• Ensure compliance considerations are integrated into new product design and operations from the inception phase by driving solutions that balance commercial outcomes and innovation, while maintaining a robust compliance posture using a clear risk-based approach.
• Review technical documentation, user journeys, and product flows to ensure compliance risks are addressed; provide clear, actionable and solution-focused advice during the product lifecycle.
• Build and scale compliance policies governing advertising, social media campaigns, influencer partnerships, and product launches.
• Partner with Legal, Product, and Marketing teams to operationalize a timely review process for client-facing assets and go-to-market materials.

AML/CFT MLRO Duties
• Act as the designated MLRO, with full statutory responsibility for overseeing the organisation's AML/CFT framework.
• Receive, review, and assess all internal Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) from staff, and make informed decisions on whether to file external disclosures with competent local authorities.
• Oversee and continuously improve the transaction monitoring programme, with support from global compliance and product functions.
• Ensure robust sanctions screening against all applicable lists, including OFAC, UK OFSI, UN, EU, and applicable local sanctions designations.
• Oversee customer risk scoring, risk-based KYC/CDD processes, and enhanced due diligence for high-risk customers, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and customers from high-risk jurisdictions.

Governance Culture
• Act as a key member of the senior leadership team, providing compliance input on new products, services, partnerships, and business initiatives.
• Champion a strong compliance culture across the organisation through training, communications, and leadership by example.
• Design and deliver AML/CFT and compliance training programmes for all staff, ensuring completion records are maintained.
• Ensure that the organisation's compliance obligations are adequately resourced, and advise the Board on staffing, systems, and budget requirements.
• Establish and maintain a compliance manual, risk register and oversee the escalation and resolution of compliance incidents and breaches.

Reporting Recordkeeping
• Prepare and submit all required regulatory reports and notifications to relevant authorities within stipulated deadlines.
• Ensure that all compliance records, SAR documentation, KYC files, and transaction monitoring records are maintained in accordance with applicable retention requirements.
• Support and facilitate any inspections, supervisory visits, or regulatory examinations.

 

What We Look For In You
• Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
• Professional certification in compliance or AML is strongly preferred (e.g. CAMS, ICA Certificate/Diploma in AML or Compliance, CFE, or equivalent).

Experience
• Minimum of 8 years of experience in compliance, AML, or financial crime prevention, with at least 3 years in a senior or leadership compliance role.
• Demonstrated in-house experience working within virtual asset service providers (VASPs), cryptocurrency exchanges, fintech firms, or regulated financial institutions.
• Prior experience as an MLRO or Deputy MLRO is highly desirable.
• Experience engaging directly with financial regulators and the financial intelligence unit
• Hands-on experience building compliance programmes from the ground up in a start-up or scaling environment is a significant advantage.
• Familiarity with the regional regulatory framework and requirements is strongly preferred.

Knowledge Skills
• Deep understanding of FATF Recommendations and their application to virtual asset service providers, including the Travel Rule (FATF Recommendation 16)
• Strong knowledge of crypto-specific AML typologies.
• Proficiency with blockchain analytics and transaction monitoring tools (e.g. Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs, or equivalent).
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia.
• Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify and articulate complex risk scenarios clearly.
• Demonstrated ability to engage constructively with regulators, external auditors, and law enforcement.
• High degree of personal integrity and sound professional judgment.

 

Nice to Haves
• • 
Experience in cryptocurrency or blockchain compliance programs.
• Experience working in a multi-national financial institution setting.
• Familiarity with compliance technology and analytics tools.
• Prior exposure to multi-jurisdictional compliance oversight.
• In-depth knowledge of crypto products, including spot trading, derivatives, staking, lending/borrowing, DeFi, and stablecoins.

 

Additional Notes

This role will be subject to fit and proper assessment as part of the licensing process. Candidates must be prepared to undergo background checks, provide regulatory questionnaires, CVs, references, and proof of relevant qualifications. Prior enforcement history, regulatory sanctions, or unexplained gaps in professional record may affect eligibility.

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company event
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

 

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Representative, Brokerage Services
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role 

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

As a member of this team, you'll be the company's voice and will use exceptional empathy and product expertise to ensure our users feel understood and valued.

You will be empowered to help our customers with a range of needs from simplistic to complex by phone, email and chat. This work will range in various topics including equities trading, margin, and options trading-related issues. Your job is not only to help our customers, but to help us learn as a company from each interaction, so that we can make our customers' experience using our products as seamless as possible. We offer a variety of schedules designed to meet our customers and employee needs.

This role is based in our Denver, CO, and Westlake, TX offices, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week during the 10-week onboarding period. After onboarding, in-person attendance is expected at least 3 days a week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.
