jobs.title: Senior Technical Account Manager - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
Starling Bank is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking with more than 3,000 people in our UK offices and 4 MILLION customers in the UK! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way. Now we present… Engine by Starling.

Engine by Starling is Starling’s software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling Bank, and over a year ago we split out as a separate business. We are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology.

This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

At Engine by Starling, our technologists are at our very heart and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Engine is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, and discovering to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of our Sydney office in the CBD, so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. 

About the role

As a Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM) in our growing Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) region, you will join an established regional TAM team and play a key role in the continued success and expansion of Engine's presence in the market. This is a high-impact, executive-facing role, critical to the sustained success of our strategic ANZ clients. You will serve as the primary technical executive advisor, building strong, trusted relationships that strengthen our regional credibility.

Working closely with the regional and global TAM teams, you will be instrumental in ensuring our strategic clients maximise the value of our platform and achieve their business goals, while contributing to the ongoing localisation of our established global client success playbook for the unique requirements of the ANZ financial markets. This senior position involves fostering trusted relationships with C-level and VP-level senior stakeholders within client organisations, and leveraging internal Technology, Delivery, and Product teams to drive exceptional service and platform evolution.

Note: You will be required to participate in an On-Call rotation (e.g., 1 week every 8-10) with other global TAMs to support our global clients outside of standard business hours.

Learn more about what Technical Account Management looks like here at Engine: https://enginebystarling.com/insights/discussion/operational-transformation/technical-account-management-at-engine/ 

What you'll get to do:

Strategic Client Success & Regional Growth (40%)
• Drive the technical success strategy for your assigned strategic ANZ clients, focusing on achieving client satisfaction, maximum platform adoption, and driving quantifiable business outcomes.
• Apply and help refine the established global TAM strategy for the ANZ market, ensuring successful platform integration and adoption.
• Develop and execute joint success plans with the client, identifying and prioritising technical initiatives that secure the client's use case success.
• Direct and present during Monthly/Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), focusing on strategic alignment, platform performance, and identifying opportunities for key feature adoption growth and value realisation.
• Cultivate and maintain a trusted advisory relationship with the client's executive management team (VP and C-Suite), influencing their technical strategy and translating complex platform capabilities into clear strategic value for their ANZ operations.

Technical Guidance, Defect, Change & Incident Management (30%)
• Partner with the Client Solutions team to own defect management for your clients, triaging and prioritising defects and driving them to resolution with Technology and Product teams so that clients can reach go-live on schedule.
• Maintain clear visibility of open defects against each client's go-live milestones, communicating status, risk and workarounds to client stakeholders and escalating go-live blockers early.
• Identify recurring defect themes and feed them into Problem Management and product feedback to reduce repeat issues across clients.
• Manage client change requests end to end, assessing impact, agreeing priorities and coordinating delivery with Technology, Product and Delivery teams so that changes are controlled and do not put client go-live or stability at risk.
• Keep clients informed of the status, timing and outcome of their change requests, and escalate scope, timeline or dependency risks early.
• Own and direct the end-to-end Major Incident lifecycle for your clients, driving cross-functional resolution for all incidents.

Global Strategy Execution & Product Influence (20%)
• Ensure successful implementation of global product changes and API updates within the client's environment.
• Capture and manage general client feedback on the platform, service and ways of working, logging and prioritising it, and closing the loop with clients on actions and outcomes.
• Synthesise and localise client feedback to identify market-specific product requirements.
• Serve as a primary voice of ANZ clients in global product forums, ensuring regional strategic requirements are appropriately weighted and incorporated into the international platform roadmap.
• Continually engage in the client's quarterly and annual planning cycles to ensure Engine's platform roadmap aligns with their critical business goals in the ANZ market.

Knowledge Management & Mentorship (10%)
• Contribute to and extend ANZ market-specific knowledge assets (e.g., localised runbooks, best practice guides) to support the regional team and onboard future TAM hires.
• Act as a regional technical expert, proactively supporting cross-training of internal teams (e.g., Sales, Delivery) on the nuances of ANZ client environments and integrations.
• Maintain compliance with global knowledge management standards, ensuring teams in other regions can support out of hours effectively.
• 5+ years of progressive experience in Technical Account Management or a Strategic Customer Success role, with a demonstrated focus on managing top-tier enterprise accounts.
• Proven track record of executing and adapting a defined global strategy or methodology within a specific region or market.
• Expert-level technical aptitude with cloud-based SaaS systems and APIs, demonstrated by the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues with autonomy.
• Proven executive gravitas and effectiveness in influencing and guiding technical strategy with C-level and VP-level senior stakeholders in a major financial institution environment.
• Exceptional presentation and interpersonal communication skills, with a track record of successfully conveying complex technical concepts to non-technical executive audiences.
• Direct experience operating in or supporting clients in the ANZ market is highly desirable including familiarity with APRA- or RBNZ-regulated environments, such as APRA's CPS 230 operational risk and CPS 234 information security standards.

Interview Process: 

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• First interview - Interview with ANZ team members including review of a short take home assignment
• Second interview - Interview with regional leadership
• Third interview - Final interview with Client Success Leadership team
• 25 days holiday. You’ll also get your birthday on us
• The option to opt-out of public holidays
• The option to buy/sell up to 5 days of annual leave a year
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Enhanced Pat & Mat leave
• Perkbox
• Length of service increased annual leave

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Engine by Starling is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Engine by Starling are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 

When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. By submitting your application, you agree that Engine by Starling and Starling Bank will collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we will process, where we will process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

We use AI tools to support various parts of our recruitment process, helping our team manage applications and assessments more efficiently. These tools are strictly used for support and do not replace human judgment with all final hiring decisions being made by our team. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please reach out to us.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Non-Financial Risks
jobs.description:
We are seeking a dynamic individual to join our team as the Senior Specialist for Latam & MEA as an individual contributor. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the risk function across the region, overseeing risk identification, assessment, and mitigation efforts to safeguard the stability and integrity of the organisation's operations in the region. 

This role requires a seasoned professional with a deep understanding of regional market dynamics, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Your mission

As the Regional Senior Specialist you will be responsible for:
• Be a critical member of the Latam & MEA Risk team in developing and executing a global risk management strategy tailored to the region.
• Ensure consistent application of risk management methodologies, policies and procedures across all operations.
• Conduct risk self assessments for the business in entities, as per risk management principles, supporting remediation and closure;
• Work closely with product teams to value add on risk insights into product changes, new product and market launch, open issues and horizon risks relevant to the region.

jobs.title: Engineer People Technology
jobs.description:
As a People Technology Engineer (Workday Time & Absence), you will be a vital technical contributor driving the configuration, maintenance, and optimization of our time and absence processes. You will execute standard configuration tasks, resolve legacy setup issues, and implement mandatory legislative updates for our growing global workforce (with a focus on the Americas region).

Working closely with senior domain experts and People Operations stakeholders, you will help clear our T&A backlog and enable our global expansion. Long-term, you will be a key part of our shift toward a regionally aligned, POps-adjacent product team, broadening your skills to provide holistic Workday support to your regional stakeholders.

How we work: 

We apply engineering principles to People Tech. You’ll be part of a team that values documentation, peer reviews, and scalable architecture. We empower teams to make decisions and take ownership. We value clear outcomes, strong cross-functional partnerships and measurable impact.

What will you be working on?:
• Functional Configuration: Execute hands-on configuration of Workday Time Tracking and Absence Management. Build and update standard leave plans, holiday calendars, time entry codes, and basic routing rules.
• Issue Resolution & Ticket Management: Manage and resolve technical support queries and bugs via Jira. Troubleshoot user errors, correct localized accrual issues, and maintain the day-to-day functional health of the T&A module.
• Stakeholder Support: Partner with regional People Operations teams (Americas focus) to understand their operational bottlenecks and implement system adjustments that improve employee experience and ensure local compliance.
• Testing & Documentation: Conduct rigorous unit and regression testing for Workday bi-annual releases and internal feature deployments. Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for all T&A configurations.
• Data & Reporting: Build and maintain custom reports to support People Operations in tracking absence liabilities, time-off balances, and operational metrics.

jobs.title: Senior Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Wise has already pioneered new ways for people to transfer money across borders and currencies. Our customers can also manage their hard-earned money with the world’s first platform to offer true multi-currency banking. Your mission is to uplift our process management capabilities and work with the area leads to determine what good looks like.

 

This role will be instrumental in transforming our current operational landscape into a more efficient, robust, and scalable system, ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements and enhancing our ability to detect and prevent financial crime. The successful candidate will leverage their expertise in Process Management methodologies, process automation, and change management to drive significant improvements across the organisation.

 

It is a unique opportunity to join one of the fastest growing companies in Europe. With over 15 million happy customers we’re already moving more than £9 billion a month and have more than 2,500 people in our operations functions across the US, Estonia, Hungary and Singapore and 800 in Product and engineering. We serve a wide range of customers from personal users, freelancers, small businesses to enterprise businesses and banks.

You will be one of the first members of the newly set-up function that will be setting the standards on how operational processes are mapped, measured and improved. It will be part of the new Business Process Excellence function.. 

 

Your Mission:
• Global Process Mapping and Optimisation: Conduct a comprehensive analysis of existing "as-is" Operational Processes at Wise. This will involve detailed process mapping, identification of bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement. Design and develop optimized "to-be" processes, focusing on creating a streamlined, standardised, and globally consistent approach.
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Looking at the processes from controls, compliance and efficiency angle and working with experts from those areas to drive improvements.
• Strategic Impact: Work with product and engineering teams to make sure there is alignment on the biggest opportunities and they get prioritised.
• Data-Driven Success: Clearly define what success looks like for your processes and evaluate progress using a blend of qualitative and quantitative methods to demonstrate impact.
• Operational Control Mapping and Assurance: Rigorously map all existing operational Level 1 (L1) controls into the new process design, ensuring full coverage and alignment with regulatory expectations. Develop and implement a robust process for evidencing the effective operation of these controls. This includes defining key performance indicators (KPIs), establishing monitoring mechanisms, and creating clear documentation for audit and regulatory scrutiny.

jobs.title: Country Manager
jobs.description:
About the role
• We’re looking for an executor with a brilliant mind and strong communication skills to expand Wise’s product offering in South Africa.
• This is a unique opportunity to play a pioneering role in growing Wise in one of Africa’s most important financial markets, helping millions more potential customers save money by using our services.
• You’ll be responsible for overseeing local operations, defining our market expansion strategy, executing on it, and being the face of Wise in South Africa.
• Our banking relationships determine the quality of our product and a large part of its economics. Our relationships with regulators, governments and payment systems are crucial too.

Key aspects of this role will include:
• Expanding Wise’s regulatory presence in South Africa.
• Building and improving relationships with banks, payment partners and other financial institutions.
• Helping Product teams build better, faster and more cost-effective products for customers.
• Driving Wise’s market expansion strategy from a payments infrastructure, regulatory and operational partnerships point of view.

What will you be doing?
• Working with Product teams — Product Managers, Analysts and Engineers — you will help define the opportunities for Wise’s products in South Africa and, where relevant, other markets in Southern Africa. You’ll collaborate across teams and inspire others so that we deliver the best solution for our customers.

Your mission will be to:
• Own and expand Wise’s regulatory presence in South Africa
• Identify the most appropriate way to grow Wise in South Africa and, where relevant, other countries in the region.
• Manage the regulatory and licensing process end-to-end, including understanding the regulatory landscape, preparing and coordinating applications, submitting materials, securing regulatory buy-in, and supporting the fulfilment of local requirements.
• Build strong, constructive relationships with relevant regulators and public-sector stakeholders, including the South African Reserve Bank, the Financial Sector Conduct Authority, the Financial Intelligence Centre and other relevant bodies.
• Understand existing and new regulations, and figure out the best ways our product can comply with them.
• Translate regulatory requirements into product implementations together with our Compliance teams.
• Be one of the Product team’s go-to people for regulatory knowledge. We see regulation as an opportunity.

Shape the product opportunity in South Africa
• Identify opportunities to offer the best product in the market by taking advantage of our existing and future authorisations.
• Contribute to defining the opportunities and direction for Wise’s products in South Africa.
• Work closely with Product Managers and Product Engineers to develop our vision and build better products and experiences for customers.
• Help Product teams understand local payments infrastructure, customer pain points, regulatory requirements and operational constraints.
• Work with global teams — Product, Finance, Treasury, Legal, Compliance and Operations — to ensure our customers and products are at the centre of our mission.

Build new relationships with financial institutions and payments partners
• Identify and open new relationships with relevant financial institutions, including banks, payment processors, card issuers, card processors, authorised dealers, authorised dealers with limited authority, clearing and settlement participants, system operators and other payments ecosystem partners.
• Manage the process end-to-end: find the right potential partners, pitch Wise as a client, negotiate commercial agreements and contracts, complete account opening forms, explain our compliance processes, pass due diligence, and do anything else needed to be ready for development.
• Build partnerships that improve our ability to offer faster, cheaper, more transparent and more reliable services to customers.

Improve existing banking and payments relationships
• Take ownership of improving existing relationships with transactional banking partners and other financial institutions.
• Lead commercial and relationship discussions with partners.
• Monitor our economics to ensure we offer the most sustainable and competitive service in the market.
• Create new opportunities within existing relationships with financial institutions in South Africa and the broader region.
• Continuously improve our product by increasing speed, reducing costs, improving reliability, adding visibility to transactions, and expanding access to local payment rails.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Payin Platform
jobs.description:
Recurring Payin team owns the Direct Debit API that powers automated payments into Wise. Underneath this, we are building a platform that allows customers to easily schedule top-ups or business collections.

The platform is also built on top of our internal Payin Platform rails; which is a critical component to the Wise money-movement machine and we’re looking for an engineer motivated to come and help us build for this.

We primarily offer APIs for any partner looking to set up automated funding or pre-authorizations. From setting up GBP balance top ups automatically to allowing business partners collect EUR bills monthly without having the customer go through the flow every time; our platform aims to consolidate all these use-cases.

We aim to allow customers to give a one time permission (pre-authorization) for Wise to pull money across any payment method, a USD bank account or a EUR issued bank card; you name it.

Job

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services written in any language deployed on cloud infrastructure (AWS)
• Build and maintain RESTful APIs that serve millions of customers across web and mobile platforms
• Develop and optimise services powering the card pay-in payment method — one of the most popular payment methods, enabling Wise customers to move around £1 billion every month
• Design and implement database schemas, write and optimise SQL queries against PostgreSQL databases handling high-volume transactional data
• Build and maintain event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka for asynchronous processing of financial events across distributed services
• Develop and maintain a payment orchestration system that dynamically routes payments across Payment Service Providers to optimize for cost and reliability
• Write automated tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end) to ensure correctness and reliability of financial systems
• Conduct code reviews for team members, ensuring code quality, security, and adherence to engineering standards
• Participate in on-call rotations to monitor and respond to production incidents for Tier 2 critical services
• Collaborate with product managers, designers, analysts, and engineers across other teams to deliver cross-functional projects
• Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, scalability issues, and technical debt in existing systems
• Ensure development follows security best practices, particularly around handling of sensitive financial data and compliance with financial regulations

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager - Finance Systems
jobs.description:

• You’ll be responsible for understanding the whys and hows of the Wise and Finance integration and communicate across all finance stakeholders and financial concepts to engineers

This role will give you the opportunity to
• Choose your path to impact – we believe people are most empowered when they can act autonomously. So rather than telling you what to do, you’ll work with your team to create a vision of your own. Of course, you can always gather feedback from smart, curious people across Wise but you’ll have the freedom to make your own calls
• Get amazing exposure to the full breadth and depth of our internal product finance systems while working with a group of amazing and dedicated implementation managers, engineers, analysts, and operations.

• Be part of our mission to make money without borders the new normal

jobs.title: QA Engineer I/II
jobs.description:
We Are:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. • Design, document, and execute manual test cases for:
• iOS and Android Mobile Applications
• Web applications
• Backend Services / APIs
• Validate new features against acceptance criteria and UX expectations

• Experience writing and executing test plans and test cases
• Hands-on experience testing iOS/Android mobile applications, web applications and backend services / REST APIs
• Familiarity with bug & test management tools (Jira, TestRail, etc.)
• Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail
• Good communication and collaboration skills

Nice to Have
• Understanding of basic automation concepts (Appium, Selenium, Postman, etc.)
• Exposure to CI/CD, device testing platforms (e.g., BrowserStack)
• FinTech or payments domain experience

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Marketing at Brex

Marketing tells the story of Brex to the world. From acquisition to activation, we translate product value into business results. Our team spans Revenue, Product, and Brand Marketing, and works closely with nearly every function at Brex. We move fast, experiment often, and think deeply about customer behavior. If you want your creativity to drive growth and shape perception, this is the place.

What you’ll do

The Brex Marketing team is looking for an experienced Senior Marketing Operations Manager to architect and optimize our B2B sales-led and channel-driven GTM engine. This role will define and maintain the systems, processes, and operational rigor that align Marketing, SDR, Sales, and Partner teams.

We are looking for someone who is eager to design the future-state GTM tech stack—modernizing how leads flow, how insights are generated, and how operational workloads become more efficient through automation, AI, and agentic workflows. This person will champion operational excellence by improving lead management, automating revenue processes, increasing funnel velocity, and enabling more efficient cross-functional alignment.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Own and evolve the GTM systems architecture, ensuring Salesforce, Marketo, LeanData, ZoomInfo, Qualified, Outreach, and Clay.io work together as a best-in-class, integrated ecosystem.
• Lead the design, governance, and optimization of data orchestration workflows using LeanData, including routing, prioritization, handoffs, and conversion logic across Marketing, SDR, and Sales teams.
• Design and execute a future-state operational roadmap focused on scaling B2B demand generation, ABM, and partner-led growth through automation, improved data flows, and AI-powered insights.
• Build automated lifecycle processes for lead scoring, enrichment, qualification, and cross-functional handoffs using LeanData, Zapier, Clay, Segment, and AI agents.
• Enhance sales productivity by implementing agentic workflows (e.g., automated follow-ups, enrichment workflows, SDR assistance tools) in Outreach and Salesforce.
• Manage data governance across Salesforce, Marketo, and Segment, ensuring reliable attribution, reporting, and pipeline visibility.
• Create AI-informed dashboards and reporting on pipeline performance, lead velocity, conversion, campaign effectiveness, and partner impact.
• Partner with RevOps, Sales Systems, and Engineering to operationalize cross-functional processes that reduce manual work and improve efficiency.
• Support partner/VAR motions through automated attribution, routing rules, partner engagement workflows, and integrated co-marketing processes.
• Continuously evaluate new tools, AI capabilities, and operational improvements that elevate our GTM infrastructure.

Requirements
• 4+ years in Marketing Operations or Revenue Operations supporting B2B sales-led funnels.
• Hands-on experience administering Marketo, Salesforce, and LeanData.
• Deep expertise with lead routing, lead-to-account matching, and data orchestration workflows using LeanData or similar workflow automation tools.
• Proven ability to design automated workflows, operational processes, and scalable cross-system integrations.
• Experience using AI-driven tools or agentic workflows to automate SDR tasks, enrich lead data, or accelerate GTM execution.
• Strong analytical, system design, and documentation skills; able to translate business needs into scalable technical workflows.
• Experience collaborating with Sales, SDR, RevOps, and System/Engineering teams.

Bonus Points
• Experience in FinTech or enterprise B2B SaaS environments.
• Familiarity with conversational marketing/ABM platforms like Qualified.
• Experience with tools like LeanData and Outreach in support of lead routing and SDR/BDR workflows.
• Experience with paid funnel operations is a plus (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, etc.).
• Understanding of partner/VAR operational workflows and partner attribution logic.
• Ability to design scalable integrations using tools like Segment, Zapier, or Workato-style platforms.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $134,696 - $168,370. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Engineering Relations Partner
jobs.location: Remote, India; Remote, Kenya; Remote, Lagos, Nigeria; Remote, Pakistan; Remote, Poland; Remote, South Africa; Remote, Spain
jobs.description:
About Moniepoint

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in annual digital payment transaction value.

About The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Relations Partner to join the Corporate Affairs and R D teams. You will work closely with our engineering teams to tell the story of what we’re building in a language that other expert engineers understand.

This is a technical content execution role requiring strong, foundational engineering skills. You will translate what our engineers build and learn into high-quality narratives: the kind that earns genuine respect in engineering communities, gets accepted at top-tier conferences, and attracts exceptional engineers from around the world.

The right person for this role is a skilled engineer who has found their voice as a writer and communicator; someone who can walk into a room of engineers as a peer, ask the right questions, and come out with a story worth telling.

Who You Are

To succeed in this role, you must have:
• Strong engineering capabilities: A solid background in computer science or software engineering. You have written and shipped code professionally, understand modern system architectures, and can deeply engage with complex technical concepts.
• Technical depth: Experience working within fintech, infrastructure, distributed systems, or high-scale engineering environments where you can comfortably read codebases, interpret technical documentation, and grasp deep architecture choices.
• Exceptional writing

skills:

Clarity, precision, and the ability to articulate intricate technical trade-offs and ideas accessibly without oversimplifying or watering them down.
• Proactive narrative instinct: The ability to independently dive into engineering projects, spot the most compelling technical breakthroughs or lessons, and build content around them without needing explicit instruction.
• Technical credibility: A genuine, firsthand understanding of what makes technical content credible, shareable, and respected by discerning engineering communities.
• Autonomy: The ability to manage multiple projects, technical interviews, and deadlines independently in a fully remote environment.

It's a strong plus if you have:
• Active engineering or open-source involvement: An active presence in developer spaces, an updated technical blog, open-source contributions, or a history of speaking at engineering conferences.
• Developer Relations

experience:

Background in DevRel or managing technical communities, showing you know how to engage developers authentically at scale.
• Track record in technical publishing: Experience drafting accepted conference abstracts/proposals (CFPs) for recognized industry events.
• Multimodal content production: Experience writing technical video scripts, technical teardowns, or working alongside creative production teams.

What to expect in the hiring process
• A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
• A take-home assessment
• Panel interview
• Executive interview

jobs.title: Head of Compliance, EU & UK
jobs.description:
About the Team:

Compliance at OKX is a trusted partner to the business. We're a team of risk-minded problem solvers who make sure OKX grows safely and sustainably. We advise on regulatory obligations, uphold strong controls, and continuously improve our processes so the business can scale responsibly.

 

What You'll be Doing:

As Head of Compliance, Europe UK, you'll lead the compliance program across OKX's European and UK entities. You'll report to the Deputy Chief Compliance Officer and Head of International Compliance, and take the regional function to its next level of maturity.

Your mandate is to build a robust, efficient compliance program that supports sustainable growth. You'll lead a team of Country Heads of Compliance and MLROs, bringing them together as a cohesive, high-performing regional team. Each will keep their local regulatory responsibilities and decision-making authority.
• Set the strategic direction and lead delivery of the compliance program across all OKX entities in Europe and the UK.
• Lead, support and develop Country Heads of Compliance and MLROs, strengthening consistency across the region while preserving local accountability and decision-making.
• Maintain the independence of the compliance function, with direct access to local Boards and the authority to challenge the business where needed.
• Review current workflows and improve them. Put in place scalable frameworks, and use data, automation and AI-enabled tools to improve the quality and timeliness of decisions while keeping controls strong.
• Work with first-, second- and third-line teams to build a control environment that meets or exceeds regulatory expectations.
• Act as a senior point of contact for regulators, leading or supporting examinations, inquiries and supervisory engagement.
• Partner with Business, Product and Legal on licensing scope assessments and compliance input for new products and market entries.
• Build strong partnerships with business leaders and stakeholders across Product, Legal, Operations and Risk, giving clear, practical guidance on the compliance implications of commercial decisions.
• Produce data-driven compliance reports for management and local Boards, using metrics, SLAs and KPIs that show the effectiveness of the compliance program.
• Take part in Board and committee meetings, as a member or as needed.
• Act as the escalation point for complex compliance issues, making sure they're resolved promptly and in line with the compliance program.
• Work with first-, second- and third-line teams to build a control environment that meets or exceeds regulatory expectations.
• Audit current workflows and remove unncessary friction. Implement scalable frameworks that reduce manual effort, and use data, automation and AI-enabled tools to speed up decision-making without compromising control integrity.
• Liaise with first, second, and third-line teams to build a control environment that exceeds regulatory standards while maintaining commercial agility.
• Oversee compliance reviews and investigations.
• Act as a senior point of contact with country regulators, including leading or supporting regulatory examinations, inquiries, and supervisory engagement.

 

What We Look For in You:
• 10–12+ years of compliance experience in financial services, fintech or crypto, with a track record of building and running effective compliance programs.
• A proven ability to solve problems, meet tight deadlines and deliver in a high-pressure environment.
• Experience working closely with Operations teams, balancing regulatory requirements with operational efficiency.
• Strong knowledge of EU and UK regulation, including MiCA, MiFID II, MAR, the EU AML framework (AMLD5/6, AMLR and AMLA), the Transfer of Funds Regulation (Travel Rule), DORA and GDPR, plus the UK cryptoasset regime.
• Strong people leadership, including leading teams spread across locations.
• Proven experience managing and developing senior compliance leaders, such as Heads of Compliance and MLROs, across multiple countries or entities, ideally within a regulated group.
• Comfort using data to measure performance, spot bottlenecks and justify resourcing.
• A proven ability to present the compliance program, risk posture and performance to Boards, regulators and senior committees.
• Clear, high-impact communication. You can explain complex regulatory concepts to product teams and operational challenges to regulators.

 

Nice to Haves:
• Experience scaling a crypto or high-growth fintech business in Europe.
• Prior experience in the crypto industry.
• Prior experience as a Country Head of Compliance or MLRO, or in another approved role.
• Experience working with the MFSA, FIAU, FCA or other European regulators.
• CAMS, an ICA Diploma or an equivalent certification.

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and an education subsidy
• Team-building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare for employees and dependants
• More we'd love to tell you about during the process!

jobs.title: Technology and Security Risk Director
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a highly motivated Technology and Security Risk Manager within the Second Line of Defence (2LOD). You will be responsible for continuously refining and scaling the Technology and Security oversight program, guiding first-line of defence (1LOD) execution, and providing independent risk challenge.

You will be a key member of OKX's Risk team, helping to shape and scale the firm’s 2LOD Security Data Risk programs. You’ll work closely with stakeholders including Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit.

You will play a key role in developing and implementing a comprehensive Technology and Security Risk Management program. This includes 2LOD oversight of technology defects, issues, and incidents, Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), key risk indicators (KRIs) and reporting.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of Technology Risk (including Technology Resilience, Change Management, SDLC, CI/CD pipeline, and software quality assurance) and Cybersecurity (covering internal and external threat vectors, control weaknesses, and organisational cyber hygiene). We are looking for a candidate with a strong drive for improvement and career growth.

What You’ll Be Doing 

Collaborate with internal stakeholders across the company to proactively identify, escalate, assess, and mitigate Technology and Security risks, ensuring adherence to the Technology Risk Policy.

Providing oversight of Technology and Security Risk incidents and issues, and partnering with 1LOD stakeholders to enhance related processes and ensure effective oversight

Lead the Technology Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) process from a 2LOD perspective, ensuring adherence to the ERM RCSA methodology, and providing effective challenge and oversight of 1LOD Security risks and controls.

Support the Security Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) definition, monitoring, and reporting.

Supporting the implementation and ongoing enhancement of Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) systems to enable effective risk oversight

Advocate and support the implementation of Risk Management frameworks for technology stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor for the first line.

Stay up to date on emerging trends and regulations in the digital asset space, proactively identifying and addressing new risk considerations.

What We Look For In You
• 8+ years in information security, with a strong security architecture or technical security background; fintech, crypto or cloud-native experience preferred.
• Practical experience designing, implementing or reviewing cloud, IAM, cryptographic, network or application security controls.
• Experience in risk oversight, or readiness to transition, with the technical judgement to challenge controls and recommend proportionate improvements.
• Ability to threat-model systems and assess technical evidence, including architecture diagrams, IAM policies, logging configurations and dependencies.
• Working knowledge of cloud resilience, multi-region/AZ failover, RTO/RPO and disaster recovery testing.
• Familiarity with NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and relevant privacy requirements, including GDPR and PDPA, and their application to technical controls.
• Ability to independently assess and test controls, evaluate incidents and drive remediation with engineering and security teams; GRC platform experience desirable.
• Clear written and verbal communication, translating technical findings into prioritised actions for business stakeholders and governance committees.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, providing constructive challenge and collaborating across functions and geographies.
• A proactive, adaptable approach, with confidence taking ownership and improving practices in a fast-paced environment.
• A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience; CISSP, CCSP, cloud security/architecture, CISA or CISM qualifications desirable.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.

jobs.title: 経営企画（生命保険領域のスペシャリスト）
jobs.description:
PayPayについて

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50か国の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_

我々は自分たちの想像を超える未来を創るためにあえて明確なビジョンは必要ないと考えています。常にDay1であるスタンスを忘れずに、誰もが想像できないようなビジョン（未来）を実現していくのがPayPayです。
この壮大なビジョンに前向きに取り組み、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、自ら課題発見し、周囲と協力して新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

 

業務について

▼組織・チームについて

経営企画部では、PayPayグループの事業成長と収益性向上を支えることをミッションとしています。
短期・中長期の経営計画策定や進捗管理、各種KPI・損益の予実分析、経営陣への報告・改善提案を通じて、経営課題の解決や戦略施策の実行を支援しています。また、これらを支える管理会計基盤の整備・運営にも取り組んでいます。

▼募集の背景

PayPayグループにおける生命保険領域の強化に向けて、資本・規制・会計・保険数理など、複数の専門領域を横断した経営課題への対応が重要となっています。
本ポジションでは、生命保険領域の専門性を活かし、関係部門や外部パートナーと連携しながら、経営判断に必要な論点整理・分析・提言を主体的に推進いただける方を募集しています。

【具体的な仕事の内容】

成長戦略を踏まえ、生命保険領域における中長期事業計画・年度予算の策定や、資本・規制・会計・保険数理などの観点から経営上の重要テーマを検討いただきます。

具体的な業務内容例：
• 生命保険領域における中長期事業計画・年度予算の策定
• 資本・規制・保険会計・負債評価・ALM等を踏まえた経営課題の分析・検討、経営陣への提言
• 監査法人・外部パートナー等と連携した専門的な論点の検討・推進
• 関係会社・パートナー企業の業務・運用実態の把握および経営課題の検討への反映
• 経理・財務・リスク・法務・事業部門等と連携した部門横断プロジェクトの推進

• 経営の意思決定に直接関与：

jobs.title: Java Software Engineer - Finance and Accounting
jobs.description:
Starling is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way.

We’re a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We’re a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. We employ more than 3,000 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

Our technologists are at the very heart of Starling and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Starling is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, discovering, to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five Starling values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Starling - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

Our Engineering Environment

Starling engineers are excited about helping us deliver new features, regardless of what their primary tech stack may be. Hear from the team in our latest blogs or our case studies with Women in Tech.

We value people being engaged and caring about customers, caring about the code they write and the contribution they make to Starling. People with a broad ability to apply themselves to a multitude of problems and challenges, who can work across teams do great things here at Starling, to continue changing banking for good.

We’re seeking highly motivated engineers with around 3-4 years of Java experience to play a key role in our Finance Engineering team. You will take part in writing and supporting key financial systems such as the bank’s ledgers and the systems that integrate with them.

We're looking for engineers who have good attention to detail and can write clear, concise and maintainable code. You should have a good understanding of the lifecycle of a project and be able to engage in this process with internal stakeholders, as well as experience in designing systems to solve problems. Experience with Postgres is highly desirable, and any experience with Netsuite would be a bonus.

We’re open-minded when it comes to hiring; we care more about aptitude and attitude than specific qualifications. We code mostly in Java, with some TypeScript, but you need not be an expert when you join us! We care about the quality and resilience of the systems we build, and if you’re motivated to find elegant solutions to difficult technical problems, we’d love to hear from you.

The main part of our Tech Stack is listed below. We don't ask that you have experience in all of this, but if you do, that's great!
• Java (makes up the majority of our backend codebase)
• Postgres
• AWS & GCP (we're cloud-native)
• Distributed service-based architecture
• Kubernetes (EKS)
• TeamCity for CI/CD (we release our changes frequently throughout the day!)
• Terraform and Grafana

The Team

The Finance Engineering team sits at the core of the bank, and is responsible for the correct accounting of every transaction that passes through the bank's systems. Our team focuses on correctness and accuracy of transactions, on recording the underlying story of money as it moves, and on supporting and automating the complex financial processes that take place behind the scenes.

We work directly with the treasurers and accountants that allow the bank to thrive, and with every project and system within the bank that has financial impact. This is a unique opportunity to work with some of Starling's mission-critical services and products.

Our process:

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• Initial phone call - ~45 minutes
• Take home technical test to be discussed in the technical interview - ~3 hours
• Technical interview - ~1.5 hours
• Final Interview - ~40 minutes
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

About us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Starling is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Starling are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice.

By submitting your application, you agree that Starling may collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead - Account Management
jobs.description:
We're looking for an Engineering Lead to join the Account Management team. This team is building the Current Account and Everyday banking experience products, which sit at the heart of Wise. The team owns how customers hold, organise and move their money day to day - their main account and Jars, the home screen they open, the flows they use to move, convert and add funds - and the ledger and money-movement systems underneath that the rest of the company builds on top of. Our mission is to make Wise the account customers reach for every day, and ultimately the last account they'll need to open.

The role spans engineering, product and people. You'll go broad across all three rather than deep in any one. You'll guide the team, own where it takes its systems technically, and partner with your Product Manager and Design to ship what customers rely on - staying close enough to the code to make sound architectural calls and unblock the team when it matters.

 

What you'll be doing
• Lead the team's engineers - own what they ship and their well-being, and build a clear view of how to grow each of them.
• Stay hands-on: write code, review designs and PRs, and drive whole features across backend, web and mobile, coordinating delivery across all three.
• Own the team's technical roadmap. Decide how the systems evolve, keep reliability and tech-debt risk in check, and make the architectural calls that matter.
• Partner with your PM and Design, and give sharp feedback on what's worth building and why.
• Work across boundaries with the teams we build alongside: Account Sharing on joint accounts, Send on how money moves in and out, Wise Platform on products they build on top of account.

What you'll need to succeed.

We don’t expect candidates to tick all the boxes. If you have most of the below and want to grow into the rest, we'd love to hear from you.

 

Technical
• Strong backend engineering background, close to the code to guide senior engineers through hard problems.
• Deep understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures and microservices, and comfort making high-impact architectural decisions.
• Track record of owning the reliability, scalability and correctness of critical systems at scale.
• Comfortable in a JVM codebase, or confident you'll get there fast - we're on Java/Kotlin and Spring Boot.

Leadership
• Experience leading a team of engineers and owning what they deliver.
• Leadership through trust: you give people context and direction and let them own their work.
• A clear communicator who can hold a technical argument with engineers and explain it plainly to everyone else.

Product
• A product engineer’s mindset - you measure your work by customer and business impact.
• Bias to action and comfort with ambiguity: you move quickly without dropping quality.

Nice to have
• You use AI to build faster, and you're curious where it's heading.
• You've worked in fintech, payments or banking.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analytics Manager - Wise Business
jobs.description:
Your Mission:

We're looking for a Senior Product Analytics Manager to lead analytics for the Business Account Squad at Wise. 

You’ll lead a team of 5+ analysts who are embedded in the product teams that are building the primary account businesses use for their banking needs - globally! 

The Business Account Squad sits at the heart of our proposition for businesses, building solutions to ensure that businesses can successfully and safely start to use Wise; empowering them with the workflows and controls needed to run their finances globally with ease!

Robust analytical leadership is critical to ensure we proactively leverage data to shape our roadmap and drive high-impact initiatives, ensuring that every product decision makes moving money faster, cheaper, and easier for everyone, everywhere. 

This is an AL2 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.

 

What you’ll be doing:
• Partner with Product/Engineering/Design leads to identify opportunities to improve our product and bring them to life; review team plans and progress, giving them effective feedback.
• Create and communicate a clear picture of progress against product goals. Ensure that we have clear goals, measurable KPIs, narrate our progress and drive action to accelerate progress.
• Own the data strategy for Business Account Analytics: define the roadmap to build the data and tools necessary to scale impact. Increase the speed and effectiveness of decision making across the squad.
• Lead, develop and support a team of high performing analysts. Support analyst professional development via performance feedback & coaching; hire and plan capacity and ensure that analyst efforts maximise impact.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst - Financial Crime
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Product Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to join our Global Fraud Squad. In this role, you’ll help Wise scale safely and efficiently by uncovering gaps in our fraud controls and strengthening our intelligence through analytics. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action, improving how we detect, prevent, and respond to fraud.

How you’ll contribute

Proactive detection & insights sharing
• Proactively hunt for anomalies, blind spots and gaps in controls using transaction, event and case data.
• Build Rules and features for our detection engine to catch fraudsters.
• Deliver frequent findings and recommended actions to the squad that lead to operational fixes.
• Drive root-cause and cohort analyses to diagnose why controls succeed or fail and propose prioritized remediation.
• Understand customer experience due to our controls and drive continuous improvements.

Drive KPI Performance
• Partner with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Operations and other Analysts to define and own fraud KPIs across Wise products and markets
• Identify, prioritise and drive initiatives with our product managers
• Link business outcomes to control-level metrics, define and own performance for your team

Analytical leadership in new market launches
• Be the primary analytical contact for fraud workstreams on new market launches
• Run pre-launch risk scenario modelling to estimate exposure and operational load.
• Provide clear go/no-go recommendations that balance risk, cost and customer impact.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Choose your path to impact – pick high-leverage problems, create the vision and own execution.
• Grow as a Product & Fraud Analyst – develop deep fraud domain expertise and combine it with your analytical skills.
• Work cross-functionally – partner with PMs, engineers, analysts, investigators, compliance and operations across markets.
• Be highly visible – your analysis will regularly inform Product and Risk Committees and shape strategic decisions.
• Deliver measurable change – your work will protect millions of customers while enabling Wise’s growth.

jobs.title: Director, Product Analytics (APAC)
jobs.description:
Salary Range: 230,000 - 318,000 SGD base per annum + RSUs

We’re looking for an Analytics Director for the APAC Squad who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders, to lead a high-impact analytics team that is central to building out the product roadmap for this major Region. This is a unique opportunity to drive decision making in a diverse, high-potential region!

You’ll report to the Global Senior Analytics Director for Regional Expansion, and partner daily with the Product, Banking and Engineering leads for the APAC squad. Together, you will form a cross-functional group of key decision makers who own the challenge of driving the product roadmap in this Region. You’ll also be part of the Analytics community within Wise, giving you access to a global network of analytics professionals.

You’ll lead a team of c.10 passionate product analysts and support them to partner across product teams to drive data-led decision making and ensure robust measurement of the impact of the work we do! You will also support them in identifying insights to inform our planning process - all to ensure that we are enhancing our customer’s experience across the diverse countries in the APAC region. 

If you’ve previously led or helped to build analytics teams in fast-paced, scaling, global companies - we’d love to hear from you. 

Problems you’ll solve

in this role:
• Support the APAC squad to address the most important challenges for the Region using data and insights, and building relevant KPIs to measure impact and hold ourselves accountable

jobs.title: Fraud Analyst (1 Year Contract)
jobs.description:
We Are:

YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the team
• As a key digital asset hub, Singapore is an integral part of our global strategy. Licensed by MAS, OKX SG is focused on providing Singapore users with a secure and user-friendly platform for trading digital assets.
• The Commercial team is responsible for developing and deepening relationships with high-value individual and institutional clients, understanding their needs, and connecting them with relevant products and solutions across the OKX ecosystem.

 

About the Opportunity
• We are seeking an experienced Assistant Relationship Manager to support our Relationship Managers in delivering a responsive, seamless experience for high-value clients in Singapore.
• You will take ownership of client preparation, day-to-day servicing, follow-up, and internal coordination across the client lifecycle. This includes ensuring RMs are well prepared for client conversations, agreed actions are completed promptly, and client requests are handled with care and professionalism across Product, Operations, Compliance, and other internal teams.
• This is a hands-on, client-facing role for someone who understands the expectations of sophisticated clients, anticipates what needs to be done, and follows through reliably. Success requires strong attention to detail, sound judgement, and a high level of ownership in ensuring both RMs and clients receive consistent, high-quality support.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Client Meeting Preparation
- Prepare concise client briefs covering relationship history, account activity, outstanding requests, and relevant discussion points, ensuring RMs are well prepared for client conversations.
- Coordinate meeting agendas, materials, and logistics, and conduct client or prospect research as required.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records, ensuring relevant information is readily accessible to RMs.
• Onboarding Account Support
- Guide clients through onboarding and account maintenance, clearly communicating documentation requirements, next steps, and progress.
- Coordinate KYC and account-related requests with Operations and Compliance, checking submissions for completeness and following up on outstanding information.
- Drive operational blockers towards resolution, recognising when matters require RM involvement or specialist review and escalating promptly.
• RM Enablement Process Improvement
- Maintain CRM records, action trackers, and reporting so RMs have clear visibility of client priorities and outstanding actions.
- Develop knowledge of OKX products and processes to independently handle routine enquiries and anticipate information RMs may need.
- Identify recurring service issues and improve workflows to reduce administrative burden, strengthen follow-through, and improve the overall client experience.
• Commercial Support
- Support RMs with research and preparation for prospective high-value clients, including understanding their business, trading or investment needs, and relevant market developments.
- Support prospect follow-up and progression through the sales process, coordinating agreed next steps and maintaining momentum.
- Where appropriate, support targeted outreach and initial client engagement under the direction of RMs.

 

What We Look For In You
• 5+ years of experience in financial services, fintech, crypto, wealth management, institutional sales, client servicing, or another relevant commercial environment.
• Strong interest in crypto and financial markets, with the curiosity and ability to develop deep product knowledge quickly.
• Commercially minded and confident engaging directly with clients, with the ambition to develop into an independent Relationship Manager.
• Experience supporting HNW/UHNW, family-office, institutional or other sophisticated clients, including complex account structures and time-sensitive instructions.
• Strong ownership and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple client requests and ensure issues are driven through to resolution.
• Analytical and detail-oriented, with the ability to use client and activity data to identify commercial opportunities.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across clients and internal stakeholders.
• Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.
• Fluency in English and Mandarin is required

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Team

The Global Legal team provides legal advice and guidance to OKX and its affiliated entities across all coverage areas and geographic locations, and supports business growth by working with all teams within the company to help them achieve their goals. Our team has attorneys around the world, and handles legal matters in literally hundreds of countries across the globe.

About the role
• Head of Litigation Investigations, Asia Pacific, Middle East Africa
• OKX’s footprint in these regions generates streams of contentious work that require one accountable owner in region responsible for civil litigation and arbitration including affirmative civil recovery; defensive civil litigation and arbitration; and leading regulatory enforcement investigations and responses as well as certain internal investigations.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Civil litigation:
• Own and lead the regional civil docket end-to-end including intake, early case assessment, strategy and resolution both on the defence and plaintiff side.
• Lead the affirmative side of civil disputes, e.g., recovery actions, injunctions, disclosure applications, applications against counterparties, service providers, bad actors, etc.
• Assess and develop strategy for defensive civil claims including consumer claims at volume, market conduct issues, and coordinate on relevant contentious employment matters.
• Manage and lead commercial disputes.
• Arbitration
• Real depth of arbitration experience preferred. Lead OKX’s arbitrations in the region as counsel-in-charge, including pleadings, document production, witness and expert evidence, hearings, enforcement proceedings.
• Assess mass arbitration exposure in conjunction with business priorities and develop strategic plan for risk mitigation.
• Advise business and business Legal teams on dispute resolution clauses.
• Regulatory Enforcement Internal Investigations
• Develop strategy and lead OKX’s response to regulatory enforcement inquiries working in close collaboration with Global Regulatory Legal team.
• Scope, lead and where appropriate personally conduct sensitive internal investigations. Deliver as needed root causes analysis and collaborate cross-functionally on remediation.
• Team leadership: Lead and develop the in-region team, embed AI to drive efficiency, and partner across Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, HR and Communications.
• External counsel, budget and reporting: Select and manage external counsel and experts; own the regional contentious budget and in-house/outside counsel decisions; ensure proper matter tracking and disclosure; deliver decision-ready reporting to the Global Head and governance forums.

What We Look For In You
• Approximately 12+ years post qualification experience in contentious work with experience in Asia. Candidates with more experience will be considered.
• Candidate may be based in Hong Kong or Singapore with additional locations to be considered.
• Arbitration and trial experience.
• Experience leading a team.
• Sound judgment under ambiguity. Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a growing regulatory landscape.
• Excellent written and spoken English
• Willingness to travel across the region.

Nice to Haves
• Experience in crypto, digital assets, fintech, traditional finance, or payments.
• Experience or familiarity with Middle East disputes and enforcement.
• Mandarin and/or Cantonese at professional working level preferred — a material advantage for law enforcement and regulatory engagement in the region.
• Prior in-house experience
• Additional qualifications in England Wales, Singapore, New York, California, Texas, Australia or another common law jurisdiction is welcome.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

 

Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.
