jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

Our mission is to drive user growth and engagement across global markets by building a scalable growth platform — the shared campaign engine, task and incentive systems, loyalty programs, and ToB operational tooling that power growth for every business line at OKX — and by unlocking acquisition through diversified channels including SEO, ASO, affiliate, referral, and paid.

As the Growth Platform Product Lead, you will own the product vision and roadmap for our growth middle-platform, lead a team of product managers, and act as the central partner to business, channel, and regional stakeholders who rely on the platform to hit their growth targets. This is a leadership role for someone who has built growth infrastructure at scale and knows how to turn a fragmented set of campaign tools into a unified, self-serve growth system.

What You’ll Be Doing 

Own the Growth Platform Strategy
• Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for the growth middle-platform: campaign engine, task/mission system, rewards and incentive infrastructure, loyalty and tiering, user segmentation and targeting, and the ToB configuration and analytics layer that operators use daily.
• Set platform standards for reusability, configurability, and time-to-launch so that new growth activities can be shipped by business teams without bespoke engineering.
• Balance platform investment against business-line requests, and make clear, well-communicated prioritization calls.

Build the Platform
• Lead the design and delivery of ToC growth products (campaigns, tasks, mega sales, loyalty) and the ToB capabilities behind them (campaign configuration, rules engine, budget and risk controls, reporting).
• Drive experimentation infrastructure and growth analytics so that every campaign is measurable, comparable, and optimizable.
• Leverage AI tools and automation to shorten experimentation cycles, surface insights faster, and scale growth operations with fewer manual touchpoints.

Enable Channel Growth
• Partner with channel owners across SEO, ASO, referral, affiliate, and paid to translate channel-specific funnel needs into platform capabilities.
• Identify high-leverage channel opportunities and build the platform features that amplify channel performance across markets.

Manage Stakeholders Across the Organization
• Serve as the single point of accountability for the growth platform with Trading, Listing, Paid Ads, Content, Affiliate, Referral, regional growth teams, and risk/compliance.
• Establish intake, prioritization, and governance processes that keep dozens of concurrent stakeholders aligned and informed.
• Influence senior leadership on platform investment, trade-offs, and sequencing; resolve conflicts between business urgency and platform integrity.

Lead and Grow the Team
• Manage, coach, and develop a team of product managers; set clear goals, review work quality, and build a high-performance culture.
• Raise the bar on PM craft across the team: problem framing, data literacy, spec quality, and cross-functional execution.

What We Look For In You
• 5+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years managing product managers and owning a multi-quarter roadmap.
• Deep growth middle-platform

experience:

you have designed and shipped a campaign engine, task/mission system, incentive or rewards platform, loyalty program, or comparable shared growth infrastructure that served multiple business lines.
• Proven platform thinking: track record of consolidating scattered, one-off growth tools into a reusable, configurable, self-serve system, and of measuring the efficiency gains that resulted.
• Exceptional stakeholder management: demonstrated ability to run intake and prioritization across many competing internal customers, manage up to executive leadership, and hold the line on platform trade-offs without losing partner trust.
• Strong data and analytics fluency: comfortable defining campaign and platform metrics, reading experiment results, and using data to settle prioritization debates.
• Large-scale delivery: experience navigating complex cross-team dependencies in a fast-moving, global organization.
• High learning velocity: able to rapidly internalize new domains — crypto, regional markets, new channels — and connect product, data, and market signals into actionable strategy.

Nice-To-Haves
• Experience in crypto, fintech, or other regulated consumer products where growth mechanics must satisfy risk and compliance constraints.
• Hands-on experience with SEO and/or ASO strategy, including keyword optimization, app store listing optimization, and organic growth levers.
• Experience building ToB operational platforms or internal tooling used by non-technical operators at scale.
• Experience applying AI/LLM tooling to growth operations, analytics, or PM workflows.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

jobs.title: Senior Market & Trading Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

 

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the Opportunity

You will join our Data Analytics team, which owns two core data domains end to end:
• Public market data — trades, quotes, funding, and full order-book data continuously captured from global crypto exchanges at petabyte scale.
• Proprietary trading data — orders, fills, positions, balances, and settlement activity streamed from internal desks and systems.

We are one team rather than separate engineering and analytics functions. The same people build pipelines, model data, validate its correctness, and answer the business questions it supports. You will see data problems through end to end: from the exchange connection or internal source through to the analysis produced from it.

This is an exciting time to join. We are rebuilding the platform on ClickHouse, Apache Iceberg, and Kafka while continuing to support live trading. The work combines substantial platform design with hands-on ownership of business-critical data.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Build and operate pipelines that bring market and trading data into our platform, including ingestion, parsing, normalization, validation, and storage.
• Build and extend Python- and SQL-based datasets and data models used by trading desks, quants, research, and analytics teams.
• Own data correctness through source reconciliation, data-quality and completeness checks, gap and duplicate detection, backfills, and replays.
• Investigate discrepancies end to end. Trace unexpected numbers through the pipeline to the source and fix root causes rather than symptoms.
• Onboard new exchanges, venues, products, and internal data sources, addressing real-world external-feed behaviour including authentication, rate limits, disconnects, missing history, and schema changes.
• Support data users through query support, data access, APIs, and client libraries.
• Operate what you build, including monitoring, alerting, and incident response for owned pipelines and datasets.
• Contribute to the migration toward ClickHouse, Iceberg, Kafka, and Kubernetes by running new and legacy paths in parallel, reconciling results, and cutting over safely.
• Use AI coding assistants and LLM tooling to improve development, debugging, and data investigation, while applying sound judgement and independently validating outputs.
• Depending on team needs and your strengths, develop deeper expertise in either real-time platform and pipeline engineering or proprietary trading-data datasets and analysis. Both are core to the team.

What We Look For In You
• Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
• 3–5 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, software engineering, or analytics engineering.
• Strong production-quality programming skills in Java, Python, or both.
• Sound data-modelling judgement. You can design schemas that scale with evolving data and use cases, including keys, granularity, partitioning, and schema evolution.
• Ability to reason about query behaviour and performance over large datasets.
• Demonstrated production ownership. You have designed, delivered, and operated a pipeline, service, or dataset that other teams depend on, including its reliability, monitoring, and failure modes.
• Rigour in data correctness. You validate outputs before they reach users, cross-check against independent sources where possible, and treat silent data errors as serious defects.
• Structured problem-solving under uncertainty. You can decompose ambiguous data discrepancies, form and test hypotheses, and reach defensible conclusions while clearly stating assumptions and outstanding verification needs.
• Strong initiative and persistence. You identify gaps, act without waiting for direction, work through difficult problems, and get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar systems and domains.
• Strong communication skills in both Chinese and English.

Nice to Have
• Experience in crypto, market data, trading systems, or trading operations.
• Strong Java systems-engineering capability, including JVM and concurrency fundamentals, profiling, performance tuning, and reliable high-throughput services.
• Strong Python data-engineering capability, including pandas, Polars, PyArrow, or Spark; experience with vectorisation, memory behaviour, and processing datasets larger than memory.
• Experience delivering tested, packaged Python tooling that other teams depend on.
• Depth in trading-data analysis, such as reconstructing positions from fills, balances from transfers, or PnL across settlement or expiry boundaries.
• Experience reconciling derived trading data against authoritative sources and resolving discrepancies between systems.
• Experience with real-time streaming pipelines, ideally Kafka, including ordering, gap detection, checkpoints, restart recovery, and replay.
• Hands-on experience with time-series or analytical databases, including partitioning, retention, and query-performance tuning at scale.
• Exposure to Apache Iceberg, Parquet, Spark, gRPC, Kubernetes, or cloud data infrastructure.
• Experience building connectors to external REST or WebSocket APIs.

Working Model
• Hong Kong, onsite (in-office).

 Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package.
• Learning and development programs and education subsidy for employees’ growth and development.
• Various team-building programs and company events.
• Wellness and meal allowances.
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependents.

jobs.description:
About PayPay

PayPay is a FinTech company that has grown to over 75M (as of August 2026) users since its launch in
2018. Our team is hugely diverse with members from over 50 different countries.

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_ 

We dare to believe that we do not need a clear vision to create a future beyond our imagination. PayPay will always stay true to our roots and realize a vision (future) that no one else can imagine by constantly taking risks and challenging ourselves. With this mindset, you will be presented with new and exciting opportunities on a daily basis and have the opportunity to grow and reach new dimensions that you could never have imagined. We are looking for people who can embrace this challenge, refresh the product at breakneck speed and promote PayPay with professionalism and passion.
※ Please note that you cannot apply or be selected in parallel with PayPay Corporation, PayPay Card Corporation and PayPay Securities Corporation.

 

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Platform Engineer to manage and enhance our end-to-end application delivery platform, from CloudFront to the underlying EKS clusters. Moving beyond standard maintenance, this role combines production infrastructure ownership with software engineering. You will build and scale robust in-house platform tools, develop custom Kubernetes controllers, and automate complex workflows safely. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation across cloud infrastructure, networking, Kubernetes, and service mesh technologies, with deep expertise in at least one of these areas. The candidate will also have production experience in Python or Go and the versatility to become productive in the other. We particularly value engineers who can quickly understand unfamiliar systems, capable of using AI-assisted development effectively while remaining accountable for production stability, code maintainability, and operational safety.

In this role, you will play a pivotal part in raising our engineering velocity and defining the reliability standards of our platform.

Main Responsibilities
• Develop, maintain, and automate in-house tools, Kubernetes manifest generator engine and scripts using programming languages like Python or Go to improve platform operations and efficiency.
• Perform upgrades and patching of EKS clusters and associated components, and improve the process through safe, repeatable automation.
• Manage and optimize related components such as Karpenter (cluster autoscaling) and Argo CD (GitOps continuous delivery).
• Implement and manage service mesh solutions (e.g., Istio, Linkerd) for enhanced traffic management, security, and observability.
• Participate in an on-call rotation to provide 24/7 support for critical platform issues and monitor the platform for potential issues and implement preventative measures.
• Configure and manage CloudFront distributions, WAF web ACLs for efficient secure content delivery traffic management.
• Develop and maintain documentation for platform architecture, processes, and troubleshooting guides.

• Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Quickwit.
• Platform Tools: Istio, Karpenter, Kyverno, KEDA, Artifactory, AWS Load Balancer Controller, ingress controller, cert-manager.

Required Qualifications
• Demonstrable experience with advanced software engineering practices, including unit/integration testing.
• Deep understanding of Kubernetes internals and the controller-runtime framework, experience developing, testing, and maintaining custom controllers/operators and CustomResourceDefinitions.
• Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), or similar role with a focus on end-to-end platform ownership.
• Strong understanding and practical experience with Karpenter, Argo CD, Terraform..
• Strong networking fundamentals and the ability to troubleshoot an end-to-end request path across CloudFront, WAF, load balancers, Kubernetes networking, service mesh, and workloads.

Preferred Qualifications
• Prior experience working with service mesh technologies (preferably Istio) in a production environment.
• Demonstrable experience with SSL/TLS certificate management.

jobs.title: IT SOX Controls Tester
jobs.description:

The Security Controls team plays a vital role in safeguarding Wise’s complex IT landscape. We specialise in the comprehensive testing, assessment, and continuous improvement of technology-related controls. This role requires experience in testing controls in a cloud-native environment as opposed to legacy IT systems. 

 

Your Mission:
• Perform control testing (Design & Operating Effectiveness) for Access Management, Change Management, and IT application controls across our cloud infrastructure and SaaS landscape.
• Partner with key stakeholders across Finance, Risk, Security, Platform to effectively communicate SOX 404 requirements and expectations.
• Support control owners on their journey to mature our risk and control environment.

jobs.title: Banking & Expansion Manager / Country Manager
jobs.description:
People and businesses all over the world use Wise to avoid big bank fees and week-long international wires when they send, spend, and receive money abroad. We have over 15 million customers who move $15 billion every month with us. We help them save more than $6 million in bank fees every day.

Our banking relationships determine the quality of our product and a large part of its economics. And our relationships with regulators, governments and payment systems are crucial too. So, we’re on the hunt for an executor with a brilliant mind and strong communication skills to expand our product offering in Colombia. 

This is a unique and exciting opportunity to play a pioneering role to grow Wise in one of our key markets, allowing millions more potential customers to save money by using our services. You will have full responsibility for overseeing our local operations, defining our market expansion strategy and executing on it, and being the face of Wise in Colombia. 

What will you be doing?

Working with the Product teams (Product Managers, Analysts and Engineers), you will help define the opportunities for our products in Colombia and will help build better products and experiences for our customers. You will collaborate across teams and inspire others so that we deliver the best solution. Your contribution will mainly be from the payments infrastructure, regulatory and operational banking partnerships point of view.

Your mission:

To own and expand Wise’s regulatory presence in the country.
• Identify the most appropriate way to grow Wise in Colombia. You will manage the entire licensing process for Wise’s entry into Colombia and will: understand the regulations, prepare, coordinate and submit the application, and get the regulatory buy-in as well as support the fulfillment of any other local requirements for the license applications.
• Identify opportunities to offer the best product in the market taking advantage of our existing framework and future authorizations.
• Understand existing and new regulations and figure out the best ways our product can comply with them. You will translate regulatory requirements into product implementations together with our Compliance teams. You will be one of the product team’s go-to people for regulatory knowledge. We see regulation as an opportunity!

Contribute to defining the opportunities and direction for our products in Colombia. Collaborate across teams and inspire others so that we deliver the best solution.
• Work closely with product teams (Product Managers and Product Engineers) to develop our vision and build better products and experiences for our customers. Your contribution will mainly be from the payments infrastructure, regulatory and operational banking partnerships point of view.
• Work with our global teams (Product, Finance, Treasury, etc.) to ensure our customers and products are at the center of our mission.
• Be the person of reference in our new Colombia office, from both internal and external perspectives.

To build new relationships with relevant financial institutions:
• Open new relationships with relevant financial institutions (i.e. banks, payment processors, cards issuers, processors, etc.). You will manage the process end-to-end: find the right potential partners, pitch Wise as a client, negotiate the commercial agreements and contracts, complete account opening forms, explain our compliance processes, pass due diligence, and do anything else needed to be ready for development.

Take ownership of improving existing relationships with transactional banking partners and other financial institutions. You will:
• Lead commercial and relationship discussions with partners and monitor our economics to ensure we offer the most sustainable and competitive service in the market.
• Create new opportunities within existing relationships with financial institutions in Colombia to ensure we continuously improve our product (i.e. increase speed, reduce costs, add more visibility to our transactions, etc.).

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer - Scam Prevention
jobs.description:
The team you will be joining: Scam Prevention Team

The Scam Prevention team is on the front lines, dedicated to safeguarding our platform against sophisticated financial crime. We leverage cutting-edge machine learning, real-time transaction monitoring, and advanced data analysis to create robust controls and detection capabilities. Our vision is to build a globally scalable fraud prevention engine that protects customer accounts, prevents scams, and consistently surpasses regulatory expectations.

What will you be working on?

This defining role involves continuously improving our financial crime prevention infrastructure and systems. You will deliver a direct, measurable impact on customer security by taking end-to-end ownership of projects focused on:
• Building and refining critical controls to prevent Wise customers from scams.
• Drive Backend and Frontend for our scam prevention and detection systems - You will be working 80% of the time on a backend and 20% on the frontend
• You will be delivering a tangible, real-world impact by securing customers' money, accelerating product growth by raising automation levels, and helping us engineer a world-class money transfer product.

What do we need from you?
• Engineering Expertise: 6+ years of professional experience with Java, including the Spring framework. Experience building and designing scalable web applications that handle large amounts of traffic - ideally using React based frontend applications, Javascript / Typescript.
• System Design & Operation: Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines, Distributed, and Concurrent Systems.
• Product Ownership: A strong product mindset, accountability, and the ability to drive projects independently, making data-driven decisions with the customer in mind.
• Data Proficiency: Experience with relational and non-relational databases, including query optimisation and designing resilient schemas.
• Code Quality: Exceptional fundamentals, sharp problem-solving ability, and a commitment to Test Driven Development and best coding practices.
• Collaboration: Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts across teams (Product, Data Science, Investigations).

Nice to Have:
• Familiarity with the machine learning lifecycle (data pipelines, feature engineering, and deploying ML systems into production).

jobs.title: Senior Data Science Lead - AML Risk
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Data Science Lead to join our AML Risk team in London. 

This role is a unique opportunity to work on building out the lead Data Science team and machine learning based technical solutions in the AML Risk team, which owns AML detection across all of the Wise licenses. This is an exciting opportunity to develop the program in a global company. Your work will allow Wise to keep our customers safe and making sure we can keep our ecosystem free of bad actors in a scalable way. What you build will have a direct impact on Wise’s mission and millions of our customers.

About

the Role:

In the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Risk team we are developing systems which are a mixture of unsupervised and supervised learning, with GenAI to detect and mitigate Financial Crime on a global scale. You will be making sure the AML Risk Data Science team is well equipped and working on cutting-edge technology to sustainably support Wise’s growing customer, transaction and product space.

You will be stepping into an already functioning, but growing product team.

 

Here’s how you’ll be contributing
• AML Risk Detection System Development
• Developing efficient and effective AML detection controls using a mixture of unsupervised, semi supervised and supervised learning with GenAI
• Creating frameworks to prove controls coverage at a regional level
• Developing technologies to serve Wise’s diverse international user base

 

Building a team of high performing specialists
• Working with product managers and engineering leads to understand staffing requirements
• Hiring specialists
• Mentoring more junior members of the team on technical and non-technical skillsets

Performance Testing and Optimisation
• Evaluating our AML systems against internal and external benchmarks
• Developing decisioning layers to find optimal trade-offs between precision and recall
• Providing data-driven insights on potential outcomes under various scenarios

 

Operational Process Development
• Collaborating with operational teams to refine processes, ensuring effective feedback integration into our automation systems
• Designing and managing projects that utilise excess operational capacity, such as manual data labelling for model improvement
• Creating systems which provide in-depth insight to investigators on red flags and typologies present on profiles/transactions

Deployment and Implementation
• Packaging algorithms into deployable libraries/objects and transitioning them from staging to production environments
• Implementing and maintaining scheduled processes for data gathering and model retraining using automated pipelines
• Maintaining production-grade Python services

 

A bit

about you:
• Experience implementing, training, testing and evaluating performance of Machine Learning systems;
• Strong Python knowledge. A big plus for proven familiarity and experience with OOP principles;
• Experience with statistical analysis, and ability to produce well-designed experiments;
• A strong product mindset with the ability to work independently in a cross-functional and cross-team environment;
• Good communication skills and ability to get the point across to non-technical individuals;
• Strong problem solving skills with the ability to help refine problem statements and figure out how to solve them.

 

Some extra skills that are great (but not essential):
• Familiarity with automating operational processes via technical solutions, for example Large Language Models
• Willingness to get hands dirty with operational side by sides to understand their pain points
• Knowledge and experience within the Financial Crime domain

 

 

We’re people without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We want to work with the best people, no matter their background. So if you’re passionate about learning new things and keen to join our mission, you’ll fit right in.

Also, qualifications aren’t that important to us. If you’ve got great experience, and you’re great at articulating your thinking, we’d like to hear from you.

And because we believe that diverse teams build better products, we’d especially love to hear from you if you’re from an under-represented demographic.

jobs.title: Arbitration Specialist
jobs.description:
If you're interested in the position please apply by submitting your CV and Cover Letter. In your cover letter, please answer the following questions:
• What motivates you to apply for this role?
• Why would you be a good fit?

We’re looking for an Arbitration Specialist to join our growing team, with a primary focus on Japan (Tokyo) as well as supporting the wider APAC region.

The Complaints Arbitration Specialist will communicate directly with external arbitration bodies and regulators - representing Wise before local Japanese frameworks (such as the Tokyo Bar Association, JPSA, and KLFB) as well as wider APAC dispute resolution schemes (AFCA, FSCL, Fidrec, etc.). In this role, you will ensure we reach fair, compliant outcomes based on thorough case investigations, maintain professional relationships with arbitration bodies, contribute to root-cause analysis, and actively shape future policies and operational workflows within complaints and wider business functions. This role demands diligence, legal acumen, consistency, high-level bilingual communication, and the ability to handle sensitive regulatory information with the utmost care.

Your

responsibilities:
• Case Management: Investigate arbitration cases thoroughly, providing comprehensive background information and evidence. Conduct internal audits of the customer complaint journey to ensure fair outcomes.
• Arbitration decision process: Assess cases and decisions made by external arbitration bodies, taking ownership of legally binding outcomes. Ensure Wise presents all necessary evidence based on this assessment in both Japanese and English.
• Japan & APAC Market & Regulatory Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert for Japan while supporting the broader APAC region. Maintain an in-depth understanding of Japanese regulatory frameworks, (the Tokyo Bar Association (TBA) ADR process, JPSA procedures, etc.) and evolving regional dispute resolution trends to ensure full compliance and optimal outcomes for Wise customers. Proactively monitor regulatory changes and interpret their impact on our business.
• Strategic Growth & Scaling Insight: Apply an awareness of Wise's growth and scaling challenges in the APAC market to all case management and policy contributions, ensuring solutions are scalable and future-proof.
• Cross-Functional Influence & Action: Build and maintain effective working relationships with Compliance, Operations, and Product teams to effectively translate arbitration insights and regulatory changes into actionable policy and process improvements.
• Root Cause analysis and feedback: Collect vital company data on complaints, record arbitration decisions for use in Root Cause Analysis, and share feedback with relevant teams within Wise.
• Mitigate reputational damage from adverse decisions: Defend Wise against adverse decisions to safeguard the company's reputation.
• Work across multiple teams: Communicate with relevant product/operational teams to ensure a comprehensive understanding of cases and the ability to articulate this information to the arbitration body.
• Consistently hitting SLAs: Consistently handling cases within Wise’s SLAs, as well ensuring we do not breach cases based on the arbitration body deadline.
• Strong Fincrime knowledge: Maintain up-to-date knowledge on scam and deactivation complaints, understanding how they are handled across the business.
• Contribute to the team culture in a positive manner: Positively contribute to the team culture by assisting other Arbitration Specialists and Complaints Officers, sharing decisions, and providing feedback when necessary.

jobs.title: Product Compliance Senior Manager - APAC Assets

In 2022, Wise launched the Assets product in Singapore, a new type of account. In 2024, the Assets product was launched in Australia. Assets allows customers to invest the money they hold with Wise in different asset classes such as stocks or bonds while retaining the instant access and spend functionality of a checking account.

Your mission is to work with our product teams based both in Singapore and London to improve our Assets offering in Singapore in a compliant manner through a deep understanding of the regulatory requirements and regulators’ expectations around investment products. You will also support the product teams on expanding the Assets offering in new APAC markets.

This is a first line Product Compliance role, embedded in the Product team.

This role will give you the opportunity to:

• Work together with all our amazing teams globally

jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

Sales is the growth engine at Brex. We bring in new customers, expand existing relationships, and drive the company’s bottom line. With unlimited territories and uncapped opportunity, your ambition sets the ceiling. We win together, celebrate often, and reward performance. If you want to sell a category-defining product with real ownership, this is your team.

What you’ll do

As an Account Manager II, you'll strategically own a book of our higher-value, more complex customers and carry the number for net revenue retention and expansion across it. You'll operate as a commercial advisor rather than a support contact: multi-threading into economic buyers and finance executives, leading complex multi-product negotiations, and structuring deals that hold up over multiple years.

Roughly 70% of your time goes to commercial execution and growth, and the other 30% to driving the product adoption that makes expansion durable. You'll also be a force multiplier on the team, mentoring earlier-career AMs and helping set the standard for how the account management motion runs at Brex.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Strategically own a book of higher-value, more complex accounts, typically 100 to 130 accounts, and drive net revenue retention and expansion across it
• Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for your customers, ensuring Brex is an essential part of how they operate
• Act as a commercial advisor: multi-thread into economic buyers and executive stakeholders, from Controller up to CFO, tailoring your communication and value framing to each audience
• Drive revenue by proactively identifying expansion opportunities and tying Brex's value to measurable business results, including running structured discovery, building business cases, and creating commercial proposals
• Lead complex, multi-product negotiations and structure deals across pricing, terms, and multi-year commitments, partnering with Risk, Underwriting, Legal, and Deal Desk to balance customer needs with revenue impact
• Own large expansion and cross-sell motions in partnership with Sales and Solutions Engineering
• Turn churn-risk accounts around, handling objections and competitive pressure with ease, and flag risks early with a recommended plan of action
• Build and deliver quarterly business reviews that tie product value to commercial outcomes, ROI, and expansion
• Forecast with high accuracy and maintain rigorous pipeline, CRM, and deal hygiene in Salesforce
• Consistently meet or exceed retention and expansion quota each quarter
• Deeply understand each customer's workflows, accounting processes, and financial priorities to uncover pain points and steer stakeholder dynamics toward full adoption
• Champion adoption strategies across the Brex platform, spanning cards, spend management, bill pay, travel, and banking, so expansion is durable rather than one-time
• Mentor junior AMs through coaching, deal shadowing, and best-practice sharing

Requirements
• 4+ years of experience in customer-facing roles managing a book of business, owning account health, executive relationships, renewals, and expansion strategy
• Track record of carrying and consistently hitting a retention and expansion quota, with accurate forecasting
• Demonstrated ability to run the full commercial cycle independently across renewals, upsells, and cross-sells, including business case building, negotiation, and closing
• Experience multi-threading into economic buyers and executive stakeholders on complex accounts
• Fluency in the language of modern finance, demonstrated through hands-on experience with the ecosystem of financial technology, including ERPs, spend management platforms, or AP automation tools
• Experience and comfort interacting with a high volume of customers at different stages of the customer lifecycle
• Strong business acumen with a finance-first mindset and comfortable speaking the language of CFOs, Controllers, and FP A teams
• Ability to analyze product usage data, detect important insights and trends, and implement change based on those insights
• Demonstrated success in cross-functional collaboration and leading or influencing internal roadmaps based on customer needs
• Coachability and grit, with an interest in growing your sales career and mentoring others
• Bachelor's degree; finance, business, or related fields

Bonus points
• You understand the bigger picture of customer value
• Experience in this or a similar role within a rapidly expanding start-up
• You are energized by building relationships across a wide range of levels and roles
• Experience in the credit card management space, including understanding limits, rewards, and underwriting
• Background in corporate accounting or financial systems
• Familiar with sales tools like Gong, Salesforce, and others
• Series 7 license

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $132,888 - $166,110 USD. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

jobs.title: Head of Risk - Türkiye
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced risk leader to lead the risk management function at OKX Türkiye. You will own the local enterprise risk management framework and provide independent oversight and challenge to ensure risks are identified, assessed, managed and reported within Board-approved risk appetite. Working with local management and OKX Group functions, you will oversee risks arising from local operations, intra-group services and external providers.

You will advise senior management, the Risk Committee and Board on the firm’s risk profile, emerging risks and remediation priorities. The role requires sound judgement, the confidence to challenge decisions, and a strong understanding of Turkish capital markets, operational resilience and financial services controls. Experience with crypto asset platforms and custody is highly desirable.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Lead and develop the local risk function, embedding clear accountability, independent second-line oversight and a strong risk culture across OKX Türkiye.
• Own and maintain the enterprise risk management framework, policies and procedures, aligning Group standards with local business needs and applicable Turkish requirements.
• Lead enterprise risk assessments and Risk and Control Self-Assessments with business and Group teams; maintain the risk register and challenge control effectiveness and residual risk.
• Develop and recommend risk appetite and limits for Board approval; maintain key risk indicators, monitor exposures and promptly escalate breaches and material concerns.
• Present clear, decision-focused risk reports to senior management, the Risk Committee and Board, highlighting exposures, trends, incidents and overdue remediation.
• Provide independent oversight of technology, cybersecurity, data and crypto asset custody risks, challenging control design and effectiveness with specialist Group and local teams.
• Partner with Compliance and Legal on regulatory developments, financial crime and customer protection risks, maintaining clear responsibilities and independent risk challenge.
• Oversee intra-group outsourcing and third-party risk, including due diligence, service performance, concentration risk, contractual controls and exit arrangements.
• Work with Finance and Group specialists to develop and oversee capital, liquidity, market, credit and counterparty risk controls proportionate to the local business, including stress testing.
• Oversee operational resilience, business continuity and disaster recovery readiness; challenge critical service dependencies, recovery plans, testing and incident lessons learned.
• Assess risks from new products, business changes and emerging crypto market developments; oversee incident and issue escalation and validate effective remediation.
• Act as the senior risk contact for local management and relevant regulatory engagement, working with Compliance and Legal; coordinate audit and regulatory findings and ensure timely risk remediation.

What We Look For In You
• Must hold a valid Capital Market Activities Level 3 Licence (Sermaye Piyasası Faaliyetleri Düzey 3 Lisansı) as a minimum and maintain it in good standing throughout employment.
• Approximately ten years’ relevant risk management experience in financial services or capital markets, including senior leadership or ownership of a risk function; brokerage or crypto asset experience is particularly relevant.
• Strong knowledge of the Turkish capital markets regulatory framework and the Capital Markets Board (SPK), with the ability to translate evolving crypto asset requirements into practical risk controls.
• Proven expertise in enterprise and operational risk, outsourcing governance, operational resilience and financial risk, with the ability to challenge technology, security and custody specialists.
• Strong analytical judgement and communication skills, with experience presenting to Boards and senior committees, engaging regulators and influencing stakeholders across an international group.
• A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management or a related discipline. Additional certifications such as FRM, CFA or CAMS are desirable.
• Fluent Turkish and English, with the ability to work effectively with local stakeholders and global teams.
• Fluent in the use AI tools to improve risk analysis, reporting and decision-making.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependents
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Staff Mobile Engineer to join our Mobile Infrastructure team, the foundational engineering group that powers the OKX app for millions of daily active users. This is not a feature delivery role. You will work at the platform layer, building the tools, frameworks, and systems that enable product engineering teams to move faster, ship higher quality code, and scale reliably.
You are deeply native in either iOS or Android, and confident contributing across both platforms leveraging AI coding tools to move fluidly between stacks. You care about engineering quality at the foundation level: architecture, performance, toolchain, and developer experience.

 

What You'll Be Doing
• Build and maintain mobile infrastructure, tooling, and shared frameworks that improve engineering efficiency and developer experience across the organisation.
• Analyse and optimise application code at the UI and infrastructure layer, including memory footprint, package size, startup time, and rendering performance.
• Design and develop reusable, scalable mobile components for use across iOS and Android platforms.
• Partner with product engineering teams to deliver infrastructure solutions, establish best practices, and drive technical standards.
• Drive architecture innovations that support world-class mobile app development at scale.
• Optimise project structure and engineering workflows to improve productivity, quality, and release velocity.
• Apply AI coding tools to accelerate infrastructure development, improve code quality, and cross-translate solutions across iOS and Android platforms.
• Stay current with mobile platform developments and emerging toolchain innovations, evaluating and adopting what moves the needle.

 

What We Look For In You
• 6+ years of native iOS or Android development experience, with a strong track record in infrastructure, platform, or architecture work.
• Deep expertise in either iOS (Swift/Objective-C/C++) or Android (Kotlin/Java, Jetpack), with confidence contributing across both platforms.
• Actively uses AI tools in your engineering workflow — including building AI-leveraged workflows, curating domain knowledge bases, and codifying repeatable agent skills so tools like Claude Code or Codex deliver reliably on real production work.
• Proven experience optimising app performance — memory, package size, startup time, and UI rendering — in production environments at scale.
• Deep understanding of design patterns, architectural principles, and the mobile SDK layer for building scalable, high-performance components.
• Working knowledge of remote APIs, concurrency, layouts, transitions, animations, client-side persistence, and mobile architectural patterns.
• Strong communication skills — comfortable collaborating across global teams and delivering large-scale engineering outcomes independently.

 

Nice-To-Haves
• Experience working in a dedicated mobile architecture or infrastructure team with deep platform specialisation.
• Hands-on experience across performance optimisation, toolchain engineering, automated testing frameworks, or design pattern standardisation.
• Experience working across both iOS and Android in a production infrastructure context.
• Familiarity with cross-platform frameworks such as React Native or Flutter.
• Experience in fintech, crypto, or other high-scale consumer app environments.

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Principal Architect - Payments & Ledger
jobs.description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions.

Job Description:

Principal Architect, Payments & Ledger

You'll own the architectural direction for money movement end to end: multi-currency wallets and balances, the core ledger, card issuing and authorisation, in-app FX, overseas transfers and payouts, treasury and pre-funding, settlement and reconciliation, and the shared platform services underneath them. Your remit covers both YouTrip (consumer) and YouBiz (business), across every market we operate in.

Responsibilities:
• The Ledger - Double-entry design, chart of accounts, sub-ledger boundaries, immutability and correction rules, multi-currency representation, precision and rounding policy, and how balances are derived or stored. You'll define how we handle authorisation holds, reversals, partial and incremental captures, refunds, FX revaluation and unreconciled positions, and you'll be able to explain and defend those choices to Finance, auditors and regulators.
• Money movement correctness - Idempotency, exactly-once outcomes on top of at-least-once messaging, clear state machines for every transaction type, and well-defined failure, retry, timeout and compensation paths. For every integration, the question "what happens if the partner succeeds and we fail?" should have a written answer that you own.
• Card issuing - Architecture for authorisation, clearing and settlement as a Mastercard Principal Member, including real-time authorisation on the scheme's critical path, stand-in processing, authorisation expiry, disputes and chargebacks, tokenisation for Apple Pay and Google Pay, virtual and physical card lifecycle, and the strict latency and availability targets that come with it.
• FX and multi-currency wallets - Rate sourcing, quoting and rate locking, spread and exposure management, in-app currency exchange across our wallet currencies, and pre-funding and liquidity models that keep customers' balances safe and available.
• Cross-border transfers - Corridor architecture, payout rail integrations (local real-time rails, bank transfers, SWIFT and partner networks), pre-funding and nostro design, and sanctions and AML screening built in as a core design constraint, not an afterthought.
• Reconciliation and settlement - We treat reconciliation as an architecture problem, not an operations task. You'll design systems where breaks are rare, spotted within minutes, and traceable to a clear cause, across multiple time zones, currencies and partners.
• Non-functional requirements - Latency, throughput, availability and cost as design targets with numbers attached. Clear, written decisions on where eventual consistency is acceptable and where it isn't. Recovery, replay and backfill as built-in capabilities.
• Standards and technical judgement - Engineering and coding standards, architecture reviews for significant changes, and architecture documentation that engineers actually build from. You'll write decision records that capture the reasoning and the options rejected, and keep them current.

jobs.description:

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions.

Job Description:

Technical Program Manager

As a Technical Program Manager at YouTrip, you'll help our engineering organization deliver complex, cross-team programs that power payments for millions of customers and businesses across Asia Pacific. You'll bring structure to large initiatives that span mobile, backend, infrastructure, risk, and compliance. You'll turn ambiguous goals into clear roadmaps, keep teams across India and the region aligned, and make sure critical launches ship on time, safely, and at the quality our customers expect from a financial product.

You'll also help raise the bar for how engineering works at YouTrip by driving shared standards, better delivery processes, and the tools and practices that help teams move faster with confidence. This role needs a strong mix of technical understanding and people skills, so you can earn the trust of engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders alike.

Technical Program Management at YouTrip sits within our engineering organization and plays a key role in helping teams across India and the region deliver as one. TPMs are experienced technologists who create clarity, make sure we focus on the right priorities, drive execution, and manage risk on programs that depend on strong cross-team collaboration. You'll be joining a growing India team at an important stage, with real influence over how we build and scale.

Responsibilities:
• Lead the end-to-end delivery of multiple complex, technical programs at once, such as new market launches, card and payment network integrations, platform migrations, and regulatory or security initiatives.
• Work with engineering, product, design, QA, risk, compliance, and operations teams to define scope, requirements, milestones, and ownership.
• Build roadmaps that balance near-term deliverables with the longer-term technical direction of each program.
• Track progress, surface blockers early, and resolve cross-team dependencies across India and regional teams in Singapore and other markets.
• Anticipate risks across teams and systems, and put mitigation and contingency plans in place before they affect customers or deadlines.
• Use metrics throughout the program lifecycle (delivery health, quality, reliability, and business outcomes) so decisions are grounded in data.
• Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, from engineering teams to senior leadership, through status updates, reviews, and presentations.
• Coordinate release planning for mobile (Android and iOS) and backend services, including launch readiness, rollouts, and post-launch reviews.
• Drive improvements to engineering processes, such as planning cadences, incident follow-ups, documentation standards, and delivery tooling.
• Help teams work well together by building a collaborative, accountable, and enjoyable program culture.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• 8+ years of experience in technology, including at least 4 years as a Technical Program Manager, engineering manager, or in a similar delivery leadership role.
• A background as a software engineer or in a closely related technical role, with the ability to follow system design discussions and spot edge cases and risks in technical specs.
• Working knowledge of several technology areas, such as mobile development, backend and distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data, or security, and the ability to pick up new ones quickly.
• Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other regulated environments is a strong plus.
• Proven success delivering large programs across multiple teams, time zones, and locations.
• Comfort with ambiguity and a habit of creating clarity: you make sure goals, owners, dependencies, and risks are understood by everyone involved.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics simply to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Strong relationship-building

skills:

you know how to align people with different priorities, make sure every voice is heard, and gain commitment to a shared plan.
• A focus on outcomes over activity: you prioritize by impact, think strategically, and are still willing to dig into details to help the team deliver.
• Familiarity with Agile and Scrum practices, OKRs, and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
• Relevant certifications (e.g. PMP, CSM, SAFe) are a plus but not required.

To Apply

If you're interested in this role, click Apply Now and send us your CV. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About this role 

We’re looking for a Senior Design Engineer to join the Consensys Design team, supporting MetaMask - the most used wallet in crypto. This is a rare opportunity to bring beautiful, intuitive experiences to millions of users engaging with decentralized applications and Web3 technologies every day.

As a Senior Design Engineer, you'll turn complex flows into simple and delightful experiences across our app and browser extension. Working closely with designers, engineers, and product managers, you'll take ideas from prototype to production - sweating the animations, haptics, and micro-interactions that make every interaction feel considered, not just functional. You'll build in React and React Native with an eye for pixel-perfect execution, contribute to our design system, and build agentic workflows that help the team move faster without cutting corners. If you love making complex things feel simple, care about craft down to the smallest detail, and want that craft in the hands of 30M+ users, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

In one sentence: Make MetaMask interactions feel intuitive, fast, and delightful - across mobile and extension
• Build pixel-perfect interfaces in React and React Native, with obsessive attention to detail.
• Design and implement animations and micro-interactions that make every tap feel considered.
• Translate Figma designs into accessible, production-ready experiences with minimal handoff friction.
• Build agentic workflows and tooling that speed up design-to-code and day-to-day engineering work.
• Grow the MetaMask design system: reusable, accessible components built to scale across platforms.
• Move from idea to prototype fast and validate with real users.
• Push for craft everywhere - the small animation nobody asked for that makes an interaction click.

Key Experience
• Portfolio demonstrating delightful, polished interfaces and interactions - not just static screens, but the motion and detail that make them feel alive.
• Proven track record shipping high-traffic, consumer-facing products in React and React Native.
• Fluency in modern JS/TypeScript and cross-platform frontend architecture: performance, accessibility, and scalable UI patterns
• An eye for interaction design and motion - you know when animations and haptics earn their place and when they're just noise.
• Strong Figma literacy - you read a design file like code.
• Good judgment about when to polish and when to ship.
• Comfortable working autonomously across a distributed, global team
• Hands-on experience with crypto wallets, blockchain, or related Web3 products.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.

US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)

$149,000 $210,000 USD

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

MetaMask is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself, which can be found on our page.

MetaMask may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, or conducting initial candidate assessments. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and improve efficiency — they do not replace human judgment. A human recruiter or hiring manager reviews every candidate, and all final hiring decisions are made by people, not AI.

It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants may be required to submit to background and identity verification checks, including but not limited to employment, education, criminal record checks, and other such checks as determined necessary by the company.

jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

 

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to join the OEX Mobile Growth team — a pure mobile team sitting at the intersection of engineering rigour, consumer growth craft, and product instinct. This is not a feature delivery role. You will sit upstream of requirements, shape initiatives alongside product and business stakeholders, and own the engineering end-to-end on growth bets that move real metrics for millions of users. The ideal profile combines a solid engineering foundation, hands-on growth experience serving mobile users, and the conviction to bring proposals, not just execute them.

 

What You'll Be Doing
• Own the full engineering lifecycle of mobile growth initiatives - from shaping the brief with product and business through to production launch and iteration.
• Build and optimise growth systems - including funnel instrumentation, referral mechanics, acquisition loops, and experiment frameworks — directly serving the mobile user base.
• Collaborate closely with Product Manager, Business Development, and local market teams across multiple regions to translate commercial goals into concrete, data-backed engineering proposals.
• Apply AI coding tools actively in your workflow to accelerate development, improve code quality, and bridge across tech stacks where needed.
• Drive technical decision-making on growth infrastructure, articulating trade-offs clearly and defending or revising your positions based on evidence.
• Mentor engineers on the team and help establish a culture where engineers bring solutions, not just responses.

 

What We Look For In You
• 8+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production-quality systems at scale.
• Hands-on growth engineering experience — funnel optimisation, experiment frameworks, acquisition or referral systems — in a consumer-facing (ToC) product context.
• Understanding of mobile users: how they behave, what drives retention and conversion, and how mobile-native growth mechanics differ from web.
• Actively uses AI tools as a core part of your engineering workflow — not just for code generation, but for building repeatable workflows and bridging across stacks.
• Outspoken and proposal-driven: you come to the table with a point of view, push back when you disagree, and bring data and a counter-proposal rather than just flagging concerns.
• Strong cross-functional communication — comfortable working with Product Manager, Business Development, and local markets to align on goals and hold the line on engineering quality.
• Data instincts: you think in funnels, know how to instrument what matters, and use metrics to drive decisions.

 

Nice-To-Haves
• Mobile development experience in iOS (Swift/Objective-C) or Android (Kotlin/Java) — or backend experience building growth systems that serve mobile apps directly (e.g. growth APIs, attribution pipelines, notification infrastructure).
• Experience with Rust or other systems languages — especially candidates who have recently migrated from mobile-native stacks and are building fluency in backend tooling.
• Depth in mobile attribution and MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, SKAdNetwork).
• ASO operational experience (App Store Connect, Google Play Console).
• Experience building referral systems, k-factor mechanics, or anti-fraud layers.
• Background in fintech, crypto, or regulated consumer financial products.
• Experience operating across US, EEA, and APAC markets.
• A/B experiment framework ownership at meaningful scale.

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: 法人金融事業グロース・事業開発担当
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

 

業務について

▼PayPay金融戦略本部の紹介

金融戦略本部は、PayPayの顧客基盤・加盟店基盤や豊富な決済データと、グループ各社が持つ金融機能を掛け合わせ、AI時代の新たな金融体験を創り出す、事業開発のプロフェッショナル集団です。
給与デジタル払いをはじめとする、日常の資金移動を支える金融プラットフォームの構築に加え、PayPayアプリ上で利用できるポイント運用や、PayPay証券が提供するミニアプリの事業推進を担っています。
また、加盟店向けには、「PayPay資金調達」の事業推進に加え、銀行代理業として、PayPay銀行が提供する「PayPay店舗専用ローン」や法人口座の利用拡大を推進しています。
顧客課題の発見から、事業戦略の策定、サービス企画、グロースまでを一気通貫で担い、新しい金融の当たり前を事業として実現していきます。

▼関連コンテンツ
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 01
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 02
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 03
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 05
• その仕事はユーザーファーストか？業界の常識を超えた「金融」サービスへの追求
• 機械学習モデル×ユーザーファーストで、想定の5倍の成果を生んだ「PayPay資金調達」
• 給与デジタル払いで「人生の選択肢」を増やす。お金の流れを変えるサービスを日本で初めてリリース
• 金融を“変える側”に回る選択 — 価値を起点に仕事をする事業開発

▼募集の背景
スマホファーストな金融サービスのUIUXを拡充していくためには、ユーザーが抱える課題に対する解決策（そのほとんどは、まだ世の中に存在していません）をUIUXやサービスで実現することになります。
ところが、ユーザーが抱える課題は、目に見えないことが多いです。ユーザーに聞いても教えてくれません。
それを発見し課題を構造化して解決策まで昇華できるのは、金融サービスをより良くしていきたいと言う強い情熱がある人だけだと思っています。
本気のユーザー・ファーストな金融サービスを実現すること、それを新しく入ってくれる方に実行していただきたいです。

▼業務内容

コンシューマーのモバイル決済分野でユーザーの購入体験を大きく変えてきたPayPayですが、
これからはコンシューマーだけではなく、加盟店向けにもユーザーファーストな決済・金融サービスの発明にチャレンジしていきます。

グローバルには既に加盟店向けにユーザーファーストを追求したビジネスサービスが存在しています。
PayPayは後発ながら、それらに比肩する「誰でも・自然に・簡単に」利用できるサービスを発明し、事業がより便利になる世界を実現したいと考えています。

PayPayの金融事業を国内No.1にし、金融事業を通じてPayPayの収益拡大及び事業成長を担っていただきます。

【業務内容】
・加盟店向け金融サービスのB2Bマーケティング戦略の策定と実行
・市場調査、競合分析、ターゲット顧客の明確化
・PayPayのビッグデータを活用した、インサイトの抽出と戦略・施策への反映
・リードジェネレーション及びリードナーチャリング施策の企画・実行
・各種マーケティング施策の企画・実行・効果測定・分析・改善

【対象プロダクト】
・PayPay資金調達
・PayPay銀行代理業（口座媒介・PayPay店舗専用ローン）

▼本ポジションの魅力

＜ポジションの魅力＞
・PayPayのアセットを活用して、大きな市場に対する新規事業開発にチャレンジできる
・0→1フェーズで、調査・企画・開発・グロースまで、新規事業開発の一連のプロセスに携われる
・プロダクトの社内開発で、真にユーザーファーストなサービス開発に携われる
・グループアセットを活用して、グローバルな先進事例を踏まえた戦略立案・事業推進が行える

＜チームメンバー＞
・ビジネス向け金融に精通したプロフェッショナルなメンバーで構成されたチームです。メガバンクやコンサル、SaaS企業など様々な業界出身の仲間で構成されております。

必要な経験/スキル

【必須要件】
・B2Bのデジタルサービス（金融、SaaS、Webサービス等）において、PLやトップライン（売上）を意識し、事業をグロースさせた中心的なご経験
 （※事業開発、マーケティング、プロダクトマネジメントなど、どの職種でのご経験かは問いませんが、どれか一つに卓越したスキル・能力をお持ちの方）
・急成長フェーズの事業会社（スタートアップ/ベンチャー）やコンサルティングファーム等、流動性が高くスピードが早い組織での勤務経験

【応募要件】
以下のいずれか、または複数のご経験をお持ちの方

＜事業開発・戦略系のご経験＞
・新規SaaS事業の立ち上げや、0→1、1→10フェーズをリードしたご経験
・事業計画の策定、KPI設計の実務経験
・BizDev（事業開発）やアライアンス戦略の立案・実行のご経験

＜マーケティング・グロース系のご経験＞
・The Model型の組織における、マーケティング戦略の立案・実行のご経験
・プロダクトのデータ分析に基づき、プロダクトレッドグロース戦略を企画・実行したご経験
・デジタルマーケティング（Web広告、SEO、コンテンツマーケティング、MA運用等）を実行したご経験

＜プロダクト連携のご経験＞
・新規サービスにおけるビジネス要件（BRD）を策定したご経験
・プロダクトマネージャー（PdM）やエンジニアと密に連携し、ユーザーインサイトやデータを基にしたプロダクト改善・機能開発をリードしたご経験

加えて下記のいずれか1つ以上を強みとしてPRできる経験
--------------------------------------------
・データドリブンな思考力（構造化されていない問題に対して、定量的、および定性的なデータを用いて分析的に思考することができる。）
・課題解決力（問題を特定して原因を掘り下げる論理的思考力や、改善に向けて周囲を巻き込んで動く実行力がある。）
・コミュニケーション力（ビジネスの複数の利害関係者と関わり合い、彼らの興味や懸念を理解し、成功のための共通の目標に沿ってそれらを統合するための強力なコミュニケーション力がある。）
・クロス・ファンクション（全社ユニットを横断して理解することができる。これにより、業務改善の分野を特定したり、適切な優先順位で新規事業を立案、推進することができる。）
・プロジェクトマネジメント力 （戦略を立案するだけではなく、ビジネス全体のチームを率い、スケジュールと予算をコントロールしながらプロジェクト全体を管理することができる。）
--------------------------------------------

あると望ましい経験/スキル

・戦略や事業計画の策定経験
・プロダクト戦略策定経験
・金融事業に関わる法令等の知識
・ビジネス英語力（TOEIC800点以上）

PayPayが求める人物像
• PayPay 5 sensesに当てはまる方

待遇・条件

雇用形態
• 正社員

勤務地
• Hybrid Workstyle
※所属組織のルールおよび業務指示に応じて出社対応頂きます。

勤務時間
• スーパーフレックス制（コアタイム無し）
