jobs.title: Senior/Principal Product Manager, DEX Trading
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

 

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the Opportunity

What You’ll Be Doing
• Own product strategy and roadmap for the DEX Trading product, covering Token Market, Swap (Aggregator), Bridge, Limit Order, and emerging trading primitives.
• Partner closely with the Growth Operations team to ship initiatives that drive user acquisition, activation, retention, and trading volume, turning growth hypotheses into PRDs, prototypes, and launched features.
• Identify and prototype new product opportunities in DEX, evaluating emerging protocols, narratives, and paradigms (intent-based trading, MEV protection, new L1/L2s, etc.) with AI-augmented research and competitive scanning to move faster and broader than manual analysis allows.
• Lead end-to-end execution: drive PRDs, prototypes, and supporting documentation with AI in the loop for higher velocity and quality, then partner with R D, UI/UX, QA, and Marketing through to launch.
• Define, instrument, and monitor core product KPIs (Volume, MAU, retention, route quality, etc.); run your own data analysis with AI-assisted SQL, exploratory queries, and insight synthesis to continuously optimize performance.

What We Look For In You
• 3+ years in product management, with 2+ years on consumer-facing crypto or DeFi products. Strong DeFi experience as a power user or contributor may substitute for part of the PM tenure.
• Deep understanding of the DEX stack: AMMs, order books, aggregation routing, cross-chain bridges, perpetuals, MEV, and the trade-offs between them.
• Strong data fluency: comfortable writing your own SQL / Dune queries instead of waiting on an analyst.
• Power user of modern AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, AI coding/data agents) : actively integrates them into daily PM workflows for research, writing, prototyping, and data analysis. Able to demonstrate concrete examples of how AI has accelerated your output.
• Strong individual contributor ownership, able to drive projects end-to-end across cross-functional teams without people-management leverage.
• Fluent written and verbal communication in English and Chinese.
• Bachelor's degree or higher.

 

Nice to Have
• Prior Product Manager at a leading DEX, Aggregator, Perp DEX, or Bridge (Uniswap, Jupiter, 1inch, GMX, dYdX, CoW, Across, etc.), etc.
• Demonstrable track record as a heavy DeFi user, published research, sizeable on-chain footprint, governance participation, or recognized protocol contributions.
• Familiarity with intent-based architectures, solver networks, TEE, or other emerging DeFi primitives.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Disclaimer: Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.

jobs.title: 保険事業開発（資産運用／ALM領域）
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

 

業務について

▼PayPay金融事業統括本部の紹介

PayPayをNo1のフィンテック企業に。という全社のミッションを達成するため、PayPayアプリの上でお金にまつわるすべて（「つかう」以外に「ためる」「ふやす」「かりる」「そなえる」「かんりする」）のユースケースを創り上げていく実行部隊です。
スマホファーストな金融サービスのUIUXを発明していくことにもなりますので、大手金融機関での新規事業開発を経験されていた方や、商社やネット企業で実績を上げてこられた方、海外での新規事業に携わっていた方など経験やスキル・視点は様々なメンバーで構成されています。
現状の金融サービスをより良くしていきたいという強い情熱を持った人と一緒に働きたいと思っています。

組織構成：20代後半～40代後半の総勢80名ほどで構成されております。

■チームの紹介

PayPayにおける保険サービスの新規事業企画・立ち上げや、ほけんミニアプリのサービス運営を行っています。
私たちのミッションは、保険のデジタルプラットフォーマーとなり、ユーザーにとって最も利便性の高いデジタル保険サービスを提供することです。

▼関連コンテンツ
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 01
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 02
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 03
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 05
• その仕事はユーザーファーストか？業界の常識を超えた「金融」サービスへの追求
• 「ユーザーのための保険」へPayPayが業界を変えていく

▼募集の背景
PayPayほけんミニアプリは2025年7月末時点で加入者数が累計650万件に到達し、サービス開始4年で急速に成長しております。
これまで「誰でも手軽に加入できる保険体験」を軸にサービスを拡大してきましたが、直近ではT D保険グループとの包括的業務提携を発表し、生命保険事業への本格参入という新たなフェーズを迎えています。
 
 今後は、単なる保険販売に留まらず、
 ・PayPayならではの巨大なユーザー基盤を活かした生命保険事業モデルの確立
 ・中長期で持続的に成長するための再保険・資産運用・ALM戦略の高度化
 ・事業成長とリスクコントロールを両立する経営基盤の構築
 が重要なテーマとなります。
 
 本ポジションでは、資産運用の専門性を活かし、生命保険事業の“根幹”を設計・進化させていただける方を募集しています。

▼業務内容

PayPayにおける生命保険事業の立ち上げ・成長フェーズにおいて、資産運用・ALM領域を中心に、事業戦略と一体となった意思決定に携わっていただきます。
 
 資産運用／ALM領域
 
 ・生命保険事業における資産運用戦略の策定
 ・ALM（資産負債管理）体制・運用フレームワークの構築
 ・リスク管理部門・外部パートナーと連携した運用高度化

▼本ポジションの魅力

・チャレンジと失敗を推奨する会社風土の中で、様々な0→1の事業開発を経験できる
・7400万人を超えるユーザーに対してサービスを届けることができ、自身の仕事で世の中にインパクトを与えられる
・他部門（プロダクト開発、マーケティングなど）との連携により、ユーザーファーストなサービス開発をする上での知見が豊富に得られる
・経験豊富かつ多様性のあるチームの中で、事業開発における様々な視点を学ぶことができる

必要な経験/スキル

 ・資産運用部門、またはALM・リスク管理部門での実務経験
 ・金融事業での勤務経験3年以上かつ卓越した成果を上げた経験
 ・金融事業に関わる法令等の知識
 ・戦略の立案や事業計画の策定経験
 ・社内外のステークホルダーとのコミュニケーションスキル

あると望ましい経験/スキル

・保険会社における商品開発経験
・経営管理またはリスク管理経験
・アクチュアリ―資格、またはCFA（日本証券アナリスト協会認定アナリスト等）の資格
・事業推進およびプロジェクトマネジメント経験
・外部パートナー/顧客との交渉経験
・マーケットリサーチ経験
・ビジネス英語力（TOEIC800点以上）

PayPayが求める人物像
• PayPay 5 sensesに当てはまる方

待遇・条件

雇用形態
• 正社員

勤務地
• Hybrid Workstyle
※所属組織のルールおよび業務指示に応じて出社対応頂きます。

勤務時間
• スーパーフレックス制（コアタイム無し）

jobs.title: コンプライアンス担当
jobs.description:
PayPayについて

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼チーム・組織紹介

他に類を見ないスピードで事業拡大を続けるPayPay。新たなサービスや事業が次々と生まれる中、コンプライアンス部には、ルールに照らして可否を判断するだけではなく、事業成長を支えるための仕組みを自ら企画し、実行していくことが求められています。

 

私たちが大切にしているのは、「Yesには付加価値を。Noには代案を。」という考え方です。
事業部門とともに課題を整理し、事業のスピードを落とすことなく、適切なリスクコントロールを実現する。そのために、既存のルールや業務プロセスを前提とせず、より良いコンプライアンス体制や仕組みを企画・構築していくことが、コンプライアンス部の重要なミッションです。

現在のコンプライアンス部は、主に30代～40代半ばの約10名で構成されています。新規事業や既存サービスに関するコンプライアンス対応に加え、部門横断のプロジェクトやコンプライアンス体制の高度化にも取り組んでいます。

▼募集背景

PayPayの事業・サービスが拡大する中、コンプライアンス部に求められる役割も大きく変化しています。
個別案件への対応だけではなく、事業や組織の変化を捉えて課題を特定し、必要な仕組みやルールを企画・設計し、社内外の関係者を巻き込みながら実行していくことが、これまで以上に重要になっています。

 

そこで今回、コンプライアンスの専門知識だけにとらわれず、経営企画・事業企画・プロジェクト推進などで培った企画力や推進力を活かし、PayPayのコンプライアンス機能を一緒につくっていただける方を募集します。

コンプライアンス領域の経験をお持ちの方はもちろん、異なる領域で企画・プロジェクト推進を経験されてきた方にも、これまでの経験を活かしていただけるポジションです。

▼具体的な業務内容

コンプライアンス部コンプライアンスチームに所属いただき、以下の業務をご担当いただきます。
• プロジェクト推進やそれに付随する社内調整、各種書面作成
• 当局相談、相談資料作成
• 新規および既存ビジネスのコンプライアンスレビュー
• 各種監査/検査対応、準備作業、事後管理業務
• その他、上記に関連する業務など

▼本ポジションの魅力
• コンプライアンスの枠にとどまらず、事業成長を支える仕組みやルールを自ら企画し、実行まで携わることができる
• 新規事業やサービスの構想段階から事業部門と協働し、リスクを適切にコントロールしながら事業を前に進める経験を積むことができる

必要な経験/スキル
• 関係者との円滑なコミュニケーション・調整能力
• コンプライアンス、リスク管理、法務その他これらに関連する領域での実務経験
• スピード感をもって自律的に業務をこなすことができる能力

あると望ましい経験/スキル
• 新規ビジネス等に関するコンプライアンスレビューの経験
• 金融業界またはフィンテック企業での実務経験
• 各種プロジェクト（社内外問わず）のPM経験

PayPayが求める人物像

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer II - Consumer Onboarding
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced Backend Engineer for our Consumer Onboarding team. This is a unique opportunity to have a massive impact, helping a growing number of customers around the world choosing Wise to move their money without borders.

The Consumer Onboarding team is dedicated to guiding personal customers through setting up their Wise account and resolving their first international money needs in a way that’s clear, easy, and delightful. You'll lead a team of talented engineers, collaborating daily with product managers, data analysts, and designers to continuously improve our onboarding flows and user journeys - making them faster, more intuitive, and more scalable.

 

Your mission:

As the one of most Senior Engineers in the Consumer Onboarding team, you will:
• Work closely with the Product Manager and Engineering Lead of your team to shape the roadmap, set the technical and product vision and ensure the team delivers on product goals in a robust and scalable way.
• Enable your team to succeed by ensuring they are well-resourced, can plan effectively, and are set up to commit to and deliver on their roadmap.
• Drive and deliver high impact projects end to end - from understanding customer problem, design solution alongside your team, driving technical discovery, scoping and execution to delivery
• Own the health of systems and services in your team, ensuring our system remain maintainable, scalable and performing to support our growth and scale
• Collaborate with other senior engineers and engineering lead across Onboarding squad and Wise to ensure your team’s work is aligned with the wider technical strategy.
• Coach and mentor engineers in your team supporting their technical growth and being a force multiplier

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer II - Receive Risk
jobs.description:
Team you will be working with: Receive Risk

The Receive Risk team is part of Acquiring Squad, in the Global Product tribe, dedicated to ensuring customers can receive money quickly and securely, using our full suite of Acquiring products. We build smart fraud detection and prevention systems to stop scammers and fraudsters from exploiting Wise or defrauding our customers.

Supporting our full suite of Acquiring products — QuickPay, Payment links, Invoices, e-commerce, and more — we work closely with our financial crime teams to strike the perfect balance: seamless experiences for legitimate users, strong barriers against bad actors.

What will you be working on?

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to build a fraud engine that will help us ship new products and features quickly while keeping risk and cost low. This will involve working closely with Product, Data Science, Fraud Prevention Analysts and our Fraud agents to strike the right balance between scaling quickly and mitigating risk efficiently.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About

the role:

We're looking for a Senior Staff Engineer (IC5) to join our Consumer Onboarding team. Our mission is to guide personal customers through setting up their Wise account and resolving their first international money needs in a way that's clear, easy, and delightful.

Onboarding is one of the most critical moments in a customer's journey with Wise. Get it right, and we build trust from day one. Because we sit at this key point in the customer journey, we deal with high volumes of traffic and need to balance speed, scale, and reliability with a smooth user experience. This makes it an exciting space for engineers who want to solve complex problems at scale while having a direct, visible impact on millions of customers.

How we work:

At Wise, we believe in autonomy, alignment, and impact. As an IC5 engineer, you won't just be executing tasks - you will be a visionary. You will own fundamental components and shared systems, collaborate across multiple teams, and define the long-term technical strategy for onboarding. We value open communication, high technical standards, and a genuine focus on solving real customer problems.

What will you be working on?

In the near future, you will be driving technical solutions for our biggest upcoming challenges:
• Scalable Onboarding Architecture: Designing systems that can support rapid growth in new markets and customer segments without compromising speed or reliability.
• Cross-Team Technical Alignment: Defining the technical contracts and integration points between Onboarding and other teams across Wise, such as Marketing, FinCrime, and KYC.
• End-to-End Journey Ownership: Building and evolving robust, scalable onboarding flows from account creation through to a customer's first successful transfer.
• System Health & Performance: Leading initiatives to improve the maintainability, latency, and cost efficiency of our core onboarding systems.

jobs.title: Finance Associate
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Finance at Brex

The Finance team is a strategic engine at Brex. We lead planning, forecasting, capital allocation, and ROI analysis — partnering across the business to drive clarity and unlock opportunity. We partner across teams at Brex to ensure our business is building and planning with the same dream big goals throughout our entire organization. We’re not here to report on outcomes; we shape them. If you want to influence company direction and think long-term about value creation, this is where your ownership starts.
• Cross-functional alignment: We work on complex problems that cut across Engineering, Product, Design, Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, CX, and more. This requires the ability to generate buy-in from a wide set of stakeholders on key initiatives.
• Business intelligence: We are a data-driven organization that always provides data to support our decision-making. When data is not available, we find it in market and competitive research. We convey complex financial information to varied stakeholders in order to influence decisions.
• Problem solving: We lead with solutions by defining an ambiguous problem, processing information, applying judgment and creativity, and generating buy-in around the answer. This requires the ability to not only track and improve key metrics, but to define what those key metrics should be.
• Building, not just advising: We ship the models, tooling, and automation that the frameworks depend on, and we own their accuracy.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

What You’ll Do

We are building out the Strategic Finance team and looking for someone to join the function and partner with leadership to maximize ROI from our investments.

In this role, you will own the frameworks Brex uses to underwrite and measure return on investment across the business. You will translate roadmap proposals, GTM investments, headcount requests, and pricing changes into expected return, payback, and opportunity cost, so that business partners and Finance underwrite decisions off the same set of numbers. You will work with leaders across the company, and you will close the loop after the fact, measuring realized return against what was originally underwritten.

You will bring both the financial and the commercial point of view, and need to embrace challenges and structure complex problems. This role carries high exposure to Executive Leadership, as you will regularly deliver analysis and recommendations directly to the Leadership team.

Responsibilities
• Build and own the frameworks used to evaluate investment decisions across the business, spanning R D, GTM, headcount, and pricing
• Partner with business leaders on capital allocation: sizing the cost of a given bet, pricing the tradeoffs between competing uses of the next dollar, and framing opportunity cost in terms leadership can act on
• Develop the unit economics and ROI measurement standards applied to new product launches, pricing changes, GTM programs, and platform investments
• Run post-investment measurement on major bets, comparing realized return to what was underwritten and feeding those learnings back into the framework
• Quantify the downstream commercial impact of product and GTM decisions on revenue, margin, and customer lifetime value
• Translate operating and capacity inputs into financial impact, and financial constraints into terms business partners can plan against
• Build shared definitions and a single source of truth across Finance, EPD, GTM, and Revenue Operations so all organizations plan off the same numbers
• Ship the models, dashboards, and automation the frameworks depend on, and own their accuracy
• Provide ad hoc analytical support to GTM Finance and Revenue Operations on pipeline, conversion, retention, expansion, and go-to-market efficiency questions

Requirements
• Bachelor’s Degree in Economics, Finance, Business, or related field
• 2+ years of Strategic Finance, FP A, or Investment Banking experience
• An AI-first mindset: you default to asking how AI can improve every workflow, you actively experiment with new tools, and you have used AI to accelerate analysis or automate a task
• Mastery of Excel and PowerPoint with proven experience in building financial models and managing complex data
• Strong communication, team-working, quantitative and analytical skills
• Intellectual curiosity, a collaborative work style, and the drive to take ownership in a fast-moving environment
• Comfort managing multiple workstreams simultaneously and proactively driving work forward without being asked
• A bias toward proactive insight over reactive reporting
• Ability to operate independently, build structure in ambiguous environments, and prioritize effectively
• Comfort working directly in data: SQL or BI tooling experience is a strong plus (Snowflake, Hex, Looker, or Salesforce)

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $117,520 USD - $146,900 USD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

jobs.title: Product Director, Localisation & AI Evals
jobs.location: Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR; Singapore, Singapore
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX is going all-in on AI-native localisation. The field has long been stuck on one trade-off: you can have translation quality, or you can have scale, but not both. And the real question was never "is this translation accurate?" — it's "can the user actually understand it and get through the flow?"

Web3 is the hardest place to solve this. The vocabulary reinvents itself constantly, with new tech jargon, protocol names and memes appearing every week. It sits next to dense, high-stakes trading terminology, where a single mistranslated word can mislead a user or move money. And every market has its own fast-moving regulations, so the "right" translation is a moving target that must stay compliant across jurisdictions in real time. If you want a localisation problem that is genuinely unsolved — high ambiguity, high stakes, high velocity — this is it.

We're going to break the trade-off with agents. You will own the 0-1 build and launch of two things:
• A frontier agentic translation system that localises every market (20+ languages) with a human-in-the-loop mechanism.
• A self-improving agentic QA product that autonomously evaluates translation and end-to-end localisation quality, flags its own failures, and closes the loop.

This is a build-the-frontier role, not a manage-the-vendor role.

 

This role does not require a linguistics or translation background, multilingual ability, or algorithm engineering skills. We're looking for a PM leader who can build a frontier agentic translation and QA system from 0 to 1 — and make the whole organisation share responsibility for localisation quality.

What You’ll Be Doing 

You will lead a squad of product managers and developers, and work hand-in-hand with language managers, to ship the translation and QA systems into production. You set the product direction and quality bar; your PMs and engineers build the agents, harness and evals; and the language managers ground the system in what "good" actually means in each market. Your job is to make these three groups operate as one team — and to make localisation quality something the whole organisation owns, not just the language team.

 

Own the agentic translation system

Architect and ship it end to end, from 0 to 1, across all markets and 20+ languages — where models carry the work and humans set the standard and make the final call. Break the cost curve: hold quality flat while coverage scales across languages, content and release velocity, so cost stops growing linearly with the business. Make the system interoperate cleanly with OKX's existing localisation stack and content pipelines, rather than living as an island.

Build the agentic QA and quality automation

Stand up an autonomous QA agent that evaluates translation and localisation quality at scale — catching regressions before release, monitoring in production, and self-verifying every fix, using LLM-as-a-judge and eval harnesses rather than manual review. Evaluate not just accuracy and fluency but cultural fit, bias and safety — especially on regulated and financial content, where a wrong or non-compliant phrasing is a real risk. Make quality measurable: define and drive a hard quality signal — human-acceptance rate, or the edit effort needed to reach shippable quality (e.g. Translation Time-to-Edit) — so quality is a metric the system optimises against, not a subjective call. And protect the funnel: conversion on key user journeys should never be adversely affected by language or localisation issues.

Make it self-improving

Drive a sustained reduction in severe and recurring production issues — every escape becomes a new guardrail, and the system gets smarter with every release.

 

What We Look For In You
• PM leader who has taken a frontier agentic product from 0 to 1, beyond translation.
• Proven ability to ship genuinely novel products at the edge of LLM capabilities—and repeat that success here.
• Accountable for business outcomes and measured on business metrics, not delivery volume.
• Deep hands-on experience building large-scale, frontier-LLM agentic systems from 0 to 1.
• Experience with harness/orchestration layers, multi-agent workflows, and LLM-as-a-judge or automated evaluation pipelines.
• Has built quality systems, automated evaluations, or release gates that enable confident autonomous-system launches.
• International product experience serving users across multiple languages and regions.

Nice to Haves
• Built an agentic system from scratch
• Shipped agentic / LLM applications in production
• Finance, payments or another highly regulated industry.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Institutional Product
jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own institutional partner products such as Custody, Brokerage, and Fees Incentive Programs (including MM/MT structures, VIP tiering, and rebate frameworks). Final scope will weigh your background, but the mandate is consistent: build institutional-grade products that compete on infrastructure, economic design, and reliability — and translate that into measurable growth in client adoption, trading volume, and revenue. You will partner with engineering, operations, sales, compliance, and external service providers to ship complex changes that institutional counterparties trust and rely on.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Clearly define product direction and roadmaps for Custody OES, drive its evolution and turn client and partner requirements into shipped features. Grow the client and partner base. Optimize operations through self-service portals and process automation.
• Own the fee schedule and incentive programs (MM/MT, VIP tiers, rebates), balancing market dynamics, competitor moves, and institutional needs against company strategy, revenue, and competitive position. Build and continuously evolve AI agents for competitor intel, liquidity analysis, fee and rebate simulation, and program operations.
• Own the commercial logic of your product lines. Build ROI-grounded business cases for product and partnership investments; quantify revenue and AUM impact to drive prioritisation;
• Articulate strategy, progress, and trade-offs to internal leadership and external institutional clients.
• Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design, compliance, and legal to ship complex changes. Navigate multi-jurisdictional regulatory constraints (HK, SG, EU, US) and balance trade-offs between speed, scalability, and compliance.

What We Look For In You
• PM experience at a crypto exchange on Custody OES, or at a custody, or background from traditional finance on Collateral / Tri-party / CCP solutions. Deep market knowledge and an end-to-end grasp of how counterparties, custody, execution, and settlement connect.
• Solid understanding of liquidity dynamics and how institutional crypto markets actually work. Prior hands-on experience managing fee schedules or designing incentive programs (MM/MT, VIP tiers, rebates) is a strong plus.
• Proven experience of leading strategic business reviews, facilitating on-site requirement discovery, and converting client feedback into prioritized product initiatives. Strong track record of partnering with Sales, BD, and Relationship Management teams in a B2B institutional setting.
• Proven ability to bring structure and clarity to complex problems, align senior stakeholders across functions, and drive decisions and execution. Able to communicate complex strategies and trade-offs with clarity and influence, producing high-quality strategy documents, product plans, roadmaps, and executive-level presentations. Demonstrated effectiveness leading and influencing globally distributed teams across time zones and diverse cultural contexts.
• Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools for market research and product operations. Building automated workflows, using AI for data analysis, or prototyping AI-powered features.
• Candidates with more experience will be considered as Product Director (P7-1). Experience building a zero-to-one product is a strong plus.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager, Pricing
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an Implementation Manager to join our Pricing squad in London. This role is a unique opportunity to have an impact on Wise's mission. You will play a critical role in ensuring that our pricing is fair, transparent, competitive, and implemented flawlessly across every product and route globally. 

You’ll be the bridge between commercial pricing and pricing engineering teams in Wise on one hand, and growth and regional teams that want to launch new products and drop prices.

 

Your Mission

As an Implementation Manager for Pricing you will enable delivery of the pricing for product launches, regional launches, reprices and tax compliance.

 

Here’s how you’ll be contributing to the Pricing team:
• Own the end-to-end execution of price inside Wise’s products
• You will become an expert on Wise’s pricing configuration and how it’s technically implemented in our systems
• Own Wise’s global reprice process. Repricing is one of our core mechanisms to deliver on our mission of ‘Min Fees’. We operate with one of the most detailed cost & pricing structures - with the aim of ensuring that customers pay only for what they use. You will be responsible for the execution of the end-to-end quarterly reprice process - including coordination, pricing communication, compliance and commercial updates
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams beyond pricing (compliance, product teams, regional teams, marketing) on the reprice process execution
• Work with global product and regional teams to ensure effective implementation of new routes, products, prices and taxes
• Collaborate with product, engineering, finance, and compliance teams to ensure repricing-related operational processes are accurate, compliant, auditable and efficient Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and guide product engineering teams to build tooling to improve speed and customer experience

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Build hands on experience in commercial, technical and product domains
• Work on projects at scale - pricing impacts millions of transactions and customers and has to be compliant across multiple jurisdictions
• Drive excellence in the reprice delivery process, directly impacting Wise's global customer base
• Grow professionally into a leader in delivery, honing your skills in cross-functional collaboration, data-driven decision-making, and process optimisation
• Work in a commercial area that is committed to dropping prices for customers

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Treasury
jobs.description:
Build the product capabilities that govern how Wise manages and invests tens of billions of pounds of customer funds, while controlling counterparty risk across a global network of partners.

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager in London to join our Treasury organisation, focused on Cash & Asset Management (CAM) and Counterparty Credit Risk.

This is a senior individual-contributor role. You’ll be working in two strategically important and growing domains, helping turn strong functional foundations into fully-fledged, scalable product teams. The emphasis is on setting direction, building clarity, and creating leverage through systems, metrics and process.

Your mission

You will shape and grow two developing product areas into durable, cross-functional teams:
• Cash & Asset Management — how Wise manages and invests customer funds across market conditions
• Counterparty Credit Risk — how we assess, control and scale the risks arising from the institutions we place funds with

These are areas with strong domain expertise and real-world processes already in place, but where the systems, tooling and decision frameworks need to evolve as Wise scales.

You’ll own the product strategy, systems, metrics and controls that enable high-quality decisions to be made consistently, transparently and at global scale.

You’ll drive alignment and prioritisation across engineering, analytics and functional partners.

Here’s how you’ll contribute to Wise’s mission
• Define and evolve Wise’s product approach to managing and investing customer funds across the interest‑rate cycle, balancing customer outcomes, yield, risk, capital and liquidity
• Design and improve the controls, systems and data used to manage counterparty risk at global scale
• Establish clear, decision‑driving metrics — e.g. clarifying trade‑offs between commercial outcomes and risk constraints
• Lead evaluation of external software vendors where appropriate
• Evolve the operating model for central vs local ownership as Wise scales across regions

This role will give you the opportunity to
• Work on a ~£20bn portfolio at the core of Wise’s unit economics
• Shape two high‑impact product domains as they mature and scale, with significant latitude to define how they work
• Build systems that balance commercial outcomes with prudent risk management
• Develop deep expertise in global treasury, financial markets and prudential topics over time
• Grow into external‑facing work with regulators and other third parties as the platform matures

jobs.title: Head of Financial Crime Control Governance
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Head of Financial Crime (FC) Control Governance to design, own and operate the 1LOD control governance framework across Wise entities. The role is accountable for the integrity and effectiveness of the FC control environment, ensuring 1LOD controls meet Group control standards. Working in close partnership with Product, Operations and 2LOD Compliance, the ideal candidate will provide the governance and support to enable rapid delivery while maintaining a robust, audit-ready control framework.

 

Your mission:
• Manage and enhance the 1LOD FC control governance strategy and operating model across Wise entities.
• Own and maintain the Financial Crime control library as the single source of truth and ensure ongoing library hygiene.
• Lead control mapping across the end-to-end framework (risks, processes, product, and regulatory obligations).
• Enforce control documentation quality check.
• Drive continuous improvement of the control assurance framework and workflow design, with an appetite for automation (e.g. AI-enabled documentation where appropriate).
• Run control approval governance forum including senior management sign-off and tracking of actions to completion.
• Prepare high-quality materials, dashboards, and trend analysis for senior management and risk committees.
• Act as a key 1LOD point of contact supporting regulatory exams, process walkthroughs and audit requests relating to FC controls.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Executive
jobs.description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions - YouTrip and YouBiz - empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum's Global Innovator 2025, CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn's Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses. 

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions.

About this Role

This is a hands-on role in an in-house performance marketing team running paid acquisition across several markets. You will build, launch, and monitor campaigns, working closely with the marketing teams to ensure we have high-performing creatives and results.

You Will

Build and run campaigns across markets
• Build, launch, and QA campaigns on Meta, Google, TikTok, and other platforms across countries
• Keep creatives fresh on a regular cadence, upload assets through our pipelines, and keep naming conventions and tracking parameters clean
• Monitor daily pacing against budgets and flag where spend should shift
• Work to a consistent way of running campaigns across all our markets, and help improve it as we go

Keep the numbers and maintain accounts
• Own weekly reports, including performance analysis, insights, and recommended optimizations
• Keep costs and trackers up to date and run reconciliation of the numbers
• Maintain audience syncs, exclusion lists, and conversion event checks across platforms
• Manage ad-account admin: users, billing, payment methods, invoices, and platform policy issues

Support CRM and new verticals
• Support CRM/Lifecycle initiatives, helping take campaigns from brief through to launch and read-out
• Support the launch of new products and verticals as they come online

Be the day-to-day contact
• Work with country teams on execution questions and paid amplification of content, creator, and community campaigns
• Own day-to-day creator and partner outreach and coordination
• Handle day-to-day questions from platform account managers and escalate accordingly

You Are
• 1 to 3 years hands-on in paid social or paid search, agency or in-house, and you have personally built and optimised campaigns on Meta and at least one of Google or TikTok
• Careful with detail: tracking parameters, naming, budgets, dates. You notice when a number looks wrong before anyone else does
• High competency in AI platforms is a plus
• App marketing and experience with platforms like AppsFlyer is preferred
• Exposure to CRM or lifecycle marketing (push, email, in-app) is a plus

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Trust is the first of a new breed of banks in Singapore – digitally native and focused on delivering a delightful customer experience. You will work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment to solve new and interesting challenges each day. Together with our Trust team, you will help shape the future of our bank.

Customer team at Trust is where strategy, design, data, and creative come together. The team drives design and marketing of all new products, brand building, launch campaigns, accelerating acquisitions, and boosting engagement and retention. They turn insights into actions, working across teams to scale what works and experiment with what’s next.

We're looking for a Performance Marketing Lead to join Customer team in Singapore. This hands-on leadership role will own the strategy, execution, and continuous optimisation of Trust’s paid acquisition engine. Your job is to make every dollar of paid media work harder, while amplifying, rather than competing with, the referral and word-of-mouth growth that has carried Trust to a million customers.

 

The Role Responsibility:

Own performance marketing strategy and results
• Set the strategy, budget allocation and long-term roadmap for paid acquisition across search, paid social, app install (UAC), programmatic and affiliate/partnership channels.
• Own acquisition KPIs end to end - CAC, conversion rate, activation, ROAS and downstream LTV, and report performance and outlook to marketing and business leadership.
• Manage a multi-million-dollar annual media budget, reallocating spend in real time based on channel efficiency and business priorities.

Run and scale the paid media engine
• Plan, launch and optimise always-on and campaign-based activity across Google (Search, UAC, PMax), Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads and programmatic/DSP platforms.
• Build a rigorous testing agenda - creative, audience, bidding strategy and landing page experiments to continuously improve efficiency at scale.
• Direct performance-focused creative briefs and work with in-house and agency creative teams to keep a high-velocity content pipeline feeding every channel.

Build the measurement backbone
• Own mobile and web attribution end to end, including MMP configuration (e.g. AppsFlyer/Adjust), SKAN and ATT frameworks, and server-side/first-party tracking as third-party signal degrades.
• Partner with Data and Engineering to build dashboards and incrementality/holdout tests that separate genuinely incremental growth from channel noise.
• Bring a strong point of view on marketing mix modelling and multi-touch attribution to guide budget decisions across paid, referral and on-ground channels.

Integrate paid, referral and on-ground growth
• Work closely with the growth and partnership team to design paid campaigns that reinforce (not cannibalise) Trust's referral programme.
• Identify where performance media can accelerate proven organic and word-of-mouth loops, and where it should step back and let them run.

Lead people and partners
• Manage and develop a small team of performance marketing specialists, plus media, creative and analytics agency partners.
• Act as the performance marketing voice in cross-functional forums with Product, Data Science, Finance, Legal and Compliance, translating regulatory and risk requirements into campaigns that are both effective and fully compliant with MAS advertising guidelines and internal fair-dealing standards.

Our Ideal Candidate:
• 10+ years in performance or growth marketing, including experience leading paid acquisition strategy at a consumer app, e-commerce, fintech, or digital-first brand.
• Deep, hands-on expertise across paid social, paid search and mobile app install campaigns (Google UAC, Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads), with a track record of managing meaningful budgets against hard efficiency targets.
• Strong command of mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer or Adjust), SKAN/ATT, GA4 and attribution methodology in a privacy-constrained environment.
• Comfortable in the data SQL and spreadsheet-level analysis at minimum, and able to turn campaign and cohort data into a clear investment recommendation.
• A builder's mindset: equally comfortable setting quarterly strategy and personally troubleshooting a tracking issue or a stalled campaign.
• Excellent stakeholder management, you can hold your own with Finance on ROI and with Compliance on what a bank can and cannot say in an ad.
• Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, economics, a quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Good to have:
• Prior performance marketing experience at e-commerce or high-growth fintech.
• Experience designing or scaling referral, loyalty or partnership-driven growth loops alongside paid media.
• Familiarity with Singapore's media landscape and MAS guidelines on financial promotions.
• Working knowledge of Python or scripting for marketing automation and reporting.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive II
jobs.location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team.

What you’ll do

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will be a part of a critical sales team at Brex focused on expanding our reach into the Enterprise segment. This team is tasked with hunting large, strategic, global new clients for Brex and communicating the value of our industry leading Financial Operating System (Corporate Credit Card, Expense Management, Procurement, Travel, etc.) If you enjoy working in a creative, competitive environment while helping customers accelerate their growth, this role is for you!

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our Salt Lake City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require three days per week in office - Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Deal Cycle Management: Leverage your personal network alongside strategic, creative prospecting methods in order to identify decision makers and break into Enterprise customers. Own full sales cycle including everything from prospecting, discovery, demo, deal administration, and closing
• Pipeline Management: Act with urgency to build and manage a robust Enterprise sales pipeline, ensuring a steady flow of qualified leads and opportunities. Proactively organize and autonomously prioritize opportunities at different stages of the funnel
• Value Selling: Expertly articulate the unique value proposition of Brex’s products and services, utilizing strategic thinking to align solutions with customer needs and solve complex business challenges. Leverage case studies, competitive intel, and independent research to position Brex as a premier product
• Problem Solving: Act as a trusted advisor to customers, addressing their pain points and delivering innovative solutions that drive business growth/value. Adapt and thrive in ambiguity regardless of customer size or industry
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including Sales Development, Product, Legal, Deal Desk, Underwriting, and Pre-Sales to ensure a seamless customer experience. Quickly create impactful change to our product by communicating customer needs and pain points and drive alignment internally

Requirements
• 6+ years of B2B SAAS closing experience in a net-new logo acquisition environment
• Experience closing deals with F1000 customers and Large Enterprise Organizations with a minimum 1,000 global employee base
• Familiarity selling SAAS products/solutions and effectively communicating the value/ROI
• Consistent quota attainment and track record of being a top 10% performer
• Ability to independently conduct a product demo
• Bachelor’s degree 

Bonus points
• Familiarity selling financial software (Expense Management, ERP, AP Automation, T E, Accounting Software, etc.)

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role in SF, NYC, SEA, is $294,000 - $325,000. The expected OTE range for this role in SLC is $260,000 - $291,000. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Product at Brex

The Product team is at the forefront of Brex's mission to empower employees anywhere to make better financial decisions. With a deep understanding of the business, we identify and scope out the most impactful opportunities for Brex to tackle. We are responsible for aligning cross-functional teams — such as Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design — on key decisions. We set strategy and drive products from inception to launch, enabling Brex to grow rapidly and help our customers reach their full potential.

Unlocking AI Agents for the Finance Admin

Companies buy Brex to run their spend, and the person on the hook for that is the finance admin — a controller, an accounting manager, a finance ops lead. Their job comes down to two things they can never quite get ahead of: making sure money is being spent compliantly and documented in time to close the books, and knowing where the company's money is actually going.

Today they do both by hand, at a scale that doesn't work. Roughly 4% of travel and entertainment spend is out of policy — for a company spending $10M a year, that's $400K in violations, duplicates, missing receipts, and overspend. Most companies never find it, because finding it means a human reading transactions one at a time. The ones who do find it either staff a review team or bolt on a separate audit product with its own login. On the other side, the questions that actually matter — where did spend grow this quarter, which team is drifting, what's driving the number — sit behind a queue for an analyst, or a spreadsheet the admin builds themselves at month-end. Nobody is continuously watching.

The AI team is working to give every finance admin two people they can't hire today: an auditor and a business analyst
• The auditor. An agent that reads a company's own expense policy and audit rules and reviews every transaction against them — not a 10% sample. It investigates what looks wrong, gathers the missing context by going back to the employee who spent the money, groups what a human should look at, recommends the action, closes what it can safely close, and surfaces the patterns underneath: which policies are constantly broken, which employees are repeat risks, where the real exposure is. Done right, it turns expense compliance from a post-mortem into a first line of defense that runs on every transaction, and shrinks the review pile to the exceptions that genuinely need a person.
• The business analyst. An agent that answers the questions an admin would otherwise hand to an analyst — asked in plain language against their real spend data — then learns which numbers they care about, turns those into reports their whole company can use, and eventually watches those numbers and tells them when something is off. It starts as a junior analyst who runs queries on request and grows into the analyst for the entire business.

Together they add up to a single answer for the customer: am I in control of my company's money?

As a PM on Finance Admin AI, you'd take point on one of them with real, end-to-end ownership — which one, and how much of the other you pick up, is something we'll shape around where you're strongest and what the team needs when you start.

Both are early and real — in customers' hands, with the gaps that implies. And no one has a finished playbook for this: what makes an agent's judgment about a policy trustworthy enough to act on, how you evaluate an answer that has no single correct value, how you keep quality moving up as the models shift underneath you. You'll invent much of that, with the ownership and pace of a startup and the backing of an established company behind you.

What you'll do

You'll work on our core AI team building agents for the finance admin and own one of these end to end. You'll set its product direction, decide which capabilities to build and how they should behave, and spend real time with controllers and finance teams to learn what they'll actually trust an agent to do on their behalf. From there you go as deep as it takes to make it real: shaping agent behavior, writing and iterating prompts, designing the evals that prove it works, and digging into traces when it doesn't. You'll partner closely with engineering, design, and research, and you'll set the quality bar for agents that customers rely on to keep their spend clean and their numbers right.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City office. You must be willing to work in the office at least three days per week on Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Remote work is allowed up to 4 weeks per year, in increments of at least one week.

Responsibilities
• Own product direction for your area of the Finance Admin AI surface — the strategy, the roadmap, and the day-to-day calls on what ships.
• Translate messy, company-specific finance workflows — expense policies, review and approval chains, month-end close, the way each customer actually enforces its rules — into agent behavior that holds up in production.
• Define what "good judgment" means for an agent operating on someone else's money, and build the evals, prompting approaches, and feedback loops that get it there — then re-invent them as the underlying models and tooling shift.
• Get hands-on. Prototype, measure, read transcripts and traces, and iterate toward what actually works rather than what looks good in a demo.
• Earn autonomy incrementally: figure out where the agent should recommend, where it should act, and how a customer builds enough trust to let it move from one to the other.
• Work directly with finance admins at real companies, and let their usage — not assumptions — drive the next iteration.
• Set and defend a high quality bar for agents operating in a trust-critical, financial context.

Requirements
• You're an experienced product manager. You have a track record of owning complex, user-facing products end to end — setting direction and shipping to real users — with the scope and judgment this senior role calls for.
• You've built for company admins, and you've built it for customers. You've shipped software to the personas who keep a company running — finance, accounting, HR, payroll, IT, compliance, data — and you know how much this can vary from one company to the next. It matters that this was product you sold to other companies, not an internal system inside your own.
• Depth in company workflows or in data and reporting, and genuine interest in the other — the queues, approvals, and exceptions an admin works through, or how people get answers out of their own data and what it takes to model it so those answers are right.
• You have technical depth, and you've worked on systems without a single correct answer. Having built agentic software is a strong plus. Probabilistic, optimization-driven systems where "done" doesn't exist and the work is making it steadily better: AI/ML, search and ranking, marketplace matching, risk and fraud detection, game engines. You're comfortable when the spec is an outcome and a set of signals rather than a decision tree. Also, if you've shipped an agent that real users depended on — designed the evals, iterated the prompts, worked out where it should act on its own versus stop and ask, and lived through the failure modes — say so and tell us what you learned.
• You're comfortable with ambiguity and with systems you can't fully predict. You pull signal out of noise, make good intuitive bets, and ship and refine rather than holding out for a perfect answer. Perfect is the enemy of good here.
• Strong product taste and judgment about what's worth shipping to customers and what isn't.
• You move fast and go deep — comfortable prototyping, reading data, and getting into the details rather than working through layers.

Nice to have:

hands-on depth in prompting or eval design; familiarity with fintech, expense management, or accounting workflows.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $184,000 - $230,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

→ Serve as the primary point of contact for customer queries, resolving issues promptly or escalating complex operational needs appropriately.

jobs.title: Design System Designer, OKDS
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the Opportunity

Join the team building Agentic OKDS—OKG’s design intelligence infrastructure and the operating system between human intent and AI-generated output. You will contribute across three connected capability areas: Foundations, including token architecture for color, spacing, and radius; Components, spanning OKDS core components, business components, and AI-ready architecture; and Templates + AI Tooling, covering template systems, AI transformation infrastructure, and pipeline readiness. Your primary assignment may change based on team needs, while you build the breadth to work effectively across all three. You will combine strong craft with design-engineering judgment to improve reuse, adoption, delivery speed, and implementation quality.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Own scoped initiatives across Foundations, Components, or Templates + AI Tooling—from research and reuse validation through specification, release, adoption, and iteration—while contributing effectively across all three areas as priorities change.
• Develop and maintain foundation standards and token architecture for color, spacing, radius, themes, modes, and platform variation, ensuring consistency between Figma and implementation.
• Design and evolve OKDS core components and reusable business components with clear naming, variants, states, metadata, composition rules, and architecture suitable for designers, engineers, and AI-assisted workflows.
• Build reusable template systems and AI-readable guidance, and contribute to tooling infrastructure and validation workflows that improve AI pipeline readiness and production-quality output.
• Partner closely with engineers to ensure design intent, platform behavior, component APIs, and accessibility requirements remain aligned across Web, iOS, and Android.
• Prototype and improve AI-assisted workflows for template generation, component discovery, variant generation, specification, and quality review—while applying critical human judgment to the output.
• Drive adoption with product teams through consultation, enablement, migration support, and feedback loops; treat designers and engineers as users of the platform.
• Apply quality acceptance criteria covering interaction states, responsive behavior, accessibility, compliance, and implementation-ready handoff.
• Plan and deliver work transparently, manage dependencies, and track outcomes such as reuse, adoption, reduced rework, and faster implementation.

What We Look For In You
• Demonstrated experience delivering reusable design-system components, patterns, or foundations in a complex digital-product environment.
• Strong Figma capability, including component properties, variables, modes, libraries, and scalable file organization.
• Working knowledge across design-system foundations, component architecture, and template systems, including tokens, theming, documentation, versioning, reusable business patterns, and contribution workflows.
• Strong craft under ambiguity: able to explore, prototype, test, and refine detailed interaction and visual behavior.
• Design-engineering fluency and comfort discussing implementation constraints, states, APIs, and platform differences.
• An adoption mindset: you investigate user needs, make standards practical, and follow through until teams can use them successfully.
• Practical capability with AI-assisted design and development workflows, plus the judgment to assess tooling, strengthen pipeline readiness, and review generated output for correctness, consistency, and production readiness.
• Clear written and verbal communication, constructive collaboration, and the ability to explain system decisions to designers, engineers, and product partners.
• Reliable operational ownership: able to scope work, communicate progress and risks, manage dependencies, and deliver with quality.
• Product and business awareness, including the ability to connect design-system choices to speed, quality, risk, and reuse.
• Working knowledge of accessibility, compliance, responsive behavior, and complete global-state design.

Nice to Haves
• Experience designing for Fintech, Investment platforms, or Crypto products
• Experience working with teams across offices and timezones
• Understanding of React framework for Front End development

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Core
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the Opportunity

Core owns the foundational journeys that define a user's relationship with OKX: account management, identity verification, moving and securing funds, and the risk, compliance, and customer support experiences that sit alongside them. It also covers the internal enterprise tools our support agents, PMs, and operations teams rely on every day to serve customers and run the business. These are among the most consequential surfaces in the product. They determine whether users feel confident enough to trade, whether they trust us with their assets and their data, and whether the teams behind the scenes can resolve issues quickly and well.

AI is central to how Core works and what Core builds. On the product side, we design AI-powered support and assistant experiences that help millions of users get answers and resolve issues in real time. Internally, we are an AI-native team: we use AI to move faster, sharpen our thinking, and raise the quality of what we ship, and we design the AI-native tools our internal teams depend on. If you are excited to design with AI and to shape how AI shows up for both customers and colleagues, this is a place to do it at scale.

As a designer on Core, you'll take ownership of these high-stakes experiences end to end. The problems are genuinely hard. You'll design across markets with fundamentally different regulatory requirements, from newly regulated regions to our established global user base, and your work will need to satisfy strict compliance and security standards while still feeling fast, clear, and reassuring. You'll partner closely with product, engineering, legal, and compliance, shaping requirements early rather than executing them late. This is work where the details carry real weight. If you want to influence how millions of users experience crypto at its most critical moments, and how the teams supporting them get their work done, Core is one of the most impactful places to do it at OKX.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Own complex, high-stakes journeys end to end across account, assets, compliance, or support, taking them from problem definition to shipped, polished execution.
• Design AI-powered experiences, from customer-facing assistant and support flows to AI-native internal tools, thinking through how people and AI work together, and where trust, transparency, and control matter most.
• Partner with product, engineering, legal, compliance, and risk to define the real problem, then design solutions that balance regulatory and security requirements with a genuinely good user experience.
• Produce the full range of design artifacts as needed: user flows, journey maps, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and interactive prototypes, backed by evaluative research.
• Work in an AI-native way, using AI to accelerate exploration, prototyping, and decision-making, and helping raise the bar for how the team designs.
• Shape the design vision for your area alongside UX Research, UX Writing, and product leadership, and influence the roadmap early rather than delivering to it.
• Raise the quality bar through design reviews, critique, and workshops, and bring rigor to ambiguous, high-consequence problems.

What We Look For In You

We hire against a shared set of competencies. Beyond craft, we look for how you think, decide, collaborate, and drive work forward.
• Craft and expertise. Deep design craft with a sharp eye for detail, and up-to-date knowledge of your field. You analyze problems methodically and turn them into simple, effective solutions you can execute end to end.
• Judgment in ambiguity. You cut to the root of a problem, make sound calls even with incomplete information, and find the optimal path rather than the obvious one. Core problems are rarely clean, and good judgment is what keeps users safe.
• Business and product sense. You understand how the business works and where it's heading, and you connect design decisions to strategy, metrics, and real outcomes, not just the screen in front of you.
• Collaboration and communication. You communicate with clarity and precision, build genuine trust with product, engineering, legal, and compliance, and give and seek feedback that raises the whole team's work. Partners see you as a collaborator, not a service function.
• Drive and curiosity. You ask why before you design, stay resilient when problems are hard or ambiguous, and keep pushing your craft and ideas forward. You question the brief rather than just building it.
• AI fluency. Genuine fluency and enthusiasm for AI. You already use AI tools in your own work, and you're excited to design AI-driven experiences, not just adopt the buzzword.
• Experience designing complex, multi-step flows, ideally in fintech, crypto, or another regulated or high-trust domain.
• 3+ years of experience shipping end-to-end design solutions in cross-functional teams at a tech company.

Nice to Haves
• Experience designing AI or conversational interfaces, or a track record of using AI to change how you work as a designer.
• Interest in designing complex internal tools and operational workflows, not just customer-facing surfaces.
• Exposure to data-informed design. You're comfortable interpreting user insights, behavioral data, or A/B test results.
• Familiarity with design systems and the ability to scale consistency across platforms.
• Prototyping skills to bring ideas to life and communicate transitions or microinteractions.
• Experience working across time zones with distributed teams. You know how to stay aligned and communicate with clarity.
• A degree in design, HCI, or a related field.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

We’re continuously meeting product design talent interested in shaping the future of centralized exchange products at OKX.

Our CEX Product Design team works across Manual Trading, Trading Strategy, Social VIP, Growth, and Institutional products. Depending on your experience, interests, and our current hiring needs, we’ll explore relevant opportunities across different teams and levels.

We design products for complex, fast-moving financial environments. Designers partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Data, and other functions from early exploration through delivery and iteration. • Social VIP — building differentiated experiences for social trading, communities, creators, and high-value customers.

• Present your work clearly, explain the reasoning behind your decisions, and use feedback to improve the outcome.
• Contribute to consistent, scalable experiences across platforms, markets, and product areas.
• Help strengthen design quality, collaboration, and customer-centered decision-making across the organization.

• A portfolio that shows how you frame problems, explore alternatives, make decisions, craft interactions, and measure or evaluate outcomes—not only final screens.
• Strong product thinking and the ability to connect customer needs with business goals and technical realities.
• Strong interaction design and information architecture skills, especially for complex workflows or data-rich interfaces.
• A high standard of visual craft and attention to detail.
• Experience collaborating closely with Product and Engineering throughout the product development lifecycle.
• The ability to communicate clearly, explain your reasoning, and build alignment with cross-functional partners.
• Comfort working through ambiguity, changing priorities, and incomplete information.
• The ability to take ownership, follow through on details, and help teams turn ideas into shipped experiences.
• Genuine interest in learning about centralized exchange products and the customers who use them.

Nice to Haves
• Experience designing products in trading, investment, fintech, crypto, or other complex financial domains.
• Experience with data-intensive products, professional tools, marketplaces, or high-stakes customer journeys.
• Experience using research, experimentation, and product analytics to guide design decisions.
• Experience designing for customers across multiple markets, cultures, languages, or regulatory environments.
• Experience contributing to or working with a mature design system across platforms.
