jobs.title: Sr. Member Experience Manager
jobs.description:
DAVE VS. GOLIATH. WE’RE DAVE.

Dave is a financial app on a mission to build products that level the financial playing field. It is redefining the financial landscape by leveraging technology to create an affordable, transparent, and user-centric access to liquidity for millions of Americans. As a leading innovator in the U.S. financial services sector, Dave’s digital financial platform offers products designed to meet the credit needs of those underserved by traditional financial institutions. Dave’s offerings include its flagship ExtraCash product, providing members up to $500 within minutes. The company is on track to launch several new product offerings in 2026, including a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) option.

Dave is focused on serving Americans who are financially vulnerable or living paycheck to paycheck. Dave is leading the charge in creating a new era of credit products that prioritizes speed, affordability, and accessibility, making it the go-to financial partner for those who need it most.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Dave is growing fast and the member base is growing with it. As more people choose Dave over traditional banking, the feedback loop that helps us understand their experience needs to be sharper, more structured, and more connected to the decisions that drive the business. That's what this role builds.

As Sr. Member Experience Manager, you'll own the Voice of Customer program and shape how Dave listens to, understands, and acts on member signals across every touchpoint. This isn't a "compile the feedback" role. You'll be the person translating what millions of members are experiencing into the structured, data backed case that gets in front of Product and Leadership and actually changes things.

The work sits at a real intersection. You'll tie member sentiment to business outcomes like retention, engagement, and revenue, and make the argument that doing right by the member and growing the business are the same goal. At Dave they are. This role is how we make sure that case gets made consistently, on a regular cadence, with the numbers to back it up.

If you want a high-visibility IC role where your work shapes product decisions and your voice carries weight across the org, this is it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Voice of Customer Program

You are the voice of the customer within Dave. You own how member signals get turned into something the Dave team can act on. That means pulling input from every customer contact support data, app reviews, social conversations, community feedback, and surveys, including App Store and Google Play reviews and public social conversations. You decide what gets tracked, how it's measured, and when something is significant enough to escalate, including routing anything with reputational or policy circumvention risk to Complaints/Resolve so they can move fast.

You'll build a structured, recurring rhythm for surfacing what matters: real-time visibility into issues and trend shifts as they happen, a monthly deep dive with Research into one specific friction area affecting members, and a periodic review of the biggest unresolved issues that you bring to Product and use to keep Leadership current. Each cycle produces a clear problem statement, not just a data dump, and you keep a running backlog so patterns don't disappear just because they miss a cycle.

The readouts you deliver aren't a complaints list. They're a business case. A spike in a friction category is a churn signal. A recurring drop-off in a core flow means members are transacting less or leaving. You'll tie what you're hearing to the metrics that matter, retention, engagement, revenue, and member growth, and you'll partner with Member Insights and Data Analytics so the signal you're surfacing feeds the classifiers and dashboards the rest of MS&O relies on, not just your own readouts.

Doing right by the member and making the business case are the same argument here. Members who trust the product stay longer, transact more, and tell others.

Product Feedback and Member Advocacy

When member signals point to a product gap, you build the case and bring it to Product in a way PMs can prioritize: a clear problem statement written from the member's perspective, backed by data, with a recommendation behind it.

You're also the member's advocate in the room. That means showing up prepared, defending the friction point with specifics, adjusting when new information comes in, and helping the group reach a better decision because the member's perspective was actually represented. You're not there to report back. You're there to move the outcome.

Dogfooding is part of how you stay credible in those conversations. You'll use Dave's products regularly and test new launches before they go out, so you know firsthand what the experience feels like before members do.

Cross-Functional Work

You'll represent the member's perspective across Product, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, Legal and Compliance, running the recurring syncs with product teams that keep pain points and open issues moving, and helping facilitate the forums where broader member experience initiatives get assigned an owner instead of stalling between meetings.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Five or more years in member experience, Voice of Customer, customer insights, or CX with real program ownership

 - A proactive and curious mindset with a natural drive to investigate patterns, identify opportunities, and improve the member experience.

 - Experience gathering signals from multiple touchpoints, including app store reviews and public social conversation, and turning them into structured, actionable recommendations

 - Strong judgment in separating isolated feedback from meaningful trends and determining when deeper analysis, escalation, or action is needed.

 - Working fluency with Mode, Looker, or similar tools to independently build and defend a data-backed case

 - Comfort leveraging AI tools such as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini to guide research, synthesize feedback, identify patterns, and strengthen analysis.

 - Comfort in cross-functional product conversations where you've made the member's case in a PM setting

 - Experience advocating for agent-level tools, workflows, and product improvements that reduce friction, improve efficiency, and strengthen the member experience.

 - A track record of building trusted relationships and influencing stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, Compliance, Research, and Data.

 - Strong written communication: clear problem statements, crisp readouts, recommendations that get used

 - Confidence speaking up, challenging assumptions respectfully, and calling out the obvious when needed to create clarity or resolve misalignment.

 - Strong written and verbal communication with the ability to turn complex findings into clear problem statements, concise readouts, and actionable recommendations.

 - The ability to move work forward without direct authority while navigating competing priorities and maintaining cross-functional alignment.

 - Strong organizational skills with the ability to document decisions, maintain action items, track owners and deadlines, and ensure follow-through.

BONUS POINTS

 - Experience running a formal VoC or community engagement program

 - Background in fintech or consumer financial services

 - Familiarity with QA or contact center operations

 - Experience in an agile product environment

 - Comfort with tools like Mode, Looker, Zendesk, or Rippit (MaestroQA)

Don’t let imposter syndrome get in the way of an incredible opportunity. We’re looking for people who can help us achieve our mission and vision, not just check off the boxes. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Why you’ll love working here: 

At Dave, our people are just as important as our product. Our culture reflects the values that guide who we are, how we work, and what we aspire to be. Daves are member-centric, helpful, transparent, persistent, and better together. We strive to create an environment where all Daves feel valued, heard, and empowered to do their best work. As a virtual-first company, team members can live and work anywhere in the United States, except Hawaii. 

A few of our benefits & perks:

💚 Opportunity to tackle tough challenges, learn and grow from fellow top talent, and help millions of people reach their personal financial goals

💻 Flexible hours and virtual-first work culture with a home office stipend

🏥 Premium Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance plans

👶 Generous paid parental and caregiver leave

 💰 401(k) savings plan with matching contributions

📈 Financial advisor and financial wellness support

🏖️ Flexible PTO and generous company holidays, including Juneteenth and Winter Break

🎉 All-company in-person events once or twice a year and virtual events throughout to connect with your team members and leadership team

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About

the Role:

We're looking for a Security Engineer who is equally at home hardening a CI/CD pipeline, reviewing a change to the authentication system on the backend, and triaging a bug bounty submission before lunch.This is a hands-on, builder-first role - not a governance checkbox. You'll own security operations end-to-end, embedded directly into the engineering team and working closely with infrastructure, protocol and platform.

If you treat threat modeling as a design conversation and not a compliance exercise, you're our kind of person. You should only apply for this role if you are ready to come into the office every day and work in person with our team!

What You'll Do:

Security Operations

 - Own day-to-day security operations: monitoring, alerting, triage, and response

 - Manage and monitor endpoint security via an EDR system - tune detections, investigate alerts, and drive incidents to resolution

 - Lead identity lifecycle management, including employee onboarding and off boarding (access provisioning, key rotation, deprovisioning)

Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Management

 - Be the primary owner of our ImmuneFi program - triaging, reproducing, and responding to incoming submissions daily

 - Prioritize and track vulnerabilities through to remediation in close collaboration with protocol and engineering teams

 - Develop internal tooling and processes to make the bounty workflow faster and more consistent

DevSecOps & Pipeline Hardening

 - Audit and harden CI/CD pipelines - secrets management, supply chain integrity, SAST/DAST integration, build provenance

 - Own dependency security: identify and remediate vulnerable packages across repositories (yes, including the npm dependency hell)

 - Establish and enforce security standards across the SDLC

Infrastructure Security

 - Partner with the infrastructure team to review and harden cloud environments (access controls, network segmentation, least privilege, logging)

 - Contribute to threat modeling for new systems and architectural changes

 - Drive implementation of security tooling across the stack

Vendor & External Partner Management

 - Own relationships with external security vendors and service providers — holding them accountable toSLAs, managing scope, and ensuring findings are actioned

 - Evaluate and onboard new security tooling as the team and threat landscape evolve

What We're Looking For:

- 5+ years of experience in software and security engineering, with meaningful time in a DevSecOps or security operations context

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals - you're a builder who writes code, not just policy

 - Hands-on experience hardening CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or similar) and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or equivalent)

 - Proficiency with endpoint security tooling (CrowdStrike or equivalent EDR)

 - Comfort owning identity and access management processes, including onboarding/offboarding workflows

 - Strong communication skills - you can write a clear triage report, give direct feedback to a developer and explain risk to a non-technical stakeholder

Nice to Have:

- You were a traditional software engineer before specializing in security

 - Prior experience at a DeFi protocol, crypto exchange, or blockchain infrastructure company

 - CTF/security competition background

 - Contributions to open-source security tooling

What Success Looks Like:

In your first 90 days, you've mapped our attack surface, established a daily rhythm on ImmuneFi, and shipped at least a few meaningful PRs across the full stack. Within six months, you've built enough trust in the team that engineers come to you before shipping sensitive PRs, not after.

jobs.title: Head of Finance
jobs.description:
About ether.fi http://ether.fi

ether.fi http://ether.fi is one of the largest DeFi protocols on Ethereum. We started with weETH, a liquid staking token that now secures billions of dollars of staked ETH, and built outward from there: the Liquid vault range, which runs automated yield strategies across ETH, stablecoins and BTC, and ether.fi http://ether.fi Cash, a Visa card and neobank product that lets users spend directly against their on-chain balances.

Behind the protocol is a group of operating companies in Cayman, Brazil, the US, Canada and the UAE, including a regulated investment manager and a licensed VASP. We are continuing to open new markets and add additional regulated products, with finance playing a key role in this expansion.

The role

We're hiring a Head of Finance to run the finance function. Today finance sits with the COO/CFO and financial controller. We are looking for someone to own the following: month end, audits, budget, tax, treasury operations, fund NAV, payments and payroll. The CFO will set policy and sign off. You own everything else.

It's a small team. You'll have one accountant reporting to you and can hire as we grow, but you need to be comfortable doing the work yourself. We're based across several time zones and you'll be working with legal, compliance, ops and the product teams every week.

What you'll do

 - Run month end across all entities. Management accounts within 15 business days, quarterly reporting within 45 days.

 - Balance sheet recs, including wallets, exchange and custody balances against the ledger.

 - Revenue recognition for protocol fees, vault fees, card interchange and treasury income.

 - Lead our statutory audits.

 - Own the annual budget and monthly budget vs actuals. Every material assumption needs to be documented and something you can defend.

 - Cash forecasting.

 - Daily liquidity monitoring across fiat, stables and crypto. Weekly portfolio review and rebalancing to targets set by the CFO. Moving funds for payroll and payments.

 - Put intercompany agreements and a transfer pricing model in place with our advisers.

 - Tax and regulatory finance filings across Cayman, Brazil, US, Canada and UAE (economic substance, US information returns, CRA).

 - Weekly payment run, vendors, payroll and contractors in several countries, token vesting and payouts, expenses.

 - Card inventory and cost tracking with Ops.

 - Own the finance systems (QuickBooks, crypto sub-ledger, AP tool, payroll, cap table) and cut down the manual recs.

 - Work with Compliance, Ecosystem and Product on fee models and new launches. Help HR with comp budgets, relocations and payroll.

What we're looking for

 - Qualified accountant (CA, CPA, ACCA). Big 4 audit background preferred.

 - 8+ years post-qualification, at least 4 of them in-house at a crypto, fintech or asset management business.

 - Has run a finance function before, as controller or head of finance, across multiple entities and currencies.

 - Has owned audits end to end.

 - Hands-on with intercompany agreements and transfer pricing.

 - Comfortable with crypto: wallet recs, token accounting, staking rewards, NAV for crypto funds.

 - Organised and direct. Flags problems early rather than at month end.

 - Able to work in Cayman (right to work or eligible for a permit). Relocation support is available.

Nice to have

 - Cayman funds: CIMA registration, investment manager entities, working with administrators.

 - VASP, payments or card program experience, including interchange.

 - US and Canadian tax.

 - Multi-country payroll and token compensation.

 - QuickBooks Online, a crypto sub-ledger, AP automation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Junior Designer to join our team, working remotely from anywhere in Canada.

In this role, you’ll support the execution of compelling brand design and advertising communications across static and motion-based mediums. You’re a creative designer with a strong foundation in brand systems, visual storytelling, and executional craft—comfortable translating complex ideas into engaging visuals and layouts. You bring a strong eye for detail, a passion for evolving brands, and the ability to think holistically across touchpoints.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design and execute compelling creative for brand campaigns and always-on channels, including social, dotcom, email, display advertising, and motion.

 - Support creative studio members with production design across creative versioning, copy updates, translation versioning, and other production-oriented design tasks, with a primary focus on static or digital formats. Motion experience is welcome.

 - Uphold high standards of craft, design excellence, and mistake-free production assets at all required sizes and formats across marketing channels.

 - Help uphold KOHO’s brand identity, ensuring consistency, clarity, and craft across all touchpoints.

 - Stay ahead of brand and motion design trends, applying best practices to keep KOHO’s brand fresh, expressive, and relevant.

 - Explore and integrate AI tools, design and motion systems to improve efficiency, experimentation, and creative output.

 - Continuously experiment with new tools, techniques, and workflows to elevate craft and scale creative impact.

 - Help evolve a collaborative, feedback-driven design culture that encourages knowledge sharing and alignment.

REQUIREMENTS

 - 1+ years of experience in brand design and/or marketing design, ideally within fintech, tech, or consumer brands

 - Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in design

 - Strong portfolio demonstrating brand systems thinking, visual craft, attention to detail, and fundamentals

 - Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills

 - Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, email building tools & AI Tools (such as Flora, Weavy, Midjourney, etc..)

 - A growing understanding of motion principles and systems (timing, easing, transitions)

The budgeted salary range for this role is $70,000-80,000 CAD / year. 

At KOHO, we are dedicated to providing pay transparency to all candidates. Compensation at KOHO is determined through various factors including but not limited to: comparable salary market data within Canada, technical skill assessment, a holistic view of previous work history, and internal pay equity with other KOHO team members.

DESCRIPTION DE POSTE EN FRANÇAIS

À propos du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un ou d’une designer junior pour se joindre à notre équipe, en télétravail partout au Canada.

Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez à la réalisation de communications de marque et publicitaires percutantes, en formats statiques et animés. Vous êtes une personne créative qui a de solides bases en systèmes de marque, en narration visuelle et en qualité d’exécution, et vous savez traduire des idées complexes en visuels et en mises en page attrayants. Vous avez le souci du détail et la passion de faire évoluer les marques. Vous avez aussi une vision globale de l’ensemble des points de contact.

Responsabilités

 - Concevoir et réaliser des créations percutantes pour les campagnes de marque et les canaux permanents, notamment les médias sociaux, le site Web, les courriels, les bannières publicitaires et l’animation.

 - Soutenir les membres du studio de création dans les tâches de production : déclinaisons créatives, mises à jour de textes, versions traduites et autres tâches de design de production, principalement pour les formats statiques ou numériques. Une expérience en animation est un atout.

 - Maintenir des normes élevées de qualité d’exécution et d’excellence en design, et livrer des fichiers de production sans erreur dans toutes les tailles et tous les formats requis pour les canaux marketing.

 - Contribuer à préserver l’identité de marque de KOHO en assurant la cohérence, la clarté et la qualité d’exécution à tous les points de contact.

 - Rester à l’affût des tendances en design de marque et en motion design, et appliquer les pratiques exemplaires pour que la marque KOHO demeure fraîche, expressive et pertinente.

 - Explorer et intégrer des outils d’IA ainsi que des systèmes de design et d’animation afin d’améliorer l’efficacité, l’expérimentation et la production créative.

 - Expérimenter continuellement de nouveaux outils, techniques et méthodes de travail pour rehausser la qualité d’exécution et accroître l’impact créatif à grande échelle.

 - Contribuer à faire évoluer une culture de design collaborative, axée sur la rétroaction, qui favorise le partage des connaissances et la cohésion.

Exigences

 - Baccalauréat en design (ou expérience équivalente)

 - Solide portfolio démontrant une réflexion axée sur les systèmes de marque, une maîtrise visuelle, le souci du détail et une bonne connaissance des fondements

 - Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets et priorités dans un environnement au rythme soutenu

 - Maîtrise de Figma, de la suite Adobe Creative, d’outils de création de courriels et d’outils d’IA (comme Flora, Weavy, Midjourney, etc.)

 - Compréhension croissante des principes et des systèmes d’animation (rythme, accélération et décélération, transitions)

Rémunération

L’échelle salariale prévue pour ce poste se situe entre 70 000 $ et 80 000 $ CA par année.

Chez KOHO, nous nous engageons à assurer la transparence salariale auprès de toutes les personnes candidates. KOHO is for builders.

If you’re energized by challenge, motivated by mission, and want to be part of a team that punches above its weight - we want to hear from you.

 

The KOHO culture is one of collaboration, creativity, and diverse perspectives. We are committed to building and fostering an inclusive, accessible environment for everyone. KOHO is entering its next chapter - leaner, smarter, more AI-integrated. We’re building for impact, not bureaucracy. If you thrive in environments that value clarity, ownership, and bold thinking, you’ll fit right in.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Lifecycle and Organic Growth own two things at KOHO: how Canadians find us without paid media, and every message they get from us after they sign up. As Director, Lifecycle & Organic Growth, you'll set the strategy for both and lead the teams that deliver it. On the Lifecycle side that means email, push, in-app, and SMS. On the Organic side it means koho.ca http://koho.ca, SEO, GEO, the App Store and Google Play, and content marketing.

 

You won't be starting from scratch. Lifecycle already measures its impact with a randomized global control group, tied to company KPIs like activation, power users, retention and contribution margin rather than open rates. It has a documented operating model, two-part peer QA on every send, a tiered legal review process, and an incident and continuity framework designed for a regulated financial institution. Your job is to scale what's working: grow incremental impact, bring the same measurement rigour to Organic, and connect the two into one owned-channel growth engine.

 

You'll report to the Chief Growth Officer and lead a team of seven. You'll work closely with Product, Data, Legal & Compliance, Creative, Integrated Marketing, Performance Marketing and Engineering.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Strategy and outcomes

 - Own the strategy, roadmap and targets for Lifecycle and Organic Growth. You're accountable for business outcomes (registrations, activation, engagement, retention and contribution margin).

 - Lead lifecycle programs across the whole customer journey: onboarding, activation, cross-sell and upsell, reactivation, retention and servicing.

 - Set direction for organic acquisition across koho.ca http://koho.ca, SEO, GEO (visibility in AI-powered search), app store optimization and content, alongside the senior domain lead who runs it day to day.

 - Bring Lifecycle-grade measurement to Organic: clear definitions, metrics anyone can reproduce, and reporting that connects organic presence to registrations and activation.

 - Connect owned channels with Paid, Affiliates and Product so the customer journey works end to end, not just channel by channel.

 

Measurement and experimentation

 - Steward the global control group and the incrementality program. Make sure every result the team reports is causal and holds up to scrutiny.

 - Own the experimentation roadmap (A/B tests, holdouts, multivariate journeys) and turn results into decisions.

 - Present performance and strategy to the executive team in regular business reviews.

 

Operations, governance and risk

 - Own the Lifecycle operating model: intake, prioritization, spec, peer QA, legal review tiering, launch and post-launch measurement.

 - Partner with Legal and Compliance so every customer communication is accurate, compliant and auditable, in both English and French.

 - Own incident response and business continuity for customer messaging, including fallback sending and escalation paths.

 - Own website governance: who can publish, how changes are reviewed, and how releases are protected.

 - Own the owned-channel martech stack and its vendors, with Braze as the core platform. That covers contracts, renewals and platform health.

 

People

 - Lead, develop and retain a team of senior managers and specialists, and hire as the team grows.

 - Keep the career ladder clear, and keep the team's engagement and growth high.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 10+ years in lifecycle, CRM or retention marketing at a B2C consumer tech, fintech or subscription business, including 4+ years leading managers.

 - A track record of moving business metrics through owned channels, backed by incrementality evidence (holdouts, control groups) and not just engagement rates.

 - Deep, hands-on fluency with a modern customer engagement platform (Braze strongly preferred): journey architecture, segmentation, Liquid personalization, and data integration through a CDP such as Segment.

 - Working fluency in organic growth: SEO and technical SEO fundamentals, ASO, content strategy, and how AI search is changing discovery. You don't need to be a career SEO, but you do need to set strategy and challenge how results are measured.

 - Strong analytical judgment. You're comfortable in SQL or working closely with Data, and you can tell when a number doesn't hold up.

 - Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, insurance, health or telecom) where marketing goes through legal and compliance review.

 - An operator's instinct: you've written the playbook, not just followed it.

 - Executive communication that's clear and concise, and you raise bad news early.

 - A record as a manager people want to work for, with the retention and engagement to show it.

 - You're already using AI in your day-to-day work.

 - Experience with Canadian financial services regulation and CASL.

 - Experience with predictive or ML-driven personalization (churn, propensity, send-time).

 

NICE TO HAVE

 - Professional working proficiency in French

 - Experience with a headless CMS (e.g. Sanity) and on-site experimentation

 

The posted salary range for this role is $175,000 – $210,000 CAD / year.

At KOHO, we are dedicated to providing pay transparency to all candidates. Compensation at KOHO is determined through various factors including but not limited to: comparable salary market data within Canada, technical skill assessment, a holistic view of previous work history, and internal pay equity with other KOHO team members.

 

DESCRIPTION DE POSTE EN FRANÇAIS

 

DIRECTEUR(TRICE), CYCLE DE VIE CLIENT ET CROISSANCE ORGANIQUE

 

À PROPOS DU POSTE

Chez KOHO, les équipes Cycle de vie et Croissance organique sont responsables de deux choses : la façon dont les Canadiens nous découvrent sans médias payants, et chacun des messages qu'ils reçoivent de notre part après leur inscription. À titre de directeur(trice), Cycle de vie client et croissance organique, vous définirez la stratégie de ces deux volets et dirigerez les équipes qui la mettent en œuvre. Du côté Cycle de vie, cela comprend les courriels, les notifications push, les messages intégrés à l'application et les textos. Du côté Croissance organique, cela comprend koho.ca http://koho.ca, le référencement naturel (SEO), l'optimisation pour les moteurs génératifs (GEO), l'App Store et Google Play, ainsi que le marketing de contenu.

 

Vous ne partirez pas de zéro. L'équipe Cycle de vie mesure déjà son impact au moyen d'un groupe témoin global randomisé, lié aux indicateurs clés de l'entreprise comme l'activation, les utilisateurs assidus, la rétention et la marge de contribution plutôt qu'aux taux d'ouverture. Elle dispose d'un modèle opérationnel documenté, d'un contrôle qualité par les pairs en deux étapes pour chaque envoi, d'un processus de révision juridique par niveaux et d'un cadre de gestion des incidents et de continuité conçu pour une institution financière réglementée. Votre rôle sera de faire croître ce qui fonctionne : augmenter l'impact incrémental, appliquer la même rigueur de mesure à la croissance organique et réunir les deux volets en un seul moteur de croissance par les canaux détenus.

 

Vous relèverez du chef de la croissance et dirigerez une équipe de sept personnes. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Produits, Données, Affaires juridiques et Conformité, Création, Marketing intégré, Marketing de performance et Ingénierie.

 

CE QUE VOUS FEREZ

 

STRATÉGIE ET RÉSULTATS

 - Assumer la responsabilité de la stratégie, de la feuille de route et des cibles des volets Cycle de vie et Croissance organique. Vous serez responsable des résultats d'affaires (inscriptions, activation, engagement, rétention et marge de contribution).

 - Diriger les programmes de cycle de vie tout au long du parcours client : intégration, activation, ventes croisées et incitatives, réactivation, rétention et service.

 - Orienter l'acquisition organique sur koho.ca http://koho.ca, en SEO, en GEO (visibilité dans les moteurs de recherche propulsés par l'IA), en optimisation pour les boutiques d'applications et en contenu, en collaboration avec le ou la responsable principal(e) du domaine qui en assure la gestion au quotidien.

 - Appliquer à la croissance organique la rigueur de mesure du Cycle de vie : définitions claires, indicateurs reproductibles par tous et rapports qui relient la présence organique aux inscriptions et à l'activation.

 - Relier les canaux détenus aux équipes Médias payants, Affiliation et Produits afin que le parcours client fonctionne de bout en bout, et non seulement canal par canal.

 

MESURE ET EXPÉRIMENTATION

 - Assurer la gestion du groupe témoin global et du programme d'incrémentalité. Veiller à ce que chaque résultat présenté par l'équipe soit causal et résiste à l'examen.

 - Piloter la feuille de route d'expérimentation (tests A/B, groupes de contrôle, parcours multivariés) et transformer les résultats en décisions.

 - Présenter le rendement et la stratégie à l'équipe de direction lors de revues d'affaires régulières.

 

OPÉRATIONS, GOUVERNANCE ET RISQUES

 - Assumer la responsabilité du modèle opérationnel du Cycle de vie : réception des demandes, priorisation, spécifications, contrôle qualité par les pairs, niveaux de révision juridique, lancement et mesure post-lancement.

 - Collaborer avec les équipes Affaires juridiques et Conformité afin que chaque communication client soit exacte, conforme et vérifiable, en français comme en anglais.

 - Gérer la réponse aux incidents et la continuité des activités pour les communications client, y compris les envois de relève et les procédures d'escalade.

 - Assurer la gouvernance du site Web : qui peut publier, comment les modifications sont révisées et comment les mises en production sont protégées.

 - Gérer la pile martech des canaux détenus et ses fournisseurs, avec Braze comme plateforme principale, y compris les contrats, les renouvellements et la santé de la plateforme.

 

GESTION DES PERSONNES

 - Diriger, développer et fidéliser une équipe de gestionnaires principaux et de spécialistes, et recruter à mesure que l'équipe grandit.

 - Maintenir une échelle de carrière claire et un niveau élevé d'engagement et de développement au sein de l'équipe.

 

CE DONT VOUS AUREZ BESOIN

 - Plus de 10 ans d'expérience en marketing du cycle de vie, en GRC ou en marketing de rétention au sein d'une entreprise B2C de technologie grand public, de technologie financière ou d'abonnement, dont au moins 4 ans à diriger des gestionnaires.

 - Une bonne connaissance pratique de la croissance organique : principes fondamentaux du SEO et du SEO technique, ASO, stratégie de contenu et transformation de la découvrabilité par la recherche propulsée par l'IA. Nul besoin d'être spécialiste du SEO de carrière, mais vous devez pouvoir définir la stratégie et remettre en question la façon dont les résultats sont mesurés.

 - Un excellent jugement analytique. Vous êtes à l'aise avec SQL ou en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe Données, et vous savez reconnaître un chiffre qui ne tient pas la route.

If you believe compliance should make good products possible rather than merely permissible, you’ll do your best work here.

 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

COMPLIANCE ADVISORY

 - Act as the primary compliance advisor to business partners such as Product (lending, core banking, growth & onboarding), Marketing, Technology, Payments, Partnerships, and User Success, providing timely, practical, risk-based guidance on new products, features, campaigns, and business arrangements.

 - Own the regulatory advisory and interpretation function, resolving novel questions with clear written positions and a defensible rationale that stands up to regulatory and audit scrutiny.

 - Lead compliance review and sign-off of marketing materials, disclosures, and customer communications, and embed obligations into product development early.

 - Own the Whistleblower and Ethics programs, including intake, investigation oversight, non-retaliation, and ethics reporting to the Board.

REGULATORY COMPLIANCE MANAGEMENT

 - In collaboration with Legal, own the regulatory compliance management program: horizon scanning, impact assessment, and coordinated implementation of new and amended regulatory requirements.

 - Maintain KOHO’s regulatory obligations inventory and the mapping of obligations to responsible business owners, policies, and controls.

 - Lead the development, refresh, and governance of compliance policies, standards, and procedures, including annual approval cycles.

PRIVACY OFFICE (DEPUTY CHIEF PRIVACY OFFICER)

 - Own and mature KOHO’s enterprise privacy program, aligned to privacy legislation, and act as KOHO’s designated privacy lead.

 - Establish and run the Privacy Impact Assessment process for new products, vendors, data uses, and technology changes, and govern consent, collection, use, disclosure, retention, and cross-border transfer of personal information on a privacy-by-design basis.

 - Lead privacy incident and breach response, including containment coordination, real-risk-of-significant-harm assessments, regulatory and individual notification, and root cause remediation.

 - Own privacy complaints and access and correction requests, the data inventory and privacy notices, and privacy training and awareness across the organization.

TEAM LEADERSHIP AND INDUSTRY ENGAGEMENT

 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of compliance and privacy professionals, setting clear priorities and raising the technical bar of the function.

 - Partner closely with Financial Crime, Compliance Testing, Operational Risk, Internal Audit, Legal, and Tech/Cyber to ensure integrated coverage and no gaps between mandates.

 - Represent KOHO externally with industry associations, peer forums, and regulator outreach, staying ahead of emerging compliance, privacy, and conduct risk trends.

 - Prepare and present clear, decision-ready materials for senior management and applicable Board-level committees.

AI, AUTOMATION AND INNOVATION

 - Apply AI, automation, and data analytics to advisory intake, regulatory horizon scanning, marketing review, and privacy assessments.

 - Advise the business on the responsible use of AI, including model transparency, fairness, explainability, and personal information use.

 - Evaluate and implement RegTech and privacy technology that improves speed and consistency without diluting rigour.

 - You have deep working knowledge of Canadian consumer protection, retail banking or payments, and privacy legislation.

 - You have built or substantially matured a privacy program or regulatory change program, not just operated one someone else designed.

À PROPOS DU POSTE

Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne chevronnée pour diriger les services-conseils — le cœur de la fonction Conformité de KOHO — et prendre en charge l’ensemble de notre Bureau de la protection des renseignements personnels. Vous serez également responsable du programme de protection des renseignements personnels de KOHO, de bout en bout : évaluations des facteurs relatifs à la vie privée, conception des mécanismes de consentement, gestion des incidents et intervention en cas d’atteinte à la protection des renseignements personnels.

CE QUE VOUS FEREZ

SERVICES-CONSEILS EN CONFORMITÉ

 - Agir comme principale personne-conseil en conformité auprès des partenaires d’affaires, notamment les équipes Produits (prêts, services bancaires de base, croissance et intégration), Marketing, Technologie, Paiements, Partenariats et Expérience utilisateur, en fournissant des conseils rapides, pratiques et fondés sur les risques pour les nouveaux produits, les fonctionnalités, les campagnes et les ententes commerciales.

 - Être responsable des programmes de dénonciation et d’éthique, notamment la réception des signalements, la supervision des enquêtes, la protection contre les représailles et la présentation de rapports sur l’éthique au conseil d’administration.

GESTION DE LA CONFORMITÉ RÉGLEMENTAIRE

 - En collaboration avec le service juridique, être responsable du programme de gestion de la conformité réglementaire : veille réglementaire, évaluation des répercussions et mise en œuvre coordonnée des exigences nouvelles ou modifiées.

 - Tenir à jour l’inventaire des obligations réglementaires de KOHO et établir la correspondance entre ces obligations, les responsables d’affaires, les politiques et les contrôles en place.

 - Diriger l’élaboration, la mise à jour et la gouvernance des politiques, normes et procédures de conformité, y compris les cycles annuels d’approbation.

BUREAU DE LA PROTECTION DES RENSEIGNEMENTS PERSONNELS

Encadrer le consentement ainsi que la collecte, l’utilisation, la communication, la conservation et le transfert transfrontalier de renseignements personnels selon une approche de protection de la vie privée dès la conception.

 - Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Crimes financiers, Tests de conformité, Risques opérationnels, Audit interne, Affaires juridiques et Technologie/Cybersécurité afin d’assurer une couverture intégrée et d’éviter les angles morts entre les différents mandats.

INTELLIGENCE ARTIFICIELLE, AUTOMATISATION ET INNOVATION

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

 - Own KOHO’s enterprise complaints management program, including policy, procedures, escalation pathways, and service standards.

 - Oversee handling of escalated and designated complaints, ensuring fair, timely, well-reasoned outcomes and clear written responses to customers.

 - Manage case flow with the external complaints body and oversee reporting to the FCAC and other applicable authorities.

 - Deliver complaints reporting and root cause analysis, converting complaint themes into product, process, and disclosure improvements that advance fair treatment of customers.

COMPLIANCE TESTING

 - Own the design and delivery of KOHO’s independent Compliance Testing Program, including methodology, quality standards, and reporting.

 - Develop the annual risk-based testing plan, scoped and prioritized from the regulatory obligations inventory and known risk concentrations; Collaborate with Operational Risk Management (ORM) on the selection of compliance controls.

 - Maintain a quality assurance process over testing outputs, including work performed by co-source or business process outsourcing partners, and report results and thematic conclusions into senior management and/or Board-level reporting.

TEAM LEADERSHIP AND INDUSTRY ENGAGEMENT

 - Lead, coach, and develop a multi-disciplinary team across financial crime, testing, and complaints, building bench strength and clear career paths.

 - Partner with Compliance Advisory and Privacy, Operational Risk, Internal Audit, Legal, and FIU to ensure integrated risk oversight.

 - Represent KOHO externally in industry associations, peer forums, and financial crime intelligence networks, staying ahead of emerging typologies, fraud trends, and regulatory developments.

 - Prepare and present decision-ready reporting to senior management and applicable Board-level committees.

AI, AUTOMATION AND INNOVATION

 - Apply AI, machine learning, RPA, and advanced analytics to transaction monitoring tuning, alert triage, complaints classification, and compliance testing.

 - Lead the development of automated testing scripts, intelligent workflows, and advanced reporting to increase coverage.

 - Evaluate and implement emerging RegTech and financial crime technology, and maintain model governance and tuning documentation for detection systems.

WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 10+ years of experience across AML and financial crime, compliance testing or audit, regulatory relations, or complaints within financial services.

 - You have deep working knowledge of Canadian consumer protection, AML, retail banking or payments, and privacy legislation.

 - You have direct experience managing regulatory examinations or information requests, and you’re composed under that kind of scrutiny.

 - You bring rigour to evidence and documentation — you believe a control that cannot be demonstrated has not been performed — and you deliver unwelcome findings constructively.

 - You’ve worked in regulated fintech, neobank, or direct-to-consumer financial institutions, you’re passionate about empowering financial wellness, and a relevant designation (CAMS, CFE, CIA, CPA, CRCM, or equivalent) is an asset.

The budgeted salary range for this role is $190,000-230,000 CAD / year. 

At KOHO, we are dedicated to providing pay transparency to all candidates. Compensation at KOHO is determined through various factors including but not limited to: comparable salary market data within Canada, technical skill assessment, a holistic view of previous work history, and internal pay equity with other KOHO team members.

DESCRIPTION DE POSTE EN FRANÇAIS

À PROPOS DU POSTE

Nous sommes à la recherche d’une directrice ou d’un directeur chevronné pour diriger quatre piliers interconnectés de la fonction Conformité de KOHO : le Bureau de la criminalité financière, les relations avec les organismes de réglementation, la gestion des plaintes et les tests de conformité de deuxième ligne. Relevant de la cheffe ou du chef de la conformité, vous serez responsable de la façon dont KOHO détecte et perturbe les activités criminelles financières, interagit avec les organismes de réglementation, traite équitablement les plaintes des clients et vérifie de façon indépendante l’efficacité réelle de ses contrôles de conformité.

Il s’agit volontairement d’un mandat vaste : ce sont les domaines où les faits et les preuves sont les plus importants. Vous apporterez la rigueur, la qualité documentaire et la présence exécutive nécessaires pour démontrer l’efficacité de l’environnement de contrôle de KOHO, tout en gardant l’expérience client au cœur de vos décisions.

CE QUE VOUS FEREZ

BUREAU DE LA CRIMINALITÉ FINANCIÈRE

 - Diriger le programme de KOHO en matière de lutte contre le blanchiment d’argent et le financement des activités terroristes (LBA/FT), ainsi que de conformité aux sanctions, conformément à la Loi sur le recyclage des produits de la criminalité et le financement des activités terroristes (LRPCFAT) et à ses règlements. Être responsable de l’évaluation à l’échelle de l’entreprise des risques liés au blanchiment d’argent, au financement des activités terroristes et aux sanctions.

 - Superviser la surveillance des transactions, la gestion des alertes et des dossiers, les mesures de vigilance renforcées, le filtrage des sanctions et la déclaration des opérations douteuses, notamment la qualité et la ponctualité des déclarations réglementaires auprès du Centre d’analyse des opérations et déclarations financières du Canada (CANAFE).

 - Diriger les normes relatives à la connaissance du client (KYC) et à l’évaluation du niveau de risque des clients, et collaborer avec l’Unité du renseignement financier (URF) afin de combler les écarts entre la détection de la fraude et celle des activités criminelles financières.

 - Être responsable de l’examen biennal de l’efficacité du programme de LBA/FT, du suivi des mesures correctives qui en découlent et de la formation en matière de criminalité financière.

RELATIONS AVEC LES ORGANISMES DE RÉGLEMENTATION

 - Agir comme point de coordination central auprès des organismes de réglementation et être responsable de la fréquence, de la qualité et de la cohérence de la correspondance et des déclarations réglementaires de KOHO.

 - Diriger la gestion de bout en bout des examens réglementaires, des évaluations et des demandes de renseignements, notamment la planification, la collecte des éléments probants, le contrôle de la qualité des réponses et le suivi des enjeux.

 - Être responsable du registre des constats réglementaires et des engagements, et piloter les mesures correctives jusqu’à leur résolution confirmée.

 - Tenir à jour l’inventaire des déclarations réglementaires et le registre des interactions avec les organismes de réglementation, et préparer la direction ainsi que les spécialistes concernés aux rencontres réglementaires.

GESTION DES PLAINTES

 - Superviser le traitement des plaintes transmises à un niveau supérieur et des plaintes désignées, en veillant à ce que les décisions soient équitables, rendues en temps opportun et bien motivées, et que les réponses écrites aux clients soient claires.

 - Gérer le cheminement des dossiers auprès de l’organisme externe de traitement des plaintes et superviser les déclarations à l’Agence de la consommation en matière financière du Canada (ACFC) ainsi qu’aux autres autorités compétentes.

 - Produire les rapports sur les plaintes et les analyses des causes profondes, et transformer les tendances observées en améliorations aux produits, aux processus et aux communications, afin de favoriser un traitement équitable des clients.

TESTS DE CONFORMITÉ

 - Être responsable de la conception et de la réalisation du programme indépendant de tests de conformité de KOHO, notamment de la méthodologie, des normes de qualité et de la production de rapports.

 - Élaborer le plan annuel de tests fondé sur les risques, en établissant sa portée et ses priorités à partir de l’inventaire des obligations réglementaires et des concentrations de risques connues. Collaborer avec la gestion des risques opérationnels (GRO) à la sélection des contrôles de conformité.

 - Maintenir un processus d’assurance qualité pour les résultats des tests, y compris les travaux réalisés par des partenaires de co-impartition ou d’impartition de processus opérationnels, et présenter les résultats ainsi que les conclusions thématiques à la haute direction ou dans les rapports destinés au conseil d’administration.

LEADERSHIP D’ÉQUIPE ET RAYONNEMENT DANS LE SECTEUR

 - Diriger, accompagner et faire progresser une équipe multidisciplinaire en criminalité financière, en tests de conformité et en gestion des plaintes, en développant la relève et des parcours professionnels clairs.

 - Collaborer avec les équipes Services-conseils en conformité et Protection des renseignements personnels, Risques opérationnels, Audit interne, Affaires juridiques et URF afin d’assurer une surveillance intégrée des risques.

 - Préparer et présenter des rapports axés sur la prise de décision à la haute direction et aux comités pertinents du conseil d’administration.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Platform
jobs.description:
ABOUT KOHO

We’re on a mission to make financial services better for every Canadian. That means no hidden fees, no predatory interest rates - just financial products designed to help our users spend smart, save more, and build real wealth. We’re a performance organization with a strong heart: we care deeply about outcomes, and everything ties back to our mission - to financially empower a generation of Canadians.

At KOHO, we’re not your average 9-5. We believe real impact comes from people who are trusted, empowered, and supported to do their best work - without sacrificing their lives to do it. We prioritize work-life integration, not just work-life balance. That means asynchronous collaboration, flexible hours, and a remote-first setup built around autonomy and high trust.

KOHO is entering its next chapter - leaner, smarter, more AI-integrated. We’re building for impact, not bureaucracy. If you thrive in environments that value clarity, ownership, and bold thinking, you’ll fit right in.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ready to Shape the Platform Behind KOHO's Products? 🚀

As Engineering Manager, Platform, you'll lead a full-stack platform team that owns KOHO's mobile and web platform (how our mobile app gets released and our frontend developer tooling), internal tooling and the risk domain. This is a unique opportunity to lead a team that spans platform and feature development, building the foundations other teams rely on while supporting user-facing functionality such as login and access management.

This is a role for someone who thrives in high-impact technical environments, turns ambiguous requirements into concrete solutions, and builds high-performing teams.

You'll report directly to the Senior Manager, Platform Engineering, collaborate closely with peer platform and feature teams, and manage key stakeholders including Risk, Product, and Security. Your team will also share ownership of our authentication and authorization systems, working hand in hand with the team that leads that space.

YOUR MISSION 🎯

Make it fast, safe, and easy for KOHO to build and ship great products, on mobile, on the web, and behind the scenes.

 - Build and lead a high-performing platform team: Manage a team of full-stack engineers (employees and partner contractors), set clear expectations, create real career growth paths, and maintain a culture of ownership and continuous improvement

 - Own the Mobile and Web platform: Lead how our mobile app gets released, from build pipelines and release trains to app store submissions, phased rollouts, and feature flagging, and keep our web platform healthy and scalable

 - Raise frontend developer experience, with AI at the core: Invest in frontend tooling, shared components, CI/CD, testing, and AI-assisted workflows so engineers across KOHO can build, test, and release with confidence

 - Own internal tooling for the organization: Deliver and maintain the internal tools our operations, support, and business teams rely on, treating them as products with real users and clear quality bars

 - Own the risk domain: Lead your team's ownership of risk-related systems and experiences, partnering with Risk and Compliance stakeholders to balance user experience, operational efficiency, and regulatory expectations

 - Manage key vendors: Own relationships with third-party vendors in your domain, from evaluation and integration through performance, cost, contract renewals, and migrations when needed

 - Own stability & production health: Keep your team's systems reliable through strong observability, a healthy support rotation, effective incident response, and steady reduction of tech debt

 - Collaborate across the platform: Work closely with the authentication and authorization team on initiatives that touch the mobile and web experience, and translate Platform OKRs into a focused quarterly roadmap

WHAT YOU'LL BRING 💡

We're looking for someone who:

 - Has strong full-stack engineering roots: 5+ years building and operating production software across web or mobile frontends and backend services, with enough hands-on depth to review designs, unblock engineers, and make sound architectural calls

 - Is a proven people leader: 1-3 years managing an engineering team (3-6 people), with demonstrated success coaching engineers, managing performance, hiring, and building an inclusive, high-trust team culture

 - Owns production outcomes: A track record of owning critical customer-facing or business-critical systems, setting and holding quality and reliability bars, and leading the team calmly through incidents

 - Manages vendors effectively: Experience owning third-party vendor relationships, holding partners accountable to outcomes, and making clear build-versus-buy decisions

 - Thrives in ambiguity: You can take high-level business objectives, structure the problem, and turn it into an actionable plan when requirements are not clearly defined

 - Balances strategy with execution: You can shape a roadmap and improve team process, then dive deep to unblock a tricky implementation or production issue

 - Communicates with exceptional clarity: You explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, write clear docs, and build strong relationships with Product, Design, Risk, and peer engineering teams

WHAT SETS YOU APART 🌟

This role is best suited for someone who wants real growth - not just more tasks, but more scope, more impact, and more trust, and wants to make a real impact in the financial lives of Canadians.

 - You've owned mobile release and platform engineering: Experience with mobile CI/CD, release automation, app store processes, and frontend build tooling at consumer scale

 - You've built internal tools people love: You've delivered internal platforms or admin tooling that measurably improved how operations, support, or business teams work

 - You've worked in risk, identity, or auth domains: Experience in financial services, payments, fraud, identity verification, or authentication and authorization (e.g., OAuth/OIDC, SSO, MFA), where risk, security, and auditability shape product decisions. Nice-to-have: hands-on experience with vendors such as Onfido or Auth0

 - You're passionate about developer

experience:

You treat the platform as a product for internal engineers and invest in tooling, shared components, CI/CD, and self-service that make their lives better

 - You embrace AI-enabled workflows: You're excited about using AI to accelerate development, testing, and code review, and you help your team adopt it thoughtfully

 - You understand "you build it, you run it": You've built teams that own their systems end to end, from design through on-call, with strong observability and feature-flagged releases

The posted salary range for this role is $160,000 – $190,000 CAD / year.

At KOHO, we are dedicated to providing pay transparency to all candidates. Compensation at KOHO is determined through various factors including but not limited to: comparable salary market data within Canada, technical skill assessment, a holistic view of previous work history, and internal pay equity with other KOHO team members.

DESCRIPTION DE POSTE EN FRANÇAIS

À PROPOS DU POSTE

Prêt à façonner la plateforme derrière les produits de KOHO? 🚀

En tant que gestionnaire en ingénierie, Plateforme, vous dirigerez une équipe plateforme full-stack responsable de la plateforme mobile et Web de KOHO (la façon dont notre application mobile est publiée et nos outils de développement frontend), des outils internes et du domaine du risque. Il s'agit d'une occasion unique de diriger une équipe qui couvre à la fois la plateforme et le développement de fonctionnalités, en bâtissant les fondations sur lesquelles reposent les autres équipes tout en soutenant des fonctionnalités destinées aux utilisateurs, comme la connexion et la gestion des accès.

Ce poste s'adresse à une personne qui s'épanouit dans des environnements techniques à fort impact, qui transforme des exigences ambiguës en solutions concrètes et qui bâtit des équipes performantes.

Vous relèverez directement du gestionnaire principal, Ingénierie de plateforme, collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes plateforme et fonctionnalités homologues, et gérerez des parties prenantes clés, notamment les équipes Risque, Produit et Sécurité. Votre équipe partagera également la responsabilité de nos systèmes d'authentification et d'autorisation, en travaillant main dans la main avec l'équipe qui dirige ce domaine.

VOTRE MISSION 🎯

Permettre à KOHO de concevoir et de livrer d'excellents produits rapidement, en toute sécurité et facilement, sur mobile, sur le Web et en coulisses.

 - Bâtir et diriger une équipe plateforme performante : gérer une équipe d'ingénieurs full-stack (employés et contractuels partenaires), fixer des attentes claires, créer de véritables parcours de croissance et entretenir une culture de responsabilisation et d'amélioration continue

 - Prendre en charge la plateforme mobile et Web : diriger le processus de publication de notre application mobile, des pipelines de compilation et des cycles de publication jusqu'aux soumissions aux boutiques d'applications, aux déploiements progressifs et aux indicateurs de fonctionnalités, et maintenir notre plateforme Web saine et évolutive

 - Améliorer l'expérience des développeurs frontend, avec l'IA au cœur : investir dans les outils frontend, les composants partagés, l'intégration et le déploiement continus (CI/CD), les tests et les flux de travail assistés par l'IA afin que les ingénieurs de KOHO puissent concevoir, tester et publier en toute confiance

 - Prendre en charge les outils internes de l'organisation : livrer et maintenir les outils internes sur lesquels comptent nos équipes des opérations, du soutien et des affaires, en les traitant comme des produits ayant de vrais utilisateurs et des normes de qualité claires

 - Prendre en charge le domaine du risque : diriger la responsabilité de votre équipe à l'égard des systèmes et des expériences liés au risque, en partenariat avec les parties prenantes Risque et Conformité, afin d'équilibrer l'expérience utilisateur, l'efficacité opérationnelle et les attentes réglementaires

 - Gérer les fournisseurs clés : gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs tiers de votre domaine, de l'évaluation et l'intégration jusqu'au rendement, aux coûts, aux renouvellements de contrats et aux migrations au besoin

 - Assurer la stabilité et la santé de la production : maintenir la fiabilité des systèmes de votre équipe grâce à une observabilité solide, une rotation de soutien saine, une réponse efficace aux incidents et une réduction constante de la dette technique

 - Collaborer à l'échelle de la plateforme : travailler étroitement avec l'équipe d'authentification et d'autorisation sur les initiatives touchant l'expérience mobile et Web, et traduire les OKR de la plateforme en une feuille de route trimestrielle ciblée

CE QUE VOUS APPORTEREZ 💡

Nous recherchons une personne qui :

 - Possède de solides bases en ingénierie full-stack : plus de 5 ans d'expérience en conception et en exploitation de logiciels en production, couvrant des interfaces Web ou mobiles et des services backend, avec une profondeur technique suffisante pour réviser des conceptions, débloquer les ingénieurs et prendre des décisions architecturales judicieuses

 - Est un leader d'équipe éprouvé : de 1 à 3 ans d'expérience en gestion d'une équipe d'ingénierie (3 à 6 personnes), avec un succès démontré en encadrement d'ingénieurs, en gestion du rendement, en recrutement et en création d'une culture d'équipe inclusive et fondée sur la confiance

 - Assume la responsabilité des résultats en production : un historique de prise en charge de systèmes critiques pour la clientèle ou pour l'entreprise, d'établissement et de maintien de normes de qualité et de fiabilité, et de gestion calme de l'équipe lors d'incidents

 - Gère efficacement les fournisseurs : expérience dans la gestion des relations avec des fournisseurs tiers, la responsabilisation des partenaires quant aux résultats et la prise de décisions claires entre développer à l'interne ou acheter

 - S'épanouit dans l'ambiguïté : vous savez partir d'objectifs d'affaires généraux, structurer le problème et le transformer en plan d'action lorsque les exigences ne sont pas clairement définies

 - Équilibre stratégie et exécution : vous savez élaborer une feuille de route et améliorer les processus de l'équipe, puis plonger dans les détails pour débloquer une mise en œuvre complexe ou un problème en production

 - Communique avec une clarté exceptionnelle : vous expliquez les compromis techniques aux parties prenantes non techniques, rédigez une documentation claire et bâtissez des relations solides avec les équipes Produit, Design, Risque et d'ingénierie homologues

CE QUI VOUS DISTINGUE 🌟

Ce poste convient particulièrement à une personne qui recherche une véritable croissance – non seulement plus de tâches, mais plus de portée, plus d'impact et plus de confiance – et qui souhaite avoir un impact réel sur la vie financière des Canadiens.

 - Vous avez conçu des outils internes appréciés : vous avez livré des plateformes internes ou des outils d'administration qui ont amélioré de façon mesurable le travail des équipes des opérations, du soutien ou des affaires

jobs.description:
