jobs.title: Head of Risk US
jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Global Risk function at Nu is structured around two dimensions: country risk officers (horizontal) and global functional heads by risk discipline (vertical). This matrix creates a "risk surface" that allows the organization to scale efficiently without duplicating senior expertise across geographies.

The Head of Risk US will lead the US risk surface, owning all risk disciplines locally while maintaining close coordination with global functional heads: Global Credit Risk, the Global Market and Liquidity Head, and other risk domain leads.

The US risk team is in its early stages, with existing members covering Compliance, Financial Crime/AML, Regulatory, and is expected to grow in line with the business. This is a build-from-scratch opportunity for a senior executive who thrives in dynamic, high-growth environments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Head of Risk US is a senior executive responsible for the effective and independent oversight of all risk disciplines within Nu's US operation. 

The role requires a leader who understands the US regulatory landscape deeply, can engage independently with regulators and senior governance bodies, and is capable of building a high-performing risk function in a fast-moving fintech environment. 

This is a high-visibility, high-impact position that will interact frequently with the US Board/Risk Committee, senior regulators, and Nu's executive leadership team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND EXPECTATIONS

Risk Framework & Governance

 - Build and lead a comprehensive risk management framework for the US operation, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, financial crime, and compliance risk.

 - Develop a risk appetite framework and limit structure aligned with the US Board's stated risk tolerance, ensuring all business lines operate within defined parameters.

 - Establish robust risk metrics, reporting dashboards, and early warning indicators to monitor exposures and escalate material issues in a timely manner.

 - Serve as Secretary to the US Board Risk Management Committee; prepare and circulate agendas and minutes.

 - Participate as a permanent member of key senior management committees including the Risk Committee, ALCO, Compliance Committee, and New Product Approval Committee.

Regulatory Engagement

 - Serve as the primary independent risk voice in all interactions with US regulators, engaging with confidence and autonomy.

 - Ensure Nu's control environment consistently meets and anticipates regulatory expectations in a rapidly evolving US regulatory landscape.

 - Develop and maintain relationships with regulators, demonstrating transparency, preparedness, and a mature risk culture.

Risk Surface Management

 - Oversee the day-to-day management of the US risk surface, coordinating with global functional heads on credit, market/liquidity, operational, and financial crime risk.

 - Apply Nu's "target friction" philosophy: prioritize controls based on materiality, avoiding uniform friction in favor of risk-proportionate management that enables business growth.

 - Monitor operational loss events, cyber incidents, and key risk indicators, ensuring mitigation strategies are in place and effective.

Team & Stakeholder Leadership

 - Lead and develop the US risk team, fostering a culture of high standards, intellectual rigor, and ownership.

 - Build a strong working relationship with engineering and technology teams to ensure risk infrastructure is prioritized and developed appropriately.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with the US Country Manager, Legal, Compliance, and Finance to embed risk awareness across the organization.

 - Act as a business partner to the US leadership team — risk as an enabler, not a blocker.

QUALIFICATIONS

Professional Experience & Education

 - Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MSc Finance, JD) or professional certification (CFA, FRM) preferred.

 - 15+ years of experience in risk management within financial services, with a significant portion of that in the US market.

 - Deep expertise in the US regulatory environment (OCC, Fed, FDIC); experience engaging directly with regulators at a senior level is essential.

 - Background in financial institutions, fintechs, or challenger banks strongly preferred. Candidates with exclusive experience at large traditional banks (without demonstrated adaptability) may not be the right fit for this stage of growth.

 - Experience building or significantly transforming a risk function from an early/mid-stage into a mature framework.

 - Solid understanding of all risk disciplines: credit, market, liquidity, operational, financial crime, and compliance — with particular depth in the control environment (AML/BSA, operational risk, cyber).

 - Credit risk expertise is valued but not the primary focus; Nu's global credit function provides strong support in this area.

Competencies & Attributes

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a proven ability to build structure from scratch in fast-moving environments — "generating balance based on chaos."

 - Hands-on leader who is present on the ground and willing to be deeply involved in operational realities, not just strategic oversight.

 - Independent thought leader capable of engaging directly with boards and regulators without relying on hierarchical support for every interaction.

 - Strong stakeholder management skills, particularly with engineering/technology teams — able to translate risk requirements into development priorities and negotiate trade-offs effectively.

 - Risk philosophy aligned with Nu's approach: sees friction as a tool to be applied proportionally to materiality, not a default stance. Views risk as a business partner.

 - Highly adaptive: able to respond quickly to changes in the regulatory landscape and reprioritize accordingly.

 - Intellectually curious, data-driven, and committed to continuous learning.

WORK SETUP

Location

Miami, US
Washington, US

Work model

Expected: Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

 

OUR BENEFITS

 - Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

 - Medical Insurance

 - Dental and Vision Insurance

 - Life Insurance and AD&D

 - Extended maternity and paternity leaves

 - Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

 - NuLanguage - Our language learning program

 - NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

 - 401K Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

 - Work-from-home Allowance

 - Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here https://script.google.com/a/macros/nubank.com.br/s/AKfycbwvrewE58oGSbRWIVv8CyCWN68GLxpPVsfYYXv-ZHg94QFsTJmi82rF1x0yt-OTs2W0DQ/exec

As a Principal Product Designer, you are the senior-most design authority on the team. You are a visionary with the ability to execute swiftly, articulating solutions that don't just improve the status quo but redefine it. This is an IC9-level role, meaning you operate with exceptional autonomy to drive strategic change across multiple countries and functions.

You will be the guardian of our "purple" identity, responsible for defining 0-1 experiences and elevating the level of craftsmanship across our entire global product. From leading the next generation of our illustration system to architecting the core interaction patterns of our homepage, your work will set the technical and aesthetic foundations that millions of people interact with daily. You are a consultant to leadership, a mentor to the guild, and a pioneer of design excellence.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define the Vision: Lead the creation of 0-1 product experiences, setting a high bar for concept and quality that inspires the entire design organization.

 - Evolve the Visual Identity: Spearhead the global transition to our new illustration system. Define scalable guidelines that move us from current standards to a unified, global language.

 - Architect Core Interactions: Define the structural patterns and widgets for the Nu homepage. Deliver production-ready specifications that bridge the gap between high-level design and engineering execution.

 - Unify Global Design: Eliminate fragmentation across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. You will create a cohesive design language that feels like "one Nu" while intelligently allowing for local market flexibility.

 - Drive Strategic Roadmap: Act as an advisor to business leadership, translating organizational strategy into a tangible design roadmap and removing blocks to ensure a world-class user experience.

 - Mentor and Influence: Act as an ambassador for design craft. You will coach senior design leaders and foster a culture of open communication, empathy, and continuous improvement.

 - Proven Strategic Leadership: Ability to drive large-scale organizational transformations and influence enterprise-level strategy through design.

 - Architectural Thinking: Deep expertise in design systems, interaction patterns, and creating scalable frameworks for complex digital products.

 - Swift Execution: A "visionary who does"—the ability to quickly prototype and articulate high-fidelity solutions that solve complex, ambiguous business problems.

 - Exceptional Communication: Mastery in communicating complex design logic to executive stakeholders and mentoring other designers to improve their persuasive storytelling.

Nice to Have:

- Experience in pioneering AI-driven design tools or features.

 - Record of Processing Activities (RoPA) and personal data mapping;
 
 - Privacy and data protection risk management and controls;

 - Global data subject rights (DSR) strategy and processes;
 
 - Training, awareness and privacy metrics.

 - Design and implement projects to simplify and automate privacy governance wherever possible (e.g., templates, workflows, playbooks, self‑service tools), balancing regulatory expectations with business velocity.

Data Subject Rights, Transparency & US‑Focused Governance

 - Maintain and enhance how Nu handles data subject rights requests across geographies, with particular focus on US privacy rights (e.g., access, deletion, correction, portability, opt‑out mechanisms, sensitive data rules under state laws).

 - Partner with CS/Ops and engineering teams to scale DSR handling, ensuring consistent identity verification, response quality and SLA adherence without increasing operational headcount.

 - Support the design and continuous improvement of privacy notices, in‑product privacy UX and choice mechanisms for US users, ensuring alignment with global standards and local requirements.

Third‑Party & Data Sharing Governance

This covers fair lending and adverse action explainability, UDAAP, EFTA/Reg E authorization and liability, and emerging state AI and automated decision-making laws.

 - New initiatives and digital products: Serve as the front door for new U.S. initiatives. Spot issues early, and take the first position, looping in other legal collaborators.

experience:

Direct work on AI/ML governance, model risk, or automated decision-making, with familiarity with state AI laws and evolving federal guidance. Experience with agentic payments, open banking, or other new payment technology is a plus.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS:

Skills and Knowledge (What)

ABOUT THE ROLE

As AI Research Manager, you will own the operating health and execution of Nu's ML research agenda. This is a dedicated people-management role for a small, high-talent-density team of world-class researchers, partnering closely with senior technical leads who drive the scientific direction.
The team works on a portfolio of research bets on a one-to-four-quarter horizon. This work compounds into the production capabilities Nu will depend on. Current and upcoming bets include:

 - Next-generation nuFormer architectures: proprietary transformers that learn from raw transaction sequences and power key production credit decisions

 - Multitask and multi-target modeling: single models serving many high-impact prediction tasks at once

 - Training and inference efficiency: distillation, quantization, sparsity, and parallelism to run state-of-the-art models economically at our scale

 - Causal modeling and policy optimization: moving beyond prediction to the decisions and policies those predictions should drive

 - World models: open-ended models that reason about a customer's full financial life

 - Recommendation systems: extending the backbone to app events, engagement, and personalization signals

 - Embeddings and representation learning: semantic IDs, contrastive learning, and reusable representations used across the bank

 - Real-time and continual learning: low-latency inference and models that adapt over time

Your job is to make exceptional science happen: build the conditions, focus, and operating rhythm that researchers do great work.
Location: Palo Alto, US

YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

PEOPLE & TEAM LEADERSHIP

 - Lead, mentor, and advocate for a team of world-class ML researchers, fostering an environment of psychological safety, high ambition, and rigorous scientific inquiry.

 - Own the operating health of the team, including performance, career growth, hiring, and compensation cycles for elite individual contributors who often operate at staff-and-above technical depth.

 - Attract and retain top-tier research talent in a competitive market, and build a reputation for the team as a place the best researchers want to be.

RESEARCH OPERATIONS & EXECUTION

 - Own the operating cadence of a portfolio of two-to-three concurrent, quarter-scale research bets, from problem framing and OKRs through progress tracking and clear go/no-go decisions.

 - Allocate scarce, high-value resources, most notably GPU capacity, across competing research priorities, balancing exploration against the bets most likely to compound.

 - Protect deep-focus research time. Sustaining a long-term agenda in a fast-moving company means deliberately creating the space for rigorous, multi-quarter work, so the team can pursue ambitious bets instead of being fully absorbed by short-term applied demands.

 - Raise the bar on research rigor and communication: strong experimental design, peer review, and reproducibility.

 - Cultivate the team's standing in the broader research community. Real-world impact is our primary measure of success, but we actively encourage publishing, open-source contribution, and conference presence that build a reputation reflecting the quality of the work and help attract the best researchers.

STRATEGY & CROSS-TEAM COLLABORATION

 - Partner closely with senior technical leads who drive architecture and scientific direction, aligning operational execution with the long-term research roadmap so that scientific and operating decisions reinforce each other.

 - Ensure clean handoffs from research into production, so breakthrough results land reproducibly in the hands of applied teams rather than stalling as one-off experiments.

 - Translate complex, frontier technical progress (training efficiency, causal inference, novel architectures) into clear, high-impact narratives for executive leadership, connecting research milestones to business outcomes.

 - Bridge foundational research and long-term business strategy, ensuring the team's technical inputs directly enable Nu's AI-first direction.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS

You are an experienced research or engineering manager working at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and Applied ML. You lead brilliant, highly autonomous researchers without micromanaging, and you know what it takes to sustain an ambitious, long-horizon research agenda inside a fast-moving company. You measure your success by what your team ships and discovers, not by your own keystrokes.

Experience:

3+ years of direct people-management experience leading applied AI research or core machine learning teams at big tech companies, frontier labs, or comparable high-scale environments.

WHY THIS ROLE

This is a rare chance to lead frontier AI research with a clear, compounding mission: building the intelligence layer of one of the world's largest digital banks. ABOUT NU

About the Role

Nubank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. 
This is a senior individual-contributor role with organizational-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution.

The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands-on experience in the domain produces. 
Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Defining, communicating, and executing a multi-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions.

 - Lead organization-wide authentication migrations that span heterogeneous surfaces — browser, operating system login, CLI tooling, and API-level integrations — across thousands of employees, multiple device ecosystems, and distributed work environments, producing measurable outcomes: authentication success rates above 99%, material reductions in per-authentication time, support exception rates below 1%, and return on investment within weeks of enforcement.

 - Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service-to-service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows.

 - Translating least-privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization-wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time.

 - Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits.

 - Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence.

 - Designing and facilitating large-scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement.

 - Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization.

 - Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control.

 

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS

 Must-have

 - Solid professional experience in security engineering, with a concentration in identity, authentication, or access management.

 - Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-year security programs from conception through measurable outcome — including programs that required navigating organizational obstacles, technical constraints, or material mid-course corrections.

 - Expert-level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).

 - Proficiency in software engineering: ability to produce, review, and reason about production-quality code in at least one general-purpose programming language.

 - Demonstrated ability to model identity-related threat scenarios, assess attacker techniques relevant to the IAM surface, and design controls that remain effective under adversarial conditions.

 - A demonstrable commitment to security as an organizational capability that enables business outcomes: a track record of solving real security problems, a disposition to challenge inherited security assumptions, and a clear pattern of distinguishing genuine risk reduction from security theater or responsibility transfer.

 - Experience communicating technical risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior non-technical stakeholders, including executives and regulators.

Nice-to-have

 - Experience operating within a financial services institution or similarly regulated environment subject to multiple concurrent regulatory frameworks.

 - Hands-on experience administering or integrating with an enterprise Identity Provider at scale, particularly Okta, or Keycloak.

 - Experience designing and enforcing security controls for third-party, BPO, or partner environments without direct operational control of the partner's infrastructure.

 - Experience leading organizational adoption of Zero Trust architecture, including authentication and authorization mechanisms for hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

 - Contributions to the broader security community — published research, conference presentations, open-source tooling, or participation in standards bodies.

jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE TEAM

At Nubank, Compliance is a strategic partner—not a tollgate. We view effective Risk Management & Compliance as the engine that maintains agility and empowers rapid, responsible growth across multiple global markets. Our team partners directly with internal clients using a targeted friction approach: we focus on the most relevant regulatory risks and embed compliance directly into product design rather than distributing rules after the fact.

The Global Compliance function serves as the Second Line of Defense, responsible for the full regulatory lifecycle: tracking new regulations, advising product and technology teams, testing controls, coordinating regulatory inspections, and monitoring remediation of regulatory issues.

This role is positioned at a pivotal moment. Nubank has received conditional approval for a US National Bank Charter. Should the charter be approved, this person will help build and operationalize the compliance and Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) infrastructure for a de novo national bank. In the near term, the role focuses on charter readiness—including supporting the development of the organizing bank's proposed CRA strategy—and on strengthening Nubank's consumer compliance posture under its current US operating model. The role requires someone who can build from scratch, own outcomes, and operate with an entrepreneurial mindset in a highly regulated environment.

JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking an experienced Compliance Analyst with dedicated compliance, risk, or audit experience at a regulated US financial institution or bank. This role carries primary ownership of Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) support and consumer protection compliance across Nubank's US deposit and unsecured lending products (personal loans and credit cards).

The CRA dimension of this role is central. Working within the Second Line of Defense, this person supports the oversight of CRA program execution and engages directly with community stakeholders to help assess local credit and community development needs. In the near term, and as part of charter readiness, this person will help drive the development of the proposed CRA Strategic Plan for the organizing bank.

This person reports to the Head of US Compliance, who is expected to serve as the bank's CRA Officer upon charter approval. The role provides direct support to that function.

The ideal candidate independently interprets and applies complex regulatory frameworks, translates regulatory requirements for cross-functional and business audiences, and develops proactive strategies to mitigate compliance risk. This person does not wait for direction—they identify issues, propose solutions, and drive them to completion.

Please note: This is a consumer compliance and CRA role. It is not a BSA/AML role. While a general awareness of the broader regulatory environment is useful, this position does not focus on anti-money laundering, sanctions, or financial crimes compliance. Candidates whose primary experience is in BSA/AML should review the focus areas below carefully before applying.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Community Reinvestment Act (CRA)

 - Support the development of the proposed CRA Strategic Plan for the organizing bank as part of charter readiness, including helping define assessment areas, measurable performance goals, and community development objectives appropriate to a digital banking model.

 - Engage directly with community organizations, nonprofits, local stakeholders, and community development practitioners to assess local credit and community development needs, and document those needs to inform the bank's CRA strategy.

 - Support the Second Line oversight of CRA program execution, including monitoring and providing effective challenge to the First Line on the adequacy of CRA-related activities, controls, and documentation.

 - Support the public engagement and comment process associated with the CRA Strategic Plan, should the bank pursue the strategic plan evaluation option.

 - Establish and maintain CRA records, data, and documentation to support performance evaluation readiness and examination preparedness.

 - Monitor CRA-related regulatory developments and supervisory expectations, and advise on implications for the bank's strategy and operations.

Compliance Advisory

 - Independently advise business partners on new product initiatives, marketing campaigns, servicing processes, and system implementations to identify and mitigate compliance risk before deployment.

 - Provide effective challenge to the First Line of Defense (Business Operations, Marketing, Product) on the design and adequacy of compliance controls, policies, and procedures.

 - Interpret and apply federal and state consumer protection laws to diverse and complex business scenarios, offering actionable compliance solutions—not just risk flags.

 - Assess the compliance and regulatory impact of internal operational events, audit findings, and external regulatory changes; develop and drive remediation plans in coordination with the First and Third Lines of Defense.

 - Translate complex regulatory requirements into plain-language guidance for cross-functional teams, business leadership, and where applicable, external stakeholders (e.g., partner banks, regulators).

 - Monitor emerging consumer banking trends, proposed rulemaking, and enforcement actions to proactively identify risks and advise the business on implications.

Charter Readiness & Compliance Infrastructure

 - Support the build-out of compliance and CRA infrastructure appropriate for a de novo national bank under OCC supervision, including policies, procedures, monitoring, testing, training, and recordkeeping. Activities are conducted in preparation for potential operations as a national bank, subject to charter approval.

 - Identify gaps in current compliance processes that would require enhancement or replacement under direct charter operations.

 - Conduct and contribute to compliance gap analyses comparing current processes, policies, and controls against OCC supervisory expectations for a de novo national bank; support the development of remediation roadmaps to close identified gaps.

 - Partner with Legal, Risk, and Operations to support readiness for potential OCC examinations and supervisory expectations, as well as potential examinations or inquiries from other regulators (e.g., CFPB, state regulators).

 - Execute compliance activities in alignment with Nubank's Global Compliance standards, frameworks, and methodologies, adapting them as needed for US regulatory requirements.

Mentoring & Knowledge Sharing

 - Mentor junior compliance team members and cross-functional partners on evolving regulatory landscapes, sharing insights and best practices.

 - Create and maintain compliance training materials, reference guides, and knowledge-base documentation to build institutional regulatory knowledge.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

REQUIRED

 - Dedicated compliance, risk, or audit experience within a US financial institution or bank.

 - Direct working experience with the Community Reinvestment Act (CRA), including familiarity with assessment area definition, community development activities, performance evaluation, recordkeeping, and—ideally—the CRA strategic plan option.

 - Experience engaging with community organizations, community development practitioners, or local stakeholders to identify and respond to community credit needs.

 - Bachelor's degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or a related field.

 - Deep working knowledge of US consumer compliance regulations, including ECOA/Reg B, TILA/Reg Z, UDAAP (Section 5 FTC Act / Dodd-Frank §1031), and EFTA/Reg E. Familiarity with FCRA/Reg V, GLBA/Reg P, and broader US banking regulations is a plus.

 - Demonstrated ability to independently interpret regulatory requirements and apply them to complex, ambiguous business scenarios—not just follow established playbooks.

 - Experience providing compliance advisory to product, technology, or business teams in a fast-paced environment.

 - Track record of building or materially improving compliance processes, controls, or monitoring programs (not just operating within existing ones).

 - Strong judgment, integrity, and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential matters.

 - Ability to communicate complex regulatory topics clearly to non-compliance audiences.

 - Comfort operating with a high level of autonomy while knowing when to escalate.

Preferred

 - Experience with Fair Lending compliance, including ECOA/Reg B monitoring, fair lending risk assessments, or disparate impact / disparate treatment analysis.

 - Experience with consumer complaints oversight, including complaint program design, root cause analysis, and trend reporting.

 - Experience with compliance testing, monitoring, or quality assurance for deposit, credit card, or personal loan products.

 - Experience at a de novo bank, BaaS arrangement, or fintech-bank partnership where compliance or CRA infrastructure was being built or materially enhanced.

 - Familiarity with OCC supervisory expectations, examination processes, and heightened standards for de novo institutions.

 - Understanding of how banking technology, automated decisioning, and data practices intersect with consumer protection requirements.

Senior Design Manager, AI Private Banker

About the AI Private Banker

The AI Private Banker is Nu's intelligent financial partner - an AI-powered advisor that helps millions of customers understand their finances, make confident decisions, and take action seamlessly. It is built on Nu's proprietary foundation models and data infrastructure, developed by the AI Core team that joined Nu through the Hyperplane acquisition. This is not a chatbot bolted onto a banking app. It is a fundamental reimagining of how people relate to their money, powered by conversational AI, recommendation engines, and real-time personalization across mobile and web.

The AI Private Banker represents Nu's next chapter and one of the company's highest-priority strategic bets. It sits at the intersection of banking and frontier AI, and every design decision here directly shapes how millions of people experience financial guidance.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Design Manager (M4) to lead the design organization for the AI Private Banker team in Palo Alto.

As Sr Design Manager, you will lead a multidisciplinary team of product designers and content designers (6+) crafting the AI Private Banker experience - shaping how customers interact with our AI advisor, how trust is earned, and how complex insights become simple, actionable, and human.

But you are no longer just building for the AI Private Banker vertical. You are establishing the foundational experience systems that will power AI across all of Nu, while ensuring alignment with the broader Magic App vision (Nu's next-generation unified app experience). In this context, you will help define the design vision, systems, cultural anchors, and rituals that make this product feel unmistakably Nu: clear, kind, and empowering - bridging product-specific excellence with company-wide coherence.

You will partner closely with Rohan Ramanath (GM, AI Core) and the broader product, data science, and engineering leadership to translate AI capabilities into trusted, explainable human experiences. This is a high-visibility role with senior stakeholder exposure across the US and Brazil, requiring someone who can navigate ambiguity, align teams across borders and time zones, and find structure in an emerging space.

What You'll Do

jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ensure Nubank’s sustainable growth by maintaining rigorous compliance with financial secrecy regulations and authority requirements in Mexico. In this role, you will be a key operator within our Judicial Orders & Regulatory Attention team, acting as the primary bridge for official communications from the CNBV (Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores), fiscal, administrative, and judicial authorities.

You will play a pivotal role in managing end-to-end operational workflows via the SITI AA portal, ensuring 100% compliance with statutory deadlines for information requests, account freezing/unfreezing (aseguramiento y desbloqueo de cuentas), fund transfers, and the enforcement of the Blocked Person List (Lista de Personas Bloqueadas).

YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - SITI AA Management: Daily monitoring, control, and end-to-end execution of digital requirements received through CNBV’s SITI AA portal (Atención a Autoridades), ensuring zero regulatory gaps or SLA breaches.

 - Authority Enquiries & Judicial Orders: Analyzing, processing, and responding to official subpoenas, information requests, and documentation requirements from CNBV, SAT, FGR, and competent judicial/administrative authorities.

 - Account Asset Orders: Executing regulatory actions regarding account freezing (aseguramiento), unfreezing (desbloqueo), and asset transfers in accordance with Mexican banking laws and CNBV mandates.

 - Blocked Person List (LPB): Actively supporting operational routines and monitoring workflows related to Mexico’s Lista de Personas Bloqueadas (LPB), ensuring immediate compliance upon update releases.

 - Regulatory Governance & SLA Control: Managing operational queues, tracking SLAs, and updating BI dashboards (Looker/Sheets) to guarantee timely execution and full auditability of all authority requests.

 - Continuous Process Improvement: Partnering with Legal, Compliance, and Tech teams to automate SITI AA routines, refine operational controls, and adapt workflows to regulatory updates (CNBV / SOFIPO framework).

 - Audit & Archiving Readiness: Documenting decisions, responses, and execution proofs to maintain traceable audit trails for regulatory inspections and internal reviews.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Direct Experience with SITI AA: Proven hands-on experience managing and executing requirements via CNBV’s SITI AA system in the Mexican financial sector (Banking, SOFIPOs, or Fintechs).

 - Regulatory Knowledge: Solid understanding of financial secrecy laws (secreto bancario/financiero), CNBV regulations, and legal procedures for judicial orders and account freezing/unfreezing.

 - Analytical & Detail-Oriented Mindset: Exceptional precision in handling sensitive customer data, legal documents, and official authority templates under tight, non-negotiable regulatory deadlines.

 - Process Discipline: Comfort with high-volume operational workflows, maintaining high accuracy and compliance even within bureaucratic and structured regulatory frameworks.

 - Data & BI Literacy: Familiarity with queue management and data visualization tools (Excel, Google Sheets, Looker) to monitor performance and tracking metrics.

 - Communication

Skills:

Strong written and verbal communication skills in Spanish (required for official authority responses) and English/Portuguese (for internal stakeholders).

NICE TO HAVE

 - Degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or related fields.

 - Prior experience in Compliance, AML/PLD, or Regulatory Legal Operations within a regulated financial institution.

Mission

Design and operationalize the foundational technical strategy for Product Workflow Reinvention so that:

Core Responsibilities

 - Lead the architecture of the orchestration layer: Own the end-to-end architecture of the single system of record, including data models, work legibility, and spec delivery to domain agents.

 - Design AI-native platform primitives: Build new platform abstractions from scratch, applying deep backend expertise to workflows, state management, event orchestration, and agent integrations.

 - Make agents reliable and affordable: Design agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, and integration patterns that turn frontier models into practical velocity multipliers. Own the cost side of that equation through context design, model selection, and knowing when a deterministic component beats an inference call.

 - Ship the first-generation workflow tools: Build and iterate on the internal products that remove the slowest steps in the life cycle, from research and requirements generation to technical discovery, design-to-code experimentation, self-serve customer data, service health, and ops automation. Proven track record designing, building, and operating complex backend or platform systems at scale.

 - 0-to-1 Platform Delivery: Experience leading ambiguous platform initiatives from early discovery to launch and rapid iteration. Comfort operating in small, fast-moving environments by creatively combining APIs, open-source tools, and AI models rather than over-engineering.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Community-Led Growth Senior Specialist, you'll build acquisition inside communities Nu doesn't own — WhatsApp and Telegram groups, Reddit threads, diaspora forums — where access is earned, not bought, and where most channels have no native attribution. Once inside these spaces, you'll turn community and cultural insight into content, channel activation, and outreach that drives acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and referral — always through organic, test-and-learn methods.

You will work as the marketing counterpart to a Growth Product Manager. You own community strategy, native content, and channel activation, particularly in social and other hard-to-track spaces where the audience already lives.

jobs.title: Head of Design, Digital Assets
jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

HEAD OF DESIGN (HANDS-ON), DIGITAL ASSETS

We are building open money and open financial services — not "crypto."

The Digital Assets team at Nu is reimagining how a financial services platform can use blockchain technology to solve real problems for real people — without ever making customers think about the blockchain at all. We have deliberately renamed ourselves from Crypto to Digital Assets, and we have effectively banned the word "crypto" internally. We do not do crypto for crypto's sake. We do blockchain banking.

The reference point is Apple Pay. It runs on cryptography, public and private keys, and secure tokenization inside a secure enclave. Apple never says any of that. It says "on device," and "it just works." That is the standard for everything we ship.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on design leader to join the Digital Assets team in Palo Alto. You will be the lead design voice for a genuinely new category: making digital assets — Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and stablecoins — as simple, accessible, and trusted as a debit card swipe.

This role sits at the intersection of consumer product design, financial innovation, and zero-to-one invention. Much of what you will design has never existed in consumer form before. You will not be asked to study what the incumbents did; the explicit instruction is to carve a new path.

WHAT YOU WILL DESIGN

 - The buy, hold, and sell experience for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Digital Dollars, etc. — designed to feel intuitive, familiar, and clear from the first interaction.

 - Earning, also known as staking: an experience that lets customers put eligible digital assets to work and earn rewards with clarity, control, and trust — without exposing the protocol mechanics underneath.

 - Onchain transfers and payments: sending, receiving, and using digital assets in ways that feel as simple and dependable as moving money today, while the underlying blockchain complexity stays out of the customer’s way.

 - The invisible infrastructure layer that powers core functionality across the entire company, including the US build.

 - Both the customer experience and the platform that other teams will draw on for future launches.

 - New ways for people to own, move, use, and grow value across financial products and borders — shaping a flexible foundation for what open money can become without being constrained by today’s conventions.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - Consumer instincts over crypto fluency. Deep domain experience in crypto is not the point here — and can even work against you. If your instinct is to explain custody models or gas fees to a customer, this is not the seat.

 - Mobile expertise is a must-have. There is no desktop app in Brazil; effectively no web. Strong recent mobile work is non-negotiable, and a primarily B2B or enterprise background is a hard fit.

 - Zero-to-one experience. You have designed products that did not exist before, where there were no references to copy, and you thrived in the ambiguity.

 - A product marketing mindset. You care about the words, the positioning, and how it feels — not just the design elements. Our touchstone is "a thousand songs in your pocket," decided before the product was designed.

 - The ability to hide complexity. You have made something complicated feel obvious and delightful. Products that resonate with us: Cash App, Apple, the Tesla app, Duolingo, Wise, Revolut.

 - Fintech experience is a plus, never a requirement. We will teach you the compliance, legal, and regulatory ropes. What we cannot teach is the instinct to dream a magical experience first.

 - A short line to the business. The design team reports directly to the GM of the business unit. For a senior designer, that means unusual room to shape strategy rather than receive it.

HOW WE WORK

 - Dream first. The hiring manager's framing is: "Dream the magical experience first. We'll tell you afterwards what's not allowed."

 - No desktop-first. Everything is mobile-first, consumer-first.

 - No copy-and-paste. No copying from Coinbase or Robinhood. We are deliberately different.

 - The US is part of the trajectory. You will be shaping work that serves the next phase of global growth.

THE TEAM

You will report directly to Michael Rihani, GM of the Digital Assets business unit. Michael is a product leader with close to twenty years of experience, including four years at Apple on Apple Pay, leading Bitcoin and consumer financial services at Cash App and Coinbase, and directing Supercharging UX and Bitcoin payments at Tesla. He believes the biggest thing the industry is missing is storytellers and design people who can make the technology disappear.

INTERVIEW PROCESS
1. Portfolio review with Ethan Eismann (CDO, Nu) — asynchronous
2. Live portfolio presentation with 2-3 design leaders and/or senior designers (~1 hour)
3. Hiring manager interview with Michael Rihani
4. Possible additional interviews. This interview process is subject to change, and may evolve with the hiring process. We appreciate your flexibility.

ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Senior Media Specialist - Marketing (US), you will drive Nu's paid media strategy in the US, translating business goals into full-funnel media plans across digital and offline channels, and helping build the measurement infrastructure needed to prove what's working. This role exists to help Nu grow efficiently and profitably in a market that's still early — you'll be one of the first people building the paid media engine for the US from the ground up, working independently to stand up the building blocks that don't yet exist.

You will propose, build, implement, optimize, and measure paid media campaigns end to end, operating in a test-and-learn model to find the most efficient paths to reach and convert audiences — with particular focus on the mass affluent target, reaching them in the key demographic and geographic areas aligned to Nu's product offerings, from national brand campaigns down to regional, state, and city-level activation.

This role also works closely with Business Analytics, Finance, and other marketing teams to build the first paid media measurement models for the US, translating spend into credible ROI and ROAS reporting that can hold up under scrutiny.

Key responsibilities and Expectations

 - Propose, build, implement, optimize, and measure paid media strategies across digital and offline channels (search, social, programmatic, video, CTV/OOH, direct mail, and others), matched to the right objective and funnel stage.

 - Set up the foundational building blocks for US paid media: platform accounts, tracking, tagging, and reporting infrastructure, working self-directed since much of this doesn't yet exist.

 - Run a disciplined test-and-learn model: design experiments across channel, audience, and creative to find efficient paths to growth, and scale what works.

 - Target and reach the mass affluent audience with precision: focus spend on the demographic and geographic areas that align to Nu's product offerings, balancing reach with efficiency.

 - Partner with Business Analytics and Finance to build the first paid media measurement models for the US: contribute to ROI/ROAS frameworks, incrementality approaches, and reporting that connects media spend to business outcomes.

 - Translate business goals into media strategy: work with brand, growth, and other marketing teams to turn objectives (awareness, acquisition, specific product goals) into channel plans and budget allocation.

 - Manage external media and creative agencies, and work directly with media platforms (Google, Meta, TikTok, and others) for platform best practices, beta access, and troubleshooting.

 - Bring a strong media point of view, grounded in external benchmarks and references where Nu's own US data doesn't yet exist: partner with marketing, product, and finance stakeholders to shape the US paid media approach, and represent that point of view clearly across teams.

Qualifications

 -

Experience:

6–9 years in paid media or performance marketing, including hands-on ownership of multi-channel campaigns across national and regional/local levels.

 - Industry

Experience:

Background in tech, e-commerce, mobile app, or financial services is a strong plus — particularly experience with mobile app install/conversion campaigns and mobile measurement (SDKs, MMPs such as AppsFlyer or Adjust), given Nu's app-first product.

 - Technical Expertise: Deep hands-on experience across digital platforms (Google, Meta, TikTok, programmatic/DSPs, and others) and offline channels (TV, OOH, direct mail, radio), with fluency in ROI, ROAS, CPA, and other core media and marketing metrics.

 - Mindset: Highly detail-oriented, disciplined, and rigorous in campaign execution and reporting; self-directed and independent, comfortable building measurement and infrastructure from scratch, and runs a test-and-learn cadence rather than waiting for perfect data.

 - Agency & Platform Management: Proven experience managing external media and creative agencies, plus direct working relationships with media platforms themselves, including scoping, performance accountability, and budget oversight.

 - Market Knowledge: Experience planning and executing media at national, regional, and state/city levels in the US, with the ability to identify and prioritize the geographic and demographic areas that best align to a mass affluent target, and to bring outside benchmarks to fill data gaps.

 - Communication: Strong influence skills; able to represent the media point of view to marketing, finance, and analytics stakeholders as a senior individual contributor.

 - Languages: Fluent or native English required. Portuguese and/or Spanish preferred.

Core Skills

 - Strategic Acumen: Links near-term paid media bets to Nu's broader US growth strategy, and helps stakeholders see that connection too.

 - Analytical Ability: Analyzes performance and spend data with rigor and little oversight; turns it into recommendations that hold up when Finance or Business Analytics pushes back.

 - Stakeholder Relationship & Management: Builds and sustains trust with Business Analytics, Finance, and other marketing teams independently; manages conflicting priorities between paid media bets and broader marketing plans without escalating every time.

 - Marketing Knowledge & Channel Influence: Synthesizes performance data and market insight into media objectives, and advocates for budget or channel shifts where the data warrants it.

 - Customer & Audience Insight: Acts as a primary advocate for precise, well-targeted audience strategy in cross-functional discussions; translates data and market signal into concrete channel, budget, and creative decisions.

 - AI Fluency: Uses AI tools to improve targeting, creative testing, or media efficiency; evaluates AI initiatives on ROI, effort, and risk rather than adopting tools for their own sake.

 

WORK SETUP 

Miami, US

Work model

[Hybrid / On-Site] 

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 

OUR BENEFITS 

 - Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

 - Medical Insurance

 - Dental and Vision Insurance

 - Life Insurance and AD&D

 - Extended maternity and paternity leaves

 - Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

 - NuLanguage - Our language learning program

 - NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

 - 401K

 - Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

At Nubank, software engineers sit at the intersection of data, intelligence, and scale. We build systems that process millions of decisions daily, from fraud detection to credit modeling and increasingly, we do this powered by AI. Machine learning is embedded across our core products: in how we assess risk, personalize experiences, and automate decisions at scale. Engineers here don't just consume AI capabilities; they help shape how intelligence is built, deployed, and maintained in production.

We do it with engineering rigor, autonomy, and a deep focus on impact. Our engineers work across the full spectrum: designing data pipelines and architectures, deploying and maintaining ML models in production, and building the distributed systems and platforms that power our products. We value small, independent teams that move fast, own their decisions end-to-end, and hold themselves to a high bar for quality and craft.

We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices across our entire stack. While we value candidates familiar with our technologies, we're confident that engineers who join Nubank will learn and grow alongside our team:

 - Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, leveraging functional programming and hexagonal architecture

ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

Location: U.S./Canada East Coast, including New York City, or Brazil (Eastern timezone for Europe-compatibility)

---

THE ROLE

We're launching a brand-new global account into dozens of markets at once — multi-currency holdings, yield, diversification across digital assets, and a suite of debit cards, built for people whose work and family span borders. The infrastructure underneath is powered by stablecoins and open financial services, but that complexity is fully abstracted. What the customer feels is a delightful, magical consumer product — as simple and effortless as anything Apple makes.

This is the project where every new thing at Nu lands first: the Magic App, the next evolution of the design system, new components and patterns. You'd have unusual room to experiment, iterate, and push the system forward rather than just consume it. The benchmark isn't the domestic market — it's global leaders like Revolut and Wise, and we're building to raise the bar past them.

As Head of Design for this initiative, you'll own the design function for the entire project. This is a player-coach role: you'll manage a team, but you'll also stay deeply in the craft — prototyping, refining, and setting the standard by doing, not just by directing. We need someone whose work itself is the bar.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Lead the design function for Nu's most ambitious global expansion — a multi-currency account allowing transfers to 35+ countries.

* Set and hold the craft bar at a global standard, benchmarking against the best fintech products in the world (Revolut, Wise, and beyond).

* Stay hands-on. You manage people, but you're also in the work — shipping design, prototyping, and elevating every surface and interaction.

* Push the design system forward. This product is the proving ground for new components and patterns that flow back into Nu's global design system. You don't just use the system; you evolve it.

* Navigate the balance between creative freedom and organizational maturity — earning autonomy by influencing and persuading the central design organization, contributing patterns back to the system, and building bridges rather than working in isolation.

* Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and the broader design organization to ship experiences that feel magical and effortless to customers across China, Italy, Spain, and dozens of other markets.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

* Craft first. Extreme attention to detail and a portfolio that demonstrates world-class product design — the kind of work that stands out against Revolut, Wise, or Apple.

* A hands-on manager. You've led teams, but you still design. You set the bar by doing, not just by directing.

* Fintech-adjacent domain experience. You've worked in or around financial products — payments, cards, banking, digital assets, consumer finance. If you come from outside finance, you should have extraordinary craft and a track record of making complex products feel dead simple.

* A system-level collaborator. You know how to operate within a mature design organization — influencing the global system, contributing patterns, and partnering with central teams rather than working around them.

* A bar-raiser. You're not satisfied with "good enough." You push your team and yourself to the next level, especially when competing against the best in the world.

ABOUT THE PRODUCT

A global account designed for people with cross-border lives — those who work across markets, have family in different countries, or need to move money internationally with ease. It offers multi-currency holdings, yield, diversification across digital assets, and a set of debit cards. The underlying technology is powered by stablecoins and open financial services, but that's invisible to the user. What they experience is a consumer product that feels as simple and delightful as anything Apple makes.

The product is launching nonlinearly into 35+ countries simultaneously — customers in China, Italy, Spain, and beyond. This is Nu's most ambitious global expansion to date, and the design bar must match the ambition.

INTERVIEW PROCESS
1. Async portfolio review with Ethan Eismann (CDO).
2. Live portfolio presentation (1 hour) — walkthrough of your best work with the design leadership team.
3. Hiring manager interview (45 min) with Thomaz Fortes and Thais Burin.
4. Final conversation with Ethan if needed.

---

HIRING MANAGERS: THOMAZ FORTES https://www.linkedin.com/in/thomaz-lysakowski-fortes/ & THAIS BURIN https://www.linkedin.com/in/thaisburin/ · CDO: ETHAN EISMANN https://www.linkedin.com/in/ethaneismann/

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

Every Nubank office runs on an IT Room that most people never see. Power distribution, cooling, structured cabling and fiber are the layer that keeps thousands of Nubankers connected and working — and when that layer fails, entire sites stop.

Nubank's office portfolio is growing across countries, and today each site has been built to its own standard. The ETS team owns the physical layer of these environments — structured cabling, optical fiber and, in partnership with other teams, power distribution, HVAC, fire protection and physical security systems. This role exists to bring one engineering standard to all of them.

As Lead Infrastructure Engineer for Global Office IT Physical Infra, you are the technical reference for IT Room infrastructure across Nubank's global office portfolio. You assess and size environments, define the technical specifications new sites and expansions must meet, and coordinate the vendors and construction teams who build them — so that an IT Room in Mexico City, São Paulo or Miami is built, documented and operated the same way.

This is a senior individual contributor role with technical authority rather than direct reports. You set the standard, you review the projects against it, and you catch the gaps before they become outages.

YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Assessing and sizing IT Rooms for expansion and improvement projects, defining the technical and physical specifications that meet real capacity needs, optimize resource use, and hold to operational standards.

 - Executing deployment projects for new environments and expansions in compliance with established technical specifications, and coordinating deployment logistics end to end while ensuring quality standards throughout.

 - Acting as the interface between internal teams and external vendors — translating business needs into infrastructure requirements, work orders and technical specifications — and managing those vendors and service providers to quality, deadline and compliance with Nubank's standards.

 - Coordinating with construction and engineering teams during the build-out of new offices, ensuring IT Room specifications are met from the earliest project phases rather than retrofitted later.

 - Creating and maintaining clear, current technical documentation — standards, procedures, capacity plans, topology diagrams, bayfaces — so that every site is aligned and auditable.

 - Ensuring alignment between physical infrastructure and IT operations, including cabling changes, equipment installation, capacity planning and structured cabling terminations.

 - Driving continuous improvement in the availability, resilience and efficiency of IT Room physical infrastructure: HVAC, structured cabling, optical fiber, power distribution, generators, UPS units and fire protection.

 - Supporting the assessment of the global IT Room portfolio across corporate offices, identifying gaps and standardization opportunities across multiple sites and countries.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS

 - Solid experience with mission-critical environment infrastructure, including the deployment and operation of physical infrastructure in corporate offices or data center facilities.

 - Strong hands-on command of mission-critical infrastructure systems: HVAC and air conditioning, structured cabling, optical fiber, low-voltage power distribution, UPS units, generators, and fire detection and suppression.

 - Proven experience coordinating deployment projects that run structured cabling, electrical, mechanical and civil scopes simultaneously.

 - Experience managing vendors and service providers on infrastructure projects — from technical specification through execution and acceptance.

 - A consistent track record of creating and maintaining clear technical documentation for infrastructure standards, procedures and projects.

 - A completed degree in Electrical, Electronic or Mechanical Engineering

 - Advanced English enough to work with international vendors, standards and distributed teams.

 - Proficiency in AutoCAD.

 - Availability to work in a hybrid model and to travel to Nubank office locations for site assessments and deployments.

Every transaction at Nubank travels across a network before it reaches a customer. As we grow across countries, accounts and regions, the connectivity layer underneath has to stay fast, segmented, auditable and cost-efficient, without ever becoming the thing that takes the platform down.

As a Senior Cloud Network Engineer on our Cloud Network platform engineering team, you will design, build and operate the cloud network that Nubank’s engineering teams rely on. You will treat the network as software: automated, tested and versioned. This is an IC5 role: you lead through technical depth, design quality and influence, not direct reports.  - Evaluating build vs. buy decisions with data on stability, scalability and cost.

 - Production experience with public cloud networking, preferably AWS: Transit Gateway, VPC design, Direct Connect, PrivateLink, Route 53, NAT/egress patterns and network firewalls. Experience with Azure or GCP networking is also valued. 

 - Experience connecting cloud and on-premises environments: hybrid connectivity, BGP and dynamic routing, IP address management, load balancers and firewalls, planning, deploying and troubleshooting at scale.

jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

About the role
We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to drive the overarching strategy, technical vision, and execution across Nu’s Quality & Developer Experience ecosystem. You will sit at the epicenter of our engineering transformation.

This role goes far beyond traditional quality assurance or testing; you will own the end-to-end (E2E) Developer Experience (DevEx) across the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). From internal developer platform tools and boundary APIs to our suite of testing mechanisms and automated code reviews, your mission will be to architect AI-native systems that drastically reduce review latency, guarantee architectural correctness, and double engineering productivity across Nu. Working alongside our most tenured engineering leaders and reporting into platform leadership, you will serve as the technical authority who brings fresh, market-leading perspectives from high-velocity environments to elevate our foundational standards.

Mission
Architect, scale, and operationalize an AI-transformed Developer Experience & Quality strategy so that:

 - The "Secure and Quality Path" is the Default: Automated mechanisms, linting, and smart context-aware agents enforce strict architectural standards, eliminating code quality degradation caused by high-volume AI code generation.

 - Developer Velocity Doubles (2x): The friction in review latency, pull request (PR) approvals, and continuous integration is systematically dismantled, enabling thousands of engineers to ship features safely to 140M+ customers at unprecedented speeds.

 - SDLC is Re-imagined for AI: Foundational tools across code authorship, testing, boundary APIs, and PR reviews are seamlessly integrated with state-of-the-art AI frameworks, smart LLM evaluations, and context-engineering hooks.

 - Automated Approval Standards are Built: Clear deterministic checks and intelligent human-in-the-loop triggers are established to achieve safe, automated PR approvals without manual bottlenecks.

Core Responsibilities

 - Architect E2E Quality & DevEx Platforms: Define and evolve the multi-year vision for our developer tooling ecosystem—covering internal developer platforms, boundary APIs, test automation suites, and pull request review systems.

 - Lead the AI-Driven Code Review Evolution: Architect automated review mechanisms that leverage multi-model evaluations (e.g., using specialized LLMs to audit generated code), custom IDE/GitHub plugins, and deterministic linting to accelerate PR merge times while preventing code bloat or quality degradation.

 - Define Human-in-the-Loop Boundaries: Set company-wide paradigms for when code changes can be automatically approved and merged versus when human intervention or secondary AI audits are required.

 - Partner & Mentor Across Engineering: Act as a force multiplier by partnering with engineers and product managers, elevating the technical bar and instilling modern, high-velocity DevEx practices.

 - Balance AI Speed with System Integrity: Establish observability, defect-tracking metrics, and safety rails to ensure that rapid AI-assisted development does not introduce structural fragility into Nu's core services.

 - Influence Build vs. Buy Strategy: Evaluate top-tier market tools, AI coding frameworks, and internal platforms to decide when to build bespoke internal agents or integrate emerging third-party tooling.

Key Business & Engineering Metrics You Will Influence

 - Developer Productivity & Velocity
 
 - Achieve a 2x improvement in overall engineering productivity across Nu's engineering organization.

 - PR Review Latency
 
 - Direct reduction in time-to-merge for pull requests across all BUs and countries.

 - Code Base Health & Quality
 
 - Zero degradation in code quality and zero increase in system defects despite exponentially higher volumes of AI-generated code.

 - Automated PR Approvals
 
 - Increase in the percentage of routine, low-risk code changes safely approved and merged via automated mechanisms.

 - Platform Adoption & Satisfaction
 
 - High adoption and developer satisfaction (CSAT) across proprietary internal DevEx tools and boundary APIs

Challenges and Opportunities (What You’ll Own)

 - Navigating Scale: Every change you introduce to the SDLC impacts thousands of microservices and hundreds of engineering teams delivering features to over 140 million users.

 - Tackling "Code Slop" at the Root: As AI agents generate code faster than humans can read it, you will solve one of the industry's newest and hardest problems: keeping codebase quality high without slowing down the team.

 - High Autonomy & Strategic Breadth: You will operate with autonomy, driving horizontal technical alignment without needing micro-oversight, helping lead our joint DevEx technical council.

Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For)

 - Senior IC Leadership Track Record: backend software engineering experience, with a proven track record designing developer platforms, core infra, or DevEx systems at high scale.

 - Deep DevEx & SDLC Expertise: Extensive domain depth in code review systems, test automation platforms, CI/CD pipelines, developer platforms, or static analysis tools built for massive engineering organizations.

 - AI Transformation & Tooling

Experience:

Direct hands-on experience or deep technical familiarity with AI-assisted software development—including LLM evaluation pipelines, GitHub Copilot/agent integrations, prompt/context/graph engineering, or AI-driven code review frameworks.

 - Autonomous & Opinionated Technical Leader: Demonstrable history of driving technical strategy independently, navigating ambiguity, and bringing strong, battle-tested opinions on "what good looks like" in modern software development.

 - High-Velocity Culture Fit: Experience operating in fast-moving, high-bar environments (e.g., top-tier tech firms, high-growth AI/DevEx startups, or elite AI labs) where speed of execution and technical rigor are equally valued.

 

WORK SETUP 

Work model

Hybrid / On-Site

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

About the role
As Nu scales its footprint globally, seamless international money movement is a cornerstone of our growth. We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to own the overarching architecture for Nu’s global Remittance and Cross-Border Payment Platforms. In this role, you will sit at the strategic intersection of high-scale distributed backend systems, foreign exchange (FX) engines, international payment rails, and global compliance platforms. You won't just maintain existing pipelines, you will architect the foundation that enables instant, low-cost, multi-currency money movement for millions of users across borders.Your mission: maintain and grow a resilient, multi-country remittance engine that abstracts away complex global payment rails and regulatory requirements into simple, reliable platform capabilities.

What You Will Own & Build

 - Core Remittance Platform Architecture: Design and evolve the long-term technical vision for multi-currency money movement, FX rate locking, payout routing, and ledgering across international corridors.

 - Global Rail Integration Strategy: Architect plug-and-play integrations with global payout partners, banking networks, and local clearing rails (e.g., PIX, SPEI, FedNow, SWIFT) with ultra-high reliability and low latencies.

 - Resilient Ledgering & FX Management: Build transaction execution engines that guarantee exact-once delivery, deterministic ledger balancing, real-time liquidity management, and auditability under massive concurrency.

 - Compliance & Risk System Abstractions: Partner with AML, KYC, Sanctions Screening, and Regulatory Engineering teams to embed real-time screening seamlessly into payment paths without degrading user experience or throughput.

 - Technical RFC Leadership: Drive cross-organizational consensus on high-impact architectural decisions through detailed RFCs, design reviews, and technical documentation.

 - Engineering Mentorship: Multiply organizational velocity by mentoring senior engineers across payments squads in distributed systems principles, resilience engineering, and payment domain knowledge.

What We Are Looking For

 - Tenure in Backend Software Engineering: Proven track record of designing, operating, and scaling highly available, mission-critical backend distributed platforms in demanding environments (e.g., fintech, payments, banking, or cloud platform infrastructure).

 - Deep Payments Domain Expertise: Hands-on experience building remittance systems, cross-border payments, multi-currency ledger engines, FX execution services, or integrations with international payment clearing systems.

 - Distributed Systems Mastery: High fluency with event-driven architectures, transactional consistency, distributed sagas/orchestration, double-entry accounting engines, and high-concurrency microservices.

 - Platform Mindset: Experience designing clean, developer-friendly APIs, SDKs, and platform boundaries that enable product teams to quickly launch consumer-facing remittance journeys.

 - Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to act as a horizontal technical leader, writing comprehensive design documents (RFCs), guiding executive leadership on technical trade-offs, and building consensus across geographically distributed teams.

 - Language & Location: Fluent English is required for international engineering collaboration. Portuguese or Spanish is a plus. Roles are open in Brazil (hybrid model) or key US hubs.

Why Join Us?

You will join a world-class engineering organization that values technical depth, architectural clarity, and high execution speed. You will own the technology powering one of the most strategic growth vectors at Nu, building cross-border payment infrastructure that unlocks financial freedom for tens of millions of people.

MACHINE LEARNING ENGINEER AT NUBANK

At Nubank, Machine Learning Engineers sit at the core of how we make decisions at scale. We build, train, and deploy models that drive credit, fraud, risk, personalization decisions and a growing set of AI-native experiences for millions of customers every day. We do it with engineering rigor, statistical depth, and a deep focus on impact.

Our MLEs work across the full modeling lifecycle: framing business problems as ML problems, engineering features, training and validating models, and deploying and monitoring them in production. We value small, independent teams that move fast, own their decisions end-to-end, and hold themselves to a high bar for quality and craft.

Increasingly, that work also includes Generative AI and Agentic Engineering. Depending on the problem, our engineers design and build systems that combine models, tools, workflows, evaluation loops, and human oversight to solve real business tasks reliably in production.

We strive for state-of-the-art ML practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team.

 - Large-scale model training and experimentation pipelines

 - Feature engineering and feature stores feeding both batch and real-time models

 - Model deployment and serving in production, with monitoring through operational and business metrics

 - Distributed data processing for training datasets at scale

 - Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS and Kubernetes

 - Experiment tracking, model versioning, and reproducibility tooling

 - A robust data platform built on modern ETL/ELT practices

AS A MACHINE LEARNING ENGINEER, YOU’RE EXPECTED TO:

 - Directly contribute to Nu Colombia’s strategy and performance mainly by building forecasting models and models to assess and decide on marketing investments

 - Frame ambiguous business problems as well-defined modeling problems

 - Design, build and validate machine learning models, ensuring statistical rigor and business relevance

 - Engineer and maintain features and datasets used for training and inference

 - Deploy and maintain ML models in both batch and real-time scenarios, integrating them with other systems and monitoring through operational and business metrics

 - Lead modeling projects end-to-end — from problem framing and stakeholder alignment to delivery, monitoring and iteration

 - Translate business needs into modeling strategies aligned with Nubank's architecture and long-term goals
 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong foundation in statistics, machine learning theory and modeling techniques (e.g. regression, tree-based models, deep learning)
